paragraph: 32 (1) An application for a permit must be made to the Minister by means of a notification that is in the form specified by the Minister and that is dated and signed.

heading: Notification
paragraph: (2) The notification

heading: Notification
paragraph: (a) may relate to both hazardous waste and hazardous recyclable material;

heading: Notification
paragraph: (b) may relate to one or more types of hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material;

heading: Notification
paragraph: (c) may relate to one or more shipments that contain the hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material; and

heading: Notification
paragraph: (d) must involve only

heading: Notification
paragraph: (i) one facility in Canada from which the hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material is to be shipped, and

heading: Notification
paragraph: (ii) one receiving facility in Canada to which the hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material is to be delivered.

heading: Types of hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material
paragraph: (3) The hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material must be categorized into separate types by reference to all of the information set out in subparagraphs 3(i)(i) to (iii) of Schedule 3 and each type for which all of that information is the same must be recorded as a line entry in the notification.

heading: Information in notification
paragraph: (4) The information set out in subparagraphs 3(i)(i) to (iii) of Schedule 3 must be included in each line entry and the remaining information set out in item 3 of that Schedule must be included in the notification along with a certification, which is dated and signed by the individual who provides the information, that

heading: Information in notification
paragraph: (a) the applicant satisfies the conditions set out in section 31;

heading: Information in notification
paragraph: (b) the applicant and all authorized carriers that are to transport the hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material in Canada hold the liability insurance referred to in Division 7 of this Part;

heading: Information in notification
paragraph: (c) the applicant will ensure that the hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material is managed in a manner that protects the environment and human health against the adverse effects that may result from it; and

heading: Information in notification
paragraph: (d) the information provided is accurate and complete.

heading: Timing and manner of notification
paragraph: (5) The notification must be made in the manner specified by the Minister

heading: Timing and manner of notification
paragraph: (a) within 12 months before the day on which the shipment that contains the hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material is to be shipped, in the case of a single shipment; and

heading: Timing and manner of notification
paragraph: (b) within 12 months before the day on which the first shipment is to be shipped, in the case of multiple shipments.

heading: Refusal to issue permit
paragraph: 33 The Minister must refuse to issue a permit if

heading: Refusal to issue permit
paragraph: (a) an authorization referred to in subparagraph 185(1)(b)(i) of the Act is not obtained;

heading: Refusal to issue permit
paragraph: (b) the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that, if the permit were issued, the movement of hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material, or the disposal of hazardous waste or recycling of hazardous recyclable material, under the permit would not comply with the Act, these Regulations or conditions to an authorization imposed by the jurisdiction of destination or a country of transit; or

heading: Refusal to issue permit
paragraph: (c) the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that false or misleading information was provided in the notification under section 32.

heading: Period of validity of permit
paragraph: 34 A permit is valid for the period set out in it, which cannot be longer than

heading: Period of validity of permit
paragraph: (a) 36 months after the day on which it is issued, in the case of hazardous recyclable material

heading: Period of validity of permit
paragraph: (i) that is to be conveyed in transit only through a country that is subject to OECD Decision C(2001)107/FINAL, and

heading: Period of validity of permit
paragraph: (ii) that is to be recycled by means of a final recycling operation at a receiving facility that is a pre-consented recovery facility referred to in Case 2 in Chapter II. D (2) of OECD Decision C(2001)107/FINAL, as amended from time to time, to the extent that the amendments are binding on Canada; and

heading: Period of validity of permit
paragraph: (b) 12 months after the day on which it is issued, in any other case.

heading: New application
paragraph: 35 If a permit needs to be amended the permit holder must apply for a new permit.

heading: Suspension of permit required
paragraph: 36 (1) The Minister must suspend a permit if an authority referred to in subparagraph 185(1)(b)(i) of the Act withdraws an authorization referred to in that subparagraph.

heading: Optional suspension of permit
paragraph: (2) The Minister may suspend a permit if the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that

heading: Optional suspension of permit
paragraph: (a) the permit holder no longer satisfies the conditions set out in section 31;

heading: Optional suspension of permit
paragraph: (b) the movement of hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material, or the disposal of hazardous waste or recycling of hazardous recyclable material, under the permit does not comply - or will not comply - with the Act, these Regulations or the conditions of an authorization imposed by the jurisdiction of destination or a country of transit;

heading: Optional suspension of permit
paragraph: (c) false or misleading information was provided in the notification under section 32;

heading: Optional suspension of permit
paragraph: (d) as a result of a natural or artificial disaster or another emergency, the movement of hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material, or the disposal of hazardous waste or recycling of hazardous recyclable material, cannot be in accordance with the permit; or

heading: Optional suspension of permit
paragraph: (e) the hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material is not being managed in a manner that will protect the environment and human health against the adverse effects that may result from it.

heading: Notice
paragraph: (3) The Minister must notify the permit holder of the suspension, the reasons for it and the period during which it applies.

heading: Manner of notice
paragraph: (4) The Minister notifies the permit holder when the Minister

heading: Manner of notice
paragraph: (a) informs the permit holder at their last known address or email address that the notice of the suspension and the reasons for it are available through a generally accessible electronic source and identifies the location of the notice and reasons; or

heading: Manner of notice
paragraph: (b) sends the notice and reasons to the permit holder's last known address or email address.

heading: Representations
paragraph: (5) The permit holder may make written representations to the Minister as to why the permit should be reinstated within the period of the suspension.

heading: Reinstatement of permit
paragraph: (6) The Minister may reinstate the permit only if the matter that gave rise to the suspension has been resolved or corrected during the period of the suspension.

heading: Revocation of permit
paragraph: 37 (1) The Minister must revoke a permit if the matter that gave rise to a suspension has not been resolved or corrected within the period of suspension or if the permit holder requests the revocation.

heading: Notice
paragraph: (2) Before revoking a permit, the Minister must notify the permit holder of the proposed revocation and the reasons for it.

heading: Manner of notice
paragraph: (3) The Minister notifies the permit holder when the Minister

heading: Manner of notice
paragraph: (a) informs the permit holder at their last known address or email address that the notice of the proposed revocation and the reasons for it are available through a generally accessible electronic source and identifies the location of the notice and reasons; or

heading: Manner of notice
paragraph: (b) sends the notice and reasons to the permit holder's last known address or email address.

heading: Date of revocation
paragraph: (5) The revocation of a permit is not effective until 20 days after the day on which the Minister notifies the permit holder.

heading: Conditions
paragraph: 38 For the purposes of paragraph 185(1)(c) of the Act, the prescribed conditions for the export of hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material and its import to Canada under one or more permits that are held by a permit holder after it is conveyed in transit through a foreign country are the following:

heading: Conditions
paragraph: (a) the movement, and the disposal or recycling, of the hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material must be in accordance with the permit or permits;

heading: Conditions
paragraph: (b) at the time of export,

heading: Conditions
paragraph: (i) the export from and import to Canada must not be prohibited under the laws of Canada, and

heading: Conditions
paragraph: (ii) the conveyance in transit of the hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material through a country must not be prohibited by that country;

heading: Conditions
paragraph: (c) the permit holder and all authorized carriers that transport the hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material in Canada must hold the liability insurance referred to in Division 7 of this Part;

heading: Conditions
paragraph: (d) each shipment that contains hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material must be recorded in a separate movement document in accordance with sections 39 and 40;

heading: Conditions
paragraph: (e) the movement document completed in accordance with section 40 must be provided, in accordance with that section, to the Minister and the authorities of the provinces where the facility from which the shipment was shipped and the receiving facility are located;

heading: Conditions
paragraph: (f) while they transport the shipment, every authorized carrier must produce the permit or permits, and Parts A and B of the movement document completed in accordance with section 40, when they are required to do so to demonstrate that the movement of the shipment complies with this Division;

heading: Conditions
paragraph: (g) the permit or permits, and Parts A and B of the movement document completed in accordance with section 40, must be provided to a customs office when the hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material that is contained in the shipment is required to be reported at the customs office under section 12 or 95 of the Customs Act; and

heading: Conditions
paragraph: (h) the documents referred to in section 41 must be kept in accordance with that section.

heading: Unit of measure
paragraph: 39 The unit of measure set out in the movement document to describe the quantity of a type of hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material must be the same as that used in the applicable permit.

heading: Part A
paragraph: 40 (1) Before a shipment that contains hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material is shipped from a facility under one or more permits, Part A of the movement document must be completed as follows:

heading: Part A
paragraph: (a) each type of hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material that is contained in the shipment and that was recorded as a line entry in the notification under subsection 32(3) must be recorded as a line entry;

heading: Part A
paragraph: (b) each line entry must include the reference number of the notification, the line entry number and the information that was included in the line entry in the notification under subsection 32(4), with the exception of the information referred to in clauses 3(i)(iii)(A), (F) and (L) of Schedule 3;

heading: Part A
paragraph: (c) the remaining information set out in subitem 1(3) of Schedule 10 and a certification that the information provided is accurate and complete must be included; and

heading: Part A
paragraph: (d) the individual who provides the information and certification must date and sign Part A.

heading: Part A to Minister and provincial authorities
paragraph: (2) Within three working days after the day on which the shipment is shipped from the facility, Part A of the movement document must be provided, in the form and manner specified by the Minister to the Minister and to the authorities of the provinces where the facility and the receiving facility are located, if those authorities ask for it.

heading: Part B
paragraph: (3) Each authorized carrier that transports the shipment must complete Part B of the movement document - with Part A completed in accordance with subsection (1) - by including the information set out in item 2 of Schedule 10 and a certification that the information provided is accurate and complete. The individual who provides the information and certification must date and sign Part B.

heading: Part C
paragraph: (4) Immediately after the shipment is delivered to the receiving facility, Part C of the movement document - with Part A completed in accordance with subsection (1) - must be completed as follows:

heading: Part C
paragraph: (a) the information set out in subitem 3(1) of Schedule 10 and a certification that the information provided is accurate and complete must be included; and

heading: Part C
paragraph: (b) the individual who provides the information and certification must date and sign Part C.

heading: Parts B and C to Minister and provincial authorities
paragraph: (5) Within three working days after the day on which the shipment is delivered to the receiving facility, Part B of the movement document completed by each authorized carrier and Part C of the movement document must be provided, in the form and manner specified by the Minister, to the Minister and to the authorities of the provinces where the facility from which the shipment was shipped and the receiving facility are located, if those authorities ask for it.

heading: Delivery to receiving facility
paragraph: (6) For the purposes of subsections (4) and (5), delivery of a shipment to a receiving facility occurs when the shipment arrives at the receiving facility, regardless of whether or when hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material that is contained in the shipment is accepted by the receiving facility.

heading: Permit holder
paragraph: 41 (1) The permit holder must keep the following documents that relate to hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material that is transported under one or more permits at their principal place of business in Canada for a period of five years after the latest day on which any of the permits expires:

heading: Permit holder
paragraph: (a) all documents that are necessary to demonstrate their compliance with this Division; and

heading: Permit holder
paragraph: (b) all documents that are necessary to demonstrate that they hold the liability insurance referred to in Division 7 of this Part.

heading: Authorized carrier
paragraph: (2) Each authorized carrier that has a place of business in Canada must keep the following documents that relate to a shipment that contains hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material that they transported under one or more permits at their principal place of business in Canada for a period of five years after the latest day on which any of the permits expires:

heading: Authorized carrier
paragraph: (a) all documents that are necessary to demonstrate that the movement of the shipment complies with this Division; and

heading: Authorized carrier
paragraph: (b) if the authorized carrier transported the shipment in Canada, all documents that are necessary to demonstrate that they hold the liability insurance referred to in Division 7 of this Part.

heading: Application
paragraph: 42 (1) An application for a permit to convey hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material in transit through Canada may be made by any person and must be made to the Minister by means of a notification that is in the form specified by the Minister and that is dated and signed.

heading: Notification
paragraph: (2) The notification

heading: Notification
paragraph: (a) may relate to both hazardous waste and hazardous recyclable material;

heading: Notification
paragraph: (b) may relate to one or more types of hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material;

heading: Notification
paragraph: (c) may relate to one or more shipments that contain the hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material; and

heading: Notification
paragraph: (d) must involve only

heading: Notification
paragraph: (i) one foreign exporter,

heading: Notification
paragraph: (ii) one foreign importer,

heading: Notification
paragraph: (iii) one facility in the country of origin from which the hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material is to be shipped, and

heading: Notification
paragraph: (iv) one receiving facility in the country of destination to which the hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material is to be delivered.

heading: Types of hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material
paragraph: (3) The hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material must be categorized into separate types by reference to all of the information set out in subparagraphs 4(i)(i) to (iii) of Schedule 3 and each type for which all of that information is the same must be recorded as a line entry in the notification.

heading: Information in notification
paragraph: (4) The information set out in subparagraphs 4(i)(i) to (iii) of Schedule 3 must be included in each line entry and the remaining information set out in item 4 of that Schedule must be included in the notification along with a certification, which is dated and signed by the individual who provides the information, that

heading: Information in notification
paragraph: (a) all authorized carriers that are to transport the hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material in Canada hold the liability insurance referred to in Division 7 of this Part;

heading: Information in notification
paragraph: (b) the applicant will ensure that the hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material is managed in a manner that protects the environment and human health against the adverse effects that may result from it; and

heading: Information in notification
paragraph: (c) the information provided is accurate and complete.

heading: Timing and manner of notification
paragraph: (5) The notification must be made in the manner specified by the Minister

heading: Timing and manner of notification
paragraph: (a) within 12 months before the day on which the shipment that contains the hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material is to be shipped, in the case of a single shipment; and

heading: Timing and manner of notification
paragraph: (b) within 12 months before the day on which the first shipment is to be shipped, in the case of multiple shipments.

heading: Refusal to issue permit
paragraph: 43 The Minister must refuse to issue a permit if the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that

heading: Refusal to issue permit
paragraph: (a) if the permit were issued, the transportation of hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material under the permit would not comply with the Act or these Regulations; or

heading: Refusal to issue permit
paragraph: (b) false or misleading information was provided in the notification under section 42.

heading: Period of validity of permit
paragraph: 44 A permit is valid for the period set out in it, which cannot be longer than

heading: Period of validity of permit
paragraph: (a) 36 months after the day on which it is issued, in the case of hazardous recyclable material, if

heading: Period of validity of permit
paragraph: (i) the country of origin is subject to OECD Decision C(2001)107/FINAL and, if applicable, the hazardous recyclable material is to be conveyed in transit only through a country that is subject to that Decision, and

heading: Period of validity of permit
paragraph: (ii) the hazardous recyclable material is to be recycled by means of a final recycling operation at a receiving facility that is a pre-consented recovery facility referred to in Case 2 in Chapter II. D (2) of OECD Decision C(2001)107/FINAL, as amended from time to time, to the extent that the amendments are binding on Canada; and

heading: Period of validity of permit
paragraph: (b) 12 months after the day on which it is issued, in any other case.

heading: New application
paragraph: 45 If a permit needs to be amended the permit holder must apply for a new permit.

heading: Suspension of permit required
paragraph: 46 (1) The Minister must suspend a permit when, or at any time after, a shipment enters Canada under the permit if

heading: Suspension of permit required
paragraph: (a) the Minister becomes aware that the competent authority of the country of destination or of a country through which the hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material is to be conveyed in transit after it has left Canada has not authorized the import or conveyance in transit, as the case may be; or

heading: Suspension of permit required
paragraph: (b) the competent authority of one of those countries withdraws its authorization.

heading: Optional suspension of permit
paragraph: (2) The Minister may suspend a permit if the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that

heading: Optional suspension of permit
paragraph: (a) false or misleading information was provided in the notification under section 42;

heading: Optional suspension of permit
paragraph: (b) the movement of hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material, or the disposal of hazardous waste or recycling of hazardous recyclable material, under the permit will not comply with the Act, these Regulations or the conditions of an authorization imposed by the jurisdiction of destination or a country of transit;

heading: Optional suspension of permit
paragraph: (c) the transportation of hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material under the permit does not comply with the Act or these Regulations;

heading: Optional suspension of permit
paragraph: (d) as a result of a natural or artificial disaster or another emergency, the transportation of hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material cannot be in accordance with the permit; or

heading: Optional suspension of permit
paragraph: (e) the hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material is not being managed in a manner that will protect the environment and human health against the adverse effects that may result from it.

heading: Notice
paragraph: (3) The Minister must notify the permit holder of the suspension, the reasons for it and the period during which it applies.

heading: Manner of notice
paragraph: (4) The Minister notifies the permit holder when the Minister

heading: Manner of notice
paragraph: (a) informs the permit holder at their last known address or email address that the notice of the suspension and the reasons for it are available through a generally accessible electronic source and identifies the location of the notice and reasons; or

heading: Manner of notice
paragraph: (b) sends the notice and reasons to the permit holder's last known address or email address.

heading: Representations
paragraph: (5) The permit holder may make written representations to the Minister as to why the permit should be reinstated within the period of the suspension.

heading: Reinstatement of permit
paragraph: (6) The Minister may reinstate the permit only if the matter that gave rise to the suspension has been resolved or corrected during the period of the suspension.

heading: Revocation of permit
paragraph: 47 (1) The Minister must revoke a permit if the matter that gave rise to a suspension has not been resolved or corrected within the period of suspension or if the permit holder requests the revocation.

heading: Notice
paragraph: (2) Before revoking a permit, the Minister must notify the permit holder of the proposed revocation and the reasons for it.

heading: Manner of notice

paragraph: 78 (1) The plan referred to in subsection 188(1) of the Act must contain

heading: Content of plan

heading: Content of plan

paragraph: (A) the applicable codes set out in column 1 of Part 1 of Schedule 11,

heading: Content of plan

heading: Content of plan
paragraph: (C) the letter L when the hazardous waste is a liquid, the letter P when it is a sludge, the letter S when it is a solid and the letter G when it is a gas, followed in each case by the applicable code set out in column 1 of Part 2 of Schedule 11,

heading: Content of plan
paragraph: (D) the applicable codes set out in column 1 of Part 3 of Schedule 11,

heading: Content of plan
paragraph: (E) the applicable codes set out in column 1 of Part 4 of Schedule 11,

heading: Content of plan
paragraph: (F) the applicable code set out in column 1 of Part 5 of Schedule 11,

heading: Content of plan
paragraph: (G) the applicable codes set out in Annex I or II to the Convention, as it read on May 5, 1992, as amended from time to time, to the extent that the amendments are binding on Canada,

heading: Content of plan
paragraph: (H) the applicable code, if any, set out in List A of Annex VIII to the Convention, as it read on May 5, 1992, as amended from time to time, to the extent that the amendments are binding on Canada,

heading: Content of plan
paragraph: (I) in the case of hazardous waste that is set out in column 2 of Schedule 6 or 12 or column 3 of Schedule 8 or that contains a substance that is set out in column 3 of Schedule 7, the applicable codes, if any, set out in column 1 of the applicable Schedule,

heading: Content of plan
paragraph: (J) in the case of hazardous waste that produces a leachate that contains one or more environmentally hazardous constituents, the applicable codes, if any, set out in column 1 of Schedule 2 for each environmentally hazardous constituent, and

heading: Content of plan
paragraph: (K) the applicable code, if any, set out in column 1 of Schedule 5 for every persistent organic pollutant that is contained in the hazardous waste;

heading: Content of plan
paragraph: (b) if the exporter generates the hazardous waste referred to in the plan, the name and description of the process that generates the hazardous waste and of the activity in which that process is used;

heading: Content of plan
paragraph: (c) the origin of the hazardous waste if the exporter does not generate it;

heading: Content of plan
paragraph: (d) the quantity of hazardous waste exported at the start of the implementation of the plan and the quantity of export reduction to be achieved at each stage of the plan;

heading: Content of plan
paragraph: (e) a description of how the exporter will reduce or phase out exports of the hazardous waste referred to in the plan;

heading: Content of plan
paragraph: (f) the options considered for reducing or phasing out exports of the hazardous waste referred to in the plan, including options for disposing of it in Canada;

heading: Content of plan

heading: Content of plan
paragraph: (h) for each stage of the plan, an estimate of the quantity, in kilograms or litres, of goods produced that generate the hazardous waste referred to in the plan and a description of the impact of any changes to the quantity produced on the reduction or phasing out of exports of that hazardous waste.

heading: Retention of plan
paragraph: (2) A person who submits a plan to the Minister must keep a copy of the plan at their principal place of business in Canada for a period of five years after the day on which the last stage of the plan is completed.

heading: Conditions
paragraph: 79 For the purposes of subsection 189(1) of the Act, the movement by a person of hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material within Canada is subject to the following conditions:

heading: Conditions
paragraph: (a) the shipment that contains the hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material must be shipped by a consignor to a site that is owned, operated or otherwise controlled by a consignee;

heading: Conditions
paragraph: (b) the shipment must be recorded in a movement document in accordance with section 80;

heading: Conditions
paragraph: (c) the movement document completed in accordance with section 80 must be provided, in accordance with that section, to the consignor and to the authorities of the provinces from which the shipment is shipped and to which it is delivered;

heading: Conditions
paragraph: (d) the shipment must be transported only by authorized carriers;

heading: Conditions
paragraph: (e) while they transport the shipment, every authorized carrier must produce Parts A and B of the movement document completed in accordance with section 80 when they are required to do so to demonstrate that the movement of the shipment complies with this Part; and

heading: Conditions
paragraph: (f) the documents referred to in section 81 must be kept in accordance with that section.

heading: Part A
paragraph: 80 (1) Before a shipment that contains hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material is shipped by a consignor, the consignor must ensure that Part A of the movement document is completed as follows:

heading: Part A
paragraph: (a) the hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material must be categorized into separate types by reference to all of the information set out in subparagraphs 1(g)(i) and (ii) of Schedule 4;

heading: Part A
paragraph: (b) each type of hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material for which all of that information is the same must be recorded as a line entry;

heading: Part A
paragraph: (c) the information set out in paragraph 1(g) of Schedule 4 must be included in each line entry;

heading: Part A
paragraph: (d) the remaining information set out in item 1 of Schedule 4 and a certification that the information provided is accurate and complete must be included; and

heading: Part A
paragraph: (e) the individual who provides the information and certification must date and sign Part A.

heading: Part A to provincial authorities
paragraph: (2) Within three working days after the day on which the shipment is shipped, the consignor must ensure that Part A of the movement document is provided, in the form and manner specified by the Minister, to the authorities of the provinces from which the shipment is shipped and to which it is or is to be delivered, if those authorities ask for it.

heading: Part B
paragraph: (3) Each authorized carrier must

heading: Part B
paragraph: (a) complete Part B of the movement document - with Part A completed in accordance with subsection (1) - by including the information set out in item 2 of Schedule 4 and a certification that the information provided is accurate and complete; and

heading: Part B
paragraph: (b) ensure that the individual who provides the information and certification dates and signs Part B.

heading: Part C
paragraph: (4) Within three working days after the day on which the shipment is delivered to the site, the consignee must ensure that

heading: Part C
paragraph: (a) Part C of the movement document - with Part A completed in accordance with subsection (1) - is completed by including the information set out in item 3 of Schedule 4 and a certification that the information provided is accurate and complete;

heading: Part C
paragraph: (b) the individual who provides the information and certification dates and signs Part C; and

heading: Part C
paragraph: (c) Part B of the movement document completed by each authorized carrier and Part C of the movement document are provided to the consignor.

heading: Parts B and C - provincial authorities
paragraph: (5) The consignee must ensure that Part B completed by each authorized carrier and Part C of the movement document are provided to the authorities of the provinces from which the shipment is shipped and to which it is delivered, if those authorities ask for it.

heading: Delivery to site
paragraph: (6) For the purposes of subsection (4), delivery of a shipment to the site occurs when the shipment arrives at the site, regardless of when hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material that is contained in the shipment is accepted by the consignee.

heading: Consignor
paragraph: 81 (1) The consignor must keep all documents that are necessary to demonstrate their compliance with this Part at their principal place of business in Canada for a period of five years after the day on which the shipment is shipped.

heading: Consignee
paragraph: (2) The consignee must keep all documents that are necessary to demonstrate their compliance with this Part at their principal place of business in Canada for a period of five years after the day on which the shipment is delivered to the site.

heading: Authorized carrier
paragraph: (3) Each authorized carrier must keep all documents that are necessary to demonstrate that the movement of the shipment complies with this Part at their principal place of business in Canada for a period of five years after the day on which they took possession of the shipment.

heading: Delivery to site
paragraph: (4) For the purposes of subsection (2), delivery of a shipment to the site occurs when the shipment arrives at the site, regardless of when hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material that is contained in the shipment is accepted by the consignee.

heading: Previous notices and permits
paragraph: 94 If a notice is submitted to the Minister as an application for a permit under the Export and Import of Hazardous Waste and Hazardous Recyclable Material Regulations, or a permit is issued in connection with such a notice, those Regulations, as they read immediately before the coming into force of these Regulations, apply to the notice or the permit and to the movement, and the disposal or recycling, of hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material under the permit.

paragraph: (g) for each type of hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material that is recorded as a line entry in the movement document,

heading: Movement Document - Part A
paragraph: (i) the shipping name and description that are set out in column 2 of Schedule 1 to the Transportation of Dangerous Goods Regulations and are associated with the UN number referred to in that line entry,

heading: Movement Document - Part A
paragraph: (ii) the quantity of the hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material in kilograms or litres,

heading: Movement Document - Part A
paragraph: (iii) the number of containers used, if applicable, and the code 01 when the container is a drum, 02 when it is a tank, 03 when the hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material is shipped in bulk, 04 when the container is a carton, 05 when it is a bag, 06 when it is roll off or lugger, 07 when it is palletized, wrapped with plastic wrap and not in any other container, 08 when it is a mix of containers or 09 in any other case, and

heading: Movement Document - Part A
paragraph: (iv) the applicable tariff item as defined in subsection 2(1) of the Customs Tariff; and

heading: Movement Document - Part A
paragraph: (h) the date on which the shipment is to be shipped and the date on which it is scheduled to be delivered to the facility.

heading: Movement Document - Part B
paragraph: 2 The following information in Part B is required from an authorized carrier:

heading: Movement Document - Part B
paragraph: (a) the authorized carrier's name, telephone number, email address, mailing address and unique identification number;

heading: Movement Document - Part B
paragraph: (b) the name and telephone number of the individual who signs Part B;

heading: Movement Document - Part B
paragraph: (c) in the case of an authorized carrier that is to transport a shipment that contains hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material as described in Part A into or out of Canada, the port and date of any entry into, and of any exit out of, Canada; and

heading: Movement Document - Part B
paragraph: (d) a confirmation

heading: Movement Document - Part B
paragraph: (i) that the authorized carrier has received, and will transport, the shipment in accordance with the permit or permits, and

heading: Movement Document - Part B
paragraph: (ii) if applicable, that they are to deliver the shipment to the receiving facility referred to in Part A of the movement document.

heading: Movement Document - Part C
paragraph: 3 (1) In the case of an import to or an export from Canada, or an export from, and import to, Canada following transit through a foreign country, the following information is required in Part C:

heading: Movement Document - Part C
paragraph: (a) the receiving facility's name, telephone number, email address, civic address and unique identification number;

heading: Movement Document - Part C
paragraph: (b) the name and telephone number of the individual who signs Part C;

heading: Movement Document - Part C

heading: Movement Document - Part C
paragraph: (d) for each type of hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material that is recorded as a line entry in the movement document, the quantity of the hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material, in kilograms or litres, that was received.

heading: Movement Document - Part C
paragraph: (2) In the case of a return to Canada or to a foreign country of origin, the following information is required in Part C:

heading: Movement Document - Part C
paragraph: (a) the name, telephone number, email address, civic address and unique identification number of the facility to which the shipment was delivered;

heading: Movement Document - Part C
paragraph: (b) the name and telephone number of the individual who signs Part C;

heading: Movement Document - Part C

heading: Movement Document - Part C
paragraph: (d) for each type of hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material that is recorded as a line entry in the movement document, the quantity of the hazardous waste or hazardous recyclable material, in kilograms or litres, that was received.

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: 1		  (1) In this regulation:

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: "Act" means the Water Sustainability Act;

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: "classification" means the classification of a dam determined in accordance with section 3 [dam failure consequences classification] or 31 [transition - dam failure consequences classification];

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: "dam" means

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (a) a barrier constructed for the purpose of enabling the storage or diversion of water diverted from a stream or an aquifer, or both, and

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (b) other works that are incidental to or necessary for the barrier described in paragraph (a);

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: "dam safety officer" means an engineer or an officer who is designated in writing by the comptroller as a dam safety officer;

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: "emergency plan", in relation to a dam, means

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (a) a plan

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (i)  that, immediately before February 29, 2016, was the emergency preparedness plan for the dam under the former regulation, or

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (ii)  that is prepared under section 9 [dam emergency plan] by an owner of the dam and accepted by a dam safety officer, and

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (b) the revisions, if any, to the plan referred to in paragraph (a) (i) or (ii), as applicable, set out in a record prepared by an owner of the dam and accepted by a dam safety officer;

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: "engineering professional"  means a person who is registered under the Professional Governance Act as a professional engineer or professional licensee engineering;

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: "formal inspection", in relation to a dam, means a thorough on-site inspection of the dam and dam site conducted by a person who is an owner of the dam or an agent of an owner of the dam and who is responsible for the safety of the dam;

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: "former regulation" means the British Columbia Dam Safety Regulation, B.C. Reg. 44/2000;

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: "hazardous conditions", in relation to a dam, means conditions, including, without limitation, defects or insufficiencies of the dam, that

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (a) are or are likely to be hazardous to the dam, or

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (b) may reasonably be anticipated to cause all or part of the dam, or any operation or action at or in connection with the dam, to be or become potentially hazardous to

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (i)  public safety,

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (ii)  the environment, or

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (iii)  land or other property;

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: "instrumentation", in relation to a dam, means instruments and equipment used to measure the following:

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (a) hydrological and hydraulic characteristics in relation to the dam, including, without limitation,

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (i)  water levels in the dam and reservoir and at the weirs, and

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (ii)  water flow throughout the dam;

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (b) water clarity in the reservoir and below the dam;

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (c) seismic, geological and geotechnical characteristics in relation to the dam, including, without limitation, movement of the dam, seismic activity, pore pressures and stresses applied to the dam;

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (d) temperature variations of the dam;

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (e) weather conditions that may affect the operation of the dam;

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (f) other parameters in relation to the dam;

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: "jurisdictional area", in relation to a local emergency authority, means the jurisdictional area, as defined in the Emergency Program Act, for which the local authority has responsibility under that Act;

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: "local authority" has the same meaning as in the Emergency Program Act;

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: "local emergency authority", in relation to a dam, means a local authority that is, under subsection (2), a local emergency authority for the dam;

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: "operation, maintenance and surveillance manual", in relation to a dam, means

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (a) a manual

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (i)  that, immediately before February 29, 2016, was the operation, maintenance and surveillance manual for the dam under the former regulation, or

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (ii)  that is prepared under section 8 [operation, maintenance and surveillance manual] by an owner of the dam and accepted by a dam safety officer, and

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (b) the revisions, if any, to the manual referred to in paragraph (a) (i) or (ii), as applicable, set out in a record prepared by an owner of the dam and accepted by a dam safety officer;

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: "owner", in relation to a dam, means

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (a) the following persons:

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (i)  a person who is a licensee in relation to a licence for the dam;

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (ii)  a person who must under the Act, but does not, hold a licence for the dam;

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (iii)  a person who was a licensee in relation to a licence for the dam immediately before the suspension, cancellation, termination or abandonment of the licence, and

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (b) if there is no person to whom paragraph (a) applies, the following persons:

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (i)  an owner, as defined in the Act, of the land on which the dam is located;

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (ii)  a person who had the dam constructed;

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: "potential safety hazard", in relation to a dam, means conditions that are not yet, but have the potential to become, hazardous conditions in relation to the dam;

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: "Provincial Emergency Program" means the Provincial Emergency Program continued under section 2 (1) [Provincial Emergency Program] of the Emergency Program Act;

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: "site surveillance" means the monitoring of a dam and the area surrounding or adjacent to the dam

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (a) through visual observation, and

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (b) if there is instrumentation relating to the dam, through the systematic collection of instrumentation readings and analysis and interpretation of the readings;

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: "submit", in relation to a record that, under this regulation, must or may be submitted to a dam safety officer, means submit the record in the manner required under section 25 (1) [submission of records to and acceptance of records by dam safety officer].

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (2) For the purposes of the definition of "local emergency authority" in subsection (1), a local authority is a local emergency authority for a dam if any land in the jurisdictional area of the local authority

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (a) is in the immediate vicinity of the dam or the reservoir of the dam, or

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (b) is downstream or downslope of the dam and may be adversely affected by

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (i)  a complete or partial collapse of the dam, or

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (ii)  an uncontrolled release of all or part of the water impounded by the dam.

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (3) For the purposes of this regulation, the construction of a newly constructed dam is conclusively deemed to be completed on the date on which the dam first becomes capable of storing or diverting water.

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (4) For the purposes of sections 2 (1) [application of regulation to minor dam] and 7 [application of Part 3], the height of a dam is the vertical distance to the top of the dam measured,

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (a) in the case of a dam across a stream, from the natural bed of the stream at the downstream outside limit of the dam, and

heading: Definitions and interpretation
paragraph: (b) in the case of a dam that is not across a stream, from the lowest elevation at the outside limit of the dam.

heading: Application of regulation to minor dam
paragraph: 2		  (1) Unless otherwise ordered under subsection (2), this regulation does not apply to a dam that meets both of the following criteria:

heading: Application of regulation to minor dam
paragraph: (a) the dam is less than 7.5 m in height;

heading: Application of regulation to minor dam
paragraph: (b) the dam is capable of impounding at full supply level a maximum total storage volume of water in the reservoir of the dam of 10 000 m3 or less.

heading: Application of regulation to minor dam
paragraph: (2) Subject to section 7 [application of Part 3], the comptroller or a water manager may order that this regulation applies to a dam described in subsection (1) of this section if the comptroller or water manager is satisfied that the dam is or may become potentially hazardous to

heading: Application of regulation to minor dam
paragraph: (a) public safety,

heading: Application of regulation to minor dam
paragraph: (b) the environment, or

heading: Application of regulation to minor dam
paragraph: (c) land or other property.

heading: Dam failure consequences classification
paragraph:
3
		  (1) An owner of a newly constructed dam must, as soon as practicable and, in any event, no later than 60 days, after completion of the construction of the dam,

heading: Dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (a) determine the classification of the dam in accordance with section 2 [determination of classification] of Schedule 1, and

heading: Dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (b) submit to a dam safety officer, immediately after the determination is completed, a record setting out a proposed classification for the dam.

heading: Dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (2) An owner of a dam for which the classification has been determined under the former regulation or this regulation must,

heading: Dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (a) no less frequently than is specified in item 1 of the table in Schedule 2 for the classification of the dam, redetermine the classification of the dam in accordance with section 2 of Schedule 1 to assess whether the classification of the dam has changed, and

heading: Dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (b) if the classification of the dam has changed, submit to a dam safety officer, immediately after the redetermination is completed, a record setting out a proposed new classification for the dam.

heading: Dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (3) Despite subsections (1) and (2), the comptroller or a water manager may order an owner of a dam to comply with subsection (1) or (2), as applicable, on or before a specified date.

heading: Dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (4) On receipt of a record under subsection (1) (b) or (2) (b) or paragraph (b) (ii) of this subsection from an owner of a dam proposing a classification, or a new classification, for the dam, or on receipt of information or records from an owner of a dam under paragraph (b) (i) of this subsection, a dam safety officer must give written notice to the owner of the dam who submitted the record or the information or records, as the case may be, advising that

heading: Dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (a) the dam safety officer has accepted the classification, or new classification, proposed by the owner, or

heading: Dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (b) the dam safety officer has not accepted the classification, or new classification, proposed by the owner and requiring the owner to submit to the dam safety officer, on or before the date specified by the dam safety officer, either of the following:

heading: Dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (i)  information or records, or further information or records, as the case may be, that demonstrate that the classification, or new classification, proposed by the owner is correct;

heading: Dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (ii)  a record setting out a different proposed classification, or new classification, as the case may be, for the dam.

heading: Dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (5) In the case of a dam described in subsection (1),

heading: Dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (a) until a record setting out a proposed classification for the dam is submitted under subsection (1) (b), the classification of the dam is deemed, for the purposes of this regulation, to be significant, and

heading: Dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (b) between the date on which the record referred to in paragraph (a) of this subsection is submitted to a dam safety officer and the date on which a dam safety officer gives notice under subsection (4) (a) in relation to the dam,

heading: Dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (i)  if the proposed classification for the dam is high, very high or extreme, the classification of the dam is deemed, for the purposes of this regulation, to be the proposed classification, and

heading: Dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (ii)  if the proposed classification for the dam is low or significant, the classification of the dam is deemed, for the purposes of this regulation, to be significant.

heading: Dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (6) In the case of a dam described in subsection (2) in respect of which an owner of the dam submits under subsection (2) (b) a record setting out a proposed new classification for the dam, between the date on which the record is submitted and the date on which a dam safety officer gives notice under subsection (4) (a) in relation to the dam, the classification of the dam is deemed, for the purposes of this regulation, to be the more severe in consequence of the existing classification and the proposed new classification.

heading: Dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (7) Despite subsections (5) and (6), if the comptroller or a water manager makes an order under subsection (3),

heading: Dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (a) the comptroller or water manager may, in the order, specify a classification for the dam that applies between the date on which the order is made and the date on which a dam safety officer gives notice under subsection (4) (a) in relation to the dam, and

heading: Dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (b) the classification of the dam is, during the period described in paragraph (a) of this subsection, deemed for the purposes of this regulation to be the classification specified in the order.

heading: Dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (8) For certainty, the requirements of this regulation that apply in relation to a classification of a dam also apply in relation to a deemed classification of the dam under subsection (5), (6) or (7).

heading: Dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (9) When a dam safety officer gives notice under subsection (4) (a) in relation to a dam, the classification of the dam for the purposes of this regulation is the classification accepted by the dam safety officer as set out in the notice.

heading: Owner must comply on determination or change of classification
paragraph:
4
		  Subject to this regulation, if the classification of a dam is determined for the first time or changes, an owner of the dam must, as soon as practicable after the owner becomes aware of the classification, or changed classification, as the case may be, comply with the provisions of this regulation that apply to a dam having that classification or changed classification.

heading: Responsibility of owner for dam condition and safety
paragraph:
5
		  (1) An owner of a dam must properly inspect, maintain and repair the dam and related works in a manner that keeps the dam and works in good operating condition.

heading: Responsibility of owner for dam condition and safety
paragraph: (2) An owner of a dam must exercise reasonable care to avoid the risk of significant harm resulting from a defect, insufficiency or failure of the dam or other conditions at the dam or operations or actions at or in connection with the dam to any of the following:

heading: Responsibility of owner for dam condition and safety
paragraph: (a) public safety;

heading: Responsibility of owner for dam condition and safety
paragraph: (b) the environment;

heading: Responsibility of owner for dam condition and safety
paragraph: (c) land or other property.

heading: Prevention of unauthorized operation
paragraph:
6
		  An owner of a dam must exercise reasonable care to safeguard the dam from unauthorized operation.

heading: Application of Part 3
paragraph:
7
		  This Part applies in relation to a dam if the dam meets the criteria set out in one or more of the following paragraphs:

heading: Application of Part 3
paragraph: (a) the dam is

heading: Application of Part 3
paragraph: (i)  1 m or more in height, and

heading: Application of Part 3
paragraph: (ii)  capable of impounding at full supply level a total storage volume of water in the reservoir of the dam greater than 1 000 000 m3;

heading: Application of Part 3
paragraph: (b) the dam is

heading: Application of Part 3
paragraph: (i)  2.5 m or more in height, and

heading: Application of Part 3
paragraph: (ii)  capable of impounding at full supply level a total storage volume of water in the reservoir of the dam greater than 30 000 m3;

heading: Application of Part 3
paragraph: (c) the dam is 7.5 m or more in height;

heading: Application of Part 3
paragraph: (d) the dam has a classification of significant, high, very high or extreme.

heading: Operation, maintenance and surveillance manual
paragraph:
8
		  (1) An owner of a dam for which there is not already an operation, maintenance and surveillance manual and that has a classification of significant, high, very high or extreme must

heading: Operation, maintenance and surveillance manual
paragraph: (a) prepare a manual, in the form and with the content specified by the comptroller or a water manager, that describes the operation, maintenance and surveillance procedures for the dam, and

heading: Operation, maintenance and surveillance manual
paragraph: (b) submit the manual to a dam safety officer for acceptance by the dam safety officer.

heading: Operation, maintenance and surveillance manual
paragraph: (2) Subject to subsection (3), an owner of a newly constructed dam must comply with subsection (1) as soon as practicable and, in any event, no later than 60 days, after completion of the construction of the dam.

heading: Operation, maintenance and surveillance manual
paragraph: (3) The comptroller or a water manager may order an owner of a dam to comply with subsection (1) on or before a specified date.

heading: Operation, maintenance and surveillance manual
paragraph: (4) An owner of a dam for which there is an operation, maintenance and surveillance manual must, no less frequently than is specified in item 8 of the table in Schedule 2 for the classification of the dam,

heading: Operation, maintenance and surveillance manual
paragraph: (a) review and, if necessary, revise the operation, maintenance and surveillance manual, and

heading: Operation, maintenance and surveillance manual
paragraph: (b) submit to a dam safety officer, for acceptance by the dam safety officer,

heading: Operation, maintenance and surveillance manual
paragraph: (i)  a record setting out the revisions, if any, or

heading: Operation, maintenance and surveillance manual
paragraph: (ii)  a written report advising that no revisions are necessary.

heading: Operation, maintenance and surveillance manual
paragraph: (5) Despite subsection (4), if the classification of a dam for which there is an operation, maintenance and surveillance manual changes to a classification that is more severe in consequence, an owner of the dam must comply with subsection (4) (a) and (b) as soon as practicable after the owner becomes aware of the change of classification or on or before a later date specified by a dam safety officer.

heading: Operation, maintenance and surveillance manual
paragraph: (6) An owner of a dam must follow the operation, maintenance and surveillance manual, if any, for the dam.

heading: Dam emergency plan
paragraph:
9
		  (1) An owner of a dam for which there is not already an emergency plan and that has a classification of significant, high, very high or extreme must

heading: Dam emergency plan
paragraph: (a) prepare a plan, in the form and with the content specified by the comptroller or a water manager, that includes

heading: Dam emergency plan
paragraph: (i)  a record describing the actions to be taken by the owner if there is an emergency at the dam, and

heading: Dam emergency plan
paragraph: (ii)  a record containing information for the use of the local emergency authorities for the dam for the purpose of preparing local emergency plans under the Emergency Program Act, and

heading: Dam emergency plan
paragraph: (b) submit the plan to a dam safety officer for acceptance by the dam safety officer.

heading: Dam emergency plan
paragraph: (2) Subject to subsection (3), an owner of a newly constructed dam must comply with subsection (1) as soon as practicable and, in any event, no later than 60 days, after completion of the construction of the dam.

heading: Dam emergency plan
paragraph: (3) The comptroller or a water manager may order an owner of a dam to comply with subsection (1) on or before a specified date.

heading: Dam emergency plan
paragraph: (4) A record described in subsection (1) (a) (i) must include contact information for the persons and the government agencies and other organizations that are to be contacted by the owner of the dam if there is an emergency at the dam.

heading: Dam emergency plan
paragraph: (5) A record described in subsection (1) (a) (ii) must include the name and contact information of the person who is the emergency contact for the dam.

heading: Dam emergency plan
paragraph: (6) An owner of a dam must, promptly after a plan prepared for the dam under subsection (1) is accepted by a dam safety officer, deliver a copy of the record described in subsection (1) (a) (ii) to each local emergency authority for the dam.

heading: Dam emergency plan
paragraph: (7) An owner of a dam for which there is an emergency plan must, no less frequently than is specified in item 6 of the table in Schedule 2 for the classification of the dam,

heading: Dam emergency plan
paragraph: (a) review and, if necessary, revise the names and contact information in the records described in subsections (4) and (5) of this section, and

heading: Dam emergency plan
paragraph: (b) submit to a dam safety officer, for acceptance by the dam safety officer,

heading: Dam emergency plan
paragraph: (i)  a record setting out the revisions, if any, or

heading: Dam emergency plan
paragraph: (ii)  a written report advising that no revisions are necessary.

heading: Dam emergency plan
paragraph: (8) Subject to subsection (7), an owner of a dam for which there is an emergency plan must, no less frequently than is specified in item 8 of the table in Schedule 2 for the classification of the dam,

heading: Dam emergency plan
paragraph: (a) review and, if necessary, revise the emergency plan, and

heading: Dam emergency plan
paragraph: (b) if the record is revised, submit the revised record to a dam safety officer for acceptance by the dam safety officer.

heading: Dam emergency plan
paragraph: (9) Despite subsection (8), if the classification of a dam for which there is an emergency plan changes to a classification that is more severe in consequence, an owner of the dam must comply with subsection (8) (a) and (b) as soon as practicable after the owner becomes aware of the change of classification or on or before a later date specified by a dam safety officer.

heading: Dam emergency plan
paragraph: (10) If a record described in subsection (1) (a) (ii) for a dam is revised under this regulation, an owner of the dam must, promptly after the revision is accepted by a dam safety officer, deliver a copy of the revised record to each local emergency authority for the dam.

heading: Record identifying emergency contact
paragraph: 10		  (1) An owner of a dam that has a classification of low must

heading: Record identifying emergency contact
paragraph: (a) prepare a record, in the form and with the content specified by the comptroller or a water manager, that sets out the name and contact information of the person who is the emergency contact for the dam,

heading: Record identifying emergency contact
paragraph: (b) submit the record to a dam safety officer, and

heading: Record identifying emergency contact
paragraph: (c) deliver a copy of the record to each local emergency authority for the dam.

heading: Record identifying emergency contact
paragraph: (2) Subject to subsection (3), an owner of a newly constructed dam must comply with subsection (1) as soon as practicable and, in any event, no later than 60 days, after completion of the construction of the dam.

heading: Record identifying emergency contact
paragraph: (3) A dam safety officer may specify a date on or before which an owner of a dam must comply with subsection (1) and, if the dam safety officer specifies a date, the owner must comply with subsection (1) on or before the specified date.

heading: Record identifying emergency contact
paragraph: (4) An owner of a dam for which a record referred to in subsection (1) has been prepared must, no less frequently than is specified in item 7 of the table in Schedule 2 for the classification of the dam,

heading: Record identifying emergency contact
paragraph: (a) review and, if necessary, revise the record, and

heading: Record identifying emergency contact
paragraph: (b) if the record is revised,

heading: Record identifying emergency contact
paragraph: (i)  submit the revised record to a dam safety officer, and

heading: Record identifying emergency contact
paragraph: (ii)  deliver a copy of the revised record to each local emergency authority for the dam.

heading: Record identifying emergency contact
paragraph: (5) If none of the owners of a dam have complied with subsection (1) within the required time, a dam safety officer may designate one of the owners of the dam to be the emergency contact for the dam.

heading: Record identifying emergency contact
paragraph: (6) An owner of a dam who becomes the emergency contact for the dam under this section must, as soon as practicable, give to each other owner whose address is known to the owner written notice that the owner is the emergency contact.
