paragraph:
11
		  (1) In this section:

heading: Signs must be posted
paragraph: "emergency contact", in relation to a dam, means the person identified as the emergency contact for the dam in the record referred to in section 9 (5) [dam emergency plan];

heading: Signs must be posted
paragraph: "sign" means a sign that meets the requirements of subsection (4).

heading: Signs must be posted
paragraph: (2) Subject to subsection (3), an owner of a dam that has a classification of significant, high, very high or extreme and that is located partly or entirely on Crown land, or on land that is surrounded by or adjacent to Crown land, must ensure that 2 signs are at all times posted,

heading: Signs must be posted
paragraph: (a) at each end of the top of the dam, or

heading: Signs must be posted
paragraph: (b) if a sign posted at an end of the top of the dam would not be clearly visible under all seasonal conditions to persons approaching the dam, at another location on Crown land at which the sign would be so visible.

heading: Signs must be posted
paragraph: (3) An owner of a dam is required to post only one sign under subsection (2) if a dam safety officer considers it would be impractical or unnecessary to post the other sign.

heading: Signs must be posted
paragraph: (4) Each sign that must be posted under subsection (2) must meet all of the following requirements:

heading: Signs must be posted
paragraph: (a) the sign must contain, in lettering that is clearly legible from a distance of 15 m, the following information:

heading: Signs must be posted
paragraph: (i)  the name of the dam;

heading: Signs must be posted
paragraph: (ii)  if the dam impounds water from a stream, the name of the stream;

heading: Signs must be posted
paragraph: (iii)  the following words: "If you see any dam safety concerns, please contact:", followed by

heading: Signs must be posted
paragraph: (A) the name and emergency telephone numbers for day and for night of the emergency contact for the dam, and

heading: Signs must be posted
paragraph: (B) the emergency telephone number for the Provincial Emergency Program;

heading: Signs must be posted
paragraph: (b) the sign must be at least 75 cm high and 60 cm wide;

heading: Signs must be posted
paragraph: (c) the sign must be clearly visible under all seasonal conditions to persons approaching the dam;

heading: Signs must be posted
paragraph: (d) the sign and the post, if any, must be constructed from metal or other durable materials having strength suited to the location of the sign and the local environmental conditions;

heading: Signs must be posted
paragraph: (e) the sign must meet the other requirements, if any, specified by the comptroller or a water manager.

heading: Signs must be posted
paragraph: (5) An owner of a dam may, under this section, post a sign on Crown land whether or not the owner has any other authority to occupy the Crown land.

heading: Signs must be posted
paragraph: (6) This section is subject to the requirements of any other enactment that relate to the location, appearance or construction of a sign referred to in this section.

heading:
Authorization, change approval or order for alteration
                   or improvement to or replacement of dam
paragraph:
12
		  An alteration or improvement to or replacement of all or part of a dam must be authorized under the Act by an authorization, change approval or order unless the alteration, improvement or replacement is for the purpose of

heading:
Authorization, change approval or order for alteration
                   or improvement to or replacement of dam
paragraph: (a) routine maintenance of the dam or related works,

heading:
Authorization, change approval or order for alteration
                   or improvement to or replacement of dam
paragraph: (b) addressing hazardous conditions in relation to the dam in accordance with section 14 (1) [hazardous conditions], or

heading:
Authorization, change approval or order for alteration
                   or improvement to or replacement of dam
paragraph: (c) conducting an investigation described in section 16 [invasive investigations] in accordance with that section.

heading: Requirements if alteration or improvement to or replacement of dam
paragraph:
13
		  (1) An owner of a dam must, within 30 days after completion of an alteration or improvement to or replacement of all or part of the dam, submit to a dam safety officer

heading: Requirements if alteration or improvement to or replacement of dam
paragraph: (a) a written report on the work and the manner in which the alteration, improvement or replacement was performed, and

heading: Requirements if alteration or improvement to or replacement of dam
paragraph: (b) a copy of the as-built drawings.

heading: Requirements if alteration or improvement to or replacement of dam
paragraph: (2) A report under subsection (1) (a) may be combined with a report under section 14 (2) (a) [hazardous conditions], 15 (2) (a) [potential safety hazard] or 17 (5) [removing, decommissioning, deactivating or stopping operation of dam].

heading: Requirements if alteration or improvement to or replacement of dam
paragraph: (3) An owner of a dam must, promptly after an alteration or improvement to or replacement of all or part of the dam is completed,

heading: Requirements if alteration or improvement to or replacement of dam
paragraph: (a) review and, if necessary, revise the operation, maintenance and surveillance manual and the emergency plan, if any, for the dam, and

heading: Requirements if alteration or improvement to or replacement of dam
paragraph: (b) submit to a dam safety officer for acceptance by the dam safety officer,

heading: Requirements if alteration or improvement to or replacement of dam
paragraph: (i)  a record setting out the revisions, if any, or

heading: Requirements if alteration or improvement to or replacement of dam
paragraph: (ii)  a written report advising that no revisions are necessary.

heading: Hazardous conditions
paragraph:
14
		  (1) An owner of a dam who becomes aware of hazardous conditions in relation to the dam must promptly do all of the following:

heading: Hazardous conditions
paragraph: (a) follow the emergency plan, if any, for the dam;

heading: Hazardous conditions
paragraph: (b) operate the dam in a manner, and initiate any remedial actions, including modifying the operations at the dam, that will

heading: Hazardous conditions
paragraph: (i)  safeguard the public, and

heading: Hazardous conditions
paragraph: (ii)  minimize damage to the environment or land or other property;

heading: Hazardous conditions
paragraph: (c) inform the following persons and other entities of the nature of the hazardous conditions:

heading: Hazardous conditions
paragraph: (i)  the Provincial Emergency Program;

heading: Hazardous conditions
paragraph: (ii)  persons who are in the immediate vicinity of the dam;

heading: Hazardous conditions
paragraph: (iii)  the local emergency authorities for the dam whose jurisdictional areas may be adversely affected by the hazardous conditions;

heading: Hazardous conditions
paragraph: (d) if the nature of the hazardous conditions places persons in imminent danger,

heading: Hazardous conditions
paragraph: (i)  advise persons who are in the immediate vicinity of the dam to vacate the endangered area, and

heading: Hazardous conditions
paragraph: (ii)  inform the local emergency authorities for the dam whose jurisdictional areas may be adversely affected by the hazardous conditions of the imminent danger;

heading: Hazardous conditions
paragraph: (e) inform the comptroller, a water manager or a dam safety officer of

heading: Hazardous conditions
paragraph: (i)  the nature of the hazardous conditions,

heading: Hazardous conditions
paragraph: (ii)  the actions being taken by the owner to rectify the hazardous conditions, and

heading: Hazardous conditions
paragraph: (iii)  the time and exact nature of the information given under this section to any person in relation to the hazardous conditions;

heading: Hazardous conditions
paragraph: (f) perform such further hazard response activities as the comptroller or a water manager orders.

heading: Hazardous conditions
paragraph: (2) An owner of a dam must, as soon as practicable and, in any event, no later than 30 days, after hazardous conditions at the dam have been rectified, submit to a dam safety officer

heading: Hazardous conditions
paragraph: (a) a written report on the actions taken by the owner to rectify the hazardous conditions and the effectiveness of those actions, and

heading: Hazardous conditions
paragraph: (b) on request of the dam safety officer, copies of records in the custody or under the control of the owner in relation to those actions.

heading: Potential safety hazard
paragraph:
15
		  (1) An owner of a dam who becomes aware of a potential safety hazard in relation to the dam must do all of the following:

heading: Potential safety hazard
paragraph: (a) promptly notify a dam safety officer of the potential safety hazard;

heading: Potential safety hazard
paragraph: (b) on or before the date specified by a dam safety officer

heading: Potential safety hazard
paragraph: (i)  prepare a plan, in the form and with the content specified by the dam safety officer, that sets out, in order of priority, any actions required to rectify the potential safety hazard, and

heading: Potential safety hazard
paragraph: (ii)  submit the plan to a dam safety officer for acceptance by the dam safety officer;

heading: Potential safety hazard
paragraph: (c) if the plan referred to in paragraph (b) is accepted by a dam safety officer, implement the plan, on or before the date specified by a dam safety officer, in the order of priority identified in the plan and in accordance with any requirements or conditions specified in an authorization, change approval or order.

heading: Potential safety hazard
paragraph: (2) An owner of a dam must, as soon as practicable and, in any event, no later than 30 days, after a potential safety hazard at a dam has been rectified, submit to a dam safety officer

heading: Potential safety hazard
paragraph: (a) a written report on the actions taken by the owner to rectify the potential safety hazard and the effectiveness of those actions, and

heading: Potential safety hazard
paragraph: (b) on request of the dam safety officer, copies of records in the custody or under the control of the owner in relation to those actions.

heading: Invasive investigations
paragraph:
16
		  (1) In this section, "invasive investigation" means an investigation that involves drilling, trenching, excavating a test pit or performing another invasive activity within or in close proximity to a dam.

heading: Invasive investigations
paragraph: (2) An owner of a dam who intends to conduct an invasive investigation must,

heading: Invasive investigations
paragraph: (a) at least 60 days before the date on which the owner expects the invasive investigation to begin, give to a dam safety officer written notice of the proposed investigation, and

heading: Invasive investigations
paragraph: (b) at least 30 days before the date on which the owner expects the invasive investigation to begin

heading: Invasive investigations
paragraph: (i)  prepare a plan, in the form and with the content specified by a dam safety officer, in relation to the invasive investigation, and

heading: Invasive investigations
paragraph: (ii)  submit the plan to a dam safety officer for acceptance by the dam safety officer.

heading: Invasive investigations
paragraph: (3) An owner of a dam must not begin an invasive investigation until a plan referred to in subsection (2) (b) has been accepted by a dam safety officer.

heading: Invasive investigations
paragraph: (4) An owner of a dam must ensure that all drilling, trenching, test pit excavations and other invasive activities involved in an invasive investigation are directly supervised by an engineering professional who has qualifications and experience in dam design, construction and analysis.

heading:
Removing, decommissioning, deactivating
                     or stopping operation of dam
paragraph:
17
		  (1) In this section, "restricted activity" means any of the following:

heading:
Removing, decommissioning, deactivating
                     or stopping operation of dam
paragraph: (a) removing all or a significant part of a dam;

heading:
Removing, decommissioning, deactivating
                     or stopping operation of dam
paragraph: (b) decommissioning a dam;

heading:
Removing, decommissioning, deactivating
                     or stopping operation of dam
paragraph: (c) deactivating a dam, or stopping the normal operation of a dam, for a period longer than one year.

heading:
Removing, decommissioning, deactivating
                     or stopping operation of dam
paragraph: (2) An owner of a dam who intends to perform a restricted activity must,

heading:
Removing, decommissioning, deactivating
                     or stopping operation of dam
paragraph: (a) at least 120 days before the date on which the owner expects to begin work on the restricted activity, give to a dam safety officer written notice of the proposed restricted activity, and

heading:
Removing, decommissioning, deactivating
                     or stopping operation of dam
paragraph: (b) at least 90 days before the date on which the owner expects to begin work on the restricted activity,

heading:
Removing, decommissioning, deactivating
                     or stopping operation of dam
paragraph: (i)  prepare a plan, in the form and with the content specified by a dam safety officer, in relation to the activity, and

heading:
Removing, decommissioning, deactivating
                     or stopping operation of dam
paragraph: (ii)  submit the plan to a dam safety officer for acceptance by the dam safety officer.

heading:
Removing, decommissioning, deactivating
                     or stopping operation of dam
paragraph: (3) An owner of a dam must not begin work on a restricted activity until a plan referred to in subsection (2) (b) has been accepted by a dam safety officer.

heading:
Removing, decommissioning, deactivating
                     or stopping operation of dam
paragraph: (4) Without limiting subsection (3), an owner of a dam must notify a dam safety officer of the owner's intention to begin work on a restricted activity at least 30 days before the date on which the owner expects to begin the work.

heading:
Removing, decommissioning, deactivating
                     or stopping operation of dam
paragraph: (5) An owner of a dam who has performed a restricted activity must submit to a dam safety officer, for acceptance by the dam safety officer, a written report on the work performed and the manner in which it was performed, no later than 60 days after completion of the restricted activity or on or before a later date specified by a dam safety officer.

heading:
Removing, decommissioning, deactivating
                     or stopping operation of dam
paragraph: (6) An owner of a dam who is performing or has performed work in relation to a restricted activity must take such further actions as the comptroller or a water manager orders to mitigate any adverse impact on

heading:
Removing, decommissioning, deactivating
                     or stopping operation of dam
paragraph: (a) a person,

heading:
Removing, decommissioning, deactivating
                     or stopping operation of dam
paragraph: (b) the environment, or

heading:
Removing, decommissioning, deactivating
                     or stopping operation of dam
paragraph: (c) land or other property.

heading: Site surveillance, formal inspections and tests
paragraph:
18
		  An owner of a dam must do all of the following:

heading: Site surveillance, formal inspections and tests
paragraph: (a) in order to assess the condition of the dam during the operation of the dam or the alteration or improvement to or replacement of the dam, conduct

heading: Site surveillance, formal inspections and tests
paragraph: (i)  a site surveillance of the dam no less frequently than is specified in item 2 of the table in Schedule 2 for the classification of the dam, and

heading: Site surveillance, formal inspections and tests
paragraph: (ii)  a formal inspection of the dam no less frequently than is specified in item 3 of the table in Schedule 2 for the classification of the dam;

heading: Site surveillance, formal inspections and tests
paragraph: (b) test, no less frequently than is specified in item 4 of the table in Schedule 2 for the classification of the dam, the operation of

heading: Site surveillance, formal inspections and tests
paragraph: (i)  the outlet facilities, spillway gates and other mechanical components of the dam, and

heading: Site surveillance, formal inspections and tests
paragraph: (ii)  the electrical and communication equipment relating to the dam;

heading: Site surveillance, formal inspections and tests
paragraph: (c) promptly after an activity described in this section has been performed, record the results of the activity.

heading: Instrumentation
paragraph:
19
		  (1) An owner of a dam must do all of the following:

heading: Instrumentation
paragraph: (a) install the instrumentation necessary to adequately monitor the dam and the area surrounding or adjacent to the dam;

heading: Instrumentation
paragraph: (b) maintain or replace the instrumentation referred to in paragraph (a) to ensure continuity of readings;

heading: Instrumentation
paragraph: (c) collect readings from the instrumentation referred to in paragraph (a) and analyze and interpret the readings no less frequently than is specified in item 5 of the table in Schedule 2 for the classification of the dam.

heading: Instrumentation
paragraph: (2) An owner of a dam who intends to install, modify, replace or remove instrumentation relating to the dam must submit to a dam safety officer, for acceptance by the dam safety officer,

heading: Instrumentation
paragraph: (a) a record describing the proposed installation, modification, replacement or removal at least 60 days before the date on which the owner expects the installation, modification, replacement or removal to occur, or

heading: Instrumentation
paragraph: (b) an annual plan outlining all installations, modifications, replacements and removals of instrumentation proposed for the following year.

heading: Instrumentation
paragraph: (3) An owner of a dam must not install, modify, replace or remove instrumentation relating to the dam until the record or plan referred to in subsection (2) (a) or (b), as applicable, has been accepted by a dam safety officer.

heading: Dam safety review and report
paragraph:
20
		  (1) An owner of a dam that has a classification of high, very high or extreme must, no less frequently than is specified in item 9 of the table in Schedule 2 for the classification of the dam,

heading: Dam safety review and report
paragraph: (a) ensure that an engineering professional who has qualifications and experience in dam safety analysis

heading: Dam safety review and report
paragraph: (i)  carries out a review, in accordance with the requirements of the comptroller or a water manager,

heading: Dam safety review and report
paragraph: (A) to determine if the dam is safe, and

heading: Dam safety review and report
paragraph: (B) if it is determined that the dam is not safe, to determine what actions are required to make the dam safe, and

heading: Dam safety review and report
paragraph: (ii)  prepares, in the form and with the content specified by the comptroller or a water manager, a report on the safety of the dam, and

heading: Dam safety review and report
paragraph: (b) submit to a dam safety officer, for acceptance by the dam safety officer, a copy of the report referred to in paragraph (a) (ii).

heading: Dam safety review and report
paragraph: (2) Despite subsection (1), if the classification of a dam changes to a classification that is more severe in consequence, other than a change from a low classification to a significant classification, an owner of the dam must comply with subsection (1) (a) and (b) on or before December 31 of the calendar year that is 2 years after the calendar year in which the classification changes, unless the comptroller or a water manager specifies another date.

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph:
21
		  (1) In this section, "inspection", in relation to a dam, includes, without limitation, site surveillance of the dam and a formal inspection of the dam.

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (2) An owner of a dam must, on request of a dam safety officer, submit to the dam safety officer, in the form, with the content and on or before the date specified by the dam safety officer, the following records relating to an inspection, test or review carried out in relation to a dam:

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (a) a record setting out the results of the inspection, test or review;

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (b) records setting out the data obtained from any test or measurement taken, and analysis and interpretation of the data, including, but not limited to,

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (i)  a record setting out instrumentation readings, and analysis and interpretation of the readings,

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (ii)  visual records or observations,

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (iii)  drawings,

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (iv)  soil, aggregate and concrete test results, and

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (v)  any other test results.

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (3) Despite subsection (2), an owner of a dam must promptly submit to a dam safety officer the records referred to in that subsection if an inspection, test or review carried out in relation to the dam reveals hazardous conditions or a potential safety hazard.

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (4) A dam safety officer may request an owner of a dam to submit to the dam safety officer any of the following information and records that the dam safety officer considers necessary to evaluate the condition or the hazard potential of the dam and operations and actions at or in connection with the dam:

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (a) information and records relating to the dam and those operations and actions, including, but not limited to,

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (i)  information and records respecting hydraulic, hydrological, seismic, geological and geotechnical characteristics, conditions and concerns,

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (ii)  foundation investigation results,

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (iii)  design details and as-built drawings,

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (iv)  structural analyses,

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (v)  construction records,

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (vi)  operation manuals,

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (vii)  records relating to instrumentation,

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (viii)  safety reports,

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (ix)  inundation studies, and

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (x)  plans, that have not been previously submitted to a dam safety officer, to be implemented if there is an emergency at the dam;

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (b) the following records relating to the design or construction of the dam or an alteration to or improvement or replacement of the dam:

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (i)  drawings, including, without limitation, plans and as-built drawings;

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (ii)  design notes and specifications;

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (iii)  hydraulic, hydrological, geological and geotechnical data;

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (iv)  reports and other similar records;

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (c) information and records, including, without limitation, information and records respecting hydraulic, hydrological, seismic, geological and geotechnical characteristics, conditions and concerns, relating to the following:

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (i)  the nature and use of the land that is in the immediate vicinity of the dam or the reservoir of the dam, downstream of the dam or downslope of the dam;

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (ii)  the nature and use of the stream or aquifer from which the water is being stored or diverted;

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (d) information relating to the watershed upstream of the dam.

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (5) An owner of a dam, must, on receiving a request of a dam safety officer under subsection (4), submit the requested information or record in the form, with the content and on or before the date specified by the dam safety officer.

heading:
Information and records to be submitted 
                       to dam safety officer
paragraph: (6) If information or a record in relation to a dam that is required to be submitted to a dam safety officer under this section does not exist or is otherwise not available for submission, the comptroller or a water manager may order an owner of the dam to conduct an inspection, investigation, survey or test, or prepare a record in relation to an inspection, investigation, survey or test, that is necessary to provide the information or record.

heading: Owners' designate
paragraph:
22
		  (1) The owners of a dam in respect of which there are 2 or more owners must, on request of a dam safety officer and on or before the date specified by the dam safety officer,

heading: Owners' designate
paragraph: (a) designate one of the owners for the purposes of receiving, providing and retaining information and records in relation to the dam as required or authorized by this regulation, and

heading: Owners' designate
paragraph: (b) submit to the dam safety officer the designated owner's name, address and other contact information as required by the dam safety officer.

heading: Owners' designate
paragraph: (2) If the owners of a dam to which subsection (1) applies have not complied with that subsection within the specified time, a dam safety officer may designate one of the owners for the purposes of this section.

heading: Owners' designate
paragraph: (3) An owner of a dam who is designated under this section must, as soon as practicable after the designation, give to each other owner whose address is known to the owner written notice of the designation.

heading: Compliance by any owner satisfies requirement
paragraph:
23
		  For certainty, if a dam has 2 or more owners, a requirement imposed by this regulation on an owner of the dam is satisfied if any of the owners of the dam complies with the requirement.

heading: Exemption for owner of dam with multiple owners
paragraph:
24
		  An owner of a dam in respect of which there are 2 or more owners is exempt from the requirements of this regulation in relation to the dam if

heading: Exemption for owner of dam with multiple owners
paragraph: (a) the comptroller is satisfied that proper arrangements have been made for one or more of the other owners to take responsibility for meeting the requirements of this regulation in relation to the dam, and

heading: Exemption for owner of dam with multiple owners
paragraph: (b) either of the following applies in relation to the owner:

heading: Exemption for owner of dam with multiple owners
paragraph: (i)  all the owners have agreed that one or more of the other owners acceptable to the comptroller are to be responsible for the dam;

heading: Exemption for owner of dam with multiple owners
paragraph: (ii)  the owner holds rights to store not greater than 5% of the quantity of water the storage rights to which are granted under the Act in respect of the dam.

heading:
Submission of records to and acceptance 
                   of records by dam safety officer
paragraph:
25
		  (1) A record that under this regulation must or may be submitted to a dam safety officer must be submitted in the manner specified by the dam safety officer.

heading:
Submission of records to and acceptance 
                   of records by dam safety officer
paragraph: (2) If a record submitted under this regulation by an owner of a dam to a dam safety officer for acceptance by the dam safety officer

heading:
Submission of records to and acceptance 
                   of records by dam safety officer
paragraph: (a) is not in the form or does not contain the content required under this regulation, or

heading:
Submission of records to and acceptance 
                   of records by dam safety officer
paragraph: (b) if there are no requirements under this regulation as to the form or content of the record, is not acceptable in form or content to the dam safety officer,

heading:
Submission of records to and acceptance 
                   of records by dam safety officer
paragraph: the dam safety officer may give to the owner written notice advising that the record has not been accepted, specifying the deficiencies in the record and requiring that they be rectified.

heading:
Submission of records to and acceptance 
                   of records by dam safety officer
paragraph: (3) If a dam safety officer gives notice to an owner of a dam under subsection (2) in relation to a record,

heading:
Submission of records to and acceptance 
                   of records by dam safety officer
paragraph: (a) the owner must promptly rectify the deficiencies specified in the notice, and

heading:
Submission of records to and acceptance 
                   of records by dam safety officer
paragraph: (b) the dam safety officer is not required to accept the record until the owner has rectified the deficiencies specified in the notice.

heading:
Submission of records to and acceptance 
                   of records by dam safety officer
paragraph: (4) If a dam safety officer accepts a record that was submitted under this regulation to the dam safety officer for acceptance, the dam safety officer must give written notice of the acceptance to the owner of the dam who submitted the record.

heading:
Submission of records to and acceptance 
                   of records by dam safety officer
paragraph: (5) For the purposes of this regulation, a record relating to a dam is accepted by a dam safety officer when the dam safety officer gives notice under subsection (4) in relation to the record.

heading: Retention of records
paragraph:
26
		  (1) For the purposes of section 116 (1) [records and reporting] of the Act, each person who is or was an owner of a dam must keep information or a record described in section 116 (1) (a), (b) or (c) of the Act that relates to the dam for the period between

heading: Retention of records
paragraph: (a) the date on which the information or record is obtained or prepared by the person, and

heading: Retention of records
paragraph: (b) the date that is 10 years after the date on which written notice is given to a dam safety officer, by a person who is an owner of the dam when the dam is decommissioned, stating that the decommissioning of the dam is complete and the dam has been completely removed.

heading: Retention of records
paragraph: (2) Subsection (1) does not apply to a person in relation to information or a record if another person has been designated under section 22 [owners' designate] for the purpose of retaining the information or record.

heading: Retention of records
paragraph: (3) For the purposes of section 116 (1) (b) of the Act, an owner of a dam must, in addition to the records referred to in section 116 (1) (a) or (c) of the Act, keep all other information and records in relation to the dam that, under this regulation, the owner is, or may be, required to submit to the comptroller, a water manager, an engineer or a dam safety officer.

heading: Advice of independent expert may be required
paragraph:
27
		  (1) If the comptroller or a water manager considers it advisable to obtain independent expert advice in relation to an issue respecting a dam or works relating to a dam, the comptroller or water manager may order an owner of the dam to retain an independent expert, satisfactory to the comptroller or water manager, who has qualifications and experience described in subsection (2), to prepare a written report on resolving the issue.

heading: Advice of independent expert may be required
paragraph: (2) An independent expert retained under subsection (1) must have the following qualifications and experience:

heading: Advice of independent expert may be required
paragraph: (a) in the case of an issue respecting a dam, qualifications and experience in dam design, construction and analysis or in dam operation and maintenance, as appropriate;

heading: Advice of independent expert may be required
paragraph: (b) in the case of an issue respecting works relating to a dam, qualifications and experience in hydraulic, hydrological, geological, geotechnical, mechanical or structural engineering or other discipline, as appropriate.

heading: Advice of independent expert may be required
paragraph: (3) An owner of a dam who is ordered by the comptroller or a water manager to retain an independent expert under subsection (1) must submit to the comptroller or water manager a copy of the written report referred to in that subsection promptly after the owner receives the report.

heading: General offences
paragraph:
28
		  (1) An owner of a dam who does any of the following commits an offence:

heading: General offences
paragraph: (a) fails to determine under section 3 (1) (a) [dam failure consequences classification], or redetermine under section 3 (2) (a), the classification of the dam as and when required to do so;

heading: General offences
paragraph: (b) fails to submit to a dam safety officer a record under section 3 (1) (b) setting out a proposed classification for the dam, or a record under section 3 (2) (b) setting out a proposed new classification for the dam, as and when required to do so;

heading: General offences
paragraph: (c) fails to properly inspect, maintain or repair the dam or related works contrary to section 5 (1) [responsibility of owner for dam condition and safety];

heading: General offences
paragraph: (d) fails to exercise reasonable care to avoid the risk of significant harm as required under section 5 (2);

heading: General offences
paragraph: (e) fails to exercise reasonable care to safeguard the dam from unauthorized operation contrary to section 6 [prevention of unauthorized operation].

heading: General offences
paragraph: (2) An owner of a dam who does any of the following commits an offence:

heading: General offences
paragraph: (a) fails to review or revise the operation, maintenance and surveillance manual for the dam as and when required to do so under section 8 (4) (a) or (5) [operation, maintenance and surveillance manual] or 13 (3) (a) [requirements if alteration or improvement to or replacement of dam];

heading: General offences
paragraph: (b) fails to submit to a dam safety officer the applicable record in relation to a review of the operation, maintenance and surveillance manual for the dam as and when required to do so under section 8 (4) (b) or (5) or 13 (3) (b);

heading: General offences
paragraph: (c) fails to follow the operation, maintenance and surveillance manual for the dam contrary to section 8 (6);

heading: General offences
paragraph: (d) fails to deliver a record to a local emergency authority for the dam as and when required to do so under section 9 (6) or (10) [dam emergency plan] or section 10 (4) (b) (ii) [record identifying emergency contact];

heading: General offences
paragraph: (e) fails to review or revise the emergency plan for the dam as and when required to do so under section 9 (7) (a), (8) (a) or (9) or 13 (3) (a);

heading: General offences
paragraph: (f) fails to submit to a dam safety officer the applicable record in relation to a review of the emergency plan for the dam as and when required to do so under section 9 (7) (b), (8) (b) or (9) or 13 (3) (b);

heading: General offences
paragraph: (g) fails to comply with section 10 (1) (a), (b) or (c) on or before the date specified by a dam safety officer contrary to section 10 (3);

heading: General offences
paragraph: (h) fails to review or revise the record setting out the name and contact information for the emergency contact for the dam as and when required to do so under section 10 (4) (a);

heading: General offences
paragraph: (i) fails to submit to a dam safety officer the applicable record in relation to a review of the record referred to in paragraph (h) as and when required to do so under section 10 (4) (b) (i);

heading: General offences
paragraph: (j) contravenes section 11 [signs must be posted].

heading: General offences
paragraph: (3) An owner of a dam who does any of the following commits an offence:

heading: General offences
paragraph: (a) fails to submit to a dam safety officer a written report or other record as and when required to do so under section 13 (1), 14 (2) [hazardous conditions], 15 (2) [potential safety hazard] or 17 (5) [removing, decommissioning, deactivating or stopping operation of dam];

heading: General offences
paragraph: (b) fails to notify a dam safety officer of a potential safety hazard in relation to the dam as and when required to do so under section 15 (1) (a);

heading: General offences
paragraph: (c) fails to give notice of a proposed activity in relation to the dam as and when required to do so under section 16 (2) (a) [invasive investigations] or 17 (2) (a) or (4);

heading: General offences
paragraph: (d) fails to prepare or submit to a dam safety officer a plan for an activity in relation to the dam as and when required to do so under section 15 (1) (b) (i) or (ii), 16 (2) (b) (i) or (ii) or 17 (2) (b) (i) or (ii);

heading: General offences
paragraph: (e) fails to implement a plan in relation to a potential safety hazard at the dam as and when required to do so under section 15 (1) (c);

heading: General offences
paragraph: (f) begins an activity referred to in section 16 or 17 in relation to the dam before a plan respecting the activity has been accepted by a dam safety officer contrary to section 16 (3) or 17 (3), as applicable;

heading: General offences
paragraph: (g) fails to ensure that an invasive activity is directly supervised by an engineering professional who has qualifications and experience as required under section 16 (4).

heading: General offences
paragraph: (4) An owner of a dam who does any of the following commits an offence:

heading: General offences
paragraph: (a) fails to conduct a site surveillance of the dam as and when required to do so under section 18 (a) (i) [site surveillance, formal inspections and tests];

heading: General offences
paragraph: (b) fails to conduct a formal inspection of the dam as and when required to do so under section 18 (a) (ii);

heading: General offences
paragraph: (c) fails to test the operation of mechanical components of the dam as and when required to do so under section 18 (b) (i);

heading: General offences
paragraph: (d) fails to test the operation of electrical or communication equipment relating to the dam as and when required to do so under section 18 (b) (ii);

heading: General offences
paragraph: (e) fails to record the results of an activity referred to in paragraph (a), (b), (c) or (d) when required to do so under section 18 (c);

heading: General offences
paragraph: (f) fails to install, maintain or replace instrumentation relating to the dam as required under section 19 (1) (a) or (b) [instrumentation];

heading: General offences
paragraph: (g) fails to collect, analyze or interpret readings from instrumentation relating to the dam as and when required to do so under section 19 (1) (c);

heading: General offences
paragraph: (h) fails to submit to a dam safety officer a record or a plan for a proposed installation, modification, replacement or removal of instrumentation relating to the dam as and when required to do so under section 19 (2);

heading: General offences
paragraph: (i) installs, modifies, replaces or removes instrumentation relating to the dam before the notice or plan referred to in paragraph (h) has been accepted by a dam safety officer contrary to section 19 (3);

heading: General offences
paragraph: (j) fails to ensure that an engineering professional who has qualifications and experience as required under section 20 (1) [dam safety review and report] carries out a review of, and prepares a report on, the safety of the dam as and when required to do so under section 20 (1) (a) or (2);

heading: General offences
paragraph: (k) fails to submit to a dam safety officer the report referred to in paragraph (j) as and when required to do so under section 20 (1) (b) or (2);

heading: General offences
paragraph: (l) fails to submit to a dam safety officer information or a record in relation to the dam as and when required to do so under section 21 (2), (3) or (5) [information and records to be submitted to dam safety officer];

heading: General offences
paragraph: (m) fails to submit to the comptroller or a water manager a copy of a report of an independent expert in relation to the dam as and when required to do so under section 27 (3) [advice of independent expert may be required].

heading: General offences
paragraph: (5) An owner of a dam who commits an offence under this section is liable on conviction to the following:

heading: General offences
paragraph: (a) in the case of an offence that is not a continuing offence, a fine of not more than $200 000 or imprisonment for not longer than 6 months, or both;

heading: General offences
paragraph: (b) in the case of a continuing offence, a fine of not more than $200 000 for each day the offence is continued or imprisonment for not longer than 6 months, or both.

heading: High penalty offences
paragraph:
29
		  (1) An owner of a dam who does any of the following commits an offence:

heading: High penalty offences
paragraph: (a) fails to follow the emergency plan for the dam contrary to section 14 (1) (a) [hazardous conditions];

heading: High penalty offences
paragraph: (b) fails to operate the dam or initiate a remedial action at the dam contrary to section 14 (1) (b);

heading: High penalty offences
paragraph: (c) fails to inform or advise a person or other entity respecting hazardous conditions in relation to the dam contrary to section 14 (1) (c) or (d);

heading: High penalty offences
paragraph: (d) fails to inform the comptroller, a water manager or a dam safety officer respecting hazardous conditions in relation to the dam as and when required to do so under section 14 (1) (e).

heading: High penalty offences
paragraph: (2) An owner of a dam who commits an offence under this section is liable on conviction to the following:

heading: High penalty offences
paragraph: (a) in the case of an offence that is not a continuing offence, a fine of not more than $1 000 000 or imprisonment for not longer than one year, or both;

heading: High penalty offences
paragraph: (b) in the case of a continuing offence, a fine of not more than $1 000 000 for each day the offence is continued or imprisonment for not longer than one year, or both.

heading: Definition of previously unregulated dam
paragraph:
30
		  In this Part, "previously unregulated dam" means a dam

heading: Definition of previously unregulated dam
paragraph: (a) to which, immediately before February 29, 2016, the former regulation did not apply, and

heading: Definition of previously unregulated dam
paragraph: (b) to which Part 3 [Requirements Applicable to Certain Dams] of this regulation applies.

heading: Transition - dam failure consequences classification
paragraph:
31
		  (1) If, immediately before February 29, 2016, the former regulation did not apply in relation to a dam, an owner of the dam must, on or before December 31, 2016,

heading: Transition - dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (a) determine the classification of the dam in accordance with section 2 [determination of classification] of Schedule 1, and

heading: Transition - dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (b) submit to a dam safety officer, immediately after the determination is completed, a record setting out a proposed classification for the dam.

heading: Transition - dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (2) Section 3 (4), (5), (8) and (9) [dam failure consequences classification] applies in relation to a dam described in subsection (1) of this section as if it were a dam described in section 3 (1).

heading: Transition - dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (3) An owner of a dam who, in 2015, conducted a review of conditions downstream of the dam under section 6.1 of the former regulation must begin complying with section 3 (2) of this regulation in 2016.

heading: Transition - dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (4) An owner of a dam who, between January 1, 2016 and February 28, 2016, conducted a review of conditions downstream of the dam under section 6.1 of the former regulation must begin complying with section 3 (2) of this regulation in 2017.

heading: Transition - dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (5) If, immediately before February 29, 2016, section 6.1 of the former regulation applied in relation to a dam and a review of conditions downstream of the dam was not conducted under that section between January 1, 2015 and February 28, 2016, an owner of the dam must comply with section 3 (2) of this regulation on or before March 31, 2016.

heading: Transition - dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (6) Section 3 (4), (6), (8) and (9) applies in relation to a dam described in subsection (3), (4) or (5) of this section as if it were a dam described in section 3 (2).

heading: Transition - dam failure consequences classification
paragraph: (7) The classification of a dam to which the former regulation applied immediately before February 29, 2016 continues, for the purposes of this regulation, to be the classification of the dam under the former regulation until the date on which the classification is determined in accordance with this section.

heading: Transition - operation, maintenance and surveillance manual
paragraph:
32
		  (1) An owner of a previously unregulated dam that has a classification of significant, high, very high or extreme must comply with section 8 (1) (a) and (b) [operation, maintenance and surveillance manual] within one year after the date on which a dam safety officer gives notice to an owner of the dam that the dam safety officer accepts a proposed classification for the dam under section 31.

heading: Transition - operation, maintenance and surveillance manual
paragraph: (2) If, between January 1, 2006 and December 31, 2015, an operation, maintenance and surveillance manual was submitted to a dam safety officer under section 3 (2) (b) of the former regulation in relation to a dam that has a classification of very high, and subsection (3) of this section does not apply in relation to the dam, an owner of the dam need not comply with section 8 (4) (a) and (b) of this regulation in respect of the first review of the operation, maintenance and surveillance manual until the calendar year that is 10 years after the calendar year that includes the date on which the operation, maintenance and surveillance manual was submitted to the dam safety officer under section 3 (2) (b) of the former regulation.

heading: Transition - operation, maintenance and surveillance manual
paragraph: (3) If the most recent review of the operation, maintenance and surveillance manual for a dam that has a classification of very high was completed under section 3 (3.1) of the former regulation between January 1, 2006 and December 31, 2015, an owner of the dam need not comply with section 8 (4) (a) and (b) of this regulation in respect of the immediately following review of the operation, maintenance and surveillance manual until the calendar year that is 10 years after the calendar year that includes the date on which the most recent review of the operation, maintenance and surveillance manual was completed under section 3 (3.1) of the former regulation.

heading: Transition - dam emergency plan
paragraph:
33
		  (1) An owner of a previously unregulated dam that has a classification of significant, high, very high or extreme must comply with section 9 (1) (a) and (b) [dam emergency plan] within one year after the date on which a dam safety officer gives notice to an owner of the dam that the dam safety officer accepts a proposed classification for the dam under section 31 [transition - dam failure consequences classification].

heading: Transition - dam emergency plan
paragraph: (2) Despite section 9, if, immediately before February 29, 2016, there was, under the former regulation, an emergency preparedness plan for a dam, an owner of the dam must, on or before March 31, 2017,

heading: Transition - dam emergency plan
paragraph: (a) review and, if necessary, revise the plan to ensure that it contains the record described in section 9 (1) (a) (ii),

heading: Transition - dam emergency plan
paragraph: (b) submit to a dam safety officer, for acceptance by the dam safety officer,

heading: Transition - dam emergency plan
paragraph: (i)  a record setting out the revisions, if any, or

heading: Transition - dam emergency plan
paragraph: (ii)  a written report advising that no revisions are necessary, and

heading: Transition - dam emergency plan
paragraph: (c) deliver a copy of the record described in section 9 (1) (a) (ii) to each local emergency authority for the dam.

heading: Transition - dam emergency plan
paragraph: (3) If, between January 1, 2006 and December 31, 2015, an emergency preparedness plan was submitted to a dam safety officer under section 3.1 (1) (b) of the former regulation in relation to a dam that has a classification of very high, and subsection (4) of this section does not apply in relation to the dam, an owner of the dam need not comply with section 9 (8) (a) and (b) of this regulation in respect of the first review of the emergency plan for the dam until the calendar year that is 10 years after the calendar year that includes the date on which the emergency preparedness plan was submitted to the dam safety officer under section 3.1 (1) (b) of the former regulation.

heading: Transition - dam emergency plan
paragraph: (4) If the most recent review of the emergency preparedness plan for a dam that has a classification of very high was completed under section 3.1 (3) of the former regulation between January 1, 2006 and December 31, 2015, an owner of the dam need not comply with section 9 (8) (a) and (b) of this regulation in respect of the immediately following review of the emergency plan for the dam until the calendar year that is 10 years after the calendar year that includes the date on which the most recent review of the emergency preparedness plan was completed under section 3.1 (3) of the former regulation.

heading: Transition - record identifying emergency contact
paragraph:
34
		  An owner of a dam, other than a newly constructed dam, need not comply with section 10 [record identifying emergency contact] until March 31, 2017.

heading: Transition - signs
paragraph:
35
		  An owner of a previously unregulated dam need not comply with section 11 [signs must be posted] until October 1, 2016.

heading: Transition - monitoring and review of dam safety
paragraph:
36
		  (1) For the purposes of section 18 (a) [site surveillance, formal inspections and tests], an owner of a previously unregulated dam must, on or before November 1, 2016,

heading: Transition - monitoring and review of dam safety
paragraph: (a) begin site surveillance of the dam, and

heading: Transition - monitoring and review of dam safety
paragraph: (b) conduct the first formal inspection of the dam.

heading: Transition - monitoring and review of dam safety
paragraph: (2) For the purposes of section 18 (b), an owner of a previously unregulated dam must, on or before November 1, 2016, conduct the first tests of the operation of

heading: Transition - monitoring and review of dam safety
paragraph: (a) the outlet facilities, spillway gates and other mechanical components of the dam, and

heading: Transition - monitoring and review of dam safety
paragraph: (b) the electrical and communication equipment relating to the dam.

heading: Transition - monitoring and review of dam safety
paragraph: (3) For the purposes of section 19 (1) (c) [instrumentation], an owner of a previously unregulated dam must, on or before November 1, 2016, begin collecting, analyzing and interpreting readings from the instrumentation relating to the dam.

heading: Transition - monitoring and review of dam safety
paragraph: (4) An owner of a previously unregulated dam that has a classification of high, very high or extreme must comply with section 20 (1) (a) and (b) [dam safety review and report] within 5 years after the date on which a dam safety officer gives notice to an owner of the dam that the dam safety officer accepts a proposed classification for the dam under section 31 [transition - dam failure consequences classification].

heading: Transition - general offences
paragraph:
37
		  (1) An owner of a dam who does any of the following commits an offence:

heading: Transition - general offences
paragraph: (a) fails to determine under section 31 (1) (a) [transition - dam failure consequences classification] or redetermine under section 31 (3), (4) or (5) the classification of the dam as and when required to do so;

heading: Transition - general offences
paragraph: (b) fails to submit to a dam safety officer a record under section 31 (1) (b) setting out a proposed classification for the dam, or a record under section 31 (3), (4) or (5) setting out a proposed new classification for the dam, as and when required to do so;

heading: Transition - general offences
paragraph: (c) fails to prepare an operation, maintenance and surveillance manual for the dam as and when required to do so under section 32 (1) [transition - operation, maintenance and surveillance manual];

heading: Transition - general offences
paragraph: (d) fails to submit to a dam safety officer the operation, maintenance and surveillance manual for the dam as and when required to do so under section 32 (1);

heading: Transition - general offences
paragraph: (e) fails to prepare an emergency plan for the dam as and when required to do so under section 33 (1) [transition - dam emergency plan];

heading: Transition - general offences
paragraph: (f) fails to submit to a dam safety officer the emergency plan for the dam as and when required to do so under section 33 (1);

heading: Transition - general offences
paragraph: (g) fails to review or revise the emergency plan for the dam as and when required to do so under section 33 (2) (a);

heading: Transition - general offences
paragraph: (h) fails to submit to a dam safety officer the applicable record in relation to a review of the emergency plan for the dam as and when required to do so under section 33 (2) (b);

heading: Transition - general offences
paragraph: (i) fails to deliver a record to a local emergency authority for the dam as and when required to do so under section 33 (2) (c).

heading: Transition - general offences
paragraph: (2) An owner of a dam who does any of the following commits an offence:

heading: Transition - general offences
paragraph: (a) fails to conduct a site surveillance of the dam as and when required to do so under section 36 (1) (a);

heading: Transition - general offences
paragraph: (b) fails to conduct a formal inspection of the dam as and when required to do so under section 36 (1) (b);

heading: Transition - general offences
paragraph: (c) fails to test the operation of mechanical components of the dam as and when required to do so under section 36 (2) (a);

heading: Transition - general offences
paragraph: (d) fails to test the operation of electrical or communication equipment relating to the dam as and when required to do so under section 36 (2) (b);

heading: Transition - general offences
paragraph: (e) fails to collect, analyze or interpret readings from instrumentation relating to the dam as and when required to do so under section 36 (3);

heading: Transition - general offences
paragraph: (f) fails to ensure that an engineering professional who has qualifications and experience as required under section 20 (1) [dam safety review and report] carries out a review of, and prepares a report on, the safety of the dam as and when required to do so under section 36 (4);

heading: Transition - general offences
paragraph: (g) fails to submit to a dam safety officer the report referred to in paragraph (f) as and when required to do so under section 36 (4).

heading: Transition - general offences
paragraph: (3) A person who commits an offence under this section is liable on conviction to the following:

heading: Transition - general offences
paragraph: (a) in the case of an offence that is not a continuing offence, a fine of not more than $200 000 or imprisonment for not longer than 6 months, or both;

heading: Transition - general offences
paragraph: (b) in the case of a continuing offence, a fine of not more than $200 000 for each day the offence is continued or imprisonment for not longer than 6 months, or both.

heading: Definitions
paragraph:
1
		  In this Schedule:

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "category", in relation to consequences of failure, means one of the following:

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) loss of life;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) environmental and cultural values;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (c) infrastructure and economics;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "consequences of failure" means losses or damages that are caused by a failure of a dam;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "failure", in relation to a dam, means an uncontrolled release of all or part of the water impounded by the dam, whether or not caused by a collapse of the dam.

heading: Determination of classification

2
		  (1) For the purposes of this regulation, the classification of a dam is to be determined in accordance with the following steps:

heading: Determination of classification
paragraph: (a) for each category of consequences of failure in columns 3, 4 and 5 of the table, identify the losses or damages specified in the applicable column that most closely describe the losses or damages that are the most severe potential consequences of a failure of the dam;

heading: Determination of classification
paragraph: (b) identify the dam failure consequences classification that is specified in column 1 of the table for the losses or damages referred to in paragraph (a) for each category;

heading: Determination of classification
paragraph: (c) the dam failure consequences classification identified under paragraph (b) with the most severe potential consequences is the classification of the dam.

heading: Determination of classification
paragraph: (2) For the purposes of identifying the consequences of failure in column 3 of the table, the descriptions in column 2 of the table of the population of individuals that may be at risk if there were a failure of the dam are to be considered.

heading: Short title
paragraph: 1 This Act may be cited as the Department of Fisheries and Oceans Act.

heading: Department established
paragraph: 2 (1) There is hereby established a department of the Government of Canada called the Department of Fisheries and Oceans over which the Minister of Fisheries and Oceans appointed by commission under the Great Seal shall preside.

heading: Minister
paragraph: (2) The Minister holds office during pleasure and has the management and direction of the Department.

heading: Deputy head
paragraph: 3 The Governor in Council may appoint an officer called the Deputy Minister of Fisheries and Oceans to hold office during pleasure and to be the deputy head of the Department.

heading: Powers, duties and functions of Minister
paragraph: 4 (1) The powers, duties and functions of the Minister extend to and include all matters over which Parliament has jurisdiction, not by law assigned to any other department, board or agency of the Government of Canada, relating to

heading: Powers, duties and functions of Minister
paragraph: (a) sea coast and inland fisheries;

heading: Powers, duties and functions of Minister
paragraph: (b) fishing and recreational harbours;

heading: Powers, duties and functions of Minister
paragraph: (c) hydrography and marine sciences; and

heading: Powers, duties and functions of Minister
paragraph: (d) the coordination of the policies and programs of the Government of Canada respecting oceans.

heading: Idem
paragraph: (2) The powers, duties and functions of the Minister also extend to and include such other matters, relating to oceans and over which Parliament has jurisdiction, as are by law assigned to the Minister.

heading: Security of Canada Information Sharing Act
paragraph: (3) In carrying out activities in relation to the maritime domain, the Minister may receive information that

heading: Security of Canada Information Sharing Act
paragraph: (a) relates to an activity that undermines the security of Canada, as defined in subsection 2(1) of the Security of Canada Information Disclosure Act; and

heading: Security of Canada Information Sharing Act
paragraph: (b) is relevant to his or her support of a Government of Canada institution, as defined in that section, that has jurisdiction or responsibilities under an Act of Parliament or another lawful authority in respect of those activities, including their detection, identification, analysis, prevention, investigation or disruption.

heading: Agreements
paragraph: 5 The Minister may, with the approval of the Governor in Council, enter into agreements with the government of any province or any agency thereof respecting the carrying out of programs for which the Minister is responsible.

heading: Annual report
paragraph: 6 The Minister shall, on or before the 31st day of January next following the end of each fiscal year or, if Parliament is not then sitting, on any of the first five days next thereafter that either House of Parliament is sitting, submit to Parliament a report showing the operations of the Department for that fiscal year.

heading: Short title
paragraph: 1 This Act may be cited as the Department of the Environment Act.

heading: Department established
paragraph: 2 (1) There is hereby established a department of the Government of Canada called the Department of the Environment over which the Minister of the Environment appointed by commission under the Great Seal shall preside.

heading: Minister
paragraph: (2) The Minister holds office during pleasure and has the management and direction of the Department.

heading: Deputy head
paragraph: 3 The Governor in Council may appoint an officer called the Deputy Minister of the Environment to hold office during pleasure and to be the deputy head of the Department.

heading: Powers, duties and functions of Minister
paragraph: 4 (1) The powers, duties and functions of the Minister extend to and include all matters over which Parliament has jurisdiction, not by law assigned to any other department, board or agency of the Government of Canada, relating to

heading: Powers, duties and functions of Minister
paragraph: (a) the preservation and enhancement of the quality of the natural environment, including water, air and soil quality;

heading: Powers, duties and functions of Minister
paragraph: (b) renewable resources, including migratory birds and other non-domestic flora and fauna;

heading: Powers, duties and functions of Minister
paragraph: (c) water;

heading: Powers, duties and functions of Minister
paragraph: (d) meteorology;

heading: Powers, duties and functions of Minister
paragraph: (e) notwithstanding paragraph 4(2)(g) of the Department of Health Act, the enforcement of any rules or regulations made by the International Joint Commission, promulgated pursuant to the treaty between the United States of America and His Majesty, King Edward VII, relating to boundary waters and questions arising between the United States and Canada, in so far as they relate to the preservation and enhancement of the quality of the natural environment; and

heading: Powers, duties and functions of Minister
paragraph: (f) the coordination of the policies and programs of the Government of Canada respecting the preservation and enhancement of the quality of the natural environment.

heading: Idem
paragraph: (2) The powers, duties and functions of the Minister also extend to and include such other matters, relating to the environment and over which Parliament has jurisdiction, as are by law assigned to the Minister.

heading: Idem re preservation and enhancement of environmental quality
paragraph: 5 The Minister, in exercising his powers and carrying out his duties and functions under section 4, shall

heading: Idem re preservation and enhancement of environmental quality
paragraph: (a) initiate, recommend and undertake programs, and coordinate programs of the Government of Canada that are designed

heading: Idem re preservation and enhancement of environmental quality
paragraph: (i) to promote the establishment or adoption of objectives or standards relating to environmental quality, or to control pollution,

heading: Idem re preservation and enhancement of environmental quality
paragraph: (ii) to ensure that new federal projects, programs and activities are assessed early in the planning process for potential adverse effects on the quality of the natural environment and that a further review is carried out of those projects, programs, and activities that are found to have probable significant adverse effects, and the results thereof taken into account, and

heading: Idem re preservation and enhancement of environmental quality
paragraph: (iii) to provide to Canadians environmental information in the public interest;

heading: Idem re preservation and enhancement of environmental quality
paragraph: (b) promote and encourage the institution of practices and conduct leading to the better preservation and enhancement of environmental quality, and cooperate with provincial governments or agencies thereof, or any bodies, organizations or persons, in any programs having similar objects; and

heading: Idem re preservation and enhancement of environmental quality
paragraph: (c) advise the heads of departments, boards and agencies of the Government of Canada on all matters pertaining to the preservation and enhancement of the quality of the natural environment.

heading: Guidelines related to environmental quality
paragraph: 6 For the purposes of carrying out his duties and functions related to environmental quality, the Minister may, by order, with the approval of the Governor in Council, establish guidelines for use by departments, boards and agencies of the Government of Canada and, where appropriate, by corporations named in Schedule III to the Financial Administration Act and regulatory bodies in the exercise of their powers and the carrying out of their duties and functions.

heading: Agreements
paragraph: 7 The Minister may, with the approval of the Governor in Council, enter into agreements with the government of any province or any agency thereof respecting the carrying out of programs for which the Minister is responsible.

heading: Annual report
paragraph: 8 The Minister shall, on or before January 31 next following the end of each fiscal year or, if Parliament is not then sitting, on any of the first five days next thereafter that either House of Parliament is sitting, submit to Parliament a report showing the operations of the Department for that fiscal year.
