heading: Definitions
paragraph: 1		  (1) Words and expressions used but not defined in this Act or in the regulations for the purposes of this Act, unless the context otherwise requires, have the same meanings as in the Petroleum and Natural Gas Act, other than Part 17 of that Act.

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (2) In this Act:

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "appeal tribunal" means the Energy Resource Appeal Tribunal continued under section 19;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "authorization" means, except in sections 34, 39 (1) and 104 and Part 10, an authorization under a specified enactment to carry out a related activity, and includes the conditions, if any, imposed on the authorization under this Act or the specified enactment;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "authorization holder" means a person who holds an authorization and is not a permit holder;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "board" means the board of the regulator continued under section 2;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "certificate of restoration" means a certificate issued by the regulator under section 41;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "commissioner" means the commissioner appointed under section 6.1 (1);

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "energy resource" means

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) petroleum,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) natural gas,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (c) hydrogen,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (d) methanol, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (e) ammonia;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "energy resource activity" means any of the following:

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) the exploration for or development of petroleum or natural gas;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) the production, gathering, processing, storage or disposal of petroleum or natural gas;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (c) the exploration for or development or use of a storage reservoir

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (i)  in relation to another energy resource activity, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (ii)  for the purposes of storing or disposing of carbon dioxide or a prescribed substance, whether or not in relation to another energy resource activity;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (d) the construction or operation of a facility for the purposes of an activity described in paragraph (a), (b) or (c);

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (e) the construction or operation of any of the following facilities:

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (i)  a facility for manufacturing hydrogen, ammonia or methanol from petroleum, natural gas, water or another substance;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (ii)  a facility for converting natural gas into organic compounds;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (iii)  a petroleum refinery;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (iv)  a prescribed facility;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (f) the construction or operation of a pipeline;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (g) the construction or maintenance of a prescribed road;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (h) a prescribed activity;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "energy resource road" means a road referred to in paragraph (g) of the definition of "energy resource activity";

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "environmental measure" means an action a person must take or refrain from taking for the protection or effective management of the environment;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "facility" means a system of vessels, piping, valves, tanks and other equipment that is used to gather, process, measure, store or dispose of an energy resource, water or a substance referred to in paragraph (d) or (e) of the definition of "pipeline";

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "flow line" means a pipeline that connects a well head with a scrubbing, processing or storage facility and that precedes the transfer of the conveyed substance to or from a transmission, distribution or transportation line;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "former permit holder" includes a person who was a director of a corporation that

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) held a permit with respect to which there has been a cancellation, declaration or expiry referred to in section 40, and

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) no longer exists or has amalgamated with another corporation;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "government's environmental objectives" means the prescribed objectives of the government respecting the protection and effective management of the environment;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "highway" has the same meaning as in the Transportation Act;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "land owner" means

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) a person registered in the land title office as the registered owner of the land surface or as its purchaser under an agreement for sale, and

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) a person to whom a disposition of Crown land has been issued under the Land Act,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: but does not include the government or a person referred to in paragraph (b) of the definition of "unoccupied Crown land" in section 1 of the Petroleum and Natural Gas Act;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "official", except in sections 6 and 8, means a person designated as an official under section 7 (4);

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "off-site environmental mitigation activity", in relation to a permit, means

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) an activity outside the operating areas of the permit to mitigate or otherwise offset impacts to the environment of

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (i)  an energy resource activity permitted by the permit, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (ii)  a related activity of an energy resource activity referred to in subparagraph (i) or of the application for the permit under section 24, and

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) any of the following activities in relation to an off-site environmental mitigation activity referred to in paragraph (a):

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (i)  monitoring;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (ii)  taking samples;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (iii)  conducting tests and analyses;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (iv)  submitting records and information to the regulator;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "oil and gas or storage activity" means

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) an activity described in paragraph (a), (b), (c) or (d) of the definition of "energy resource activity",

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) the construction or operation of a pipeline that is used to

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (i)  transport petroleum or natural gas, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (ii)  facilitate the carrying out of an activity described in paragraph (a) of this definition, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (c) the construction or maintenance of an energy resource road, if that activity is being carried out to facilitate the carrying out of an activity described in paragraph (a) or (b) of this definition;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "operating area" means an area, identified in a permit, within which a permit holder is permitted to carry out an energy resource activity;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "permit" means a permit issued under section 25 and includes any conditions imposed on a permit;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "permit holder" means

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) a person who holds a permit, and

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) a person, if any, who is the holder of a location with respect to that permit;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "pipeline" means, except in section 9, piping through which any of the following is conveyed:

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) an energy resource;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a.1) carbon dioxide;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) water used for, or produced in the course of, an energy resource activity;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (c) solids;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (d) substances prescribed under section 133 (2) (v) of the Petroleum and Natural Gas Act;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (e) other prescribed substances,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: and includes installations and facilities associated with the piping, but does not include

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (f) piping used to transmit natural gas at less than 700 kPa to consumers by a gas utility as defined in the Gas Utility Act,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (g) a well head, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (h) anything else that is prescribed;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "pipeline permit" means a permit that includes a permission to construct, maintain or operate a pipeline;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "pipeline permit holder" means a permit holder of a pipeline permit;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "regulator" means the British Columbia Energy Regulator continued under section 2;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "related activity" means an activity

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) that, under a specified enactment, must not be carried out except as authorized under the specified enactment or that must be carried out in accordance with the specified enactment, and

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) the carrying out of which is required for or facilitates

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (i)  carrying out an energy resource activity,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (ii)  carrying out an off-site environmental mitigation activity, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (iii)  making an application for a permit under section 24;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "specified enactment" means any of the following Acts:

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) Environmental Management Act;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) Forest Act;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (c) Heritage Conservation Act;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (d) Land Act;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (e) Water Sustainability Act;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "specified provision" means the following provisions:

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) any of the following provisions of the Environmental Management Act:

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (i)  section 9 [hazardous waste storage and disposal];

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (ii)  section 14 [permits];

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (iii)  section 15 [approvals];

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) any of the following provisions of the Forest Act:

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (i)  section 47.4 [licence to cut for persons occupying land or for energy resource purposes], but only in relation to a master licence to cut;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (ii)  sections 52.03 [issuance of cutting permit], 52.10 [extension of cutting permit] and 52.11 [postponement of cutting permit], but only in relation to a cutting permit for a master licence to cut;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (iii)  section 119.6 [issuance of road use permit for natural resource development purpose];

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (c) any of the following provisions of the Heritage Conservation Act:

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (i)  sections 12.4 to 12.8 [permit authorizing certain actions];

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (ii)  sections 12.2 and 12.3 [heritage inspection and heritage investigation permits and orders];

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (d) any of the following provisions of the Land Act:

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (i)  section 11, but only in relation to a lease or grant described in section 11 (2) (b) to (d) [disposing of Crown land];

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (iii)  section 38 [lease of Crown land], but not to the extent that it relates to the granting of an option to purchase land;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (iv)  section 39 [licence of occupation];

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (v)  section 40 [right of way and easement];

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (vi)  section 96 (1) [occupational rental];

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (e) any of the following provisions of the Water Sustainability Act, but only in relation to a use approval or a change approval as those terms are defined in section 1 (1) of that Act:

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (i)  section 10 [use approvals];

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (ii)  section 11 [changes in and about a stream], in respect of a person other than the government of British Columbia or Canada or a municipality;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (iii)  section 24 [permits over Crown land];

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (f) a prescribed regulation under a specified enactment;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "spillage" means an energy resource, oil, solids or other substances escaping, leaking or spilling from

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) a pipeline, well, shot hole, flow line, or facility, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) any source apparently associated with any of those substances.

heading: Application
paragraph: 1.1		  This Act does not apply in relation to a prescribed energy resource activity.

heading: British Columbia Energy Regulator
paragraph:
2
		  (1) The Oil and Gas Commission is renamed as the British Columbia Energy Regulator and is continued as a corporation consisting of a board of directors appointed under this section.

heading: British Columbia Energy Regulator
paragraph: (2) The board is to consist of at least 5 and no more than 7 directors appointed by the Lieutenant Governor in Council as follows:

heading: British Columbia Energy Regulator
paragraph: (a) one director who is a deputy minister;

heading: British Columbia Energy Regulator
paragraph: (b) one director who is an Indigenous person;

heading: British Columbia Energy Regulator
paragraph: (c) at least 3 and no more than 5 additional directors.

heading: British Columbia Energy Regulator
paragraph: (3) The chair of the board is a director who

heading: British Columbia Energy Regulator
paragraph: (a) is designated in writing as chair by the minister, or

heading: British Columbia Energy Regulator
paragraph: (b) if a chair is not designated under paragraph (a), is appointed by the board in accordance with procedures established under section 5 (1).

heading: British Columbia Energy Regulator
paragraph: (4) The board must elect a vice chair from among the directors.

heading: British Columbia Energy Regulator
paragraph: (5) An individual may be appointed as a director for a term of no more than 5 years and may be reappointed.

heading: British Columbia Energy Regulator
paragraph: (6) A majority of the directors holding office constitutes a quorum at meetings of the board.

heading: British Columbia Energy Regulator
paragraph: (7) If there is a tie vote, the chair of the board or, in the absence of the chair, the vice chair has the deciding vote.

heading: British Columbia Energy Regulator
paragraph: (8) A vacancy in the membership of the board or the incapacity of one of the directors does not impair the power of the remaining directors to act.

heading: British Columbia Energy Regulator
paragraph: (9) If a director dies or is unable to act or if a director's position is otherwise vacant, the minister, by order, may appoint an acting director for a period not longer than 6 months.

heading: British Columbia Energy Regulator
paragraph: (10) The regulator may pay to a director remuneration and expense allowances at rates set by the minister.

heading: Regulator is an agent of the government
paragraph:
3
		  The regulator is an agent of the government.

heading: Purposes
paragraph:
4
		  The purpose of the regulator is to regulate energy resource activities in a manner that protects public safety and the environment, supports reconciliation with Indigenous peoples and the transition to low-carbon energy, conserves energy resources and fosters a sound economy and social well-being.

heading: Direction and management of regulator
paragraph:
5
		  (1) The board may pass resolutions it considers necessary or advisable to direct its affairs, exercise its powers and perform its duties, including resolutions for one or more of the following:

heading: Direction and management of regulator
paragraph: (a) calling and holding meetings of the board and the procedures to be followed at meetings;

heading: Direction and management of regulator
paragraph: (b) making regulations of the board;

heading: Direction and management of regulator
paragraph: (c) approving the regulator's annual service plan under the Budget Transparency and Accountability Act, as well as the regulator's annual budget estimate detailing the expected revenues and planned expenditures of the regulator for the next fiscal year;

heading: Direction and management of regulator
paragraph: (d) establishing a plan of organization to carry out the powers of the regulator.

heading: Direction and management of regulator
paragraph: (2) The board must

heading: Direction and management of regulator
paragraph: (a) establish, in accordance with the regulations, if any, a conflict of interest policy for the directors that includes provisions respecting

heading: Direction and management of regulator
paragraph: (i)  the disclosure of interests in contracts or transactions with the regulator,

heading: Direction and management of regulator
paragraph: (ii)  the duty to account for profits,

heading: Direction and management of regulator
paragraph: (iii)  the validity of contracts and transactions in which a director has an interest, and

heading: Direction and management of regulator
paragraph: (iv)  the disclosure of any property owned or office held by a director that may create a conflict of interest or duty,

heading: Direction and management of regulator
paragraph: (b) submit the policy referred to in paragraph (a) to the minister, and

heading: Direction and management of regulator
paragraph: (c) establish a code of conduct, including conflict of interest provisions, that governs the conduct of employees of the regulator.

heading: Direction and management of regulator
paragraph: (3) On receipt of a conflict of interest policy under subsection (2) (b) or on the minister's own initiative, the minister may order the board to amend its conflict of interest policy and resubmit that policy to the minister in accordance with the order.

heading: Direction and management of regulator
paragraph: (4) A resolution of the board that is approved by directors, whether present in person or approving by telephone, facsimile transmission, electronic mail or any other similar means of communication, confirmed in writing or other graphic communication, is as valid as if it had been passed at a meeting of the board properly called and constituted.

heading: Capacity and powers of regulator
paragraph: 6		  (1) For the purposes of this Act, the regulator may do any or all of the following:

heading: Capacity and powers of regulator
paragraph: (a) subject to subsection (2), acquire, hold and dispose of property;

heading: Capacity and powers of regulator
paragraph: (b) invest money, and, subject to the prior approval of the Lieutenant Governor in Council, borrow money;

heading: Capacity and powers of regulator
paragraph: (c) subject to subsection (2), negotiate and enter into agreements with any person, including the government of British Columbia, the government of Canada, the government of another province or of a territory, a local government, a First Nation or with an official or agency of any of them;

heading: Capacity and powers of regulator
paragraph: (d) subject to subsection (2), expend money for the purposes of administering the Act;

heading: Capacity and powers of regulator
paragraph: (e) do other things that the Lieutenant Governor in Council may authorize.

heading: Capacity and powers of regulator
paragraph: (2) In the prescribed circumstances, the regulator may exercise the power referred to in subsection (1) (a), (c) or (d) only with the approval of the Lieutenant Governor in Council.

heading: Capacity and powers of regulator
paragraph: (3) With the prior approval of the Lieutenant Governor in Council, the regulator may in any year pay to a municipality in which it has property a grant not greater than the amount that would be payable as taxes on the property in that year if the property were not exempt from taxation by the municipality.

heading: Capacity and powers of regulator
paragraph: (4) If directed to do so by the Lieutenant Governor in Council, the regulator must pay to a municipality in which it has property a grant not greater than the amount that would be payable as taxes on the property in that year if the property were not exempt from taxation by the municipality.

heading: Commissioner
paragraph:
6.1
		  (1) The Lieutenant Governor in Council may appoint an individual, to be known as the commissioner, as the chief executive officer of the regulator.

heading: Commissioner
paragraph: (2) If the commissioner dies or is unable to act or if the commissioner's position is otherwise vacant, the minister, by order, may appoint an individual to be the acting commissioner for a period not longer than 6 months.

heading: Commissioner
paragraph: (3) The board may appoint a deputy commissioner.

heading: Commissioner
paragraph: (4) A deputy commissioner has the powers of the commissioner, unless the board otherwise directs, and is subject to any directions given by the commissioner.

heading: Powers of commissioner
paragraph:
7
		  (1) Subject to the direction of the board, the commissioner must manage the operations of the regulator or supervise the management of those operations.

heading: Powers of commissioner
paragraph: (2) The commissioner has the powers and duties of an official and of the regulator under this Act, other than those powers and duties expressly given to the board under this Act.

heading: Powers of commissioner
paragraph: (3) The commissioner may hire employees of the regulator necessary to carry on the business and operations of the regulator and may define their duties and determine their remuneration.

heading: Powers of commissioner
paragraph: (4) The commissioner may designate a person as an official for the purposes of provisions, specified by the commissioner in the designation, of this Act or the regulations made under this Act.

heading: Powers of commissioner
paragraph: (5) The commissioner may

heading: Powers of commissioner
paragraph: (a) delegate the exercise of any power or performance of any duty conferred or imposed on the regulator under this Act, other than those powers and duties expressly given to the board under this Act, to an employee or official of the regulator or another public officer, and

heading: Powers of commissioner
paragraph: (b) in making a delegation, provide directions that are binding on the delegate respecting the exercise of the power or the performance of the duty.

heading: Powers of commissioner
paragraph: (6) A delegation under subsection (5) may be made by name or by designation of the office.

heading: Regulator's responsibilities under specified enactments
paragraph:
8
		  (1) For the regulation of energy resource activities and related activities, the regulator, instead of the official named in a specified provision,

heading: Regulator's responsibilities under specified enactments
paragraph: (a) has all the powers relating to a discretion, function or duty referred to in the specified provision, including, without limiting this, the powers in the specified enactment relating to the administration and enforcement of an authorization, and

heading: Regulator's responsibilities under specified enactments
paragraph: (b) is charged with all the responsibilities pertaining to that discretion, function or duty.

heading: Regulator's responsibilities under specified enactments
paragraph: (2) Despite subsection (1), both the regulator and the director, as the latter is defined in section 1 of the Environmental Management Act, have all the powers referred to in section 14 of that Act and are charged with all the responsibilities pertaining to those powers.

heading: Regulator's responsibilities under specified enactments
paragraph: (3) Subject to this Act, the exercise of the powers conferred on the regulator by subsection (1), the carrying out of each discretion, function and duty referred to in a specified enactment and the responsibilities with which the regulator is charged under this section remain subject to the specified enactment and that specified enactment continues to apply.

heading: Regulator's responsibilities under specified enactments
paragraph: (4) Despite subsections (1) and (3), the regulator and the appropriate officials under the various specified enactments are each responsible for enforcing the specified enactments in relation to the matters described in the specified provisions.

heading: Application of section 8 to pipelines under jurisdiction of Canada
paragraph: 9		  (1) In this section:

heading: Application of section 8 to pipelines under jurisdiction of Canada
paragraph: "approval" means an approval, with any conditions imposed, under a specified enactment to carry out an activity

heading: Application of section 8 to pipelines under jurisdiction of Canada
paragraph: (a) that, under the specified enactment, must not be carried out except as approved under the specified enactment, and

heading: Application of section 8 to pipelines under jurisdiction of Canada
paragraph: (b) the carrying out of which is required for or facilitates

heading: Application of section 8 to pipelines under jurisdiction of Canada
paragraph: (i)  making an application under the Canadian Energy Regulator Act (Canada) to operate or construct a pipeline, or

heading: Application of section 8 to pipelines under jurisdiction of Canada
paragraph: (ii)  operating or constructing a pipeline;

heading: Application of section 8 to pipelines under jurisdiction of Canada
paragraph: "pipeline" has the same meaning as in the Canadian Energy Regulator Act (Canada).

heading: Application of section 8 to pipelines under jurisdiction of Canada
paragraph: (2) The regulator's powers under section 8 do not include the power to issue an approval with respect to a pipeline that is subject to the Canadian Energy Regulator Act (Canada).

heading: Application of section 8 to pipelines under jurisdiction of Canada
paragraph: (3) Despite subsection (2), the Lieutenant Governor in Council may, by regulation, extend the regulator's powers under section 8 to include the power to issue an approval under one or more specified enactments with respect to a pipeline referred to in subsection (2).

heading: Application of section 8 to pipelines under jurisdiction of Canada
paragraph: (4) If the regulator's powers are extended as described in subsection (3) in relation to an approval under one or more specified enactments,

heading: Application of section 8 to pipelines under jurisdiction of Canada
paragraph: (a) section 8 applies respecting the applicable specified enactments in relation to the pipeline, whether or not the regulator issued the approval,

heading: Application of section 8 to pipelines under jurisdiction of Canada
paragraph: (b) section 24 (3) does not apply to the granting of the approval,

heading: Application of section 8 to pipelines under jurisdiction of Canada
paragraph: (b.1) section 32 (1.1) does not apply in relation to the approval, and

heading: Application of section 8 to pipelines under jurisdiction of Canada
paragraph: (c) for the purposes of this Act other than this section and sections 34, 39 (1) and 104 and Part 10, an approval must be considered to be an authorization and a person who holds an approval must be considered to be an authorization holder.

heading: Minister may order independent audit
paragraph: 10		  (1) The minister may order an independent audit of the performance of the regulator in fulfilling its purposes or exercising its powers and performing its functions and duties under this Act.

heading: Minister may order independent audit
paragraph: (2) The minister responsible for the Wildlife Act may order an independent audit of the performance of the regulator in fulfilling its purposes or exercising its powers and performing its functions and duties under this Act in relation to the protection and effective management of the environment.

heading: Minister may order independent audit
paragraph: (3) An order under subsection (1) or (2) must include terms of reference for the audit.

heading: Minister may order independent audit
paragraph: (4) If requested by an auditor appointed for the purposes of subsection (1) or (2), the regulator must submit records in its possession that the auditor determines are relevant to the audit.

heading: Minister may order independent audit
paragraph: (5) Before an audit report is finalized, the auditor must provide to the board

heading: Minister may order independent audit
paragraph: (a) a copy of the draft audit report, and

heading: Minister may order independent audit
paragraph: (b) a reasonable opportunity to review and comment on the report.

heading: Minister may order independent audit
paragraph: (6) As soon as practicable after completing an audit, the auditor must submit the final audit report and any comments of the board to

heading: Minister may order independent audit
paragraph: (a) the minister who issued the order under subsection (1) or (2), and

heading: Minister may order independent audit
paragraph: (b) the board.

heading: Advisory committee
paragraph: 11		  (1) The board may establish and appoint an advisory committee to consider or inquire into any matter and to report its findings and provide its advice to the board.

heading: Advisory committee
paragraph: (2) The regulator may pay to a person appointed as a member of an advisory committee remuneration and expense allowances at rates set by the minister.

heading: Inquiries and recommendations
paragraph:
12
		  (1) At the request of the Lieutenant Governor in Council, the regulator must, at the places and times and in a manner the Lieutenant Governor in Council considers advisable,

heading: Inquiries and recommendations
paragraph: (a) make inquiries, conduct investigations and prepare studies and reports on any matter within the scope of this Act, and

heading: Inquiries and recommendations
paragraph: (b) recommend to the Lieutenant Governor in Council any measures the regulator considers necessary or advisable in the public interest related to energy resource activities.

heading: Inquiries and recommendations
paragraph: (2) Subsection (1) does not apply to a matter that is before the regulator.

heading: Public Service Act and Public Service Labour Relations Act
paragraph:
13
		  (1) The Public Service Act and the Public Service Labour Relations Act do not apply to the regulator or to its employees.

heading: Public Service Act and Public Service Labour Relations Act
paragraph: (2) Despite subsection (1), the Public Service Pension Plan, continued under the Public Sector Pension Plans Act, continues to apply to the regulator and to its employees.

heading: Financial administration
paragraph: 14		  (1) The regulator must establish and maintain an accounting system satisfactory to the Minister of Finance.

heading: Financial administration
paragraph: (2) The regulator must prepare financial statements in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles.

heading: Financial administration
paragraph: (3) Whenever required by the Minister of Finance, the regulator must provide detailed accounts of its revenues and expenditures for the period or to the date the Minister of Finance designates.

heading: Financial administration
paragraph: (4) All books or records of account, documents and other financial records of the regulator are at all times open for inspection by the Minister of Finance or a person designated by the Minister of Finance.

heading: Financial administration
paragraph: (5) The Minister of Finance may direct the Comptroller General to examine and report to Treasury Board on any or all of the financial and accounting operations of the regulator.

heading: Financial administration
paragraph: (6) The regulator, with the approval of the Minister of Finance, may budget for a deficit in a fiscal year.

heading: Financial administration
paragraph: (7) The Minister of Finance, for the purposes of subsection (6), may grant an approval for one fiscal year or for any other number of fiscal years.

heading: Financial administration
paragraph: (8) The fiscal year of the regulator is a period of 12 months beginning on April 1 in each year and ending on March 31 in the next year.

heading: Financial administration
paragraph: (9) The Minister of Finance is the fiscal agent of the regulator.

heading: Audit
paragraph:
15
		  Unless the Auditor General is appointed in accordance with the Auditor General Act as the auditor of the regulator, an auditor appointed by the regulator must, at least once for each fiscal year, audit and report on the accounts of the regulator to the Executive Council through the minister and to the board, and the costs of the audit must be paid by the regulator.

heading: Application of Business Corporations Act
paragraph: 16		  (1) Subject to subsection (2), the Business Corporations Act does not apply to the regulator.

heading: Application of Business Corporations Act
paragraph: (2) The Lieutenant Governor in Council, by order, may declare that certain provisions of the Business Corporations Act and Societies Act apply to the regulator.

heading: Appropriation
paragraph:
18
		  (1) In this section, "revenue" includes interest but does not include penalties.

heading: Appropriation
paragraph: (2) The Minister of Finance, out of the consolidated revenue fund, must pay to the regulator

heading: Appropriation
paragraph: (a) the gross revenue received from the levies authorized under section 110,

heading: Appropriation
paragraph: (b) the gross revenue received from the levies authorized under section 47, and

heading: Appropriation
paragraph: (c) the gross revenue received from fees in relation to

heading: Appropriation
paragraph: (i)  applications for and issuance of permits and the prescribed authorizations issued by the regulator under this Act, and

heading: Appropriation
paragraph: (ii)  fees prescribed under section 112 (1) (c).

heading: Appropriation
paragraph: (3) With the approval of Treasury Board, the minister may pay out of the consolidated revenue fund, on application by the regulator, money required for the purposes of sections 12, 52 and 53.

heading: Continuation of Energy Resource Appeal Tribunal
paragraph:
19
		  (1) The Oil and Gas Appeal Tribunal is continued as the Energy Resource Appeal Tribunal.

heading: Continuation of Energy Resource Appeal Tribunal
paragraph: (2) The appeal tribunal is to hear appeals under section 72.

heading: Continuation of Energy Resource Appeal Tribunal
paragraph: (3) The appeal tribunal consists of the following members appointed by the Lieutenant Governor in Council after a merit-based process:

heading: Continuation of Energy Resource Appeal Tribunal
paragraph: (a) a member designated as the chair;

heading: Continuation of Energy Resource Appeal Tribunal
paragraph: (b) one or more members designated as vice chairs after consultation with the chair;

heading: Continuation of Energy Resource Appeal Tribunal
paragraph: (c) other members appointed after consultation with the chair.

heading: Application of Administrative Tribunals Act
paragraph:
20
		  The following provisions of the Administrative Tribunals Act apply to the appeal tribunal:

heading: Application of Administrative Tribunals Act
paragraph: (a) Part 1 [Interpretation and Application];

heading: Application of Administrative Tribunals Act
paragraph: (b) Part 2 [Appointments];

heading: Application of Administrative Tribunals Act
paragraph: (c) Part 3 [Clustering];

heading: Application of Administrative Tribunals Act
paragraph: (d) Part 4 [Practice and Procedure], except the following:

heading: Application of Administrative Tribunals Act
paragraph: (i)  section 23 [notice of appeal (exclusive of prescribed fee)];

heading: Application of Administrative Tribunals Act
paragraph: (ii)  section 25 [appeal does not operate as stay];

heading: Application of Administrative Tribunals Act
paragraph: (iii)  section 34 (1) and (2) [party power to compel witnesses and require disclosure];

heading: Application of Administrative Tribunals Act
paragraph: (e) section 44 [tribunal without jurisdiction over constitutional questions];

heading: Application of Administrative Tribunals Act
paragraph: (f) section 46.3 [tribunal without jurisdiction to apply the Human Rights Code];

heading: Permit required
paragraph: 21		  Subject to section 23, a person must not carry out an energy resource activity unless

heading: Permit required
paragraph: (a) either

heading: Permit required
paragraph: (i)  the person holds a permit that gives the person permission to carry out that energy resource activity, or

heading: Permit required
paragraph: (ii)  the person is required to carry out that energy resource activity by an order issued under section 49, and

heading: Permit required
paragraph: (b) the person carries out the energy resource activity in compliance with

heading: Permit required
paragraph: (i)  this Act and the regulations,

heading: Permit required
paragraph: (ii)  a permit issued to the person, if any, and

heading: Permit required
paragraph: (iii)  an order issued to the person, if any.

heading: Consultation and notification
paragraph:
22
		  (1) In subsection (3), "prescribed applicant" means a person who intends to submit an application under section 24 and who is in a prescribed class of persons.

heading: Consultation and notification
paragraph: (2) Before submitting an application under section 24, a person must notify the land owner of the land on which the person intends to carry out an energy resource activity of the person's intention to submit the application, and the notice must advise the land owner that the land owner may make a submission to the regulator under subsection (5) of this section with respect to the application or proposed application.

heading: Consultation and notification
paragraph: (3) Subject to subsection (4), before submitting an application under section 24, a prescribed applicant must carry out the prescribed consultations or provide the prescribed notices, or both, as applicable, with respect to the energy resource activities, off-site environmental mitigation activities and related activities, if any, that will be the subject of the prescribed applicant's application.

heading: Consultation and notification
paragraph: (4) The regulator, on written request, may exempt a person from one or more of the applicable consultation or notification requirements under subsection (3) and, on making an exemption, substitute other consultation or notification requirements than those prescribed for the purposes of subsection (3).

heading: Consultation and notification
paragraph: (5) A person, other than the applicant, may make a written submission to the regulator with respect to an application or a proposed application under section 24.

heading: Consultation and notification
paragraph: (6) If a person makes a submission under subsection (5), the regulator must send a copy of the submission to the applicant or to the person intending to apply for a permit, as the case may be.

heading: Preliminary plan
paragraph:
23
		  (1) Before submitting an application under section 24 for a pipeline permit, a person may submit to the regulator a preliminary plan of the proposed route of the pipeline.

heading: Preliminary plan
paragraph: (2) Subject to subsection (3), a person may enter on land as necessary for making surveys, examinations or other arrangements for the purpose of fixing the site of the pipeline referred to in subsection (1), if the person

heading: Preliminary plan
paragraph: (a) has submitted a preliminary plan under subsection (1), and

heading: Preliminary plan
paragraph: (b) has either

heading: Preliminary plan
paragraph: (i)  provided the prescribed security to the regulator to compensate the land owner or the Crown for any damage or disturbance that may be caused by the entry on the land by the person, or

heading: Preliminary plan
paragraph: (ii)  entered into an agreement with the land owner regarding entry on the land.

heading: Preliminary plan
paragraph: (3) A person who has not entered into an agreement referred to in subsection (2) (b) (ii) must notify, in accordance with the regulations, the owner of the land of the person's intention to enter on that land.

heading: Preliminary plan
paragraph: (4) The right of entry under subsection (2) does not extend to any of the following:

heading: Preliminary plan
paragraph: (a) land occupied by a building;

heading: Preliminary plan
paragraph: (b) the curtilage of a dwelling house;

heading: Preliminary plan
paragraph: (c) protected heritage property, unless the person is authorized by the local government or the minister responsible for the protection of the protected heritage property.

heading: Preliminary plan
paragraph: (5) In subsection (4) (c), "protected heritage property" means land or an object that is

heading: Preliminary plan
paragraph: (a) protected under section 12.1 of the Heritage Conservation Act,

heading: Preliminary plan
paragraph: (b) designated under section 611 of the Local Government Act or section 593 of the Vancouver Charter, or

heading: Preliminary plan
paragraph: (c) included under section 614 (3) (b) of the Local Government Act in a schedule to an official community plan.

heading: Application for permit and authorization
paragraph: 24		  (1) Subject to subsection (4), a person may apply to the regulator for a permit by submitting, in the form and manner the regulator requires,

heading: Application for permit and authorization
paragraph: (a) a description of the proposed site of the energy resource activity,

heading: Application for permit and authorization
paragraph: (b) the information, plans, application form and records required by the regulator,

heading: Application for permit and authorization
paragraph: (c) a written report, satisfactory to the regulator, regarding the results of the consultations carried out or notification provided under section 22, if any,

heading: Application for permit and authorization
paragraph: (d) the prescribed information,

heading: Application for permit and authorization
paragraph: (e) the prescribed records, and

heading: Application for permit and authorization
paragraph: (f) the security required under section 30.

heading: Application for permit and authorization
paragraph: (2) An application for a permit under subsection (1) may be consolidated with an application for an authorization.

heading: Application for permit and authorization
paragraph: (3) Despite anything in a specified enactment, the regulator may not grant an authorization to a person for a related activity unless the person meets the prescribed requirements.

heading: Application for permit and authorization
paragraph: (4) A person may not submit an application for a permit to drill or operate a well, other than a water source well, unless

heading: Application for permit and authorization
paragraph: (a) the person is the owner of the petroleum and natural gas rights or is the holder of the location in respect of the well,

heading: Application for permit and authorization
paragraph: (b) the person has an agreement with the owner or the holder of the location referred to in paragraph (a) authorizing the drilling or operation, as applicable,

heading: Application for permit and authorization
paragraph: (c) the person is the holder of a storage reservoir licence issued under section 130 of the Petroleum and Natural Gas Act, or

heading: Application for permit and authorization
paragraph: (d) the minister has approved the submission under subsection (5).

heading: Application for permit and authorization
paragraph: (5) For the purposes of subsection (4) (d), the minister may

heading: Application for permit and authorization
paragraph: (a) approve the submission by a person of an application for a permit to drill a well if the well is to be drilled for exploratory or research purposes only, and

heading: Application for permit and authorization
paragraph: (b) in approving a submission under paragraph (a), declare that, if a permit is issued to the person on the basis of the submission, the person is not required to be an owner or holder referred to in subsection (4) or have the agreement referred to in that subsection in order to drill or operate the well for the purposes referred to in paragraph (a).

heading: Permits and authorizations issued by regulator
paragraph: 25		  (1) Subject to subsection (1.1), on application by a person under section 24 and after considering

heading: Permits and authorizations issued by regulator
paragraph: (a) written submissions made under section 22 (5), if any, and

heading: Permits and authorizations issued by regulator
paragraph: (b) the government's environmental objectives, if any have been prescribed for the purposes of this section,

heading: Permits and authorizations issued by regulator
paragraph: the regulator may issue a permit to the person if the person meets the requirements prescribed for the purposes of this section.

heading: Permits and authorizations issued by regulator
paragraph: (1.1) The Lieutenant Governor in Council, by regulation, may issue a direction to the regulator with respect to the exercise of the regulator's power under section 8 or subsection (1) of this section, and the regulator must comply with the direction despite any other provision of

heading: Permits and authorizations issued by regulator
paragraph: (a) this Act, the regulations or an order made under this Act, or

heading: Permits and authorizations issued by regulator
paragraph: (b) a specified enactment.

heading: Permits and authorizations issued by regulator
paragraph: (2) In issuing a permit under subsection (1), the regulator

heading: Permits and authorizations issued by regulator
paragraph: (a) must specify the energy resource activities the person is permitted to carry out, and

heading: Permits and authorizations issued by regulator
paragraph: (b) may impose any conditions on the permit that the regulator considers necessary.

heading: Permits and authorizations issued by regulator
paragraph: (3) A permit and any authorizations granted to the applicant for the permit may be issued as a single document.

heading: Permits and authorizations issued by regulator
paragraph: (4) If the regulator issues a permit under subsection (1), the regulator must provide notice, in accordance with subsection (5), to the land owner of the land on which an operating area is located.

heading: Permits and authorizations issued by regulator
paragraph: (5) A notice under subsection (4) must

heading: Permits and authorizations issued by regulator
paragraph: (a) advise the land owner of the issuance of the permit and of the location of the proposed site of an energy resource activity on the land owner's land, and

heading: Permits and authorizations issued by regulator
paragraph: (b) state that the land owner may appeal under section 72 the decision to issue the permit, and include an address to which an appeal may be sent.

heading: Permits and authorizations issued by regulator
paragraph: (6) A permit holder must not begin an energy resource activity on a land owner's land before the expiry of 15 days from the day the permit was issued, unless the land owner consents in writing to the activity beginning before the expiry of that period.

heading: Off-site environmental mitigation activities
paragraph:
25.1
		  (1) In this section:

heading: Off-site environmental mitigation activities
paragraph: "energy resource management area" means an energy resource management area established under section 105.1 (1) (b) (i);

heading: Off-site environmental mitigation activities
paragraph: "mitigation area", in relation to an oil and gas management area, means a mitigation area established under section 105.1 (1) (b) (ii) as a mitigation area for the oil and gas management area;

heading: Off-site environmental mitigation activities
paragraph: (2) Subject to subsection (3) and the regulations, in issuing or amending a permit that permits an energy resource activity in a prescribed class of energy resource activities to be carried out in an energy resource management area, the regulator

heading: Off-site environmental mitigation activities
paragraph: (a) must specify in the permit

heading: Off-site environmental mitigation activities
paragraph: (i)  the off-site environmental mitigation activities the permit holder is required to carry out, and

heading: Off-site environmental mitigation activities
paragraph: (ii)  the mitigation area for the energy resource management area, or a location in that mitigation area, where those off-site environmental mitigation activities must be carried out, and

heading: Off-site environmental mitigation activities
paragraph: (b) may specify in the permit when and how those off-site environmental mitigation activities must be carried out, including, without limitation, by specifying methods to be used or results to be achieved.

heading: Off-site environmental mitigation activities
paragraph: (3) In amending a permit, the regulator may not specify off-site mitigation activities in relation to any of the following:

heading: Off-site environmental mitigation activities
paragraph: (a) an energy resource activity that is or was permitted by the permit before the amendment, unless the amendment will increase the potential impacts to the environment of the energy resource activity;

heading: Off-site environmental mitigation activities
paragraph: (b) in the case of an amendment that will increase the potential impacts to the environment of an energy resource activity described in paragraph (a), the actual or potential impacts to the environment of the energy resource activity permitted by the permit before the amendment.

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph:
26
		  (0.1) In this section, "associate", in relation to a permit holder or applicant, means any of the following, as applicable:

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (a) an agent of the applicant or permit holder;

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (b) a director, officer or shareholder of the applicant or permit holder;

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (c) a person who, in the opinion of the regulator,

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (i)  may have influence over the applicant or permit holder, or

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (ii)  may be able to affect the activities permitted by the permit.

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (1) The regulator may

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (a) refuse to issue a permit,

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (b) suspend a permit or a permission specified in a permit,

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (c) cancel a permit or a permission specified in a permit, or

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (d) amend a permit.

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (2) Without limiting the authority of the regulator under subsection (1), the regulator may make a decision under subsection (1) if the applicant or permit holder, or an associate of the applicant or permit holder, does any of the following:

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (a) contravenes or has contravened

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (i)  this Act, the regulations, a permit, an authorization or an order issued under this Act, or

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (ii)  the Petroleum and Natural Gas Act or regulations made under that Act;

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (b) fails to meet or no longer meets any of the conditions of section 24 (4);

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (c) fails to meet or no longer meets the requirements prescribed for the purposes of section 25 (1), if any;

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (d) begins an energy resource activity permitted by a permit but then fails to carry out or continue that energy resource activity;

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (e) engages in or has engaged in a pattern of conduct that shows, in the commissioner's opinion, that the person is unfit to have a permit;

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (f) is or has been convicted of an offence under

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (i)  this Act or any other enactment, or

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (ii)  a law enacted by the government of Canada, another province of Canada or a foreign jurisdiction

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: for conduct that shows, in the commissioner's opinion, that the person is unfit to have a permit.

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (3) Without limiting the authority of the regulator under subsection (1), the regulator may make a decision under subsection (1) with respect to an applicant or permit holder if the applicant or permit holder is an employer, employee, officer, director or agent of a

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (a) permit holder against whom the regulator has made a decision under subsection (1), or

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (b) permit holder that has an employee, officer, director or agent against whom the regulator has made a decision under subsection (1).

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (4) Without limiting the authority of the regulator under subsection (1), the regulator may make a decision under subsection (1) with respect to a permit holder who holds more than one permit for any contravention by the permit holder of

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (a) any of the permit holder's permits, or

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (b) any order issued to the permit holder with respect to energy resource activities permitted, or off-site environmental mitigation activities required, under any of the permit holder's permits.

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (5) If the regulator suspends or cancels a permit or a permission under subsection (1) (b) or (c) or a permit expires under section 32 (1), the regulator may also suspend or cancel an authorization issued to the permit holder for a related activity of an energy resource activity permitted, or an off-site environmental mitigation activity required, by the permit, whether or not a specified enactment prohibits the suspension or cancellation of the authorization or requires the regulator to make a finding other than the suspension or cancellation of a permit before suspending or cancelling an authorization.

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (6) The regulator must give a permit holder an opportunity to be heard before making a decision under subsection (1) (b), (c) or (d) or (5) and must notify the permit holder of its decision under any of those provisions.

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (7) If the regulator refuses under subsection (1) to issue a permit, the regulator must provide notice, in accordance with subsection (8), to the land owner of the land notified by the applicant under section 22 (2).

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (8) A notice under subsection (7) must advise the land owner

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (a) that the regulator has refused to issue a permit,

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (b) that the applicant for the permit may, in relation to the refusal, request a review under section 70 or appeal under section 72, and

heading: Actions by regulator respecting permit
paragraph: (c) that the land owner may, on request, be a party to an appeal referred to in paragraph (b).

heading: Spent permit or permission
paragraph: 27		  (1) The regulator, on its own initiative or on application by a permit holder or authorization holder, may declare to be spent

heading: Spent permit or permission
paragraph: (a) a permit, if the regulator considers that the permit holder no longer requires the permit,

heading: Spent permit or permission
paragraph: (b) a permission specified in a permit, if the regulator considers that the permit holder no longer requires the permission, and

heading: Spent permit or permission
paragraph: (c) despite anything in a specified enactment prohibiting the declaration, an authorization held by the permit holder or authorization holder, if the regulator considers that the permit holder or authorization holder no longer requires the authorization.

heading: Spent permit or permission
paragraph: (2) Before the regulator makes a declaration under subsection (1) on its own initiative, the regulator must give the permit holder or authorization holder an opportunity to be heard.

heading: Spent permit or permission
paragraph: (3) If the regulator declares a permit or permission or an authorization to be spent under subsection (1), the regulator must provide written notice of that declaration to the permit holder, former permit holder, authorization holder or former authorization holder.

heading: Permitted activity under pipeline permits
paragraph:
28
		  (1) In this section:

heading: Permitted activity under pipeline permits
paragraph: "applicable Act" means the Forest Act, the Forest and Range Practices Act, the Railway Act and the Railway Safety Act;

heading: Permitted activity under pipeline permits
paragraph: "authority" means a person authorized to grant an approval under an applicable Act.

heading: Permitted activity under pipeline permits
paragraph: (2) Despite anything in an applicable Act but subject to subsection (3),

heading: Permitted activity under pipeline permits
paragraph: (a) the regulator, in a pipeline permit, may give permission to the pipeline permit holder to construct or operate a pipeline across, along, over or under any highway, road, public place, railway, underground communication or power line or another pipeline, and

heading: Permitted activity under pipeline permits
paragraph: (b) the pipeline permit holder may carry out the activities referred to in paragraph (a) in accordance with the pipeline permit and this Act.

heading: Permitted activity under pipeline permits
paragraph: (3) If, but for subsection (2), a permit holder would not be entitled to carry out the activities referred to in subsection (2) (a) without obtaining an approval under an applicable Act, the authority, on application made by the pipeline permit holder in accordance with the applicable Act, must grant the approval to the pipeline permit holder, but may impose, with respect to the carrying out of those activities, any conditions that the authority is authorized to impose on the approval under the applicable Act.

heading: Transfer of permit and authorizations
paragraph: 29		  (1) On application in writing signed by both a permit holder and a person who wants to acquire the permit, the regulator

heading: Transfer of permit and authorizations
paragraph: (a) may transfer the permit to that person, subject to any conditions the regulator considers necessary, and

heading: Transfer of permit and authorizations
paragraph: (b) if the regulator transfers the permit under paragraph (a), must transfer, despite anything in a specified enactment prohibiting the transfer, all authorizations issued to the permit holder for related activities of an energy resource activity permitted, or an off-site environmental mitigation activity required, by the permit.

heading: Transfer of permit and authorizations
paragraph: (1.1) On application in writing signed by both an authorization holder and a person who wants to acquire the authorization, the regulator may transfer, despite anything in a specified enactment prohibiting the transfer, the authorization to that person, subject to any conditions the regulator considers necessary.

heading: Transfer of permit and authorizations
paragraph: (1.2) Despite subsection (1), an application under that subsection is not required to be signed by the permit holder if

heading: Transfer of permit and authorizations
paragraph: (a) the permit is cancelled under section 26, 33 or 43.3,

heading: Transfer of permit and authorizations
paragraph: (b) the permit is declared to be spent under section 27,

heading: Transfer of permit and authorizations
paragraph: (c) the permit relates to an orphan site under section 45, or

heading: Transfer of permit and authorizations
paragraph: (d) the regulator is satisfied that the permit holder no longer exists or cannot be located.

heading: Transfer of permit and authorizations
paragraph: (2) In deciding whether to grant an application under subsection (1), the regulator may consider

heading: Transfer of permit and authorizations
paragraph: (a) any of the matters referred to in section 26 (2) to (4), and

heading: Transfer of permit and authorizations
paragraph: (b) any other matter that may be considered under a specified enactment,

heading: Transfer of permit and authorizations
paragraph: as though the person who wants to acquire the permit were an applicant for the permit and an authorization referred to in subsection (1) (b) of this section.

heading: Transfer of permit and authorizations
paragraph: (2.1) Subsection (2) applies to a transfer under subsection (1.1).

heading: Transfer of permit and authorizations
paragraph: (2.2) If the regulator decides to grant an application under subsection (1) in relation to a permit described in subsection (1.2) (a) or (b), the permit is reinstated.

heading: Transfer of permit and authorizations
paragraph: (2.3) If the regulator decides to grant an application under subsection (1) in relation to a permit described in subsection (1.2) (c), the orphan site designation is cancelled.

heading: Transfer of permit and authorizations
paragraph: (3) A person to whom a permit or authorization is transferred under subsection (1) or (1.1) has the same rights and obligations as if the permit or authorization had been issued to that person.

heading: Required security
paragraph:
30
		  (1) The regulator, by order or by imposition of a condition under section 25 (2) (b), may require a holder or applicant to provide security to the regulator, in the amount the regulator requires and in accordance with the regulations, to ensure the performance of an obligation under this Act, a permit or an authorization.

heading: Required security
paragraph: (2) In this section, "holder or applicant" means a permit holder, an applicant for a permit, a transferee of a permit, an authorization holder, an applicant for an authorization or a transferee of an authorization.

heading: Amendment of permit
paragraph:
31
		  (1) Before submitting an application under subsection (4) for an amendment to a permit, a permit holder must provide notice to the land owner of the land on which an operating area is located, and the notice must

heading: Amendment of permit
paragraph: (a) provide a description of the proposed amendment, and

heading: Amendment of permit
paragraph: (b) advise the land owner that the land owner may make a submission to the regulator under subsection (2).

heading: Amendment of permit
paragraph: (1.1) The regulator may exempt a person or a class of persons from the requirement to provide notice under subsection (1) to a land owner or a class of land owners if the regulator is satisfied that

heading: Amendment of permit
paragraph: (a) the activity respecting the proposed amendment would not be carried out on the land of the land owner or class of land owners, and

heading: Amendment of permit
paragraph: (b) the proposed amendment would not change the effect of the permit on the land of the land owner or class of land owners.

heading: Amendment of permit
paragraph: (2) A land owner who receives a notice under subsection (1) may make a written submission to the regulator regarding the proposed amendment within 15 days of receiving the notice.

heading: Amendment of permit
paragraph: (3) If a land owner makes a submission under subsection (2), the regulator must send a copy of the submission to the permit holder.

heading: Amendment of permit
paragraph: (4) After complying with subsection (1), a permit holder may apply to the regulator for an amendment to the permit holder's permit by submitting an application in writing.

heading: Amendment of permit
paragraph: (5) On receipt of an application under subsection (4), the regulator may require the permit holder to carry out one or more of the prescribed consultations or provide one or more of the prescribed notices, as applicable, with respect to the proposed amendment.

heading: Amendment of permit
paragraph: (6) A permit holder required to carry out consultations or provide notice under subsection (5) must submit a written report to the regulator regarding the results of the consultations or notice.

heading: Amendment of permit
paragraph: (7) On receipt of an application under subsection (4) and after considering a submission made under subsection (2), if any, and the results of consultations carried out or notices provided under subsection (5), if any, the regulator may amend the permit holder's permit or refuse to amend the permit.

heading: Amendment of permit
paragraph: (8) An amendment made under subsection (7) is effective on and after the day it is made, unless the amendment changes the effect of the permit on the land of the land owner referred to in subsection (1), in which case the amendment is effective on and after the earlier of the following:

heading: Amendment of permit
paragraph: (a) the 15th day following the day it is made;

heading: Amendment of permit
paragraph: (b) the day the permit holder obtains written consent from the land owner to treat the amendment as being in effect on and after the date the consent is given.

heading: Amendment of permit
paragraph: (9) If the regulator amends a permit under subsection (7), the regulator must provide notice to the land owner referred to in subsection (1) in accordance with subsection (10), unless notice was not required under subsection (1.1).

heading: Amendment of permit
paragraph: (10) A notice under subsection (9) must

heading: Amendment of permit
paragraph: (a) advise the land owner of the amendment,

heading: Amendment of permit
paragraph: (b) state that the land owner may appeal under section 72 the decision to amend the permit if the amendment changes the effect of the permit on the land of the land owner, and

heading: Amendment of permit
paragraph: (c) provide an address to which an appeal may be sent.

heading: Amendment of permit
paragraph: (11) If the regulator refuses to amend a permit under subsection (7), the regulator must provide to the land owner referred to in subsection (1) notice in accordance with subsection (12).

heading: Amendment of permit
paragraph: (12) A notice under subsection (11) must advise the land owner

heading: Amendment of permit
paragraph: (a) that the applicant for the amendment may, in relation to the refusal, request a review under section 70 or appeal under section 72, and

heading: Amendment of permit
paragraph: (b) that the land owner may, on request, be a party to an appeal referred to in paragraph (a).

heading: Expiration of permit and authorizations
paragraph:
32
		  (1) Subject to subsections (8) and (9), a permit and, despite anything in a specified enactment, any authorization issued to the permit holder for a related activity of an energy resource activity permitted, or an off-site environmental mitigation activity required, by the permit expire on the day after the prescribed period has elapsed if the permit holder has not by that day begun an energy resource activity permitted by the permit.

heading: Expiration of permit and authorizations
paragraph: (1.1) Despite anything in a specified enactment, an authorization issued to an authorization holder expires if the authorization holder has not applied for a permit before the prescribed period has elapsed.

heading: Expiration of permit and authorizations
paragraph: (2) A permit holder, before the expiry of the permit holder's permit under subsection (1), may apply to the regulator for an extension of the prescribed period with respect to the permit holder's permit and authorizations by submitting to the regulator the information, application form and records required by the regulator.

heading: Expiration of permit and authorizations
paragraph: (3) On receipt of an application under subsection (2), the regulator may require the permit holder to carry out one or more of the prescribed consultations or provide one or more of the prescribed notices with respect to the extension for which the application is made.

heading: Expiration of permit and authorizations
paragraph: (4) A permit holder required to carry out consultations or provide notice under subsection (3) must submit a written report to the regulator regarding the results of the consultations or notice.

heading: Expiration of permit and authorizations
paragraph: (5) On application under subsection (2), the regulator may

heading: Expiration of permit and authorizations
paragraph: (a) extend by not more than one year the prescribed period with respect to the applicant's permit, and

heading: Expiration of permit and authorizations
paragraph: (b) in granting an extension, impose additional conditions on the permit and the authorizations.

heading: Expiration of permit and authorizations
paragraph: (6) Despite anything in a specified enactment, if the regulator grants an extension under subsection (5) for a period of time, the regulator may also extend the term of an authorization referred to in subsection (1), other than an authorization under section 10 [use approvals] of the Water Sustainability Act.

heading: Expiration of permit and authorizations
paragraph: (7) An extension with respect to a permit holder's permit and authorizations may be granted under this section only once, unless the regulator is satisfied there are special circumstances to justify one or more further extensions.

heading: Expiration of permit and authorizations
paragraph: (8) Despite subsection (1), a permit or an authorization does not expire under that subsection if the regulator grants an extension under subsection (5) with respect to the permit or the term of the authorization is extended under subsection (6).

heading: Expiration of permit and authorizations
paragraph: (9) Despite subsection (1), an authorization issued to a permit holder for a related activity of an off-site environmental mitigation activity required by the permit does not expire under that subsection if the permit holder has begun to carry out the off-site environmental mitigation activity by the day referred to in that subsection.

heading: Surrender of permit or permission
paragraph: 33		  (1) A permit holder may send a notice to the regulator advising the regulator of the permit holder's intention to surrender the permit or a permission specified in a permit.

heading: Surrender of permit or permission
paragraph: (1.1) An authorization holder may send a notice to the regulator advising the regulator of the authorization holder's intention to surrender the authorization.

heading: Surrender of permit or permission
paragraph: (2) On receipt of a notice under subsection (1), the regulator may

heading: Surrender of permit or permission
paragraph: (a) cancel the permit holder's permit or permission, as the case may be, and

heading: Surrender of permit or permission
paragraph: (b) despite anything in a specified enactment, cancel an authorization issued to the permit holder for a related activity of

heading: Surrender of permit or permission
paragraph: (i)  the energy resource activity with respect to which the notice was submitted, or

heading: Surrender of permit or permission
paragraph: (ii)  an off-site environmental mitigation activity required by the permit in relation to that energy resource activity.

heading: Surrender of permit or permission
paragraph: (2.1) On receipt of a notice under subsection (1.1), the regulator, despite anything in a specified enactment, may cancel the authorization.

heading: Surrender of permit or permission
paragraph: (3) A cancellation under subsection (2) or (2.1) is effective on the date specified by the regulator.

heading: Required ownership, interest or authorization
paragraph:
34
		  (1) In this section:

heading: Required ownership, interest or authorization
paragraph: "entry agreement" means an agreement

heading: Required ownership, interest or authorization
paragraph: (a) that is between

heading: Required ownership, interest or authorization
paragraph: (i)  a specified permit holder, and

heading: Required ownership, interest or authorization
paragraph: (ii)  a land owner of an area of land, and

heading: Required ownership, interest or authorization
paragraph: (b) that authorizes the specified permit holder to enter, occupy or use the land owner's area of land for the purposes of constructing and operating a pipeline other than a flow line;

heading: Required ownership, interest or authorization
paragraph: "specified permit holder" means a pipeline permit holder who holds a permit respecting a pipeline other than a flow line.

heading: Required ownership, interest or authorization
paragraph: (2) Subject to sections 23 and 39 and subsection (3) of this section, a permit holder must not begin or carry out an energy resource activity or an off-site environmental mitigation activity on or under an area of land unless the permit holder,

heading: Required ownership, interest or authorization
paragraph: (a) if the area of land is not a highway, either is the owner in fee simple of the area of land or has acquired the area of land or the necessary interests in the area of land in accordance with

heading: Required ownership, interest or authorization
paragraph: (i)  the Land Act or the Ministry of Lands, Parks and Housing Act,

heading: Required ownership, interest or authorization
paragraph: (ii)  Part 16 or 17 of the Petroleum and Natural Gas Act, or

heading: Required ownership, interest or authorization
paragraph: (iii)  subsection (3) of this section, or

heading: Required ownership, interest or authorization
paragraph: (b) if the area of land is a highway, has obtained an authorization required under an enactment to enter, occupy or use the area of land.

heading: Required ownership, interest or authorization
paragraph: (3) Subject to subsection (4), if a specified permit holder has failed to obtain an entry agreement, the specified permit holder may expropriate, in accordance with the Expropriation Act, as much of the land or interests in it of any person as may be necessary for constructing and operating the pipeline authorized by the permit.

heading: Required ownership, interest or authorization
paragraph: (4) The land that may be expropriated under subsection (3) must not exceed 18 m in breadth.

heading: Required ownership, interest or authorization
paragraph: (5) On application by a specified permit holder, the regulator may authorize, on any conditions the regulator considers appropriate, an expropriation, in accordance with the Expropriation Act, that exceeds the breadth specified in subsection (4).

heading: Obligations in carrying out energy resource activities
paragraph: 35		  (1) In carrying out energy resource activities, off-site environmental mitigation activities and related activities, a permit holder, an authorization holder or a person entering land under section 23 must minimize

heading: Obligations in carrying out energy resource activities
paragraph: (a) damage and disturbance to the sites of those activities, and

heading: Obligations in carrying out energy resource activities
paragraph: (b) waste.

heading: Obligations in carrying out energy resource activities
paragraph: (2) A pipeline permit holder must make reasonable efforts to ensure that its energy resource activities do not prevent access to or use of a highway, road, railway or public place.

heading: Obligations in carrying out energy resource activities
paragraph: (3) A pipeline permit holder, as soon as reasonably possible after constructing a pipeline, must restore, in accordance with the regulations, if any, the land and surface disturbed by the construction.

heading: Environmental protection and management
paragraph:
36
		  (1) A permit holder and a person carrying out an energy resource activity or an off-site environmental mitigation activity must comply with environmental measures established under the authority of a regulation made under section 104.

heading: Environmental protection and management
paragraph: (2) Subject to regulations made under section 98, the regulator, by order, may exempt, on any conditions the regulator considers necessary, a permit holder or a person carrying out an energy resource activity or an off-site environmental mitigation activity from a requirement imposed by regulation under section 103.

heading: Spillage
paragraph:
37
		  (1) A permit holder, an authorization holder and a person carrying out an energy resource activity or an off-site environmental mitigation activity must

heading: Spillage
paragraph: (a) prevent spillage, and

heading: Spillage
paragraph: (b) promptly report to the regulator any damage or malfunction likely to cause spillage that could be a risk to public safety or the environment.

heading: Spillage
paragraph: (2) If spillage occurs, a permit holder, an authorization holder or person carrying out an energy resource activity or an off-site environmental mitigation activity must promptly do all of the following:

heading: Spillage
paragraph: (a) remedy the cause or source of the spillage;

heading: Spillage
paragraph: (b) contain and eliminate the spillage;

heading: Spillage
paragraph: (c) remediate any land or body of water affected by the spillage;

heading: Spillage
paragraph: (d) if the spillage is a risk to public safety or the environment, report to the regulator

heading: Spillage
paragraph: (i)  the location and severity of the spillage, and

heading: Spillage
paragraph: (ii)  any damage or malfunction causing or contributing to the spillage.

heading: Spillage
paragraph: (3) A person who is aware that spillage is occurring or likely to occur must make reasonable efforts to prevent or assist in containing or preventing the spillage.

heading: Records, reports and plans
paragraph:
38
		  (1) A permit holder and an authorization holder must do all of the following:

heading: Records, reports and plans
paragraph: (a) prepare and maintain the prescribed records, reports and plans;

heading: Records, reports and plans
paragraph: (b) prepare and maintain an emergency response program and a response contingency plan satisfactory to the regulator or as prescribed by regulation, if any;

heading: Records, reports and plans
