paragraph: (c) prepare and maintain the records, reports and plans the regulator orders the permit holder or authorization holder to maintain;

heading: Records, reports and plans
paragraph: (d) at the request of the regulator, produce the records, reports and plans referred to in paragraph (a), (b) or (c) for inspection and copying;

heading: Records, reports and plans
paragraph: (e) at the request of the regulator or as prescribed by regulation, submit to the regulator, in the form and manner the regulator requires, the records, reports and plans referred to in paragraph (a), (b) or (c).

heading: Disclosure
paragraph:
38.1
		  The regulator, in accordance with and to the extent required by the regulations, must

heading: Disclosure
paragraph: (a) disclose to the public, or keep confidential, the records, reports and plans referred to in section 38, and

heading: Disclosure
paragraph: (b) disclose to the public applications received under sections 24 and 31.

heading: Suspension of activity
paragraph:
39
		  (1) If a permit holder begins an energy resource activity but ceases to have the interests in land or authorization referred to in section 34 necessary to carry out that activity, the permit holder must immediately suspend all energy resource activities and related activities being carried out on that land, unless the regulator approves the continuation of those activities under subsection (2).

heading: Suspension of activity
paragraph: (2) The regulator, on application by a permit holder referred to in subsection (1), may

heading: Suspension of activity
paragraph: (a) approve the continuation of the permit holder's energy resource activities and related activities, and

heading: Suspension of activity
paragraph: (b) on granting an approval under paragraph (a), impose additional conditions on the permit holder's permit and authorizations, if any.

heading: Suspension of activity
paragraph: (3) A permit holder with permission to drill or operate a well must immediately suspend its drilling and operations if

heading: Suspension of activity
paragraph: (a) the permit holder ceases

heading: Suspension of activity
paragraph: (i)  to be the owner of the petroleum and natural gas rights or the holder of the location in respect of the well,

heading: Suspension of activity
paragraph: (ii)  to have a valid agreement with the owner of the rights or the holder of the location referred to in subparagraph (i) authorizing the drilling or operation, as applicable, or

heading: Suspension of activity
paragraph: (iii)  to hold a storage reservoir licence issued under section 130 of the Petroleum and Natural Gas Act, or

heading: Suspension of activity
paragraph: (b) the minister rescinds a declaration made under section 24 (5) with respect to the permit holder and those activities.

heading: Suspension of activity
paragraph: (4) A permit holder who suspends activities under subsection (1) or (3) must

heading: Suspension of activity
paragraph: (a) immediately notify the regulator of the suspension,

heading: Suspension of activity
paragraph: (b) comply with the prescribed requirements, and

heading: Suspension of activity
paragraph: (c) carry out any actions as directed by the regulator.

heading: Obligations when permit, permission or authorization expires or is cancelled or spent
paragraph: 40		  If a permit, a permission specified in a permit or an authorization

heading: Obligations when permit, permission or authorization expires or is cancelled or spent
paragraph: (a) is cancelled under section 26, 33 or 43.3,

heading: Obligations when permit, permission or authorization expires or is cancelled or spent
paragraph: (b) is declared to be spent under section 27, or

heading: Obligations when permit, permission or authorization expires or is cancelled or spent
paragraph: (c) expires under section 32,

heading: Obligations when permit, permission or authorization expires or is cancelled or spent
paragraph: the permit holder, former permit holder, authorization holder or former authorization holder, as the case may be, must

heading: Obligations when permit, permission or authorization expires or is cancelled or spent
paragraph: (d) unless otherwise ordered by the regulator, perform each obligation imposed

heading: Obligations when permit, permission or authorization expires or is cancelled or spent
paragraph: (i)  in relation to the permit, permission or authorization under this Act or a specified enactment, and

heading: Obligations when permit, permission or authorization expires or is cancelled or spent
paragraph: (ii)  under the permit or authorization

heading: Obligations when permit, permission or authorization expires or is cancelled or spent
paragraph: that has not been performed by the date of the cancellation, declaration or expiry,

heading: Obligations when permit, permission or authorization expires or is cancelled or spent
paragraph: (e) comply with the prescribed requirements, and

heading: Obligations when permit, permission or authorization expires or is cancelled or spent
paragraph: (f) carry out any other actions for the purposes of restoration or the protection of public safety that the regulator orders the permit holder, former permit holder, authorization holder or former authorization holder to carry out.

heading: Certificate of restoration
paragraph:
41
		  (1) A person, other than a person in a prescribed class of persons, to whom

heading: Certificate of restoration
paragraph: (a) section 40 (a) or (b) applies, or

heading: Certificate of restoration
paragraph: (b) an order has been issued under section 49

heading: Certificate of restoration
paragraph: may apply to the regulator for a certificate of restoration by submitting, in the form and manner the regulator requires, the information and other records required by the regulator.

heading: Certificate of restoration
paragraph: (2) On application by a person under subsection (1), the regulator may issue to the person a certificate of restoration certifying, on the basis of the information known to the regulator at the time of certification, that the regulator is satisfied

heading: Certificate of restoration
paragraph: (a) in the case of an application by a person referred to in subsection (1) (a), that the person has complied with section 40 (d) to (f), or

heading: Certificate of restoration
paragraph: (b) in the case of an application by a person referred to in subsection (1) (b), that the person has complied with the order referred to in that subsection.

heading: Certificate of restoration
paragraph: (3) The issuance of a certificate of restoration does not relieve a person from any obligations under section 40 or under an order referred to in subsection (1) (b) of this section in respect of any matter that was not known to the regulator at the time the certificate of restoration was issued.

heading: Continuing liability
paragraph:
42
		  A transfer under section 29, 43.09 or 43.10, a cancellation, declaration or expiry referred to in section 40 or the issuance of a certificate of restoration under section 41 does not affect or relieve the permit holder, former permit holder, authorization holder or former authorization holder from

heading: Continuing liability
paragraph: (a) the consequences of any contravention or offence or any related fine, imprisonment, fee, charge or penalty, if the contravention or offence occurred before the transfer, cancellation, declaration or expiry, or

heading: Continuing liability
paragraph: (b) any liability imposed on the permit holder, former permit holder, authorization holder or former authorization holder under a specified enactment.

heading: Definitions
paragraph:
43.01
		  In this Division:

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "former permit holder" means a person who held a permit that

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) was cancelled under section 26, 33 or 43.3,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) was declared spent under section 27, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (c) expired under section 32;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "permit holder" means a person who holds a permit;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "principal", in relation to a corporation, means an individual who

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) is a director or officer of the corporation,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) is directly or indirectly in control of the corporation, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (c) in the case of a corporation that has ceased to exist, was a person described in paragraph (a) or (b) immediately before the corporation ceased to exist;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "responsible person", in relation to a permit, has the meaning given to it in section 43.02.

heading: Responsible person
paragraph:
43.02
		  (1) The following are responsible persons for a permit:

heading: Responsible person
paragraph: (a) a person who holds the petroleum or natural gas rights or the location for the permit;

heading: Responsible person
paragraph: (b) a person who has a legal or beneficial interest in the petroleum or natural gas rights or the location for the permit;

heading: Responsible person
paragraph: (c) a person who has a legal or beneficial interest in production or profits resulting from an energy resource activity authorized by the permit;

heading: Responsible person
paragraph: (d) a person who is made responsible for the permit under

heading: Responsible person
paragraph: (i)  section 43.05 (2) [register of responsible persons], or

heading: Responsible person
paragraph: (ii)  section 43.06 [evasion of responsibility].

heading: Responsible person
paragraph: (2) Without limiting subsection (1), the following are also responsible persons for a permit:

heading: Responsible person
paragraph: (a) if the location for the permit is cancelled, reverts or is abandoned, a person who was described in subsection (1) (a) or (b) immediately before that event;

heading: Responsible person
paragraph: (b) if the permit is cancelled under section 26, 33 or 43.3, is declared spent under section 27 or expires under section 32, a person who was described in subsection (1) (c) immediately before that event.

heading: Responsible person
paragraph: (3) Despite this section, the following are not responsible persons:

heading: Responsible person
paragraph: (a) the government;

heading: Responsible person
paragraph: (b) a person excluded by regulation.

heading: Application of this Division
paragraph:
43.03
		  This Division applies in relation to any of the following:

heading: Application of this Division
paragraph: (a) a permit for an oil and gas or storage activity;

heading: Application of this Division
paragraph: (b) a permit for a prescribed energy resource activity.

heading: Identifying responsible persons
paragraph:
43.04
		  (1) A permit holder and a responsible person for a permit must

heading: Identifying responsible persons
paragraph: (a) prepare and maintain the prescribed records, and

heading: Identifying responsible persons
paragraph: (b) at the request of the regulator or as prescribed by regulation, submit those records to the regulator.

heading: Identifying responsible persons
paragraph: (2) Subsection (1) does not apply in relation to a permit that is cancelled under section 26, 33 or 43.3, is declared spent under section 27 or expires under section 32.

heading: Identifying responsible persons
paragraph: (3) The following persons must, at the request of the regulator, submit to the regulator any information or records in the custody or control of the person that might assist the regulator in identifying responsible persons for a permit:

heading: Identifying responsible persons
paragraph: (a) the permit holder or former permit holder;

heading: Identifying responsible persons
paragraph: (b) a responsible person for the permit;

heading: Identifying responsible persons
paragraph: (c) a person who the regulator has reasonable grounds to believe has information or records that might assist the regulator in identifying responsible persons for the permit.

heading: Identifying responsible persons
paragraph: (4) Information and records required to be submitted under this section must be submitted in the form and manner the regulator requires.

heading: Register of responsible persons
paragraph:
43.05
		  (1) Subject to the regulations, the regulator may establish a register of responsible persons.

heading: Register of responsible persons
paragraph: (2) A person who is listed in the register as a responsible person for a permit is conclusively deemed to be a responsible person for the permit for the purposes of this Division unless the person

heading: Register of responsible persons
paragraph: (a) satisfies the regulator that the person is not a responsible person, and

heading: Register of responsible persons
paragraph: (b) if required by the regulator, submits to the regulator any information or records that might assist the regulator in identifying responsible persons for the permit.

heading: Register of responsible persons
paragraph: (3) Information and records required to be submitted under this section must be submitted in the form and manner the regulator requires.

heading: Evasion of responsibility
paragraph:
43.06
		  The regulator, by order, may designate a person who has ceased to be a responsible person for a permit as a responsible person for the permit, after giving the person an opportunity to be heard, if

heading: Evasion of responsibility
paragraph: (a) the regulator is satisfied, having regard to the circumstances in which the person ceased to be a responsible person, that the person intended to evade responsibility, or

heading: Evasion of responsibility
paragraph: (b) the person ceased to be a responsible person in prescribed circumstances and the regulator is not satisfied that the person did not intend to evade responsibility.

heading: Expanded responsibility - orders
paragraph:
43.07
		  (1) In this section, "specified provision" means any of the following:

heading: Expanded responsibility - orders
paragraph: (a) section 30 (1) [order requiring security];

heading: Expanded responsibility - orders
paragraph: (b) section 40 (f) [order to carry out restoration or protection];

heading: Expanded responsibility - orders
paragraph: (c) section 49 (1) [order issued by official];

heading: Expanded responsibility - orders
paragraph: (d) section 50 (1) (c) [order to repay regulator];

heading: Expanded responsibility - orders
paragraph: (e) section 53 (3) [order to pay costs of proceedings].

heading: Expanded responsibility - orders
paragraph: (2) If a permit holder or former permit holder has ceased to exist or fails to comply with an order under a specified provision, the regulator may make an order under the specified provision against

heading: Expanded responsibility - orders
paragraph: (a) a responsible person for the permit, or

heading: Expanded responsibility - orders
paragraph: (b) a principal of the permit holder or former permit holder or of a responsible person described in paragraph (a).

heading: Expanded responsibility - limited work order
paragraph:
43.08
		  (1) The regulator may make an order in relation to an orphan site against

heading: Expanded responsibility - limited work order
paragraph: (a) a responsible person for the permit for the orphan site, or

heading: Expanded responsibility - limited work order
paragraph: (b) a principal of the permit holder or former permit holder for the orphan site or of a responsible person described in paragraph (a).

heading: Expanded responsibility - limited work order
paragraph: (2) An order under subsection (1) may require a person to

heading: Expanded responsibility - limited work order
paragraph: (a) perform an obligation described in section 40 (d),

heading: Expanded responsibility - limited work order
paragraph: (b) comply with a requirement described in section 40 (e), or

heading: Expanded responsibility - limited work order
paragraph: (c) carry out an action that might have been ordered under section 40 (f).

heading: Expanded responsibility - transfer of permit
paragraph:
43.09
		  (1) The regulator, by order, may transfer a permit in relation to an orphan site to

heading: Expanded responsibility - transfer of permit
paragraph: (a) a responsible person for the permit for the orphan site, or

heading: Expanded responsibility - transfer of permit
paragraph: (b) a principal of the permit holder or former permit holder for the orphan site or of a responsible person described in paragraph (a).

heading: Expanded responsibility - transfer of permit
paragraph: (2) A transfer under this section may be made without the consent of the permit holder or former permit holder or the person to receive the permit.

heading: Expanded responsibility - transfer of permit
paragraph: (3) Section 29 (2.2), (2.3) and (3) applies in relation to a transfer under this section.

heading: Expanded responsibility - transfer of authorization
paragraph:
43.10
		  (1) In this section, "linked authorization", in relation to an orphan site, means an authorization issued to the permit holder or former permit holder for the orphan site for related activities of an energy resource activity permitted by the permit.

heading: Expanded responsibility - transfer of authorization
paragraph: (2) The regulator, by order, may transfer a linked authorization for an orphan site to a person, despite anything in a specified enactment prohibiting the transfer, if

heading: Expanded responsibility - transfer of authorization
paragraph: (a) an order under section 43.08 (1) in relation to the orphan site is made against the person, or

heading: Expanded responsibility - transfer of authorization
paragraph: (b) the permit for the orphan site is transferred under section 43.09 (1) to the person.

heading: Expanded responsibility - transfer of authorization
paragraph: (3) A transfer under this section may be made without the consent of the permit holder or former permit holder or the person to receive the linked authorization.

heading: Expanded responsibility - transfer of authorization
paragraph: (4) Section 29 (3) applies in relation to a transfer under this section.

heading: Expanded responsibility - administration in relation to orders
paragraph:
43.11
		  (1) This section applies to

heading: Expanded responsibility - administration in relation to orders
paragraph: (a) an order contemplated by section 43.07 (2), or

heading: Expanded responsibility - administration in relation to orders
paragraph: (b) an order under section 43.08 (1), 43.09 (1) or 43.10 (2).

heading: Expanded responsibility - administration in relation to orders
paragraph: (2) Before making an order to which this section applies against a principal, the regulator must give the principal an opportunity to be heard.

heading: Expanded responsibility - administration in relation to orders
paragraph: (3) An order to which this section applies is not unreasonable, if made against a person other than a principal, only because the order imposes a burden on the person that is disproportionate to that person's interest in, control over or benefit from the relevant energy resource activity.

heading: Compensation for restoration by responsible persons
paragraph:
43.12
		  Subject to the regulations, the regulator may, on application by a responsible person who has restored an orphan site in whole or in part, pay to the person an amount of compensation determined as follows out of the fund:

heading: Definitions
paragraph:
43.1
		  In this Part:

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "dormant site" means a site of an energy resource activity that is a dormant site in accordance with the regulations;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "liability reduction plan" means a plan under section 43.4 (2);

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "portfolio", in relation to a permit holder, means all of the sites of an energy resource activity that are sites for which the permit holder holds a permit;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "shutdown obligations" means the obligations under section 40 (d) to (f).

heading: Requirements to reduce liability
paragraph:
43.2
		  Subject to section 43.4, a permit holder must comply with the prescribed requirements if the permit holder's portfolio

heading: Requirements to reduce liability
paragraph: (a) includes one or more dormant sites, and

heading: Requirements to reduce liability
paragraph: (b) meets the prescribed criteria, if any.

heading: Automatic cancellation of permit
paragraph:
43.3
		  Subject to section 43.4, if a site of an energy resource activity in a prescribed class of sites is a dormant site for longer than the prescribed period of time, the permit in relation to the site is cancelled on the day immediately after that period.

heading: Liability reduction plan
paragraph:
43.4
		  (1) Sections 43.2 and 43.3 do not apply in relation to a site of an energy resource activity if the site is subject to an approved liability reduction plan.

heading: Liability reduction plan
paragraph: (2) Subject to the regulations, a permit holder may submit to the regulator a plan to reduce the permit holder's shutdown obligations in relation to one or more sites.

heading: Liability reduction plan
paragraph: (3) The regulator may approve a liability reduction plan.

heading: Liability reduction plan
paragraph: (4) An approved liability reduction plan is an order of the regulator.

heading: Liability reduction plan
paragraph: (5) Without limiting any other power of the regulator, if a permit holder does not comply with an approved liability reduction plan, the regulator may revoke the approval of that plan.

heading: Definitions
paragraph:
44
		  In this Part:

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "former permit holder" means a person who held a permit that

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) was cancelled under section 26, 33 or 43.3,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) was declared spent under section 27, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (c) expired under section 32;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "fund" means the fund continued under section 45 (3);

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "marketable gas" means natural gas that is available for sale for direct consumption as a domestic, commercial or industrial fuel, or as an industrial raw material, or that is delivered to a storage facility, whether it occurs naturally or results from the processing of natural gas;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "orphan site" means a site designated under section 45 (2);

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "parties", in relation to an orphan site, means

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) the permit holder or former permit holder for the orphan site,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) the responsible persons for that permit holder or former permit holder, and

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (c) an individual who is designated by order under section 44.1;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "principal" has the same meaning as in section 43.01;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "responsible person" has the same meaning as in section 43.01;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "restore" includes the requirements under section 40;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "surface lease" means

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) a surface lease as defined in section 141 of the Petroleum and Natural Gas Act, and

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) an order of the Surface Rights Board under the Petroleum and Natural Gas Act.

heading: Parties - designating principals
paragraph: 44.1		  (1) The regulator, by order, may designate a principal of a party described in paragraph (a) or (b) of the definition of "parties" in section 44 as a party for the purposes of paragraph (c) of that definition.

heading: Parties - designating principals
paragraph: (2) Before making an order under subsection (1) against a principal, the regulator must give the principal an opportunity to be heard.

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites
paragraph:
45
		  (1) The regulator may restore orphan sites.

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites
paragraph: (2) The regulator may designate as an orphan site

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites
paragraph: (a) a well, facility, pipeline, or energy resource road if

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites
paragraph: (i)  the permit holder or former permit holder with respect to the well, facility, pipeline, or energy resource road is insolvent, or

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites
paragraph: (ii)  the regulator has not been able to identify the permit holder or former permit holder in respect to the well, facility, pipeline, or energy resource road or is satisfied that that permit holder or former permit holder no longer exists or cannot be located, or

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites
paragraph: (b) an area, if the regulator is satisfied that the area requires restoration as a direct or indirect result of the carrying out of an energy resource activity or an off-site environmental mitigation activity by

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites
paragraph: (i)  a person who is insolvent, or

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites
paragraph: (ii)  a person the regulator has not been able to identify or is satisfied no longer exists or cannot be located.

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites
paragraph: (3) The fund held by the regulator under section 6.2 of the former Act is continued, and the purposes of the fund are to provide money as follows:

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites
paragraph: (a) to pay the costs of restoration in respect of orphan sites;

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites
paragraph: (b) to pay costs incurred in pursuing reimbursement for the costs referred to in paragraph (a) from the person responsible for paying them;

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites
paragraph: (c) to pay any other costs directly related to the operations of the regulator in respect of the fund;

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites
paragraph: (d) to pay compensation for the purposes of section 46.

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites
paragraph: (4) The following must be deposited to the credit of the fund:

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites
paragraph: (a) money paid to the regulator under section 18 (2) (b);

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites
paragraph: (b) money borrowed to meet any deficit in the fund;

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites
paragraph: (c) money recovered or received by the regulator under subsection (7) of this section;

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites
paragraph: (c.1) money received by the regulator specifically for a purpose set out in subsection (3);

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites
paragraph: (c.2) money received by the regulator from a disposition described in section 45.03 (1) or (2);

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites
paragraph: (d) any interest or other income of the fund.

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites
paragraph: (4.1) For certainty, nothing in this section prevents the regulator from depositing money not described in subsection (4) to the credit of the fund.

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites
paragraph: (5) The regulator may do one or more of the following:

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites
paragraph: (a) pay money from the fund for any of the purposes referred to in subsection (3) in accordance with any regulations made for the purposes of this section and section 46;

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites
paragraph: (b) from the fund, repay any money borrowed by the regulator for the purposes of the fund;

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites
paragraph: (c) determine the date on which an orphan site has been satisfactorily restored.

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites
paragraph: (6) For the purposes of subsection (2), a permit holder or former permit holder must be considered to be insolvent if the permit holder or former permit holder files for protection under the Companies' Creditors Arrangement Act (Canada) or is a bankrupt or an insolvent person under the Bankruptcy and Insolvency Act (Canada).

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites
paragraph: (7) If the regulator restores an orphan site, the costs paid out of the fund in respect of that orphan site are a debt payable by the parties, jointly and severally, to the regulator and the regulator has a right of action against the parties for the recovery of that debt and may issue and file a certificate under section 93.1 (1) naming any of them.

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites
paragraph: (8) For the purpose of restoring an orphan site, the regulator has the same powers as it has under sections 53 and 57.

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites - limitation periods
paragraph: 45.01		  (1) In this section, "restoration debt proceeding" means

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites - limitation periods
paragraph: (a) an action referred to in section 45 (7), or

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites - limitation periods
paragraph: (b) the filing of a certificate under section 93.1 for the purposes of section 45 (7).

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites - limitation periods
paragraph: (2) A restoration debt proceeding may be commenced at any time within 7 years after the date on which the debt becomes payable.

heading: Registry of orphan sites
paragraph:
45.02
		  The regulator must publish, on a publicly accessible website maintained by or on behalf of the regulator,

heading: Registry of orphan sites
paragraph: (a) a list of orphan sites, and

heading: Registry of orphan sites
paragraph: (b) a notice that property abandoned at the listed orphan sites may be available for disposition.

heading: Disposition of abandoned property
paragraph:
45.03
		  (1) If the regulator, in the course of restoring an orphan site under section 45 (1), disposes of property abandoned at the orphan site, the regulator must pay into the fund any money received in relation to the disposition.

heading: Disposition of abandoned property
paragraph: (2) If the regulator transfers a permit to a person under section 29, in circumstances described in section 29 (1.2), or under section 43.09 (1), the regulator

heading: Disposition of abandoned property
paragraph: (a) may dispose of property abandoned at the site of the permit to the person or another person, and

heading: Disposition of abandoned property
paragraph: (b) must pay into the fund any money received in relation to the disposition.

heading: Disposition of abandoned property
paragraph: (3) Good and sufficient title vests in a person to whom property is disposed of under this section, as against any other person who claims or might claim against the property.

heading: Disposition of abandoned property
paragraph: (4) Subject to subsection (5) and the regulations, if the regulator is satisfied that a person has a claim to property disposed of by the regulator in relation to which money has been paid into the fund under subsection (1) or (2) (b), the regulator may pay out of the fund to the person an amount in relation to the claim.

heading: Disposition of abandoned property
paragraph: (5) The total amount that may be paid to persons under subsection (4) in relation to property disposed of by the regulator must not exceed the difference between

heading: Disposition of abandoned property
paragraph: (a) the amount of money paid into the fund in relation to the disposition of the property, and

heading: Disposition of abandoned property
paragraph: (b) the amount of money paid out of the fund in relation to the disposition of the property.

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites - use of security
paragraph:
45.1
		  Despite section 45, if the regulator receives money from the realization of security provided under section 30 in relation to an orphan site,

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites - use of security
paragraph: (a) the regulator must deposit the money received to the credit of the fund,

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites - use of security
paragraph: (b) if applicable, the debt under section 45 (7) in relation to the orphan site is reduced by the amount of the money received, and

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites - use of security
paragraph: (c) subject to and in accordance with the regulations, the regulator must, if the regulator determines under section 45 (5) (c) that the orphan site has been satisfactorily restored, repay from the fund the portion, if any, of the money received that exceeds the sum of

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites - use of security
paragraph: (i)  the debt under section 45 (7) in relation to the orphan site, and

heading: Reclamation of orphan sites - use of security
paragraph: (ii)  the costs, estimated by the regulator, of continuing to manage the orphaned site.

heading: Compensation for land owners respecting orphan sites
paragraph:
46
		  (1) On application by a land owner on whose land the regulator expends money in accordance with section 45, the regulator may make payments from the fund to compensate the land owner for the loss of use of the land owner's land as a result of the failure by the permit holder or former permit holder referred to in section 45 (2) to restore the land, subject to the maximums, conditions and limitations prescribed by regulation.

heading: Compensation for land owners respecting orphan sites
paragraph: (2) In determining the amount of compensation to be paid to a land owner under subsection (1), the regulator may consider any payments due to the land owner or a previous land owner under a surface lease with respect to the site.

heading: Compensation for land owners respecting orphan sites
paragraph: (3) Before it compensates a land owner under subsection (1), the regulator may require as a condition of compensation that the land owner assign to the regulator the land owner's rights, if any, to overdue payments under a surface lease.

heading: Orphan site restoration levy
paragraph:
47
		  (1) Subject to this section, the board, for the purposes of raising revenue for the fund, may make regulations as follows:

heading: Orphan site restoration levy
paragraph: (a) subject to the approval of Treasury Board,

heading: Orphan site restoration levy
paragraph: (i)  requiring permit holders or a class of permit holders to pay a levy to the government, and

heading: Orphan site restoration levy
paragraph: (ii)  establishing the amount to be raised by the levy;

heading: Orphan site restoration levy
paragraph: (b) respecting payment of the levy and providing for the imposition of penalties, payable to the government, to enforce payment of the levy.

heading: Orphan site restoration levy
paragraph: (2) If a levy is imposed under this section, each permit holder who is required to pay the levy must pay the portion of the amount to be raised by the levy that is calculated in accordance with the following formula:

heading: Orphan site restoration levy
paragraph: (3) For the purposes of subsection (2), the liability of a permit holder is the cost, estimated by the regulator, to the permit holder of compliance with section 40 (d) to (f) in relation to all of the permits and authorizations held by the permit holder.

heading: Orphan site restoration levy
paragraph: (4) An estimate under subsection (3) must be based on the situation of the permit holder on a date specified in the regulation imposing the levy, which date

heading: Orphan site restoration levy
paragraph: (a) must be in the calendar year in which the levy is imposed, and

heading: Orphan site restoration levy
paragraph: (b) subject to paragraph (a), may be a date before the date that regulation comes into force.

heading: Orphan site restoration levy
paragraph: (5) For certainty, the board may impose more than one levy under this section in a calendar year.

heading: Reference and application
paragraph:
48
		  (1) In this Part:

heading: Reference and application
paragraph: (a) a reference to "the Act" is to be read as a reference to all of the following:

heading: Reference and application
paragraph: (i)  this Act;

heading: Reference and application
paragraph: (ii)  the specified enactments, other than the Environmental Management Act and the Water Sustainability Act;

heading: Reference and application
paragraph: (iii)  section 118 of the Petroleum and Natural Gas Act;

heading: Reference and application
paragraph: (b) a reference to "the regulations" is to be read as a reference to both the regulations made under this Act and to the regulations made under the specified enactments, other than the Environmental Management Act and the Water Sustainability Act;

heading: Reference and application
paragraph: (c) a reference to "an authorization"

heading: Reference and application
paragraph: (i)  includes an authorization under section 138 [entry on unoccupied Crown land] of the Petroleum and Natural Gas Act, and

heading: Reference and application
paragraph: (ii)  does not include any of the following:

heading: Reference and application
paragraph: (A) an authorization under the Environmental Management Act or the Water Sustainability Act issued by the regulator under section 8 of this Act;

heading: Reference and application
paragraph: (B) an approval, as defined in section 9 of this Act and as issued by the regulator under that section, under the Environmental Management Act or the Water Sustainability Act;

heading: Reference and application
paragraph: (d) a reference to a related activity does not include a related activity under the Environmental Management Act or the Water Sustainability Act.

heading: Reference and application
paragraph: (2) Despite anything in a specified enactment,

heading: Reference and application
paragraph: (a) an order may be issued under Division 2 with respect to an authorization or a related activity,

heading: Reference and application
paragraph: (b) the powers granted under Division 3 to an official or peace officer may be exercised with respect to an authorization or a related activity, and

heading: Reference and application
paragraph: (c) a finding may be made under section 62 and an administrative penalty may be imposed under section 63 with respect to an authorization or a related activity.

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: 49		  (1) An official may issue an order to

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (a) a person carrying out an energy resource activity, an off-site environmental mitigation activity or a related activity, with respect to those activities or any of the person's obligations under the Act or the regulations,

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (b) a permit holder, former permit holder, authorization holder or former authorization holder, with respect to any of the person's obligations under the Act or the regulations or the person's permit or authorization, if any, or

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (c) a person who may enter on land under section 23, with respect to that entry,

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: if, in the opinion of the official,

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (d) the person fails to comply with the Act, the regulations, a previous order made under the Act, or the person's permit or authorization, or

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (e) the order is necessary

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (i)  to mitigate a risk to public safety,

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (ii)  to protect the environment, or

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (iii)  to promote the conservation of petroleum and natural gas resources.

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (2) An official may issue an order to a person under subsection (1) with respect to an act or omission by the person whether or not the regulator has made a finding under section 62 with respect to that act or omission.

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (3) An order under subsection (1) must be in writing and must

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (a) name the person to whom the order is addressed,

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (b) specify the action to be taken, stopped or modified,

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (c) state the date by which the person must comply with the order,

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (d) state the reasons for the order,

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (e) state that the person may request a review of the order under section 70 or appeal the decision under section 72, and include an address to which a request for a review or an appeal may be sent,

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (f) be dated the day the order is made, and

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (g) be served on the person to whom it is addressed.

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (3.1) If an order under subsection (1) is addressed to an employee, agent or contractor of a permit holder, the official who served the order must serve a copy of the order on the permit holder.

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (4) Without limiting subsection (3) (b), an order under subsection (1) may specify any of the following requirements:

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (a) that a person must apply to obtain or amend a permit or an authorization in accordance with the Act and the regulations;

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (b) that a person remedy a failure referred to in subsection (1) (d);

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (c) that a person repair damage to the environment;

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (d) that a person suspend or resume an energy resource activity, an off-site environmental mitigation activity, a related activity or any aspect of any of those activities;

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (e) that a person use a specified method to carry out an energy resource activity or an off-site environmental mitigation activity;

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (f) that a person conduct tests, take samples, conduct analyses and submit records and information to the regulator;

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (g) that a person control or prevent the escape of petroleum, natural gas, water, waste or other substances from a well, pipeline or facility;

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (h) that a person repressure, recycle or carry out pressure maintenance of any pool or portion of it, or use any other enhanced recovery technique, including the introduction or injection of natural gas, water or other substances into any pool or part of it;

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (i) with respect to water produced in relation to the production of petroleum or natural gas, that a person dispose of the water into an underground formation or as otherwise specified;

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (j) that a person deepen a well beyond the formation from which production is being taken or has been taken;

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (k) that a person recomplete a well;

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (l) that a person restrict or cease production of petroleum, natural gas or water;

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (m) that natural gas be gathered, and processed if necessary, and that the natural gas or liquid hydrocarbons extracted be marketed or injected into an underground reservoir for storage or for any other purpose;

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (n) that a pipeline permit holder alter or divert its pipeline;

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (o) that a permit holder prepare and implement, in a form and manner satisfactory to the official, a program of measures to contain and eliminate spillage;

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (p) that a permit holder arrange for an independent audit of the permit holder's operations and activities and have the auditor's report submitted to the official.

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (5) Despite subsection (3), if the official referred to in subsection (1) is of the opinion that a person's actions or omissions are of such nature that they are causing, or may imminently cause, serious damage to the environment or that they are a risk to public safety, the order under subsection (1) may be issued orally.

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (6) If, under subsection (5), an official issues an order orally, an official, within 48 hours, must confirm the order in writing as required under subsection (3) or the order ceases to be effective.

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (7) An official may amend an order issued under subsection (1), and subsection (3) applies to the amendment.

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (8) If satisfied that the circumstances that gave rise to an order under subsection (1) are no longer present or have been affected by other circumstances, an official may terminate the order by providing the person to whom the order was addressed with written notice of the termination.

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (9) An order under subsection (1) may specify a requirement that is different from a requirement in a provision of a regulation under this Act, if the regulation expressly states that the provision is subject to this section.

heading: Order issued by official
paragraph: (10) Subject to subsection (9), if a regulation is made concerning a matter with respect to which an order has been made under this section, the order, if it has not been terminated under subsection (8), is no longer valid to the extent of any inconsistency between the order and the regulation.

heading: Technical orders
paragraph:
49.1
		  (1) The regulator may, by order related to a specific location, well or area, do any or all of the following:

heading: Technical orders
paragraph: (a) designate a field by describing its surface area;

heading: Technical orders
paragraph: (b) designate a pool by describing the surface area vertically above the pool and by naming the geological formation and the zone in which the pool occurs;

heading: Technical orders
paragraph: (c) control and regulate the production of petroleum, natural gas and water by restriction, proration or prohibition.

heading: Technical orders
paragraph: (2) After an order is made under subsection (1), the regulator must publish notice of the order as prescribed.

heading: Technical orders
paragraph: (3) An order under subsection (1) (c) may specify a requirement that is different from a requirement in a provision of a regulation under this Act, if the regulation expressly states that the provision is subject to this section.

heading: Technical orders
paragraph: (4) Subject to subsection (3), if a regulation is made concerning a matter with respect to which an order has been made under subsection (1) (c), the order, if it has not been rescinded, is no longer valid to the extent of any inconsistency between the order and the regulation.

heading: Regulator may carry out action
paragraph:
50
		  (1) If a person to whom an order is issued under section 40 (f) or 49 (1) has not complied with the order by the date specified in the order, the regulator may do one or more of the following:

heading: Regulator may carry out action
paragraph: (a) by order in writing, restrict or prohibit the person from carrying out an action referred to in the order;

heading: Regulator may carry out action
paragraph: (b) after giving the person an opportunity to be heard, carry out an action referred to in the order;

heading: Regulator may carry out action
paragraph: (c) by order in writing, require the person to pay to the regulator the amount of all direct and indirect costs the regulator determines were reasonably incurred in carrying out the action referred to in paragraph (b).

heading: Regulator may carry out action
paragraph: (2) An order referred to in subsection (1) (c) must provide the person to whom it is issued with an accounting of the expenditures relating to the action referred to in subsection (1) (b).

heading: Access restricted or prohibited
paragraph:
51
		  (1) Subject to this section, an official, by order, may restrict or prohibit, in a manner prescribed by regulation, access to a public area, including a highway, road, resource road, and railway, if the official is of the opinion that the restriction or prohibition is necessary

heading: Access restricted or prohibited
paragraph: (a) because of hazardous conditions relating to an energy resource activity, or

heading: Access restricted or prohibited
paragraph: (b) to facilitate an investigation relating to hazardous conditions described in paragraph (a).

heading: Access restricted or prohibited
paragraph: (2) If an official issues an order under subsection (1), the regulator must confirm the order in writing within 24 hours or the order ceases to be effective.

heading: Access restricted or prohibited
paragraph: (3) An order under subsection (1) (b) may not restrict or prohibit access to a public area for a period of more than 30 days.

heading: Access restricted or prohibited
paragraph: (4) An order under subsection (1) (b) may not restrict or prohibit access to a provincial public highway within the meaning of the Transportation Act.

heading: Emergency measures
paragraph: 52		  (1) An official may, in the case of an emergency,

heading: Emergency measures
paragraph: (a) enter on any land or body of water and do the things the official considers necessary to implement and carry out measures to

heading: Emergency measures
paragraph: (i)  contain and eliminate spillage, or

heading: Emergency measures
paragraph: (ii)  protect public safety, and

heading: Emergency measures
paragraph: (b) order

heading: Emergency measures
paragraph: (i)  any permit holder or authorization holder, and

heading: Emergency measures
paragraph: (ii)  the use of any person's equipment and the operator of that equipment,

heading: Emergency measures
paragraph: to assist in the implementation or carrying out of measures referred to in paragraph (a).

heading: Emergency measures
paragraph: (2) The regulator may reimburse a person for costs or expenses incurred as a result of an order issued under subsection (1) if the person is not, in the regulator's opinion, responsible for the emergency or for any related spillage or the likely source or cause of that spillage.

heading: Emergency measures
paragraph: (3) If costs or expenses are incurred by the regulator in implementing or carrying out measures referred to in subsection (1) (a) or making a reimbursement under subsection (2), the regulator may do one or more of the following:

heading: Emergency measures
paragraph: (a) take, deal with and dispose of the spillage, subject to section 55;

heading: Emergency measures
paragraph: (b) order the person who the regulator believes is responsible for the emergency or for any related spillage or the likely source or cause of that spillage to pay the costs and expenses, or a part of them;

heading: Emergency measures
paragraph: (c) order the person referred to in paragraph (b) to indemnify the regulator for costs or expenses paid by the regulator;

heading: Emergency measures
paragraph: (d) for the purpose of paragraph (b) or (c), direct the manner of payment or indemnification.

heading: Control of energy resource activities
paragraph:
53
		  (1) If, in the commissioner's opinion,

heading: Control of energy resource activities
paragraph: (a) a permit holder has engaged in a pattern of conduct that shows that the person is unfit to carry out the energy resource activities permitted by the permit holder's permit, and

heading: Control of energy resource activities
paragraph: (b) there is a risk to public safety, the environment or petroleum and natural gas resources,

heading: Control of energy resource activities
paragraph: the regulator may

heading: Control of energy resource activities
paragraph: (c) enter, seize and take control of any well, pipeline, facility or storage reservoir together with any associated chattel and fixture and any pertinent records,

heading: Control of energy resource activities
paragraph: (d) either discontinue all activity or take over the management and control of the well, pipeline, facility or storage reservoir,

heading: Control of energy resource activities
paragraph: (e) take the steps the regulator considers necessary

heading: Control of energy resource activities
paragraph: (i)  to prevent the flow or release of petroleum, natural gas or other substances from any stratum that a well enters, including plugging a well at any depth, or

heading: Control of energy resource activities
paragraph: (ii)  for public safety or to protect the environment, and

heading: Control of energy resource activities
paragraph: (f) carry out any other prescribed actions.

heading: Control of energy resource activities
paragraph: (2) If the regulator takes control of a well, pipeline, facility or storage reservoir,

heading: Control of energy resource activities
paragraph: (a) the regulator may issue orders concerning the well, pipeline, facility or storage reservoir to

heading: Control of energy resource activities
paragraph: (i)  the permit holder, and

heading: Control of energy resource activities
paragraph: (ii)  an officer, employee, agent and contractor of the permit holder operating the well, pipeline, facility or storage reservoir,

heading: Control of energy resource activities
paragraph: and, if the regulator issues an order to a person referred to in either subparagraph (i) or (ii), the order applies to both the person referred to in subparagraph (i) and the persons referred to in subparagraph (ii), and

heading: Control of energy resource activities
paragraph: (b) subject to section 55, the regulator may take, deal with and dispose of all petroleum, natural gas or other substances from the well, pipeline, facility or storage reservoir.

heading: Control of energy resource activities
paragraph: (3) The commissioner may order by whom and to what extent costs and expenses incurred as a result of proceedings taken under this section are to be paid.

heading: Use of proceeds
paragraph:
54
		  From the proceeds of spillage disposed of under section 52 (3) (a) or of petroleum, natural gas or other substances disposed of under section 53 (2) (b), the regulator

heading: Use of proceeds
paragraph: (a) must pay royalties owed with respect to the petroleum or natural gas under Part 10 of the Petroleum and Natural Gas Act, and

heading: Use of proceeds
paragraph: (b) after making the payments referred to in paragraph (a), may pay

heading: Use of proceeds
paragraph: (i)  costs and expenses incurred as a result of proceedings taken under section 52 or 53, as applicable, and

heading: Use of proceeds
paragraph: (ii)  costs and expenses of carrying out investigations and conservation measures that the regulator considers necessary in connection with the exercise of its powers under section 52 or 53.

heading: Payment into court
paragraph: 55		  The net proceeds of spillage disposed of under section 52 (3) (a) or of petroleum, natural gas or other substances disposed of under section 53 (2) (b) remaining after payment of the costs and expenses under section 54 must be paid by the regulator into the Supreme Court, and must be paid out to the persons and in the amounts as may be determined by the court on application of a person claiming to be entitled to any of the proceeds.

heading: Statutory immunity
paragraph:
56
		  (1) Subject to subsection (3), no legal proceeding for damages lies or may be commenced or maintained against the commissioner, an official or the regulator's directors or employees because of anything done or omitted

heading: Statutory immunity
paragraph: (a) in the exercise or intended exercise of any power under this Act, or

heading: Statutory immunity
paragraph: (b) in the performance or intended performance of any duty or function under this Act.

heading: Statutory immunity
paragraph: (2) Subject to subsection (3), no legal proceeding for damages lies or may be commenced or maintained against the government or the regulator because of anything done or omitted

heading: Statutory immunity
paragraph: (a) in the exercise or intended exercise of a power under sections 50 to 53, or

heading: Statutory immunity
paragraph: (b) in the performance or intended performance of a duty under sections 50 to 53.

heading: Statutory immunity
paragraph: (3) Subsections (1) and (2) do not apply to a person referred to in subsection (1), the government or the regulator in relation to anything done or omitted in bad faith.

heading: Entry and inspection or audit
paragraph:
57
		  (1) In subsection (2), "dwelling" means

heading: Entry and inspection or audit
paragraph: (a) a structure occupied as a private residence, and

heading: Entry and inspection or audit
paragraph: (b) if only part of a structure is occupied as a private residence, that part of the structure.

heading: Entry and inspection or audit
paragraph: (2) For any purpose related to the administration or enforcement of the Act, the regulations, a permit or an authorization, an official may enter, at any reasonable time, on land or premises, other than a dwelling, if the official has reasonable grounds to believe that

heading: Entry and inspection or audit
paragraph: (a) the land or premises is the site of an energy resource activity, an off-site environmental mitigation activity or a related activity that is regulated under the Act or the regulations or is carried on by a person who is required under this Act to hold a permit or an authorization to carry out that activity, or

heading: Entry and inspection or audit
paragraph: (b) records concerning the activities referred to in paragraph (a) are kept on the land or premises.

heading: Entry and inspection or audit
paragraph: (2.1) A person must admit onto land or premises referred to in subsection (2) an official entering the land or premises under that subsection, and must provide the official with the means and assistance necessary for the purpose of the entry.

heading: Entry and inspection or audit
paragraph: (3) In order to obtain access under subsection (2), an official may enter land owned by a person other than a permit holder if the entry is reasonably necessary to obtain the access.

heading: Entry and inspection or audit
paragraph: (4) An official who enters on land or premises under this section may

heading: Entry and inspection or audit
paragraph: (a) inspect or audit anything or any activity that is reasonably related to the purpose of the inspection or audit,

heading: Entry and inspection or audit
paragraph: (b) take samples and carry out tests and examinations,

heading: Entry and inspection or audit
paragraph: (c) require production for the purposes of inspection or audit or copying of

heading: Entry and inspection or audit
paragraph: (i)  a permit or authorization that is required for the activity, and

heading: Entry and inspection or audit
paragraph: (ii)  a record required to be kept under the Act or the regulations, and

heading: Entry and inspection or audit
paragraph: (d) make inquiries the official considers necessary.

heading: Entry and inspection or audit
paragraph: (5) A peace officer has the powers and duties of an official under this section with respect to the enforcement of the provisions of the Act and the regulations.

heading: Inspection of vehicle
paragraph:
58
		  For any purpose related to the administration and enforcement of the Act, the regulations, a permit or an authorization, an official or peace officer may

heading: Inspection of vehicle
paragraph: (a) require a person operating a vehicle to stop the vehicle, and

heading: Inspection of vehicle
paragraph: (b) carry out an inspection of a vehicle and its contents.

heading: Obligation of an official
paragraph:
59
		  An official who under this Part enters onto land or premises for the purposes of administering or enforcing the Act or the regulations, stops a vehicle, requests records or plans or seizes records or plans must provide proof of identity, on the request of the person who

heading: Obligation of an official
paragraph: (a) is in possession or apparent possession of the land or premises,

heading: Obligation of an official
paragraph: (b) has apparent custody or control of the records or plans being inspected or audited,

heading: Obligation of an official
paragraph: (c) is in charge of the activity being inspected or audited, or

heading: Obligation of an official
paragraph: (d) is operating a vehicle stopped under section 58.

heading: Obligation of person inspected or audited
paragraph:
60
		  (1) The operator of a vehicle must stop the vehicle when required to do so by

heading: Obligation of person inspected or audited
paragraph: (a) an official referred to in section 58, or

heading: Obligation of person inspected or audited
paragraph: (b) a peace officer

heading: Obligation of person inspected or audited
paragraph: who

heading: Obligation of person inspected or audited
paragraph: (c) is in uniform,

heading: Obligation of person inspected or audited
paragraph: (d) displays an official identification card or badge, or

heading: Obligation of person inspected or audited
paragraph: (e) is in or near a vehicle that is either a vehicle of a peace officer or readily identifiable as a regulator or other government vehicle.

heading: Obligation of person inspected or audited
paragraph: (2) A person who is described in paragraphs (a) to (d) of section 59 must produce, if and as required by the official or peace officer,

heading: Obligation of person inspected or audited
paragraph: (a) proof of identity,

heading: Obligation of person inspected or audited
paragraph: (b) a permit or an authorization held by the person under the Act, and

heading: Obligation of person inspected or audited
paragraph: (c) a record or plan required to be maintained under section 38.

heading: Requirement to submit to inspection or audit
paragraph:
61
		  A person must not

heading: Requirement to submit to inspection or audit
paragraph: (a) obstruct or interfere with an official or peace officer acting under the authority of this Division to administer or enforce the Act or the regulations, or

heading: Requirement to submit to inspection or audit
paragraph: (b) withhold, destroy, tamper with, alter, conceal or refuse to produce any information, record, plan, report, substance, sample or thing that is required to be produced by an official or peace officer administering or enforcing the Act or the regulations.

heading: Application for investigation
paragraph:
61.1
		  (1) An individual who is resident in British Columbia and at least 18 years of age may apply to the regulator for an investigation of a prescribed contravention under this Act in relation to the emission of methane that the individual alleges has occurred or is occurring.

heading: Application for investigation
paragraph: (2) An application under this section must include a statutory declaration or affirmation

heading: Application for investigation
paragraph: (a) stating the name and address of the applicant,

heading: Application for investigation
paragraph: (b) stating that the applicant is resident in British Columbia and at least 18 years of age,

heading: Application for investigation
paragraph: (c) stating the nature of the alleged contravention and the name of each person alleged to have done something, or to have failed to do something, in contravention of this Act or the regulations, and

heading: Application for investigation
paragraph: (d) containing a concise statement of the evidence supporting the allegations.

heading: Application for investigation
paragraph: (3) If a form of application has been prescribed for the purposes of this section, an application under this section must be made in the prescribed form.

heading: Investigation by regulator
paragraph:
61.2
		  After receiving an application under section 61.1, the regulator must

heading: Investigation by regulator
paragraph: (a) acknowledge its receipt, in accordance with the regulations, within 20 days, and

heading: Investigation by regulator
paragraph: (b) investigate all matters that the regulator considers necessary to determine the facts relating to the alleged contravention.

heading: Progress reports
paragraph:
61.3
		  (1) Subject to subsection (3), after acknowledging receipt of an application under section 61.1, the regulator must report, in accordance with the regulations, to the applicant every 90 days on the progress of the investigation and the action, if any, that the regulator has taken.

heading: Progress reports
paragraph: (2) A report under this section must include an estimate of the time required to complete the investigation.

heading: Progress reports
paragraph: (3) A report under this section is not required if the investigation is discontinued before the end of a 90-day period referred to in subsection (1).

heading: Discontinuation of investigation
paragraph:
61.4
		  (1) The regulator may discontinue an investigation if the regulator is of the opinion that

heading: Discontinuation of investigation
paragraph: (a) the alleged contravention does not require further investigation, or

heading: Discontinuation of investigation
paragraph: (b) the investigation does not substantiate the alleged contravention.

heading: Discontinuation of investigation
paragraph: (2) If an investigation is discontinued, the regulator must

heading: Discontinuation of investigation
paragraph: (a) prepare a written statement of the reasons for the discontinuation, and

heading: Discontinuation of investigation
paragraph: (b) in accordance with the regulations, send a copy of the statement to the applicant and to any person whose conduct was investigated.

heading: Discontinuation of investigation
paragraph: (3) A copy of the statement sent to a person whose conduct was investigated must not disclose the name or address of the applicant or any other personal information about the applicant.

heading: Contraventions
paragraph:
62
		  (1) After giving an opportunity to be heard to a person who is alleged to have contravened a provision of the Act, the regulations, a permit, an authorization or an order, the regulator may find that the person has contravened the provision.

heading: Contraventions
paragraph: (2) If a corporation contravenes a provision referred to in subsection (1), a director, agent or officer of the corporation who authorized, permitted or acquiesced in the contravention also contravenes the provision.

heading: Contraventions
paragraph: (3) If an employee, contractor or agent of a permit holder contravenes a provision referred to in subsection (1) in the course of carrying out the employment, contract or agency, the permit holder also contravenes the provision.

heading: Contraventions
paragraph: (4) If a person contravenes a provision referred to in subsection (1), any other person who

heading: Contraventions
paragraph: (a) is directly or indirectly responsible for the act or omission that constitutes the contravention, and

heading: Contraventions
paragraph: (b) is a contractor, employee or agent of the person or of an other person described in paragraph (a)

heading: Contraventions
paragraph: also contravenes the provision.

heading: Contraventions
paragraph: (5) The regulator may not find that a person has contravened a provision referred to in subsection (1) if the person demonstrates to the satisfaction of the regulator that

heading: Contraventions
paragraph: (a) the person exercised due diligence to prevent the contravention, or

heading: Contraventions
paragraph: (c) the person's actions relevant to the provision were the result of an officially induced error.

heading: Contraventions
paragraph: (6) If

heading: Contraventions
paragraph: (a) a corporation referred to in subsection (2),

heading: Contraventions
paragraph: (b) an employee, contractor or agent referred to in subsection (3), or

heading: Contraventions
paragraph: (c) a person referred to in subsection (4)

heading: Contraventions
paragraph: has not contravened a provision referred to in subsection (1) as a result of demonstrating to the satisfaction of the regulator anything referred to in subsection (5) (a) and (c), the regulator may find that any of the other persons referred to in subsections (2) to (4) has contravened the provision, unless the other person demonstrates to the satisfaction of the regulator anything referred to in subsection (5) (a) and (c).

heading: Contraventions
paragraph: (7) Nothing in subsection (5) prevents

heading: Contraventions
paragraph: (a) an official from issuing an order under section 49 (1) to a person with respect to an act or omission by the person, or

heading: Contraventions
paragraph: (b) the regulator from doing anything referred to in section 50.

heading: Contraventions
paragraph: (8) A person does not contravene a provision referred to in subsection (1) by doing or omitting to do something if that act or omission is reasonably necessary to conform with the requirements of the Workers Compensation Act or any regulations under that Act.

heading: Administrative penalties
paragraph: 63		  (1) If the regulator finds that a person has contravened a provision referred to in section 62 (1), the regulator may impose an administrative penalty on the person in an amount that does not exceed the prescribed amount.

heading: Administrative penalties
paragraph: (2) Before the regulator imposes an administrative penalty on a person, the regulator must consider the following:

heading: Administrative penalties
paragraph: (a) previous contraventions by, administrative penalties imposed on or orders issued to

heading: Administrative penalties
paragraph: (i)  the person,

heading: Administrative penalties
paragraph: (ii)  if the person is an individual, a corporation for which the individual is or was an officer, director or agent, and

heading: Administrative penalties
paragraph: (iii)  if the person is a corporation, an individual who is or was an officer, director or agent of the corporation;

heading: Administrative penalties
paragraph: (b) the gravity and magnitude of the contravention;

heading: Administrative penalties
paragraph: (c) the extent of the harm to others resulting from the contravention;

heading: Administrative penalties
paragraph: (d) whether the contravention was repeated or continuous;

heading: Administrative penalties
paragraph: (e) whether the contravention was deliberate;

heading: Administrative penalties
paragraph: (f) any economic benefit derived by the person from the contravention;

heading: Administrative penalties
paragraph: (g) the person's efforts to prevent and correct the contravention;

heading: Administrative penalties
paragraph: (h) any other matters prescribed by the Lieutenant Governor in Council.

heading: Administrative penalties
paragraph: (3) If a person is charged with an offence under this Act, an administrative penalty may not be imposed on the person in respect of the same circumstances that gave rise to the charge.

heading: Notice of contravention or penalty
paragraph:
64
		  If the regulator finds that a person has contravened a provision referred to in section 62 (1) or imposes an administrative penalty on a person, the regulator must give to the person a notice of the finding or administrative penalty and the notice must specify the following:

heading: Notice of contravention or penalty
paragraph: (a) the contravention;

heading: Notice of contravention or penalty
paragraph: (b) the amount of the penalty, if any;

heading: Notice of contravention or penalty
paragraph: (c) the date by which the penalty, if any, must be paid;

heading: Notice of contravention or penalty
paragraph: (d) the person's right to request a review of the decision under section 70 or to appeal the decision under section 72;

heading: Notice of contravention or penalty
paragraph: (e) an address to which a request for a review or an appeal may be sent.

heading: Due date of penalty
paragraph:
65
		  The person on whom an administrative penalty is imposed must pay the administrative penalty

heading: Due date of penalty
paragraph: (a) if paragraph (b) does not apply, within 30 days after the date on which the notice referred to in section 64 is served on the person, or

heading: Due date of penalty
paragraph: (b) by the later of the following:

heading: Due date of penalty
paragraph: (i)  if the person requests a review of the administrative penalty under section 70, 30 days after the date on which the notice referred to in section 71 (1) (b) is served on the person, unless the penalty is rescinded under section 71 (1) (a);

heading: Due date of penalty
paragraph: (ii)  if the person appeals the administrative penalty under section 72 and the appeal tribunal does not make an order under section 72 (4) with respect to that appeal, 30 days after the date on which the decision of the appeal tribunal is served on the person, unless the penalty is rescinded under section 72 (6) (a) or dealt with as described in section 72 (6) (b).

heading: Enforcement of administrative penalty
paragraph:
66
		  (1) An administrative penalty constitutes a debt payable to the government by the person on whom the penalty is imposed.

heading: Enforcement of administrative penalty
paragraph: (2) If a person fails to pay an administrative penalty as required under section 65,

heading: Enforcement of administrative penalty
paragraph: (a) the government may file with the Supreme Court or Provincial Court a certified copy of the notice imposing the administrative penalty and, on being filed, the notice has the same force and effect, and all proceedings may be taken on the notice, as if it were a judgment of that court, and

heading: Enforcement of administrative penalty
paragraph: (b) the regulator may refuse to consider applications made by the person under section 24.

heading: Revenue from administrative penalties
paragraph:
67
		  The regulator must pay all amounts derived from administrative penalties into the consolidated revenue fund.

heading: Time limit for imposing an administrative penalty
paragraph:
68
		  (1) The time limit for making a finding under section 62 and giving a notice under section 64 is

heading: Time limit for imposing an administrative penalty
paragraph: (a) 3 years after the date on which the act or omission that is alleged to constitute the contravention occurred, or

heading: Time limit for imposing an administrative penalty
paragraph: (b) if the commissioner issues a certificate described in subsection (2) of this section, 3 years after the date on which the commissioner learned of the act or omission referred to in paragraph (a).

heading: Time limit for imposing an administrative penalty
paragraph: (2) A certificate purporting to have been issued by the commissioner certifying the date referred to in subsection (1) (b) is proof of that date.

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph:
69
		  (1) In this Part:

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: "determination" means

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: (a) with respect to an eligible person other than a land owner referred to in paragraph (b),

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: (i)  a decision made by the regulator under section 25 or 26,

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: (ii)  a declaration made by the regulator on its own initiative under section 27,

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: (iii)  an order made by the regulator under section 40 (f),

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: (iv)  an order issued by an official or the regulator under Division 2 of Part 5,

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: (v)  a finding made by the regulator under section 62,

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: (vi)  an administrative penalty imposed by the regulator under section 63, and

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: (vii)  a prescribed decision made under this Act, and

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: (b) with respect to a land owner of land on which an operating area is located,

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: (i)  a decision made by the regulator

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: (A) under section 25 to issue a permit to carry out an energy resource activity on the land of the land owner, and

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: (B) under section 31 to amend a permit, if the amendment changes the effect of the permit on the land of the land owner, and

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: (ii)  a decision made by a review official under section 71 to vary a determination referred to in paragraph (a) (i) of this definition so that

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: (A) a permit is amended, if the amendment changes the effect of the permit on the land of the land owner, or

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: (B) a permit is issued to carry out energy resource activities on the land of a land owner;

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: "eligible person" means

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: (a) an applicant for a permit,

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: (b) a permit holder or former permit holder,

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: (b.1) an authorization holder or former authorization holder,

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: (c) a land owner of land on which an operating area is located,

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: (d) a person to whom an order under section 49 (1) has been issued, and

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: (e) a person with respect to whom the regulator has made a finding of a contravention under section 62;

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: "review official" means, in relation to a determination, a person who did not make the determination but who is designated in writing by the regulator to review the determination for the purposes of sections 70 and 71.

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: (2) Despite anything in a specified enactment, a determination may not be appealed, reviewed or otherwise reconsidered except as provided in this Part.

heading: Review by review official
paragraph:
70
		  (1) Subject to subsection (2), an eligible person, other than a land owner of land on which an operating area is located, may request, in accordance with this section, a review of a determination.

heading: Review by review official
paragraph: (2) An eligible person may not request a review of a determination under subsection (1) if the eligible person has appealed the determination under section 72.

heading: Review by review official
paragraph: (3) A request for a review under subsection (1) must be made within 30 days of receiving the later of

heading: Review by review official
paragraph: (a) the determination, and

heading: Review by review official
paragraph: (b) any written reasons respecting the determination.

heading: Review by review official
paragraph: (4) Despite subsection (3), a review official may extend the time to request a review, even if the time to make the request has expired, if satisfied that

heading: Review by review official
paragraph: (a) special circumstances existed which precluded making the request within the time period required under subsection (3), and

heading: Review by review official
paragraph: (b) an injustice would otherwise result.

heading: Review by review official
