paragraph: 88 All courts and justices in Canada have the same jurisdiction with respect to offences under this Act as they have under sections 257 and 258 of the Canada Shipping Act, 2001 with respect to offences under that Act, and those sections apply to offences under this Act in the same manner and to the same extent as they apply to offences under the Canada Shipping Act, 2001.

heading: Externally produced material
paragraph: 89 (1) A regulation made under this Act may incorporate by reference material produced by a person or body other than the Minister, including by a government, a government agency or an international body.

heading: Jointly produced material
paragraph: (2) A regulation made under this Act may incorporate by reference material produced jointly by the Minister and a government or government agency for the purpose of harmonizing the regulation with other laws.

heading: Internally produced standards
paragraph: (3) A regulation made under this Act may incorporate by reference technical or explanatory material produced by the Minister, such as specifications, test methods, procedures, construction standards, operational standards, safety standards and performance standards of a technical nature.

heading: Incorporation as amended from time to time
paragraph: (4) Material may be incorporated by reference as it exists on a particular date or as it is amended from time to time.

heading: Transmission and publication
paragraph: (5) For greater certainty, a document that is incorporated by reference in a regulation is not required to be transmitted for registration or publication in the Canada Gazette by reason only that it is incorporated by reference.

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (6) Subsections (1) to (5) do not limit any authority to make regulations incorporating material by reference that exists apart from those subsections.

heading: Defence
paragraph: 90 A person is not liable to be found guilty of an offence for any contravention in respect of which a document that is incorporated by reference in a regulation is relevant unless, at the time of the alleged contravention, it was accessible as required by section 91 or was accessible to the person.

heading: Accessibility of incorporated documents
paragraph: 91 The Minister shall ensure that any document that is incorporated by reference under subsection 89(1) is accessible.

heading: Five-year review
paragraph: 92 Every five years beginning on the day on which this section comes into force, the provisions and operation of this Act shall be reviewed by the committee of the Senate, of the House of Commons or of both Houses that is designated or established for that purpose.

heading: Short title
paragraph: 1 This Act may be cited as the Fisheries Development Act.

heading: Definitions
paragraph: 2 In this Act,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: fishery products includes any fishery resources and any products derived from fishery resources; (produits de la peche)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: fishery resources includes fish, molluscs, crustaceans, marine mammals and marine plants; (ressources de la peche)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: Minister means the Minister of Fisheries and Oceans. (ministre)

heading: Minister may undertake projects
paragraph: 3 (1) The Minister may undertake projects

heading: Minister may undertake projects
paragraph: (a) for the more efficient exploitation of fishery resources and for the exploration for and development of new fishery resources and new fisheries;

heading: Minister may undertake projects
paragraph: (b) for the introduction and demonstration to fishermen of new types of fishing vessels and fishing equipment and of new fishing techniques; and

heading: Minister may undertake projects
paragraph: (c) for the development of new fishery products and for the improvement of the handling, processing and distribution of fishery products.

heading: Projects with a province
paragraph: (2) The Minister may enter into an agreement with any province providing for the undertaking jointly with the government of the province or any agency thereof of any project that the Minister is authorized to undertake under subsection (1).

heading: Payments to a province
paragraph: (3) The Minister may, with the approval of the Governor in Council, enter into an agreement with any province providing for the payment to the province of contributions in respect of the cost of any project that is undertaken by the government of the province or any agency thereof and that the Minister is authorized to undertake under subsection (1).

heading: Projects with a person
paragraph: (4) The Minister may enter into an agreement with any person for the joint undertaking of any project that the Minister is authorized to undertake under subsection (1) or for the payment to any person of contributions in respect of the cost of any such project undertaken by that person.

heading: Economic studies
paragraph: (5) For the purpose of assisting the formulation and assessment of fisheries development projects, the Minister may undertake economic studies alone or jointly with the government of any province or agency thereof or with any university, educational institution or person, and may coordinate any such studies with similar studies undertaken in Canada.

heading: Services, etc., of other departments
paragraph: 4 The Minister shall, in carrying out any project or economic study under this Act, make use, wherever possible, of the services and facilities of other departments of the Government of Canada or of any agencies thereof.

heading: Minister may make payments
paragraph: 5 The Minister may make payments to such persons or classes of persons, in such amounts and on such terms and conditions as may be prescribed by the Governor in Council,

heading: Minister may make payments
paragraph: (a) for the construction and equipment of commercial cold storages, or commercial bait freezing facilities equipped with mechanical refrigeration, that will be suitable for the preservation of fishery products;

heading: Minister may make payments
paragraph: (b) for the modification of commercial cold storages, or commercial bait freezing facilities equipped with mechanical refrigeration, to make the cold storages or bait freezing facilities suitable for the preservation of fishery products;

heading: Minister may make payments
paragraph: (c) for the construction, modification, conversion and equipment of fishing vessels; and

heading: Minister may make payments
paragraph: (d) for the construction and equipment of commercial ice-making and ice-storing facilities, or commercial fish-chilling facilities, that will contribute to improvements in productivity in commercial fishing operations.

heading: Provisions to be included in agreements
paragraph: 6 Every agreement entered into pursuant to subsection 3(2) or (3) shall specify

heading: Provisions to be included in agreements
paragraph: (a) the respective proportions of the cost of any project to which the agreement relates that are to be paid by the Minister and the province, or the contribution in respect of any such project that is to be paid by the Minister, and the times at which the amounts to be paid by the Minister or the province are to be paid;

heading: Provisions to be included in agreements
paragraph: (b) the authority that is to be responsible for the undertaking, operation and maintenance of any project or any part thereof to which the agreement relates;

heading: Provisions to be included in agreements
paragraph: (c) the respective proportions of the revenues from any project to which the agreement relates that are to be paid to the Minister and the province; and

heading: Provisions to be included in agreements
paragraph: (d) the terms and conditions respecting the operation and maintenance of any project to which the agreement relates and the charges, if any, to be charged to persons to whom any of the benefits of the project are made available.

heading: Advisory committees
paragraph: 7 (1) The Minister may, in order to carry out the purposes and provisions of this Act, establish such advisory committees as he deems necessary and appoint the members thereof.

heading: Remuneration and expenses of members
paragraph: (2) Each member of a committee established under subsection (1) is entitled to be paid such amount for each day he attends any meeting of the committee as may be fixed by the Governor in Council and is entitled to be paid reasonable travel and living expenses while absent from his ordinary place of residence in the course of his duties under this Act.

heading: Validity of agreements
paragraph: 8 No agreement entered into pursuant to subsection 3(2), (3) or (4) providing for the payment of any money by the Minister has any force or effect until such time as money has been appropriated by Parliament for the purpose of discharging any commitment under that agreement.

heading: Regulations
paragraph: 9 The Governor in Council may make regulations

heading: Regulations
paragraph: (a) prescribing, for the purposes of section 5, the persons to whom payments may be made, the maximum amount of each payment and the terms and conditions on which the payments may be made;

heading: Regulations
paragraph: (b) prescribing matters, including matters similar to those required to be specified in an agreement under subsection 3(2) or (3), to be provided for in agreements entered into pursuant to subsection 3(4); and

heading: Regulations
paragraph: (c) with respect to any other matter concerning which he deems regulations necessary or desirable to carry out the purposes and provisions of this Act.

heading: Report
paragraph: 10 The Minister shall, as soon as possible after the termination of each fiscal year, submit a report to Parliament respecting the operations for that year under this Act and under agreements made under this Act.

heading: Short Title
paragraph: 1 These Regulations may be cited as the Fishery (General) Regulations.

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: 2 In these Regulations,

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: Act means the Fisheries Act; (Loi)

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: Convention Area has the same meaning as in subsection 2(1) of the Atlantic Fishery Regulations, 1985; (zone de la Convention)

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: Department means the Department of Fisheries and Oceans; (ministere)

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: document means a licence, fisher's registration card or vessel registration card that grants a legal privilege to engage in fishing or any other activity related to fishing and fisheries; (document)

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: fisher's registration card means a fisher's registration card issued under any of the Regulations listed in subsection 3(4); (carte d'enregistrement de pecheur)

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: fish landing station means any place, premises, vessel or vehicle used to receive fish landed, whether directly or indirectly, from a fishing vessel; (poste de debarquement du poisson)

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: licence means any type, kind or category of licence issued under any of the Regulations listed in subsection 3(4) or under these Regulations; (permis)

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: licence number means the number assigned to a licence by the Department at the time the licence is issued; (numero de permis)

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: observer means a person who is designated under section 39 or 39.1; (observateur)

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: provincial or territorial fisher's certificate means a certificate of accreditation or registration, however described and regardless of format, that is issued to a commercial fisher through a program of accreditation or registration established under provincial or territorial legislation; (certificat provincial ou territorial de pecheur)

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: Regional Director-General means a Regional Director-General or an Associate Regional Director-General of the Department; (directeur general regional)

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: registered vessel means a fishing vessel registered with the Department under any of the Regulations listed in subsection 3(4); (bateau enregistre)

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: Regulatory Area means that part of the Convention Area that lies beyond the areas in which any country exercises fisheries jurisdiction; (zone de reglementation)

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: vessel registration card means a vessel registration card or vessel registration certificate issued under any of the Regulations listed in subsection 3(4); (carte d'enregistrement de bateau)

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: vessel registration number means the number assigned to a vessel by the Department at the time the vessel is registered as a fishing vessel under any of the Regulations listed in subsection 3(4). (numero d'enregistrement de bateau)

heading: Application
paragraph: 3 (1) Subject to subsection (2), Parts I to VIII apply in respect of

heading: Application
paragraph: (a) fishing and related activities in Canadian fisheries waters off the Atlantic, Pacific and Arctic coasts;

heading: Application
paragraph: (b) fishing and related activities in the provinces of Nova Scotia, New Brunswick, British Columbia, Prince Edward Island and Newfoundland and Labrador and in the Yukon Territory and Northwest Territories; and

heading: Application
paragraph: (c) fishing and related activities carried out in waters other than Canadian fisheries waters from vessels subject to the jurisdiction of Canada.

heading: Application
paragraph: (2) Parts I to VIII do not apply in respect of fishing and related activities in respect of which the Quebec Fishery Regulations, 1990 apply.

heading: Application
paragraph: (3) Parts IX and X apply in respect of Canada and Canadian fisheries waters.

heading: Application
paragraph: (4) Where there is an inconsistency between these Regulations and any of the following Regulations, the following Regulations shall prevail:

heading: Application
paragraph: (a) the Atlantic Fishery Regulations, 1985;

heading: Application
paragraph: (b) the British Columbia Sport Fishing Regulations, 1996;

heading: Application
paragraph: (c) the Foreign Vessel Fishing Regulations;

heading: Application
paragraph: (d) the Marine Mammal Regulations;

heading: Application
paragraph: (e) the Management of Contaminated Fisheries Regulations;

heading: Application
paragraph: (f) the Maritime Provinces Fishery Regulations;

heading: Application
paragraph: (g) the Newfoundland and Labrador Fishery Regulations;

heading: Application
paragraph: (h) the Northwest Territories Fishery Regulations;

heading: Application
paragraph: (i) the Pacific Fishery Regulations, 1993;

heading: Application
paragraph: (j) the Yukon Territory Fishery Regulations;

heading: Application
paragraph: (k) the Aboriginal Communal Fishing Licences Regulations;

heading: Application
paragraph: (l) the Pacific Aquaculture Regulations;

heading: Application
paragraph: (m) the Aquatic Invasive Species Regulations; and
