heading: Free use permit in area subject to area-based licence
paragraph: 49.1		  (1) In this section and despite the definition of "area-based licence" in section 1 (1), "area-based licence" means a community forest agreement, a first nations woodland licence or a woodlot licence.

heading: Free use permit in area subject to area-based licence
paragraph: (2) With the consent of the holder of an area-based licence, the minister may enter into a free use permit authorizing the holder of the permit to harvest timber from Crown land within the area subject to the area-based licence.

heading: Free use permit in area subject to area-based licence
paragraph: (3) Despite sections 48 (1) and 49 (1), the minister may enter into a free use permit under this section only with an applicant described in section 48 (1) (a.1), (b), (c), (d), (g) or (h).

heading: Free use permit in area subject to area-based licence
paragraph: (4) Despite subsection (3), the minister must not enter into a free use permit with an applicant described in section 48 (1) (a.1), (b), (c), (d) or (h) if, on land the applicant owns or occupies, there is sufficient timber that is reasonably accessible for the purpose specified in the application.

heading: Free use permit in area subject to area-based licence
paragraph:
(5) 
              Section 49 (2) and (2.2) applies to a free use permit entered into under this section except that the minister may not, under section 49 (2.1), enter into a free use permit with an applicant described in section 48 (1) (g) for a volume exceeding 50 m3.

heading: Free use permit in area subject to area-based licence
paragraph: (6) Sections 48 (3) and 49 (3) and (4) do not apply in respect of a free use permit entered into under this section.

heading: Christmas tree permit
paragraph:
50
		  (1) The minister may enter into a Christmas tree permit that

heading: Christmas tree permit
paragraph: (a) authorizes the permittee to harvest or grow and harvest Christmas trees on Crown land,

heading: Christmas tree permit
paragraph: (b) requires the payment of the deposits and fees prescribed by the minister, and

heading: Christmas tree permit
paragraph: (c) includes other terms and conditions, consistent with this Act, the Forest and Range Practices Act, the Wildfire Act and any regulations or standards made under those Acts, as determined by the minister.

heading: Christmas tree permit
paragraph: (2) For the purposes of this section, the minister may prescribe different deposits and different rates or amounts of fees.

heading: Use by government employees and agents
paragraph:
52
		  (1) The minister or timber sales manager may, in writing, authorize

heading: Use by government employees and agents
paragraph: (a) employees acting in the course of their duties, and

heading: Use by government employees and agents
paragraph: (b) agents of the government acting in accordance with the terms of the agency

heading: Use by government employees and agents
paragraph: to harvest Crown timber or to use and occupy Crown land in a Provincial forest.

heading: Use by government employees and agents
paragraph: (2) An authorization under subsection (1)

heading: Use by government employees and agents
paragraph: (a) is an agreement under the Forest Act for the purposes of the definition of "forest practice" in the Forest and Range Practices Act, and

heading: Use by government employees and agents
paragraph: (b) may include terms and conditions that the minister or timber sales manager considers appropriate and that are consistent with this Act, the Forest and Range Practices Act, the Wildfire Act and any regulations or standards made under those Acts.

heading: Use by government employees and agents
paragraph: (3) If the minister or timber sales manager so specifies in the authorization, the Forest and Range Practices Act applies to the authorization as if the authorization were a forestry licence to cut.

heading: Definition
paragraph: 52.01		  In this Part, "agreement" means

heading: Definition
paragraph: (a) a forest licence,

heading: Definition
paragraph: (b) an area-based licence, or

heading: Definition
paragraph: (c) a licence referred to in section 52.02 (2).

heading: Requirement to obtain cutting permit
paragraph:
52.02
		  (1) The holder of a forest licence or an area-based licence must not harvest the allowable annual cut available except as authorized under a cutting permit issued under this Part.

heading: Requirement to obtain cutting permit
paragraph: (2) The holder of any of the following agreements must not harvest Crown timber under the agreement except as authorized under a cutting permit issued under this Part:

heading: Requirement to obtain cutting permit
paragraph: (a) a timber licence;

heading: Requirement to obtain cutting permit
paragraph: (b) a master licence to cut;

heading: Requirement to obtain cutting permit
paragraph: (c) a forestry licence to cut that requires the holder to obtain a cutting permit before harvesting Crown timber under the licence.

heading: Requirement to obtain cutting permit
paragraph: (3) Subsections (1) and (2) do not apply to the extent that harvesting without a cutting permit is specifically authorized under this Act or another enactment.

heading: Issuance of cutting permit
paragraph:
52.03
		  (1) Subject to this Part and section 209, the minister may, on application by the holder of an agreement, issue a cutting permit authorizing the holder to exercise harvesting rights under the agreement.

heading: Issuance of cutting permit
paragraph: (2) Without limiting the minister's discretion under subsection (1) to consider other matters, in deciding whether to issue a cutting permit, the minister must consider the impact that timber harvesting under the cutting permit, and road construction in relation to the cutting permit, would have on

heading: Issuance of cutting permit
paragraph: (a) the management and conservation of forest resources,

heading: Issuance of cutting permit
paragraph: (b) cultural heritage resources,

heading: Issuance of cutting permit
paragraph: (c) public health and safety, and

heading: Issuance of cutting permit
paragraph: (d) prescribed matters.

heading: Issuance of cutting permit
paragraph: (3) The duty of the minister under section 52.05, 52.06 or 52.07 to refuse to issue a cutting permit does not limit the minister's discretion under this section to refuse to issue a cutting permit.

heading: Application for cutting permit
paragraph:
52.04
		  (1) An application made under section 52.03 must be submitted in the form and manner specified by the minister.

heading: Application for cutting permit
paragraph: (2) The minister may require an applicant to include in an application for a cutting permit, at the applicant's expense,

heading: Application for cutting permit
paragraph: (a) information respecting existing or proposed roads that provide or will provide access to the cutting permit area,

heading: Application for cutting permit
paragraph: (b) information, plans, studies or analyses that the minister considers will assist in considering the matters referred to in section 52.03 (2), and

heading: Application for cutting permit
paragraph: (c) any other information the minister considers relevant to the application.

heading: Application for cutting permit
paragraph: (3) The minister may require that the information, plans, studies or analyses required under subsection (2) (b) be prepared by a person with the qualifications specified by the minister.

heading: Mandatory refusal to issue cutting permit
paragraph:
52.05
		  (1) The minister must refuse to issue a cutting permit if one or more of the following circumstances applies:

heading: Mandatory refusal to issue cutting permit
paragraph: (a) the minister determines that, taking into account the prescribed matters, if any, issuance of the cutting permit would compromise a prescribed government objective;

heading: Mandatory refusal to issue cutting permit
paragraph: (b) the cutting permit area is located outside a forest landscape area and one or more of the following applies:

heading: Mandatory refusal to issue cutting permit
paragraph: (i)  the applicant does not hold a forest stewardship plan or woodlot licence plan, as required under the Forest and Range Practices Act, in relation to the cutting permit area;

heading: Mandatory refusal to issue cutting permit
paragraph: (ii)  the applicant was required, under section 15.1 of the Forest and Range Practices Act, to prepare and make publicly available a forest operations map before applying for the permit, and the minister considers that, taking into account the prescribed matters, if any,

heading: Mandatory refusal to issue cutting permit
paragraph: (A) the applicant has not complied with section 15.1 of that Act, or

heading: Mandatory refusal to issue cutting permit
paragraph: (B) the cutting permit area is inconsistent with the approximate locations of cutblocks shown in the forest operations map;

heading: Mandatory refusal to issue cutting permit
paragraph: (c) the cutting permit area is located in a forest landscape area and either of the following applies:

heading: Mandatory refusal to issue cutting permit
paragraph: (i)  the applicant does not hold a forest operations plan, as required under the Forest and Range Practices Act, that applies to the cutting permit area;

heading: Mandatory refusal to issue cutting permit
paragraph: (ii)  the minister considers that, taking into account the prescribed matters, if any, the cutting permit area is inconsistent with the approximate locations of the proposed cutblocks shown in a forest operations plan held by the applicant;

heading: Mandatory refusal to issue cutting permit
paragraph: (d) a prescribed circumstance.

heading: Mandatory refusal to issue cutting permit
paragraph: (2) If a person applies for a cutting permit and only a portion of the cutting permit area is located outside a forest landscape area,

heading: Mandatory refusal to issue cutting permit
paragraph: (a) subsection (1) (b) applies to the application as it relates to the portion of the cutting permit area located outside the forest landscape area, and

heading: Mandatory refusal to issue cutting permit
paragraph: (b) subsection (1) (c) applies to the application as it relates to the portion of the cutting permit area located in the forest landscape area.

heading: Refusal of cutting permit for supplemental forest licence
paragraph: 52.06		  The minister must refuse to issue a cutting permit for a supplemental forest licence if the minister is not satisfied that the condition described in section 14.2 (2) is met.

heading: Cutting permit for master licence to cut
paragraph:
52.07
		  The minister must refuse to issue a cutting permit for a master licence to cut unless one or both of the following apply:

heading: Cutting permit for master licence to cut
paragraph: (a) the holder of the master licence to cut is authorized, under one or both of the following, to occupy the cutting permit area:

heading: Cutting permit for master licence to cut
paragraph: (i)  a written authorization from the government;

heading: Cutting permit for master licence to cut
paragraph: (ii)  an enactment;

heading: Cutting permit for master licence to cut
paragraph: (b) the cutting permit would facilitate harvesting

heading: Cutting permit for master licence to cut
paragraph: (i)  for a purpose prescribed for the purposes of section 47.4 (2) (b) (ii), or

heading: Cutting permit for master licence to cut
paragraph: (ii)  in a circumstance prescribed for the purposes of section 47.4 (2) (b) (iii).

heading: Content of cutting permit
paragraph:
52.08
		  (1) A cutting permit issued for an agreement must specify the term of the cutting permit, which term must not exceed the shorter of the following:

heading: Content of cutting permit
paragraph: (a) the period set out in subsection (2);

heading: Content of cutting permit
paragraph: (b) the period remaining on the term of the agreement.

heading: Content of cutting permit
paragraph: (2) The period for the purposes of subsection (1) (a) is as follows:

heading: Content of cutting permit
paragraph: (a) in the case of a cutting permit issued for an agreement other than a master licence to cut, 4 years;

heading: Content of cutting permit
paragraph: (b) in the case of a cutting permit issued for a master licence to cut, 4 years or a longer period established by regulation, if any.

heading: Content of cutting permit
paragraph: (3) A cutting permit issued for an agreement must do the following, within the limits provided in the agreement and subject to this Act and the Forest and Range Practices Act:

heading: Content of cutting permit
paragraph: (a) in the case of a cutting permit issued for a forest licence, authorize the holder to harvest a portion of the allowable annual cut available from a specified area within the timber supply area or tree farm licence area specified in the forest licence;

heading: Content of cutting permit
paragraph: (b) in the case of a cutting permit issued for an area-based licence, authorize the holder to harvest a portion of the allowable annual cut available from a specified area within the licence area;

heading: Content of cutting permit
paragraph: (c) in the case of a cutting permit issued for a timber licence, master licence to cut or forestry licence to cut, authorize the holder to harvest Crown timber under the licence from a specified area within the area of land described in the licence.

heading: Content of cutting permit
paragraph: (4) A cutting permit must include the prescribed terms and conditions, if any.

heading: Content of cutting permit
paragraph: (5) A cutting permit may include other terms and conditions that, subject to subsection (7), are within the limits provided in the agreement and consistent with this Act, the Forest and Range Practices Act, the Wildfire Act and any regulations or standards made under those Acts.

heading: Content of cutting permit
paragraph: (6) The terms and conditions referred to in subsection (5) may include, without limitation, terms and conditions respecting one or more of the following:

heading: Content of cutting permit
paragraph: (a) timber that is to be reserved from harvesting under the cutting permit;

heading: Content of cutting permit
paragraph: (b) periods during which timber may not be harvested under the cutting permit;

heading: Content of cutting permit
paragraph: (c) vehicles, machinery or harvesting methods that may not be used in harvesting timber under the cutting permit, either during specified periods or generally;

heading: Content of cutting permit
paragraph: (d) roads used or constructed by the holder under the cutting permit.

heading: Content of cutting permit
paragraph: (7) Terms and conditions included in a cutting permit issued for an agreement may set requirements or restrictions that are more stringent than the requirements and restrictions that apply to the holder

heading: Content of cutting permit
paragraph: (a) under the agreement, or

heading: Content of cutting permit
paragraph: (b) under this Act, the Forest and Range Practices Act, the Wildfire Act or any standards made under those Acts.

heading: Duty to comply with terms and conditions
paragraph: 52.09		  The holder of a cutting permit must comply with the terms and conditions of the cutting permit.

heading: Extension of cutting permit
paragraph:
52.10
		  (1) Subject to this section, on application by the holder of a cutting permit, other than a cutting permit issued for a licence to cut, the minister must extend the term of a cutting permit for a period that

heading: Extension of cutting permit
paragraph: (a) does not exceed one year, and

heading: Extension of cutting permit
paragraph: (b) does not result in a term for the cutting permit that is longer than the maximum term for a cutting permit referred to in section 52.08 (1).

heading: Extension of cutting permit
paragraph: (2) The minister may not extend the term of a cutting permit issued for an agreement if

heading: Extension of cutting permit
paragraph: (a) the agreement provides that the term of a cutting permit issued for the agreement must not be extended,

heading: Extension of cutting permit
paragraph: (b) rights under the cutting permit or agreement are under suspension, or

heading: Extension of cutting permit
paragraph: (c) the minister considers that the extension would prevent the fulfillment of an obligation under the Forest and Range Practices Act.

heading: Extension of cutting permit
paragraph: (3) An application under subsection (1) must be in writing and accompanied by payment of a fee equal to the amount determined in accordance with the regulations.

heading: Extension of cutting permit
paragraph: (4) The minister may, on request of the holder of the cutting permit, waive the fee required under subsection (3) if the minister is satisfied that the reasons for the extension are circumstances that are

heading: Extension of cutting permit
paragraph: (a) beyond the holder's control, and

heading: Extension of cutting permit
paragraph: (b) unrelated to the holder's financial situation.

heading: Extension of cutting permit
paragraph: (5) A fee paid under subsection (3) must not be credited towards stumpage.

heading: Postponement of cutting permit
paragraph: 52.11		  (1) On application by the holder of a cutting permit, the minister may, in accordance with the regulations, postpone the operation of the cutting permit for a period not exceeding 2 years.

heading: Postponement of cutting permit
paragraph: (2) The minister must specify as the effective date of a postponement under subsection (1) a date that is on or after the date on which the application for postponement was made.

heading: Postponement of cutting permit
paragraph: (3) If the operation of a cutting permit is postponed under subsection (1), the minister may, on application by the holder of the cutting permit and in accordance with the regulations, grant one or more extensions to the period of postponement, each for a period not exceeding 2 years.

heading: Postponement of cutting permit
paragraph: (4) During the period for which the operation of a cutting permit is postponed under this section, the holder of the cutting permit

heading: Postponement of cutting permit
paragraph: (a) must not exercise rights under the cutting permit, and

heading: Postponement of cutting permit
paragraph: (b) is liable to perform all obligations that are

heading: Postponement of cutting permit
paragraph: (i)  imposed, in respect of the cutting permit, under this Act, the Forest and Range Practices Act or the Wildfire Act, and

heading: Postponement of cutting permit
paragraph: (ii)  incurred before the effective date of the postponement.

heading: Postponement of cutting permit
paragraph: (5) On application by the holder of a cutting permit, the minister must rescind the postponement of the operation of the cutting permit.

heading: Postponement of cutting permit
paragraph: (6) If the postponement of the operation of a cutting permit is rescinded under subsection (5),

heading: Postponement of cutting permit
paragraph: (a) all rights under the cutting permit are exercisable by the holder of the cutting permit,

heading: Postponement of cutting permit
paragraph: (b) the period remaining on the term of the cutting permit, as at the date on which the postponement is rescinded and despite the terms and conditions of the cutting permit, is equal to the shorter of the following:

heading: Postponement of cutting permit
paragraph: (i)  the period remaining on the term of the agreement for which the cutting permit was issued;

heading: Postponement of cutting permit
paragraph: (ii)  the period that remained on the term of the cutting permit on the effective date of the postponement, and

heading: Postponement of cutting permit
paragraph: (c) the minister may not, under this section, grant another postponement of the operation of the cutting permit.

heading: Effect on cutting permit of expiration, cancellation, surrender or termination of agreement
paragraph: 52.12		  On the date on which an agreement expires or is cancelled, surrendered or terminated under this Act, all cutting permits issued for the agreement are cancelled without notice.

heading: Transition - immediate application
paragraph:
52.13
		  Despite any agreement, this Part, and the regulations made for the purposes of this Part, applies in relation to agreements entered into before, on or after the date this section comes into force.

heading: Interpretation and application
paragraph:
53
		  (1) In this Part:

heading: Interpretation and application
paragraph: "agreement" means an agreement in the form of a licence, permit or agreement referred to in section 12;

heading: Interpretation and application
paragraph: "disposition", in relation to an agreement, includes a disposition of an interest in the agreement;

heading: Interpretation and application
paragraph: "marketing of fibre" means

heading: Interpretation and application
paragraph: (a) the acquisition and disposition of rights to harvest timber in British Columbia, and

heading: Interpretation and application
paragraph: (b) the buying and selling, within British Columbia, of timber or wood residue;

heading: Interpretation and application
paragraph: (1.2) For the purposes of this section and Divisions 2, 2.1 and 4 of this Part, "agreement" includes a pulpwood agreement.

heading: Holders of agreements
paragraph:
53.1
		  (1) For the purposes of this Part and subject to subsection (2), a person is the holder of an agreement if any of the following applies:

heading: Holders of agreements
paragraph: (a) the person has entered into the agreement, whether singly or jointly with one or more other persons;

heading: Holders of agreements
paragraph: (b) the person, under section 54.2 (2), became a holder of the agreement on completion of a disposition;

heading: Holders of agreements
paragraph: (c) the person is a partner in a partnership that is a person referred to in paragraph (a) or (b) of this subsection.

heading: Holders of agreements
paragraph: (2) The government is not to be considered the holder of an agreement for the purposes of this Part.

heading: Cutting permits to be treated as part of agreement
paragraph:
53.3
		  For the purposes of this Division, a cutting permit issued for an agreement is to be treated as if the cutting permit formed part of the agreement.

heading: Transfer of agreements permitted
paragraph:
54
		  (1) Subject to subsection (2) and to section 54.4, the holder of an agreement may dispose of the agreement to another person.

heading: Transfer of agreements permitted
paragraph: (2) A disposition of an agreement is without effect unless all of the following conditions have been met:

heading: Transfer of agreements permitted
paragraph: (a) the minister, in writing, approves the disposition;

heading: Transfer of agreements permitted
paragraph: (b) as of the end of the day of the completion of the disposition, all money

heading: Transfer of agreements permitted
paragraph: (i)  required to be paid to the government under the circumstances set out in section 130 (1.1), and

heading: Transfer of agreements permitted
paragraph: (ii)  due and payable to the government under that section

heading: Transfer of agreements permitted
paragraph: in respect of the agreement

heading: Transfer of agreements permitted
paragraph: (iii)  has been paid, or

heading: Transfer of agreements permitted
paragraph: (iv)  is the subject of an arrangement for payment approved by the revenue minister;

heading: Transfer of agreements permitted
paragraph: (c) in the case of a disposition of a tree farm licence, any private tenure in the tree farm licence area remains subject to the tree farm licence;

heading: Transfer of agreements permitted
paragraph: (d) in the case of a disposition of a woodlot licence,

heading: Transfer of agreements permitted
paragraph: (i)  the intended recipient is a person or first nation that, under section 44, may enter into a woodlot licence, and

heading: Transfer of agreements permitted
paragraph: (ii)  the private land, if any, in the woodlot licence area remains subject to the woodlot licence;

heading: Transfer of agreements permitted
paragraph: (d.1) in the case of a disposition of an agreement in relation to which the holder of the agreement has a replaceable contract with a contractor, all obligations of the holder of the agreement under the replaceable contract are assumed by the recipient of the agreement;

heading: Transfer of agreements permitted
paragraph: (d.2) in the case of a disposition of an agreement

heading: Transfer of agreements permitted
paragraph: (i)  that is a non-BCTS licence, as defined in section 22.2 (1), and

heading: Transfer of agreements permitted
paragraph: (ii)  in relation to which rights to harvest Crown timber have been released to the government under a BCTS disposition agreement under section 22.2,

heading: Transfer of agreements permitted
paragraph: all rights and obligations of the holder of the non-BCTS licence under the BCTS disposition agreement are assumed by the recipient of that non-BCTS licence;

heading: Transfer of agreements permitted
paragraph: (d.3) in the case of a disposition of a BC timber sales agreement, the intended recipient is registered

heading: Transfer of agreements permitted
paragraph: (i)  as a BC timber sales enterprise, and

heading: Transfer of agreements permitted
paragraph: (ii)  if applicable, in a category of BC timber sales enterprises that, under section 20 (2) (b) (i), was eligible to apply for the agreement;

heading: Transfer of agreements permitted
paragraph: (d.4) in the case of a disposition of a road permit, the intended recipient is an eligible holder within the meaning of section 114;

heading: Transfer of agreements permitted
paragraph: (f) the disposition is completed within the longer of the following periods after approval is given by the minister under paragraph (a) of this subsection:

heading: Transfer of agreements permitted
paragraph: (i)  a period specified by the minister in giving the approval;

heading: Transfer of agreements permitted
paragraph: (ii)  a prescribed period, if any.

heading: Transfer of agreements permitted
paragraph: (2.1) On the request of the minister for the purposes of considering whether to approve a disposition, the holder of the agreement or the intended recipient of the agreement must provide to the minister

heading: Transfer of agreements permitted
paragraph: (a) prescribed information, and

heading: Transfer of agreements permitted
paragraph: (b) any other information the minister considers necessary.

heading: Transfer of agreements permitted
paragraph: (3) In subsection (2) (d.1), "replaceable contract" and "contractor" have the same meaning as in section 152.

heading: Conditions attached to ministerial approval of dispositions
paragraph:
54.01
		  (1) In this section, "specified agreement" means a specific agreement held by one or both of the following:

heading: Conditions attached to ministerial approval of dispositions
paragraph: (a) the intended recipient of an agreement under a disposition referred to in section 54;

heading: Conditions attached to ministerial approval of dispositions
paragraph: (b) a related person of the intended recipient.

heading: Conditions attached to ministerial approval of dispositions
paragraph: (2) The minister may, in approving a disposition of an agreement under section 54 (2) (a), attach conditions to the approval.

heading: Conditions attached to ministerial approval of dispositions
paragraph: (3) Without limiting subsection (2), the minister may, in approving a disposition of an agreement under section 54 (2) (a), attach as a condition that one or more specified agreements be disposed of

heading: Conditions attached to ministerial approval of dispositions
paragraph: (a) in accordance with section 54 to a person who is at arm's length from the intended recipient and from the related persons of the intended recipient, if any, and

heading: Conditions attached to ministerial approval of dispositions
paragraph: (b) by a date specified by the minister.

heading: Conditions attached to ministerial approval of dispositions
paragraph: (4) Without limiting subsection (2), the minister may, in approving a disposition of an agreement under section 54 (2) (a), attach conditions in relation to a road permit associated with the agreement, including conditions requiring the holder of the agreement to do any of the following:

heading: Conditions attached to ministerial approval of dispositions
paragraph: (a) dispose of the road permit, in accordance with section 54, to the intended recipient of the agreement;

heading: Conditions attached to ministerial approval of dispositions
paragraph: (b) surrender the road permit or rights under the road permit;

heading: Conditions attached to ministerial approval of dispositions
paragraph: (c) if the holder will continue to hold the road permit after the disposition of the agreement, provide security to the minister for the performance of the holder's obligations under the road permit, this Act, the Forest and Range Practices Act and the Wildfire Act.

heading: Mandatory refusal of dispositions
paragraph: 54.02		  (1) In considering whether to approve a disposition under section 54 (2) (a), the minister must consider the effect of the disposition on

heading: Mandatory refusal of dispositions
paragraph: (a) the marketing of fibre in British Columbia, and

heading: Mandatory refusal of dispositions
paragraph: (b) the public interest.

heading: Mandatory refusal of dispositions
paragraph: (2) Subsection (3) applies if, in considering the matters under subsection (1), the minister considers that any of the following applies:

heading: Mandatory refusal of dispositions
paragraph: (a) in the case of a disposition of a tree farm licence, forest licence or pulpwood agreement, the disposition would result in one or more of the following persons, on an individual or aggregate basis, holding or otherwise controlling rights to harvest Crown timber in an amount that is detrimental to competition in the marketing of fibre in all or part of British Columbia:

heading: Mandatory refusal of dispositions
paragraph: (i)  the intended recipient of the agreement;

heading: Mandatory refusal of dispositions
paragraph: (ii)  a related person of the intended recipient;

heading: Mandatory refusal of dispositions
paragraph: (b) in any case, it would not be in the public interest for the intended recipient to acquire the agreement under the disposition or to hold the rights under the agreement.

heading: Mandatory refusal of dispositions
paragraph: (3) In the circumstances referred to in subsection (2), the minister

heading: Mandatory refusal of dispositions
paragraph: (a) must not approve the disposition, or

heading: Mandatory refusal of dispositions
paragraph: (b) may approve the disposition only if the minister attaches conditions to the approval that will address, to the satisfaction of the minister, the applicable circumstances under subsection (2).

heading: Mandatory refusal of dispositions
paragraph: (4) Nothing in this section is intended to limit the authority of the minister to refuse approval of a disposition under section 54 (2) (a).

heading: Confirmation of completion of disposition and effect of completion
paragraph:
54.2
		  (1) On completing a disposition of an agreement, both the holder of the agreement and the person who acquired the agreement under the disposition must confirm the completion in writing to the minister within 7 days after the completion.

heading: Confirmation of completion of disposition and effect of completion
paragraph: (2) On completing a disposition of an agreement, the person who acquired the agreement under the disposition becomes the holder of the agreement for the purposes of this Act.

heading: Dispositions exempt from certain requirements
paragraph:
54.3
		  (1) In this section, "security interest" means an interest, in an agreement, that secures payment or performance of an obligation.

heading: Dispositions exempt from certain requirements
paragraph: (2) Sections 54 (2) and 54.2 do not apply to the following dispositions:

heading: Dispositions exempt from certain requirements
paragraph: (a) the granting, in good faith, of a security interest in an agreement;

heading: Dispositions exempt from certain requirements
paragraph: (b) the transmission of an interest in an agreement

heading: Dispositions exempt from certain requirements
paragraph: (i)  to a trustee in bankruptcy of the holder of the agreement, or

heading: Dispositions exempt from certain requirements
paragraph: (ii)  from the estate of a deceased holder of an agreement to the deceased holder's personal representative.

heading: Dispositions exempt from certain requirements
paragraph: (3) Within 3 months after a disposition referred to in subsection (2) (b), the trustee or personal representative referred to in that subsection must provide to the minister written notice of the disposition.

heading: Dispositions exempt from certain requirements
paragraph: (4) For certainty, subsection (2) (a) does not include a disposition resulting from the enforcement of a security interest.

heading: Transfer of certain agreements not permitted
paragraph:
54.4
		  (0.1) In this section, "restricted forest licence" has the same meaning as in section 14.2 (1).

heading: Transfer of certain agreements not permitted
paragraph: (1) The holder of an agreement may not dispose of the agreement to another person if the agreement

heading: Transfer of certain agreements not permitted
paragraph: (b) is one of the following agreements, unless the disposition is made with the approval of the Lieutenant Governor in Council or as permitted by the regulations:

paragraph: (i)  a non-replaceable forest licence entered into under section 13.1 (4) or (4.2);

heading: Transfer of certain agreements not permitted
paragraph: (i.1)  an agreement entered into under section 47.3 (1) (a);

heading: Transfer of certain agreements not permitted
paragraph: (ii)  a community forest agreement;

heading: Transfer of certain agreements not permitted
paragraph: (iii)  a first nations woodland licence,

heading: Transfer of certain agreements not permitted
paragraph: (d) is an occupant licence to cut unless the disposition is made in conjunction with a disposition of

heading: Transfer of certain agreements not permitted
paragraph: (i)  land, or

paragraph: (ii)  a right to occupy land

heading: Transfer of certain agreements not permitted
paragraph: to which the licence to cut pertains, or

paragraph: (e) is a free use permit.

heading: Transfer of certain agreements not permitted
paragraph: (1.01) The holder of an agreement that is a restricted forest licence or supplemental forest licence may not dispose of the agreement to another person if the holder, at the time the agreement was entered into,

heading: Transfer of certain agreements not permitted

heading: Transfer of certain agreements not permitted
paragraph: unless the disposition is made with the approval of the Lieutenant Governor in Council or as permitted by the regulations.

paragraph: (1.1) The Lieutenant Governor in Council may attach conditions to an approval under subsection (1) (b) or (1.01).

heading: Transfer of certain agreements not permitted
paragraph: (1.2) Despite any of the exceptions to the prohibitions on disposition in subsections (1) and (1.01), a person may not dispose of an agreement in respect of which rights are under suspension under section 76 or 78.

paragraph: (1.3) A disposition approved by the Lieutenant Governor in Council under subsection (1) (b) or (1.01) must be completed within the longer of the following periods after approval is given:

paragraph: (1.4) The conditions under section 54 (2) (a) and (f) do not apply to a disposition approved by the Lieutenant Governor in Council under subsection (1) (b) or (1.01) of this section.

heading: Transfer of certain agreements not permitted
paragraph: (2) A disposition of an agreement contrary to this section is without effect.

heading: Effect of disposition on obligations
paragraph:
54.6
		  (0.1) In this section, "outstanding liability", in relation to an agreement, means a liability referred to in subsection (1)

heading: Effect of disposition on obligations
paragraph: (a) accrued or accruing as of the date on which a disposition of the agreement is completed, and

heading: Effect of disposition on obligations
paragraph: (b) still outstanding as of that date.

heading: Effect of disposition on obligations
paragraph: (1) Subject to subsection (1.1), on completing a disposition of an agreement, the person who acquired the agreement under the disposition becomes liable in the person's capacity as the holder of the agreement

heading: Effect of disposition on obligations
paragraph: (a) for payment of all money in respect of the agreement that

heading: Effect of disposition on obligations
paragraph: (i)  is required to be paid to the government under the circumstances set out in section 130, whether before or after the date of completion, and

heading: Effect of disposition on obligations
paragraph: (ii)  is due and payable to the government under that section after the date of the completion or under an arrangement for payment under section 54 (2) (b) (iv),

heading: Effect of disposition on obligations
paragraph: (b) to perform all obligations under the agreement, including but not limited to obligations accrued or accruing as of the date of completion and still outstanding as of that date, and

heading: Effect of disposition on obligations
paragraph: (c) to perform all other obligations in respect of the agreement, including but not limited to obligations

heading: Effect of disposition on obligations
paragraph: (i)  accrued or accruing as of the date of completion of the disposition and still outstanding as of that date, and

heading: Effect of disposition on obligations
paragraph: (ii)  imposed with respect to the agreement under this Act, the Forest and Range Practices Act or the Wildfire Act.

heading: Effect of disposition on obligations
paragraph: (1.1) Subsection (1) does not apply to a person who acquires an agreement under a disposition referred to in section 54.3 (2).

heading: Effect of disposition on obligations
paragraph: (2) The following persons, as applicable, continue to be liable, jointly and severally with the person referred to in subsection (1) who acquires an agreement under a disposition, for all outstanding liabilities in relation to the agreement:

heading: Effect of disposition on obligations
paragraph: (a) the person who disposed of the agreement, other than a trustee in bankruptcy or a personal representative referred to in section 54.3 (2) (b);

heading: Effect of disposition on obligations
paragraph: (b) a person who held the agreement, if the agreement was disposed of

heading: Effect of disposition on obligations
paragraph: (i)  by the trustee in bankruptcy, referred to in section 54.3 (2) (b) (i), of the person, or

heading: Effect of disposition on obligations
paragraph: (ii)  by the personal representative, referred to in section 54.3 (2) (b) (ii), of the person.

heading: Suspension of rights if condition of disposition not met
paragraph: 54.61		  (1) The minister may suspend rights under an agreement under section 76 (1), or under a BC timber sales agreement under section 78.1 (1), if any of the following apply:

heading: Suspension of rights if condition of disposition not met
paragraph: (a) the holder purports to dispose of the agreement when a condition set out in section 54 (2) is not met;

heading: Suspension of rights if condition of disposition not met
paragraph: (b) the holder purports to dispose of the agreement contrary to section 54.4;

heading: Suspension of rights if condition of disposition not met
paragraph: (c) a condition attached under section 54.01 or 54.4 (1.1) to an approval of a disposition of the agreement is not met.

heading: Suspension of rights if condition of disposition not met
paragraph: (1.1) The minister may suspend rights under a road permit under section 76 (1) if a condition relating to the road permit attached under section 54.01 (4) to an approval of a disposition of an agreement is not met.

heading: Suspension of rights if condition of disposition not met
paragraph: (2) A timber sales manager may take action under section 78 (1) in relation to a BC timber sales agreement if satisfied that any of the circumstances set out in subsection (1) of this section applies to the agreement.

heading: Interpretation
paragraph:
54.62
		  (1) For the purposes of this Division, control of a corporation that holds an agreement changes if, as a result of an amalgamation or one or more transactions,

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (a) control of the corporation changes or is acquired or disposed of, or

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (b) control of a holding corporation, whose subsidiary is the corporation, changes or is acquired or disposed of.

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (2) For the purposes of this Division, a corporation that holds an agreement amalgamates with another corporation that holds an agreement if the corporation, or a holding corporation whose subsidiary is the corporation, amalgamates with

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (a) another corporation that holds an agreement, or

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (b) a holding corporation whose subsidiary is a corporation that holds an agreement.

heading: Notice of change of control or amalgamation
paragraph:
54.63
		  A corporation that holds an agreement must give written notice to the minister of the following events within 30 days after each event:

heading: Notice of change of control or amalgamation
paragraph: (a) a change of control of the corporation;

heading: Notice of change of control or amalgamation
paragraph: (b) an amalgamation of the corporation with another corporation that holds an agreement.

heading: Review of change of control or amalgamation
paragraph:
54.64
		  (1) On receiving notice under section 54.63, the minister must

heading: Review of change of control or amalgamation
paragraph: (a) review the change of control or amalgamation, as applicable, and

heading: Review of change of control or amalgamation
paragraph: (b) consider the effects of the change of control or amalgamation, as applicable, on

heading: Review of change of control or amalgamation
paragraph: (i)  the marketing of fibre in British Columbia, and

heading: Review of change of control or amalgamation
paragraph: (ii)  the public interest.

heading: Review of change of control or amalgamation
paragraph: (2) On the request of the minister for the purposes of a review under subsection (1) (a), the corporation must provide to the minister

heading: Review of change of control or amalgamation
paragraph: (a) prescribed information, and

heading: Review of change of control or amalgamation
paragraph: (b) any other information the minister considers necessary.

heading: Circumstances in which minister may take administrative action
paragraph:
54.65
		  The minister may take action under section 54.66 against a corporation that holds an agreement if

heading: Circumstances in which minister may take administrative action
paragraph: (a) control of the corporation changes, or the corporation amalgamates with another corporation that holds an agreement, and

heading: Circumstances in which minister may take administrative action
paragraph: (b) any of the following apply:

heading: Circumstances in which minister may take administrative action
paragraph: (i)  immediately after the change of control or amalgamation, all money

heading: Circumstances in which minister may take administrative action
paragraph: (A) required to be paid by the corporation to the government under the circumstances set out in section 130 (1.1), and

heading: Circumstances in which minister may take administrative action
paragraph: (B) due and payable to the government under that section

heading: Circumstances in which minister may take administrative action
paragraph: in respect of the agreement

heading: Circumstances in which minister may take administrative action
paragraph: (C) has not been paid, and

heading: Circumstances in which minister may take administrative action
paragraph: (D) is not the subject of an arrangement for payment approved by the revenue minister;

heading: Circumstances in which minister may take administrative action
paragraph: (ii)  in the case of a change of control or amalgamation of a corporation that holds a BC timber sales agreement, the change of control or amalgamation results in the corporation no longer being registered

heading: Circumstances in which minister may take administrative action
paragraph: (A) as a BC timber sales enterprise, or

heading: Circumstances in which minister may take administrative action
paragraph: (B) if applicable, in a category of BC timber sales enterprises that, under section 20 (2) (b) (i), was eligible to apply for the agreement;

heading: Circumstances in which minister may take administrative action
paragraph: (iii)  in the case of a change of control or amalgamation of a corporation that holds a first nations woodland licence, the change of control or amalgamation results in the corporation being a person or entity that, under section 43.54, is not permitted to enter into a first nations woodland licence;

heading: Circumstances in which minister may take administrative action
paragraph: (iv)  in the case of a change of control or amalgamation of a corporation that holds a woodlot licence, the change of control or amalgamation results in the corporation being a person who, under section 44, is not permitted to enter into a woodlot licence;

heading: Circumstances in which minister may take administrative action
paragraph: (v)  in the case of a change of control or amalgamation of a corporation that holds a tree farm licence, forest licence or pulpwood agreement, the minister considers that the change of control or amalgamation results in one or more of the following persons, on an individual or aggregate basis, holding or otherwise controlling rights to harvest Crown timber in an amount that is detrimental to competition in the marketing of fibre in all or part of British Columbia:

heading: Circumstances in which minister may take administrative action
paragraph: (A) the corporation;

heading: Circumstances in which minister may take administrative action
paragraph: (B) a related person of the corporation;

heading: Circumstances in which minister may take administrative action
paragraph: (vi)  the minister considers that, as a result of the change of control or amalgamation, it is not in the public interest for the corporation to continue to hold the agreement or to exercise the rights under the agreement.

heading: Administrative actions following change of control or amalgamation
paragraph:
54.66
		  (1) In the circumstances referred to in section 54.65, the minister may

heading: Administrative actions following change of control or amalgamation
paragraph: (a) without notice, immediately suspend rights under one or both of the following:

heading: Administrative actions following change of control or amalgamation
paragraph: (i)  the applicable agreement referred to in section 54.65 (b);

heading: Administrative actions following change of control or amalgamation
paragraph: (ii)  if applicable, a cutting permit issued for the agreement, and

heading: Administrative actions following change of control or amalgamation
paragraph: (b) after giving the corporation an opportunity to be heard, do one or more of the following:

heading: Administrative actions following change of control or amalgamation
paragraph: (i)  confirm or vary a suspension under paragraph (a) of this subsection;

heading: Administrative actions following change of control or amalgamation
paragraph: (i.1)  suspend rights under the agreement, a cutting permit issued for the agreement or both;

heading: Administrative actions following change of control or amalgamation
paragraph: (ii)  subject to subsection (3) of this section, require the corporation to dispose of the agreement, in accordance with section 54 and by the date specified by the minister, to a person who is at arm's length from the corporation and from the related persons of the corporation, if any;

heading: Administrative actions following change of control or amalgamation
paragraph: (iii)  accept a proposal made by the corporation under section 54.67;

heading: Administrative actions following change of control or amalgamation
paragraph: (iv)  impose other requirements on the corporation.

heading: Administrative actions following change of control or amalgamation
paragraph: (2) The minister must reinstate any rights suspended under subsection (1) (a) if the minister does not confirm or vary the suspension after providing an opportunity to be heard under subsection (1) (b).

heading: Administrative actions following change of control or amalgamation
paragraph: (3) The minister may not impose a requirement under subsection (1) (b) (ii) if the minister accepts a proposal under subsection (1) (b) (iii).

heading: Proposal by corporation following administrative action
paragraph:
54.67
		  (1) In this section, "specified agreement" means a specific agreement held by one or both of the following:

heading: Proposal by corporation following administrative action
paragraph: (a) a corporation that has been given an opportunity to be heard under section 54.66 (1);

heading: Proposal by corporation following administrative action
paragraph: (b) a related person of the corporation.

heading: Proposal by corporation following administrative action
paragraph: (2) For the purposes of addressing a circumstance under section 54.65 (b), a corporation that has been given an opportunity to be heard under section 54.66 (1) may propose to the minister that one or more specified agreements be disposed of.

heading: Proposal by corporation following administrative action
paragraph: (3) If the minister accepts a proposal under subsection (2), it is a condition of the minister's acceptance that each specified agreement be disposed of

heading: Proposal by corporation following administrative action
paragraph: (a) in accordance with section 54 to a person who is at arm's length from the corporation and from the related persons of the corporation, if any, and

heading: Proposal by corporation following administrative action
paragraph: (b) by a date specified by the minister.

heading: Proposal by corporation following administrative action
paragraph: (4) The minister must accept a proposal made under subsection (2) if

heading: Proposal by corporation following administrative action
paragraph: (a) the minister intends to impose a requirement under section 54.66 (1) (b) (ii) to address circumstances under section 54.65 (b), and

heading: Proposal by corporation following administrative action
paragraph: (b) the proposed disposition will address, to the satisfaction of the minister, those circumstances.

heading: Exempt changes of control
paragraph:
54.68
		  (1) Sections 54.63 to 54.67 do not apply to a change of control of a corporation that is caused by a transmission of shares in its capital

heading: Exempt changes of control
paragraph: (a) to a trustee in bankruptcy of the holder of the shares, or

heading: Exempt changes of control
paragraph: (b) from the estate of a deceased person to the deceased person's personal representative.

heading: Exempt changes of control
paragraph: (2) Within 3 months after a change of control referred to in subsection (1), the corporation must provide to the minister written notice of the change of control.

heading: Subsequent suspension or cancellation of rights
paragraph:
54.69
		  (1) The minister may suspend rights under an agreement under section 76 (1), or under a BC timber sales agreement under section 78.1 (1), if any of the following apply:

heading: Subsequent suspension or cancellation of rights
paragraph: (a) the holder did not dispose of the agreement as required under section 54.66 (1) (b) (ii);

heading: Subsequent suspension or cancellation of rights
paragraph: (b) a proposal of the holder was accepted under section 54.66 (1) (b) (iii) by the minister and a condition of the minister's acceptance set out in section 54.67 (3) was not met;

heading: Subsequent suspension or cancellation of rights
paragraph: (c) the holder failed to comply with a requirement imposed under section 54.66 (1) (b) (iv).

heading: Subsequent suspension or cancellation of rights
paragraph: (2) The minister may cancel an agreement, other than a BC timber sales agreement, under section 77 (1) if

heading: Subsequent suspension or cancellation of rights
paragraph: (a) rights under the agreement were suspended, or a suspension of rights under the agreement was confirmed or varied, under section 54.66 (1) (b) (i),

heading: Subsequent suspension or cancellation of rights
paragraph: (b) the suspension remains in effect, and

heading: Subsequent suspension or cancellation of rights
paragraph: (c) any of the circumstances set out in subsection (1) of this section applies to the agreement.

heading: Subsequent suspension or cancellation of rights
paragraph: (3) A timber sales manager may take action under section 78 (1) in relation to a BC timber sales agreement if satisfied that any of the circumstances set out in subsection (1) of this section applies to the agreement.

heading: Disposition of private land subject to tree farm licence or woodlot licence
paragraph:
54.7
		  (1) The minister's prior written consent must be obtained for the disposition of private land or an interest in private land if the private land or interest is subject to a tree farm licence or to a woodlot licence.

heading: Disposition of private land subject to tree farm licence or woodlot licence
paragraph: (2) The minister may attach conditions to a consent given under subsection (1).

heading: Disposition of private land subject to tree farm licence or woodlot licence
paragraph: (3) The minister, without notice and despite section 77, may cancel a tree farm licence or woodlot licence if the minister determines that

heading: Disposition of private land subject to tree farm licence or woodlot licence
paragraph: (a) the minister's prior written consent was not obtained to a disposition for which the consent was required under in subsection (1), or

heading: Disposition of private land subject to tree farm licence or woodlot licence
paragraph: (b) the person to whom a consent was given under subsection (1) does not comply with a condition attached to the consent under subsection (2).

heading: Disposition of private land subject to tree farm licence or woodlot licence
paragraph: (4) If the minister determines that there are grounds under subsection (3) to cancel a tree farm licence or woodlot licence, but decides against cancelling the licence,

heading: Disposition of private land subject to tree farm licence or woodlot licence
paragraph: (a) the minister is deemed to have consented to the disposition of the private land or the disposition of the interest in the private land, and

heading: Disposition of private land subject to tree farm licence or woodlot licence
paragraph: (b) the minister, in making the decision not to cancel, may attach conditions to the licence that the minister considers appropriate in the circumstances.

heading: Disposition of private land subject to tree farm licence or woodlot licence
paragraph: (5) The holder of a licence to which conditions are attached under subsection (4) (b) must comply with the conditions.

heading: Disposition of private land subject to tree farm licence or woodlot licence
paragraph: (6) This section does not apply to a disposition of private land, or an interest in private land, that is subject to a tree farm licence or woodlot licence if

heading: Disposition of private land subject to tree farm licence or woodlot licence
paragraph: (a) the licence is disposed of in accordance with section 54, and

heading: Disposition of private land subject to tree farm licence or woodlot licence
paragraph: (b) the private land or interest in private land, as applicable, is disposed of to the person who acquired the licence under the disposition referred to in paragraph (a) of this subsection.

heading: Exchanges of rights
paragraph:
57
		  (1) The minister, with the consent of the Lieutenant Governor in Council, may enter into, in exchange for the surrender of a timber licence, a new timber licence describing Crown land the timber on which is not otherwise encumbered.

heading: Exchanges of rights
paragraph: (2) Despite section 95 of the Land Act, the Lieutenant Governor in Council may accept under that section, in exchange for Crown land, private forest land of greater or lesser value.

heading: Exchanges of rights
paragraph: (3) Before a transaction is completed under subsection (1) or (2), the minister must obtain a current appraisal of the value of the lands or timber, as the case may be, involved in the transaction, prepared by an independent appraiser appointed by the minister.

heading: Extension of timber sale licences and cutting permits
paragraph:
58.1
		  (1) The holder of a timber sale licence may apply in writing to the timber sales manager for an extension of the term of the licence for a period that

heading: Extension of timber sale licences and cutting permits
paragraph: (a) does not exceed one year, and

heading: Extension of timber sale licences and cutting permits
paragraph: (b) does not result in a term of more than 4 years for the licence.

heading: Extension of timber sale licences and cutting permits
paragraph: (3) Subject to subsection (8), the timber sales manager must accept an application under subsection (1) if

heading: Extension of timber sale licences and cutting permits
paragraph: (a) the timber sale licence does not prohibit the extension,

heading: Extension of timber sale licences and cutting permits
paragraph: (b) rights under the timber sale licence are not under suspension, and

heading: Extension of timber sale licences and cutting permits
paragraph: (c) the holder of the timber sale licence pays to the government a fee equal to the amount determined under subsection (5) and, if applicable, subsection (5.1).

heading: Extension of timber sale licences and cutting permits
paragraph: (4) On the date of acceptance of an application under subsection (3), the term of the timber sale licence is extended in accordance with the application.

heading: Extension of timber sale licences and cutting permits
paragraph: (5) The fee referred to in subsection (3) (c)

heading: Extension of timber sale licences and cutting permits
paragraph: (a) for a timber sale licence for which there was a bonus bid is a fee equal to a prescribed percentage of an amount calculated according to the following formula:

heading: Extension of timber sale licences and cutting permits
paragraph: or

heading: Extension of timber sale licences and cutting permits
paragraph: (b) for a timber sale licence for which there was a bonus offer is a fee equal to a prescribed percentage of an amount calculated according to the following formula:

heading: Extension of timber sale licences and cutting permits
paragraph: (5.1) If the holder of a timber sale licence harvested timber under the licence before applying to extend the term of the licence under subsection (1), the fee payable under subsection (5) (a) or (b) is reduced, to a maximum of 90%, by the percentage derived from the following formula:

heading: Extension of timber sale licences and cutting permits
paragraph: (6) At the request of the holder of a timber sale licence who has submitted an application for an extension under subsection (1), the timber sales manager may waive the fee referred to in subsection (3) (c) if the timber sales manager is satisfied that the reasons for the extension are circumstances

heading: Extension of timber sale licences and cutting permits
paragraph: (a) beyond the holder's control, and

heading: Extension of timber sale licences and cutting permits
paragraph: (b) unrelated to the holder's financial situation.

heading: Extension of timber sale licences and cutting permits
paragraph: (7) A fee paid under subsection (3) (c) must not be credited towards stumpage.

heading: Extension of timber sale licences and cutting permits
paragraph: (8) The timber sales manager may reject an application to extend the term of a timber sale licence if, in the opinion of the timber sales manager, the extension would prevent the fulfillment of an obligation under the Forest and Range Practices Act.

heading: Surrender of BC timber sales agreement
paragraph:
58.3
		  (1) The holder of a timber sale licence may apply in writing to the timber sales manager to surrender the licence.

heading: Surrender of BC timber sales agreement
paragraph: (2) The timber sales manager must accept the application to surrender the licence if

heading: Surrender of BC timber sales agreement
paragraph: (a) no harvesting has taken place under the licence, and

heading: Surrender of BC timber sales agreement
paragraph: (b) any requirements prescribed for the purposes of this section are fulfilled.

heading: Surrender of BC timber sales agreement
paragraph: (3) On the date of acceptance of an application under subsection (2)

heading: Surrender of BC timber sales agreement
paragraph: (a) the timber sale licence that is the subject of the application is surrendered, and

heading: Surrender of BC timber sales agreement
paragraph: (b) if the timber sale licence was advertised on or after November 4, 2003, any deposit required under this Act in relation to the licence and held by the government is forfeited to the government.

heading: Surrender of BC timber sales agreement
paragraph: (4) However, at the request of the holder of a timber sale licence, the minister or a person authorized by the minister may relieve the holder of a timber sale licence surrendered under this section from the forfeiture imposed under subsection (3) (b) if the minister or authorized person is satisfied that the reasons for the surrender are circumstances

heading: Surrender of BC timber sales agreement
paragraph: (a) beyond the holder's control, and

heading: Surrender of BC timber sales agreement
paragraph: (b) unrelated to the holder's financial situation.

heading: Surrender of BC timber sales agreement
paragraph: (5) A request referred to in subsection (4) must

heading: Surrender of BC timber sales agreement
paragraph: (a) be made within 30 days after the date an application to surrender a timber sale licence under subsection (1) is made,

heading: Surrender of BC timber sales agreement
paragraph: (b) be signed by, or on behalf of, the requesting person, and

heading: Surrender of BC timber sales agreement
paragraph: (c) specify the reasons for the request.

heading: Temporary reductions
paragraph:
61
		  (1) The minister, with the consent of the holder of the licence or agreement, may reduce for a specified period the allowable annual cut authorized

heading: Temporary reductions
paragraph: (a) in a forest licence, or

heading: Temporary reductions
paragraph: (b) for a tree farm licence area, community forest agreement area, first nations woodland licence area or woodlot licence area.

heading: Temporary reductions
paragraph: (2) Before expiry of a period of reduction specified under this section, the minister, with the consent of the holder of the licence or agreement, may

heading: Temporary reductions
paragraph: (a) extend the period of the reduction, or

heading: Temporary reductions
paragraph: (b) increase or decrease the size of the reduction.

heading: Temporary reductions
paragraph: (3) During the period of a reduction under this section, the total volume of timber comprised in the reduction is available for disposition under this Act to persons other than the holder of the licence or agreement.

heading: Return of surrendered harvesting rights
paragraph:
62
		  At the end of the period of any reduction specified under section 61, the allowable annual cut authorized in or for the licence or agreement that was subject to the reduction is restored by this section to the amount that is equal to the allowable annual cut that was in effect for the licence or agreement immediately before the reduction, minus any reductions, other than under section 61, that have been made under this Act or the licence or agreement during the period of the reduction.

heading: Definitions for sections 63 to 63.05
paragraph:
62.1
		  In this section and in sections 63 to 63.05:

heading: Definitions for sections 63 to 63.05
paragraph: "base-level allowable annual cut" means the allowable annual cut prescribed as the base-level allowable annual cut for ungrouped licences and groups of licences;

heading: Definitions for sections 63 to 63.05
paragraph: "combined allowable annual cut", in relation to a group of licences, means the combined total of the allowable annual cuts authorized for each licence in the group of licences;

heading: Definitions for sections 63 to 63.05
paragraph: "combined allowable annual cut reduction", in relation to a group of licences, means the share of a timber supply area reduction that applies to the group of licences, as determined under section 63.02 and, if applicable, section 63.03;

heading: Definitions for sections 63 to 63.05
paragraph: "group of licences" means 2 or more licences that are in a group of licences, as determined under section 63.01;

heading: Definitions for sections 63 to 63.05
paragraph: "licence" means a forest licence;

heading: Definitions for sections 63 to 63.05
paragraph: "timber supply area reduction", in relation to a timber supply area, means the amount of reduction in the allowable annual cut for the timber supply area that is to be distributed among the licences in that timber supply area, as determined under section 63 (2) (a);

heading: Definitions for sections 63 to 63.05
paragraph: "ungrouped licence" means a licence that is not in a group of licences.

heading: Reduction among licences in timber supply area
paragraph:
63
		  (1) If the allowable annual cut determined for a timber supply area is reduced under section 8 for any reason, other than a reduction in the area of land in the timber supply area, the minister may reduce the allowable annual cuts of the licences in the timber supply area.

heading: Reduction among licences in timber supply area
paragraph: (2) To reduce the allowable annual cuts of the licences referred to in subsection (1), the minister must do the following:

heading: Reduction among licences in timber supply area
paragraph: (a) determine how much of the reduction in the allowable annual cut determined for the timber supply area is to be distributed among the licences;

heading: Reduction among licences in timber supply area
paragraph: (b) determine under section 63.01

heading: Reduction among licences in timber supply area
paragraph: (i)  which licences are in a group of licences, and

heading: Reduction among licences in timber supply area
paragraph: (ii)  which licences are ungrouped licences;

heading: Reduction among licences in timber supply area
paragraph: (c) distribute the timber supply area reduction among the groups of licences and ungrouped licences by using the methods set out in section 63.02 and, if applicable, section 63.03;

heading: Reduction among licences in timber supply area
paragraph: (d) if the combined allowable annual cut of a group of licences is reduced as a result of the distribution under paragraph (c), distribute that combined allowable annual cut reduction among those licences by using the methods set out in section 63.04 and, if applicable, section 63.05.

heading: Reduction among licences in timber supply area
paragraph: (3) A reduction under subsection (2) to the allowable annual cut of a licence takes effect when notice of the reduction is served on the holder of the licence.

heading: Reduction among licences in timber supply area
paragraph: (4) When a reduction to the allowable annual cut of a licence takes effect, the licence is deemed to be amended to reflect the reduction.

paragraph: (3) A forestry licence to cut referred to in subsection (2) must

paragraph: (a) the time by which the timber or special forest products must be harvested to prevent them from being significantly reduced in value, lost or destroyed or to minimize the spread of an insect infestation,

paragraph: (b) any seasonal site conditions or constraints that would limit the harvesting of the timber or special forest products, and
