paragraph:
75
		  No agreement made under this Act prevents or impedes the government from using, or granting the use of, Crown land for any purpose that the minister considers is compatible with timber harvesting.

heading: Definitions
paragraph:
75.01
		  (1) In this Division:

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "allowable annual cut partition" means a portion of the allowable annual cut for a timber supply area or tree farm licence area that is specified by the chief forester under section 8 (5);

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "base-level allowable annual cut" means the allowable annual cut that is prescribed for the purposes of this Division;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "exempted licence" means a forest licence that

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) specifies an allowable annual cut that is less than the base-level allowable annual cut, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) is a non-replaceable forest licence that meets prescribed conditions;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "harvested volume" means,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) in relation to a licence to which a limit specified in an order made under section 75.02 applies to the licence, the volume, as determined in accordance with the regulations, of the partitioned timber that is harvested under that licence, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) in relation to 2 or more licences held by the same person to which a limit specified in an order made under section 75.02 applies to the licences, the sum of the volume, as determined in accordance with the regulations, of the partitioned timber that is harvested under each of those licences;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "partitioned timber", in relation to an allowable annual cut partition, means the timber that is subject to the allowable annual cut partition.

heading: Partition order
paragraph:
75.02
		  (1) In subsections (2) and (3), "forest licence" means a forest licence that is not an exempted licence.

heading: Partition order
paragraph: (2) If the chief forester specifies an allowable annual cut partition for a timber supply area, the minister, by order, may, if he or she considers it necessary to ensure the attribution specified in the partition is carried out, specify a limit on the harvested volume for one or more forest licences in the timber supply area in respect of one or more of the following:

heading: Partition order
paragraph: (a) a type of timber or terrain in parts of Crown land within the timber supply area;

heading: Partition order
paragraph: (b) different areas of Crown land within the timber supply area.

heading: Partition order
paragraph: (3) If the chief forester specifies an allowable annual cut partition for a tree farm licence area, the minister, by order, may, if he or she considers it necessary to ensure the attribution specified in the partition is carried out, specify a limit on the harvested volume for

heading: Partition order
paragraph: (a) the tree farm licence, in respect of one or more of the following:

heading: Partition order
paragraph: (i)  a type of timber or terrain in parts of Crown land within the tree farm licence area;

heading: Partition order
paragraph: (ii)  different areas of Crown land within the tree farm licence area;

heading: Partition order
paragraph: (iii)  a type of timber or terrain in different parts of private land within the tree farm licence area, and

heading: Partition order
paragraph: (b) one or more forest licences in the tree farm licence area, in respect of one or more of the following:

heading: Partition order
paragraph: (i)  a type of timber or terrain in parts of Crown land within the tree farm licence area;

heading: Partition order
paragraph: (ii)  different areas of Crown land within the tree farm licence area.

heading: Partition order
paragraph: (3.1) In making an order under subsection (2) or (3) (b), the minister may specify one limit that applies in relation to 2 or more forest licences held by the same person.

heading: Partition order
paragraph: (3.2) For greater certainty, if the minister specifies one limit that applies to 2 or more forest licences, as described in subsection (3.1), the person who is the holder of the forest licences may harvest any portion, including all or nothing, of the harvested volume under any of the forest licences that are subject to the limit.

heading: Partition order
paragraph: (4) A limit specified under this section on the harvested volume for one or more forest licences or for a tree farm licence must be determined in accordance with the regulations.

heading: Partition order
paragraph: (4.1) In determining a limit under this section on the harvested volume for one or more forest licences or for a tree farm licence, the minister may take into consideration the volume of partitioned timber harvested under the applicable licence or licences since the date the allowable annual cut partition took effect.

heading: Partition order
paragraph: (5) An order made under this section must specify

heading: Partition order
paragraph: (a) a term not exceeding 10 years,

heading: Partition order
paragraph: (b) the allowable annual cut partition relating to the order, and

heading: Partition order
paragraph: (c) the harvested volume limit that each licence holder affected by the order may not exceed during the term of the order.

heading: Partition order
paragraph: (6) The minister must serve a copy of an order made under this section on the holder of one or more licences to which the order relates, but the order is not invalid only because it is not served.

heading: Partition order
paragraph: (7) Subject to an amendment or cancellation under subsection (8) or an increase or waiver under section 75.03, the holder of a licence to which a limit specified in an order made under this section applies must ensure that,

heading: Partition order
paragraph: (a) if the limit is specified for one licence, the harvested volume under the licence does not exceed the harvested volume limit specified for that licence in the order, and

heading: Partition order
paragraph: (b) if the limit is specified for 2 or more licences held by the same person, the harvested volume under those licences does not exceed the harvested volume limit specified for those licences in the order.

heading: Partition order
paragraph: (8) If, under section 8 (5.1), the allowable annual cut partition relating to an order made under this section

heading: Partition order
paragraph: (a) is amended, the minister may amend the order if the minister considers it necessary to ensure the attribution specified in the partition is carried out, or

heading: Partition order
paragraph: (b) is cancelled, the order is cancelled on the same date the partition is cancelled.

heading: Increase or waiver of harvested volume limit in order
paragraph:
75.03
		  (1) On request of the holder of one or more licences to which an order made under section 75.02 applies, the minister may increase or waive the harvested volume limit specified for that licence or licences if the minister is satisfied that the reasons for the increase or waiver meet prescribed criteria.

heading: Increase or waiver of harvested volume limit in order
paragraph: (2) A request under subsection (1) must

heading: Increase or waiver of harvested volume limit in order
paragraph: (a) be signed by, or on behalf of, the requesting person, and

heading: Increase or waiver of harvested volume limit in order
paragraph: (b) specify the reasons for the request.

heading: Consolidation, subdivision or replacement of licences subject to an order
paragraph:
75.04
		  (1) In this section, "original licence" means a forest licence or tree farm licence to which an order made under section 75.02 applies.

heading: Consolidation, subdivision or replacement of licences subject to an order
paragraph: (2) If an original licence is replaced under section 19 or 39 by 2 or more other licences, the harvested volume that, before the replacement, was charged to the original licence must be charged to the other licences by allocating that volume among the other licences by the method set out in subsection (3).

heading: Consolidation, subdivision or replacement of licences subject to an order
paragraph: (3) The part of the harvested volume to be allocated among each of the other licences must be determined by multiplying that volume by the fraction obtained by dividing the allowable annual cut of that other licence by the allowable annual cut of the original licence.

heading: Consolidation, subdivision or replacement of licences subject to an order
paragraph: (4) If 2 or more licences are replaced under section 19 or 39 by one other licence, the harvested volume that, before the replacement, was charged to the original licences must be charged to the other licence.

heading: Consolidation, subdivision or replacement of licences subject to an order
paragraph: (5) The minister must amend an order made under section 75.02 to account for an allocation of volume under subsection (2) of this section or a charging of volume under subsection (4) of this section.

heading: Consolidation, subdivision or replacement of licences subject to an order
paragraph: (6) If an original licence is a forest licence that is replaced by another forest licence under section 15 or if an original licence is a tree farm licence that is replaced by another tree farm licence under section 36,

heading: Consolidation, subdivision or replacement of licences subject to an order
paragraph: (a) the harvested volume that, before the replacement, was charged to the original licence must be charged to the replacement licence, and

heading: Consolidation, subdivision or replacement of licences subject to an order
paragraph: (b) the order made under section 75.02 in respect of the original licence applies to the replacement licence as if the replacement licence were the original licence.

heading: Penalty for non-compliance with minister's order
paragraph:
75.05
		  (1) If the harvested volume limit specified for one or more licences in an order made under section 75.02 is exceeded, the licence holder must pay to the government the penalty determined under subsection (2) of this section.

heading: Penalty for non-compliance with minister's order
paragraph: (2) The penalty under subsection (1) is the product of

heading: Penalty for non-compliance with minister's order
paragraph: (a) the volume of harvested timber that exceeds the harvested volume limit, and

heading: Penalty for non-compliance with minister's order
paragraph: (b) the prescribed rate.

heading: Penalty for non-compliance with minister's order
paragraph: (3) A penalty under this section is in addition to stumpage payable or another penalty under this Act or another enactment.

heading: Relief from penalty
paragraph:
75.06
		  (1) On the request of a licence holder who is subject to a penalty imposed under section 75.05, the minister may grant relief, in whole or in part, from the penalty if the minister is satisfied that the reasons for the relief meet prescribed criteria.

heading: Relief from penalty
paragraph: (2) A request under subsection (1) must

heading: Relief from penalty
paragraph: (a) be submitted within 90 days after the date the penalty is imposed under section 75.05 (1),

heading: Relief from penalty
paragraph: (b) be signed by, or on behalf of, the requesting person, and

heading: Relief from penalty
paragraph: (c) specify the reasons for the request.

heading: Regulation making powers
paragraph:
75.07
		  (1) Without limiting Division 3 of Part 12, the Lieutenant Governor in Council may make regulations as follows:

heading: Regulation making powers
paragraph: (a) prescribing the allowable annual cut referred to in the definition of "base-level allowable annual cut" in section 75.01;

heading: Regulation making powers
paragraph: (b) prescribing conditions for the purposes of paragraph (b) of the definition of "exempted licence" in section 75.01;

heading: Regulation making powers
paragraph: (c) for the purpose of the definition of "harvested volume" in section 75.01 (1), specifying the rules, methods, formulas or requirements for determining the harvested volume, including, without limitation, requiring the holder of one or more licences to which an order under section 75.02 applies to make assessments of the partitioned timber;

heading: Regulation making powers
paragraph: (d) specifying the criteria, circumstances, rules, methods or formulas to be used to determine limits on harvested volume under section 75.02;

heading: Regulation making powers
paragraph: (e) prescribing criteria for increasing or waiving a harvested volume limit for the purposes of section 75.03;

heading: Regulation making powers
paragraph: (f) prescribing penalty rates for the purposes of section 75.05;

heading: Regulation making powers
paragraph: (g) prescribing criteria for relief from penalty for the purposes of section 75.06.

heading: Regulation making powers
paragraph: (3) A rate prescribed under subsection (1) (f) may be different for different portions of the volume referred to in section 75.05 (2) (a).

heading: Interpretation
paragraph:
75.1
		  (1) In this Division:

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: "cut control period" in relation to a licence, means the cut control period determined for that licence under section 75.4 or 75.5;

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: "volume of timber harvested", in relation to each licence as defined in a provision of this Division, means the total of the timber volumes that are attributed to the licence

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (a) in cut control statements issued on behalf of the government to the holder of the licence, or

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (b) under the authority of a regulation made under subsection (3) (b) or (c),

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: for

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (c) the term of the licence, if it is a licence as defined in section 75.2 or 75.21, or

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (d) the cut control period for the licence, if it is not a licence as defined in section 75.2 or 75.21,

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: less all downward adjustments to those volumes to which the holder of the licence is entitled under subsection (3) of this section.

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (2) In the definition of "volume of timber harvested" in subsection (1), "timber volumes" means the following volumes:

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (a) if the timber volume is reported by scale under Part 6 of the Act,

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (i)  the volume of timber cut under the licence and under road permits associated with the licence, and

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (ii)  the volume of timber estimated to be wasted or damaged under the licence and under road permits associated with the licence;

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (b) if the timber volume is calculated using information from a cruise of the timber before the timber is cut, the volume of timber calculated to have been cut under the licence and under road permits associated with the licence;

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (c) the volume of timber cut, damaged or destroyed by the holder of the licence without authorization;

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (d) the volume of timber attributed to the licence by the minister under the authority of a regulation made under subsection (3) (b) or (c);

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (e) except for a licence as defined in section 75.2 or 75.21, the excess volume of timber, if any, carried forward under section 75.7 from the immediately preceding cut control period.

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (3) For the purposes of the definition of "volume of timber harvested" in subsection (1), the Lieutenant Governor in Council may make regulations

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (a) prescribing percentages or amounts by which the timber volumes attributed to a licence in statements referred to in that definition must be, subject to an applicable limit set out in an order issued under a regulation made under paragraph (a.1), adjusted downward to take into account

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (i)  grades and species of timber, or

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (ii)  uses of timber

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: included in the volumes described in subsection (2) (a) and (b),

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (a.1) with respect to percentages prescribed under paragraph (a), authorizing the minister, subject to any terms specified in the regulation, to set, by order respecting an area, a limit on one or both of the following amounts:

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (i)  the aggregate volume of downward adjustments that may be made to one or more types of licences in the area;

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (ii)  the volume of downward adjustment that may be made to a licence or type of licence specified in the order,

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (b) authorizing the minister, in specified circumstances and with the consent of the licensees, to attribute a portion of the volume of timber harvested under any type of licence, as defined in a provision of this Division, to another licence as so defined, whether of the same or a different type, and

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (c) authorizing the minister, in specified circumstances and with the consent of the licensee, to attribute a portion of the volume of timber harvested under the licence in a cut control period to the immediately preceding cut control period.

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (3.1) If the minister is authorized to make an order under authority of a regulation made under subsection (3) (a.1), the order made under that authority must set out the following:

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (a) the area for which the order is made;

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (b) the licence or type of licence to which the order applies;

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (c) the time period during which the limit applies;

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (d) the grade and species of timber, or the uses of timber, to which the order applies.

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (3.2) An order made under authority of a regulation made under subsection (3) (a.1) must be published by posting the order on a publicly accessible website maintained by or on behalf of the government.

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (4) A percentage prescribed under subsection (3) (a) for a grade or species of timber may be any percentage within the range of 0% to 100%.

heading: Exception for licences that define "volume of timber harvested"
paragraph:
75.11
		  (1) If a licence, as defined in a provision of this Division,

heading: Exception for licences that define "volume of timber harvested"
paragraph: (a) provides that the definition of "volume of timber harvested" in section 75.1 (1) does not apply to the licence, and

heading: Exception for licences that define "volume of timber harvested"
paragraph: (b) contains a different definition that is specific to the licence,

heading: Exception for licences that define "volume of timber harvested"
paragraph: that different definition applies to that licence for the purposes of this Division instead of the definition of "volume of timber harvested" in section 75.1 (1).

heading: Exception for licences that define "volume of timber harvested"
paragraph: (2) For the purposes of a definition of "volume of timber harvested" included in a licence referred to in subsection (1), the Lieutenant Governor in Council may make regulations

heading: Exception for licences that define "volume of timber harvested"
paragraph: (a) authorizing the minister, in specified circumstances and with the consent of the licensees, to attribute a portion of the volume of timber harvested under any type of licence, as defined in a provision of this Division, to another licence as so defined, whether of the same or a different type, and

heading: Exception for licences that define "volume of timber harvested"
paragraph: (b) authorizing the minister, in specified circumstances and with the consent of the licensee, to attribute a portion of the volume of timber harvested under the licence in a cut control period to the immediately preceding cut control period.

heading: Bonus bid equalization payment for attributed timber volumes
paragraph:
75.12
		  (1) The holder of a licence for which a bonus bid was tendered must pay an amount to the government, in accordance with the regulations, if

heading: Bonus bid equalization payment for attributed timber volumes
paragraph: (a) a volume of timber harvested under another licence is attributed to the holder's licence under the authority of a regulation made under section 75.1 (3) (b) or 75.11 (2) (a), and

heading: Bonus bid equalization payment for attributed timber volumes
paragraph: (b) the bonus bid that was tendered for the holder's licence is higher than the bonus bid, if any, that was tendered for the licence under which the attributed volume was harvested.

heading: Bonus bid equalization payment for attributed timber volumes
paragraph: (2) Without limiting Division 3 of Part 12, the Lieutenant Governor in Council may make regulations respecting payments required under subsection (1), including, without limitation,

heading: Bonus bid equalization payment for attributed timber volumes
paragraph: (a) the criteria, circumstances, rules, methods or formulas to be used in calculating the amount payable,

heading: Bonus bid equalization payment for attributed timber volumes
paragraph: (b) the time period within which the amount must be paid, and

heading: Bonus bid equalization payment for attributed timber volumes
paragraph: (c) the form and manner of payment.

heading: Limit on total cut for licences with a term of 5 years or less
paragraph:
75.2
		  (1) In this section, "licence" means a

heading: Limit on total cut for licences with a term of 5 years or less
paragraph: (a) timber sale licence that specifies an allowable annual cut,

heading: Limit on total cut for licences with a term of 5 years or less
paragraph: (b) forest licence,

heading: Limit on total cut for licences with a term of 5 years or less
paragraph: (c) tree farm licence, or

heading: Limit on total cut for licences with a term of 5 years or less
paragraph: (d) woodlot licence

heading: Limit on total cut for licences with a term of 5 years or less
paragraph: originally having a term ending 5 years or less after its commencement date.

heading: Limit on total cut for licences with a term of 5 years or less
paragraph: (2) The holder of a licence must ensure that the volume of timber harvested during the term of the licence does not exceed a limit equal to the sum of the allowable annual cuts

heading: Limit on total cut for licences with a term of 5 years or less
paragraph: (a) authorized for the licence if it is a forest licence, timber sale licence or woodlot licence, or

heading: Limit on total cut for licences with a term of 5 years or less
paragraph: (b) available to the holder under the licence if it is a tree farm licence

heading: Limit on total cut for licences with a term of 5 years or less
paragraph: for the period of the original term of the licence.

heading: Limit on total cut for licences with a term of 5 years or less
paragraph: (2.1) The holder of a licence must ensure that the volume of timber harvested under the licence does not exceed the maximum harvestable volume specified in the licence.

heading: Limit on total cut for licences with a term of 5 years or less
paragraph: (2.2) If compliance with subsection (2) is inconsistent with compliance with subsection (2.1), subsection (2.1) prevails to the extent of the inconsistency.

heading: Limit on total cut for licences with a term of 5 years or less
paragraph: (3) If the volume of timber harvested during the term of a licence exceeds the applicable limit under subsection (2) or the limit under subsection (2.1), the holder of the licence must pay to the government the penalty determined under subsection (4).

heading: Limit on total cut for licences with a term of 5 years or less
paragraph: (4) The penalty under subsection (3) is the product of

heading: Limit on total cut for licences with a term of 5 years or less
paragraph: (a) the volume of timber harvested during the term of the licence that exceeds the applicable limit under subsection (2) or the limit under subsection (2.1), and

heading: Limit on total cut for licences with a term of 5 years or less
paragraph: (b) the prescribed rate.

heading: Limit on total cut for licences with a term of 5 years or less
paragraph: (5) A penalty under this section is in addition to stumpage payable or another penalty under this Act or another enactment.

heading: Limit on total cut for forestry licence to cut
paragraph: (2) The holder of a forestry licence to cut must ensure that the volume of timber harvested under the forestry licence to cut does not exceed the maximum harvestable volume specified in the forestry licence to cut.

heading: Limit on total cut for forestry licence to cut
paragraph: (3) If the volume of timber harvested under a forestry licence to cut exceeds the limit specified in subsection (2), the holder of the forestry licence to cut must pay to the government the penalty determined under subsection (4).

heading: Limit on total cut for forestry licence to cut
paragraph: (4) The penalty under subsection (3) is the product of

heading: Limit on total cut for forestry licence to cut
paragraph: (a) the volume of timber harvested under the forestry licence to cut that exceeds the limit referred to in subsection (2), and

heading: Limit on total cut for forestry licence to cut
paragraph: (b) the prescribed rate.

heading: Limit on total cut for forestry licence to cut
paragraph: (5) A penalty under this section is in addition to stumpage payable or another penalty under this Act or another enactment.

heading: Cut control period for short term licences that are extended
paragraph:
75.22
		  (1) In this section, "licence" means a forest licence originally having a term ending 5 years or less after its commencement date.

heading: Cut control period for short term licences that are extended
paragraph: (2) On the date the term of a licence is extended under section 47.3 (3) (b) beyond 5 years from the commencement date,

heading: Cut control period for short term licences that are extended
paragraph: (a) if the licence specifies an allowable annual cut greater than 10 000 m3, section 75.4 (2) to (7) applies to the licence,

heading: Cut control period for short term licences that are extended
paragraph: (b) if the licence specifies an allowable annual cut of 10 000 m3 or less, section 75.5 (2) to (5) applies to the licence, and

heading: Cut control period for short term licences that are extended
paragraph: (c) the first cut control period for a licence described in paragraph (a) or (b) as determined under section 75.4 (2) or 75.5 (2), as the case may be, is based on the commencement date of the term of the licence.

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for short term licences
paragraph:
75.3
		  (1) In this section, "licence" means a licence that is a forest licence, woodlot licence or tree farm licence and has a term of 5 years or less.

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for short term licences
paragraph: (2) If a licence is replaced under section 19 or 39 by 2 or more other licences,

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for short term licences
paragraph: (a) each of the other licences, for the purposes of section 75.2, is deemed to have begun on the first day of the term of the replaced licence, and

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for short term licences
paragraph: (b) the volume of timber harvested that, before the replacement, was charged to the replaced licence must be charged to the other licences by allocating that volume among the other licences by the method set out in subsection (3).

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for short term licences
paragraph: (3) The part of the volume of timber harvested referred to in subsection (2) (b) to be allocated among each of the other licences must be determined by multiplying that volume by the fraction obtained by dividing the allowable annual cut of that other licence by the allowable annual cut of the replaced licence.

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for short term licences
paragraph: (4) If 2 or more licences are replaced under section 19, 39 or 46.2 by one other licence,

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for short term licences
paragraph: (a) the term of that other licence, for the purposes of section 75.2, is deemed to have begun

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for short term licences
paragraph: (i)  on the first day of the terms of the replaced licences, if their terms began on the same day, or

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for short term licences
paragraph: (ii)  on the earliest of the dates on which the any of the terms of the replaced licences began, if their terms began on different dates, and

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for short term licences
paragraph: (b) the volumes that before the replacement were charged to the replaced licences must be charged to that other licence.

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph:
75.4
		  (1) In this section and in section 75.41 "licence" means

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: (a) a forest licence that specifies an allowable annual cut greater than 10 000 m3 and has a term of more than 5 years,

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: (a.1) a woodlot licence that has a term of more than 5 years, or

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: (c) a tree farm licence that has a term of more than 5 years.

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: (2) The first cut control period for a licence, other than a woodlot licence, that is not a replacement for another licence is 5 years beginning on January 1 of the calendar year in which the term of the licence begins.

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: (2.1) The first cut control period for a licence that is a woodlot licence, and is not a replacement for another woodlot licence, is 5 years beginning on

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: (a) the first day of a month designated by the minister, or

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: (b) if the minister does not designate a month under paragraph (a), January 1

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: of the calendar year in which the term of the woodlot licence begins.

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: (3) For a licence that is a replacement under section 15, 36 or 46 for another licence,

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: (a) the first cut control period is the same as the cut control period for the replaced licence, immediately before its replacement, and

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: (b) the volume of timber harvested that, before the replacement, was charged to the replaced licence must be charged to the replacement licence.

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: (4) The holder of a licence, other than a woodlot licence, may terminate

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: (a) the first cut control period for the licence, and

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: (b) any subsequent cut control period determined under this section,

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: by written notice, delivered after January 1 and before June 30 of the calendar year of delivery, to a person designated by the minister.

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: (4.1) The holder of a licence that is a woodlot licence may terminate

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: (a) the first cut control period for the licence, and

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: (b) any subsequent cut control period for the licence determined under this section

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: by written notice to a person designated by the minister, delivered between the last anniversary date of the beginning of the cut control period for the licence and 6 months after that date.

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: (5) If the holder of a licence, other than a woodlot licence, terminates a cut control period under subsection (4),

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: (a) the termination takes effect on December 31 of the year immediately preceding the calendar year of delivery of the notice of termination, and

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: (b) a new cut control period of 5 years for the agreement begins on January 1 of the calendar year of delivery of the notice of termination.

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: (5.1) If the holder of a licence that is a woodlot licence terminates a cut control period under subsection (4.1),

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: (a) the termination takes effect on the day immediately preceding the last anniversary date of the beginning of the cut control period for the licence, and

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: (b) a new cut control period of 5 years for the licence begins on the last anniversary date.

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: (6) If the holder of a licence who under subsection (4) or (4.1) may terminate the cut control period for the licence does not do so, then, immediately after the expiry of that cut control period, a new cut control period of 5 years for the licence begins.

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: (7) If a licence

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: (a) expires or is surrendered, or

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: (b) is terminated under this Act,

heading: Cut control period for major licences
paragraph: the cut control period for the licence ends on the date the licence expires, is surrendered or is terminated despite any thing to the contrary in this Division.

heading: Cut control limit for major licences
paragraph:
75.41
		  (1) The holder of a licence, other than a woodlot licence, must ensure that the volume of timber harvested during its cut control period does not exceed 110% of the sum of the allowable annual cuts

heading: Cut control limit for major licences
paragraph: (a) authorized for the licence for that period if it is a forest licence, or

heading: Cut control limit for major licences
paragraph: (b) available to the holder under the licence for that period if it is a tree farm licence.

heading: Cut control limit for major licences
paragraph: (1.1) The holder of a licence that is a woodlot licence must ensure that the volume of timber harvested during its cut control period does not exceed 120% of the sum of the allowable annual cuts that for that period are authorized for the licence.

heading: Cut control limit for major licences
paragraph: (2) Despite subsection (1) or (1.1), the holder of a licence must ensure that the volume of timber harvested during its final cut control period does not exceed 100% of the sum of the allowable annual cuts for that period that are

heading: Cut control limit for major licences
paragraph: (a) authorized for the licence if it is a forest licence or woodlot licence, or

heading: Cut control limit for major licences
paragraph: (b) available to the holder under the licence if it is a tree farm licence.

heading: Cut control limit for major licences
paragraph: (3) The holder of a licence that provides that a replacement for it must not be offered must ensure that the volume of timber harvested under the licence does not exceed the maximum harvestable volume specified in the licence.

heading: Cut control limit for major licences
paragraph: (4) If compliance with subsection (1), (1.1) or (2) is inconsistent with compliance with subsection (3), subsection (3) prevails to the extent of the inconsistency.

heading: Cut control period for other licences
paragraph:
75.5
		  (1) In this section and in section 75.51:

heading: Cut control period for other licences
paragraph: "forest licence" means a forest licence that specifies an allowable annual cut of 10 000 m3 or less and has a term of more than 5 years;

heading: Cut control period for other licences
paragraph: "timber sale licence" means a timber sale licence that specifies an allowable annual cut of 10 000 m3 or less and has a term of more than 5 years.

heading: Cut control period for other licences
paragraph: (2) The first cut control period

heading: Cut control period for other licences
paragraph: (a) for a forest licence that is not a replacement under section 15 for another forest licence, or

heading: Cut control period for other licences
paragraph: (b) for a timber sale licence

heading: Cut control period for other licences
paragraph: is 5 years beginning on January 1 of the calendar year in which the term of the licence begins.

heading: Cut control period for other licences
paragraph: (3.1) For a forest licence that is a replacement under section 15 for another forest licence,

heading: Cut control period for other licences
paragraph: (a) the first cut control period is the same as the cut control period for the replaced licence, immediately before its replacement, and

heading: Cut control period for other licences
paragraph: (b) the volume of timber harvested that, before the replacement, was charged to the replaced licence must be charged to the replacement licence.

heading: Cut control period for other licences
paragraph: (4) Immediately after the expiry of the first cut control period, or any subsequent cut control period, for a forest licence or timber sale licence, a new 5 year cut control period for the licence begins.

heading: Cut control period for other licences
paragraph: (5) If a forest licence or timber sale licence

heading: Cut control period for other licences
paragraph: (a) expires or is surrendered, or

heading: Cut control period for other licences
paragraph: (b) is terminated under any provision of this Act,

heading: Cut control period for other licences
paragraph: the cut control period for the licence ends on the date the licence expires, is surrendered or is terminated despite any thing to the contrary in this Division.

heading: Cut control limit for other licences
paragraph:
75.51
		  (1) The holder of a timber sale licence or forest licence must ensure that the volume of timber harvested during a cut control period for the licence is not more than 120% of the sum of the allowable annual cuts for that period that are authorized for the licence.

heading: Cut control limit for other licences
paragraph: (2) Despite subsection (1), the holder of a timber sale licence or forest licence must ensure that the volume of timber harvested during the final cut control period for the licence is not more than 100% of the sum of the allowable annual cuts for that period that are authorized for the licence.

heading: Cut control limit for other licences
paragraph: (3) The holder of

heading: Cut control limit for other licences
paragraph: (a) a timber sale licence, or

heading: Cut control limit for other licences
paragraph: (b) a forest licence

heading: Cut control limit for other licences
paragraph: that provides that a replacement for it must not be offered must ensure that the volume of timber harvested under the licence does not exceed the maximum harvestable volume specified in the licence.

heading: Cut control limit for other licences
paragraph: (4) If compliance with subsection (1) or (2) is inconsistent with compliance with subsection (3), subsection (3) prevails to the extent of the inconsistency.

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for major and other licences
paragraph:
75.6
		  (1) In this section, "licence" means

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for major and other licences
paragraph: (a) a licence as defined in section 75.4, excluding a woodlot licence, or

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for major and other licences
paragraph: (b) a forest licence as defined in section 75.5.

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for major and other licences
paragraph: (2) If a licence is replaced under section 19 or 39 by 2 or more other licences,

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for major and other licences
paragraph: (a) the first cut control period for each of the other licences is deemed to have begun on the same day on which the latest cut control period for the replaced licence began, and

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for major and other licences
paragraph: (b) the volume of timber harvested that, before the replacement, was charged to the replaced licence during its latest cut control period must be charged to the other licences by allocating that volume among the other licences during their first cut control period by the method set out in subsection (3).

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for major and other licences
paragraph: (3) The part of the volume of timber harvested referred to in subsection (2) (b) to be allocated among each of the other licences must be determined by multiplying that volume by the fraction obtained by dividing the allowable annual cut of that other licence by the allowable annual cut of the replaced licence.

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for major and other licences
paragraph: (4) If 2 or more licences are replaced under section 19 or 39 by one other licence,

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for major and other licences
paragraph: (a) the cut control periods for the replaced licences are deemed to have ended on December 31 of the calendar year immediately preceding the calendar year of the replacement,

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for major and other licences
paragraph: (b) the first cut control period for the other licence begins on January 1 of the calendar year of the replacement, and

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for major and other licences
paragraph: (c) the following must be charged to the first cut control period of that other licence:

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for major and other licences
paragraph: (i)  the volume of timber harvested that was charged to the replaced licences during the calendar year of the replacement;

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for major and other licences
paragraph: (ii)  the volume of timber harvested that exceeded the volume that was authorized for, or available to the holders of, the replaced licences for the immediately preceding cut control periods.

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for woodlot licences
paragraph:
75.61
		  (1) In this section, "licence" means a woodlot licence as described in paragraph (a.1) of the definition of "licence" in section 75.4 (1).

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for woodlot licences
paragraph: (2) If 2 licences are replaced under section 46.2 by one other licence,

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for woodlot licences
paragraph: (a) the cut control periods for the replaced licences are deemed to have ended on

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for woodlot licences
paragraph: (i)  the day immediately preceding the last anniversary date of the beginning of the cut control periods for the replaced licences, if the anniversary date of their cut control periods is the same, or

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for woodlot licences
paragraph: (ii)  the earlier of the days immediately preceding the last anniversary dates of the beginning of the cut control periods for the replaced licences, if the anniversary dates of their cut control periods are different,

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for woodlot licences
paragraph: (b) the first cut control period for the other licence begins on

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for woodlot licences
paragraph: (i)  the last anniversary date of the beginning of the cut control periods for the replaced licences, if the anniversary date of their cut control periods is the same, or

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for woodlot licences
paragraph: (ii)  the earlier of the last anniversary dates of the beginning of the cut control periods for the replaced licences, if the anniversary dates of their cut control periods are different, and

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for woodlot licences
paragraph: (c) the following must be charged to the first cut control period of that other licence:

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for woodlot licences
paragraph: (i)  the volume of timber harvested that was charged to the replaced licences from the last anniversary date of the beginning of the cut control periods for the replaced licences to the date of the replacement;

heading: Reconciliation of cut control for woodlot licences
paragraph: (ii)  the volume of timber harvested that exceeded the volume that was authorized for the replaced licences for the immediately preceding cut control periods.

heading: Carry forward of excess harvest volume
paragraph:
75.7
		  If the volume of timber harvested during a cut control period for a licence, as defined in section 75.4, a forest licence, as defined in section 75.5, or a timber sale licence, as defined in section 75.5, exceeds the sum of the allowable annual cuts

heading: Carry forward of excess harvest volume
paragraph: (a) authorized for the licence for that period if it is a forest licence, timber sale licence or woodlot licence, or

heading: Carry forward of excess harvest volume
paragraph: (b) available to the holder under the licence for that period if it is a tree farm licence,

heading: Carry forward of excess harvest volume
paragraph: the excess volume of timber must be treated as being timber harvested during a cut period that is the next cut control period.

heading: No carry forward of unharvested volume
paragraph:
75.8
		  (1) If the volume of timber harvested during a cut control period for a licence, as defined in section 75.4, a forest licence, as defined in section 75.5, or a timber sale licence, as defined in section 75.5, is less than the sum of the allowable annual cuts

heading: No carry forward of unharvested volume
paragraph: (a) authorized for the licence for that period if it is a forest licence, timber sale licence or woodlot licence, or

heading: No carry forward of unharvested volume
paragraph: (b) available to the holder for that period under the licence if it is a tree farm licence,

heading: No carry forward of unharvested volume
paragraph: the holder of the licence must not harvest that unharvested volume of timber in a subsequent cut control period.

heading: No carry forward of unharvested volume
paragraph: (2) The unharvested volume of timber, referred to in subsection (1), in a tree farm licence area or woodlot licence area may be disposed of to a person other than the holder of the tree farm licence or woodlot licence by means of

heading: No carry forward of unharvested volume
paragraph: (a) a forestry licence to cut,

heading: No carry forward of unharvested volume
paragraph: (b) a timber sale licence under section 20, or

heading: No carry forward of unharvested volume
paragraph: (c) a non-replaceable forest licence.

heading: Exemption from cut control limits
paragraph:
75.9
		  (1) If the minister considers that timber on Crown land or other forest resources on Crown land is at risk because of wind, fire, insect or disease, he or she

heading: Exemption from cut control limits
paragraph: (a) may exempt the holder of a licence, as defined in section 75.4, a forest licence, as defined in section 75.5, or a timber sale licence, as defined in section 75.5, from the limit under section 75.41 or 75.51, as the case may be, and

heading: Exemption from cut control limits
paragraph: (b) in granting the exemption must specify a different limit and may attach conditions to the exemption.

heading: Exemption from cut control limits
paragraph: (2) The holder of a licence who is exempted under this section must comply with a condition of the exemption.

heading: Penalty for exceeding cut control limits
paragraph:
75.91
		  (1) If the volume of timber harvested during a cut control period for a licence, as defined in section 75.4, a forest licence, as defined in section 75.5, or a timber sale licence, as defined in section 75.5, exceeds

heading: Penalty for exceeding cut control limits
paragraph: (a) the limit under section 75.41 or 75.51, as the case may be, or

heading: Penalty for exceeding cut control limits
paragraph: (b) the limit specified under section 75.9,

heading: Penalty for exceeding cut control limits
paragraph: the holder of the licence must pay to the government the penalty determined under subsection (2).

heading: Penalty for exceeding cut control limits
paragraph: (2) The penalty under subsection (1) is the product of

heading: Penalty for exceeding cut control limits
paragraph: (a) the volume of timber harvested during the cut control period that exceeds the applicable limit referred to in subsection (1), and

heading: Penalty for exceeding cut control limits
paragraph: (b) the prescribed rate.

heading: Penalty for exceeding cut control limits
paragraph: (3) A penalty under this section is in addition to stumpage payable or another penalty under this Act or another enactment.

heading: Relief
paragraph:
75.92
		  The minister may grant to the holder of a licence full or partial relief from the penalty under section 75.2 or 75.91 in any of the following circumstances:

heading: Relief
paragraph: (a) timber is deemed, under section 119.2 (2), to be harvested under the licence during the cut control period to which the penalty relates;

heading: Relief
paragraph: (b) in the case of a timber sale licence that specifies an allowable annual cut, or in the case of a forest licence or woodlot licence, the allowable annual cut authorized for the licence is reduced under section 8, 9, 61, 63, 173, 185, 202 or 273 or Part 18;

heading: Relief
paragraph: (c) in the case of a tree farm licence, the allowable annual cut available to the holder of the licence is reduced under section 8, 9, 61, 63, 173, 185, 202 or 273 or Part 18.

heading: Suspension of rights
paragraph:
76
		  (0.1) In this section, "agreement" does not include a BC timber sales agreement.

heading: Suspension of rights
paragraph: (1) In addition to any penalty, charge or order under this Act or the Forest and Range Practices Act, the minister may suspend rights under an agreement if its holder

heading: Suspension of rights
paragraph: (a) made a material misrepresentation, omission or misstatement of fact in the application for the agreement or in information provided in the application,

heading: Suspension of rights
paragraph: (b) made a material misrepresentation, omission or misstatement of fact in an operational plan,

heading: Suspension of rights
paragraph: (c) did not perform an obligation to be performed under the agreement, other than an obligation described in section 14 (1) (g.1), 43.3 (1) (g.1), 43.55 (1) (h), 45 (1) (f.1) or 47.7 (g), or

heading: Suspension of rights
paragraph: (d) failed to comply with the requirements under this Act, the Forest and Range Practices Act, the Forest Practices Code of British Columbia Act or the Wildfire Act.

heading: Suspension of rights
paragraph: (1.1) In addition to any penalty, charge or order under this Act or the Forest and Range Practices Act, the minister may suspend rights under

heading: Suspension of rights
paragraph: (a) a forest licence if there is a contravention of the condition described in section 14 (1) (g.1),

heading: Suspension of rights
paragraph: (c) a community forest agreement if there is a contravention of the condition described in section 43.3 (1) (g.1),

heading: Suspension of rights
paragraph: (c.01) a first nations woodland licence if there is a contravention of the condition described in section 43.55 (1) (h),

heading: Suspension of rights
paragraph: (d) a woodlot licence if there is a contravention of the condition described in section 45 (1) (f.1), or

heading: Suspension of rights
paragraph: (e) a forestry licence to cut if there is a contravention of the condition described in section 47.7 (g).

heading: Suspension of rights
paragraph: (2) Without limiting subsection (1), the minister may suspend rights under a replaceable major licence or a replaceable woodlot licence if

heading: Suspension of rights
paragraph: (a) the holder is subject to a requirement under the Forest and Range Practices Act, in respect of a non-replaceable major licence or non-replaceable woodlot licence, to establish a free growing stand, and

heading: Suspension of rights
paragraph: (b) the holder has failed to comply with the requirement referred to in paragraph (a).

heading: Suspension of rights
paragraph: (2.1) If the minister is authorized under subsection (1), (1.1) or (2) to suspend rights under an agreement for which a cutting permit has been issued, the minister may suspend rights under the agreement, the cutting permit or both.

heading: Suspension of rights
paragraph: (2.2) If the minister is authorized under subsection (1) to suspend rights under an agreement that is a cutting permit, the minister may suspend rights under the cutting permit, the agreement for which the cutting permit was issued or both.

heading: Notice and duration of suspension
paragraph: 76.1		  (1) Before rights under an agreement are suspended under section 76, the minister must serve on the holder of the agreement a notice of suspension that specifies

heading: Notice and duration of suspension
paragraph: (a) the reason for the suspension, and

heading: Notice and duration of suspension
paragraph: (b) the date on which the suspension takes effect, which must be at least 5 days after the date of service of the notice.

heading: Notice and duration of suspension
paragraph: (2) If rights under an agreement held by a first nation or its representative are suspended under section 76 (1.1), the notice of suspension must include the particulars of the first nation's non-compliance with the agreement between the government and the first nation respecting treaty-related measures, interim measures or economic measures.

heading: Notice and duration of suspension
paragraph: (3) A suspension of rights takes effect on the date specified in the notice of suspension and continues until

heading: Notice and duration of suspension
paragraph: (a) the rights are reinstated by the minister, or

heading: Notice and duration of suspension
paragraph: (b) the agreement is cancelled under this Act.

heading: Notice and duration of suspension
paragraph: (4) The minister, on request of the holder of an agreement who has been served with a notice of suspension under this section, must allow the holder an opportunity to be heard and may, after hearing the holder, rescind the notice.

heading: Notice and duration of suspension
paragraph: (5) If rights under an agreement have been suspended under section 76 on the grounds that the holder

heading: Notice and duration of suspension
paragraph: (a) did not perform an obligation referred to in section 76 (1) (c),

heading: Notice and duration of suspension
paragraph: (b) failed to comply with a requirement referred to in section 76 (1) (d), or

heading: Notice and duration of suspension
paragraph: (c) contravened a condition referred to in section 76 (1.1),

heading: Notice and duration of suspension
paragraph: the minister must, on application by the holder, reinstate the suspended rights if the minister is satisfied that the holder is performing the obligation or complying with the requirement or condition, as applicable.

heading: Notice and duration of suspension
paragraph: (6) If rights under a cutting permit are reinstated under subsection (5), the period remaining on the term of the cutting permit, as at the date of the reinstatement and despite the terms and conditions of the cutting permit, is equal to the shorter of the following:

heading: Notice and duration of suspension
paragraph: (a) the period remaining on the term of the agreement for which the cutting permit was issued;

heading: Notice and duration of suspension
paragraph: (b) the period that remained on the term of the cutting permit on the date on which the suspension took effect.

heading: Cancellation
paragraph:
77
		  (1) If rights under an agreement are under suspension under section 76 (1) or (2), the minister may cancel the agreement.

heading: Cancellation
paragraph: (1.1) If rights under an agreement are under suspension under section 76 (1.1), the minister may cancel

heading: Cancellation
paragraph: (a) the agreement, and

heading: Cancellation
paragraph: (b) a road use permit issued to the holder of the agreement, if the road use permit is associated with the agreement.

heading: Cancellation
paragraph: (2) At least 3 months before cancelling an agreement or road use permit the minister must serve on its holder a written notice of cancellation specifying the grounds of cancellation and the day on which cancellation takes effect.

heading: Cancellation
paragraph: (3) If within 30 days after a notice of cancellation has been served the holder so requests, the minister must give the holder an opportunity to be heard.

heading: Cancellation
paragraph: (4) A notice of cancellation may be rescinded or the day on which a cancellation takes effect may be postponed.

heading: Cancellation
paragraph: (5) Notice of a cancellation must be published in the Gazette.

heading: Cancellation
paragraph: (6) If the minister cancels a road permit under subsection (1), the minister may specify the date by which a road authorized under the permit must be deactivated.

heading: BC timber sales - disqualification, suspension and cancellation
paragraph:
78
		  (1) By notice served on a person, the timber sales manager, in addition to any other action that may be taken under this Act, may do any or all of the following, if any of the criteria referred to in subsection (2) are met:

heading: BC timber sales - disqualification, suspension and cancellation
paragraph: (a) disqualify the person, indefinitely or for a specified period, from being registered as a BC timber sales enterprise;

heading: BC timber sales - disqualification, suspension and cancellation
paragraph: (d) cancel any BC timber sales agreements held by the person.

heading: BC timber sales - disqualification, suspension and cancellation
paragraph: (2) The timber sales manager may take an action under subsection (1) against a person if satisfied that the person

heading: BC timber sales - disqualification, suspension and cancellation
paragraph: (a) has made a material misrepresentation, omission or misstatement of fact in

heading: BC timber sales - disqualification, suspension and cancellation
paragraph: (i)  an application for registration as a BC timber sales enterprise under the regulations or in information furnished with the application, or

heading: BC timber sales - disqualification, suspension and cancellation
paragraph: (ii)  an application for a BC timber sales agreement or in information furnished with the application,

heading: BC timber sales - disqualification, suspension and cancellation
paragraph: (b) has not performed an obligation of the person under a BC timber sales agreement, or

heading: BC timber sales - disqualification, suspension and cancellation
paragraph: (c) has not complied with

heading: BC timber sales - disqualification, suspension and cancellation
paragraph: (i)  this Act or a regulation made under this Act,

paragraph: (ii)  the Forest and Range Practices Act or a regulation or standard made under that Act,

paragraph: (ii.1)  the Forest Practices Code of British Columbia Act or a regulation made under that Act, or

heading: BC timber sales - disqualification, suspension and cancellation

heading: BC timber sales - disqualification, suspension and cancellation

heading: BC timber sales - disqualification, suspension and cancellation

paragraph: (b) authorizing the timber sales manager to determine, on a case-by-case basis, within prescribed limits and according to prescribed criteria, the period of disqualification.

heading: BC timber sales - minister's powers of suspension and cancellation
paragraph: 78.1		  (1) By notice served on a BC timber sales enterprise, the minister, in addition to any other action that may be taken under this Act or the Forest and Range Practices Act, may suspend rights under any BC timber sales agreement held by the person, if the person

heading: BC timber sales - minister's powers of suspension and cancellation
paragraph: (a) has made a material misrepresentation, omission or misstatement of fact in an operational plan prepared by the person, or

paragraph: (i)  this Act or a regulation made under this Act, or

heading: Continuing liability
paragraph: 79		  (1) Despite the expiry, surrender or cancellation of a holder's agreement, or the suspension of rights under the agreement, the holder is liable to perform all of the following obligations, to the extent that the obligations were incurred before the expiry, surrender, cancellation or suspension:

heading: Continuing liability
paragraph: (a) obligations to pay the following:

heading: Continuing liability
paragraph: (i)  rent, fees, costs and penalties owing to the government in respect of the agreement;

heading: Continuing liability
paragraph: (ii)  any other money required under this Act to be paid to the government in respect of the agreement;

heading: Continuing liability
paragraph: (b) other obligations of the holder

heading: Continuing liability
paragraph: (i)  under the agreement, or

heading: Continuing liability
paragraph: (ii)  with respect to the agreement, under this Act, the Forest and Range Practices Act, the Forest Practices Code of British Columbia Act or the Wildfire Act.

heading: Continuing liability
paragraph: (1.1) Subject to subsection (1.2), for the purposes of performing obligations referred to in subsection (1) (b), the holder may enter onto Crown land.

heading: Continuing liability
paragraph: (1.2) Subject to the regulations under subsection (1.4), if any, the minister or timber sales manager may impose requirements he or she considers necessary or desirable to be met by the holder as conditions of entering onto the Crown land, including that the holder provide security.

heading: Continuing liability
paragraph: (1.3) The holder must comply with any requirements imposed under subsection (1.2).

heading: Continuing liability
paragraph: (1.4) For the purposes of subsection (1.2), the Lieutenant Governor in Council may make regulations

heading: Continuing liability
paragraph: (a) limiting the circumstances under which the minister or timber sales manager may exercise the discretion under subsection (1.2),

heading: Continuing liability
paragraph: (b) specifying the form and amount of the security, and

heading: Continuing liability
paragraph: (c) specifying the circumstances under which the security may be realized.

heading: Continuing liability
paragraph: (2) In this section,

heading: Continuing liability
paragraph: (a) references to an agreement are to be read as including references to a road permit or road use permit issued to the holder of the agreement, and

heading: Continuing liability
paragraph: (b) "holder" includes a former holder.

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: 79.1		  (1) In this section:

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: "agreement" means

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (a) a form of agreement referred to in section 12, or

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (b) a pulpwood agreement;

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: "residual fibre" means Crown timber in an area that is cut but not removed from the area.

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (2) The minister may order the holder of an agreement

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (a) to submit a report to the minister in the form and within the time period specified by the minister,

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (b) to include in the report referred to in paragraph (a) information specified by the minister related to an area specified by the minister, which may include, without limitation, the following information:

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (i)  an estimate, made in accordance with the regulations, of the volume of residual fibre in the area at the time of the report;

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (ii)  an estimate, made in accordance with the regulations, of the volume of residual fibre the holder of the agreement reasonably expects to be in the area at a time specified by the minister;

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (iii)  an estimate, made in accordance with the regulations, of the volume of residual fibre the holder of the agreement does not intend to use,

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (c) to submit updates of any information included in the report under paragraph (b), in the form and within the time period specified by the minister,

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (d) if the residual fibre is not being utilized or is not going to be utilized, not to damage some or all of the residual fibre for a period of time specified by the minister in an area specified by the minister, and

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (e) to handle the residual fibre as set out in the regulations.

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (3) The minister may amend or rescind an order made under subsection (2).

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (4) If an order is made under subsection (2) (d), the holder of the agreement may identify all or a portion of the residual fibre that is subject to the order and notify the minister that the holder of the agreement is willing to abandon the holder's rights to the identified residual fibre.

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (5) If the holder of the agreement gives notice to the minister under subsection (4), for a period of 60 days starting on the date notice is received by the minister,

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (a) the holder of the agreement may not deal with the residual fibre identified in the notice without the consent of the minister, and

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (b) the minister may

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (i)  by order, specify some or all of the residual fibre identified in the notice and deem, as abandoned, the rights of the holder of the agreement to the residual fibre specified in the order, and

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (ii)  issue to a person other than the holder of the agreement one or both of the following in respect of some or all of the residual fibre specified in the order made under subparagraph (i):

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (A) a fibre recovery permit referred to in section 47.72 (1) (c) if the person other than the holder of the agreement holds a fibre supply licence to cut under section 47.3 (1) or 47.71 that includes the area that is subject to the order made under subsection (2) (d) of this section;

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (B) a forestry licence to cut referred to in section 47.6 (2.11) that includes the area that is subject to the order made under subsection (2) (d) of this section.

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (6) Notice given under subsection (4) is deemed to be received by the minister as follows:

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (a) if given by mailing a copy by ordinary or registered mail, on the 5th day after the copy is mailed;

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (b) if given by sending a copy by electronic mail, on the 3rd day after the copy is sent;

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (c) if given by leaving a copy at a district office, on the 3rd day after the copy is left;

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (d) if given by delivering by hand a copy to a district manager, on delivery of the copy.

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (7) On the date the minister makes an order under subsection (5) (b) (i) deeming the rights of a holder of an agreement to be abandoned with respect to the residual fibre specified in the order, all rights of the holder of the agreement to that residual fibre are cancelled.

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (8) As soon as practicable after the date the minister makes an order under subsection (5) (b) (i), the minister must give to the holder of the agreement

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (a) a copy of the order, and

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (b) written notice stating that the rights of the holder of the agreement respecting the residual fibre specified in the order are cancelled.

heading: Residual fibre orders
paragraph: (9) As soon as practicable after the date the minister issues a permit or licence under subsection (5) (b) (ii), the minister must give to the holder of the agreement written notice that the permit or licence has been issued.

heading: When compensation is not payable
paragraph:
80
		  (1) In this section, "compensation" includes damages.

heading: When compensation is not payable
paragraph: (2) No compensation is payable by the government and proceedings must not be commenced or continued to claim compensation from the government or to obtain a declaration that compensation is payable by the government in respect of an expiry, failure to extend, reduction, refusal, deletion or deeming, or a reduction in an allowable annual cut as a result of a determination or a deeming, under any of:

heading: When compensation is not payable
paragraph: (a) the following provisions of this Act: sections 8 (1), (2) and (10); 9 (3) and (4); 27 (a); 63, 63.2, 68 to 70 and 72 to 74;

heading: When compensation is not payable
paragraph: (c) the following provisions of the Forest Act, R.S.B.C. 1979, c. 140: sections 15 (1); 19 (b) and (c); 33 (1) and (5); 37 (1); 39 (1);

heading: When compensation is not payable
paragraph: (3) No compensation is payable by the government and proceedings must not be commenced or continued to claim compensation from the government or to obtain a declaration that compensation is payable by the government in respect of the effect, under section 75.02, 75.1 or 75.11, on a licence as defined in a provision of Division 3.1 of Part 4.

heading: When compensation is not payable
paragraph: (4) No compensation is payable by the government and proceedings must not be commenced or continued to claim compensation from the government or to obtain a declaration that compensation is payable by the government as a result of a cancellation of rights under section 79.1 (7).

heading: When compensation is not payable
paragraph: (5) No compensation is payable by the government and proceedings must not be commenced or continued to claim compensation from the government or to obtain a declaration that compensation is payable by the government in respect of the following:

heading: When compensation is not payable
paragraph: (a) a decision of the minister under Part 3.1 to

heading: When compensation is not payable
paragraph: (i)  refuse to issue a cutting permit, or

heading: When compensation is not payable
paragraph: (ii)  include a term or condition in a cutting permit;

heading: When compensation is not payable
paragraph: (b) a decision of the minister under Part 8 to

heading: When compensation is not payable
paragraph: (i)  refuse to issue a road permit, or

heading: When compensation is not payable
paragraph: (ii)  include a term or condition in a road permit.

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph:
80.2
		  (1) In this section:

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: "Acts" means this Act, the Forest and Range Practices Act and the Forest Practices Code of British Columbia Act, and includes the regulations under each of them;

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: "group licence interim period", in relation to a licence in a group of licences which licence is specified in a minister's order, means,

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: (a) if there is only one reduction in allowable annual cut for that licence under the minister's order, the period beginning on March 31, 2003 and ending on

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: (i)  the date when the minister's order is made for the licence, if no subsequent date is specified in the minister's order in relation to that reduction and for the purposes of section 3 (5.1) of the Forestry Revitalization Act, or

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: (ii)  the subsequent date, if one is specified in the minister's order, in relation to that reduction and for the purposes of section 3 (5.1) of the Forestry Revitalization Act, or

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: (b) if there are a series of reductions in allowable annual cut for that licence under the minister's order,

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: (i)  for the first in the series of reductions, the period beginning on March 31, 2003 and ending on

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: (A) the date when the minister's order is made for that first reduction, if no subsequent date is specified in the minister's order, in relation to that first reduction and for the purposes of section 3 (5.1) of the Forestry Revitalization Act, or

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: (B) the subsequent date, if one is specified in the minister's order, in relation to that first reduction and for the purposes of section 3 (5.1) of the Forestry Revitalization Act, and

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: (ii)  for the further reduction in the series of reductions, the period beginning at the end of the period for the immediately preceding reduction and ending on

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: (A) the date when the minister's order is made for that further reduction, if no subsequent date is specified in the minister's order, in relation to that further reduction and for the purposes of section 3 (5.1) of the Forestry Revitalization Act, or

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: (B) the subsequent date, if one is specified in the minister's order, in relation to that further reduction and for the purposes of section 3 (5.1) of the Forestry Revitalization Act;

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: "minister's order" means an order made under section 3 of the Forestry Revitalization Act;

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: "timber licence interim period", in relation to a timber licence specified in a minister's order, means

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: (a) if there is only one reduction in area for that licence under the minister's order, the period beginning on March 31, 2003 and ending on

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: (i)  the date when the minister's order is made for the licence, if no subsequent date is specified in the minister's order in relation to that reduction and for the purposes of section 3 (5.1) of the Forestry Revitalization Act, or

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: (ii)  the subsequent date, if one is specified in the minister's order, in relation to that reduction and for the purposes of section 3 (5.1) of the Forestry Revitalization Act, or

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: (b) if there are a series of reductions in area for that licence under the minister's order,

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: (i)  for the first in the series of reductions, the period beginning on March 31, 2003 and ending on

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: (A) the date when the minister's order is made for that first reduction, if no subsequent date is specified in the minister's order, in relation to that first reduction and for the purposes of section 3 (5.1) of the Forestry Revitalization Act, or

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: (B) the subsequent date, if one is specified in the minister's order, in relation to that first reduction and for the purposes of section 3 (5.1) of the Forestry Revitalization Act, and

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: (ii)  for a further reduction in the series of reductions, the period beginning at the end of the period for the immediately preceding reduction and ending on

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: (A) the date when the minister's order is made for that further reduction, if no subsequent date is specified in the minister's order, in relation to that further reduction and for the purposes of section 3 (5.1) of the Forestry Revitalization Act, or

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: (B) the subsequent date, if one is specified in the minister's order, in relation to that further reduction and for the purposes of section 3 (5.1) of the Forestry Revitalization Act.

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: (2) In this section words and expressions have the same meanings as they have in section 1 of the Forestry Revitalization Act.

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: (3) A determination of whether or not the holder of a licence in a group of licences has complied with the Acts, in relation to timber harvesting under the licence, during a group licence interim period must be made

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: (a) if there is only one reduction in allowable annual cut for that licence under a minister's order, without regard to the order, or

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: (b) if there are a series of reductions in allowable annual cut for that licence under a minister's order, without regard to the order, except as it pertains to the allowable annual cut remaining under the licence after each of the group licence interim periods, in turn, under the order.

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: (4) A determination of whether or not the holder of a timber licence specified in a minister's order has complied with the Acts, in relation to timber harvesting under the licence, during a timber licence interim period must be made

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: (a) if there is only one reduction in area for that licence under a minister's order, without regard to the order, or

heading: Forestry Revitalization Act
paragraph: (b) if there are a series of reductions in area for that licence under a minister's order, without regard to the order, except as it pertains to the area of Crown land remaining under the licence after each of the interim periods, in turn, under the order.

heading: Grounds for refusing to issue authorization
paragraph: 81		  (1) In this section:

heading: Grounds for refusing to issue authorization
paragraph: "Acts" means this Act, the Forest and Range Practices Act, the Forest Practices Code of British Columbia Act and the Wildfire Act;

heading: Grounds for refusing to issue authorization
paragraph: "applicant" means a person, first nation or other entity who seeks a specified authorization;

heading: Grounds for refusing to issue authorization
paragraph: "refuse to issue", in relation to a specified authorization, includes the following:
