heading: What is the effect of specifying a designated area?
paragraph: (5) If a person who, under this Act, the Forest and Range Practices Act or the Forest Practices Code of British Columbia Act, has a discretion to issue a permit, licence or plan, in this subsection called the "issuing authority",

heading: What is the effect of specifying a designated area?
paragraph: (a) receives an application for the permit or licence or receives a plan submitted for approval, whether before, on or after the date of an order of the minister making a direction referred to in subsection (2) (b), and

heading: What is the effect of specifying a designated area?
paragraph: (b) by reason only of the direction,

heading: What is the effect of specifying a designated area?
paragraph: (i)  does not issue the permit, licence or plan, or

heading: What is the effect of specifying a designated area?
paragraph: (ii)  in whole or in part, issues the permit, licence or plan as permitted under subsection (2) (b) (ii),

heading: What is the effect of specifying a designated area?
paragraph: then, subject to subsection (6), after the Crown land to which the direction pertains ceases to be a designated area, or after an earlier date, if any, ordered in writing by the minister, the issuing authority must issue the permit, licence or plan, or, in the case of one previously issued as authorized under subsection (2) (b) (ii), must amend the permit, licence or plan to give effect as nearly as practicable to the original application or submission.

heading: What is the effect of specifying a designated area?
paragraph: (6) The requirement in subsection (5) that a permit, licence or plan be issued, or amended to give effect as nearly as practicable to the original application or submission, is subject to the issuing authority

heading: What is the effect of specifying a designated area?
paragraph: (a) continuing to have the discretion to carry out that requirement, and

heading: What is the effect of specifying a designated area?
paragraph: (b) receiving confirmation from the applicant or from the person that submitted the plan that the applicant or person wishes to proceed.

heading: What is the effect of specifying a designated area?
paragraph: (7) In issuing or amending a permit, licence or plan under subsection (5) the person who has the discretion may include terms and conditions that the person with the discretion considers necessary or desirable in the circumstances.

heading: What is the effect of specifying a designated area?
paragraph: (8) The minister, by written order, may vary a variance, suspension or direction made under subsection (2).

heading: What is the effect of specifying a designated area?
paragraph: (9) The minister must serve a copy of an order made under subsection (2), (4), (5) or (8) on the holder of

heading: What is the effect of specifying a designated area?
paragraph: (a) an agreement, and

heading: What is the effect of specifying a designated area?
paragraph: (b) a special use permit

heading: What is the effect of specifying a designated area?
paragraph: to which the order relates, but the order is not invalid only because it is not served.

heading: What is the effect of specifying a designated area?
paragraph: (10) A suspension referred to in this section is not a suspension for the purposes of sections 13.1 (4.1) (c) (i), 15 (2) (a), 36 (2) (a), 46 (2) (a), 52.10 (2) (b), 58.1 (3) (b) and 81 (2) (c) (i) and (3) (c).

heading: Conditions
paragraph: 171		  (1) The minister, by written order, may attach conditions to an agreement or to a special use permit if the agreement or special use permit relates to all or part of a designated area.

heading: Conditions
paragraph: (2) A condition under subsection (1) expires when the Crown land it relates to ceases to be a designated area or on an earlier expiry date, if any, ordered in writing by the minister.

heading: Conditions
paragraph: (3) The minister, by written order, may vary a condition made under this section.

heading: Conditions
paragraph: (4) The minister must serve a copy of an order made under this section on the holder of the agreement or special use permit affected by the order, but the order is not invalid only because it is not served.

heading: Suspension and cancellation
paragraph:
172
		  (1) If a permit, licence or plan is varied under section 170, the failure of the holder of, or party to, the permit, licence or plan to comply with the variance is grounds for a suspension under section 76 of rights under the agreement to which the permit, licence or plan relates.

heading: Suspension and cancellation
paragraph: (2) If under section 171 a condition is attached to an agreement, the failure of the holder of the agreement to comply with the condition is grounds for a suspension under section 76 of rights under the agreement.

heading: Suspension and cancellation
paragraph: (3) If a special use permit is varied under section 170 or has a condition attached to it under section 171,

heading: Suspension and cancellation
paragraph: (a) the failure of the holder of the permit to comply with the variance or condition is grounds for

heading: Suspension and cancellation
paragraph: (i)  suspending rights under the permit, or

heading: Suspension and cancellation
paragraph: (ii)  cancelling the permit, and

heading: Suspension and cancellation
paragraph: (b) sections 76, 76.1 and 77, other than section 77 (5), apply to the suspension or cancellation.

heading: Allowable annual cut and allowable harvest in a designated area
paragraph: (2) The chief forester, by written order, may reduce the allowable annual cut of

heading: Allowable annual cut and allowable harvest in a designated area
paragraph: (a) a timber supply area, or

heading: Allowable annual cut and allowable harvest in a designated area
paragraph: (b) a tree farm licence area,

heading: Allowable annual cut and allowable harvest in a designated area
paragraph: if all or part of the area is a designated area.

heading: Allowable annual cut and allowable harvest in a designated area
paragraph: (2.1) An allowable annual cut reduction under subsection (2)

heading: Allowable annual cut and allowable harvest in a designated area
paragraph: (a) for the designated area to which it relates, may be made effective on or after the date the designated area is specified under section 169 (1), and

heading: Allowable annual cut and allowable harvest in a designated area
paragraph: (b) may specify that portions of the reduction are attributable to different types of timber and terrain in different parts of Crown land within the designated area.

heading: Allowable annual cut and allowable harvest in a designated area
paragraph: (3) If the allowable annual cut of a timber supply area is reduced under subsection (2), the minister may distribute all or part of the reduction among the forest licences in the timber supply area in accordance with section 63 (2) and, for this purpose, section 63 (4) applies.

heading: Allowable annual cut and allowable harvest in a designated area
paragraph: (3.1) An allowable annual cut reduction under subsection (3) may be made effective on or after the date on which the chief forester's order to which it relates is made or is made effective.

heading: Allowable annual cut and allowable harvest in a designated area
paragraph: (6) The minister, by written order, may reduce the allowable annual cut authorized for a community forest agreement area, first nations woodland licence area or woodlot licence area if all or part of the area is a designated area.

heading: Allowable annual cut and allowable harvest in a designated area
paragraph: (6.1) An allowable annual cut reduction under subsection (6), for the designated area to which it relates, may be made effective on or after the date the designated area is specified under section 169 (1).

heading: Allowable annual cut and allowable harvest in a designated area
paragraph: (7) If the chief forester or minister makes an order under subsection (2), (3) or (6) that affects a timber supply area, a forest licence or the licence area of an area-based licence and, after the order is made, a determination or reduction is made under section 8 or 63 that establishes a new allowable annual cut for the timber supply area, forest licence or licence area of the area-based licence, the chief forester or minister, as the case may be, may issue a new order under subsection (2), (3) or (6) that affects the area or licence.

heading: Allowable annual cut and allowable harvest in a designated area
paragraph: (8) The chief forester or minister, as the case may be, must serve a copy of an order made under this section on the holder of an agreement to which the order relates, but the order is not invalid only because it is not served.

heading: Allowable annual cut and allowable harvest in a designated area
paragraph: (9) An order under subsection (2), (3), (6) or  (7) expires when the Crown land it relates to ceases to be a designated area.

heading: Allowable annual cut and allowable harvest in a designated area
paragraph: (10) After an order expires under subsection (9), the allowable annual cut for the timber supply area, forest licence or licence area of the area-based licence that was affected by the order is the allowable annual cut that was in effect immediately before the last order made under this section less any reductions made under this Act or the licence, other than reductions made under this section, during the period that the order was in effect.

heading: Effect of reduction on annual allowable cut determination
paragraph:
173.1
		  (1) Neither a reduction in allowable annual cut under section 173 (2), nor a restoration of an allowable annual cut under section 173 (10), constitutes a determination of an allowable annual cut for the purposes of the time limits set out in section 8 (1) and (2).

heading: Effect of reduction on annual allowable cut determination
paragraph:
(2) 
            Section 8 does not apply to a reduction of an allowable annual cut under section 173.

heading: Effect of reduction on annual allowable cut determination
paragraph: (3) If an allowable annual cut of a timber supply area or tree farm licence area is reduced under section 173, the chief forester is not required to make an allowable annual cut determination under section 8 (1) in respect of those areas at the times set out in section 8 (1) or (2) (c) or (d), but must make that determination within 2 years after the designated area to which the reduction applies ceases to be a designated area.

heading: Order prevails
paragraph:
174
		  If an order made in accordance with this Part conflicts or is inconsistent with

heading: Order prevails
paragraph: (a) this Act, the Forest and Range Practices Act, the Forest Practices Code of British Columbia Act, the Wildfire Act or any regulations or standards made under those Acts,

heading: Order prevails
paragraph: (b) an agreement, or

heading: Order prevails
paragraph: (c) a permit, licence or plan listed in section 170 (3),

heading: Order prevails
paragraph: the order prevails.

heading: Hearing not required
paragraph: 175		  An order may be made under this Part without a hearing.

heading: No compensation during first 4 years of designation
paragraph:
175.1
		  During and in respect of the first 4-year period in which Crown land continues as a designated area, no compensation or damages is payable by the government to the holder of any agreement because of or arising out of the designated land status of all or any part of the Crown land to which the agreement relates.

heading: Compensation for fifth and subsequent years of designation
paragraph:
175.2
		  (1) In this section:

heading: Compensation for fifth and subsequent years of designation
paragraph: "agreement" does not include a cutting permit;

heading: Compensation for fifth and subsequent years of designation
paragraph: "compensable period", in relation to Crown land that is specified as a designated area, means the period that

heading: Compensation for fifth and subsequent years of designation
paragraph: (a) starts 4 years after the date the Crown land becomes a designated area, and

heading: Compensation for fifth and subsequent years of designation
paragraph: (b) ends when the Crown land ceases to be a designated area;

heading: Compensation for fifth and subsequent years of designation
paragraph: "established practices" has the same meaning as in section 226;

heading: Compensation for fifth and subsequent years of designation
paragraph: "net income" has the same meaning as in section 226.

heading: Compensation for fifth and subsequent years of designation
paragraph: (2) The holder of an agreement is entitled to compensation if

heading: Compensation for fifth and subsequent years of designation
paragraph: (a) an area of Crown land that is specified as a designated area continues as a designated area for more than 4 years, and

heading: Compensation for fifth and subsequent years of designation
paragraph: (b) the allowable annual cut of the agreement is reduced under section 173.

heading: Compensation for fifth and subsequent years of designation
paragraph: (3) Subject to the adjustments under subsection (4), the compensation to which the holder of an agreement is entitled under this section is an amount determined by the minister based on the net income that would have been earned on the sale of harvested timber if, during each year of the compensable period,

heading: Compensation for fifth and subsequent years of designation
paragraph: (a) the volume of the harvested timber had been equal to the amount by which the allowable annual cut of the agreement is reduced under section 173,

heading: Compensation for fifth and subsequent years of designation
paragraph: (b) the timber had been harvested from the harvest profile that supports the allowable annual cut of the agreement, as specified by the chief forester for the purposes of this section, and

heading: Compensation for fifth and subsequent years of designation
paragraph: (c) the timber had been harvested and sold in accordance with established practices.

heading: Compensation for fifth and subsequent years of designation
paragraph: (4) After determining the net income amount under subsection (3), the minister must

heading: Compensation for fifth and subsequent years of designation
paragraph: (a) adjust the compensation, in accordance with the regulations, to reflect the amount of income tax that would be payable, and

heading: Compensation for fifth and subsequent years of designation
paragraph: (b) make other adjustments that may be required by regulation.

heading: Set-off for benefits previously received
paragraph:
175.3
		  The amount of compensation payable under section 175.2 to the holder of an agreement affected by the specification of a designated area must be reduced by any financial benefit or other benefit received by that holder from the government arising out of the specification.

heading: Limit on compensation
paragraph:
175.4
		  (1) In this section, "compensation" includes damages.

heading: Limit on compensation
paragraph: (2) The compensation payable to the holder of an agreement because of or arising out of

heading: Limit on compensation
paragraph: (a) the specification of a designated area,

heading: Limit on compensation
paragraph: (b) an order made under this Part, or

heading: Limit on compensation
paragraph: (c) either of the things specified in paragraphs (a) or (b) in combination with the other

heading: Limit on compensation
paragraph: is limited to the amount of compensation determined in relation to that agreement under sections 175.2 and 175.3.

heading: Limit on compensation
paragraph: (3) No action lies and an action or other proceeding must not be brought or continued against the government for compensation in an amount that exceeds the amount limited under this section.

heading: Award of licences
paragraph:
178
		  (1) In this section, "contractor" and "subcontractor" have the same meaning as in section 152.

heading: Award of licences
paragraph: (2) If, as a result of the Nisga'a Final Agreement, the holder of an agreement or a contractor or subcontractor loses the right to harvest Crown timber, the regional manager may enter into a forest licence or forestry licence to cut, or the district manager may enter into a forestry licence to cut, with the agreement holder, contractor or subcontractor without advertising or accepting applications from other persons.

heading: Award of licences
paragraph: (3) The volume of timber authorized by the forest licence or forestry licence to cut referred to in subsection (2) must not exceed the volume of timber that would compensate the agreement holder, contractor or subcontractor for the loss of the right to harvest timber as result of the Nisga'a Final Agreement.

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph:
180
		  In this Part:

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: "access purpose" means the use of Crown land for any of the following:

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: (a) access to Crown timber;

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: (b) a right of way for a highway, pipeline or power transmission;

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: (c) access to water storage;

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: "ancillary road structure" means any of the following structures, whether moveable or non-moveable, located on Crown land:

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: (a) a bridge, culvert or gate;

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: (b) livestock fencing;

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: (c) a prescribed structure;

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: "authorized official", in relation to an agreement, licence or permit referred to in this Part, means a person who has authority under this Act or the Forest Practices Code of British Columbia Act to enter into, issue or amend the agreement, licence or permit;

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: "construct" includes reconstruct, reactivate, upgrade or replace;

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: "information" includes a record;

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: "non-TFL timber licence" means a timber licence that has a licence area that is not in the licence area of a tree farm licence;

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: "non-timber production purpose" means the use of Crown land for a purpose other than the following:

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: (a) a timber production purpose;

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: (b) an access purpose;

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: (c) a purpose referred to in section 182 [designation for first nation purpose, BCTS licence purpose or community forest agreement purpose];

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: "profile of timber", in relation to a licence area or timber supply area, means the composition of timber in the area, having regard to the following factors:

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: (a) the types of timber in the area;

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: (b) the types of terrain in the area;

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: (c) other factors that the chief forester considers relevant;

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: "road" means a road or a portion of a road;

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: "timber production improvement" means an improvement that is for a timber production purpose but does not include the following:

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: (a) a road or ancillary road structure;

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: (b) a prescribed improvement;

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: "timber production purpose" means the use of land for purposes ancillary to timber production, including the use of land for the following:

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: (a) a logging camp;

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: (b) a log dump or dry land sort;

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: (c) a temporary timber processing site;

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: (d) an airstrip, helipad or other landing site for aircraft used for timber harvesting or transporting timber;

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: (e) a facility ancillary to timber production;

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: (f) a prescribed purpose;

heading: Definitions for Part 15
paragraph: "volume-based portion", in relation to a timber supply area, means the portion of the timber supply area for which the chief forester is required to make an allowable annual cut determination under section 8 (1) (a) [allowable annual cut].

heading: Designation for access purpose or non-timber production purpose
paragraph: 181		  The Lieutenant Governor in Council may, by regulation, designate an area of Crown land as a special purpose area so that the Crown land may be used for one of the following purposes:

heading: Designation for access purpose or non-timber production purpose
paragraph: (a) an access purpose;

heading: Designation for access purpose or non-timber production purpose
paragraph: (b) a non-timber production purpose.

heading: Designation for first nation purpose, BCTS licence purpose or community forest agreement purpose
paragraph:
182
		  (1) The Lieutenant Governor in Council may, by regulation, designate an area of Crown land as a special purpose area so that Crown land or timber may be used for any one or more of the purposes referred to in this section.

heading: Designation for first nation purpose, BCTS licence purpose or community forest agreement purpose
paragraph: (2) An area of Crown land may be designated as a special purpose area for any of the following first nation purposes:

heading: Designation for first nation purpose, BCTS licence purpose or community forest agreement purpose
paragraph: (a) disposing of a fee simple interest in Crown land to a first nation to implement or further an agreement between the first nation and the government respecting treaty-related measures, interim measures or economic measures;

heading: Designation for first nation purpose, BCTS licence purpose or community forest agreement purpose
paragraph: (b) entering into one or more of the following with a first nation or its representative:

heading: Designation for first nation purpose, BCTS licence purpose or community forest agreement purpose
paragraph: (i)  a community forest agreement under section 43.51 (1) (a) [direct award of community forest agreements];

heading: Designation for first nation purpose, BCTS licence purpose or community forest agreement purpose
paragraph: (ii)  a first nations woodland licence;

heading: Designation for first nation purpose, BCTS licence purpose or community forest agreement purpose
paragraph: (iii)  a woodlot licence under section 47.3 (1) (a) [direct award of specified licences];

heading: Designation for first nation purpose, BCTS licence purpose or community forest agreement purpose
paragraph: (iv)  a forest licence under section 47.3 (1) (a);

heading: Designation for first nation purpose, BCTS licence purpose or community forest agreement purpose
paragraph: (c) increasing the licence area or allowable annual cut of one or more agreements or licences referred to in paragraph (b).

heading: Designation for first nation purpose, BCTS licence purpose or community forest agreement purpose
paragraph: (3) An area of Crown land may be designated as a special purpose area for the purposes of entering into one or more BCTS licences.

heading: Designation for first nation purpose, BCTS licence purpose or community forest agreement purpose
paragraph: (4) An area of Crown land may be designated as a special purpose area for either of the following purposes:

heading: Designation for first nation purpose, BCTS licence purpose or community forest agreement purpose
paragraph: (a) entering into one or more community forest agreements under

heading: Designation for first nation purpose, BCTS licence purpose or community forest agreement purpose
paragraph: (i)  section 43.2 [applications for community forest agreements], or

heading: Designation for first nation purpose, BCTS licence purpose or community forest agreement purpose
paragraph: (ii)  section 43.51 (1) (b);

heading: Designation for first nation purpose, BCTS licence purpose or community forest agreement purpose
paragraph: (b) increasing the licence area or allowable annual cut of one or more community forest agreements referred to in paragraph (a) of this subsection.

heading: Purpose and cancellation date of designation
paragraph:
183
		  (1) A regulation that designates an area of Crown land as a special purpose area must specify the following:

heading: Purpose and cancellation date of designation
paragraph: (a) the purpose or purposes of the special purpose area;

heading: Purpose and cancellation date of designation
paragraph: (b) the date the designation is cancelled.

heading: Purpose and cancellation date of designation
paragraph: (2) Subject to section 184, the date specified under subsection (1) (b) must not be more than 3 years after the effective date of the designation, but the designation may be cancelled before that specified date.

heading: Limits on power to extend designation
paragraph:
184
		  (1) In this section, "original cancellation date", in relation to the designation of an area as a special purpose area, means the cancellation date of the designation as at the effective date of the designation.

heading: Limits on power to extend designation
paragraph: (2) The Lieutenant Governor in Council's power to amend the original cancellation date by specifying a later cancellation date for the designation of an area as a special purpose area is restricted as follows:

heading: Limits on power to extend designation
paragraph: (a) the amendment may be made only once;

heading: Limits on power to extend designation
paragraph: (b) the amendment may not be made earlier than one year before the original cancellation date;

heading: Limits on power to extend designation
paragraph: (c) the later cancellation date may not be more than 3 years after the original cancellation date.

heading: Impacts on harvest profile and AAC of area-based licence
paragraph:
185
		  (1) If an area designated as a special purpose area overlaps the licence area of an area-based licence, the chief forester must do all of the following:

heading: Impacts on harvest profile and AAC of area-based licence
paragraph: (a) specify the harvest profile for the licence area by identifying the components of the profile of timber that the chief forester considers could be harvested to support the allowable annual cut for the licence area as at the effective date of the designation;

heading: Impacts on harvest profile and AAC of area-based licence
paragraph: (b) determine the amount by which the allowable annual cut for the licence area will be reduced, if at all, when Crown land is deleted from the licence area under

heading: Impacts on harvest profile and AAC of area-based licence
paragraph: (i)  section 189 [deletion of licence area from area-based licence or timber licence],

heading: Impacts on harvest profile and AAC of area-based licence
paragraph: (ii)  section 190 [order for early deletion of licence area], or

heading: Impacts on harvest profile and AAC of area-based licence
paragraph: (iii)  section 191 [order to extend deletion if special purpose area overlaps cutting permit area];

heading: Impacts on harvest profile and AAC of area-based licence
paragraph: (c) if a reduction is determined under paragraph (b), specify the adjusted allowable annual cut that results from that reduction;

heading: Impacts on harvest profile and AAC of area-based licence
paragraph: (d) specify the new harvest profile for the licence area by identifying the components of the profile of timber that the chief forester considers could be harvested to support the allowable annual cut for the licence area after the effective date of the reduction and deletion referred to in paragraph (b);

heading: Impacts on harvest profile and AAC of area-based licence
paragraph: (e) specify the harvest profile that will be impacted, if at all, as a result of the reduction and deletion referred to in paragraph (b) by identifying the differences between the harvest profile specified under paragraph (a) and the new harvest profile specified under paragraph (d).

heading: Impacts on harvest profile and AAC of area-based licence
paragraph: (2) The matters set out in subsection (1) must be specified and determined within 4 months after the effective date of the designation referred to in that subsection or, if an extension is granted under section 187 (4) [request for information by chief forester], within 5 months after that effective date.

heading: Impacts on harvest profile and AAC of area-based licence
paragraph: (3) For certainty, if the licence area of a timber licence is in the licence area of a tree farm licence, the tree farm licence area includes, for the purposes of specifying and determining the matters set out in subsection (1), the licence area of the timber licence.

heading: Impacts on non-TFL timber licence
paragraph:
186
		  (1) If an area designated as a special purpose area overlaps the licence area of a non-TFL timber licence, the chief forester must do all of the following:

heading: Impacts on non-TFL timber licence
paragraph: (a) specify the harvest profile for the area of overlap by identifying the components of the profile of timber that the chief forester considers could be harvested in that area of overlap as at the effective date of the designation;

heading: Impacts on non-TFL timber licence
paragraph: (b) determine the number of hectares in the area of overlap;

heading: Impacts on non-TFL timber licence
paragraph: (c) determine the average volume of timber, per hectare, that the chief forester considers could be harvested from the harvest profile in the area of overlap were the area of overlap not subject to deletion under

heading: Impacts on non-TFL timber licence
paragraph: (i)  section 189 [deletion of licence area from area-based licence or timber licence],

heading: Impacts on non-TFL timber licence
paragraph: (ii)  section 190 [order for early deletion of licence area], or

heading: Impacts on non-TFL timber licence
paragraph: (iii)  section 191 [order to extend deletion if special purpose area overlaps cutting permit area].

heading: Impacts on non-TFL timber licence
paragraph: (2) If the cutting permit area of a cutting permit issued for the non-TFL timber licence is in the area of overlap referred to in subsection (1), the chief forester must exclude that cutting permit area from that area of overlap for the purposes of specifying and determining the matters set out in that subsection.

heading: Impacts on non-TFL timber licence
paragraph: (3) The matters set out in subsection (1) must be specified and determined within 4 months after the effective date of the designation referred to in that subsection or, if an extension is granted under section 187 (4) [request for information by chief forester], within 5 months after that effective date.

heading: Request for information by chief forester
paragraph:
187
		  (1) For the purposes of specifying and determining the matters set out in section 185 (1) [impacts on harvest profile and AAC of area-based licence], the chief forester may, by written request served on the holder of an area-based licence, require the holder to provide the following information:

heading: Request for information by chief forester
paragraph: (a) the approved management plan for the licence;

heading: Request for information by chief forester
paragraph: (b) information used or obtained in preparing the approved management plan for the licence;

heading: Request for information by chief forester
paragraph: (c) information used or included in the holder's inventory of a forest resource, as prepared and maintained under Part 6.1 [Forest Resource Inventories];

heading: Request for information by chief forester
paragraph: (d) other information that the chief forester may specify.

heading: Request for information by chief forester
paragraph: (2) For the purposes of specifying and determining the matters set out in section 186 (1) [impacts on non-TFL timber licence], the chief forester may, by written request served on the holder of a non-TFL timber licence, require the holder to provide the information specified in the request.

heading: Request for information by chief forester
paragraph: (3) Information requested under subsection (1) or (2) must be provided in the form and manner and within the time period specified by the chief forester.

heading: Request for information by chief forester
paragraph: (4) The chief forester may grant an exemption, or an extension of not more than 30 days, to the holder of an area-based licence or non-TFL timber licence if the chief forester is satisfied that

heading: Request for information by chief forester
paragraph: (a) some or all of the information requested from the holder is not available to the holder, or

heading: Request for information by chief forester
paragraph: (b) the holder cannot reasonably provide or obtain the requested information within the time period specified in the request.

heading: Request for information by chief forester
paragraph: (5) The chief forester must specify and determine the matters set out in sections 185 (1) and 186 (1) in respect of an area-based licence or non-TFL timber licence regardless of whether the holder of the licence complies with a request for information under this section.

heading: Notice to holder of area-based licence or non-TFL timber licence
paragraph:
188
		  As soon as practicable after the matters set out in section 185 (1) [impacts on harvest profile and AAC of area-based licence] or 186 (1) [impacts on non-TFL timber licence] are specified and determined in relation to the licence area of an area-based licence or non-TFL timber licence, the minister must serve notice of those matters on the holder of the licence.

heading: Deletion of licence area from area-based licence or timber licence
paragraph:
189
		  Subject to an order under section 190 [order for early deletion of licence area] or 191 [order to extend deletion if special purpose area overlaps cutting permit area], if an area designated as a special purpose area overlaps the licence area of an area-based licence or timber licence, the Crown land in the area of overlap is deleted from the licence area on the date that is one year after the effective date of the designation.

heading: Order for early deletion of licence area
paragraph:
190
		  (1) If an area designated as a special purpose area overlaps the licence area of an area-based licence or timber licence, the minister may, by order, specify a deletion date that is earlier than one year after, but not earlier than 2 months after, the effective date of the designation.

heading: Order for early deletion of licence area
paragraph: (2) By no later than 2 months before the effective date of an order under subsection (1), the minister must serve notice of the order on the holder of the licence to which the order relates.

heading: Order for early deletion of licence area
paragraph: (3) If a deletion date is specified by an order under subsection (1), the Crown land is deleted from the licence area of the area-based licence or timber licence on the date specified in the order.

heading: Order to extend deletion if special purpose area overlaps cutting permit area
paragraph:
191
		  (1) The minister may, by order, specify a deletion date that is later than the deletion date under section 189 [deletion of licence area from area-based licence or timber licence] if the following requirements are met in relation to a cutting permit issued for an area-based licence or timber licence:

heading: Order to extend deletion if special purpose area overlaps cutting permit area
paragraph: (a) an area designated as a special purpose area overlaps the cutting permit area;

heading: Order to extend deletion if special purpose area overlaps cutting permit area
paragraph: (b) timber harvesting in the area of overlap has not been completed;

heading: Order to extend deletion if special purpose area overlaps cutting permit area
paragraph: (c) the cutting permit was issued before the effective date of the designation;

heading: Order to extend deletion if special purpose area overlaps cutting permit area
paragraph: (d) the minister considers that the exercise of harvesting rights in the area of overlap will not significantly interfere with the purpose or purposes of the special purpose area.

heading: Order to extend deletion if special purpose area overlaps cutting permit area
paragraph: (2) An order under subsection (1) must not specify a deletion date that is later than the expiry date of the cutting permit referred to in that subsection.

heading: Order to extend deletion if special purpose area overlaps cutting permit area
paragraph: (3) If a deletion date is specified by an order under subsection (1), the Crown land is deleted from the licence area of the area-based licence or timber licence on the date specified in the order.

heading: Cancellation of area-based licence or timber licence if entire licence area deleted
paragraph:
192
		  The minister may cancel an area-based licence or timber licence if the entire licence area of the licence is deleted under

heading: Cancellation of area-based licence or timber licence if entire licence area deleted
paragraph: (a) section 189 [deletion of licence area from area-based licence or timber licence],

heading: Cancellation of area-based licence or timber licence if entire licence area deleted
paragraph: (b) an order under section 190 (1) [order for early deletion of licence area], or

heading: Cancellation of area-based licence or timber licence if entire licence area deleted
paragraph: (c) an order under section 191 (1) [order to extend deletion if special purpose area overlaps cutting permit area].

heading: Effective date of AAC reduction for area-based licence
paragraph:
193
		  (1) If the chief forester determines a reduction under section 185 (1) (b) [impacts on harvest profile and AAC of area-based licence] to the allowable annual cut for the licence area of an area-based licence, the reduction and the adjusted allowable annual cut specified under section 185 (1) (c) take effect on the date that Crown land is deleted under this Division from the licence area.

heading: Effective date of AAC reduction for area-based licence
paragraph: (2) When a reduction to the allowable annual cut of an area-based licence takes effect, the licence is deemed to be amended to reflect the reduction.

heading: Deletion of cutting permit area within licence area
paragraph:
194
		  (1) On the date that Crown land is deleted under this Division from the licence area of an area-based licence or timber licence, the Crown land is also deleted from the cutting permit area of any cutting permit issued for the licence.

heading: Deletion of cutting permit area within licence area
paragraph: (2) If the entire cutting permit area of a cutting permit is deleted under subsection (1), the minister may cancel the cutting permit.

heading: Deemed amendment to affected agreement or cutting permit
paragraph:
195
		  (1) If Crown land is deleted under this Division from the licence area of an area-based licence or timber licence, the licence is deemed to be amended to reflect the deletion.

heading: Deemed amendment to affected agreement or cutting permit
paragraph: (2) If Crown land is deleted under section 194 [deletion of cutting permit area within licence area] from the cutting permit area of a cutting permit, the cutting permit is deemed to be amended to reflect the deletion.

heading: Order to suspend rights under area-based licence or timber licence
paragraph:
196
		  (1) If a special purpose area overlaps the licence area of an area-based licence or timber licence, the minister may, by order, suspend rights under the licence that relate to the area of overlap.

heading: Order to suspend rights under area-based licence or timber licence
paragraph: (2) If the minister is authorized under subsection (1) to suspend rights under a licence for which a cutting permit has been issued, the minister may suspend rights under the licence, the cutting permit or both.

heading: Restriction on entering into or amending area-based licence or timber licence
paragraph:
197
		  (1) Except as authorized under subsection (2), an authorized official must not enter into an area-based licence or timber licence if the licence area would overlap a special purpose area.

heading: Restriction on entering into or amending area-based licence or timber licence
paragraph: (2) An authorized official may enter into an area-based licence or timber licence that overlaps a special purpose area if the area-based licence or timber licence is a replacement for another licence.

heading: Restriction on entering into or amending area-based licence or timber licence
paragraph: (3) An authorized official must not amend the licence area of an area-based licence or timber licence if the amendment would result in a new area of overlap between the licence area and a special purpose area.

heading: Definitions for Division 4 of Part 15
paragraph:
198
		  In this Division:

heading: Definitions for Division 4 of Part 15
paragraph: "AAC available for BCTS licences", in relation to a timber supply area, means the allowable annual cut that is available for granting under BCTS licences in the timber supply area, as specified by the minister under section 10 (1) [apportioning cut];

heading: Definitions for Division 4 of Part 15
paragraph: "AAC reduction for the timber supply area", in relation to a timber supply area, means a reduction to the allowable annual cut for the volume-based portion of the timber supply area, as determined by the chief forester under section 199 (1) (b) [impacts on harvest profile and AAC of timber supply area];

heading: Definitions for Division 4 of Part 15
paragraph: "BCTS licence purpose", in relation to the designation of an area as a special purpose area, means a designation made for a purpose described in section 182 (3) [designation for first nation purpose, BCTS licence purpose or community forest agreement purpose].

heading: Impacts on harvest profile and AAC of timber supply area
paragraph:
199
		  (1) If an area designated as a special purpose area overlaps the volume-based portion of a timber supply area, the chief forester must do all of the following:

heading: Impacts on harvest profile and AAC of timber supply area
paragraph: (a) specify the harvest profile for the volume-based portion by identifying the components of the profile of timber that the chief forester considers could be harvested to support the allowable annual cut for that volume-based portion as at the effective date of the designation;

heading: Impacts on harvest profile and AAC of timber supply area
paragraph: (b) determine the amount by which the allowable annual cut for the volume-based portion would be reduced, if at all, were the area of overlap required to be removed from that volume-based portion;

heading: Impacts on harvest profile and AAC of timber supply area
paragraph: (c) if a reduction is determined under paragraph (b), specify the adjusted allowable annual cut for the volume-based portion that results from that reduction;

heading: Impacts on harvest profile and AAC of timber supply area
paragraph: (d) specify the new harvest profile for the volume-based portion by identifying the components of the profile of timber that the chief forester considers could be harvested to support the allowable annual cut for that volume-based portion after the effective date of the reduction referred to in paragraph (b);

heading: Impacts on harvest profile and AAC of timber supply area
paragraph: (e) specify the harvest profile that will be impacted, if at all, as a result of the reduction referred to in paragraph (b) by identifying the differences between the harvest profile specified under paragraph (a) and the new harvest profile specified under paragraph (d).

heading: Impacts on harvest profile and AAC of timber supply area
paragraph: (2) The matters set out in subsection (1) must be specified and determined within 4 months after the effective date of the designation referred to in that subsection.

heading: Notice to holders of forest licences
paragraph:
200
		  (1) Within 30 days after the matters set out in section 199 (1) [impacts on harvest profile and AAC of timber supply area] are specified and determined in relation to the volume-based portion of a timber supply area, the minister must serve notice of those matters on the holder of each forest licence in that volume-based portion.

heading: Notice to holders of forest licences
paragraph: (2) In the notice under subsection (1), the minister may specify a website maintained by or on behalf of the government where the holder may obtain the harvest profiles specified under section 199 (1) (a), (d) and (e).

heading: Effective date of AAC reduction for timber supply area
paragraph:
201
		  If the chief forester determines a reduction under section 199 (1) (b) [impacts on harvest profile and AAC of timber supply area] for the volume-based portion of a timber supply area, the reduction and the adjusted allowable annual cut specified under section 199 (1) (c) take effect 40 days after that determination.

heading: Reduction to forest licences following designation as special purpose area
paragraph:
202
		  (1) The minister must make reductions under this section to the allowable annual cuts of forest licences in a timber supply area if

heading: Reduction to forest licences following designation as special purpose area
paragraph: (a) a portion of an area designated as a special purpose area overlaps the timber supply area, and

heading: Reduction to forest licences following designation as special purpose area
paragraph: (b) the chief forester determines an AAC reduction for the timber supply area.

heading: Reduction to forest licences following designation as special purpose area
paragraph: (2) If the designation referred to in subsection (1) (a) is made for a purpose other than a BCTS licence purpose, the minister must do both of the following:

heading: Reduction to forest licences following designation as special purpose area
paragraph: (a) determine how much of the AAC reduction for the timber supply area is to be applied to the AAC available for BCTS licences by using the formula set out in section 203 [reduction to AAC available for BCTS licences];

heading: Reduction to forest licences following designation as special purpose area
paragraph: (b) reduce the allowable annual cuts of the forest licences in the timber supply area in accordance with the method set out in section 204 [method of reduction if designation made other than for BCTS licence purpose].

heading: Reduction to forest licences following designation as special purpose area
paragraph: (3) If the designation referred to in subsection (1) (a) is made for a BCTS licence purpose, the minister must reduce the allowable annual cuts of the forest licences in the timber supply area by distributing the AAC reduction for the timber supply area among the forest licences in accordance with section 63 (2) (b), (c) and (d) [reduction among licences in timber supply area].

heading: Reduction to forest licences following designation as special purpose area
paragraph: (4) The minister's determination under subsection (2) (a)

heading: Reduction to forest licences following designation as special purpose area
paragraph: (a) must be made within 40 days after the chief forester determines the AAC reduction for the timber supply area, and

heading: Reduction to forest licences following designation as special purpose area
paragraph: (b) takes effect 40 days after the chief forester's determination.

heading: Reduction to forest licences following designation as special purpose area
paragraph: (5) The reduction under subsection (2) (b) or (3) must be made, and the notice required under section 205 [notice and effective date of reductions to forest licences] must be given, within 3 months after the chief forester determines the AAC reduction for the timber supply area.

heading: Reduction to forest licences following designation as special purpose area
paragraph: (6) The reduction to the allowable annual cuts of forest licences in the volume-based portion of a timber supply area must not exceed the following amounts:

heading: Reduction to forest licences following designation as special purpose area
paragraph: (a) in the case of a reduction under subsection (2) (b), the amount of the AAC reduction for the timber supply area, less the amount applied under subsection (2) (a) to the AAC available for BCTS licences;

heading: Reduction to forest licences following designation as special purpose area
paragraph: (b) in the case of a reduction under subsection (3), the amount of the AAC reduction for the timber supply area.

heading: Reduction to AAC available for BCTS licences
paragraph:
203
		  The formula for the purposes of section 202 (2) (a) [reduction to forest licences following designation as special purpose area] is as follows:

heading: Method of reduction if designation made other than for BCTS licence purpose
paragraph:
204
		  The method for the purposes of section 202 (2) (b) [reduction to forest licences following designation as special purpose area] is as follows:

heading: Method of reduction if designation made other than for BCTS licence purpose
paragraph: (a) determine how much of the AAC reduction for the timber supply area is to be distributed among forest licences in the timber supply area by using the following formula:

heading: Method of reduction if designation made other than for BCTS licence purpose
paragraph: (b) distribute the amount determined under paragraph (a) among the forest licences in accordance with section 63 (2) (b), (c) and (d) [reduction among licences in timber supply area].

heading: Notice and effective date of reductions to forest licences
paragraph:
205
		  (1) If a reduction is made under section 202 [reduction to forest licences following designation as special purpose area] to the allowable annual cut of a forest licence, the minister must serve notice of the reduction on the holder of the forest licence.

heading: Notice and effective date of reductions to forest licences
paragraph: (2) A reduction made under this Division to the allowable annual cut of a forest licence takes effect on the date that notice under subsection (1) is served on the holder of the forest licence.

heading: Notice and effective date of reductions to forest licences
paragraph: (3) When a reduction to the allowable annual cut of a forest licence takes effect, the licence is deemed to be amended to reflect the reduction.

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under cutting permit under forest licence
paragraph:
206
		  (1) If a special purpose area overlaps the cutting permit area of a cutting permit issued for a forest licence, the minister may, by order, do any of the following:

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under cutting permit under forest licence
paragraph: (a) amend the cutting permit;

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under cutting permit under forest licence
paragraph: (b) suspend rights under the cutting permit;

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under cutting permit under forest licence
paragraph: (c) cancel rights under the cutting permit.

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under cutting permit under forest licence
paragraph: (2) In deciding whether to make an order under this section, the minister must consider the following:

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under cutting permit under forest licence
paragraph: (a) whether the exercise of rights under the cutting permit would significantly interfere with the purpose or purposes of the special purpose area;

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under cutting permit under forest licence
paragraph: (b) other factors the minister considers relevant.

heading: Restriction on entering into or amending certain forest licences
paragraph:
207
		  (1) If a special purpose area overlaps a portion of a timber supply area, an authorized official must not enter into a forest licence that would, under section 14 (1) (b.1) [content of forest licence], restrict timber harvesting to the portion of the timber supply area.

heading: Restriction on entering into or amending certain forest licences
paragraph: (2) Subsection (1) does not apply if the forest licence is a replacement for another licence that, under section 14 (1) (b.1), restricts timber harvesting to the portion of the timber supply area.

heading: Restriction on entering into or amending certain forest licences
paragraph: (3) An authorized official must not amend a forest licence if, as a result of the amendment, the forest licence would restrict timber harvesting to a portion of a timber supply area that overlaps a special purpose area.

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits
paragraph:
208
		  (1) In this section:

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits
paragraph: "licence" means any of the following:

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (a) a forestry licence to cut;

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (b) a fibre supply licence to cut;

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (c) a timber sale licence;

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (d) a pulpwood agreement;

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits
paragraph: "permit" means any of the following:

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (a) a free use permit;

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (b) a Christmas tree permit;

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (c) a cutting permit issued for a forestry licence to cut;

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (d) a fibre recovery permit.

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (2) Subject to subsection (4), if rights under a licence or permit are exercisable in a special purpose area, the minister may, by order, do any of the following:

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (a) amend the licence or permit as it relates to the rights;

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (b) suspend the rights;

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (c) cancel the rights.

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (3) In deciding whether to make an order under this section, the minister must consider the following:

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (a) whether the exercise of rights under the licence or permit would significantly interfere with the purpose or purposes of the special purpose area;

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (b) the nature and extent of rights under the licence or permit that are authorized to be exercised in the special purpose area;

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (c) other factors the minister considers relevant.

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (4) The minister may not make an order under this section in respect of a free use permit entered into with any of the following persons:

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (a) a person who requires Crown timber for the purpose of scientific investigation, as referred to in section 48 (1) (d) [free use permit];

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (b) a person who requires Crown timber for a traditional and cultural activity, as referred to in section 48 (1) (g);

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (c) a treaty first nation referred to in section 48 (1) (h).

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (5) For certainty, a forestry licence to cut includes a forestry licence to cut issued under a pulpwood agreement.

heading: Restriction on entering into or amending certain other licences or permits
paragraph:
209
		  (1) Except as authorized under subsection (2), an authorized official must not enter into or issue any of the following licences or permits if the licence or permit would grant rights exercisable in a special purpose area:

heading: Restriction on entering into or amending certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (a) a forestry licence to cut;

heading: Restriction on entering into or amending certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (b) a fibre supply licence to cut or fibre recovery permit;

heading: Restriction on entering into or amending certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (c) a free use permit;

heading: Restriction on entering into or amending certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (d) a Christmas tree permit;

heading: Restriction on entering into or amending certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (e) a timber sale licence;

heading: Restriction on entering into or amending certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (f) a cutting permit for a forest licence, timber licence, area-based licence or forestry licence to cut.

heading: Restriction on entering into or amending certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (2) An authorized official may enter into or issue a licence or permit that grants rights exercisable in a special purpose area if the licence or permit is one of the following:

heading: Restriction on entering into or amending certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (a) a forestry licence to cut entered into for any of the following purposes:

heading: Restriction on entering into or amending certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (i)  preventing or suppressing forest fires;

heading: Restriction on entering into or amending certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (ii)  protecting forest health, including pest management;

heading: Restriction on entering into or amending certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (iii)  protecting public health or safety;

heading: Restriction on entering into or amending certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (b) a free use permit entered into with a person referred to in section 208 (4) (a), (b) or (c) [order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits];

heading: Restriction on entering into or amending certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (c) a cutting permit issued for a forestry licence to cut referred to in paragraph (a).

heading: Restriction on entering into or amending certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (3) An authorized official must not amend any of the following licences, permits or agreements if, as a result of the amendment, the licence, permit or agreement would grant rights exercisable in a special purpose area:

heading: Restriction on entering into or amending certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (a) a forestry licence to cut, other than a forestry licence referred to in subsection (2) (a);

heading: Restriction on entering into or amending certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (b) a free use permit, other than a free use permit referred to in subsection (2) (b);

heading: Restriction on entering into or amending certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (c) a Christmas tree permit;

heading: Restriction on entering into or amending certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (d) a timber sale licence;

heading: Restriction on entering into or amending certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (e) a cutting permit issued for a forest licence, timber licence, area-based licence or forestry licence to cut, other than a cutting permit referred to in subsection (2) (c);

heading: Restriction on entering into or amending certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (f) a pulpwood agreement.

heading: Restriction on entering into or amending certain other licences or permits
paragraph: (4) For certainty, a forestry licence to cut includes a forestry licence to cut issued under a pulpwood agreement.

heading: Application of Division 6 of Part 15 to road authorized under special use permit or master licence to cut
paragraph:
210
		  (1) This Division applies in relation to a road authorized under a special use permit only if the road provides access to an area for a timber production purpose.

heading: Application of Division 6 of Part 15 to road authorized under special use permit or master licence to cut
paragraph: (2) This Division does not apply in relation to a road authorized under

heading: Application of Division 6 of Part 15 to road authorized under special use permit or master licence to cut
paragraph: (a) a master licence to cut, or

heading: Application of Division 6 of Part 15 to road authorized under special use permit or master licence to cut
paragraph: (b) a cutting permit issued for a master licence to cut.

heading: Order to deactivate road
paragraph:
211
		  (1) The minister may make an order under this section if either of the following applies in relation to a road:

heading: Order to deactivate road
paragraph: (a) the road is authorized under an agreement listed in section 12 [form of agreements], or under a special use permit, and is located in a special purpose area;

heading: Order to deactivate road
paragraph: (b) the road is authorized under a road permit or special use permit and compensation in relation to the road has been provided under Division 6 [Compensation for Roads and Timber Production Improvements] of Part 16 [Compensation in Relation to Special Purpose Areas].

heading: Order to deactivate road
paragraph: (2) If a road described in subsection (1) (a) or (b) is authorized under an agreement or permit referred to in that subsection, the minister may, by order, do any of the following:

heading: Order to deactivate road
paragraph: (a) require the holder of the agreement or permit to deactivate the road;

heading: Order to deactivate road
paragraph: (b) exempt the holder from a requirement under this Act or the Forest and Range Practices Act respecting deactivation of the road;

heading: Order to deactivate road
paragraph: (c) impose conditions with respect to an exemption under paragraph (b).

heading: Order to deactivate road
paragraph: (3) Subject to an exemption set out in an order under this section, the applicable requirements under the Forest and Range Practices Act respecting deactivation apply in relation to the road that is subject to the order.

heading: Government deactivation of road
paragraph: 212		  (1) If a road described in section 211 (1) (a) or (b) is authorized under an agreement or permit referred to in that section, the minister may enter into, with the holder of the agreement or permit, a written agreement under which

heading: Government deactivation of road
paragraph: (a) the government agrees to deactivate the road, and

heading: Government deactivation of road
paragraph: (b) the holder agrees to pay to the government, in accordance with the agreement, the costs incurred by the government in respect of the deactivation.

heading: Government deactivation of road
paragraph: (2) The minister may not enter into an agreement under this section respecting the deactivation of a road if the minister has made an order under section 211 [order to deactivate road] in relation to the road.

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights in relation to road
paragraph:
213
		  (1) If a road authorized under a road permit or special use permit is located in a special purpose area, the minister may, by order, do any of the following:

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights in relation to road
paragraph: (a) amend the permit;

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights in relation to road
paragraph: (b) suspend rights under the permit;

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights in relation to road
paragraph: (c) cancel rights under the permit.

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights in relation to road
paragraph: (2) In deciding whether to make an order under this section, the minister must consider the following:

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights in relation to road
paragraph: (a) whether the road significantly interferes with the purpose or purposes of the special purpose area;

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights in relation to road
paragraph: (b) other factors the minister considers relevant.

heading: Prohibition on constructing road under pre-existing authorization
paragraph:
214
		  (1) In this section, "pre-existing authorization", in relation to an area designated as a special purpose area, means an authorization granted, before the effective date of the designation, under a road permit or special use permit.

heading: Prohibition on constructing road under pre-existing authorization
paragraph: (2) Unless the minister, by order, allows otherwise, the holder of a pre-existing authorization that authorizes a road to be constructed in an area designated as a special purpose area must not construct or continue to construct the road in the special purpose area.

heading: Restriction on authorizing new road
paragraph:
215
		  (1) After the effective date of the designation of an area as a special purpose area, and except as authorized under subsection (2), an authorized official must not, under a road permit or special use permit, authorize the holder of the permit to construct a road in the special purpose area.

heading: Restriction on authorizing new road
paragraph: (2) An authorized official may, under a road permit or special use permit, authorize the holder of the permit to construct a road in an area designated as a special purpose area if the authorized official is satisfied that one or more of the following apply:

heading: Restriction on authorizing new road
paragraph: (a) the road does not significantly interfere with the purpose or purposes of the special purpose area;

heading: Restriction on authorizing new road
paragraph: (b) the road is necessary to carry out timber harvesting under a forestry licence to cut entered into for a purpose described in section 209 (2) (a) [restriction on entering into or amending certain other licences or permits];

heading: Restriction on authorizing new road
paragraph: (c) the road is necessary to carry out timber harvesting under a forestry licence to cut entered into before the effective date of the designation;

heading: Restriction on authorizing new road
paragraph: (d) the road is necessary to carry out timber harvesting under a cutting permit issued for a forestry licence to cut referred to in paragraph (b).

heading: Prohibition on removing ancillary road structure
paragraph:
216
		  Unless the minister, by order, allows otherwise, a person must not remove an ancillary road structure if the ancillary road structure is used in relation to a road to which either of the following applies:

heading: Prohibition on removing ancillary road structure
paragraph: (a) the road is authorized under an agreement listed in section 12 [form of agreements], or under a special use permit, and is located in a special purpose area;

heading: Prohibition on removing ancillary road structure
paragraph: (b) the road is authorized under a road permit or special use permit and compensation in relation to the road has been provided under Division 6 [Compensation for Roads and Timber Production Improvements] of Part 16 [Compensation in Relation to Special Purpose Areas].

heading: Order that property in ancillary road structure vests in government
paragraph:
217
		  (1) The minister may, by order, cause property in an ancillary road structure to be vested in the government if any of the following apply:

heading: Order that property in ancillary road structure vests in government
paragraph: (a) the ancillary road structure is used in relation to a road that

heading: Order that property in ancillary road structure vests in government
paragraph: (i)  is authorized under an area-based licence or a cutting permit issued for an area-based licence, and

heading: Order that property in ancillary road structure vests in government
paragraph: (ii)  is located in a special purpose area;

heading: Order that property in ancillary road structure vests in government
paragraph: (b) the ancillary road structure is used in relation to a road authorized under a cutting permit issued for a forest licence and rights in relation to the road are cancelled by an order under section 206 (1) (c) [order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under cutting permit under forest licence];

heading: Order that property in ancillary road structure vests in government
paragraph: (c) the ancillary road structure is used in relation to a road authorized under a licence or permit, as defined in section 208 (1) [order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits], and rights in relation to the road are cancelled by an order under section 208 (2) (c);

heading: Order that property in ancillary road structure vests in government
paragraph: (d) the ancillary road structure is used in relation to a road authorized under a road permit or special use permit and rights in relation to the road are cancelled by an order under

heading: Order that property in ancillary road structure vests in government
paragraph: (i)  section 213 (1) (c) [order to amend, suspend or cancel rights in relation to road], or

heading: Order that property in ancillary road structure vests in government
paragraph: (ii)  section 261 [order to cancel rights in relation to road for which compensation provided].

heading: Order that property in ancillary road structure vests in government
paragraph: (2) If property in an ancillary road structure is subject to an order under this section, the property vests in the government on the effective date of the order.

heading: Order that property in ancillary road structure vests in government
paragraph: (3) Within 30 days after making an order under this section in respect of an ancillary road structure, the minister must serve notice of the order on the following:

heading: Order that property in ancillary road structure vests in government
paragraph: (a) the holder of the licence or permit that authorizes the road in relation to which the ancillary road structure is used;

heading: Order that property in ancillary road structure vests in government
paragraph: (b) if the minister has knowledge of any other person who holds an interest in the ancillary road structure, that other person.

heading: Order that property in ancillary road structure vests in government
paragraph: (4) An order under this section in respect of an ancillary road structure used in relation to a road authorized under a licence or permit does not relieve the holder of the licence or permit from an obligation to deactivate the road.

heading: Prohibition on constructing timber production improvement under pre-existing authorization
paragraph:
218
		  (1) In this section, "pre-existing authorization", in relation to an area designated as a special purpose area, means an authorization granted, before the effective date of the designation, under a road permit or special use permit.

heading: Prohibition on constructing timber production improvement under pre-existing authorization
paragraph: (2) Unless the minister, by order, allows otherwise, the holder of a pre-existing authorization that authorizes a timber production improvement to be constructed in an area designated as a special purpose area must not construct or continue to construct the timber production improvement in the special purpose area.

heading: Order to amend, suspend or cancel rights in relation to timber production improvement
paragraph:
219
		  The minister may, by order, amend, suspend or cancel rights under a special use permit in relation to a timber production improvement located in a special purpose area if the minister considers that the timber production improvement significantly interferes with the purpose or purposes of the special purpose area.

heading: Restriction on authorizing new timber production improvement
paragraph:
220
		  After the effective date of the designation of an area as a special purpose area, an authorized official must not, under a special use permit, authorize a timber production improvement in the special purpose area.

heading: Requirement to serve notice of orders
paragraph:
221
		  As soon as practicable after making an order under any of the following provisions, the minister must serve notice of the order on the holder of the licence, permit or agreement to which the order relates:

heading: Requirement to serve notice of orders
paragraph: (a) section 191 [order to extend deletion if special purpose area overlaps cutting permit area];

heading: Requirement to serve notice of orders
paragraph: (b) section 196 [order to suspend rights under area-based licence or timber licence];

heading: Requirement to serve notice of orders
paragraph: (c) section 206 [order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under cutting permit under forest licence];

heading: Requirement to serve notice of orders
paragraph: (d) section 208 [order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits];

heading: Requirement to serve notice of orders
paragraph: (e) section 211 [order to deactivate road];

heading: Requirement to serve notice of orders
paragraph: (f) section 213 [order to amend, suspend or cancel rights in relation to road];

heading: Requirement to serve notice of orders
paragraph: (g) section 214 [prohibition on constructing road under pre-existing authorization];

heading: Requirement to serve notice of orders
paragraph: (h) section 216 [prohibition on removing ancillary road structure];

heading: Requirement to serve notice of orders
paragraph: (i) section 218 [prohibition on constructing timber production improvement under pre-existing authorization];

heading: Requirement to serve notice of orders
paragraph: (j) section 219 [order to amend, suspend or cancel rights in relation to timber production improvement].

heading: Extension of time periods
paragraph:
222
		  (1) The minister may, by order, extend a time required for the minister, the chief forester or any other person to do anything required or permitted under this Part if the minister considers that the extension is necessary to prevent, alleviate or respond to special circumstances.

heading: Extension of time periods
paragraph: (2) Subsection (1) applies despite section 141 [extension of time].

heading: Exemption for licence entered into for special purposes
paragraph:
223
		  (1) In this section, "licence entered into for special purposes", in relation to the designation of an area for a purpose or purposes referred to in section 182 [designation for first nation purpose, BCTS licence purpose or community forest agreement purpose], means an area-based licence, forest licence or BCTS licence that is entered into, after the effective date of the designation, for the purpose or purposes to which the designation relates.

heading: Exemption for licence entered into for special purposes
paragraph: (2) The following provisions do not apply in relation to an area-based licence if the area-based licence is a licence entered into for special purposes:

heading: Exemption for licence entered into for special purposes
paragraph: (a) Division 3 [Impacts and Restrictions on Area-Based Licences and Timber Licences];

heading: Exemption for licence entered into for special purposes
paragraph: (b) section 209 (1) (f) and (3) (e) [restriction on entering into or amending certain other licences or permits].

heading: Exemption for licence entered into for special purposes
paragraph: (3) The following provisions do not apply in relation to a forest licence if the forest licence is a licence entered into for special purposes:

heading: Exemption for licence entered into for special purposes
paragraph: (a) Division 4 [Impacts and Restrictions on Forest Licences];

heading: Exemption for licence entered into for special purposes
paragraph: (b) section 209 (1) (f) and (3) (e).

heading: Exemption for licence entered into for special purposes
paragraph: (4) Division 5 [Impacts and Restrictions on Certain Other Licences and Permits] does not apply in relation to a BCTS licence if the BCTS licence is a licence entered into for special purposes.

heading: Exemption for licence entered into for special purposes
paragraph: (5) Division 6 [Impacts and Restrictions on Roads, Ancillary Road Structures and Improvements] does not apply in relation to a road permit or special use permit that is associated with a licence entered into for special purposes.

heading: Exemption for licence entered into for special purposes
paragraph: (6) On the effective date of the cancellation of the designation of an area as a special purpose area, an area-based licence, forest licence or BCTS licence that was entered into for the purpose or purposes to which the designation relates ceases to be a licence entered into for special purposes.

heading: Effect of suspension of rights under Part 15
paragraph:
224
		  A suspension of rights under this Part is not a suspension for the purposes of the following provisions:

heading: Effect of suspension of rights under Part 15
paragraph: (a) section 13.1 (4.1) (c) (i) [direct award of forest licence to produce bioenergy - refusal to enter into licence];

heading: Effect of suspension of rights under Part 15
paragraph: (b) section 15 (2) (a) [replacement for forest licence];

heading: Effect of suspension of rights under Part 15
paragraph: (c) section 36 (2) (a) [replacement for tree farm licence];

heading: Effect of suspension of rights under Part 15
paragraph: (d) section 46 (2) (a) [replacement for woodlot licence];

heading: Effect of suspension of rights under Part 15
paragraph: (e) section 52.10 (2) (b) [extension of cutting permit];

heading: Effect of suspension of rights under Part 15
paragraph: (f) section 58.1 (3) (b) [extension of timber sale licences];
