heading: Effect of suspension of rights under Part 15
paragraph: (g) section 81 (2) (c) (i) and (3) (c) [grounds for refusing to issue authorization].

heading: Regulations under Part 15
paragraph:
225
		  (1) The Lieutenant Governor in Council may make regulations for the purposes contemplated by this Part, including regulations that designate areas as special purpose areas for the purposes of Division 2 [Designation of Special Purpose Areas].

heading: Regulations under Part 15
paragraph: (2) A regulation made on or before December 31, 2026 for the purposes of this Part may be made retroactive to a date not earlier than July 15, 2023 and, if made retroactive, is deemed to have come into force on the specified date.

heading: Definitions for Part 16
paragraph:
226
		  (1) In this Part:

heading: Definitions for Part 16
paragraph: "deletion for a non-timber production purpose" means a deletion under Division 3 [Impacts and Restrictions on Area-Based Licences and Timber Licenses] of Part 15 [Special Purpose Areas] of Crown land from the licence area of an area-based licence or non-TFL timber licence, if the deletion occurs in connection with an area that is designated as a special purpose area for a non-timber production purpose;

heading: Definitions for Part 16
paragraph: "deletion for an access purpose" means a deletion under Division 3 of Part 15 of Crown land from the licence area of an area-based licence or non-TFL timber licence, if the deletion occurs in connection with an area that is designated as a special purpose area for an access purpose;

heading: Definitions for Part 16
paragraph: "deletion for other special purposes" means a deletion under Division 3 of Part 15 of Crown land from the licence area of an area-based licence or non-TFL timber licence, if the deletion occurs in connection with an area that is designated as a special purpose area for one or more of the purposes referred to in section 182 [designation for first nation purpose, BCTS licence purpose or community forest agreement purpose];

heading: Definitions for Part 16
paragraph: "deletion period" has the meaning set out in section 227 [meaning of "deletion period"];

heading: Definitions for Part 16
paragraph: "established practices" means practices that

heading: Definitions for Part 16
paragraph: (a) have been carried out previously in relation to the harvest and sale of a volume of timber that is harvested from the relevant harvest profile, and

heading: Definitions for Part 16
paragraph: (b) are evidenced by records that

heading: Definitions for Part 16
paragraph: (i)  have been submitted previously under this Act, and

heading: Definitions for Part 16
paragraph: (ii)  are considered relevant by the minister;

heading: Definitions for Part 16
paragraph: "net income" means the amount determined in accordance with section 228 [meaning of "net income"];

heading: Definitions for Part 16
paragraph: "original allowable annual cut" means the following:

heading: Definitions for Part 16
paragraph: (a) in relation to an area-based licence, the allowable annual cut for the licence area of the area-based licence at the beginning of a deletion period;

heading: Definitions for Part 16
paragraph: (b) in relation to a forest licence, the allowable annual cut of the forest licence at the beginning of a deletion period;

heading: Definitions for Part 16
paragraph: "original licence area", in relation to a non-TFL timber licence, means the licence area of the non-TFL timber licence at that time the licence was first entered into;

heading: Definitions for Part 16
paragraph: "reduction for a non-timber production purpose" means a reduction under section 202 [reduction to forest licences following designation as special purpose area] to the allowable annual cut of a forest licence, if the reduction is made in connection with an area that is designated as a special purpose area for a non-timber production purpose;

heading: Definitions for Part 16
paragraph: "reduction for an access purpose" means a reduction under section 202 to the allowable annual cut of a forest licence, if the reduction is made in connection with an area that is designated as a special purpose area for an access purpose;

heading: Definitions for Part 16
paragraph: "reduction for other special purposes" means a reduction under section 202 to the allowable annual cut of a forest licence, if the reduction is made in connection with an area that is designated as a special purpose area for one or more of the purposes referred to in section 182;

heading: Definitions for Part 16
paragraph: "relevant harvest profile" means the following:

heading: Definitions for Part 16
paragraph: (a) in relation to the licence area of an area-based licence,

heading: Definitions for Part 16
paragraph: (i)  the harvest profile for the licence area, as specified under section 185 (1) (a) [impacts on harvest profile and AAC of area-based licence], or

heading: Definitions for Part 16
paragraph: (ii)  if impacts to that harvest profile are specified under section 185 (1) (e), the impacted harvest profile specified under that section;

heading: Definitions for Part 16
paragraph: (b) in relation to the licence area of a non-TFL timber licence, the harvest profile for the portion of the licence area that overlaps a special purpose area, as specified under section 186 (1) (a) [impacts on non-TFL timber licence];

heading: Definitions for Part 16
paragraph: (c) in relation to the volume-based portion of a timber supply area,

heading: Definitions for Part 16
paragraph: (i)  the harvest profile for the volume-based portion, as specified under section 199 (1) (a) [impacts on harvest profile and AAC of timber supply area], or

heading: Definitions for Part 16
paragraph: (ii)  if impacts to that harvest profile are specified under section 199 (1) (e), the impacted harvest profile specified under that section;

heading: Definitions for Part 16
paragraph: "remaining term" has the meaning set out in section 229 [meaning of "remaining term"].

heading: Definitions for Part 16
paragraph: (2) If a word or expression used in this Part is defined in section 180 [definitions for Part 15], the word or expression has the same meaning as defined in that section.

heading: Meaning of "deletion period"
paragraph:
227
		  (1) The deletion period for a forest licence, and for replacements for the forest licence, is each successive 15-year period, commencing with the beginning of the term of the original forest licence.

heading: Meaning of "deletion period"
paragraph: (2) The deletion period for a tree farm licence, and for replacements for the tree farm licence, is each successive 25-year period, commencing with the beginning of the term of the original tree farm licence.

heading: Meaning of "deletion period"
paragraph: (3) The deletion period for a community forest agreement, and for replacements for the community forest agreement, is each successive 25-year period, commencing with the beginning of the term of the following, as applicable:

heading: Meaning of "deletion period"
paragraph: (a) unless paragraph (b) applies, the original community forest agreement;

heading: Meaning of "deletion period"
paragraph: (b) if the original community forest agreement is a probationary community forest agreement, the original probationary community forest agreement.

heading: Meaning of "deletion period"
paragraph: (4) The deletion period for a first nations woodland licence, and for replacements for the first nations woodland licence, is each successive 25-year period, commencing with the beginning of the term of the original first nations woodland licence.

heading: Meaning of "deletion period"
paragraph: (5) The deletion period for a woodlot licence, and for replacements for the woodlot licence, is each successive 15-year period, commencing with the beginning of the term of the original woodlot licence.

heading: Meaning of "deletion period"
paragraph: (6) For the purposes of this section, an agreement or licence is the original if the agreement or licence

heading: Meaning of "deletion period"
paragraph: (a) does not replace a previous agreement or licence, or

heading: Meaning of "deletion period"
paragraph: (b) is not a licence entered into under

heading: Meaning of "deletion period"
paragraph: (i)  section 19 [consolidation and subdivision of forest licences],

heading: Meaning of "deletion period"
paragraph: (ii)  section 39 [consolidation and subdivision of tree farm licences], or

heading: Meaning of "deletion period"
paragraph: (iii)  section 46.2 [consolidation of woodlot licences].

heading: Meaning of "net income"
paragraph:
228
		  (1) Net income, in relation to the harvest and sale of a volume of timber, is the amount determined by the following formula and in accordance with the regulations, if any:

heading: Meaning of "net income"
paragraph: (2) For the purposes of the formula under subsection (1), the costs include the following:

heading: Meaning of "net income"
paragraph: (a) stumpage that would be payable to the government;

heading: Meaning of "net income"
paragraph: (b) planning, administrative and overhead costs that would be attributed to the harvest and sale of the timber;

heading: Meaning of "net income"
paragraph: (c) costs in respect of the following matters that would be associated with the harvest and sale of the timber:

heading: Meaning of "net income"
paragraph: (i)  constructing, maintaining and deactivating roads;

heading: Meaning of "net income"
paragraph: (ii)  felling, de-limbing and bucking timber;

heading: Meaning of "net income"
paragraph: (iii)  yarding and loading timber;

heading: Meaning of "net income"
paragraph: (iv)  transporting timber;

heading: Meaning of "net income"
paragraph: (v)  sorting and scaling timber;

heading: Meaning of "net income"
paragraph: (vi)  log booming;

heading: Meaning of "net income"
paragraph: (vii)  any additional loading and unloading of timber in relation to sorting and scaling timber, log booming, or transporting the timber to market by any means;

heading: Meaning of "net income"
paragraph: (d) costs that would be incurred to fulfill an obligation or requirement, including a silviculture or other forest management obligation or requirement, that would be

heading: Meaning of "net income"
paragraph: (i)  associated with the harvest of the timber, and

heading: Meaning of "net income"
paragraph: (ii)  imposed under this Act, the Forest and Range Practices Act or the Wildfire Act;

heading: Meaning of "net income"
paragraph: (e) export fees and brokerage fees that would be incurred;

heading: Meaning of "net income"
paragraph: (f) any other costs that the minister determines would be incurred to bring the timber to market.

heading: Meaning of "remaining term"
paragraph: 229		  (1) The remaining term of an area-based licence or non-TFL timber licence, in relation to the deletion of Crown land from the licence area as a result of the designation of an area as a special purpose area, is the period that

heading: Meaning of "remaining term"
paragraph: (a) starts on the date the Crown land is deleted from the licence area under Division 3 [Impacts and Restrictions on Area-Based Licences and Timber Licences] of Part 15 [Special Purpose Areas], and

heading: Meaning of "remaining term"
paragraph: (b) ends on the expiry date of the term of the licence as at the effective date of the designation.

heading: Meaning of "remaining term"
paragraph: (2) The remaining term of a forest licence, in relation to the designation of an area as a special purpose area, is the period that

heading: Meaning of "remaining term"
paragraph: (a) starts on the date the allowable annual cut of the licence is reduced under section 202 [reduction to forest licences following designation as special purpose area] as a result of the designation, and

heading: Meaning of "remaining term"
paragraph: (b) ends on the expiry date of the term of the licence as at the effective date of the designation.

heading: Definitions for Division 2 of Part 16
paragraph:
230
		  In this Division:

heading: Definitions for Division 2 of Part 16
paragraph: "total compensable AAC" means the following:

heading: Definitions for Division 2 of Part 16
paragraph: (a) for the purposes of determining the compensation to which the holder of an area-based licence is entitled under section 231 [compensation for area-based licence for deletion for access purpose], the amount by which the allowable annual cut reduction referred to in subsection (1) (b) of that section exceeds 5% of the original allowable annual cut of the licence;

heading: Definitions for Division 2 of Part 16
paragraph: (b) for the purposes of determining the compensation to which the holder of an area-based licence is entitled under section 232 [compensation for area-based licence for deletion for non-timber production purpose], the amount by which the allowable annual cut reduction referred to in subsection (1) (b) of that section exceeds 5% of the original allowable annual cut of the licence;

heading: Definitions for Division 2 of Part 16
paragraph: "total compensable area" means the following:

heading: Definitions for Division 2 of Part 16
paragraph: (a) for the purposes of determining the compensation to which the holder of a non-TFL timber licence is entitled under section 234 [compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for access purpose], the amount by which the licence area reduction referred to in subsection (1) (b) of that section exceeds 5% of the original licence area;

heading: Definitions for Division 2 of Part 16
paragraph: (b) for the purposes of determining the compensation to which the holder of a non-TFL timber licence is entitled under section 235 [compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for non-timber production purpose], the amount by which the licence area reduction referred to in subsection (1) (b) of that section exceeds 5% of the original licence area.

heading: Compensation for area-based licence for deletion for access purpose
paragraph:
231
		  (1) The holder of an area-based licence is entitled to compensation if

heading: Compensation for area-based licence for deletion for access purpose
paragraph: (a) the allowable annual cut of the licence is reduced as a result of a particular deletion for an access purpose, and

heading: Compensation for area-based licence for deletion for access purpose
paragraph: (b) as a result of the particular deletion and, if applicable, one or more previous deletions for an access purpose, the allowable annual cut of the licence is reduced, during the deletion period, by an amount that exceeds 5% of the original allowable annual cut.

heading: Compensation for area-based licence for deletion for access purpose
paragraph: (2) Subject to the adjustments under subsection (3), the compensation to which the holder of an area-based licence is entitled under this section is an amount determined by the minister based on the net income that would be earned on the sale of harvested timber if, during each year of the remaining term of the licence,

heading: Compensation for area-based licence for deletion for access purpose
paragraph: (a) the volume of the harvested timber were equal to that portion of the total compensable AAC that the minister determines is attributable to the particular deletion referred to in subsection (1) (a),

heading: Compensation for area-based licence for deletion for access purpose
paragraph: (b) the timber were harvested from the relevant harvest profile, and

heading: Compensation for area-based licence for deletion for access purpose
paragraph: (c) the timber were harvested and sold in accordance with established practices.

heading: Compensation for area-based licence for deletion for access purpose
paragraph: (3) After determining the net income amount under subsection (2), the minister must

heading: Compensation for area-based licence for deletion for access purpose
paragraph: (a) adjust the compensation, in accordance with the regulations, to reflect the amount of income tax that would be payable, and

heading: Compensation for area-based licence for deletion for access purpose
paragraph: (b) make other adjustments that may be required by regulation.

heading: Compensation for area-based licence for deletion for non-timber production purpose
paragraph:
232
		  (1) The holder of an area-based licence is entitled to compensation if

heading: Compensation for area-based licence for deletion for non-timber production purpose
paragraph: (a) the allowable annual cut of the licence is reduced as a result of a particular deletion for a non-timber production purpose, and

heading: Compensation for area-based licence for deletion for non-timber production purpose
paragraph: (b) as a result of the particular deletion and, if applicable, one or more previous deletions for a non-timber production purpose, the allowable annual cut of the licence is reduced, during the deletion period, by an amount that exceeds 5% of the original allowable annual cut.

heading: Compensation for area-based licence for deletion for non-timber production purpose
paragraph: (2) Subject to the adjustments under subsection (3), the compensation to which the holder of an area-based licence is entitled under this section is an amount determined by the minister based on the net income that would be earned on the sale of harvested timber if, during each year of the remaining term of the licence,

heading: Compensation for area-based licence for deletion for non-timber production purpose
paragraph: (a) the volume of the harvested timber were equal to that portion of the total compensable AAC that is attributable to the particular deletion referred to in subsection (1) (a),

heading: Compensation for area-based licence for deletion for non-timber production purpose
paragraph: (b) the timber were harvested from the relevant harvest profile, and

heading: Compensation for area-based licence for deletion for non-timber production purpose

heading: Compensation for area-based licence for deletion for non-timber production purpose
paragraph: (b) make other adjustments that may be required by regulation.

heading: Compensation for area-based licence for deletion for other special purposes
paragraph:
233
		  (1) The holder of an area-based licence is entitled to compensation if the allowable annual cut for the licence area is reduced as a result of a particular deletion for other special purposes.

heading: Compensation for area-based licence for deletion for other special purposes
paragraph: (2) Subject to the adjustments under subsection (3), the compensation to which the holder of an area-based licence is entitled under this section is an amount determined by the minister based on the net income that would be earned on the sale of harvested timber if, during each year of the remaining term of the licence,

heading: Compensation for area-based licence for deletion for other special purposes
paragraph: (a) the volume of the harvested timber were equal to the amount by which the allowable annual cut of the licence is reduced as a result of the particular deletion referred to in subsection (1),

heading: Compensation for area-based licence for deletion for other special purposes
paragraph: (b) the timber were harvested from the relevant harvest profile, and

heading: Compensation for area-based licence for deletion for other special purposes
paragraph: (c) the timber were harvested and sold in accordance with established practices.

heading: Compensation for area-based licence for deletion for other special purposes
paragraph: (3) After determining the net income amount under subsection (2), the minister must
