heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for access purpose
paragraph:
234
		  (1) The holder of a non-TFL timber licence is entitled to compensation if

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for access purpose
paragraph: (a) a portion of the licence area is deleted as a result of a particular deletion for an access purpose, and

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for access purpose
paragraph: (b) as a result of the particular deletion and, if applicable, one or more previous deletions for an access purpose, the licence area is reduced by an amount that exceeds 5% of the original licence area.

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for access purpose
paragraph: (2) Subject to the adjustments under subsection (4), the compensation to which the holder of a non-TFL timber licence is entitled under this section is an amount determined by the minister based on the net income that would be earned on the sale of harvested timber if, during each year of the remaining term of the licence,

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for access purpose
paragraph: (a) the size of the area from which the timber were harvested were equal to the size of the area that

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for access purpose
paragraph: (i)  is deleted as a result of the particular deletion referred to in subsection (1) (a), as determined by the chief forester under section 186 (1) (b) [impacts on non-TFL timber licence], and

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for access purpose
paragraph: (ii)  is in that portion of the total compensable area that the minister determines is attributable to that particular deletion,

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for access purpose
paragraph: (b) the volume of the harvested timber were equal to the amount calculated by using the formula set out in subsection (3),

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for access purpose
paragraph: (c) the timber were harvested from the relevant harvest profile, and

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for access purpose
paragraph: (d) the timber were harvested and sold in accordance with established practices.

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for access purpose
paragraph: (3) The formula for the purposes of subsection (2) (b) is as follows:

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for access purpose
paragraph: (4) After determining the net income amount under subsection (2), the minister must

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for access purpose
paragraph: (a) adjust the compensation, in accordance with the regulations, to reflect the amount of income tax that would be payable, and

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for access purpose
paragraph: (b) make other adjustments that may be required by regulation.

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for non-timber production purpose
paragraph:
235
		  (1) The holder of a non-TFL timber licence is entitled to compensation if

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for non-timber production purpose
paragraph: (a) a portion of the licence area is deleted as a result of a particular deletion for a non-timber production purpose, and

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for non-timber production purpose
paragraph: (b) as a result of the particular deletion and, if applicable, one or more previous deletions for a non-timber production purpose, the licence area is reduced by an amount that exceeds 5% of the original licence area.

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for non-timber production purpose
paragraph: (2) Subject to the adjustments under subsection (3), the compensation to which the holder of a non-TFL timber licence is entitled under this section is an amount determined by the minister based on the net income that would be earned on the sale of harvested timber if, during each year of the remaining term of the licence,

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for non-timber production purpose
paragraph: (a) the size of the area from which the timber were harvested were equal to the size of the area that

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for non-timber production purpose
paragraph: (i)  is deleted as a result of the particular deletion referred to in subsection (1) (a), as determined by the chief forester under section 186 (1) (b) [impacts on non-TFL timber licence], and

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for non-timber production purpose
paragraph: (ii)  is in that portion of the total compensable area that the minister determines is attributable to that particular deletion,

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for non-timber production purpose
paragraph: (b) the volume of the harvested timber were equal to the amount calculated by using the formula set out in section 234 (3),

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for non-timber production purpose
paragraph: (c) the timber were harvested from the relevant harvest profile, and

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for non-timber production purpose
paragraph: (d) the timber were harvested and sold in accordance with established practices.

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for non-timber production purpose
paragraph: (3) After determining the net income amount under subsection (2), the minister must

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for non-timber production purpose
paragraph: (a) adjust the compensation, in accordance with the regulations, to reflect the amount of income tax that would be payable, and

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for non-timber production purpose
paragraph: (b) make other adjustments that may be required by regulation.

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for other special purposes
paragraph:
236
		  (1) The holder of a non-TFL timber licence is entitled to compensation if a portion of the licence area is deleted as a result of a particular deletion for other special purposes.

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for other special purposes
paragraph: (2) Subject to the adjustments under subsection (3), the compensation to which the holder of a non-TFL timber licence is entitled under this section is an amount determined by the minister based on the net income that would be earned on the sale of harvested timber if, during each year of the remaining term of the licence,

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for other special purposes
paragraph: (a) the size of the area from which the timber were harvested were equal to the size of the area that is deleted as a result of the particular deletion referred to in subsection (1), as determined by the chief forester under section 186 (1) (b) [impacts on non-TFL timber licence],

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for other special purposes
paragraph: (b) the volume of the harvested timber were equal to the amount calculated by using the formula set out in section 234 (3) [compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for access purpose] and, for this purpose, the size of the deleted area is the size, in hectares, of the area referred to in paragraph (a) of this subsection,

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for other special purposes
paragraph: (c) the timber were harvested from the relevant harvest profile, and

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for other special purposes
paragraph: (d) the timber were harvested and sold in accordance with established practices.

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for other special purposes
paragraph: (3) After determining the net income amount under subsection (2), the minister must

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for other special purposes
paragraph: (a) adjust the compensation, in accordance with the regulations, to reflect the amount of income tax that would be payable, and

heading: Compensation for non-TFL timber licence for deletion for other special purposes
paragraph: (b) make other adjustments that may be required by regulation.

heading: Definition for Division 3 of Part 16
paragraph:
237 
		  In this Division, "total compensable AAC" means the following:

heading: Definition for Division 3 of Part 16
paragraph: (a) for the purposes of determining the compensation to which the holder of a forest licence is entitled under section 238 [compensation for forest licence for reduction for access purpose], the amount by which the allowable annual cut reductions referred to in subsection (1) (b) of that section exceed 5% of the original allowable annual cut of the licence;

heading: Definition for Division 3 of Part 16
paragraph: (b) for the purposes of determining the compensation to which the holder of a forest licence is entitled under section 239 [compensation for forest licence for reduction for non-timber production purpose], the amount by which the allowable annual cut reductions referred to in subsection  (1) (b) of that section exceed 5% of the original allowable annual cut of the licence.

heading: Compensation for forest licence for reduction for access purpose
paragraph:
238
		  (1) The holder of a forest licence is entitled to compensation if

heading: Compensation for forest licence for reduction for access purpose
paragraph: (a) the allowable annual cut of the licence is reduced as a result of a particular reduction for an access purpose, and

heading: Compensation for forest licence for reduction for access purpose
paragraph: (b) as a result of the particular reduction and, if applicable, one or more previous reductions for an access purpose, the allowable annual cut of the licence is reduced, during the deletion period, by an amount that exceeds 5% of the original allowable annual cut.

heading: Compensation for forest licence for reduction for access purpose
paragraph: (2) Subject to the adjustments under subsection (3), the compensation to which the holder of a forest licence is entitled under this section is an amount determined by the minister based on the net income that would be earned on the sale of timber that would be harvested if, during each year of the remaining term of the licence,

heading: Compensation for forest licence for reduction for access purpose
paragraph: (a) the volume of timber harvested were equal to that portion of the total compensable AAC that is attributable to the particular reduction referred to in subsection (1) (a),

heading: Compensation for forest licence for reduction for access purpose
paragraph: (b) the timber were harvested from the relevant harvest profile, and

heading: Compensation for forest licence for reduction for access purpose
paragraph: (c) the timber were harvested and sold in accordance with established practices.

heading: Compensation for forest licence for reduction for access purpose
paragraph: (3) After determining the net income amount under subsection (2), the minister must

heading: Compensation for forest licence for reduction for access purpose
paragraph: (a) adjust the compensation, in accordance with the regulations, to reflect the amount of income tax that would be payable, and

heading: Compensation for forest licence for reduction for access purpose
paragraph: (b) make other adjustments that may be required by regulation.

heading: Compensation for forest licence for reduction for non-timber production purpose
paragraph:
239
		  (1) The holder of a forest licence is entitled to compensation if

heading: Compensation for forest licence for reduction for non-timber production purpose
paragraph: (a) the allowable annual cut of the licence is reduced as a result of a particular reduction for a non-timber production purpose, and

heading: Compensation for forest licence for reduction for non-timber production purpose
paragraph: (b) as a result of the particular reduction and, if applicable, one or more previous reductions for a non-timber production purpose, the allowable annual cut of the licence is reduced, during the deletion period, by an amount that exceeds 5% of the original allowable annual cut.

heading: Compensation for forest licence for reduction for non-timber production purpose
paragraph: (2) Subject to the adjustments under subsection (3), the compensation to which the holder of a forest licence is entitled under this section is an amount determined by the minister based on the net income that would be earned on the sale of timber that would be harvested if, during each year of the remaining term of the licence,

heading: Compensation for forest licence for reduction for non-timber production purpose
paragraph: (a) the volume of timber harvested were equal to that portion of the total compensable AAC that is attributable to the particular reduction referred to in subsection (1) (a),

heading: Compensation for forest licence for reduction for non-timber production purpose
paragraph: (b) the timber were harvested from the relevant harvest profile, and

heading: Compensation for forest licence for reduction for non-timber production purpose
paragraph: (c) the timber were harvested and sold in accordance with established practices.

heading: Compensation for forest licence for reduction for non-timber production purpose
paragraph: (3) After determining the net income amount under subsection (2), the minister must

heading: Compensation for forest licence for reduction for non-timber production purpose
paragraph: (a) adjust the compensation, in accordance with the regulations, to reflect the amount of income tax that would be payable, and

heading: Compensation for forest licence for reduction for non-timber production purpose
paragraph: (b) make other adjustments that may be required by regulation.

heading: Compensation for forest licence for reduction for other special purposes
paragraph:
240
		  (1) The holder of a forest licence is entitled to compensation if the allowable annual cut of the forest licence is reduced as a result of a particular reduction for other special purposes.

heading: Compensation for forest licence for reduction for other special purposes
paragraph: (2) Subject to the adjustments under subsection (3), the compensation to which the holder of a forest licence is entitled under this section is an amount determined by the minister based on the net income that would be earned on the sale of timber that would be harvested if, during each year of the remaining term of the forest licence,

heading: Compensation for forest licence for reduction for other special purposes
paragraph: (a) the volume of timber harvested were equal to the amount by which the allowable annual cut of the licence is reduced as a result of the particular reduction referred to in subsection (1),

heading: Compensation for forest licence for reduction for other special purposes
paragraph: (b) the timber were harvested from the relevant harvest profile, and

heading: Compensation for forest licence for reduction for other special purposes
paragraph: (c) the timber were harvested and sold in accordance with established practices.

heading: Compensation for forest licence for reduction for other special purposes
paragraph: (3) After determining the net income amount under subsection (2), the minister must

heading: Compensation for forest licence for reduction for other special purposes
paragraph: (a) adjust the compensation, in accordance with the regulations, to reflect the amount of income tax that would be payable, and

heading: Compensation for forest licence for reduction for other special purposes
paragraph: (b) make other adjustments that may be required by regulation.

heading: Compensation if special purpose area overlaps cutting permit area
paragraph:
241
		  (1) The minister may compensate the holder of a cutting permit issued for a tree farm licence, first nations woodland licence, non-TFL timber licence, forest licence or forestry licence to cut if a special purpose area overlaps the cutting permit area and one of the following occurs:

heading: Compensation if special purpose area overlaps cutting permit area
paragraph: (a) in the case of a cutting permit issued for a tree farm licence, first nations woodland licence or non-TFL timber licence, the area of overlap is deleted under section 194 (1) [deletion of cutting permit area within licence area];

heading: Compensation if special purpose area overlaps cutting permit area
paragraph: (b) in the case of a cutting permit issued for a forest licence, rights to harvest in the area of overlap are cancelled by an order under section 206 (1) (c) [order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under cutting permit under forest licence];

heading: Compensation if special purpose area overlaps cutting permit area
paragraph: (c) in the case of a cutting permit issued for a forestry licence to cut, rights to harvest in the area of overlap are cancelled by an order under section 208 (2) (c) [order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits].

heading: Compensation if special purpose area overlaps cutting permit area
paragraph: (2) The compensation for which the holder of a cutting permit is eligible under subsection (1) is the amount determined by the minister in accordance with the regulations.

heading: Compensation if special purpose area does not overlap cutting permit area
paragraph:
242
		  (1) The minister may compensate the holder of a cutting permit issued for a tree farm licence, first nations woodland licence, non-TFL timber licence, forest licence or forestry licence to cut if an area designated as a special purpose area does not overlap the cutting permit area but the minister is satisfied that the following requirements are met:

heading: Compensation if special purpose area does not overlap cutting permit area
paragraph: (a) the cutting permit was issued before the effective date of the designation;

heading: Compensation if special purpose area does not overlap cutting permit area
paragraph: (b) as a result of the special purpose area, there is no practicable means by which the holder can access the cutting permit area or a portion of the cutting permit area.

heading: Compensation if special purpose area does not overlap cutting permit area
paragraph: (2) If the holder of a cutting permit believes that the requirements under subsection (1) are met, the holder must provide to the minister, in the form and manner that the minister may require,

heading: Compensation if special purpose area does not overlap cutting permit area
paragraph: (a) a statement setting out why the holder considers that the requirements are met, and

heading: Compensation if special purpose area does not overlap cutting permit area
paragraph: (b) any additional information that the minister may require.

heading: Compensation if special purpose area does not overlap cutting permit area
paragraph: (3) The holder of a cutting permit is not eligible for compensation under subsection (1) unless all the information required under subsection (2) is provided before the earlier of

heading: Compensation if special purpose area does not overlap cutting permit area
paragraph: (a) the date the designation referred to in subsection (1) is cancelled, and

heading: Compensation if special purpose area does not overlap cutting permit area
paragraph: (b) the date the cutting permit expires.

heading: Compensation if special purpose area does not overlap cutting permit area
paragraph: (4) If the requirements under this section are met, the compensation for which the holder of the cutting permit is eligible is the amount determined by the minister in accordance with the regulations.

heading: Compensation for cutting permit issued for community forest agreement or woodlot licence
paragraph:
243
		  (1) The minister may compensate the holder of a cutting permit issued for a community forest agreement or woodlot licence if the minister is satisfied that the impact and other requirements specified in the regulations are met.

heading: Compensation for cutting permit issued for community forest agreement or woodlot licence
paragraph: (2) If the requirements under subsection (1) are met, the compensation for which the holder of the cutting permit is eligible is the amount determined by the minister in accordance with the regulations.

heading: Duty of cutting permit holder to provide information to minister
paragraph:
244
		  (1) The holder of a cutting permit must provide to the minister, on request, information the minister considers necessary for the purposes of considering or determining a matter under this Division.

heading: Duty of cutting permit holder to provide information to minister
paragraph: (2) Information requested by the minister under this section must be provided in the form and manner and within the time period specified by the minister.

heading: No compensation for fibre supply licence to cut or free use permit
paragraph:
245
		  No compensation is payable to the holder of a fibre supply licence to cut or free use permit in respect of an order under section 208 (2) [order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits] that amends, suspends or cancels rights under the licence or permit.

heading: Compensation for forestry licence to cut
paragraph:
246
		  (1) The minister may compensate the holder of a forestry licence to cut if

heading: Compensation for forestry licence to cut
paragraph: (a) rights under the licence are cancelled by an order under section 208 (2) (c) [order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits], and

heading: Compensation for forestry licence to cut
paragraph: (b) the minister is satisfied that the requirements specified in the regulations are met.

heading: Compensation for forestry licence to cut
paragraph: (2) If the requirements under subsection (1) are met, the compensation for which the holder of the forestry licence to cut is eligible is the amount determined by the minister in accordance with the regulations.

heading: Compensation for timber sale licence
paragraph:
247
		  (1) No compensation is payable to the holder of a timber sale licence in respect of an order under section 208 (2) (a) or (b) [order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits] that amends or suspends rights under the licence.

heading: Compensation for timber sale licence
paragraph: (2) The minister may compensate the holder of a timber sale licence if

heading: Compensation for timber sale licence
paragraph: (a) rights under the licence are cancelled by an order under section 208 (2) (c), and

heading: Compensation for timber sale licence
paragraph: (b) the minister is satisfied that the requirements specified in the regulations are met.

heading: Compensation for timber sale licence
paragraph: (3) If the requirements under subsection (2) are met, the compensation for which the holder of the timber sale licence is eligible is the amount determined by the minister in accordance with the regulations.

heading: No compensation, unless regulations provide otherwise, for pulpwood agreement
paragraph:
248
		  (1) Unless the regulations provide otherwise, no compensation is payable to the holder of a pulpwood agreement in respect of an order under section 208 (2) [order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits] that amends, suspends or cancels rights under the pulpwood agreement.

heading: No compensation, unless regulations provide otherwise, for pulpwood agreement
paragraph: (2) Subsection (1) does not affect the compensation for which the holder of a pulpwood agreement may be eligible, under Division 4 [Compensation for Cutting Permits], in respect of a cutting permit that is issued for a forestry licence to cut that is issued under the pulpwood agreement.

heading: Compensation for Christmas tree permit
paragraph:
249
		  (1) The minister may compensate the holder of a Christmas tree permit if

heading: Compensation for Christmas tree permit
paragraph: (a) rights under the permit are cancelled by an order under section 208 (2) (c) [order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits], and

heading: Compensation for Christmas tree permit
paragraph: (b) the minister is satisfied that the requirements specified in the regulations are met.

heading: Compensation for Christmas tree permit
paragraph: (2) If the requirements under subsection (1) are met, the compensation for which the holder of the Christmas tree permit is eligible is the amount determined by the minister in accordance with the regulations.

heading: Interpretation rule for ancillary road structures
paragraph:
250
		  For certainty, if an ancillary road structure is used in relation to a road, the ancillary road structure forms part of the road.

heading: Application of Division 6 of Part 16 to road authorized under special use permit or master licence to cut
paragraph:
251
		  (1) This Division applies in relation to a road authorized under a special use permit only if the road provides access to an area for a timber production purpose.

heading: Application of Division 6 of Part 16 to road authorized under special use permit or master licence to cut
paragraph: (2) This Division does not apply in relation to a road authorized under

heading: Application of Division 6 of Part 16 to road authorized under special use permit or master licence to cut
paragraph: (a) a master licence to cut, or

heading: Application of Division 6 of Part 16 to road authorized under special use permit or master licence to cut
paragraph: (b) a cutting permit issued for a master licence to cut.

heading: Compensation for road located in special purpose area
paragraph:
252
		  (1) The minister may compensate the holder of a road permit or special use permit that authorizes a road located in an area designated as a special purpose area if the minister is satisfied that the following requirements are met:

heading: Compensation for road located in special purpose area
paragraph: (a) the road permit or special use permit was issued before the effective date of the designation;

heading: Compensation for road located in special purpose area
paragraph: (b) in the case of a road permit, the road permit is associated with a forest licence, timber licence, tree farm licence or prescribed licence;

heading: Compensation for road located in special purpose area
paragraph: (c) rights in relation to the road are cancelled by an order under section 213 (1) (c) [order to amend, suspend or cancel rights in relation to road];

heading: Compensation for road located in special purpose area
paragraph: (d) the general requirements under section 253;

heading: Compensation for road located in special purpose area
paragraph: (e) the requirements, if any, specified in the regulations.

heading: Compensation for road located in special purpose area
paragraph: (2) If the requirements under subsection (1) are met, the minister may compensate the holder of the road permit or special use permit for the costs or a portion of the costs incurred to construct the road, as determined by the minister in accordance with the regulations.

heading: General requirements for compensation for road
paragraph:
253
		  The general requirements for compensation in relation to a road authorized under a road permit or special use permit are as follows:

heading: General requirements for compensation for road
paragraph: (a) the holder of the permit has incurred costs to construct the road;

heading: General requirements for compensation for road
paragraph: (b) the costs referred to in paragraph (a) have not been paid, and are not payable, by the government;

heading: General requirements for compensation for road
paragraph: (c) the holder of the permit has not, under this Act or another enactment, previously received compensation in respect of the road;

heading: General requirements for compensation for road
paragraph: (d) payment of compensation is just in the circumstances.

heading: Compensation for road located outside special purpose area if road associated with cutting permit
paragraph:
254
		  (1) The minister may compensate the holder of a road permit that authorizes a road located outside an area designated as a special purpose area if the minister is satisfied that the following requirements are met:

heading: Compensation for road located outside special purpose area if road associated with cutting permit
paragraph: (a) the road is associated with a cutting permit;

heading: Compensation for road located outside special purpose area if road associated with cutting permit
paragraph: (b) the cutting permit was issued, before the effective date of the designation, for a forest licence, timber licence, tree farm licence or prescribed licence;

heading: Compensation for road located outside special purpose area if road associated with cutting permit
paragraph: (c) costs to construct the road were applied under section 105 [stumpage rate determined], before the effective date of the designation, to determine, redetermine or vary the rate of stumpage for timber authorized to be harvested under the cutting permit;

heading: Compensation for road located outside special purpose area if road associated with cutting permit
paragraph: (d) harvesting rights under the cutting permit are impacted, as a result of the special purpose area, in one of the ways described in section 255;

heading: Compensation for road located outside special purpose area if road associated with cutting permit
paragraph: (e) the general requirements under section 253;

heading: Compensation for road located outside special purpose area if road associated with cutting permit
paragraph: (f) the requirements, if any, specified in the regulations.

heading: Compensation for road located outside special purpose area if road associated with cutting permit
paragraph: (2) If the requirements under subsection (1) are met, the minister may compensate the holder of the road permit for the costs or a portion of the costs incurred to construct the road, as determined by the minister in accordance with the regulations.

heading: Impact requirements for road associated with cutting permit
paragraph:
255
		  (1) For the purposes of section 254 (1) (d), harvesting rights under the cutting permit are impacted, in the case of a special purpose area that overlaps the cutting permit area, if both of the following apply:

heading: Impact requirements for road associated with cutting permit
paragraph: (a) harvesting under the cutting permit cannot be completed in the area of overlap because

heading: Impact requirements for road associated with cutting permit
paragraph: (i)  the area of overlap is deleted from the cutting permit area under section 194 (1) [deletion of cutting permit area within licence area], or

heading: Impact requirements for road associated with cutting permit
paragraph: (ii)  rights exercisable in the area of overlap are cancelled by an order under

heading: Impact requirements for road associated with cutting permit
paragraph: (A) section 206 (1) (c) [order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under cutting permit under forest licence], or

heading: Impact requirements for road associated with cutting permit
paragraph: (B) section 208 (2) (c) [order to amend, suspend or cancel rights under certain other licences or permits];

heading: Impact requirements for road associated with cutting permit
paragraph: (b) harvesting under the cutting permit cannot reasonably be completed by harvesting timber from areas located outside the area of overlap.

heading: Impact requirements for road associated with cutting permit
paragraph: (2) For the purposes of section 254 (1) (d), harvesting rights under the cutting permit are impacted, in the case of a special purpose area that does not overlap the cutting permit area, if harvesting under the cutting permit is no longer practicable in the cutting permit area or a portion of the cutting permit area.

heading: Compensation in other cases if road under road permit located outside special purpose area
paragraph:
256
		  (1) The minister may compensate the holder of a road permit that authorizes a road located outside an area designated as a special purpose area if the minister is satisfied that the impact and other requirements specified in the regulations are met.

heading: Compensation in other cases if road under road permit located outside special purpose area
paragraph: (2) If the requirements under subsection (1) are met, the minister may compensate the holder of the road permit for the costs or a portion of the costs incurred to construct the road, as determined by the minister in accordance with the regulations.

heading: Compensation if road under special use permit located outside special purpose area
paragraph:
257
		  (1) The minister may compensate the holder of a special use permit that authorizes a road located outside an area designated as a special purpose area if the minister is satisfied that the impact and other requirements specified in the regulations are met.

heading: Compensation if road under special use permit located outside special purpose area
paragraph: (2) If the requirements under subsection (1) are met, the minister may compensate the holder of the special use permit for the costs or a portion of the costs incurred to construct the road, as determined by the minister in accordance with the regulations.

heading: Compensation for timber production improvement located in special purpose area
paragraph:
258
		  (1) The minister may compensate the holder of a special use permit that authorizes a timber production improvement located in a special purpose area if the minister is satisfied that the following requirements are met:

heading: Compensation for timber production improvement located in special purpose area
paragraph: (a) rights in relation to the timber production improvement are cancelled by an order under section 219 [order to amend, suspend or cancel rights in relation to timber production improvement];

heading: Compensation for timber production improvement located in special purpose area
paragraph: (b) the costs incurred to construct the timber production improvement have not been paid, and are not payable, by the government;

heading: Compensation for timber production improvement located in special purpose area
paragraph: (c) the holder has not, under this Act or another enactment, previously received compensation in respect of the timber production improvement;

heading: Compensation for timber production improvement located in special purpose area
paragraph: (d) payment of compensation is just in the circumstances.

heading: Compensation for timber production improvement located in special purpose area
paragraph: (2) If the requirements under subsection (1) are met, the minister may compensate the holder of the special use permit for the costs or a portion of the costs incurred to construct the timber production improvement, as determined by the minister in accordance with the regulations.

heading: Compensation for timber production improvement located outside special purpose area
paragraph:
259
		  (1) The minister may compensate the holder of a special use permit that authorizes a timber production improvement located outside a special purpose area if the minister is satisfied that the following requirements are met:

heading: Compensation for timber production improvement located outside special purpose area
paragraph: (a) as a result of the special purpose area,

heading: Compensation for timber production improvement located outside special purpose area
paragraph: (i)  the means by which the holder accesses the improvement can no longer be used, and

heading: Compensation for timber production improvement located outside special purpose area
paragraph: (ii)  there is no practicable alternative means by which the holder can access the improvement;

heading: Compensation for timber production improvement located outside special purpose area
paragraph: (b) the requirements under section 258 (1) (b), (c) and (d).

heading: Compensation for timber production improvement located outside special purpose area
paragraph: (2) If the requirements under subsection (1) of this section are met, the minister may compensate the holder of the special use permit for the costs or a portion of the costs incurred to construct the timber production improvement, as determined by the minister in accordance with the regulations.

heading: Duty of holder of licence to provide information to minister
paragraph:
260
		  (1) The holder of a road permit or special use permit must provide to the minister, on request, information the minister considers necessary for the purposes of considering or determining a matter under this Division.

heading: Duty of holder of licence to provide information to minister
paragraph: (2) Without limiting subsection (1), the minister may request the holder of a road permit or special use permit to provide information that identifies or provides evidence of any of the following:

heading: Duty of holder of licence to provide information to minister
paragraph: (a) areas where harvesting has occurred or has not yet occurred in a cutting permit area or other area in which the holder has harvesting rights;

heading: Duty of holder of licence to provide information to minister
paragraph: (b) areas or the size of areas that contain timber within an area referred to in paragraph (a);

heading: Duty of holder of licence to provide information to minister
paragraph: (c) the volume of timber that has been harvested in an area referred to in paragraph (a);

heading: Duty of holder of licence to provide information to minister
paragraph: (d) costs that have actually been incurred to construct a road, ancillary road structure or timber production improvement.

heading: Duty of holder of licence to provide information to minister
paragraph: (3) Information requested under this section must be provided in the form and manner and within the time period specified by the minister.

heading: Order to cancel rights in relation to road for which compensation provided
paragraph:
261
		  The minister may, by order, cancel rights under a road permit or special use permit if

heading: Order to cancel rights in relation to road for which compensation provided
paragraph: (a) the rights relate to a road or timber production improvement that is located outside a special purpose area, and

heading: Order to cancel rights in relation to road for which compensation provided
paragraph: (b) the minister decides to provide compensation under this Division to the holder of the permit.

heading: Compensation may take form of agreement
paragraph:
262
		  (1) On application to the minister by the holder of an area-based licence, non-TFL timber licence or forest licence, the compensation or a portion of the compensation to which the holder is entitled under this Part may take the form of an agreement, other than a cutting permit, listed in section 12 (1) [form of agreements].

heading: Compensation may take form of agreement
paragraph: (2) For the purposes of subsection (1), the minister may enter into an agreement with the holder of the licence without advertising or inviting applications from other persons.

heading: Reductions and exceptions in respect of compensation
paragraph:
263
		  (1) The compensation that the minister provides to a person under this Part must be reduced by any financial or other benefit that

heading: Reductions and exceptions in respect of compensation
paragraph: (a) the person receives from the government, and

heading: Reductions and exceptions in respect of compensation
paragraph: (b) arises out of the deletion, reduction, order or other impact that gives rise to the compensation.

heading: Reductions and exceptions in respect of compensation
paragraph: (2) If a person waives entitlement, in whole or in part, to compensation under this Part, the minister, as applicable,

heading: Reductions and exceptions in respect of compensation
paragraph: (a) is not required to provide the compensation, or

heading: Reductions and exceptions in respect of compensation
paragraph: (b) may reduce the amount of the compensation.

heading: Limit on compensation in relation to special purpose areas
paragraph:
264
		  (1) In this section, "compensation" includes damages.

heading: Limit on compensation in relation to special purpose areas
paragraph: (2) Unless this Part provides otherwise,

heading: Limit on compensation in relation to special purpose areas
paragraph: (a) no compensation is payable by the government because of or arising out of the designation of an area as a special purpose area, and

heading: Limit on compensation in relation to special purpose areas
paragraph: (b) no action or other proceeding may be commenced or maintained to claim compensation from the government, or to obtain a declaration that compensation is payable by the government, because of or arising out of the designation of an area as a special purpose area.

heading: Limit on compensation in relation to special purpose areas
paragraph: (3) In respect of a matter for which compensation is payable to a person under this Part,

heading: Limit on compensation in relation to special purpose areas
paragraph: (a) the compensation payable to the person in respect of the matter is limited to the amount of compensation determined in relation to that person under this Part, and

heading: Limit on compensation in relation to special purpose areas
paragraph: (b) no action or other proceeding may be commenced or maintained to claim compensation from the government, or to obtain a declaration that compensation is payable by the government, in an amount that exceeds the amount limited under paragraph (a).

heading: General regulation-making powers for Part 16
paragraph:
265
		  (1) The Lieutenant Governor in Council may make regulations respecting compensation for the purposes of this Part, including for the purposes of any provision of this Part that provides for compensation or contemplates regulations that will provide for compensation.

heading: General regulation-making powers for Part 16
paragraph: (2) In making a regulation for the purposes of this Part, the Lieutenant Governor in Council may do any of the following:

heading: General regulation-making powers for Part 16
paragraph: (a) authorize or require the chief forester or minister to specify or determine matters relating to the provision or determination of compensation;

heading: General regulation-making powers for Part 16
paragraph: (b) specify information or matters that the chief forester or minister may or must consider;

heading: General regulation-making powers for Part 16
paragraph: (c) specify matters for which or circumstances under which compensation may or may not be paid;

heading: General regulation-making powers for Part 16
paragraph: (d) specify records that may be used, in relation to the harvest and sale of timber,

heading: General regulation-making powers for Part 16
paragraph: (i)  as evidence of established practices, or

heading: General regulation-making powers for Part 16
paragraph: (ii)  to develop data for use as evidence of established practices;

heading: General regulation-making powers for Part 16
paragraph: (e) specify requirements, criteria, rules, principles, concepts, methods, models or formulas in relation to the provision or determination of compensation;

heading: General regulation-making powers for Part 16
paragraph: (f) provide that compensation is to be calculated based on present value;

heading: General regulation-making powers for Part 16
paragraph: (g) establish adjustments that may or must be made to compensation, including, without limitation, adjustments to reflect income tax that would be payable in relation to net income;

heading: General regulation-making powers for Part 16
paragraph: (h) specify how adjustments specified under paragraph (g) are to be made, calculated or determined;

heading: General regulation-making powers for Part 16
paragraph: (i) specify whether or not interest is authorized or required to be paid;

heading: General regulation-making powers for Part 16
paragraph: (j) if interest is authorized or required to be paid, prescribe interest rates and the manner of calculating interest;

heading: General regulation-making powers for Part 16
paragraph: (k) prescribe the role of auditors or other experts and the qualifications for auditors or other experts;

heading: General regulation-making powers for Part 16
paragraph: (l) without limiting section 151 (1.1), provide that a provision of the regulations does not apply in relation to

heading: General regulation-making powers for Part 16
paragraph: (i)  a specified agreement, licence, permit or other authorization referred to in this Part, or

heading: General regulation-making powers for Part 16
paragraph: (ii)  a specified class of agreement, licence, permit or other authorization referred to in this Part.

heading: General regulation-making powers for Part 16
paragraph: (3) The authority to make regulations described in another provision of this Part does not limit subsection (1) or (2).

heading: General regulation-making powers for Part 16
paragraph: (4) A regulation made on or before December 31, 2026 for the purposes of this Part may be made retroactive to a date not earlier than July 15, 2023 and, if made retroactive, is deemed to have come into force on the specified date.

heading: Regulations respecting determination of net income
paragraph:
266
		  In making a regulation for the purposes of this Part, the Lieutenant Governor in Council may do any of the following in relation to the determination of net income:

heading: Regulations respecting determination of net income
paragraph: (a) provide for the determination of revenues and costs referred to in the formula set out in section 228 [meaning of "net income"];

heading: Regulations respecting determination of net income
paragraph: (b) require that revenues be determined based on any of the following:

heading: Regulations respecting determination of net income
paragraph: (i)  arm's-length transactions;

heading: Regulations respecting determination of net income
paragraph: (ii)  average revenues over a specified period;

heading: Regulations respecting determination of net income
paragraph: (c) require that costs be determined based on average costs incurred;

heading: Regulations respecting determination of net income
paragraph: (d) specify additional costs or expenses that must be deducted from revenues;

heading: Regulations respecting determination of net income
paragraph: (e) specify costs that are excluded from the determination of costs.

heading: Regulations respecting provision of information
paragraph:
267
		  In making a regulation under this Part, the Lieutenant Governor in Council may do any of the following:

heading: Regulations respecting provision of information
paragraph: (a) require the holder of an agreement, licence, permit or other authorization referred to in this Part to provide

heading: Regulations respecting provision of information
paragraph: (i)  information specified in the regulation, or

heading: Regulations respecting provision of information
paragraph: (ii)  information specified by the chief forester or minister;

heading: Regulations respecting provision of information
paragraph: (b) restrict or impose conditions on the use of information referred to in paragraph (a);

heading: Regulations respecting provision of information
paragraph: (c) specify the form and manner in which information referred to in paragraph (a) must be provided, or require the holder to provide the information in the form and manner that the chief forester or minister may require.

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for cutting permits
paragraph:
268
		  (1) In making a regulation respecting compensation contemplated by a provision of Division 4 [Compensation for Cutting Permits], the Lieutenant Governor in Council may do any of the following:

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for cutting permits
paragraph: (a) specify impact and other requirements that must be met for the purposes of section 243 (1) [compensation for cutting permit issued for community forest agreement or woodlot licence];

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for cutting permits
paragraph: (b) require or authorize the minister to determine compensation based on any or all of the following:

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for cutting permits
paragraph: (i)  the harvest profile for a cutting permit area;

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for cutting permits
paragraph: (ii)  established practices in relation to the harvest and sale of timber;

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for cutting permits
paragraph: (iii)  the average volume of harvestable timber, per hectare, in a cutting permit area;

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for cutting permits
paragraph: (iv)  the number of hectares in an affected cutting permit area that contain harvestable timber;

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for cutting permits
paragraph: (v)  the average net income, per cubic metre, that would be earned from the sale of harvestable timber that is harvested in a cutting permit area;

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for cutting permits
paragraph: (c) set out rules that apply if the holder of a cutting permit, as a result of the designation of an area as a special purpose area, is or would be entitled to or eligible for compensation under both

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for cutting permits
paragraph: (i)  a provision of Division 4 [Compensation for Cutting Permits], and

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for cutting permits
paragraph: (ii)  a provision of Division 2 [Compensation for Area-Based Licences and Non-TFL Timber Licences] or 3 [Compensation for Forest Licences].

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for cutting permits
paragraph: (2) A regulation under subsection (1) (c) may specify circumstances in which, despite Division 2 or 3,

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for cutting permits
paragraph: (a) a holder who is entitled to or eligible for compensation under Division 4 is not entitled to compensation under Division 2 or 3, or

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for cutting permits
paragraph: (b) the amount of compensation under Division 2 or 3 must be reduced, in accordance with the regulations, to reflect compensation to be provided under Division 4.

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for cutting permits
paragraph: (3) A regulation made for the purposes of section 243 [compensation for cutting permit issued for community forest agreement or woodlot licence] may authorize the minister to provide compensation, in the amount determined by the minister, to the holder of a specified cutting permit issued for a community forest agreement.

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for roads and timber production improvements
paragraph:
269
		  In making a regulation respecting compensation contemplated by a provision of Division 6 [Compensation for Roads and Timber Production Improvements], the Lieutenant Governor in Council may do any of the following:

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for roads and timber production improvements
paragraph: (a) specify requirements that must be met for the purposes of the following provisions:

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for roads and timber production improvements
paragraph: (i)  section 252 (1) (e) [compensation for road located in special purpose area];

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for roads and timber production improvements
paragraph: (ii)  section 254 (1) (f) [compensation for road located outside special purpose area if road associated with cutting permit];

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for roads and timber production improvements
paragraph: (b) specify impact and other requirements that must be met for the purposes of the following provisions:

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for roads and timber production improvements
paragraph: (i)  section 256 (1) [compensation in other cases if road under road permit located outside special purpose area];

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for roads and timber production improvements
paragraph: (ii)  section 257 (1) [compensation if road under special use permit located outside special purpose area];

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for roads and timber production improvements
paragraph: (c) require that compensation be determined based on costs actually and reasonably incurred;

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for roads and timber production improvements
paragraph: (d) require that compensation for costs incurred to construct a road be based on road costs applied under section 105 [stumpage rate determined];

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for roads and timber production improvements
paragraph: (e) require that compensation in respect of a road be reduced if costs incurred to construct the road include any costs associated with an ancillary road structure that is

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for roads and timber production improvements
paragraph: (i)  used in relation to the road, and

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for roads and timber production improvements
paragraph: (ii)  removed by the person to whom the compensation relates;

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for roads and timber production improvements
paragraph: (f) require that compensation in respect of a road be proportionate to the amount of harvestable timber that the minister determines can no longer be harvested as a result of the special purpose area to which the compensation relates;

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for roads and timber production improvements
paragraph: (g) require that compensation be reduced to account for amortization or depreciation;

heading: Regulations respecting compensation for roads and timber production improvements
paragraph: (h) require that compensation be adjusted to take into account an amortization agreement entered into with the government before the effective date of the designation to which the compensation relates.

heading: Definitions for Part 17
paragraph:
270
		  In this Part:

heading: Definitions for Part 17
paragraph: "AAC available for BCTS licences" has the same meaning as in section 198 [definitions for Division 4 of Part 15];

heading: Definitions for Part 17
paragraph: "established practices" has the same meaning as in section 226 [definitions for Part 16];

heading: Definitions for Part 17
paragraph: "net income" has the same meaning as in section 226;

heading: Definitions for Part 17
paragraph: "profile of timber" has the same meaning as in section 180 [definitions for Part 15];

heading: Definitions for Part 17
paragraph: "reduction authorization order" means an order referred to in section 271 [reduction authorization order];

heading: Definitions for Part 17
paragraph: "relevant harvest profile", in relation to the volume-based portion of a timber supply area, means

heading: Definitions for Part 17
paragraph: (a) the harvest profile specified under section 272 (1) (a) [impact of reduction authorization order on harvest profile], or

heading: Definitions for Part 17
paragraph: (b) if impacts to the harvest profile are specified under section 272 (1) (c), the impacted harvest profile specified under that section;

heading: Definitions for Part 17
paragraph: "volume-based portion" has the same meaning as in section 180.

heading: Reduction authorization order
paragraph:
271
		  The Lieutenant Governor in Council may, by order, authorize the minister to reduce the allowable annual cuts of forest licences in a timber supply area, by an amount not exceeding the amount specified in the order, so that timber may be made available for one or both of the following purposes:

heading: Reduction authorization order
paragraph: (a) entering into one or more forest licences with a first nation or its representative under section 47.3 (1) (a) [direct award of specified licences];

heading: Reduction authorization order
paragraph: (b) entering into one or more BCTS licences.

heading: Impact of reduction authorization order on harvest profile
paragraph:
272
		  (1) If a reduction authorization order is made in relation to a timber supply area, the chief forester must do all of the following:

heading: Impact of reduction authorization order on harvest profile
paragraph: (a) specify the harvest profile for the volume-based portion of the timber supply area by identifying the components of the profile of timber that the chief forester considers could be harvested to support the allowable annual cut for that volume-based portion as at the effective date of the reduction authorization order;

heading: Impact of reduction authorization order on harvest profile
paragraph: (b) specify the new harvest profile for the volume-based portion by identifying the components of the profile of timber that the chief forester considers could be harvested to support the allowable annual cut for the volume-based portion if the allowable annual cut for that volume-based portion were reduced by the maximum reduction amount authorized under the reduction authorization order;

heading: Impact of reduction authorization order on harvest profile
paragraph: (c) specify the harvest profile that will be impacted, if at all, as a result of the reduction referred to in paragraph (b) by identifying the differences between the harvest profile specified under paragraph (a) and the new harvest profile specified under paragraph (b).

heading: Impact of reduction authorization order on harvest profile
paragraph: (2) The matters set out in subsection (1) must be specified within 4 months after the effective date of the reduction authorization order.

heading: Impact of reduction authorization order on harvest profile
paragraph: (3) Within 30 days after the matters set out in subsection (1) are specified in relation to the volume-based portion of a timber supply area, the minister must serve notice of those matters on the holder of each forest licence in that volume-based portion.

heading: Impact of reduction authorization order on harvest profile
paragraph: (4) In the notice under subsection (3), the minister may specify a website maintained by or on behalf of the government where the holder may obtain the harvest profiles specified under subsection (1) (a), (b) and (c).

heading: Reduction to forest licences following reduction authorization order
paragraph:
273
		  (1) If a reduction authorization order is made in relation to a timber supply area, the minister may, within 2 years after the effective date of the reduction authorization order, reduce the allowable annual cuts of the forest licences in the volume-based portion of the timber supply area.

heading: Reduction to forest licences following reduction authorization order
paragraph: (2) To make reductions under subsection (1) in relation to a reduction authorization order made for a first nation purpose referred to in section 271 (a) [reduction authorization order], the minister must do the following:

heading: Reduction to forest licences following reduction authorization order
paragraph: (a) apply a portion of the maximum reduction amount authorized under the reduction authorization order to the AAC available for BCTS licences in accordance with the formula set out in section 203 [reduction to AAC available for BCTS licences];

heading: Reduction to forest licences following reduction authorization order
paragraph: (b) distribute among the forest licences, in accordance with section 63 (2) [reduction among licences in timber supply area], an amount not exceeding the maximum reduction amount authorized under the reduction authorization order, less the portion of that amount that is applied to the AAC available for BCTS licences.

heading: Reduction to forest licences following reduction authorization order
paragraph: (3) To make reductions under subsection (1) in relation to a reduction authorization order made for a BCTS licence purpose referred to in section 271 (b), the minister must distribute among the forest licences, in accordance with section 63 (2), an amount not exceeding the maximum reduction amount authorized under the reduction authorization order.

heading: Reduction to forest licences following reduction authorization order
paragraph: (4) Section 63 (3) and (4) applies in relation to reductions made in accordance with subsections (2) (b) and (3) of this section.

heading: Reduction to forest licences following reduction authorization order
paragraph: (5) For the purposes of this section, section 63 (2) and the formula set out in section 203 are to be applied as if the allowable annual cut for the volume-based portion of the timber supply area had been reduced by the maximum reduction amount authorized under the reduction authorization order.

heading: Compensation for forest licence following reduction
paragraph:
274
		  (1) The holder of a forest licence is entitled to compensation if the allowable annual cut of the forest licence is reduced under section 273 [reduction to forest licences following reduction authorization order].

heading: Compensation for forest licence following reduction
paragraph: (2) Subject to the adjustments under subsection (3), the compensation to which the holder of a forest licence is entitled under this section is an amount determined by the minister based on the net income that would be earned on the sale of harvested timber if, during each year of the remaining term of the licence,

heading: Compensation for forest licence following reduction
paragraph: (a) the volume of the harvested timber were equal to the amount by which the allowable annual cut of the licence is reduced under section 273,

heading: Compensation for forest licence following reduction
paragraph: (b) the timber were harvested from the relevant harvest profile, and

heading: Compensation for forest licence following reduction
paragraph: (c) the timber were harvested and sold in accordance with established practices.

heading: Compensation for forest licence following reduction
paragraph: (3) After determining the net income amount under subsection (2), the minister must

heading: Compensation for forest licence following reduction
paragraph: (a) adjust the compensation, in accordance with the regulations, to reflect the amount of income tax that would be payable, and

heading: Compensation for forest licence following reduction
paragraph: (b) make other adjustments that may be required by regulation.

heading: Compensation for forest licence following reduction
paragraph: (4) For the purposes of this section, the remaining term of a forest licence is the period between

heading: Compensation for forest licence following reduction
paragraph: (a) the date the allowable annual cut of the licence is reduced under section 273, and

heading: Compensation for forest licence following reduction
paragraph: (b) the expiry date of the term of the licence, as at the effective date of the reduction authorization order.

heading: General provisions respecting compensation in relation to reduction authorization orders
paragraph:
275
		  (1) Division 7 [General Provisions in Relation to Compensation] of Part 16 [Compensation in Relation to Special Purpose Areas] applies for the purposes of this Part.

heading: General provisions respecting compensation in relation to reduction authorization orders
paragraph: (2) In applying Division 7 of Part 16 for the purposes of this Part, section 264 [limit on compensation in relation to special purpose areas] is to be read as if the references to "the designation of an area as a special purpose area" were references to "a reduction authorization order".

heading: Regulations under Part 17
paragraph:
276
		  (1) The Lieutenant Governor in Council may make regulations respecting compensation for the purposes of this Part.

heading: Regulations under Part 17
paragraph: (2) Without limiting subsection (1), the following provisions apply for the purposes of making regulations under this Part:

heading: Regulations under Part 17
paragraph: (a) section 265 [general regulation-making powers for Part 16];

heading: Regulations under Part 17
paragraph: (b) section 266 [regulations respecting determination of net income];

heading: Regulations under Part 17
paragraph: (c) section 267 [regulations respecting provision of information].

heading: Definitions for Part 18
paragraph:
277
		  In this Division:

heading: Definitions for Part 18
paragraph: "forest tenure" has the same meaning as in section 11 (3) [minister's power to acquire land] of the Park Act;

heading: Definitions for Part 18
paragraph: "Park Act deletion" means a deletion under section 11 (2.3) of the Park Act;

heading: Definitions for Part 18
paragraph: "Park Act expropriation" means an expropriation under section 11 (2) (g) of the Park Act.

heading: Purposes of Part 18
paragraph: 278		  The purposes of this Part are to provide for the following:

heading: Purposes of Part 18
paragraph: (a) compensation, in respect of Park Act deletions, for holders of forest tenures referred to in section 11 (2.4) of the Park Act;

heading: Purposes of Part 18
paragraph: (b) compensation, in respect of Park Act expropriations, for holders of road permits and holders of special use permits referred to in section 11 (2.21) of the Park Act;

heading: Purposes of Part 18
paragraph: (c) powers and duties that may or must be exercised or performed under this Act in relation to Park Act deletions and Park Act expropriations.

heading: Regulations under Part 18
paragraph: 279		  (1) For the purposes of this Part, the Lieutenant Governor in Council may make regulations respecting any of the following:

heading: Regulations under Part 18
paragraph: (a) compensation in respect of Park Act deletions and Park Act expropriations, including, without limitation, requirements that must be met for the purposes of determining entitlement to or eligibility for compensation in respect of Park Act deletions and Park Act expropriations;

heading: Regulations under Part 18
paragraph: (b) the exercise of powers and performance of duties under this Act that the Lieutenant Governor in Council considers necessary or advisable in relation to Park Act deletions and Park Act expropriations.

heading: Regulations under Part 18
paragraph: (2) Division 8 [Regulations under Part 16] of Part 16 [Compensation in Relation to Special Purpose Areas] applies for the purposes of making regulations under this Part.

heading: Regulations under Part 18
paragraph: (3) In making a regulation under this Part, the Lieutenant Governor in Council may do any of the following:

heading: Regulations under Part 18
paragraph: (a) specify provisions of Part 15 [Special Purpose Areas] or 16, and the regulations under those provisions, that apply for the purposes of this Part;

heading: Regulations under Part 18
paragraph: (b) set out rules respecting the application of the provisions specified under paragraph (a) of this subsection.

heading: Regulations under Part 18
paragraph: (4) The regulation-making powers referred to in subsection (2) and (3) do not limit subsection (1).

heading: Definitions for Part 19
paragraph: 280		  In this Part:

heading: Definitions for Part 19
paragraph: (a) section 60.2 [other deletions of Crown land - tree farm licences];

heading: Definitions for Part 19

heading: Definitions
paragraph: 1		  (1) In this Act:

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "agreement under the Forest Act" means an agreement in the form of a licence, a permit or an agreement referred to in section 12 of the Forest Act or a pulpwood agreement;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "agreement under the Range Act" means an agreement in the form of a licence or permit referred to in section 3 of the Range Act;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "area of catastrophic damage" means an area designated under section 108.2 as an area of catastrophic damage;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "board" means the Forest Practices Board continued under section 136;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "commission" means the Forest Appeals Commission continued under section 140.1;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "council" means the Forest Practices Advisory Council referred to in section 170;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "deactivate", in relation to a road, means to deactivate the road in accordance with the prescribed requirements;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "determination" means any act, decision, procedure, levy, finding, order or other determination made under this Act by the minister or an official;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "ecological community" means a group of different species occupying a particular area;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "forest landscape area", in relation to a forest landscape plan, means the area of land specified in the plan as the forest landscape area;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "forest landscape plan" means a forest landscape plan under section 2.21;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "forest operations area", in relation to a forest operations plan, means the area of land specified in the plan as the forest operations area;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "forest practice" means a prescribed activity that is carried out by

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) the government,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) a holder of an agreement under the Forest Act, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (c) a person in a prescribed category of persons

heading: Definitions
paragraph: on private land, subject to a tree farm licence, a community forest agreement or a woodlot licence, or on Crown forest land;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "free growing stand" means a stand of healthy trees of a commercially valuable species, the growth of which is not impeded by competition from plants, shrubs or other trees;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "interpretive forest site" means an interpretive forest site established under section 56 of this Act or section 6 of the Forest Practices Code of British Columbia Act or designated under the Forest Act;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "minister" includes the minister's delegate;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "ministry website" means a publicly accessible website maintained by or on behalf of the ministry of the minister;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "objectives set by government" means

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) objectives prescribed under section 149 (1),

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) objectives established under section 93.4 of the Land Act by the minister responsible for the administration of the Land Act, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (c) objectives established by the Haida Gwaii Management Council under section 4 (1) of the Haida Gwaii Reconciliation Act;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "official" means an employee in the

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) ministry of the minister responsible for the administration of this Act, which employee is designated by name or title to be an official by that minister for the purpose of that provision,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) ministry of the minister responsible for the Wildlife Act, which employee is designated by name or title to be an official by that minister for the purpose of that provision, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (c) British Columbia Energy Regulator who is designated by name or title to be an official by the commissioner under the Energy Resource Activities Act for the purpose of that provision;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "operational plan" means a forest operations plan, forest stewardship plan, woodlot licence plan, range use plan or range stewardship plan;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "planning guideline" means a guideline included under section 2.28 (2) in a forest landscape plan;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "range development", in relation to the management for range purposes of range land or livestock, means

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) a structure,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) an excavation,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (c) a livestock trail indicated in a range use plan or a range stewardship plan as a range development, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (d) an improvement to forage quality or quantity on an area that results from

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (i)  the application of seed, fertilizer or prescribed fire to the area, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (ii)  the cultivation of the area;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "range practice" means

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) a prescribed activity that is carried out on Crown range by

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (i)  the holder of an agreement under the Range Act, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (ii)  a person in a prescribed category of persons, and

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) the activities related to constructing, modifying or maintaining a range development that are carried out on Crown range by a person other than the holder of an agreement under the Range Act;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "recreation feature" means a biological, physical, cultural or historic feature that has recreational significance or value;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "recreation resource" means

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) a recreation feature,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) a scenic or wilderness feature or setting that has recreational significance or value, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (c) a recreation facility;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "recreation site" means a recreation site established under section 56 of this Act or section 6 of the Forest Practices Code of British Columbia Act or designated under the Forest Act;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "recreation trail" means a recreation trail established under section 56 of this Act, section 6 of the Forest Practices Code of British Columbia Act or designated under the Forest Act;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "seed" means any part of a forest tree represented, sold or used to grow a plant;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "special use permit" means a special use permit under the Forest Practices Code of British Columbia Act;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "standard" means a standard established by the chief forester under section 169;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "trail-based recreation area" means a trail-based recreation area established under section 56;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "wildlife" means

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) vertebrates, other than fish, that are wildlife within the meaning of the Wildlife Act,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) fish from or in the non-tidal waters of British Columbia, including

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (i)  vertebrates of the order Petromyzoniformes (lampreys) or class Osteichthyes (bony fishes), or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (ii)  invertebrates of the subphylum Crustacea (crustaceans) or phylum Mollusca (mollusks), and

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (c) invertebrates or plants listed by the minister responsible for the administration of the Wildlife Act as endangered, threatened or vulnerable species,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: and includes the eggs and juvenile stages of these vertebrates, invertebrates and plants.

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (2) Words and expressions not defined in this Act have the meaning given to them in the Forest Act and the Range Act unless the context indicates otherwise.

paragraph: 2		  (1) A reference in this Act to the minister or his or her designate, or to the minister or a person authorized by the minister, or any similar reference, does not mean that a reference to the minister alone requires the minister to deal with the matter personally, and a reference to the minister alone means a reference to the minister or an appropriate official of the ministry of the minister responsible for the administration of this Act.

heading: Interpretation
paragraph: (4) Section 14 (2) of the Interpretation Act does not apply to this Act.
