paragraph: (a) include a map that

heading: Content of woodlot licence plan
paragraph: (i)  uses a scale and format satisfactory to the minister,

heading: Content of woodlot licence plan
paragraph: (ii)  provides prescribed information about forest resources, and

heading: Content of woodlot licence plan
paragraph: (iii)  shows the boundaries of areas for which the woodlot licence plan specifies intended results or strategies,

heading: Content of woodlot licence plan
paragraph: (b) except in prescribed circumstances, specify intended results or strategies, each in relation to

heading: Content of woodlot licence plan
paragraph: (i)  objectives set by government, and

heading: Content of woodlot licence plan
paragraph: (ii)  other objectives that are established under this Act and that pertain to all or part of the area subject to the plan, and

heading: Content of woodlot licence plan
paragraph: (c) conform to prescribed requirements.

heading: Content of woodlot licence plan
paragraph: (2) A woodlot licence plan must be consistent with the objectives referred to in subsection (1) (b).

heading: Content of woodlot licence plan
paragraph: (3) A woodlot licence plan need not be consistent with objectives set by government to the extent that those objectives pertain to

heading: Content of woodlot licence plan
paragraph: (a) retention of old forest,

heading: Content of woodlot licence plan
paragraph: (b) seral stage distribution,

heading: Content of woodlot licence plan
paragraph: (c) landscape connectivity, or

heading: Content of woodlot licence plan
paragraph: (d) temporal and spatial distribution of cutblocks.

heading: Content of woodlot licence plan
paragraph: (4) A woodlot licence plan or an amendment to a woodlot licence plan must be signed by the person required to prepare the plan, if an individual or, if a corporation or band as defined in the Indian Act (Canada), by an individual or the individuals authorized to sign on behalf of the corporation or band.

heading: Term of woodlot licence plan
paragraph: 14		  (1) The term of a woodlot licence plan

heading: Term of woodlot licence plan
paragraph: (a) is 10 years, and

heading: Term of woodlot licence plan
paragraph: (b) begins on the date specified in writing by the minister in approving the plan.

heading: Term of woodlot licence plan
paragraph: (2) The minister must extend the term of a woodlot licence plan that conforms to prescribed requirements for an additional period of 10 years unless the holder, by written notice given to the minister at least 6 months before the expiry of the initial term, requests an extension for a specified shorter period, in which case the minister must extend the term for that shorter period.

heading: Term of woodlot licence plan
paragraph: (3) Before or after the expiration of a woodlot licence plan that does not conform to the prescribed requirements referred to in subsection (2), the minister may extend the term of the plan for a period or periods not exceeding 2 years in total.

heading: Term of woodlot licence plan
paragraph: (4) The extended woodlot licence plan may include changes to the extent authorized by regulation.

heading: Amendments to a woodlot licence plan
paragraph:
15
		  (1) In this section:

heading: Amendments to a woodlot licence plan
paragraph: "amendment" means an amendment to a woodlot licence plan to make it consistent with an objective;

heading: Amendments to a woodlot licence plan
paragraph: "objective" means

heading: Amendments to a woodlot licence plan
paragraph: (a) an objective set by government, and

heading: Amendments to a woodlot licence plan
paragraph: (b) an objective that is established under this Act

heading: Amendments to a woodlot licence plan
paragraph: but does not include an objective referred to in section 13 (3).

heading: Amendments to a woodlot licence plan
paragraph: (2) No later than 5 years after the date an objective is established, the holder of a woodlot licence plan that becomes inconsistent with an objective must submit an amendment to the minister for approval.

heading: Amendments to a woodlot licence plan
paragraph: (3) Despite subsection (2), the holder of a woodlot licence plan need not submit an amendment that pertains to a portion of the plan that is subject to

heading: Amendments to a woodlot licence plan
paragraph: (a) a cutting permit, or

heading: Amendments to a woodlot licence plan
paragraph: (b) a road permit

heading: Amendments to a woodlot licence plan
paragraph: in effect immediately before the establishment of the objective.

heading: Publication of forest operations maps by forest stewardship plan holders
paragraph:
15.1
		  (1) Subject to subsection (4) of this section and section 15.3, the holder of a forest stewardship plan may apply for a cutting permit or a road permit to construct a road only if the requirements under subsections (2) and (3) have been met.

heading: Publication of forest operations maps by forest stewardship plan holders
paragraph: (2) Before applying for a cutting permit or a road permit to construct a road, the holder of a forest stewardship plan must do all of the following:

heading: Publication of forest operations maps by forest stewardship plan holders
paragraph: (a) prepare a forest operations map that

heading: Publication of forest operations maps by forest stewardship plan holders
paragraph: (i)  shows, as applicable, the approximate location of the cutblock that is to be harvested or the proposed road that is to be constructed under the permit, and

heading: Publication of forest operations maps by forest stewardship plan holders
paragraph: (ii)  conforms to prescribed requirements;

heading: Publication of forest operations maps by forest stewardship plan holders
paragraph: (b) make the forest operations map publicly available, in accordance with the regulations, for review and comment;

heading: Publication of forest operations maps by forest stewardship plan holders
paragraph: (c) prepare and submit to the government, in accordance with the regulations, a report on the public review and any comments made under paragraph (b).

heading: Publication of forest operations maps by forest stewardship plan holders
paragraph: (3) If the holder of a forest stewardship plan intends to rely on a forest operations map under subsection (2) for the purposes of applying for a cutting permit or road permit, the holder must apply for the cutting permit or road permit, as applicable, within the longer of the following periods after making the forest operations map publicly available under subsection (2)  (b):

heading: Publication of forest operations maps by forest stewardship plan holders
paragraph: (a) 2 years;

heading: Publication of forest operations maps by forest stewardship plan holders
paragraph: (b) a prescribed period, if any.

heading: Publication of forest operations maps by forest stewardship plan holders
paragraph: (4) Subsections (1) to (3) do not apply to an application for a cutting permit or road permit if timber is to be harvested under the cutting permit or roads are to be constructed under the road permit, as applicable, only for the following purposes:

heading: Publication of forest operations maps by forest stewardship plan holders
paragraph: (a) a purpose set out in section 4 (1) (a) to (c) or (d) (ii);

heading: Publication of forest operations maps by forest stewardship plan holders
paragraph: (b) a prescribed purpose.

heading: Publication of forest operations maps by timber sales managers
paragraph:
15.2
		  (1) In this section, "operating period" means a period in a series of consecutive periods that is the longer of the following:

heading: Publication of forest operations maps by timber sales managers
paragraph: (a) 2 years;

heading: Publication of forest operations maps by timber sales managers
paragraph: (b) a prescribed period, if any.

heading: Publication of forest operations maps by timber sales managers
paragraph: (2) Subject to section 15.3, a timber sales manager must do the following before the start of each operating period:

heading: Publication of forest operations maps by timber sales managers
paragraph: (a) prepare a forest operations map that

heading: Publication of forest operations maps by timber sales managers
paragraph: (i)  shows the approximate locations of cutblocks that are to be harvested under timber sale licences for which the timber sales manager intends to invite applications during the operating period,

heading: Publication of forest operations maps by timber sales managers
paragraph: (ii)  shows the approximate locations of roads that the timber sales manager intends to construct during the operating period in order to access timber to be harvested under timber sale licences, and

heading: Publication of forest operations maps by timber sales managers
paragraph: (iii)  conforms to prescribed requirements;

heading: Publication of forest operations maps by timber sales managers
paragraph: (b) make the forest operations map publicly available, in accordance with the regulations, for review and comment.

heading: Publication of forest operations maps by timber sales managers
paragraph: (3) Nothing in this section is intended to limit the authority of a timber sales manager

heading: Publication of forest operations maps by timber sales managers
paragraph: (a) to invite applications for or issue a timber sale licence, or

heading: Publication of forest operations maps by timber sales managers
paragraph: (b) to construct a road.

heading: Exemption from requirement to publish a forest operations map
paragraph:
15.3
		  The minister, in writing, may exempt a person from section 15.1 or 15.2 if the minister considers that timber should be harvested without delay because the timber is in danger of being

heading: Exemption from requirement to publish a forest operations map
paragraph: (a) damaged,

heading: Exemption from requirement to publish a forest operations map
paragraph: (b) significantly reduced in value, or

heading: Exemption from requirement to publish a forest operations map
paragraph: (c) lost or destroyed.

heading: Approval of forest stewardship plan, woodlot licence plan or amendment
paragraph:
16
		  (1) Subject to subsection (1.02), the minister must approve a forest stewardship plan or an amendment to a forest stewardship plan if satisfied of all of the following:

heading: Approval of forest stewardship plan, woodlot licence plan or amendment
paragraph: (a) the plan meets the requirements set out in section 5;

heading: Approval of forest stewardship plan, woodlot licence plan or amendment
paragraph: (b) the person who submitted the plan has complied with section 18 (1) and (2);

heading: Approval of forest stewardship plan, woodlot licence plan or amendment
paragraph: (c) the person who submitted the plan has given sufficient consideration to

heading: Approval of forest stewardship plan, woodlot licence plan or amendment
paragraph: (i)  matters raised by Indigenous nations during engagement under section 18 (1) (a), and

heading: Approval of forest stewardship plan, woodlot licence plan or amendment
paragraph: (ii)  comments received from the public under section 18 (1) (b).

heading: Approval of forest stewardship plan, woodlot licence plan or amendment
paragraph: (1.02) The minister may not under subsection (1) approve the following:

heading: Approval of forest stewardship plan, woodlot licence plan or amendment
paragraph: (a) a forest stewardship plan if a portion of a forest development unit included in the plan would be within a forest landscape area or an area of land that was formerly a forest landscape area;

heading: Approval of forest stewardship plan, woodlot licence plan or amendment
paragraph: (b) an amendment to a forest stewardship plan if, as a result of the amendment, a portion of a forest development unit included in the plan would be within a forest landscape area or an area of land that was formerly a forest landscape area.

heading: Approval of forest stewardship plan, woodlot licence plan or amendment
paragraph: (1.1) The minister must approve a woodlot licence plan or an amendment to a woodlot licence plan if it conforms to section 13.

heading: Approval of forest stewardship plan, woodlot licence plan or amendment
paragraph: (2) A forest stewardship plan, a woodlot licence plan or an amendment to either that is submitted to the minister for approval must be considered to have conformed to this Act, the regulations, the standards and the objectives set by government if the plan or amendment conforms to the relevant provisions of this Act, the regulations, the standards and the objectives as they were 4 months before the date of the submission of the plan or amendment to the minister.

heading: Approval of forest stewardship plan, woodlot licence plan or amendment
paragraph: (2.01) The Lieutenant Governor in Council, by order, may declare that a forest stewardship plan, a woodlot licence plan or an amendment to either that is submitted to the minister for approval, despite subsection (2), must immediately conform to some or all of this Act, the regulations, the standards and the objectives set by government as set out in the order.

heading: Approval of forest stewardship plan, woodlot licence plan or amendment
paragraph: (2.1) Except in prescribed circumstances, before approving a plan or amendment, the minister may require the holder of a proposed plan or amendment to submit information that the minister reasonably requires in order to determine if the proposed plan or amendment conforms to subsection (1) or (1.1), whichever is applicable.

heading: Approval of forest stewardship plan, woodlot licence plan or amendment
paragraph: (3) The minister must give written reasons for refusing to approve a forest stewardship plan, a woodlot licence plan or an amendment to either.

heading: Approval in emergency cases
paragraph:
17
		  If the minister determines that timber subject to a forest stewardship plan, a woodlot licence plan, or an amendment to either should be harvested without delay because it is in danger of being damaged, significantly reduced in value, lost or destroyed, the minister, in prescribed circumstances, may approve the plan or amendment even though the plan or amendment does not comply with section 16.

heading: Engagement on and review of forest stewardship plans
paragraph:
18
		  (1) A person must not submit to the minister for approval a forest stewardship plan, or an amendment to a forest stewardship plan, unless the person has done the following, in accordance with the regulations:

heading: Engagement on and review of forest stewardship plans
paragraph: (a) made reasonable efforts to engage with Indigenous nations affected by the plan;

heading: Engagement on and review of forest stewardship plans
paragraph: (b) made the plan publicly available for review and comment.

heading: Engagement on and review of forest stewardship plans
paragraph: (2) In submitting a forest stewardship plan or amendment to the minister for approval, the person submitting the plan or amendment must include the following:

heading: Engagement on and review of forest stewardship plans
paragraph: (a) a summary of the engagement referred to in subsection (1) (a) and a description of any changes made to the plan to address matters raised by Indigenous nations;

heading: Engagement on and review of forest stewardship plans
paragraph: (b) a summary of the public review and comment referred to in subsection (1) (b) and a description of any changes made to the plan to address comments received from the public.

heading: Engagement on and review of forest stewardship plans
paragraph: (3) If the minister requests a person to resubmit a forest stewardship plan or amendment to address changes requested by the minister, the minister may relieve the person from the requirements under subsections (1) and (2) for the purposes of resubmitting the plan or amendment.

heading: Minor amendments to forest stewardship and woodlot licence plans
paragraph:
20
		  (1) Despite section 16, except in prescribed circumstances, an approval is not required to amend a forest stewardship plan or a woodlot licence plan if its holder determines that

heading: Minor amendments to forest stewardship and woodlot licence plans
paragraph: (a) the proposed amendment

heading: Minor amendments to forest stewardship and woodlot licence plans
paragraph: (i)  conforms to section 5, for an amendment to a forest stewardship plan, or to section 13, for an amendment to a woodlot licence plan, and

heading: Minor amendments to forest stewardship and woodlot licence plans
paragraph: (ii)  does not materially change the intended results or strategies specified in the plan, or

heading: Minor amendments to forest stewardship and woodlot licence plans
paragraph: (b) the proposed amendment conforms to prescribed requirements.

heading: Minor amendments to forest stewardship and woodlot licence plans
paragraph: (2) The holder of a forest stewardship plan or a woodlot licence plan must provide the district manager with a copy of the amendment as soon as practicable after it has been incorporated in the plan.

heading: Minor amendments to forest stewardship and woodlot licence plans
paragraph: (3) The minister may take action in accordance with the regulations if the minister considers that the decision under subsection (1) was wrongly made.

heading: Definitions for Part 2.1
paragraph:
20.2
		  In this Part:

heading: Definitions for Part 2.1
paragraph: "licence area", in relation to a timber sale licence, means the area of land subject to the licence;

heading: Definitions for Part 2.1
paragraph: "permit area", in relation to a cutting permit or road permit, means the area of land subject to the permit;

heading: Definitions for Part 2.1
paragraph: "plan area" means,

heading: Definitions for Part 2.1
paragraph: (a) in relation to a forest operations plan, the forest operations area, and

heading: Definitions for Part 2.1
paragraph: (b) in relation to a forest stewardship plan or woodlot licence plan, the area to which the plan applies.

heading: Compliance with forest operations plans
paragraph:
20.21
		  (1) The holder of a forest operations plan must do the following:

heading: Compliance with forest operations plans
paragraph: (a) comply with the requirements included in the plan;

heading: Compliance with forest operations plans
paragraph: (b) comply with any other provision in the plan that relates to a requirement referred to in paragraph (a).

heading: Compliance with forest operations plans
paragraph: (2) Subject to subsection (4), if a forest operations plan expires, the obligation under subsection (1) continues to apply to the person who held the expired plan in relation to the requirements and other provisions in the plan as they read immediately before the plan expired.

heading: Compliance with forest operations plans
paragraph: (3) Subject to subsection (4), if a forest operations plan is amended to remove a person as a holder of the plan, the obligation under subsection (1) continues to apply to the person in relation to the requirements and other provisions in the plan as they read immediately before the person was removed as a holder.

heading: Compliance with forest operations plans
paragraph: (4) A person is not required to comply with an obligation that continues under subsection (2) or (3) if

heading: Compliance with forest operations plans
paragraph: (a) the person holds another forest operations plan that applies to the same area to which the obligation relates, and

heading: Compliance with forest operations plans
paragraph: (b) the other forest operations plan includes a requirement or other provision that is identified as being a replacement for the requirement or other provision to which the obligation relates.

heading: Compliance with forest operations plans
paragraph: (5) For the purposes of an obligation that continues under subsection (2) or (3), a requirement or other provision referred to in subsection (1) may, as applicable, be amended as if

heading: Compliance with forest operations plans
paragraph: (a) the forest operations plan had not expired, or

heading: Compliance with forest operations plans
paragraph: (b) the person had not been removed as a holder of the forest operations plan.

heading: Compliance with forest stewardship plans and woodlot licence plans
paragraph:
20.22
		  (1) The holder of a forest stewardship plan or woodlot licence plan must do the following:

heading: Compliance with forest stewardship plans and woodlot licence plans
paragraph: (a) ensure that the intended results specified in the plan are achieved;

heading: Compliance with forest stewardship plans and woodlot licence plans
paragraph: (b) carry out the strategies described in the plan;

heading: Compliance with forest stewardship plans and woodlot licence plans
paragraph: (c) comply with any other provision in the plan that relates to a result or strategy referred to in paragraph (a) or (b).

heading: Compliance with forest stewardship plans and woodlot licence plans
paragraph: (2) Subject to subsection (4), if a forest stewardship plan or woodlot licence plan expires, the obligation under subsection (1) continues to apply to the person who held the expired plan in relation to the results, strategies and other provisions in the plan as they read immediately before the plan expired.

heading: Compliance with forest stewardship plans and woodlot licence plans
paragraph: (3) Subject to subsection (4), if a forest stewardship plan is amended to remove a person as the holder of the plan, the obligation under subsection (1) continues to apply to the person in relation to the results, strategies and other provisions in the plan as they read immediately before the person was removed as a holder.

heading: Compliance with forest stewardship plans and woodlot licence plans
paragraph: (4) A person is not required to comply with an obligation that continues under subsection (2) or (3) if

heading: Compliance with forest stewardship plans and woodlot licence plans
paragraph: (a) the person holds another forest stewardship plan or woodlot licence plan, or a forest operations plan, that applies to the same area to which the obligation relates, and

heading: Compliance with forest stewardship plans and woodlot licence plans
paragraph: (b) that other plan includes a provision that is identified as being a replacement for the result, strategy or other provision to which the obligation relates.

heading: Compliance with forest stewardship plans and woodlot licence plans
paragraph: (5) For the purposes of an obligation that continues under subsection (2), a result, strategy or other provision referred to in subsection (1) may be amended as if the forest stewardship plan or woodlot licence plan had not expired.

heading: Plans that apply to issued permits and licences
paragraph:
20.23
		  (1) If a forest operations plan, forest stewardship plan or woodlot licence plan applies to a portion of the permit area of a cutting permit or road permit on the following date, the plan, as it read on that date, continues to apply in relation to the activities carried out under the permit in the portion despite any subsequent amendment, replacement or expiration of the plan:

heading: Plans that apply to issued permits and licences
paragraph: (a) unless paragraph (b) applies, the date on which the permit is issued;

heading: Plans that apply to issued permits and licences
paragraph: (b) if the portion was added to the permit area by an amendment to the permit, the date on which the permit was amended.

heading: Plans that apply to issued permits and licences
paragraph: (2) If a forest operations plan or forest stewardship plan applies to the licence area of a timber sale licence on the date the licence is advertised, the plan, as it read on that date, continues to apply to the licence area despite any subsequent amendment, replacement or expiration of the plan.

heading: Exemption from requirement to amend operational plan
paragraph:
20.24
		  The requirement under section 2.45 (1), 8 (1) or 15 (2) to propose and submit amendments to a forest operations plan, forest stewardship plan or woodlot licence plan, as applicable, does not apply to a portion of the plan area if

heading: Exemption from requirement to amend operational plan
paragraph: (a) the portion is

heading: Exemption from requirement to amend operational plan
paragraph: (i)  a permit area of a cutting permit or road permit, or

heading: Exemption from requirement to amend operational plan
paragraph: (ii)  a licence area of a timber sale licence,

heading: Exemption from requirement to amend operational plan
paragraph: (b) a road referred to in section 20.27 exists on the portion, or

heading: Exemption from requirement to amend operational plan
paragraph: (c) the portion conforms to prescribed criteria.

heading: Planning documents made available to the public
paragraph:
20.25
		  (1) In this section, "plan" means any of the following:

heading: Planning documents made available to the public
paragraph: (a) a forest operations plan;

heading: Planning documents made available to the public
paragraph: (b) a forest stewardship plan;

heading: Planning documents made available to the public
paragraph: (c) a woodlot licence plan;

heading: Planning documents made available to the public
paragraph: (d) a site level plan referred to in section 2.52;

heading: Planning documents made available to the public
paragraph: (e) a site plan referred to in section 10.

heading: Planning documents made available to the public
paragraph: (2) A person, other than a timber sales manager, who holds a plan must make the plan publicly available in accordance with the regulations.

heading: Planning documents made available to the public
paragraph: (3) A timber sales manager who holds a plan must publish the plan on a ministry website.

heading: Additional parties to plans
paragraph:
20.26
		  (1) Subject to subsections (2) and (3), if a forest operations plan, forest stewardship plan or woodlot licence plan has been approved by the minister, a person may be added or removed as a party to the plan only if an amendment to add or remove the person as a party to the plan is approved by the minister.

heading: Additional parties to plans
paragraph: (2) Unless the regulations provide otherwise, a forest operations plan may be held only by one person.

heading: Additional parties to plans
paragraph: (3) A woodlot licence plan may be held only by the holder of the woodlot licence to which the plan relates.

heading: Roads constructed by the minister for accessing timber sale licences
paragraph:
20.27
		  An approval or refusal to approve a forest operations plan, a forest stewardship plan or an amendment to a forest operations plan or forest stewardship plan does not affect the minister's discretion under section 121 of the Forest Act to construct a road to provide access to an area to be harvested under a timber sale licence.

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph:
21.1
		  (1) In this Division:

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: "construct", in relation to a road, includes to modify the road;

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: "forest resource road" means a road, other than a road referred to in subsection (2), that is

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: (a) on Crown land in a Provincial forest,

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: (b) outside a Provincial forest and for the purpose of providing access to timber on Crown land,

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: (c) on private land that is subject to an agreement under the Forest Act, or

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: (d) subject to a requirement for a special use permit;

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: "major culvert" has the prescribed meaning;

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: "modify", in relation to a road, includes

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: (a) to widen the running surface of the road,

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: (b) to realign or reconstruct a portion of the road, and

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: (c) to install or replace a bridge or major culvert associated with the road;

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: "natural resource development purpose", in relation to a road, means use of the road for any of the following purposes:

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: (a) developing a natural resource other than timber;

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: (b) transporting a natural resource other than timber;

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: (c) transporting equipment, materials or personnel associated with an activity referred to in paragraph (a) or (b);

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: "right of way", in relation to a road, means one of the following:

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: (a) unless paragraph (b) applies, the Crown land in the area that is

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: (i)  the length of the road, and

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: (ii)  37.5 metres on each side of the centre line of the road;

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: (b) if a road permit shows or describes the road corridor in which the road may be constructed, the Crown land in that road corridor;

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: "road prism", in relation to a road, means the area consisting of

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: (a) the road surface, and

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: (b) any cut slope and road fill;

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: "significant road work", in relation to a forest service road, means the following:

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: (a) modifying the forest service road;

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: (b) constructing works in the road prism or right of way of the forest service road;

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: (c) connecting a road to the forest service road;

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: "silviculture purpose", in relation to a road, means use of the road for either of the following purposes:

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: (a) providing access for tree planting that requires more than 12 months to complete;

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: (b) transporting machinery associated with silviculture treatments;

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: "timber harvesting purpose", in relation to a road, means use of the road for any of the following purposes:

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: (a) timber harvesting;

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: (b) transporting timber;

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: (c) transporting equipment, materials or personnel associated with an activity referred to in paragraph (a) or (b).

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: (2) The following roads are excluded from the definition of "forest resource road" in subsection (1):

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: (a) a forest service road;

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: (b) a road authorized under the Land Act;

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: (c) a provincial public highway within the meaning of the Transportation Act;

heading: Definitions for Division 2
paragraph: (d) a road constructed or maintained under the Community Charter;

heading: Restriction on use, construction, maintenance and deactivation of roads
paragraph: (2) A person must not use, construct, maintain or deactivate a road except in accordance with this Act, the regulations, the standards and any forest operations plan, forest stewardship plan or woodlot licence plan, if the road is

heading: Restriction on use, construction, maintenance and deactivation of roads
paragraph: (a) a forest service road, or

heading: Restriction on use, construction, maintenance and deactivation of roads
paragraph: (b) a forest resource road.

heading: Use of forest service roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph:
22.1
		  (1) A person must not use a forest service road for a timber harvesting purpose, silviculture purpose or natural resource development purpose unless one of the following applies:

heading: Use of forest service roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (a) the person is authorized to use the road under a road use permit;

heading: Use of forest service roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (b) the person is granted an exemption under subsection (2).

heading: Use of forest service roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (2) The minister may grant an exemption to a person for the purposes of subsection (1) (b) if satisfied that the person's use of the forest service road will not

heading: Use of forest service roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (a) unnecessarily impact forest resources,

heading: Use of forest service roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (b) materially affect the use of the road by others, or

heading: Use of forest service roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (c) materially increase the need for road maintenance.

heading: Use of forest service roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (3) A person granted an exemption under subsection (2) must comply with any conditions of the exemption imposed by the minister.

heading: Use of forest service roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (4) Subsection (1) does not apply to a person if the person's use of the forest service road is related to operations associated with an agreement under the Range Act.

heading: Use of forest resource roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: 22.11		  (1) A person must not use a forest resource road for a timber harvesting purpose or silviculture purpose unless one of the following applies:

heading: Use of forest resource roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (a) the person is authorized to use the road under

heading: Use of forest resource roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (i)  a road permit,

heading: Use of forest resource roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (ii)  a cutting permit,

heading: Use of forest resource roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (iii)  a woodlot licence,

heading: Use of forest resource roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (iv)  a timber sale licence, or

heading: Use of forest resource roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (v)  a forestry licence to cut;

heading: Use of forest resource roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (b) the road is authorized under any of the following held by another person:

heading: Use of forest resource roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (i)  a permit or licence referred to in paragraph (a) (i) to (iv);

heading: Use of forest resource roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (ii)  a special use permit;

heading: Use of forest resource roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (c) the person is granted an exemption under subsection (3).

heading: Use of forest resource roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (2) A person must not use a forest resource road for a natural resource development purpose unless one of the following applies:

heading: Use of forest resource roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (a) the person is authorized to use the road under a special use permit;

heading: Use of forest resource roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (b) the road is authorized under any of the following held by another person:

heading: Use of forest resource roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (i)  a road permit;

heading: Use of forest resource roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (ii)  a woodlot licence;

heading: Use of forest resource roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (iii)  a special use permit;

heading: Use of forest resource roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (c) the road

heading: Use of forest resource roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (i)  was constructed under the authority of the Coal Act, Mineral Tenure Act, Mines Act or Mining Right of Way Act,

heading: Use of forest resource roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (ii)  is located within the boundary of a claim, lease, permit or other authorization granted or issued under an Act specified in subparagraph (i), and

heading: Use of forest resource roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (iii)  is being used for the purposes of developing a natural resource, other than timber, under the applicable authorization specified in subparagraph (ii);

heading: Use of forest resource roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (d) the road is authorized under the Geothermal Resources Act or Petroleum and Natural Gas Act;

heading: Use of forest resource roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (e) the person is granted an exemption under subsection (3).

heading: Use of forest resource roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (3) The minister may grant an exemption to a person for the purposes of subsection (1) (c) or (2) (e) if satisfied that the person's use of the forest resource road will not unnecessarily impact forest resources.

heading: Use of forest resource roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (4) A person who is granted an exemption under subsection (3) must do the following:

heading: Use of forest resource roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (a) maintain the road, for the duration of the person's use of the road, in accordance with the regulations and any applicable forest operations plan, forest stewardship plan or woodlot licence plan;

heading: Use of forest resource roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (b) comply with any conditions of the exemption imposed by the minister.

heading: Use of forest resource roads for timber harvesting, silviculture or natural resource development purposes
paragraph: (5) Subsection (1) does not apply to a person if the person's use of the forest resource road is for a timber harvesting purpose related to operations associated with an agreement under the Range Act.

heading: Notice of use of forest service road or road authorized under permit or licence
paragraph: 22.12		  (1) A person who intends to use a forest service road for a timber harvesting purpose, silviculture purpose or natural resource development purpose must provide notice to the following, in accordance with subsection (3):

heading: Notice of use of forest service road or road authorized under permit or licence
paragraph: (a) the minister;

heading: Notice of use of forest service road or road authorized under permit or licence
paragraph: (b) if applicable, the holder of a road use permit to whom the obligation to maintain the forest service road has been transferred.

heading: Notice of use of forest service road or road authorized under permit or licence
paragraph: (2) If a road is authorized under any of the following permits or licences, a person who intends to use the road for a timber harvesting purpose, silviculture purpose or natural resource development purpose must provide notice to the holder of the permit or licence, in accordance with subsection (3):

heading: Notice of use of forest service road or road authorized under permit or licence
paragraph: (a) a road permit;

heading: Notice of use of forest service road or road authorized under permit or licence
paragraph: (b) a cutting permit;

heading: Notice of use of forest service road or road authorized under permit or licence
paragraph: (c) a woodlot licence;

heading: Notice of use of forest service road or road authorized under permit or licence
paragraph: (d) a timber sale licence;

heading: Notice of use of forest service road or road authorized under permit or licence
paragraph: (e) a special use permit.

heading: Notice of use of forest service road or road authorized under permit or licence
paragraph: (3) A notice required under subsection (1) or (2) must

heading: Notice of use of forest service road or road authorized under permit or licence
paragraph: (a) be given on or before the earlier of the following:

heading: Notice of use of forest service road or road authorized under permit or licence
paragraph: (i)  the date that is 6 days before the date on which the person will begin to use the road;

heading: Notice of use of forest service road or road authorized under permit or licence
paragraph: (ii)  the prescribed date, if any,

heading: Notice of use of forest service road or road authorized under permit or licence
paragraph: (b) be given in the prescribed form and manner, if any, and

heading: Notice of use of forest service road or road authorized under permit or licence
paragraph: (c) specify the date on which the person will begin using the road.

heading: Notice of use of forest service road or road authorized under permit or licence
paragraph: (4) Subsections (1) and (2) do not apply to a person if the person's use of the road is related to operations associated with an agreement under the Range Act.

heading: Non-industrial use of a road
paragraph: 22.2		  (1) Subject to subsections (2) to (4) and to regulations respecting roads made under the Industrial Roads Act, a road that is

heading: Non-industrial use of a road
paragraph: (a) a forest service road, or

heading: Non-industrial use of a road
paragraph: (b) authorized under a road permit or a woodlot licence

heading: Non-industrial use of a road
paragraph: may be used by any person without charge for a purpose other than a timber harvesting purpose, silviculture purpose or natural resource development purpose.

heading: Non-industrial use of a road
paragraph: (2) The

heading: Non-industrial use of a road
paragraph: (a) district manager, for a forest service road, or

heading: Non-industrial use of a road
paragraph: (b) holder of a road permit or a woodlot licence, for a road under the permit or licence,

heading: Non-industrial use of a road
paragraph: may take action under subsection (3) if

heading: Non-industrial use of a road
paragraph: (c) use of the road under subsection (1) would likely

heading: Non-industrial use of a road
paragraph: (i)  cause significant damage to the road,

heading: Non-industrial use of a road
paragraph: (ii)  cause significant sediment delivery, or

heading: Non-industrial use of a road
paragraph: (iii)  endanger property, public health or public safety, or

heading: Non-industrial use of a road
paragraph: (d) the presence on the road of a vehicle or animal would likely cause damage to the road or environment or endanger life or property.

heading: Non-industrial use of a road
paragraph: (3) In the circumstances described in subsection (2),

heading: Non-industrial use of a road
paragraph: (a) the district manager, for a forest service road, may

heading: Non-industrial use of a road
paragraph: (i)  close the road or restrict its use, or

heading: Non-industrial use of a road
paragraph: (ii)  remove a vehicle or an animal from the road at the expense of the owner of the vehicle or animal, and

heading: Non-industrial use of a road
paragraph: (b) the holder of a road permit or a woodlot licence, for a road under the permit or licence,

heading: Non-industrial use of a road
paragraph: (i)  with the prior consent of the minister, may close the road or restrict its use, or

heading: Non-industrial use of a road
paragraph: (ii)  may remove a vehicle or an animal from the road at the expense of the owner of the vehicle or animal.

heading: Non-industrial use of a road
paragraph: (4) The minister, in accordance with the regulations, may specify types of expenses that must be paid to

heading: Non-industrial use of a road
paragraph: (a) government for a road referred to in subsection (1) (a),

heading: Non-industrial use of a road
paragraph: (b) a holder of a permit or licence referred to in subsection (1) (b), or

heading: Non-industrial use of a road
paragraph: (c) other persons who meet prescribed requirements

heading: Non-industrial use of a road
paragraph: by a person who uses a road or class of roads for a purpose other than a timber harvesting purpose, silviculture purpose or natural resource development purpose.

heading: Notice of requirement for payment by user of road
paragraph: 22.3		  (0.1) In this section, "person responsible for maintaining a road" means the following:

heading: Notice of requirement for payment by user of road
paragraph: (a) in relation to a road authorized under a road permit, the holder of the permit;

heading: Notice of requirement for payment by user of road
paragraph: (b) in relation to a road authorized under a woodlot licence, the holder of the licence;

heading: Notice of requirement for payment by user of road
paragraph: (c) in relation to a forest service road, the holder of a road use permit to whom the obligation to maintain the forest service road has been transferred, if applicable;

heading: Notice of requirement for payment by user of road
paragraph: (d) in relation to a prescribed forest service road, the minister.

heading: Notice of requirement for payment by user of road
paragraph: (1) By written notice in accordance with this section, the person responsible for maintaining a road may require payment, within the limits imposed under subsection (2) (b), from a person who uses the road for

heading: Notice of requirement for payment by user of road
paragraph: (a) a timber harvesting purpose, silviculture purpose or natural resource development purpose, or

heading: Significant road work in relation to forest service roads
paragraph:
23.1
		  (1) A person must not carry out significant road work in relation to a forest service road unless one of the following applies:

heading: Significant road work in relation to forest service roads
paragraph: (a) the person is authorized under subsection (2) by the minister to carry out the significant road work;

heading: Significant road work in relation to forest service roads
paragraph: (b) the person is authorized under the regulations to carry out the significant road work.

heading: Significant road work in relation to forest service roads
paragraph: (2) The minister may, on application, authorize a person to carry out significant road work in relation to a forest service road.

heading: Significant road work in relation to forest service roads
paragraph: (3) The minister, in granting an authorization under subsection (2), may impose under section 112 (1) one or more of the following conditions:

heading: Significant road work in relation to forest service roads
paragraph: (a) that the person give an indemnity to the government for losses or damages sustained by the government, or for claims for losses or damages made against the government, arising out of the significant road work;

heading: Significant road work in relation to forest service roads
paragraph: (4) If a person is authorized under subsection (2) to carry out significant road work in relation to a forest service road, the minister may authorize the person to use sand, gravel, rock or other materials in the road right of way for the purposes of carrying out the significant road work.

heading: Significant road work in relation to forest service roads

heading: Order to deactivate road
paragraph:

		  (1) The minister may, by order, require the holder of an agreement under the Forest Act to deactivate a road authorized or constructed under the agreement.

heading: Order to deactivate road
paragraph: (a) the location of the road;

heading: Order to deactivate road

paragraph: 23.3		  (1) The minister may exempt the holder of an agreement under the Forest Act from a requirement under this Act or the Forest Act that relates to the deactivation of a road authorized or constructed under the agreement.

heading: Sanitation exemption
paragraph: 25		  The minister may exempt a person in writing from specified provisions of this Act, the regulations or the standards if the minister considers it necessary or desirable so that the person may follow a course of action specified by the minister for the purposes of limiting or mitigating or both limiting and mitigating the spread of forest pests.

heading: Control of insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors
paragraph:
26
		  (1) If the minister determines that a forested area on private land is being damaged by insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors, the minister, by written notice given to the owner, may require the owner to submit, for that forested area, a proposal that conforms to subsection (3) to control or dispose of the insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors.

heading: Control of insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors
paragraph: (2) If the minister determines that on a forested area on Crown land that is subject to

heading: Control of insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors
paragraph: (a) a forest operations plan,

heading: Control of insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors
paragraph: (a.1) a forest stewardship plan,

heading: Control of insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors
paragraph: (b) a woodlot licence plan, or

heading: Control of insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors
paragraph: (c) another prescribed operational plan

heading: Control of insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors
paragraph: there are insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors that are causing damage to the forest, the minister, by written notice given to the holder of the plan, may require the holder to submit, for that forested area, a proposal that conforms to subsection (3) to control or dispose of the insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors.

heading: Control of insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors
paragraph: (3) An owner required under subsection (1), or a holder required under subsection (2), to submit a proposal must

heading: Control of insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors
paragraph: (a) submit the proposal to the minister within the period specified by the minister,

heading: Control of insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors
paragraph: (b) in the proposal, specify reasonable measures to be carried out for that forested area by the owner or holder, as the case may be, to control or dispose of the insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors, and

heading: Control of insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors
paragraph: (c) state the time frame within which the measures are to be completed.

heading: Control of insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors
paragraph: (4) The minister may approve or reject a proposal received in response to the minister's written notice given under subsection (1) or  (2).

heading: Control of insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors
paragraph: (5) If the minister approves a proposal under subsection (3), the owner or holder who made the proposal must carry out the measures specified in the proposal.

heading: Control of insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors
paragraph: (6) By order, given to

heading: Control of insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors
paragraph: (a) an owner of private land referred to in subsection (1), or

heading: Control of insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors
paragraph: (b) a holder of a plan referred to in subsection (2)

heading: Control of insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors
paragraph: who does not submit a proposal as required under subsection (1) or (2) or who does not comply with subsection (5), the minister may require the owner or holder to carry out measures specified in the order by a date specified in the order.

heading: Control of insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors
paragraph: (7) If the minister approves a proposal submitted under subsection (3) or makes an order under subsection (6), the minister may, to the extent the minister considers necessary or desirable to facilitate the carrying out of the proposal or order, exempt the affected owner or holder from complying with one or more of the following provisions:

heading: Control of insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors
paragraph: (a) a provision of this Act, the regulations or the standards;

heading: Control of insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors
paragraph: (b) a provision of an agreement under the Forest Act;

heading: Control of insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors
paragraph: (c) a provision of the Forest Act that requires the owner or holder to

heading: Control of insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors
paragraph: (i)  obtain a cutting permit, or

heading: Control of insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors
paragraph: (ii)  comply with a provision referred to in paragraph (b);

heading: Control of insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors
paragraph: (c.1) a provision of a forest operations plan;

heading: Control of insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors
paragraph: (d) a provision of a forest stewardship plan;

heading: Control of insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors
paragraph: (e) a provision of a woodlot licence plan.

heading: Control of insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors
paragraph: (8) If the minister makes an order under subsection (6) that is inconsistent with a provision referred to in subsection (7), the minister must, in making the order, exempt the affected owner or holder from the provision.

heading: Control of insects, diseases, animals or abiotic factors
paragraph: (9) If a proposal approved, or an order made, by the minister under this section requires the holder of an agreement under the Forest Act to carry out a measure other than timber harvesting, then to the extent provided in the regulations, the expenses of the measure are to be paid by the government.

heading: Forest health emergency
paragraph: 27		  (1) If the Lieutenant Governor in Council considers that a forest health emergency exists in an area of Crown land or private land, he or she may designate the area by regulation as a forest health emergency management area.

heading: Forest health emergency
paragraph: (2) The minister may order

heading: Forest health emergency
paragraph: (a) the holder of an agreement under the Forest Act that authorizes timber harvesting in the emergency management area, or

heading: Forest health emergency
paragraph: (b) the timber sales manager

heading: Forest health emergency
paragraph: to carry out measures in the emergency management area, limited in the case of the holder, to the area of the holder's agreement, to prevent, contain or limit the spread of forest health factors.

heading: Forest health emergency
paragraph: (3) An order under subsection (2) must specify

heading: Forest health emergency
paragraph: (a) the measures to be carried out,

heading: Forest health emergency
paragraph: (b) the date by which the measures must be completed, and

heading: Forest health emergency
paragraph: (c) the person's right to a review under section 80 or to an appeal under section 82.

heading: Forest health emergency
paragraph: (4) A person is exempt from a provision referred to in section 26 (7) if compliance with the provision would prevent the person from carrying out the measures referred to in subsection (2) of this section.

heading: Forest health emergency
paragraph: (5) If an order made by the minister under this section requires the holder of an agreement under the Forest Act or the timber sales manager to carry out a measure other than timber harvesting, then to the extent provided in the regulations, the expenses of the measure are to be paid by the government.

heading: Property in trees
paragraph: 28		  Trees established on Crown land under section 29 or 30 of this Act are the property of the government.

heading: Free growing stands
paragraph:
29
		  (0.1) The holder of an agreement within the meaning of section 2.2 who harvests timber to which a forest operations plan applies must establish, in accordance with the plan, the prescribed requirements and the standards, a free growing stand on those portions of the area of the harvest that are in the net area to be reforested.

heading: Free growing stands
paragraph: (1) The holder of an agreement within the meaning of section 3 who harvests timber to which a forest stewardship plan applies must establish, in accordance with the plan, the prescribed requirements and the standards, a free growing stand on those portions of the area of the harvest that are in the net area to be reforested.

heading: Free growing stands
paragraph: (2) A timber sales manager who is the holder of a forest operations plan or forest stewardship plan must establish, in accordance with the plan, the prescribed requirements and the standards, a free growing stand on those portions of the area of the harvest under the plan that are in the net area to be reforested.

heading: Free growing stands
paragraph: (3) A holder of a woodlot licence who harvests timber under the licence must establish a free growing stand on those portions of the area of the harvest that are in the net area to be reforested in accordance with

heading: Free growing stands
paragraph: (a) the woodlot licence plan, if any, that is pertinent to the licence,

heading: Free growing stands
paragraph: (b) the prescribed requirements, and

heading: Free growing stands
paragraph: (c) the standards.

heading: Transfer of obligation to establish a free growing stand
paragraph:
29.1
		  (1) A person who, under section 29 or Part 11, has an obligation to establish a free growing stand may transfer the obligation to another person by agreement if

heading: Transfer of obligation to establish a free growing stand
paragraph: (a) the agreement to transfer is in writing,

heading: Transfer of obligation to establish a free growing stand
paragraph: (b) the transfer meets the prescribed requirements, and

heading: Transfer of obligation to establish a free growing stand
paragraph: (c) the parties to the agreement submit it to the minister and the minister approves it.

heading: Transfer of obligation to establish a free growing stand
paragraph: (2) An agreement referred to in subsection (1) has no effect if it does not receive the minister's approval under subsection (1) (c).

heading: Transfer of obligation to establish a free growing stand
paragraph: (3) A person to whom an obligation to establish a free growing stand was transferred by agreement under this section may transfer the obligation by agreement to another person if

heading: Transfer of obligation to establish a free growing stand
paragraph: (a) the latter agreement to transfer is in writing,

heading: Transfer of obligation to establish a free growing stand
paragraph: (b) the transfer meets the prescribed requirements, and

heading: Transfer of obligation to establish a free growing stand
paragraph: (c) the parties to the latter agreement submit it to the minister and the minister approves it.

heading: Transfer of obligation to establish a free growing stand
paragraph: (4) An agreement referred to in subsection (3) has no effect if it does not receive the minister's approval under subsection (3) (c).

heading: Transfer of obligation to establish a free growing stand
paragraph: (5) Without limiting subsections (1) (b) and (3) (b), the transfer must include the stocking requirements that pertain to the area.

heading: Transfer of obligation to establish a free growing stand
paragraph: (6) A person to whom an obligation to establish a free growing stand is transferred under this section may amend the stocking requirements that pertain to the area.

heading: Transfer of obligation to establish a free growing stand
paragraph: (7) If the minister approves an agreement under subsection (1) (c) or (3) (c), the person who transferred the obligation is no longer required, as of the date of the approval, to meet the obligation.

heading: Transfer of obligation to establish a free growing stand
paragraph: (8) If the minister approves an agreement under subsection (1) (c) or (3) (c) and the person to whom the obligation is transferred is the holder of an agreement listed in section 12 of the Forest Act,

heading: Transfer of obligation to establish a free growing stand
paragraph: (a) the transferred obligation is conclusively deemed to be an obligation under the holder's agreement, and

heading: Transfer of obligation to establish a free growing stand
paragraph: (b) any security provided in respect of the holder's agreement is conclusively deemed to be security for the purposes of the transferred obligation,

heading: Transfer of obligation to establish a free growing stand
paragraph: except in prescribed circumstances.

heading: Free growing stands for non-replaceable licences
paragraph: 30		  (1) In this section, "licence holder" means a person who

heading: Free growing stands for non-replaceable licences
paragraph: (a) is the holder of a timber licence, forestry licence to cut, non-replaceable forest licence, non-replaceable woodlot licence or non-replaceable timber sale licence,

heading: Free growing stands for non-replaceable licences
paragraph: (b) is not the holder of a replaceable tree farm licence or a replaceable forest licence,

heading: Free growing stands for non-replaceable licences
paragraph: (c) has an obligation under section 29 to establish a free growing stand on an area harvested under the timber licence, forestry licence to cut, non-replaceable forest licence, non-replaceable woodlot licence or non-replaceable timber sale licence, and

heading: Free growing stands for non-replaceable licences
paragraph: (d) meets prescribed requirements, if any.

heading: Free growing stands for non-replaceable licences
paragraph: (2) A licence holder may request that the government assume responsibility for carrying out the obligation under section 29 to establish a free growing stand

heading: Free growing stands for non-replaceable licences
paragraph: (a) by notice given to the district manager, or

heading: Free growing stands for non-replaceable licences
paragraph: (b) by notice given to the timber sales manager if the licence is a

heading: Free growing stands for non-replaceable licences
paragraph: (i)  non-replaceable forest licence, or

heading: Free growing stands for non-replaceable licences
paragraph: (ii)  forestry licence to cut

heading: Free growing stands for non-replaceable licences
paragraph: that is a BC timber sales agreement.

heading: Free growing stands for non-replaceable licences
paragraph: (3) By notice given to a licence holder within a prescribed period after the holder has made a request under subsection (2), the district manager or timber sales manager in the case of a BC timber sales agreement, may assume on behalf of the government the responsibility for establishing the free growing stand if all of the following requirements have been met:

heading: Free growing stands for non-replaceable licences
paragraph: (a) the licence holder has completed timber harvesting on the area and the district manager or a timber sales manager in the case of a BC timber sales agreement, is satisfied with the way the timber harvesting has been carried out;

heading: Free growing stands for non-replaceable licences
paragraph: (b) the district manager or a timber sales manager in the case of a BC timber sales agreement is satisfied that the licence holder

heading: Free growing stands for non-replaceable licences
paragraph: (i)  is in compliance with this Act, regulations and standards with respect to the area, or

heading: Free growing stands for non-replaceable licences
paragraph: (ii)  has remedied any contraventions of this Act, regulations or standards on the area that the minister required to be remedied;

heading: Free growing stands for non-replaceable licences
paragraph: (c) the licence holder has paid the government an amount that the district manager or a timber sales manager in the case of a BC timber sales agreement determines will pay the costs of establishing the free growing stand and any other directly or indirectly associated costs;

heading: Free growing stands for non-replaceable licences
paragraph: (d) other prescribed requirements.

heading: Free growing stands for non-replaceable licences
paragraph: (4) Money collected by the government under subsection (3) must be paid into the Silviculture Payments Sub-account of the Forest Stand Management Fund special account established by the Special Accounts Appropriation and Control Act.

heading: Free growing stands for non-replaceable licences
paragraph: (5) A licence holder to whom notice has been given within the prescribed period referred to in subsection (3) ceases to be responsible for the obligation under section 29 to establish a free growing stand on the first date, after completion of timber harvesting, as described in subsection (3) (a), on which the requirements set out or referred to in subsection (3) (b) to (d) have all been fulfilled.

heading: Free growing stands for non-replaceable licences
paragraph: (6) Compensation is not payable to the government or licence holder for any difference between the amount paid under subsection (3), and the actual costs incurred by the government both directly and indirectly to establish the free growing stand.

heading: Free growing stands for non-replaceable licences
paragraph: (7) A receipt of a request under subsection (2) does not require

heading: Free growing stands for non-replaceable licences

heading: Free growing stands for non-replaceable licences
paragraph: (b) the timber sales manager

heading: Free growing stands for non-replaceable licences
paragraph: to assume, on behalf of government, the obligation under section 29 to establish a free growing stand.

heading: Seed
paragraph: 31		  A person required to establish a free growing stand must ensure that seed used for that purpose conforms to prescribed requirements.

heading: Stocking standards
paragraph:
31.1
		  (1) In prescribed circumstances, the chief forester may, by order, require the holder of a forest stewardship plan to comply with stocking standards set out in the order.

heading: Stocking standards
paragraph: (2) In making an order under subsection (1), the chief forester may exempt the holder of the forest stewardship plan from a stocking standard set out in the plan or the regulations on the condition that the holder complies with the stocking standards set out in the order.

heading: Range use plan and range stewardship plan required
paragraph:
32
		  (1) Before the holder of an agreement under the Range Act grazes livestock or cuts hay on Crown range to which the agreement applies, the holder must prepare, and obtain the minister's approval of,

heading: Range use plan and range stewardship plan required
paragraph: (a) a range use plan, or

heading: Range use plan and range stewardship plan required
paragraph: (b) if subsection (2) applies, a range stewardship plan

heading: Range use plan and range stewardship plan required

heading: Range use plan and range stewardship plan required

heading: Range use plan and range stewardship plan required
paragraph: (a) the person's performance record,

heading: Range use plan and range stewardship plan required
paragraph: (b) the condition of the Crown range to which the range stewardship plan would apply, and whether the person has maintained or improved forage quality and quantity on the Crown range, and

heading: Range use plan and range stewardship plan required

heading: Range use plan and range stewardship plan required
paragraph: (a) has a range stewardship plan for the area that is in effect, and

heading: Range use plan and range stewardship plan required

paragraph: (b) include a schedule that describes for each pasture to be used for grazing of livestock,

heading: Content of range use plan for grazing
paragraph: (i)  the livestock class,

heading: Content of range use plan for grazing
paragraph: (ii)  the number of livestock, and

heading: Content of range use plan for grazing
paragraph: (iii)  the period of use,

heading: Content of range use plan for grazing
paragraph: (c) specify actions to be carried out in the area under the plan to deal with issues identified by the minister,

heading: Content of a range use plan for hay cutting
paragraph: 34		  (1) A range use plan for hay cutting, must

heading: Content of range stewardship plan
paragraph: 35		  (1) A range stewardship plan must

heading: Content of range stewardship plan
paragraph: (a) include a map of a scale and format satisfactory to the minister that

heading: Content of range stewardship plan
paragraph: (i)  shows the area for the agreement under the Range Act that pertains to the plan,

heading: Term of range use plan and range stewardship plan
paragraph: 36		  (1) The term of a range use plan or range stewardship plan is the period, not exceeding 5 years, that the minister specifies at the time of approval.

heading: Term of range use plan and range stewardship plan
paragraph: (2) Despite subsection (1), the minister, in the circumstances and on the conditions, if any, that are prescribed may extend the term of a range use plan or range stewardship plan for an additional period not exceeding 5 years.

heading: Term of range use plan and range stewardship plan
paragraph: (3) The extended range use plan or extended range stewardship plan may include changes to the extent authorized by regulation.

paragraph:
