paragraph: (b) all tenants of the land, if any, and

heading: Public notification requirements - licensee
paragraph: (c) if different from the occupant, the owner or manager of the land or the agent of either.

heading: Public notification requirements - licensee
paragraph: (5.2) For the purposes of subsection (5.1) of this section, the reference in

heading: Public notification requirements - licensee
paragraph: (a) section 63 (1) (e) and (f) to the licensee is to be read, if there is no licensee, as a reference to the certificate holder, and

heading: Public notification requirements - licensee
paragraph: (b) section 63 (1) (e) to the licence number is to be read, if there is no licence, as a reference to the certificate number.

heading: Public notification requirements - licensee
paragraph: (5.3) Subsection (5.1) does not apply if subsection (4) or (5) applies.

heading: Public notification requirements - licensee
paragraph: (6) Before using a pesticide in an outdoor public use area for a use described in section 5 (1) (f), (i) or (l), a licensee must post a treatment notice that complies with section 63 (1) and (2),

heading: Public notification requirements - licensee
paragraph: (a) if the treatment area is fenced, at each gate or opening that provides access to the area, and

heading: Public notification requirements - licensee
paragraph: (b) if the treatment area is not fenced, at intervals around or along the area as necessary so that a notice is clearly visible and will provide notice of the pesticide use to any person approaching the area,

heading: Public notification requirements - licensee
paragraph: which treatment notices must not be removed by the licensee within 48 hours after the pesticide use.

heading: Public notification requirements - licensee
paragraph: (7) At least 72 hours before using a pesticide on the property of a school or a child care facility, a licensee must provide a treatment notice that complies with section 63 (1) to the school or facility administrator, principal or manager or an agent of the administrator, principal or manager.

heading: Public notification requirements - licensee
paragraph: (8) At least 48 hours before using a pesticide on private land to control adult mosquitoes, a licensee must provide a treatment notice that complies with section 63 (1) to

heading: Public notification requirements - licensee
paragraph: (a) the owner or manager of each property within 200 m of the treatment area, and

heading: Public notification requirements - licensee
paragraph: (b) beekeepers whose bees enter or are likely to enter the treatment area.

heading: Public notification requirements - licensee
paragraph: (9) Before using a fumigant gas in a structure, a licensee must

heading: Public notification requirements - licensee
paragraph: (a) post a treatment notice that complies with section 63 (1) and (2) at each entrance to the structure, and

heading: Public notification requirements - licensee
paragraph: (b) ensure that the treatment notice remains posted until the licensee confirms that it is safe to enter the structure.

heading: Public notification requirements - licensee
paragraph: (10) The notice period under subsection (2), (4), (7) or (8) may be shortened only with the consent of each person who has access to the proposed treatment area and is entitled to notice of the proposed use either in writing or by posted notice.

heading: Public notification requirements - licensee
paragraph: (11) Before using a pesticide for a use described in section 5 (1) (a), (b), (g), (j) or (k), a licensee must post a notice in accordance with section 64 [public notification requirement - form and content] immediately before the use.

heading: Public notification requirements - licensee
paragraph: (12) Immediately following a pesticide use for which a treatment notice was required to be given or posted under this section, the licensee must provide written notice to the owner, manager, administrator or principal, or the agent of the owner, manager, administrator or principal, giving notice that the pesticide use occurred and of any differences between the information given in the treatment notice and the actual pesticide use.

heading: Public notification requirements - licensee
paragraph: (13) If during public consultations a licensee offers to directly notify an individual about an intended pesticide use, before performing the use the licensee must notify the individual in the agreed time and manner.

heading: Different notification requirements - Public Health Act
paragraph: 11		  Section 10 (2) to (8) of this regulation does not apply to a licensee under the Integrated Pest Management Act to the extent that an order made by a medical health officer under the Public Health Act imposes a different requirement on the licensee in relation to giving notice of pesticide use.

heading: Exemptions from public notification requirements
paragraph: 12		  A licensee is exempt from section 10 (4) (b), (5) (b) or (6), as applicable, in relation to a pesticide use if

heading: Exemptions from public notification requirements
paragraph: (a) the pesticide is insecticide applied in cracks and crevices,

heading: Exemptions from public notification requirements
paragraph: (b) the pesticide is insect gel, or insect bait in a bait station, that is placed in a concealed location not accessible to children or pets,

heading: Exemptions from public notification requirements
paragraph: (c) the pesticide is insecticide applied to a wasp nest that

heading: Exemptions from public notification requirements
paragraph: (i)  is outdoors, or

heading: Exemptions from public notification requirements
paragraph: (ii)  is indoors and no person will have access to the treatment area within the 48 hour period after the use,

heading: Exemptions from public notification requirements
paragraph: (d) the pesticide is rodenticide and is used in accordance with the requirements in section 81 [use requirements - licensee in relation to rodenticide use],

heading: Exemptions from public notification requirements
paragraph: (e) the pesticide is herbicide and is used to manage weeds along fences or in cracks in the pavement on roads, in sidewalks or in parking lots,

heading: Exemptions from public notification requirements
paragraph: (f) granular pesticide is used in flower, vegetable or shrub beds and mixed into soil,

heading: Exemptions from public notification requirements
paragraph: (g) the pesticide is bacterial pesticide applied to water, or

heading: Exemptions from public notification requirements
paragraph: (h) the pesticide is used as described in section 5 (1) (d).

heading: Licence fees
paragraph: (2) An applicant for a pesticide user non-service licence for a pesticide use described in section 5 (1) (a) to (f), (h) to (l) or (n) [pesticide uses requiring a licence] must include $250 with the application for each year of the term requested.

heading: Licence fees
paragraph: (3) An applicant for a pesticide user service licence for a use described in section 5 (1) (a), (b), (g), (j), (k) or (l) [pesticide uses requiring a licence] and an applicant for a pesticide user non-service licence for a use described in section 5 (1) (g) must include with the application the following fee for each year of the term requested:

heading: Licence fees
paragraph: (a) $250 if the application is for pesticide use on less than 50 ha in each year;

heading: Licence fees
paragraph: (b) $500 if the application is for pesticide use on 50 or more ha in any year and less than 500 ha in each year;

heading: Licence fees
paragraph: (c) $1 000 if the application is for pesticide use on 500 or more ha in any year.

heading: Licence fees
paragraph: (4) An applicant for a pesticide user service licence for a pesticide use not referred to in subsection (2) or (3) must include with the application the following fee for each year of the term requested:

heading: Licence fees
paragraph: (a) $250 if the application is for the pesticide use from one business address;

heading: Licence fees
paragraph: (b) $500 if the application is for the pesticide use from 2 or 3 business addresses;

heading: Licence fees
paragraph: (c) $1 000 if the application is for the pesticide use from 4 or more business addresses.

heading: Licence fees
paragraph: (5) An applicant for a pesticide vendor licence must include with the application the following fee for each year of the term requested:

heading: Licence fees
paragraph: (a) $250 if the application is for the sale of domestic pesticides only or for the sale of less than 100 kg per year of commercial, restricted or permit-restricted pesticides;

heading: Licence fees
paragraph: (b) $1 000 if the application is for the sale of 100 or more kg per year of commercial, restricted or permit-restricted pesticides.

heading: Licence fees
paragraph: (6) If an applicant would be subject to a fee under two or more of subsections (2), (3), (4) and (5) in respect of an application, the licence fee payable on application is the highest fee payable under subsection (2), (3), (4) or (5) as applicable.

heading: Licence fees
paragraph: (7) A fee paid on application is not refundable unless the application is withdrawn before any processing has occurred.

heading: Licence fees
paragraph: (8) If a licensee is required by the term and condition in section 47 (1) (c) [licence terms and conditions] to give notice to the administrator of a change that has the effect of increasing the fee payable in relation to the licence, the notice must be accompanied by the amount of the increase.

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a certificate
paragraph:
14
		  (1) The following classes of pesticides are prescribed for the purpose of section 5 (1) of the Act:

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a certificate
paragraph: (a) permit-restricted;

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a certificate
paragraph: (b) restricted.

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a certificate
paragraph: (2) The following uses are prescribed for the purposes of section 5 (1) of the Act:

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a certificate
paragraph: (a) aerial application of a pesticide by a pilot;

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a certificate
paragraph: (b) use of an SGAR on public or private land for the management of rodents.

heading: Pesticides prescribed in relation to certified individuals
paragraph:
15
		  The following classes of pesticides are prescribed for the purposes of section 5 (2) and (3) of the Act:

heading: Pesticides prescribed in relation to certified individuals
paragraph: (a) permit-restricted;

heading: Pesticides prescribed in relation to certified individuals
paragraph: (b) restricted;

heading: Pesticides prescribed in relation to certified individuals
paragraph: (c) commercial;

heading: Pesticides prescribed in relation to certified individuals
paragraph: (d) domestic.

heading: Certificate criteria
paragraph:
16
		  (1) For the purpose of section 5 (5) (b) of the Act, the administrator must be satisfied that the applicant

heading: Certificate criteria
paragraph: (a) has reached 16 years of age,

heading: Certificate criteria
paragraph: (b) has attained the appropriate educational level for the certificate or has completed one or more courses specified by the administrator, and

heading: Certificate criteria
paragraph: (c) either

heading: Certificate criteria
paragraph: (i)  has passed an examination set by the administrator for the purpose of testing the knowledge of an applicant in relation to the matters listed in Schedule 3 for the category of certificate applied for, or

heading: Certificate criteria
paragraph: (ii)  has passed an examination, approved by the administrator, of another provincial government and has passed an examination set by the administrator for the purpose of testing the knowledge of an applicant in relation to the Act and this regulation.

heading: Certificate criteria
paragraph: (2) Despite subsection (1) (c), if an applicant has previously held a certificate in the category applied for, the administrator may issue a new certificate in accordance with section 53 [certificate renewal requirements].

heading: Certificate criteria
paragraph: (3) Before reinstating a suspended certificate, the administrator must be satisfied that the holder satisfies the requirements of section 5 (5) of the Act.

heading: Certificate fees
paragraph:
17
		  (1) An applicant for a certificate, other than a residential applicator certificate, must include with the application a fee of $90 for each certificate examination required for the certificate.

heading: Certificate fees
paragraph: (2) If an applicant for a certificate

heading: Certificate fees
paragraph: (a) has been given notice of the time and place of a certificate examination on 2 different occasions, and

heading: Certificate fees
paragraph: (b) has failed to attend for the examination on both occasions,

heading: Certificate fees
paragraph: the administrator is deemed to have rejected the applicant's application and the fee paid under subsection (1) is forfeited.

heading: Certificate fees
paragraph: (3) An applicant for a certificate renewal to whom section 53 applies must include with the application a non-refundable fee of $25.

heading: Pesticides and pesticide uses requiring a permit
paragraph:
18
		  (1) Permit-restricted pesticides are prescribed for the purpose of section 6 (1) of the Act.

heading: Pesticides and pesticide uses requiring a permit
paragraph: (2) Except as provided in subsection (4), the following uses of a pesticide are prescribed for the purpose of section 6 (1) of the Act:

heading: Pesticides and pesticide uses requiring a permit
paragraph: (a) aerial application of a pesticide;

heading: Pesticides and pesticide uses requiring a permit
paragraph: (b) use of a pesticide, other than an excluded pesticide, in or on a body of water, unless under section 5 [pesticide uses requiring a licence] a licence is required for the use or under section 24 [pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation] a confirmation is required for the use;

heading: Pesticides and pesticide uses requiring a permit
paragraph: (c) use of a pesticide, other than an excluded pesticide, on public land, unless under section 5 a licence is required for the use or under section 24 a confirmation is required for the use;

heading: Pesticides and pesticide uses requiring a permit
paragraph: (d) use of strychnine to control bird populations.

heading: Pesticides and pesticide uses requiring a permit
paragraph: (3) In addition to the uses prescribed in subsection (2), if a licence or confirmation applicant or holder requires an exemption from a requirement under section 33 (3) (b) [containment, storage, transportation, disposal and use of pesticides] in relation to a use for which the licence or confirmation, as applicable, is required, a permit specifying the requirement and the terms and conditions on which the exemption is authorized is required for the use.

heading: Pesticides and pesticide uses requiring a permit
paragraph: (4) A use described in subsection (2) is not prescribed if

heading: Pesticides and pesticide uses requiring a permit
paragraph: (a) the use is aerial application to private land used primarily for agricultural production,

heading: Pesticides and pesticide uses requiring a permit
paragraph: (b) the use is aerial application

heading: Pesticides and pesticide uses requiring a permit
paragraph: (i)  of a pesticide listed in Schedule 4,

heading: Pesticides and pesticide uses requiring a permit
paragraph: (ii)  in accordance with a licence or a confirmation, and

heading: Pesticides and pesticide uses requiring a permit
paragraph: (iii)  to land that is neither in an urban area nor used for residential purposes,

heading: Pesticides and pesticide uses requiring a permit
paragraph: (c) the use is for research purposes

heading: Pesticides and pesticide uses requiring a permit
paragraph: (i)  of a pesticide that is exempt from registration under the federal Act for research purposes, and

heading: Pesticides and pesticide uses requiring a permit
paragraph: (ii)  consistent with the terms on which the pesticide is exempted from registration, or

heading: Pesticides and pesticide uses requiring a permit
paragraph: (d) the use is of a pesticide on public land used for agricultural activities, except agricultural activities authorized by a licence or permit issued under the Range Act.

heading: Permit criteria
paragraph: 19		  (1) For the purposes of section 6 (3) (b) of the Act, the administrator must be satisfied that the applicant

heading: Permit criteria
paragraph: (a) maintains a business location in British Columbia for doing business in the Province or provides the administrator with an address in British Columbia at which the person may be served with documents,

heading: Permit criteria
paragraph: (b) has conducted the consultations as required under section 20 [public consultation requirements - permits] and submitted a description of the action, if any, the applicant proposes to take in response to comments received during consultations, and

heading: Permit criteria
paragraph: (c) if requested by the administrator, has submitted to the administrator an evaluation of the geographical features that require a pesticide-free zone or a no-treatment zone at the treatment location.

heading: Permit criteria
paragraph: (2) For the purposes of section 6 (3) (b) of the Act in relation to a permit for a use described in section 18 (3), the administrator must also be satisfied that

heading: Permit criteria
paragraph: (a) meeting the requirement is impractical in relation to the proposed use, method of application or treatment area, and

heading: Permit criteria
paragraph: (b) if the terms and conditions imposed on the permit under section 18 (3) are complied with, allowing the licensee or confirmation holder to perform the use without meeting the requirement will not cause unreasonable adverse effects.

heading: Public consultation requirements - permits
paragraph:
20
		  An applicant for a permit must conduct public consultations in accordance with section 60 [public consultation - permit application].

heading: Exemptions from public consultation requirement
paragraph:
21
		  An applicant for a permit is exempt from the requirement under section 60 (2) (j) for a 30 day comment period if the applicant satisfies the administrator that

heading: Exemptions from public consultation requirement
paragraph: (a) the application relates to an unforeseen pest problem and the delay in applying the pesticide required to carry out the consultations is likely to result in an unreasonable adverse effect,

heading: Exemptions from public consultation requirement
paragraph: (b) the particular pesticide use to which the application relates is

heading: Exemptions from public consultation requirement
paragraph: (i)  to such a small area, or

heading: Exemptions from public consultation requirement
paragraph: (ii)  to such a remote area

heading: Exemptions from public consultation requirement
paragraph: that the use is unlikely to affect any person, other than the person who owns the treatment area, or any other person's property, or

heading: Exemptions from public consultation requirement
paragraph: (c) the application relates to a treatment area located within a region of the Province in respect of which the provincial health officer or a medical health officer has advised that there is an increased risk to human health due to the West Nile virus.

heading: Public notification requirement - permits
paragraph:
22
		  If during public consultations a permit holder offers to directly notify an individual about an intended pesticide use, before performing the use the holder must notify the individual in the agreed time and manner.

heading: Permit fees
paragraph:
23
		  (1) An applicant for a permit must include with the application a fee of $1 000 for a term of up to 3 years.

heading: Permit fees
paragraph: (2) A fee paid on application is not refundable unless the application is withdrawn before any processing has occurred.

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph:
24
		  (1) The following classes of pesticides are prescribed for the purpose of section 7 (1) of the Act:

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (a) restricted pesticides;

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (b) commercial pesticides;

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (c) domestic pesticides.

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (2) Except as provided in subsection (3), the following uses of a pesticide in a class referred to in subsection (1) are prescribed for the purpose of section 7 (1) of the Act:

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (a) the management of vegetation or preservation of wood on more than 20 ha per year of public or private land that is

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (i)  used as a railway right of way, yard or associated signal or communication facility, and

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (ii)  managed by a single entity;

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (b) the management of vegetation on more than 20 ha per year of public or private land that is

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (i)  used as

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (A) a highway,

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (B) a facility or right of way for a public utility as defined in the Utilities Commission Act,

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (C) a facility or right of way for the delivery of water, not including a pipe or a system or arrangement of pipes to distribute water in a community to ultimate consumers, or

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (D) a pipeline and associated facilities, and

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (ii)  managed by a single entity;

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (c) the management of mosquitoes, using bacterial pesticide, on more than 1 ha per year of public land that is

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (i)  a body of water, and

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (ii)  managed by a single entity;

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (d) the preservation of more than 1 000 wooden poles per year on public or private land that is

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (i)  used as

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (A) a highway, or

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (B) a facility or right of way for a public utility as defined in the Utilities Commission Act, and

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (ii)  managed by a single entity;

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (e) the management of forest pests on more than 20 ha per year of public land that is

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (i)  used for timber production or forested, and

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (ii)  managed by a single entity;

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (f) the management of vegetation on more than 20 ha per year of public land that is

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (i)  used as an industrial site, other than an industrial site described in paragraph (a) (i) or (b) (i), and

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (ii)  managed by a single entity;

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (g) the management of noxious weeds or invasive plants on more than 50 ha per year of public land managed by a single entity;

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (h) the management of mosquitoes on public land, other than with a bacterial pesticide applied to a body of water.

heading: Pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation
paragraph: (3) A use described in subsection (2) (h) is not prescribed if carried out by aerial application to land that is in an urban area or used for residential purposes.

heading: Confirmation holder exemptions
paragraph: 25		  (1) A confirmation holder is exempt from the requirements under section 69 [confirmation holder use of pesticide - integrated pest management] in relation to the use of wood preservatives on land described in section 24 (2) (a).

heading: Confirmation holder exemptions
paragraph: (2) A confirmation holder is exempt from a requirement in section 33 (3) (b) [containment, storage, transportation, disposal and use requirements] in relation to a pesticide use if the confirmation holder holds a permit issued under section 6 (1) of the Act authorizing the exemption in relation to the use and setting out terms and conditions the confirmation holder must comply with instead.

heading: Confirmation criteria
paragraph:
26
		  For the purpose of section 7 (3) (b) of the Act, the administrator must be satisfied that the applicant

heading: Confirmation criteria
paragraph: (a) maintains a business location in British Columbia for doing business in the Province or provides the administrator with an address in British Columbia at which the person may be served with documents, and

heading: Confirmation criteria
paragraph: (b) has conducted the consultations as required under section 27 (1) and submitted with the application a description of the action, if any, the applicant proposes to take in response to comments received during consultations.

heading: Public consultation requirements - confirmations
paragraph:
27
		  (1) A person preparing a pest management plan for the purposes of section 7 (1) (a) of the Act must conduct public consultations in relation to the pest management plan in accordance with section 61 [public consultation - pesticide management plan].

heading: Public consultation requirements - confirmations
paragraph: (2) A holder of a confirmation must conduct public consultations in accordance with section 61 before submitting an amendment to the pesticide use notice if the amendment relates to information required under section 59 (1) (c), (d) or (e) [pesticide use notice requirements].

heading: Public notification requirement - confirmations
paragraph:
28
		  (1) A holder of a confirmation must give notice to individuals in the vicinity of a treatment location, in accordance with section 64 [public notification requirement - form and content].

heading: Public notification requirement - confirmations
paragraph: (2) If during public consultations a confirmation holder offers to directly notify an individual about an intended pesticide use, before performing the use the holder must notify the individual in the agreed time and manner.

heading: Confirmation fees
paragraph:
29
		  (1) An applicant for a confirmation must include with the pesticide use notice the following fees:

heading: Confirmation fees
paragraph: (a) for a use described in section 24 (2) (a) to (c) or (e) to (h) [pesticide uses requiring a confirmation],

heading: Confirmation fees
paragraph: (i)  $500 for a confirmation if the confirmation is for pesticide use on less than 50 ha in each year of the term,

heading: Confirmation fees
paragraph: (ii)  $1 000 for a confirmation if the confirmation is for pesticide use on 50 or more ha in any year of the term and less than 500 ha in each year of the term, and

heading: Confirmation fees
paragraph: (iii)  $2 000 for a confirmation if the confirmation is for pesticide use on 500 or more ha in any year of the term;

heading: Confirmation fees
paragraph: (b) for a use described in section 24 (2) (d),

heading: Confirmation fees
paragraph: (i)  $1 000 if the confirmation is for pesticide use on more than 1 000 poles in any year of the term of confirmation and not more than 10 000 poles in each year of the term of the confirmation, and

heading: Confirmation fees
paragraph: (ii)  $2 000 if the confirmation is for pesticide use on more than 10 000 poles in any year of the term of the confirmation.

heading: Confirmation fees
paragraph: (2) If an amendment to a pesticide use notice required under section 59 (2) [pesticide use notice requirements] has the effect of increasing the fee payable in relation to the confirmation, the amended notice must be accompanied by the amount of the increase for the remainder of the term of the confirmation.

heading: Confirmation fees
paragraph: (3) If a confirmation is issued in relation to a pesticide use notice or an amended pesticide use notice, the fee paid with the pesticide use notice is not refundable.

heading: Fee for pest management plan copy
paragraph:
30
		  For the purposes of section 7 (6) (c) (ii) of the Act, a confirmation holder may charge $0.25 for each page for a copy of the pest management plan.

heading: Requirement to notify fire department
paragraph:
31
		  Within 60 days after starting to store pesticides at a location, each of the following must provide notice of the storage location to the fire department responsible for fire protection at that location:

heading: Requirement to notify fire department
paragraph: (a) a pesticide manufacturer;

heading: Requirement to notify fire department
paragraph: (b) a pesticide distributor;

heading: Requirement to notify fire department
paragraph: (c) a pesticide formulator;

heading: Requirement to notify fire department
paragraph: (d) a pesticide wholesaler;

heading: Requirement to notify fire department
paragraph: (e) a licensee;

heading: Requirement to notify fire department
paragraph: (f) a permit holder;

heading: Requirement to notify fire department
paragraph: (g) a confirmation holder.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph:
32
		  A person who holds a licence or a confirmation must

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (a) apply integrated pest management in accordance with section 68 [licensee - integrated pest management] or 69 [confirmation holder - integrated pest management], as applicable, when using a pesticide, and

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (b) unless the pesticide use is authorized under another enactment or by an order of the court or the Lieutenant Governor in Council, before using a pesticide obtain the express permission of the owner or manager of the land to which pesticide is applied.

heading: Containment, storage, transportation, disposal and use of pesticides
paragraph:
33
		  (1) A person who stores a pesticide must store it in a manner that

heading: Containment, storage, transportation, disposal and use of pesticides
paragraph: (a) minimizes hazards to human health and the environment, and

heading: Containment, storage, transportation, disposal and use of pesticides
paragraph: (b) is in accordance with the standards prescribed in sections 65 [pesticide container and labelling standards], 66 [pesticide storage] and 67 [pesticide storage - licensee], as applicable.

heading: Containment, storage, transportation, disposal and use of pesticides
paragraph: (2) A person who transports or causes or allows the transport of a pesticide must ensure that the pesticide is secured and transported in accordance with the applicable standards prescribed in Division 7 [Standards for Use, Containment, Transport, Storage or Sale of Pesticide] of Part 2 and in a manner that prevents

heading: Containment, storage, transportation, disposal and use of pesticides
paragraph: (a) the escape, discharge or unauthorized removal of the pesticide from the transport vehicle, and

heading: Containment, storage, transportation, disposal and use of pesticides
paragraph: (b) the contamination of food or drink intended for animal or human consumption, household furnishings, toiletries, clothing, bedding or similar items that are transported with the pesticide.

heading: Containment, storage, transportation, disposal and use of pesticides
paragraph: (3) A person who uses a pesticide must use it in a manner that

heading: Containment, storage, transportation, disposal and use of pesticides
paragraph: (a) minimizes hazards to human health and the environment, and

heading: Containment, storage, transportation, disposal and use of pesticides
paragraph: (b) is in accordance with the applicable standards prescribed in Division 7 [Standards for Use, Containment, Transport, Storage or Sale of Pesticide] of Part 2 in relation to

heading: Containment, storage, transportation, disposal and use of pesticides
paragraph: (i)  the handling, mixing, applying or disposing of pesticides, and

heading: Containment, storage, transportation, disposal and use of pesticides
paragraph: (ii)  the handling and disposal of containers used for pesticide.

heading: Use requirements - agricultural operations
paragraph:
33.1
		  (1) In this section, "agricultural operation", "contaminated runoff", "groundwater", "property boundary" and "watercourse" have the same meaning as in the Code of Practice for Agricultural Environmental Management, B.C. Reg. 8/2019.

heading: Use requirements - agricultural operations
paragraph: (2) A person who applies a pesticide for the purposes of an agricultural operation must ensure all of the following:

heading: Use requirements - agricultural operations
paragraph: (a) that contaminated runoff does not enter a watercourse or groundwater, or cross a property boundary;

heading: Use requirements - agricultural operations
paragraph: (b) that pesticide spray drift does not enter a watercourse or groundwater;

heading: Use requirements - agricultural operations
paragraph: (c) that all precautions are taken that are reasonably necessary to prevent an unreasonable volume of pesticide spray drift from crossing a property boundary, unless the person in possession of the property into which the drift crosses allows otherwise.

heading: Use requirements - agricultural operations
paragraph: (3) A person who applies pesticides for the purposes of an agricultural operation must keep a record containing the following information:

heading: Use requirements - agricultural operations
paragraph: (a) the date, time and location of application;

heading: Use requirements - agricultural operations
paragraph: (b) the temperature, precipitation, wind speed and wind direction at the time of application;

heading: Use requirements - agricultural operations
paragraph: (c) the name of each targeted pest;

heading: Use requirements - agricultural operations
paragraph: (d) for each pesticide applied,

heading: Use requirements - agricultural operations
paragraph: (i)  the product trade name and pest control product registration number, and

heading: Use requirements - agricultural operations
paragraph: (ii)  the application method and rate of application.

heading: Records of sale and annual report - vendor licensee
paragraph:
34
		  (1) A licensee who sells pesticides must

heading: Records of sale and annual report - vendor licensee
paragraph: (a) keep a record of each sale of a commercial, permit-restricted or restricted pesticide, and

heading: Records of sale and annual report - vendor licensee
paragraph: (b) prepare and submit to the administrator by April 1 of each year following a calendar year in which the licensee was licensed, a summary of the licensee's sales in the calendar year.

heading: Records of sale and annual report - vendor licensee
paragraph: (2) The record required under subsection (1) (a) must include all the following in relation to each sale:

heading: Records of sale and annual report - vendor licensee
paragraph: (a) the date of sale;

heading: Records of sale and annual report - vendor licensee
paragraph: (b) the purchaser's name, address, telephone number and, for sales of restricted or permit-restricted pesticide, the purchaser's applicator certificate number;

heading: Records of sale and annual report - vendor licensee
paragraph: (c) the certified dispenser's name and certificate number;

heading: Records of sale and annual report - vendor licensee
paragraph: (d) the pesticide sold, including its trade name and registration number under the federal Act;

heading: Records of sale and annual report - vendor licensee
paragraph: (e) the size of the container the pesticide was sold in and the number of containers sold;

heading: Records of sale and annual report - vendor licensee
paragraph: (f) if the pesticide is an SGAR,

heading: Records of sale and annual report - vendor licensee
paragraph: (i)  the name and certificate number of a person who holds a valid pesticide applicator certificate endorsed for the use of SGARs, and

heading: Records of sale and annual report - vendor licensee
paragraph: (ii)  the name and licence number of the licensee who intends to use the SGAR;

heading: Records of sale and annual report - vendor licensee
paragraph: (g) if the pesticide is an SGAR and the licensee who intends to use the SGAR holds a pesticide non-service user licence, the category of essential service location that applies to the treatment site at which the SGAR is to be used.

heading: Records of sale and annual report - vendor licensee
paragraph: (3) The annual summary of pesticide sales required under subsection (1) (b) must include all the following in relation to each commercial, restricted and permit-restricted pesticide sold by the licensee in the calendar year to which it relates:

heading: Records of sale and annual report - vendor licensee
paragraph: (a) trade name;

heading: Records of sale and annual report - vendor licensee
paragraph: (b) registration number under the federal Act;

heading: Records of sale and annual report - vendor licensee
paragraph: (c) active ingredient;

heading: Records of sale and annual report - vendor licensee
paragraph: (d) total litres or kilograms sold.

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph:
35
		  (1) A licensee who uses a pesticide, other than a wood preservative, must keep a record containing the following information for each treatment location and day of use:

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (a) if the use was performed as a service, the name and address of the person for whom the service was performed;

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (b) if the service was performed for another licensee or a permit or confirmation holder, the number of the person's licence, permit or confirmation;

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (c) if the use was not performed as a service, the name and address of the owner or manager of the treatment location;

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (d) the name and certificate number of the pesticide applicator certificate holder who used the pesticide or supervised the use;

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (e) the date and time of the pesticide use;

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (f) the name of the pest targeted by the use or the purpose of the pesticide use;

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (g) the trade name of each pesticide used and its registration number under the federal Act;

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (h) for each pesticide used, the method and rate of application and the total quantity used;

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (i) if the use was outdoors, the prevailing meteorological conditions including temperature, precipitation and velocity and direction of the wind;

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (j) pest monitoring methods and injury thresholds used to fulfill the licensee's integrated pest management requirements in relation to the use;

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (k) advice given to the owner or manager of the treatment area in relation to the following:

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (i)  safe re-entry time;

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (ii)  the number of days before a crop can be harvested safely;

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (iii)  additional precautions that should be taken to minimize exposure to the pesticide;

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (l) if the licensee decided under section 71 (4) [use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder] that a no-treatment zone may be reduced, the information on which the licensee based the decision.

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (2) A licensee who performs a use described in section 5 (1) (g) [pesticide uses requiring a licence] on more than 20 ha per year managed by a single entity must also keep records of each of the following for each treatment location:

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (a) the results of pest monitoring carried out by the licensee in relation to

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (i)  the pest population, and

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (ii)  the damage caused by pests;

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (b) the use of the monitoring results described in paragraph (a) to determine injury thresholds;

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (c) how public notification was given and where notices were posted;

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (d) the effectiveness and impacts of the pesticide use.

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (3) A licensee who performs a use described in section 5 (1) (g) on more than 20 ha per year managed by a single entity must keep a record for each piece of the licensee's pesticide application equipment that requires calibration showing when the equipment was calibrated and the data upon which its calibration was based.

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (4) A licensee who uses a wood preservative must keep the records described in subsection (1) (a) to (h) for each treatment location and day of use.

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (5) A licensee who uses a fumigant gas must keep a record of the results of monitoring required under section 82 [use requirements - licensee in relation to fumigant gas].

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (6) A licensee who uses an SGAR must keep a record containing the following information:

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (a) for each treatment site, the information described in subsection (1);

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (b) measures that were taken to comply with the requirements set out in section 68 (1) (a);

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (c) the results of rodent monitoring carried out by the licensee in relation to

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (i)  the rodent population, and

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (ii)  the damage caused by rodents;

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (d) the date on which the SGAR is removed from the treatment site.

heading: Records of use - licensee
paragraph: (7) Despite subsection (1) (i), a licensee is not required to record the prevailing meteorological conditions if a pesticide is deployed in a weather-resistant container.

heading: Records of use - permit holder
paragraph:
36
		  A permit holder who uses a pesticide, or authorizes the use of a pesticide, must keep a record containing the following information for each treatment location and day of use under the permit:

heading: Records of use - permit holder
paragraph: (a) the name and address of the owner or manager of the treatment location;

heading: Records of use - permit holder
paragraph: (b) if the use was performed as a service, the name and licence number of the licensee who performed the service;

heading: Records of use - permit holder
paragraph: (c) if the use was not performed as a service, the name and certificate number of the pesticide applicator certificate holder who used the pesticide or supervised the use;

heading: Records of use - permit holder
paragraph: (d) if a confirmation was required for the use, the confirmation number;

heading: Records of use - permit holder
paragraph: (e) the information described in section 35 (1) (e) to (i) and (k) [records of use - licensee].

heading: Records of use - confirmation holder
paragraph:
37
		  (1) A confirmation holder who uses a pesticide or authorizes the use of a pesticide, other than a wood preservative, must keep a record containing the following information for each treatment location and day of use:

heading: Records of use - confirmation holder
paragraph: (a) the name and address of the owner or manager of the treatment location;

heading: Records of use - confirmation holder
paragraph: (b) if the use was performed as a service, the name and licence number of the licensee who performed the service;

heading: Records of use - confirmation holder
paragraph: (c) if the use was not performed as a service, the name and certificate number of the pesticide applicator certificate holder who used the pesticide or supervised the use;

heading: Records of use - confirmation holder
paragraph: (d) if a permit was required for the use or the class of pesticide, the permit number;

heading: Records of use - confirmation holder
paragraph: (e) the information required under section 35 (1) (e) to (i), (k) and (l) and (2).

heading: Records of use - confirmation holder
paragraph: (2) A confirmation holder must keep a record for each piece of the holder's pesticide application equipment that requires calibration showing when the equipment was calibrated and the data upon which its calibration was based.

heading: Records of use - confirmation holder
paragraph: (3) A confirmation holder who uses a wood preservative, or authorizes the use of a wood preservative, must keep the records required under section 35 (4).

heading: Public consultation records
paragraph:
38
		  (1) A licensee, a permit holder and a confirmation holder who is required under this regulation to conduct consultations in relation to an application or a pesticide use must prepare and maintain the following records of those consultations:

heading: Public consultation records
paragraph: (a) a record of when, where and how the notice was published or when the notice was given of the public consultation, as applicable;

heading: Public consultation records
paragraph: (b) a summary of the verbal public responses to the public consultation;

heading: Public consultation records
paragraph: (c) a summary of the responses given by the licensee, permit holder or confirmation holder to the public responses described in paragraph (b).

heading: Public consultation records
paragraph: (2) In addition to the records under subsection (1), a licensee, a permit holder and a confirmation holder must also retain

heading: Public consultation records
paragraph: (a) copies of any notices published or given under section 60, 61 or 62, and

heading: Public consultation records
paragraph: (b) all written responses to the notice under subsection (1).

heading: Public consultation records
paragraph: (3) If a person described in subsection (1) conducting public consultations described in subsection (1) agrees to give notice to an individual before a pesticide use, the licensee, permit holder or confirmation holder must retain a copy of the notice given.

heading: Annual use report - licensee, permit holder and confirmation holder
paragraph:
39
		  (1) A pesticide user service licensee and a pesticide user non-service licensee, a permit holder and a confirmation holder must provide to the administrator an annual report for a calendar year by January 31 in the next calendar year.

heading: Annual use report - licensee, permit holder and confirmation holder
paragraph: (2) An annual report under this section must include

heading: Annual use report - licensee, permit holder and confirmation holder
paragraph: (a) the name and address of the licensee, permit holder or confirmation holder, and their licence, permit or confirmation number,

heading: Annual use report - licensee, permit holder and confirmation holder
paragraph: (b) the following information for each pesticide used in the calendar year:

heading: Annual use report - licensee, permit holder and confirmation holder
paragraph: (i)  trade name;

heading: Annual use report - licensee, permit holder and confirmation holder
paragraph: (ii)  registration number under the federal Act;

heading: Annual use report - licensee, permit holder and confirmation holder
paragraph: (iii)  active ingredient;

heading: Annual use report - licensee, permit holder and confirmation holder
paragraph: (iv)  amount in kilograms, and

heading: Annual use report - licensee, permit holder and confirmation holder
paragraph: (c) the total area treated.

heading: Annual use report - licensee, permit holder and confirmation holder
paragraph: (3) The annual report of a pesticide user service licensee must

heading: Annual use report - licensee, permit holder and confirmation holder
paragraph: (a) provide separate records of the information required under subsection (2) (b) for

heading: Annual use report - licensee, permit holder and confirmation holder
paragraph: (i)  those pesticides used for another licensee or a permit or confirmation holder, and

heading: Annual use report - licensee, permit holder and confirmation holder
paragraph: (ii)  those pesticides used for a person who did not hold a licence, permit or confirmation for the use, and

heading: Annual use report - licensee, permit holder and confirmation holder
paragraph: (b) set out the total area treated in the calendar year for a use described in section 5 (1) (a), (b), (j), (k) or (l).

heading: Annual use report - licensee, permit holder and confirmation holder
paragraph: (3.1) If a licensee uses an SGAR that was purchased by the licensee by means of the internet, the licensee must, in the licensee's annual report for the calendar year in which the SGAR was used, include the name of the person who sold the SGAR to the licensee.

heading: Annual use report - licensee, permit holder and confirmation holder
paragraph: (4) In the annual report required under this section a licensee, in relation to a use described in section 5 (1) (g) [pesticide uses requiring a licence] on more than 20 ha per year managed by a single entity, and a confirmation holder, in relation to all pesticide uses, must also provide the following information:

heading: Annual use report - licensee, permit holder and confirmation holder
paragraph: (a) a description of the treatment location and a map identifying its gross boundaries;

heading: Annual use report - licensee, permit holder and confirmation holder
paragraph: (b) the methods used to apply pesticide;

heading: Annual use report - licensee, permit holder and confirmation holder
paragraph: (c) the total area treated;

heading: Annual use report - licensee, permit holder and confirmation holder
paragraph: (d) total area treated with each pesticide used;

heading: Annual use report - licensee, permit holder and confirmation holder
paragraph: (e) methods of non-pesticide pest controls used and the estimated total area of their use.

heading: Licensee - notice of intent to treat public land or aerially or by fumigation
paragraph:
40
		  If a licensee has not given prior notice under section 45 (h) [licence applications] that the licensee intends to

heading: Licensee - notice of intent to treat public land or aerially or by fumigation
paragraph: (a) use a pesticide on public land,

heading: Licensee - notice of intent to treat public land or aerially or by fumigation
paragraph: (b) aerially apply pesticide, or

heading: Licensee - notice of intent to treat public land or aerially or by fumigation
paragraph: (c) use a fumigant gas pesticide,

heading: Licensee - notice of intent to treat public land or aerially or by fumigation
paragraph: the licensee must give written notice to the administrator at least 2 business days before the first such use.

heading: Licensee - annual notice of intent to treat more than 20 ha private forest land
paragraph:
41
		  (1) For the purpose of the annual notice of intent to treat under this section, a licensee who uses a pesticide for a use described in subsection (2) must prepare and retain a detailed map or diagram showing the treatment locations for the applicable calendar year and indicating for each treatment location

heading: Licensee - annual notice of intent to treat more than 20 ha private forest land
paragraph: (a) the proposed treatment areas, and

heading: Licensee - annual notice of intent to treat more than 20 ha private forest land
paragraph: (b) the geographic features that require a pesticide-free zone or a no-treatment zone.

heading: Licensee - annual notice of intent to treat more than 20 ha private forest land
paragraph: (2) At least 14 days before using a pesticide for the first time in a calendar year for a use described in section 5 (1) (g) [pesticide uses requiring a licence] on more than 20 ha per year managed by a single entity, a licensee must provide to the administrator a notice of intent to treat that complies with subsection (3).

heading: Licensee - annual notice of intent to treat more than 20 ha private forest land
paragraph: (3) A notice of intent to treat under subsection (2) must provide all the following information:

heading: Licensee - annual notice of intent to treat more than 20 ha private forest land
paragraph: (a) the name and business location of the licensee;

heading: Licensee - annual notice of intent to treat more than 20 ha private forest land
paragraph: (b) a description of each treatment location proposed for a use described in subsection (2) for the calendar year and a map or diagram, based on the map or diagram prepared and retained under subsection (1), that clearly identifies those locations;

heading: Licensee - annual notice of intent to treat more than 20 ha private forest land
paragraph: (c) a description of the proposed treatment for each treatment area including the pesticide to be used and its method of application;

heading: Licensee - annual notice of intent to treat more than 20 ha private forest land
paragraph: (d) the total area of treatment areas in the treatment locations described under paragraph (b).

heading: Licensee - annual notice of intent to treat more than 20 ha private forest land
paragraph: (4) After a notice of intent to treat has been submitted for a calendar year, the licensee may increase the total provided under subsection (3) (d) by up to 10% if the licensee gives written notice to the administrator at least 2 business days before using the pesticide, which notice provides the information required under subsection (3) in relation to the increased area.

heading: Licensee - annual notice of intent to treat more than 20 ha private forest land
paragraph: (5) If, during a calendar year, the licensee intends to exceed the total provided under subsection (3) (d) by more than 10%, the licensee, at least 14 days before a pesticide use that causes the excess, must provide to the administrator a revised notice of intent to treat that complies with subsection (3).

heading: Licensee - annual notice of intent to treat more than 20 ha private forest land
paragraph: (6) The detailed map required by subsection (1) must be provided to the administrator within 3 business days of a request.

heading: Confirmation holder - annual notice of intent to treat
paragraph:
42
		  (1) For the purpose of an annual notice of intent to treat under this section, a confirmation holder who uses a pesticide, or authorizes the use of a pesticide, other than a wood preservative, must prepare and retain a detailed map or diagram showing the treatment locations for the applicable calendar year and indicating for each treatment location

heading: Confirmation holder - annual notice of intent to treat
paragraph: (a) the proposed treatment areas, and

heading: Confirmation holder - annual notice of intent to treat
paragraph: (b) the geographic features that require a pesticide-free zone or a no-treatment zone.

heading: Confirmation holder - annual notice of intent to treat
paragraph: (2) At least 21 days before the first use of pesticide in a calendar year, a confirmation holder must submit to the administrator a notice of intent to treat that complies with subsection (3).

heading: Confirmation holder - annual notice of intent to treat
paragraph: (3) A notice under subsection (2) must contain all the following information, which information must be consistent with the information provided in the pesticide management plan and pesticide use notice prepared or submitted in relation to the confirmation:

heading: Confirmation holder - annual notice of intent to treat
paragraph: (a) the name and business location of the confirmation holder;

heading: Confirmation holder - annual notice of intent to treat
paragraph: (b) a description of the proposed treatment locations for the calendar year and a map or diagram, based on the map or diagram prepared and retained under subsection (1), that clearly identifies those locations;

heading: Confirmation holder - annual notice of intent to treat
paragraph: (c) a description of the proposed treatment for each treatment area including the pesticide to be used and its method of application;

heading: Confirmation holder - annual notice of intent to treat
paragraph: (d) the total area of treatment areas in the treatment locations described under paragraph (b).

heading: Confirmation holder - annual notice of intent to treat
paragraph: (4) After a notice of intent to treat has been submitted for a calendar year, a confirmation holder may increase the total provided under subsection (3) (d) by up to 10% if the confirmation holder gives written notice to the administrator at least 2 business days before using the pesticide, which notice provides the information required under subsection (3) in relation to the increased area.

heading: Confirmation holder - annual notice of intent to treat
paragraph: (5) If, during a calendar year, a confirmation holder intends to exceed the total provided under subsection (3) (d) by more than 10%, the confirmation holder, at least 21 days before a pesticide use that causes the excess, must provide to the administrator a revised notice of intent to treat that complies with subsection (3).

heading: Confirmation holder - annual notice of intent to treat
paragraph: (6) The detailed map described in subsection (1) must be provided to the administrator within 3 business days of a request.

heading: Classification of pesticides
paragraph:
43
		  (1) The pesticides set out in Schedule 1 are classified as permit-restricted pesticides.

heading: Classification of pesticides
paragraph: (2) The pesticides set out in Schedule 2 are classified as excluded pesticides.

heading: Category of licence required
paragraph:
44
		  (1) The following categories of licences are prescribed:

heading: Category of licence required
paragraph: (a) pesticide vendor;

heading: Category of licence required
paragraph: (b) pesticide user service;

heading: Category of licence required
paragraph: (c) pesticide user non-service.

heading: Category of licence required
paragraph: (2) Subject to Division 2 [Licences] of Part 1, a person must hold a pesticide vendor licence who

heading: Category of licence required
paragraph: (a) sells or offers to sell a pesticide, or

heading: Category of licence required
paragraph: (b) purchases, directly or indirectly, a pesticide for the purpose of selling the pesticide.

heading: Category of licence required
paragraph: (3) Subject to Division 2 of Part 1, a person must hold a pesticide user service licence who

heading: Category of licence required
paragraph: (a) provides, or offers to provide, for a fee a service respecting pesticides,

heading: Category of licence required
paragraph: (b) provides, or offers to provide, for a fee a service of a use prescribed in section 5 (1) [pesticide uses requiring a licence], or

heading: Category of licence required
paragraph: (c) purchases, directly or indirectly, a pesticide for the purpose of providing a service described in paragraph (a) or (b).

heading: Category of licence required
paragraph: (4) Subject to Division 2 of Part 1, a person must hold a pesticide user non-service licence who uses, or whose employees use, pesticide on the person's own land.

heading: Licence applications
paragraph:
45
		  An applicant for a licence must provide the following information, as applicable to the category of licence and class of pesticides or use applied for, in an application form that is signed by the applicant or the applicant's agent and is in the form specified by the administrator:

heading: Licence applications
paragraph: (a) name, address and telephone number of the applicant, and if the applicant is a corporation, the name of a person who is the principal contact in relation to the application;

heading: Licence applications
paragraph: (b) if the applicant carries on business in a name other than a name provided under paragraph (a), that other name;

heading: Licence applications
paragraph: (c) each business address where pesticides are sold or from which pesticides are used;

heading: Licence applications
paragraph: (d) category of licence applied for;

heading: Licence applications
paragraph: (e) classes and amounts of pesticides in relation to which the applicant applies to be licensed to sell;

heading: Licence applications
paragraph: (f) uses of pesticides for which the applicant applies to be licensed and the number of hectares or poles per year to be treated under the licence;

heading: Licence applications
paragraph: (g) term requested up to a maximum of 5 years;

heading: Licence applications
paragraph: (h) whether the applicant intends to, during the term of the licence,

heading: Licence applications
paragraph: (i)  use a pesticide on public land,

heading: Licence applications
paragraph: (ii)  aerially apply a pesticide, or

heading: Licence applications
paragraph: (iii)  use a fumigant gas pesticide.

heading: Duties of certified individuals in relation to licensee
paragraph:
46
		  (1) For the purpose of section 5 (2) of the Act, the duties that a licensee providing a service using a class of pesticides prescribed in section 15 [pesticides prescribed in relation to certified individual] must ensure are performed by a certified individual are the following:

heading: Duties of certified individuals in relation to licensee
paragraph: (a) be present when the service is provided;

heading: Duties of certified individuals in relation to licensee
paragraph: (b) either

heading: Duties of certified individuals in relation to licensee
paragraph: (i)  perform the use, or

heading: Duties of certified individuals in relation to licensee
paragraph: (ii)  supervise, in accordance with section 59.3 [supervision requirements], not more than 4 assistant applicators who perform the use.

heading: Duties of certified individuals in relation to licensee
paragraph: (3) For the purpose of section 5 (3) of the Act, the duties that a licensee selling a class of pesticides prescribed in section 15 must ensure are performed by a certified individual are the following:

heading: Duties of certified individuals in relation to licensee
paragraph: (a) advise each person who intends to purchase a pesticide that the person

heading: Duties of certified individuals in relation to licensee
paragraph: (i)  may lawfully use the pesticide only for the use described on the label and in accordance with the instructions on that label, and

heading: Duties of certified individuals in relation to licensee
paragraph: (ii)  is subject to any prohibitions, limits or conditions with respect to the use of the pesticide as set out in applicable provincial enactments and municipal bylaws;

heading: Duties of certified individuals in relation to licensee
paragraph: (a.1) ask each person who intends to purchase a pesticide what the person intends to use the pesticide for and

heading: Duties of certified individuals in relation to licensee
paragraph: (i)  take reasonable steps to confirm that the pesticide is appropriate for the intended use, or

heading: Duties of certified individuals in relation to licensee
paragraph: (ii)  refuse to sell the pesticide to the person if the person does not provide sufficient information to confirm that the pesticide is appropriate for the intended use;

heading: Duties of certified individuals in relation to licensee
paragraph: (b) offer to provide advice in relation to pest management and the safe use of the pesticide;

heading: Duties of certified individuals in relation to licensee
paragraph: (c) in respect of the sale of SGARs,

heading: Duties of certified individuals in relation to licensee
paragraph: (i)  confirm that each person who intends to purchase an SGAR

heading: Duties of certified individuals in relation to licensee
paragraph: (A) holds a valid pesticide user service licence or pesticide user non-service licence, and

heading: Duties of certified individuals in relation to licensee
paragraph: (B) either holds a valid pesticide applicator certificate endorsed for the use of SGARs, or can provide the name and certificate number of a person who holds such a certificate,

heading: Duties of certified individuals in relation to licensee
paragraph: (ii)  if the person who intends to purchase the SGAR holds a pesticide non-service user licence, ask the person

heading: Duties of certified individuals in relation to licensee
paragraph: (A) to identify the category of essential service location that applies to the treatment site at which the SGAR is to be used, and

heading: Duties of certified individuals in relation to licensee
paragraph: (B) to present documentation that demonstrates the authority of the person to use SGARs to manage rodents at the essential service location at which the SGAR is to be used,

heading: Duties of certified individuals in relation to licensee
paragraph: (iii)  refuse to sell the SGAR if the requirements set out in subparagraphs (i) and (ii) are not met, and

heading: Duties of certified individuals in relation to licensee
paragraph: (iv)  at the time of the sale, advise the purchaser of the SGAR that

heading: Duties of certified individuals in relation to licensee
paragraph: (A) the use of SGARs creates risks to wildlife,

heading: Duties of certified individuals in relation to licensee
paragraph: (B) when using SGARs there are requirements in relation to integrated pest management and the keeping of records, and

heading: Duties of certified individuals in relation to licensee
paragraph: (C) there are standards in relation to the disposal of SGARs and of dead rodents, and municipal bylaws may also apply to such disposal.

heading: Licence terms and conditions
paragraph:
47
		  (1) The following are terms and conditions of every licence issued under section 4 of the Act:

heading: Licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (a) a licensee must comply with all applicable regulations;

heading: Licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (b) a licence is not transferable without the written approval of the administrator;

heading: Licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (c) within 30 days after a change in any information provided by the licensee in an application under section 45 [licence applications], the licensee must give written notice to the administrator of the change;

heading: Licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (d) if a licensee performs a pesticide use as a service

heading: Licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (i)  for a permit holder, the licensee must comply with the terms and conditions of the permit, or

heading: Licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (ii)  for a confirmation holder, the licensee must comply with the requirements set out in sections 73 to 79;

heading: Licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (e) if a licensee believes that the licensee or another person has contravened the Act or this regulation in a manner involving the release of pesticide into the environment, the licensee must give written notice to the administrator as soon as practicable.

heading: Licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (2) A person may request the administrator's approval of a transfer of a licence to another person by submitting to the administrator an application containing the name of the licensee and the information required on a new licence application.

heading: Vendor licence terms and conditions
paragraph:
48
		  The following are terms and conditions of every pesticide vendor licence issued under section 4 of the Act:

heading: Vendor licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (a) the licence is valid according to its terms only in relation to the business location indicated on the licence application;

heading: Vendor licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (b) the licensee must have available for inspection, at the place and time a pesticide is sold, a copy of the certificate held by the certified individual required under section 5 (3) of the Act to perform duties described in section 46 (3) [duties of certified individuals in relation to licensee] in relation to the sale;

heading: Vendor licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (c) a licensee may not sell a pesticide to an individual who has not reached 16 years of age;

heading: Vendor licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (d) a licensee may sell or distribute a permit-restricted pesticide or a restricted pesticide only to a person who

heading: Vendor licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (i)  holds a certificate, or

heading: Vendor licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (ii)  is the agent of an individual who holds a certificate;

heading: Vendor licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (e) a licensee may sell or distribute a permit-restricted pesticide only to a person who

heading: Vendor licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (i)  holds a permit, or

heading: Vendor licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (ii)  is the agent of a person who holds a permit;

heading: Vendor licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (f) a licensee must ensure that an individual holding a pesticide dispenser certificate endorsed for the applicable class of pesticides performs the following functions:

heading: Vendor licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (i)  provides assistance with handling and storing pesticide at the business location;

heading: Vendor licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (ii)  provides assistance in responding to emergencies involving pesticides at the business location;

heading: Vendor licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (g) a licensee must, in respect of the sale of an SGAR,

heading: Vendor licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (i)  confirm that a person who intends to purchase the SGAR

heading: Vendor licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (A) holds a valid pesticide user service licence or a pesticide user non-service licence, and

heading: Vendor licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (B) either holds a valid pesticide applicator certificate endorsed for the use of SGARs, or can provide the name and certificate number of a person who holds such a certificate,

heading: Vendor licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (ii)  if the person who intends to purchase the SGAR holds a pesticide non-service user licence, ask the person

heading: Vendor licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (A) to identify the category of essential service that applies to the treatment site at which the SGAR is to be used, and

heading: Vendor licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (B) to present documentation that demonstrates the authority of the person to use SGARs to manage rodents at the essential service location at which the SGAR is to be used,

heading: Vendor licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (iii)  refuse to sell the SGAR if the requirements set out in subparagraphs (i) and (ii) are not met, and

heading: Vendor licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (iv)  at the time of the sale, advise the purchaser of the SGAR that

heading: Vendor licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (A) the use of SGARs creates risks to wildlife,

heading: Vendor licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (B) when using SGARs there are requirements in relation to integrated pest management and the keeping of records, and

heading: Vendor licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (C) there are requirements in relation to the disposal of SGARs and of dead rodents, and municipal bylaws may apply to such disposal.

heading: User service and user non-service licence terms and conditions
paragraph:
49
		  (1) The following are terms and conditions of every pesticide user service licence and pesticide user non-service licence:

heading: User service and user non-service licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (a) the licensee must ensure that an individual holding the certificate required under section 50 (4) in relation to a particular use is present when the use is performed and either

heading: User service and user non-service licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (i)  performs the use, or

heading: User service and user non-service licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (ii)  supervises, in accordance with section 59.3 [supervision requirements], not more than 4 assistant applicators who perform the use;

heading: User service and user non-service licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (c) the licensee must ensure that a copy of the certificate of the certificate holder performing the duties for the licensee that must be performed by a certificate holder is at or near the treatment area during the pesticide use.

heading: Category of certificate required
paragraph:
50
		  (1) The following categories of certificates are prescribed:

heading: Category of certificate required
paragraph: (a) pesticide dispenser;

heading: Category of certificate required
paragraph: (b) pesticide applicator;

heading: Category of certificate required
paragraph: (c) residential applicator.

heading: Category of certificate required
paragraph: (2) Subject to Division 3 [Certificates] of Part 1, an individual must hold a pesticide dispenser certificate endorsed for the class of pesticide dispensed who performs for a person holding a pesticide vendor licence the duties required under section 46 (3) [duties of certified individual in relation to licence] in relation to the class of pesticides.

heading: Category of certificate required
paragraph: (3) Subject to Division 3 of Part 1, an individual must hold a pesticide applicator certificate endorsed for a class of pesticide who performs for a holder of a pesticide user service licence or a pesticide user non-service licence the duties required under section 46 (1) [duties of certified individual in relation to licence] in relation to the class of pesticides.

heading: Category of certificate required
paragraph: (4) Subject to Division 3 of Part 1, an individual must hold a pesticide applicator certificate endorsed for a pesticide use who performs or supervises the pesticide use for a holder of a pesticide user service licence, a pesticide user non-service licence, a permit or a confirmation unless the use is of an excluded pesticide.

heading: Certificate applications
paragraph:
51
		  An applicant for a certificate must provide the following information, as applicable to the category of certificate and class of pesticides or use applied for, in an application form that is signed by the applicant and is in the form specified by the administrator:

heading: Certificate applications
paragraph: (a) individual's name and address and date of birth;

heading: Certificate applications
paragraph: (b) category of certificate applied for;

heading: Certificate applications
paragraph: (c) class of pesticides or uses requested in relation to the category of certificate.

heading: Certificate examinations
paragraph:
52
		  (1) An examination for the purpose of section 16 (1) (c) [certificate criteria] examines the applicant's knowledge in relation to the certificate applied for and each matter set out in Schedule 3.

heading: Certificate examinations
paragraph: (2) An examination referred to in subsection (1)

heading: Certificate examinations
paragraph: (a) may be taken orally or in writing, as directed by the administrator, and

heading: Certificate examinations
paragraph: (b) must be taken at the time and place directed by the administrator.

heading: Certificate renewal requirements
paragraph:
53
		  (1) For the purposes of section 16 (2), the administrator may reissue a certificate before its expiry date or within one year after that date without requiring the applicant to sit the examination required under section 16 (1) (c) if

heading: Certificate renewal requirements
paragraph: (a) within the 5 year period immediately preceding the application date, the applicant has accumulated 20 continuing education credits relating to a matter set out in Schedule 3, or

heading: Certificate renewal requirements
paragraph: (b) the applicant

heading: Certificate renewal requirements
paragraph: (i)  has accumulated at least 5 but fewer than 20 continuing education credits relating to a matter set out in Schedule 3 within the 5 year period immediately preceding the application date, and

heading: Certificate renewal requirements
paragraph: (ii)  as a term of the new certificate, agrees to complete the difference between the number of continuing education credits accumulated in the 5 year period referred to in subparagraph (i) and 20 within the period specified for that purpose in the certificate.

heading: Certificate renewal requirements
paragraph: (2) A continuing education credit is equal to one hour of training that is

heading: Certificate renewal requirements
paragraph: (a) in relation to a matter set out in Schedule 3, and

heading: Certificate renewal requirements
paragraph: (b) provided by a training provider that

heading: Certificate renewal requirements
paragraph: (i)  is approved by the administrator,

heading: Certificate renewal requirements
paragraph: (ii)  provides training approved by the administrator, and

heading: Certificate renewal requirements
paragraph: (iii)  maintains, for at least 5 years, registration, attendance and course completion information for each student.

heading: Certificate terms and conditions
paragraph:
54
		  The following are terms and conditions of every certificate issued under section 5 of the Act:

heading: Certificate terms and conditions
paragraph: (a) a certificate holder must comply with all applicable regulations;

heading: Certificate terms and conditions
