paragraph: (b) a certificate is not transferable;

heading: Certificate terms and conditions
paragraph: (c) if a certificate holder believes that the certificate holder or another person has contravened the Act or this regulation in a manner involving the release of pesticide into the environment, the certificate holder must give written notice to the administrator as soon as practicable;

heading: Certificate terms and conditions
paragraph: (d) a certificate holder must ensure that the certificate holder's certificate is at or near anyplace where the certificate holder is performing a duty that under this regulation must be performed by a certified individual.

heading: Pesticide dispenser certificate terms and conditions
paragraph:
54.1
		  Without limiting section 54 [certificate terms and conditions], it is a condition of every pesticide dispenser certificate issued under section 5 of the Act that the certificate holder perform the duties described in section 46 (3) [duties of certified individuals in relation to licensee].

heading: Residential applicator certificate terms and conditions
paragraph:
54.2
		  Without limiting section 54 [certificate terms and conditions], the following are terms and conditions of every residential applicator certificate issued under section 5 of the Act:

heading: Residential applicator certificate terms and conditions
paragraph: (a) the certificate holder may use, under the certificate, only a pesticide that

heading: Residential applicator certificate terms and conditions
paragraph: (i)  is classed as a domestic pesticide,

heading: Residential applicator certificate terms and conditions
paragraph: (ii)  is not a fumigant, and

heading: Residential applicator certificate terms and conditions
paragraph: (iii)  does not have a label indicating that the pesticide may be used only by persons holding a certificate or other authorization to use the pesticide;

heading: Residential applicator certificate terms and conditions
paragraph: (b) the certificate holder may use, under the certificate, a pesticide only

heading: Residential applicator certificate terms and conditions
paragraph: (i)  on private residential land,

heading: Residential applicator certificate terms and conditions
paragraph: (ii)  if the certificate holder is the owner or occupier of the land on which the pesticide is used or if the certificate holder is acting with the agreement of the owner or occupier of that land, and

heading: Residential applicator certificate terms and conditions
paragraph: (iii)  for a purpose described in section 5 (1) (i).

heading: Category of permit required
paragraph:
55
		  (1) Subject to Division 4 [Permits] of Part 1, a person must hold a permit endorsed for the use of a permit-restricted pesticide who uses or authorizes the use of the permit-restricted pesticide.

heading: Category of permit required
paragraph: (2) Subject to Division 4 of Part 1, a person must hold a permit endorsed for the applicable use who uses or authorizes the use of a pesticide for a use described in section 18 (2) [pesticides and pesticide uses requiring a permit].

heading: Category of permit required
paragraph: (3) Subject to Division 4 of Part 1, a licensee and a confirmation holder require a permit for the purposes of section 7 (2) [licence requirement exemptions] or 25 (2) [confirmation holder exemptions], as applicable, authorizing an exemption from a requirement under section 33 (3) (b) in relation to a use and setting out terms and conditions the licensee or confirmation holder must comply with instead.

heading: Permit applications
paragraph:
56
		  An applicant for a permit must provide the following information in an application form that is signed by the applicant or the applicant's agent and is in the form specified by the administrator:

heading: Permit applications
paragraph: (a) name, address and telephone number of the applicant, and if the applicant is a corporation, the name of a person who is the principal contact in relation to the application;

heading: Permit applications
paragraph: (b) if the applicant carries on business in a name other than a name provided under paragraph (a), that other name;

heading: Permit applications
paragraph: (c) pesticide class or pesticide use in relation to which the permit is applied for and the following information in relation to the particular pesticide intended to be used:

heading: Permit applications
paragraph: (i)  active ingredient;

heading: Permit applications
paragraph: (ii)  registration number under the federal Act;

heading: Permit applications
paragraph: (iii)  rate of application;

heading: Permit applications
paragraph: (iv)  method of application;

heading: Permit applications
paragraph: (v)  number of hectares to be treated;

heading: Permit applications
paragraph: (vi)  quantity in kilograms;

heading: Permit applications
paragraph: (d) purpose of the proposed pesticide use;

heading: Permit applications
paragraph: (e) a description of the treatment location and a map identifying the gross boundaries of the treatment area;

heading: Permit applications
paragraph: (f) proposed start and end date of pesticide use;

heading: Permit applications
paragraph: (g) name of the owner or manager of the treatment location.

heading: Permit terms and conditions
paragraph:
57
		  (1) The following are terms and conditions of every permit issued under section 6 of the Act:

heading: Permit terms and conditions
paragraph: (a) a permit holder must comply with all applicable regulations;

heading: Permit terms and conditions
paragraph: (b) a permit is not transferable without the written approval of the administrator;

heading: Permit terms and conditions
paragraph: (c) a permit holder must ensure that an individual holding the certificate required under section 50 (4) [category of certificate required] in relation to a particular use is present when the use is performed and either

heading: Permit terms and conditions
paragraph: (i)  performs the use, or

heading: Permit terms and conditions
paragraph: (ii)  supervises, in accordance with section 59.3 [supervision requirements], not more than 4 assistant applicators who perform the use;

heading: Permit terms and conditions
paragraph: (d) a permit holder must ensure that a copy of the certificate of the individual described in paragraph (c) is at or near the treatment location during the pesticide use;

heading: Permit terms and conditions
paragraph: (e) if a permit holder believes that the permit holder or another person has contravened this regulation in a manner involving the release of pesticide into the environment, the permit holder must give written notice to the administrator as soon as practicable.

heading: Permit terms and conditions
paragraph: (3) A person may request the administrator's approval of a transfer of a permit to another person by submitting to the administrator an application containing the name of the permit holder and the information required on a new permit application.

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph:
58
		  (1) A pest management plan prepared for the purpose of section 7 (1) (a) of the Act must include the following identifying information:

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (a) a description of the geographic boundaries of the area to which the plan applies and maps or diagrams showing proposed treatment areas within that area;

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (b) the person responsible for managing pests in relation to the land described in paragraph (a);

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (c) the name and phone number of an individual who is the principal contact for information relating to the pest management plan.

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (2) A pest management plan prepared for the purpose of section 7 (1) (a) of the Act must include the following integrated pest management elements:

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (a) a description of the program that will be employed to prevent organisms from becoming pests;

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (b) either

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (i)  a description of the program that will be employed to identify pests targeted by the plan, or

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (ii)  identification of the pests targeted by the plan;

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (c) a description of the monitoring program that will be employed before or during the pesticide use for assessing pest populations, environmental conditions and damage caused by pests, which program must include a description of

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (i)  the monitoring methods,

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (ii)  the frequency of monitoring, and

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (iii)  the data that will be collected;

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (d) the injury thresholds that will be applied in deciding whether a pesticide treatment is necessary and an explanation of

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (i)  how the thresholds were chosen, and

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (ii)  how the thresholds will be applied;

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (e) pest treatment options including

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (i)  a description of the pesticide and non-pesticide treatment methods of controlling pests that may be used,

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (ii)  the rationale for selecting the treatment methods described under subparagraph (i),

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (iii)  the benefits and limitations of each treatment method described under subparagraph (i), and

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (iv)  a description of how a decision to use treatment methods will be made;

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (f) a description of the monitoring program that will be employed for evaluating the effectiveness of the pesticide use on pest populations and the environment, including effects on organisms other than targeted pests, by comparison with the information collected under the program described in paragraph (c), which program must include a description of

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (i)  the monitoring methods,

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (ii)  the frequency of monitoring, and

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (iii)  the data that will be collected.

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (3) A pest management plan prepared for the purpose of section 7 (1) (a) of the Act must include the following operational information:

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (a) a description of the methods of handling, preparing, mixing, applying and otherwise using pesticides that will be employed under the plan including a description of the following procedures:

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (i)  procedures for safely transporting pesticides;

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (ii)  procedures for safely storing pesticides;

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (iii)  procedures for safely mixing, loading and applying pesticides;

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (iv)  procedures for the safe disposal of empty pesticide containers and unused pesticides;

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (v)  procedures for responding to pesticide spills;

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (b) a description of the environmental protection strategies and procedures that will be followed under the plan, including a description of the following strategies and procedures:

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (i)  strategies to protect community watersheds and other domestic and agricultural water sources from adverse effects of pesticide use;

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (ii)  strategies to protect fish and wildlife, riparian areas and wildlife habitat from adverse effects of pesticide use;

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (iii)  strategies to prevent pesticide contamination of food intended for human consumption;

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (iv)  pre-treatment inspection procedures for identifying treatment area boundaries;

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (v)  procedures for maintaining and calibrating pesticide application equipment;

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (vi)  procedures for monitoring weather conditions and strategies for modifying pesticide application methods for different weather conditions;

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (c) identification of each pesticide that will be used under the plan, the manner of its application and the type of equipment required for each manner of application.

heading: Pest management plans
paragraph: (4) If a confirmation holder submits under section 59 (2) an amendment to a pesticide use notice, the confirmation holder must amend the pest management plan prepared in relation to the pesticide use notice so that it is consistent with the amended pesticide use notice.

heading: Pesticide use notice requirements
paragraph:
59
		  (1) A pesticide use notice under section 7 (2) of the Act must be signed by the applicant or the applicant's agent and contain the following information:

heading: Pesticide use notice requirements
paragraph: (a) the name and business address of the applicant, and if different from the business address, an address for service on the applicant;

heading: Pesticide use notice requirements
paragraph: (b) if the applicant carries on business in a name other than a name provided under paragraph (a), that other name;

heading: Pesticide use notice requirements
paragraph: (c) the class of pesticide prescribed under section 24 (1) [pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation] or the use prescribed under section 24 (2) in relation to which the notice is sent;

heading: Pesticide use notice requirements
paragraph: (d) a description of the geographic boundaries of the area to which the pesticide use notice relates, as described in the applicable pest management plan, including the names of the regional districts of which all or a part are within those geographic boundaries;

heading: Pesticide use notice requirements
paragraph: (e) a list of the active ingredients of the pesticides proposed for use under the applicable pest management plan;

heading: Pesticide use notice requirements
paragraph: (f) a statement of whether aerial application of pesticide is intended under the applicable pest management plan;

heading: Pesticide use notice requirements
paragraph: (g) the name and phone number of an officer or employee of the applicant who is the principal contact for information relating to the applicable pest management plan;

heading: Pesticide use notice requirements
paragraph: (h) the location for the purpose of section 7 (6) (a) of the Act;

heading: Pesticide use notice requirements
paragraph: (i) the maximum number of hectares or poles per year intended to be treated with pesticide under the applicable pest management plan;

heading: Pesticide use notice requirements
paragraph: (j) the term of the applicable pest management plan, which must not exceed 5 years;

heading: Pesticide use notice requirements
paragraph: (k) the amount of the fee prescribed in section 29 [confirmation fees] in relation to the confirmation requested.

heading: Pesticide use notice requirements
paragraph: (2) If, after the applicant has submitted a pesticide use notice, the information required under subsection (1) changes, the applicant must submit to the administrator an amended pesticide use notice containing the amended information.

heading: Prohibited activities
paragraph:
59.1
		  A licensee, a permit holder and a confirmation holder must ensure that assistant applicators do not perform any of the following activities under the licence, permit or confirmation:

heading: Prohibited activities
paragraph: (a) select the pesticides to be used in a treatment area;

heading: Prohibited activities
paragraph: (b) determine the method or rate of pesticide application in a treatment area;

heading: Prohibited activities
paragraph: (c) determine injury thresholds for the purposes of section 68 (1) (d) [licensee use of pesticide - integrated pest management] or 69 (1) (d) [confirmation holder use of pesticide - integrated pest management], if applicable;

heading: Prohibited activities
paragraph: (d) mix pesticide concentrates;

heading: Prohibited activities
paragraph: (e) calibrate pesticide application equipment;

heading: Prohibited activities
paragraph: (f) handle or use fumigants;

heading: Prohibited activities
paragraph: (g) use permit-restricted pesticides or restricted pesticides;

heading: Prohibited activities
paragraph: (h) use pesticides having a label indicating that the pesticide may be used only by persons holding a certificate or other authorization to use the pesticide;

heading: Prohibited activities
paragraph: (i) conduct evaluations for the purposes of section 68 (2) or 69 (2), if applicable;

heading: Prohibited activities
paragraph: (j) use an SGAR.

heading: Training and training records
paragraph:
59.2
		  (1) A licensee, a permit holder and a confirmation holder must ensure that each assistant applicator applying or using a pesticide under the licence, permit or confirmation has, within the 12 months before the first application of a pesticide in a calendar year, completed a course established by the administrator for the purpose of ensuring that assistant applicators are knowledgeable in the application of the pesticide.

heading: Training and training records
paragraph: (2) A licensee, a permit holder and a confirmation holder must

heading: Training and training records
paragraph: (a) prepare and maintain a record of each assistant applicator's completion of the course referred to in subsection (1),

heading: Training and training records
paragraph: (b) keep the record at or near the treatment area during application of the pesticide, and

heading: Training and training records
paragraph: (c) make the record available to the supervising certificate holder.

heading: Supervision requirements
paragraph:
59.3
		  A certified individual who is supervising assistant applicators

heading: Supervision requirements
paragraph: (a) must not be more than 500 m from each assistant applicator,

heading: Supervision requirements
paragraph: (b) must maintain continuous visual or auditory contact with each assistant applicator,

heading: Supervision requirements
paragraph: (c) must review the record kept under section 59.2 [training and training records] in respect of each assistant applicator, and

heading: Supervision requirements
paragraph: (d) must not permit an assistant applicator to apply a pesticide unless satisfied that the assistant applicator has completed the course required under section 59.2 (1).

heading: Public consultation - permit application
paragraph:
60
		  (1) Within the 45 day period after the administrator has issued an application number in relation to an application for a permit for a pesticide use, the applicant must

heading: Public consultation - permit application
paragraph: (a) publish a notice of the application containing the information set out in subsection (2) in the manner specified by the administrator, or

heading: Public consultation - permit application
paragraph: (b) if all persons who may be affected by use are identifiable, give written notice containing the information set out in subsection (2) to each of those persons.

heading: Public consultation - permit application
paragraph: (2) A notice for the purpose of subsection (1) must contain all the following:

heading: Public consultation - permit application
paragraph: (a) the heading "APPLICATION FOR PESTICIDE USE" in block letters 18 pt. or larger and in bold or medium type;

heading: Public consultation - permit application
paragraph: (b) the application number;

heading: Public consultation - permit application
paragraph: (c) the applicant's name, address, email address and a telephone number at which the applicant can be contacted;

heading: Public consultation - permit application
paragraph: (d) the purpose of the pesticide use;

heading: Public consultation - permit application
paragraph: (e) the manner of application of the pesticide;

heading: Public consultation - permit application
paragraph: (f) the location and size of the treatment area;

heading: Public consultation - permit application
paragraph: (g) the trade name of the pesticide and its active ingredient;

heading: Public consultation - permit application
paragraph: (h) pesticide use proposed start and end dates;

heading: Public consultation - permit application
paragraph: (i) a location where copies of the permit application and maps of the treatment area may be examined;

heading: Public consultation - permit application
paragraph: (j) the following paragraph:

heading: Public consultation - permit application
paragraph: A person wishing to contribute information about the treatment area for the evaluation of this permit application must send copies of the information to both the applicant at the address above or email address above and the administrator under the Integrated Pest Management Act at [address] within 30 days of the publication of this notice.

heading: Public consultation - permit application
paragraph: (3) Within 90 days after the date the notice required under subsection (1) is published or given, as applicable, the applicant for the permit must submit to the administrator

heading: Public consultation - permit application
paragraph: (a) proof of publication of the notice or, if the notice was not published, a copy of the notice and a statement identifying the persons to whom the notice was given, and

heading: Public consultation - permit application
paragraph: (b) a signed statement describing the action the applicant proposes to take in response to information provided in response to the notice.

heading: Public consultation - pest management plan
paragraph: 61		  (1) At least 45 days before submitting a pesticide use notice to the administrator, an applicant for a confirmation must publish, in the manner specified by the administrator, the first of 2 notices containing the information set out in subsection (2), that must be published in a 2 week period.

heading: Public consultation - pest management plan
paragraph: (2) A notice for the purpose of subsection (1) must contain all the following:

heading: Public consultation - pest management plan
paragraph: (a) the heading "DEVELOPMENT OF A PEST MANAGEMENT PLAN" in block letters;

heading: Public consultation - pest management plan
paragraph: (b) a reference number or other identifier unique to the proposed pest management plan;

heading: Public consultation - pest management plan
paragraph: (c) the applicant's name, address, email address and telephone number;

heading: Public consultation - pest management plan
paragraph: (d) a statement that the use of pesticides is intended within the area to which the pest management plan applies;

heading: Public consultation - pest management plan
paragraph: (e) a description, with reference to communities, of the area to which the pest management plan applies;

heading: Public consultation - pest management plan
paragraph: (f) the proposed duration of the pest management plan;

heading: Public consultation - pest management plan
paragraph: (g) the trade name and active ingredient of the pesticides proposed to be used under the pest management plan;

heading: Public consultation - pest management plan
paragraph: (h) the proposed manners of applying the pesticides identified under paragraph (g);

heading: Public consultation - pest management plan
paragraph: (i) a location where copies of the proposed pest management plan and maps of the proposed treatment area may be examined;

heading: Public consultation - pest management plan
paragraph: (j) the following paragraph:

heading: Public consultation - pest management plan
paragraph: A person wishing to contribute information about a proposed treatment area, relevant to the development of the pest management plan, may send copies of the information to the applicant at the address above or email address above within 30 days of the publication of this notice.

heading: Public consultation - pest management plan
paragraph: (3) If a proposed pesticide use under a pest management plan has the potential to significantly impact an individual or member of an organization or community, the confirmation holder must make reasonable efforts, starting at least 45 days before submitting a pesticide use notice to the administrator, to contact and consult those individuals.

heading: Public consultations - licensees in respect of forest land
paragraph:
62
		  (1) For the purposes of section 9 [public consultation requirements - licensee], at least 14 days before the pesticide use, the licensee must give written notice to the owner of any property within 150 m of the treatment area.

heading: Public consultations - licensees in respect of forest land
paragraph: (2) A notice for the purposes of subsection (1) must contain all the following:

heading: Public consultations - licensees in respect of forest land
paragraph: (a) description of the treatment area;

heading: Public consultations - licensees in respect of forest land
paragraph: (b) reason for the pesticide use;

heading: Public consultations - licensees in respect of forest land
paragraph: (c) pesticide to be used, its registration number under the federal Act and its active ingredients;

heading: Public consultations - licensees in respect of forest land
paragraph: (d) the earliest date that the pesticide will be used;

heading: Public consultations - licensees in respect of forest land
paragraph: (e) the width of the no-treatment zone that will be maintained from a water supply intake or well used for domestic or agricultural purposes, including water for livestock or for irrigation of crops;

heading: Public consultations - licensees in respect of forest land
paragraph: (f) a request that the recipient

heading: Public consultations - licensees in respect of forest land
paragraph: (i)  supply the licensee with the location of water supply intakes or wells described in paragraph (e), and

heading: Public consultations - licensees in respect of forest land
paragraph: (ii)  advise the licensee of other land uses that may be adversely affected by the use;

heading: Public consultations - licensees in respect of forest land
paragraph: (g) a phone number at which the licensee or an employee can be reached for more information about the proposed pesticide use.

heading: Treatment notice - form and content
paragraph:
63
		  (1) A treatment notice for the purposes of section 10 must contain all the following information:

heading: Treatment notice - form and content
paragraph: (a) description of the treatment area;

heading: Treatment notice - form and content
paragraph: (b) name of the targeted pest;

heading: Treatment notice - form and content
paragraph: (c) the registration number under the federal Act of the pesticide to be used and its active ingredient;

heading: Treatment notice - form and content
paragraph: (d) proposed date and start time of the pesticide use and proposed alternative dates and times of the pesticide use;

heading: Treatment notice - form and content
paragraph: (e) name of licensee and licence number;

heading: Treatment notice - form and content
paragraph: (f) a phone number at which the licensee or an employee can be reached for more information about the proposed pesticide use;

heading: Treatment notice - form and content
paragraph: (g) precautions that should be taken to minimize exposure to a pesticide or its residues, including, without limiting this, specifying the period following the use during which people should not enter the treatment area;

heading: Treatment notice - form and content
paragraph: (h) if fruit-bearing trees or other food crops are treated, the number of days before food can be harvested safely.

heading: Treatment notice - form and content
paragraph: (2) A treatment notice posted for the purposes of section 10 must

heading: Treatment notice - form and content
paragraph: (a) if posted in an outdoor area, be at least 550 cm2 in size and if posted in an indoor area, be at least 200 cm2 in size,

heading: Treatment notice - form and content
paragraph: (b) if the notice may be exposed to water, be constructed of water resistant material,

heading: Treatment notice - form and content
paragraph: (c) use type or letters that are clearly legible to a person approaching the treatment area,

heading: Treatment notice - form and content
paragraph: (d) contain a cautionary symbol, like a stop sign or a raised hand, that will draw the attention of a person approaching the treatment area, and

heading: Treatment notice - form and content
paragraph: (e) display, in bold, block letters, the words "NOTICE OF PESTICIDE USE" or, in place of the word "pesticide", the word "insecticide", "herbicide" or another category of pesticide.

heading: Public notification requirement - form and content
paragraph:
64
		  (1) A notice for the purposes of section 10 (11) [public notification requirements - licensee] or 28 (1) [public notification requirement - confirmations] must be posted or given before each pesticide use in accordance with this section and in the case of a notice posted in accordance with subsection (2) may not be removed for at least 14 days after the use.

heading: Public notification requirement - form and content
paragraph: (2) Except as provided in subsections (3) and (4), a notice for the purposes of section 10 (11) or 28 (1) must

heading: Public notification requirement - form and content
paragraph: (a) if in relation to private land, be posted

heading: Public notification requirement - form and content
paragraph: (i)  so that it is clearly visible and legible from each approach maintained by the owner or manager of the land for use by the public to access the treatment area, or

heading: Public notification requirement - form and content
paragraph: (ii)  at a location on a highway so that the notice is clearly visible and legible to a member of the public accessing the approaches described in subparagraph (i) from the highway,

heading: Public notification requirement - form and content
paragraph: (b) if in relation to public land, be posted

heading: Public notification requirement - form and content
paragraph: (i)  so that it is clearly visible and legible from each approach used by the public to access the treatment area, or

heading: Public notification requirement - form and content
paragraph: (ii)  at a location on a highway so that so the notice is clearly visible and legible to a member of the public accessing the approaches described in subparagraph (i) from the highway,

heading: Public notification requirement - form and content
paragraph: (c) if posted by a confirmation holder, give notice of

heading: Public notification requirement - form and content
paragraph: (i)  the trade name or active ingredient of the pesticide that will be used,

heading: Public notification requirement - form and content
paragraph: (ii)  the date and time of the pesticide use,

heading: Public notification requirement - form and content
paragraph: (iii)  precautions to be taken to prevent harm to people entering the treatment area,

heading: Public notification requirement - form and content
paragraph: (iv)  the confirmation holder's confirmation number, and

heading: Public notification requirement - form and content
paragraph: (v)  how to contact the confirmation holder or that person's agent to obtain additional information about the pesticide or pesticide use, and

heading: Public notification requirement - form and content
paragraph: (d) if posted by a licensee, give notice of

heading: Public notification requirement - form and content
paragraph: (i)  the trade name or active ingredient of the pesticide that will be used,

heading: Public notification requirement - form and content
paragraph: (ii)  the date and time of the pesticide use,

heading: Public notification requirement - form and content
paragraph: (iii)  precautions to be taken to prevent harm to people entering the treatment area,

heading: Public notification requirement - form and content
paragraph: (iv)  the licensee's licence number, unless the licensee is using the pesticide under contract with a confirmation holder, in which case, the confirmation holder's confirmation number, and

heading: Public notification requirement - form and content
paragraph: (v)  how to contact the licensee or that person's agent to obtain additional information about the pesticide or pesticide use, unless the licensee is using the pesticide under contract with a confirmation holder, in which case, how to contact the confirmation holder or that person's agent for the additional information.

heading: Public notification requirement - form and content
paragraph: (3) A notice for the purposes of section 28 (1) in relation to a confirmation holder intending to use, or authorize the use of, a pesticide to manage adult mosquitoes

heading: Public notification requirement - form and content
paragraph: (a) must be

heading: Public notification requirement - form and content
paragraph: (i)  published in the manner specified by the administrator,

heading: Public notification requirement - form and content
paragraph: (ii)  broadcast on a radio station heard in the treatment area, or

heading: Public notification requirement - form and content
paragraph: (iii)  given personally to the residents of the treatment area,

heading: Public notification requirement - form and content
paragraph: (b) must be given in writing to beekeepers registered under the Bee Regulation who have apiaries registered under the Bee Regulation in the treatment area, and

heading: Public notification requirement - form and content
paragraph: (c) must give notice of the matters described in subsection (2) (c) in relation to the proposed pesticide use.

heading: Public notification requirement - form and content
paragraph: (4) Notice under this section is not required in relation to a use described in section 5 (1) (c) or (d) [pesticide uses requiring a licence] or 24 (2) (c) or (d) [pesticide uses requiring a confirmation].

heading: Pesticide container and labelling standards
paragraph:
65
		  (1) Pesticide must be kept, handled, stored or transported

heading: Pesticide container and labelling standards
paragraph: (a) in the container in which it was originally packaged and with the label originally affixed by the manufacturer, or

heading: Pesticide container and labelling standards
paragraph: (b) in a container designed for containing the pesticide and labelled in accordance with subsection (2).

heading: Pesticide container and labelling standards
paragraph: (2) For the purposes of subsection (1) (b), a label must display

heading: Pesticide container and labelling standards
paragraph: (a) the trade name of the pesticide,

heading: Pesticide container and labelling standards
paragraph: (b) the name and the concentration of the active ingredient in the pesticide, and

heading: Pesticide container and labelling standards
paragraph: (c) the pesticide's registration number under the federal Act.

heading: Pesticide container and labelling standards
paragraph: (3) Subsections (1) and (2) do not apply to tanks being used for mixing pesticides for or holding pesticides during use.

heading: Pesticide storage
paragraph:
66
		  (1) Pesticide, other than excluded pesticides and domestic pesticides, must be stored

heading: Pesticide storage
paragraph: (a) separately from food intended for human or animal consumption, and

heading: Pesticide storage
paragraph: (b) in a storage facility that is

heading: Pesticide storage
paragraph: (i)  ventilated so that pesticide vapours are vented to the outside,

heading: Pesticide storage
paragraph: (ii)  not used for the storage of food intended for human or animal consumption,

heading: Pesticide storage
paragraph: (iii)  locked when unattended, and

heading: Pesticide storage
paragraph: (iv)  accessible only to persons authorized by the person storing the pesticide.

heading: Pesticide storage
paragraph: (2) Each door providing access to a facility described in subsection (1) (b) must bear a sign that

heading: Pesticide storage
paragraph: (a) has the words "WARNING: CHEMICAL STORAGE - AUTHORIZED PERSONS ONLY" written in block letters, and

heading: Pesticide storage
paragraph: (b) is clearly visible to a person approaching the door.

heading: Pesticide storage
paragraph: (3) Fumigants and other pesticides that

heading: Pesticide storage
paragraph: (a) release vapours, and

heading: Pesticide storage
paragraph: (b) bear a "poison" symbol on the label

heading: Pesticide storage
paragraph: must be stored in a storage facility that is not attached to or within a building used for living accommodation.

heading: Pesticide storage and signage requirements - vendor licensee
paragraph:
67
		  (1) Despite section 66, a holder of a pesticide vendor licence must store and display pesticides, other than domestic or excluded pesticides, in a storage facility that is

heading: Pesticide storage and signage requirements - vendor licensee
paragraph: (a) separated from the other areas of the vendor's business premises by floor to ceiling walls constructed of wood, fibreboard, plaster, brick or other solid material,

heading: Pesticide storage and signage requirements - vendor licensee
paragraph: (b) entered from the outside or, if the entry is inside, has a self-closing door, and

heading: Pesticide storage and signage requirements - vendor licensee
paragraph: (c) ventilated so that pesticide vapours are vented to the outside.

heading: Pesticide storage and signage requirements - vendor licensee
paragraph: (2) A holder of a pesticide vendor licence must store and display domestic pesticides separately from food intended for human or animal consumption.

heading: Pesticide storage and signage requirements - vendor licensee
paragraph: (3) A holder of a pesticide vendor licence must store and display SGARs and domestic pesticides, other than excluded pesticides, in a manner that prevents the public from accessing the pesticides without the assistance of a certified dispenser.

heading: Pesticide storage and signage requirements - vendor licensee
paragraph: (4) If a holder of a pesticide vendor licence offers SGARs for sale, the licensee must, in the place where each SGAR is displayed, post signage that complies with the standards established by the administrator.

heading: Licensee use of pesticide - integrated pest management
paragraph:
68
		  (1) Except as provided in section 7 (1) [licence requirement exemptions], a licensee may use a pesticide only after doing all the following in accordance with integrated pest management principles:

heading: Licensee use of pesticide - integrated pest management
paragraph: (a) identify and implement, or identify and advise the owner, occupant or manager of the treatment area of, reasonable measures to prevent pests;

heading: Licensee use of pesticide - integrated pest management
paragraph: (b) identify pest species and pest complexes to be managed;

heading: Licensee use of pesticide - integrated pest management
paragraph: (c) monitor to determine the population of pests and their location;

heading: Licensee use of pesticide - integrated pest management
paragraph: (d) determine the injury threshold for each pest and apply them to the determination of when to use a pesticide;

heading: Licensee use of pesticide - integrated pest management
paragraph: (e) select pest treatment methods based on

heading: Licensee use of pesticide - integrated pest management
paragraph: (i)  consideration of practical alternatives to pesticide use, and

heading: Licensee use of pesticide - integrated pest management
paragraph: (ii)  protection of human health and the environment.

heading: Licensee use of pesticide - integrated pest management
paragraph: (2) After each pesticide use, a licensee must evaluate, in accordance with integrated pest management principles, the effectiveness of the use.

heading: Confirmation holder use of pesticide - integrated pest management
paragraph:
69
		  (1) Except as provided in section 25 (1) [confirmation holder exemptions], a confirmation holder may use, or authorize the use of, a pesticide only after doing all the following in accordance with integrated pest management principles:

heading: Confirmation holder use of pesticide - integrated pest management
paragraph: (a) implement the reasonable measures to prevent pests identified in the pest management plan prepared in relation to the confirmation;

heading: Confirmation holder use of pesticide - integrated pest management
paragraph: (b) identify pest species and pest complexes to be managed;

heading: Confirmation holder use of pesticide - integrated pest management
paragraph: (c) determine, on the basis of monitoring

heading: Confirmation holder use of pesticide - integrated pest management
paragraph: (i)  the population of pests and their location,

heading: Confirmation holder use of pesticide - integrated pest management
paragraph: (ii)  the environmental conditions and features of the treatment area, and

heading: Confirmation holder use of pesticide - integrated pest management
paragraph: (iii)  the damage that has been or may be caused by the pests;

heading: Confirmation holder use of pesticide - integrated pest management
paragraph: (d) determine the injury threshold for each pest and apply it to the determination of when to use a pesticide;

heading: Confirmation holder use of pesticide - integrated pest management
paragraph: (e) select pest treatment methods based on, as identified in the pest management plan prepared in relation to the confirmation,

heading: Confirmation holder use of pesticide - integrated pest management
paragraph: (i)  consideration of practical alternatives to pesticide use, and

heading: Confirmation holder use of pesticide - integrated pest management
paragraph: (ii)  protection of human health and the environment.

heading: Confirmation holder use of pesticide - integrated pest management
paragraph: (2) A confirmation holder must make pre-treatment and post-treatment observations of the treatment area to evaluate the effectiveness and impact of each pesticide use.

heading: Use requirements - all users
paragraph:
70
		  (1) A container used to prepare, mix or apply a pesticide must not be washed or submerged in a body of water.

heading: Use requirements - all users
paragraph: (2) If equipment is used to draw water from a body of water or an irrigation system into a container used to contain, prepare, mix or apply a pesticide, a gap must be maintained between the pesticide and the equipment so that pesticide is prevented from entering the body of water or irrigation system.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph:
71
		  (1) A licensee, for the purposes of a pesticide use for which the licence is required, and a confirmation holder for the purposes of a pesticide use for which the confirmation is required, must do all the following before the pesticide use:

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (a) ensure that each individual who will be using the pesticide is informed of

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (i)  the boundaries of the proposed treatment area,

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (ii)  the requirements for personal protection, and

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (iii)  the pesticide use procedures required to protect human health and the environment;

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (b) ensure that the application equipment is in good working order and, if required, is calibrated to conform with the application rates on the pesticide label;

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (c) carry out an inspection of the treatment area to ensure that the applicable regulatory requirements and standards can be met in carrying out the use;

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (d) if the pesticide is to be applied aerially, ensure that the pilot conducts an inspection of the proposed treatment area to ensure that the pilot is familiar with the boundaries and other critical features of the treatment area.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (2) A person described in subsection (1) must ensure that the following precautions are taken in carrying out the pesticide use:

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (a) precautions to prevent unprotected human exposure to pesticide;

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (b) precautions to ensure that domestic water sources, agricultural water sources and soil used for agricultural crop production are protected for their intended use;

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (c) except as provided under subsection (12), precautions to avoid the use of pesticide over vertebrate wildlife or domestic animals that are visible to the user.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (3) Except as provided in subsections (4) and (12) and section 79 (2), a person described in subsection (1) must maintain a 30 m no-treatment zone around a water supply intake or well used for domestic or agricultural purposes, including water for livestock or for irrigation of crops.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (4) A person described in subsection (1) may reduce the no-treatment zone under subsection (3) if reasonably satisfied that the smaller zone will ensure that pesticide from the use will not enter the water supply intake or well.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (5) Except as provided in subsection (12) or (13), a person described in subsection (1) must ensure that a no-treatment zone between an outdoor pesticide use area and a body of water is sufficient to prevent the release of pesticide spray or runoff into the body of water.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (6) Unless an adjacent property owner or manager agrees otherwise, a person described in subsection (1) must ensure that a no-treatment zone between an outdoor pesticide use area and the adjacent property is sufficient to prevent the release of pesticide spray or runoff onto the adjacent property.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (7) Except as provided in section 76 (3) [use requirements - railway vegetation management], a person described in subsection (1) must not engage in broadcast spraying or foliar spraying outdoors if the wind speed exceeds 8 km per hour.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (8) Except in the case of pesticide use to manage adult mosquitoes, a person described in subsection (1) must spray pesticides only between 30 minutes before sunrise and 30 minutes after sunset unless a lighting device is used so that the person applying the pesticide and the pesticide use are clearly visible from a distance of at least 30 m.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (9) A person described in subsection (1) must not

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (a) use a residual pesticide on water-saturated soil, during heavy rainfall or if heavy rainfall is imminent, or

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (b) spray a pesticide on foliage covered by ice or frost or if water is flowing on the foliage.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (10) A person described in subsection (1) must ensure that a use of herbicide does not remove vegetation that is necessary to

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (a) prevent erosion of a stream bank,

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (b) prevent debris that would cause an unreasonable adverse effect from entering a stream, or

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (c) maintain slope stability in areas where landslides have occurred.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (11) A person described in subsection (1) must use slug bait that may be harmful to children or domestic animals only

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (a) in slug bait stations that are resistant to tampering by children and animals, or

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (b) in areas that are inaccessible to children and domestic animals.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (12) Subsections (2) (c), (3) and (5) do not apply in relation to a pesticide use if the pesticide is a bacterial pesticide.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder
paragraph: (13) Subsection (5) does not apply in relation to pesticide use in a storm water catch basin if the pesticide is methoprene.

heading: Use requirements - confirmation holder
paragraph:
72
		  (1) A confirmation holder using, or authorizing the use of, a pesticide must

heading: Use requirements - confirmation holder
paragraph: (a) comply with all applicable regulations,

heading: Use requirements - confirmation holder
paragraph: (b) ensure that an individual holding the certificate required under section 50 (4) [category of certificate required] in relation to a particular use is present when the use is performed and either

heading: Use requirements - confirmation holder
paragraph: (i)  performs the use, or

heading: Use requirements - confirmation holder
paragraph: (ii)  supervises, in accordance with section 59.3 [supervision requirements], not more than 4 assistant applicators who perform the use,

heading: Use requirements - confirmation holder
paragraph: (c) ensure that the certificate of the individual described in paragraph (b) is at or near the treatment area during the pesticide use, and

heading: Use requirements - confirmation holder
paragraph: (d) if the confirmation holder believes that the confirmation holder or another person has contravened the Act or this regulation in a manner involving the release of pesticide into the environment, the confirmation holder must give written notice to the administrator as soon as practicable.

heading: Use requirements - confirmation holder
paragraph: (3) A confirmation holder may use, or authorize the use of, pesticides only in areas described for the purposes of section 42 (3) [confirmation holder - annual notice of intent to treat] in the confirmation holder's notice of intent to treat provided to the administrator for the calendar year in which the pesticide use is proposed.

heading: Use requirements - confirmation holder
paragraph: (4) A confirmation holder must ensure that a person applying pesticide on the confirmation holder's behalf has access to the detailed map or diagram required under section 42 (1) [confirmation holder - annual notice of intent to treat].

heading: Use requirements for pesticide-free zone - confirmation holder and licensee
paragraph:
73
		  (1) Except as provided in sections 74 (1) and (2), 75 (3) to (7), 76 (5) to (7), 77 (2), 78 (2), 79 (3) and (4) and 80, a licensee, for the purposes of a pesticide use described in section 5 (1) (a), (b), (g), (j), (k) or (l) [pesticide uses requiring a licence], and a confirmation holder, for the purposes of a pesticide use for which the confirmation is required, must ensure that a minimum 10 m pesticide-free zone is maintained around or along bodies of water, dry streams and classified wetlands.

heading: Use requirements for pesticide-free zone - confirmation holder and licensee
paragraph: (2) Pesticide-free zones must be measured in horizontal distance from the high water mark of the body of water, dry stream or classified wetlands.

heading: Use requirements for pesticide-free zone - confirmation holder and licensee
paragraph: (3) A person described in subsection (1) must ensure that a no-treatment zone, sufficient to ensure the maintenance of the pesticide-free zone required under subsection (1), is maintained around the pesticide-free zone.

heading: Use requirements for pesticide-free zone - confirmation holder and licensee
paragraph: (4) This section does not apply in relation to a pesticide use if the pesticide is a bacterial pesticide.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to specific uses
paragraph:
74
		  (1) A licensee for the purposes of a pesticide use described in section 5 (1) (a), (b), (k) or (l) [pesticide uses requiring a licence] and a confirmation holder for the purposes of a pesticide use described in section 24 (2) (a), (b), (f) or (g) [pesticide classes and pesticide uses requiring a confirmation] using glyphosate, may reduce the pesticide-free zone required under section 73 (1) as follows:

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to specific uses
paragraph: (a) to 2 m along or around a body of water or a classified wetland that is fish bearing or that drains directly into a fish bearing body of water or a dry stream that when wet is fish bearing or drains directly into a fish bearing body of water

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to specific uses
paragraph: (i)  if the treatment area is

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to specific uses
paragraph: (A) railway ballast, signal, switch or yard, or

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to specific uses
paragraph: (B) another industrial site that must be free of vegetation, or

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to specific uses
paragraph: (ii)  if the pesticide is applied using selective application methods;

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to specific uses
paragraph: (b) except as provided in section 77 (2), to 5 m along or around body of water or a classified wetland that is fish bearing or that drains directly into a fish bearing body of water or along or around a dry stream that when wet is fish bearing or drains directly into a fish bearing body of water, unless the treatment area is described in paragraph (a) (i);

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to specific uses
paragraph: (c) except as provided in section 77 (2), to a 2 m no-treatment zone along or around a body of water if the body of water is not fish bearing at any time of the year and does not drain directly into a fish bearing body of water.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to specific uses
paragraph: (2) A person described in subsection (1), despite that subsection, may apply glyphosate

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to specific uses
paragraph: (a) up to but not below the high water mark of temporary, free-standing bodies of water, and

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to specific uses
paragraph: (b) over dry streams

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to specific uses
paragraph: that are not fish bearing at any time of the year and do not drain directly into a fish bearing body of water.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to forestry uses
paragraph:
75
		  (1) In this section:

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to forestry uses
paragraph: "fish bearing", in relation to a body of water or classified wetland, means the body of water or classified wetland is frequented by

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to forestry uses
paragraph: (a) anadromous salmonids,

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to forestry uses
paragraph: (b) rainbow trout, cutthroat trout, brown trout, bull trout, Dolly Varden char, lake trout, brook trout, kokanee, largemouth bass, smallmouth bass, mountain whitefish, lake whitefish, arctic grayling, burbot, white sturgeon, black crappie, yellow perch, walleye or northern pike,

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to forestry uses
paragraph: (c) a species of fish identified as a species at risk under section 11 (1) of the Government Actions Regulation, or

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to forestry uses
paragraph: (d) a species of fish identified as regionally important wildlife under section 11 (2) of the Government Actions Regulation;

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to forestry uses
paragraph: "wildlife habitat feature" means a wildlife habitat feature identified under section 11 of the Government Actions Regulation.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to forestry uses
paragraph: (2) A licensee, for the purposes of a pesticide use described in section 5 (1) (g) or (j) [pesticide uses requiring a licence], and a confirmation holder, for the purposes of a pesticide use described in section 24 (2) (e) [pesticide uses requiring a confirmation], must ensure that integrated pest management monitoring activities required under section 68 (1) or 69 (1) are conducted within the 18 month period before the pesticide use to which it relates.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to forestry uses
paragraph: (3) A person described in subsection (2) using glyphosate may reduce the pesticide-free zone required under section 73 (1) to 2 m along or around a body of water or classified wetland if

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to forestry uses
paragraph: (a) the body of water or classified wetland is not fish bearing at any time of the year, and

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to forestry uses
paragraph: (b) selective application methods are used between 2 m and 10 m above the high water mark.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to forestry uses
paragraph: (4) The pesticide-free zone required under section 73 (1) is not required along or around a body of water by a person described in subsection (2) using glyphosate, if

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to forestry uses
paragraph: (a) the body of water is

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to forestry uses
paragraph: (i)  a temporary free-standing body of water,

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to forestry uses
paragraph: (ii)  not a classified wetland nor a wildlife habitat feature,

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to forestry uses
paragraph: (iii)  not fish bearing and does not drain into a fish bearing body of water within 100 m, and

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to forestry uses
paragraph: (b) no glyphosate is applied below the high water mark.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to forestry uses
paragraph: (5) The pesticide-free zone required under section 73 (1) is not required along or around a body of water by a person described in subsection (2) using glyphosate if the body of water is

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to forestry uses
paragraph: (a) a temporary free-standing body of water,

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to forestry uses
paragraph: (b) not a wildlife habitat feature,

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to forestry uses
paragraph: (c) not fish bearing and does not drain into a fish bearing body of water within 100 m, and

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to forestry uses
paragraph: (d) either smaller than 25 m2 or not a wetland.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to forestry uses
paragraph: (6) The pesticide-free zone required under section 73 (1) is not required along a dry stream by a person described in subsection (2) using glyphosate, if

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to forestry uses
paragraph: (a) the dry stream is not a wildlife habitat feature, and

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to forestry uses
paragraph: (b) not fish bearing when wet.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to forestry uses
paragraph: (7) If the conditions in subsection (5) or (6) are met, glyphosate may be applied to a body of water and a dry stream.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to railway vegetation management
paragraph:
76
		  (1) A licensee, for the purposes of a pesticide use described in section 5 (1) (a), and a confirmation holder, for the purposes of a pesticide use described in section 24 (2) (a), may not apply pesticide from an aircraft.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to railway vegetation management
paragraph: (2) A person described in subsection (1) must not apply pesticide to Rubus species of plants that are more than 3 m away from rails, signals or switch stands from the time the flowers open until the berries have predominantly dropped from the vines.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to railway vegetation management
paragraph: (3) A person described in subsection (1) may spray pesticide when wind speeds are between 8 km per hour and 16 km per hour if a shrouded boom is used.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to railway vegetation management
paragraph: (4) A person described in subsection (1) may apply pesticide from a moving vehicle if

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to railway vegetation management
paragraph: (a) a shrouded boom is used and the vehicle speed is not more than 30 km per hour,

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to railway vegetation management
paragraph: (b) a shrouded boom is not used, paragraph (c) does not apply and the vehicle speed is not more than 16 km per hour, or

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to railway vegetation management
paragraph: (c) the pesticide is a wood preservative.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to railway vegetation management
paragraph: (5) A person described in subsection (1) using glyphosate may reduce the pesticide-free zone required under section 73 (1) to a 1 m no-treatment zone along or around a body of water if

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to railway vegetation management
paragraph: (a) the pesticide is applied to railway ballast or yards, and

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to railway vegetation management
paragraph: (b) the body of water is a temporary, free-standing body of water that is not fish bearing at any time of the year and does not drain directly into fish bearing waters.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to railway vegetation management
paragraph: (6) A person described in subsection (1) may reduce the pesticide-free zone required under section 73 (1) to a 1 m no-treatment zone along or around a body of water or a dry steam if

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to railway vegetation management
paragraph: (a) the treatment is selective application to trees at highway crossings along the right of way,

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to railway vegetation management
paragraph: (b) the body of water or dry stream is not fish bearing at any time of the year and does not drain directly into fish bearing water, and

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to railway vegetation management
paragraph: (c) if in relation to a body of water, the body of water is a temporary, free-standing body of water.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to railway vegetation management
paragraph: (7) The pesticide-free zone required under section 73 (1) is not required by a person described in subsection (1) if

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to railway vegetation management
paragraph: (a) the pesticide is a wood preservative, and

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to railway vegetation management
paragraph: (b) precautions are taken that prevent the deposit of the wood preservative below the high water mark.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to noxious weed and invasive plant management
paragraph:
77
		  (1) Each of the following must not apply herbicide more than 1.5 m from a targeted weed or plant:

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to noxious weed and invasive plant management
paragraph: (a) a licensee for the purposes of a pesticide use described in section 5 (1) (l);

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to noxious weed and invasive plant management
paragraph: (b) a licensee performing noxious weed or invasive plant management in relation to a use described in section 5 (1) (a), (b), (g), (j) or (k);

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to noxious weed and invasive plant management
paragraph: (c) a confirmation holder, for the purposes of a pesticide use described in section 24 (2) (g);

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to noxious weed and invasive plant management
paragraph: (d) a confirmation holder performing noxious weed or invasive plant management in relation to a use described in section 24 (2) (a), (b), (e) or (f).

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to noxious weed and invasive plant management
paragraph: (2) A person described in subsection (1) using glyphosate may reduce the pesticide-free zone required under section 73 (1) to a minimum of 1 m if selective application is used between 1 m and 10 m above the high water mark.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to noxious weed and invasive plant management
paragraph: (3) A person described in subsection (1) in carrying out the use must make reasonable efforts to

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to noxious weed and invasive plant management
paragraph: (a) identify sites where biological weed control organisms have been released, and

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to noxious weed and invasive plant management
paragraph: (b) prevent harm to those organisms.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to mosquito management
paragraph:
78
		  (1) Subject to subsection (1.1), a licensee, for the purposes of a pesticide use described in section 5 (1) (c), and a confirmation holder, for the purposes of a pesticide use described in section 24 (2) (c) or (h), must not use a pesticide that is a mosquito larvicide in permanent, fish bearing bodies of water or waters that have permanent, direct, surface-water connections with fish bearing bodies of water.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to mosquito management
paragraph: (1.1) A person described in subsection (1) is exempt from that subsection if the following conditions are met:

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to mosquito management
paragraph: (a) the British Columbia Centre for Disease Control has advised the public that it has identified the West Nile virus in mosquitoes in the region of the Province where the pesticide is to be applied, and

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to mosquito management
paragraph: (b) the mosquitoes to be treated are species that are vectors of the West Nile virus.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to mosquito management
paragraph: (2) The pesticide-free zone required under section 73 (1) is not required by a confirmation holder in relation to the application of pesticide to a body of water for the purpose of managing mosquitoes.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to mosquito management
paragraph: (3) If a person described in subsection (1) does not know whether specific bodies of water are described by that subsection, the person must contact a local representative of Fisheries and Oceans Canada and inquire before applying mosquito larvicide to those waters.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to mosquito management
paragraph: (4) A person described in subsection (1) must

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to mosquito management
paragraph: (a) confirm by water dip samples that mosquito larvae are present in a body of water before applying mosquito larvicide to the body of water,

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to mosquito management
paragraph: (b) document the efficacy of a use of mosquito larvicide by conducting pre-treatment and post-treatment larval samples of the water, and

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to mosquito management
paragraph: (c) spray a pesticide for the purpose of controlling adult mosquitoes only between sunset and sunrise.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to mosquito management
paragraph: (5) A person described in subsection (1) may not use a pesticide containing propoxur in

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to mosquito management
paragraph: (a) a wildlife management area designated under section 4 of the Wildlife Act,

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to mosquito management
paragraph: (b) a critical wildlife area or wildlife sanctuary designated under section 5 of the Wildlife Act,

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to mosquito management
paragraph: (c) land acquired and administered under section 3 of the Wildlife Act,

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to mosquito management
paragraph: (d) an ecological reserve designated under the Ecological Reserve Act,

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to mosquito management
paragraph: (e) a bird sanctuary designated under the regulations pursuant to the Migratory Birds Convention Act, 1994 (Canada), or

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to mosquito management
paragraph: (f) a wildlife area designated under the Canada Wildlife Act.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to mosquito management
paragraph: (6) A licensee, for the purposes of a pesticide use described in section 5 (1) (c.1), may use methoprene in a storm water catch basin only if the following conditions are met:

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to mosquito management
paragraph: (a) the licensee must contact the drinking water officer within the meaning of the Drinking Water Protection Act for the region within which the treatment is proposed in order to ascertain if the proposed treatment area is near a water supply intake or well used for domestic or agricultural purposes, including water for livestock or irrigation of crops, and

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to mosquito management
paragraph: (b) if the storm water catch basin drains directly into a fish bearing body of water,

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to mosquito management
paragraph: (i)  the British Columbia Centre for Disease Control has advised the public that it has identified the West Nile virus in mosquitoes in the region of the Province where the pesticide is to be applied, and

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to mosquito management
paragraph: (ii)  the mosquitoes to be treated are species that are vectors of the West Nile virus.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to the use of wood preservatives on poles
paragraph: 79		  (1) In this section:

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to the use of wood preservatives on poles
paragraph: "external liquid formulation" means liquid preservative that is applied to the exterior of wood;

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to the use of wood preservatives on poles
paragraph: "groundline bandage treatment formulation" means a preservative in a paste form that is applied to the exterior of wood and then wrapped with a covering;

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to the use of wood preservatives on poles
paragraph: "liquid internal preservative" means a liquid preservative that is applied to wood by low pressure through a hole drilled into the core of the wood.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to the use of wood preservatives on poles
paragraph: (2) The no-treatment zone required under section 71 (3) is not required by a licensee for the purpose of a use described in section 5 (1) (d) [pesticide uses requiring a licence] or a confirmation holder for the purpose of a use described in section 24 (2) (d) if

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to the use of wood preservatives on poles
paragraph: (a) an external liquid formulation, a groundline bandage treatment formulation or a liquid internal preservative is used, and

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to the use of wood preservatives on poles
paragraph: (b) a 10 m no-treatment zone is maintained

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to the use of wood preservatives on poles
paragraph: (i)  around wells, and

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to the use of wood preservatives on poles
paragraph: (ii)  from a water intake on any side from which land slopes upward.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to the use of wood preservatives on poles
paragraph: (3) The pesticide-free zone required under section 73 (1) [use requirements for pesticide-free zone] is not required by a person described in subsection (2) if

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to the use of wood preservatives on poles
paragraph: (a) a liquid internal wood preservative is used,

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to the use of wood preservatives on poles
paragraph: (b) a 3 m no-treatment zone is maintained from fish bearing bodies of water and dry streams that are fish bearing when wet,

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to the use of wood preservatives on poles
paragraph: (c) a 1 m no-treatment zone is maintained from non-fish bearing bodies of water, and

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to the use of wood preservatives on poles
paragraph: (d) no pesticide is applied below the high water mark of dry streams that are not fish bearing at any time of the year.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to the use of wood preservatives on poles
paragraph: (4) The pesticide-free zone required under section 73 (1) [use requirements for pesticide-free zone] is not required by a person described in subsection (2) if

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to the use of wood preservatives on poles
paragraph: (a) an external liquid formulation or groundline bandage treatment formulation is used,

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to the use of wood preservatives on poles
paragraph: (b) a 3 m no-treatment zone is maintained from fish bearing bodies of water and dry streams that are fish bearing when wet, and

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder in relation to the use of wood preservatives on poles
paragraph: (c) a 1 m no-treatment zone is maintained from non-fish bearing bodies of water or dry streams that are not fish bearing at any time of the year.

heading: Use requirements - licensee and confirmation holder using bacterial pesticide
paragraph:
80
		  Sections 71 (2) (c), (3) and (5) and 73 (1) do not apply to a licensee or a confirmation holder using a bacterial pesticide.

heading: Use requirements - licensee in relation to rodenticide use
paragraph:
81
		  (1) A licensee providing a service or performing a use described in section 5 (1) (e), (f), (h), (i) or (n) [pesticide uses requiring a licence] must deploy rodenticide bait only

heading: Use requirements - licensee in relation to rodenticide use
paragraph: (a) in rigid walled bait containers that are fastened down to prevent tipping or removal and that remain securely closed for the period of time they are in use, or

heading: Use requirements - licensee in relation to rodenticide use
paragraph: (b) in locations and in a manner so that unauthorized people and domestic pets cannot gain access to them.

heading: Use requirements - licensee in relation to rodenticide use
paragraph: (2) A licensee who deploys rodenticide bait in a container must ensure that a label is placed on the outside of the container lid which label contains all the following:

heading: Use requirements - licensee in relation to rodenticide use
paragraph: (a) the word "Poison" or the symbol for poison;

heading: Use requirements - licensee in relation to rodenticide use
paragraph: (b) the name of the licensee's contact and the phone number at which that person can be reached for information about the pesticide use;

heading: Use requirements - licensee in relation to rodenticide use
paragraph: (c) the pesticide's active ingredient or its registration number under the federal Act.

heading: Use requirements - licensee in relation to rodenticide use
