paragraph: (3) Every person is guilty of an offence if, while contravening this Act or the regulations, they wilfully or recklessly cause

heading: Offence committed wilfully or recklessly
paragraph: (a) a risk of imminent death or serious bodily harm to another person;

heading: Offence committed wilfully or recklessly
paragraph: (b) a risk of substantial harm to the environment; or

heading: Offence committed wilfully or recklessly
paragraph: (c) harm to the environment.

heading: Punishment
paragraph: (4) Every person who commits an offence under subsection (3) is liable

heading: Punishment
paragraph: (a) on summary conviction, to a fine of not more than $300,000 or to imprisonment for a term of not more than six months, or to both; and

heading: Punishment
paragraph: (b) on conviction on indictment, to a fine of not more than $1,000,000 or to imprisonment for a term of not more than three years, or to both.

heading: Contravention of regulations
paragraph: 69 Every person who contravenes a provision of the regulations is guilty of an offence and liable

heading: Contravention of regulations
paragraph: (a) on summary conviction, to a fine of not more than $200,000 or to imprisonment for a term of not more than six months, or to both; and

heading: Contravention of regulations
paragraph: (b) on conviction on indictment, to a fine of not more than $500,000 or to imprisonment for a term of not more than three years, or to both.

heading: Due diligence
paragraph: 69.1 A person is not to be found guilty of an offence under this Act - other than an offence under section 30 or subsection 33(8), 40(1) or 44(7), an offence under subsection 47(4) as it relates to a contravention of subsection 47(3) or an offence under subsection 68(3) or 70(3) - if they establish that they exercised all due diligence to prevent the commission of the offence.

heading: Officers, etc., of corporations
paragraph: 70 (1) If a corporation commits an offence under this Act, any officer, director or agent of the corporation who directed, authorized, assented to, acquiesced in or participated in the commission of the offence is a party to and guilty of the offence and liable on conviction to the punishment provided for the offence, whether or not the corporation has been prosecuted or convicted.

heading: Duty to ensure compliance
paragraph: (2) Every director and officer of a corporation shall take all reasonable care to ensure that the corporation complies with this Act and the regulations.

heading: Offence and punishment
paragraph: (3) Every person who contravenes subsection (2) is guilty of an offence and liable

heading: Offence and punishment
paragraph: (a) on summary conviction, to a fine of not more than $200,000 or to imprisonment for a term of not more than six months, or to both; or

heading: Offence and punishment
paragraph: (b) on conviction on indictment, to a fine of not more than $500,000 or to imprisonment for a term of not more than three years, or to both.

heading: Offence by employee or agent or mandatary
paragraph: 71 In a prosecution for an offence under this Act - other than an offence under section 30 or subsection 33(8), 40(1) or 44(7), an offence under subsection 47(4) as it relates to a contravention of subsection 47(3) or an offence under subsection 68(3) or 70(3) - it is sufficient proof of the offence to establish that it was committed by an employee or agent or mandatary of the accused, whether or not the employee or agent or mandatary is identified or has been prosecuted for the offence, unless the accused establishes that

heading: Offence by employee or agent or mandatary
paragraph: (a) the offence was committed without the knowledge or consent of the accused; and

heading: Offence by employee or agent or mandatary
paragraph: (b) the accused exercised all due diligence to prevent its commission.

heading: Continuing offence
paragraph: 72 If an offence under this Act is continued on more than one day, the person who committed it is liable to be convicted for a separate offence for each day on which it is continued.

heading: Limitation period
paragraph: 73 (1) A proceeding by way of summary conviction in respect of an offence under this Act may be commenced at any time within two years after the day on which the Minister became aware of the subject-matter of the proceedings.

heading: Minister's certificate
paragraph: (2) A document purporting to have been issued by the Minister, certifying the day on which the Minister became aware of the subject-matter of the proceedings, is evidence of that fact without proof of the signature or official character of the person appearing to have signed it and without further proof.

heading: Venue
paragraph: 74 An information in respect of an offence under this Act may be tried, determined or adjudged by a summary conviction court if the defendant is resident or carrying on business within the territorial division of the court, even though the matter of the information did not arise in that territorial division.

heading: Analysis and examination
paragraph: 75 (1) An inspector may submit to an analyst for analysis or examination any pest control product or other thing seized by the inspector, any sample taken from that product or thing, or any other sample taken by the inspector.

heading: Certificate of analyst
paragraph: (2) A certificate of an analyst stating that the analyst has analysed or examined a pest control product or other thing or a sample and stating the result of the analysis or examination is evidence of the statements contained in the certificate without proof of the signature or the official character of the person appearing to have signed it.

heading: Attendance of analyst
paragraph: (3) The party against whom the certificate is produced may, with leave of the court, require the attendance of the analyst for the purpose of cross-examination.

heading: Notice
paragraph: (4) The certificate shall not be received in evidence unless the party who intends to produce it has given the party against whom it is intended to be produced reasonable notice of that intention, together with a copy of the certificate.

heading: Suspended sentence
paragraph: 76 When an offender is convicted of an offence under this Act, the court may suspend the passing of sentence and may make an order that the offender comply with any condition that has any or all of the effects described in section 77.

heading: Orders of court
paragraph: 77 (1) When an offender is convicted of an offence under this Act, the court may, having regard to the nature of the offence and the circumstances surrounding its commission, in addition to any other punishment that may be imposed under this Act, make an order that has any or all of the following effects:

heading: Orders of court
paragraph: (a) prohibiting the offender from committing an act or engaging in an activity that may, in the opinion of the court, result in the continuation or repetition of the offence;

heading: Orders of court
paragraph: (b) directing the offender to take any measures that the court considers appropriate to avoid harm to human health or the environment that results from or may result from the act or omission that constituted the offence, or to remedy that harm;

heading: Orders of court
paragraph: (c) directing the offender to pay the victim, within the period that the court considers reasonable, an amount of money to cover the loss or damage that resulted from the offence;

heading: Orders of court
paragraph: (d) directing the offender to publish, in any manner that the court directs, at the offender's own expense, the facts relating to the offence and an apology for any harm caused by the offence;

heading: Orders of court
paragraph: (e) directing the offender, at the offender's own expense, to notify any person who is aggrieved or affected by the offender's conduct of the facts relating to the conviction;

heading: Orders of court
paragraph: (f) directing the offender to post a bond or pay an amount of money into court that the court considers appropriate to ensure compliance with any condition required under this section;

heading: Orders of court
paragraph: (g) directing the offender to submit to the Minister, on application by the Attorney General of Canada made within three years after the conviction, any information with respect to the offender's activities that the court considers appropriate in the circumstances;

heading: Orders of court
paragraph: (h) directing the offender to compensate the Minister, in whole or in part, for the cost of any remedial or preventive measure taken by the Minister as a result of the act or omission that constituted the offence;

heading: Orders of court
paragraph: (i) directing the offender to perform community service, subject to any reasonable conditions that may be imposed by the court;

heading: Orders of court
paragraph: (j) directing the offender to pay an amount that the court considers appropriate for the purpose of conducting research; and

heading: Orders of court
paragraph: (k) requiring the offender to comply with any other conditions that the court considers appropriate in the circumstances for securing the offender's good conduct and for preventing the offender from repeating the same offence or committing another offence under this Act.

heading: Coming into force and duration of order
paragraph: (2) An order made under section 76 or subsection (1) comes into force on the day on which the order is made or on any other day that the court may determine, but shall not continue in force for more than three years after that day.

heading: Publication
paragraph: (3) If an offender does not comply with an order requiring the publication of facts relating to the offence, the Minister may publish the facts and recover the costs of publication from the offender.

heading: Debt due to Her Majesty
paragraph: (4) If the court orders the offender to compensate the Minister or if the Minister incurs publication costs under paragraph (1)(h) or subsection (3), the costs incurred by the Minister constitute a debt due to Her Majesty in right of Canada and may be recovered in a court of competent jurisdiction.

heading: Additional fine
paragraph: 78 When an offender has been convicted of an offence under this Act, the court may order the offender to pay, in addition to any fine that may otherwise be imposed under this Act, a fine equal to three times the court's estimation of any monetary benefits that the court is satisfied the offender gained as a result of the commission of the offence.

heading: Publication of information about contraventions
paragraph: 79 (1) The Minister may publish information about any contravention of this Act or the regulations, including a contravention designated as a violation under the Agriculture and Agri-Food Administrative Monetary Penalties Act, for the purpose of encouraging voluntary compliance with this Act and the regulations.

heading: Publication of personal information
paragraph: (2) The information published under subsection (1) may include personal information as defined in section 3 of the Privacy Act.

heading: Annual report
paragraph: 80 (1) The Minister shall, as soon as possible after the end of each fiscal year, prepare and cause to be laid before each House of Parliament a report on the administration and enforcement of this Act for that year.

heading: Contents
paragraph: (2) The Minister shall include in the annual report, for the fiscal year covered by the report,

heading: Contents
paragraph: (a) a status report respecting registrations, including the registration of pest control products that pose lower risks, re-evaluations and special reviews under this Act or the Pest Control Products Act, chapter P-9 of the Revised Statutes of Canada, 1985; and

heading: Contents
paragraph: (b) a report on significant scientific developments relating to the evaluation of the health and environmental risks and the value of pest control products and the integration of those developments into decision-making under this Act.

heading: Permanent review of Act
paragraph: 80.1 (1) The administration of this Act shall, every 7 years after the day on which section 1 comes into force, stand referred to such committee of the House of Commons, of the Senate or of both Houses of Parliament as may be designated or established for that purpose.

heading: Review and report
paragraph: (2) The committee designated or established for the purposes of subsection (1) shall, as soon as practicable, undertake a comprehensive review of the provisions and operation of this Act and shall, within one year after the review is undertaken or within such further time as the House of Commons, the Senate or both Houses of Parliament, as the case may be, may authorize, submit a report thereon, including a statement of any changes to this Act or its administration that the committee would recommend.

heading: Applications under repealed Act
paragraph: 81 (1) This Act and the regulations apply to an application for the registration of a pest control product or for an amendment to its registration made under the Pest Control Products Act, chapter P-9 of the Revised Statutes of Canada, 1985, before the day on which section 1 comes into force if no decision to grant or deny the application has been made in respect of that application on or before that day. In any case, paragraph 28(1)(a) and subsection 35(1) do not apply to applications made before April 1, 1995.

heading: Pest control products registered under repealed Act
paragraph: (2) This Act and the regulations apply to all registrations under the Pest Control Products Act, chapter P-9 of the Revised Statutes of Canada, 1985, that are in effect on the day on which section 1 comes into force, except that paragraphs 42(2)(c) to (f) apply only to registrations in respect of which the public has been consulted under this Act in accordance with paragraph 28(1)(a) or (b).

heading: Definitions
paragraph: 1 (1) The following definitions apply in these Regulations.

heading: Definitions
paragraph: Act means the Pest Control Products Act. (Loi)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: antimicrobial agent means a non-agricultural pest control product that is manufactured, represented, distributed or used as a means to directly or indirectly control or destroy the following on or in inanimate objects, industrial processes and systems, surfaces, water and air:

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) micro-organisms; and

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) organisms that are not vascular plants and that cause fouling. (agent antimicrobien)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: antimicrobial preservative means a chemical substance, or a mixture of chemical substances, that is intentionally incorporated into, or applied to, an article for the purpose of preserving it from deterioration or degradation by preventing the growth of micro-organisms. (agent de conservation antimicrobien)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: approved label means a label that meets the conditions of registration relating to the label as specified by the Minister and that is placed in the Register. (etiquette approuvee)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: CAS registry number means the identification number that is assigned to a chemical substance by the Chemical Abstracts Service Division of the American Chemical Society. (numero d'enregistrement CAS)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: certificate of equivalency means a certificate that is issued under subsection 39(1) with respect to a foreign product. (certificat d'equivalence)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: common chemical name, with respect to an active ingredient of a pest control product, means the name set out in International Standard ISO 1750:1981 (E/F), entitled Pesticides and other agrochemicals - Common names, published by the International Organization for Standardization, as amended from time to time. (nom chimique commun)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: cooperator means an individual, a corporation or an unincorporated entity, or part of one, that agrees to use or allows the use of a pest control product for research purposes on a site owned or operated by it. (collaborateur)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: device means an instrument, gadget, apparatus, appliance or other similar object. (dispositif)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: display panel means the part of the label that is affixed to the container, wrapping, covering or holder in which a pest control product is wholly or partly contained, placed or packed. It does not include any brochure or leaflet that accompanies the product. (aire d'affichage)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: domestic animal means an animal that is under the control of humans and dependent on them for its survival. (animal domestique)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: experimental label means a label that is for use during research. (certificat d'equivalence)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: foreign product means a pest control product that is registered in a country other than Canada. (produit etranger)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: foreign product use certificate means a certificate that is issued under subsection 41(3) with respect to an imported foreign product. (certificat d'utilisation d'un produit etranger)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: marketplace label means a label that matches the approved label and that has added to it any other written, printed or graphic matter that relates to the pest control product. (etiquette de marche)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: metric unit means a unit of measurement set out in Schedule I to the Weights and Measures Act. (unite metrique)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: microbial agent means a pest control product whose active ingredient is a micro-organism. It includes any metabolites and toxins produced by the micro-organism. (agent microbien)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: ozone-generating device means a device that is manufactured, represented, distributed or used to control, destroy or inactivate viruses, bacteria or other micro-organisms that are human pathogens or to reduce their population levels - other than in swimming pools, spas or wastewater or drinking-water treatment systems - by means of the generation of ozone. (dispositif generateur d'ozone)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: pheromone means a semiochemical that is produced by an individual of a species and that affects the behaviour of other individuals of the same species. (pheromone)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: principal display panel means the part of the display panel that is visible under normal conditions of display for sale. (aire d'affichage principale)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: product certification body means a body that is accredited by the Standards Council of Canada to give third-party written assurance that a product meets the specified requirements for the product, including initial certification and maintenance of that certification. (organisme de certification de produits)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: registration certificate means a certificate issued under section 12 that states that the pest control product named in it is registered under the Act. (certificat d'homologation)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: research means tests that are carried out to generate test data in support of an application for registration of a pest control product or an application to amend a registration, using a pest control product that contains an unregistered active ingredient, using an unregistered pest control product that contains a registered active ingredient or using a registered pest control product in a manner or for a use that is not specified in the conditions of registration. (recherche)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: research authorization certificate means a certificate issued under subsection 50(2) that states that the pest control product named in it may be used in conducting research. (certificat d'autorisation de recherche)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: researcher means an individual who is employed by or who provides service to a research establishment and who is responsible for using or supervising the use of a pest control product for research purposes. (chercheur)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: research establishment means a person who is engaged in research that pertains to a pest control product. (etablissement de recherche)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: research notification certificate means a certificate issued under section 54 that confirms that proposed research meets the criteria set out in section 53. (certificat d'avis de recherche)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: research site means an area that is treated or to be treated with a pest control product for the purpose of conducting research. (site de recherche)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: secondary display panel means the part of the display panel other than the principal display panel. (aire d'affichage secondaire)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: seed means a generative part of a plant that is used for propagation purposes. It includes seed-like fruits, bulbs, tubers and corms but does not include whole plants or cuttings. (semence)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: semiochemical means a message-bearing chemical that is produced by a plant or an animal, or a synthetic analogue of such a chemical, that evokes a behavioural response in individuals of the same or another species. (ecomone)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: Stockholm Convention means the Stockholm Convention on Persistent Organic Pollutants, signed at Stockholm on May 22, 2001, as amended from time to time. (Convention de Stockholm)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: treated article means an inanimate product or substance, but does not include a food as defined in section 2 of the Food and Drugs Act,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) that, during the manufacturing process, is treated with a pest control product either by intentionally:

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (i) incorporating the product into the article; or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (ii) applying it to the article, and

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) whose primary purpose, prior to that treatment, is not, directly or indirectly, to control, destroy, attract or repel a pest or to mitigate or prevent the injurious, noxious or troublesome effects of a pest. (article traite)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: treated seed means seed into which a pest control product is intentionally incorporated or to which the product is applied. (semence traitee)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: ultraviolet radiation-emitting device means a device that is manufactured, represented, distributed or used to control, destroy or inactivate viruses, bacteria or other micro-organisms that are human pathogens or to reduce their population levels - other than in swimming pools, spas or wastewater or drinking-water treatment systems - by means of ultraviolet radiation. (dispositif a rayonnement ultraviolet)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: validity period means the period specified under paragraph 8(1)(c) of the Act. (periode de validite)

heading: Definition of common chemical name
paragraph: (2) For the purpose of the application of the definition common chemical name in subsection (1), the common chemical name "carboxin" is to be read as "carbathiin" wherever it appears in the Standard referred to in that definition.

heading: Prescribing
paragraph: 2 For the purpose of paragraph (c) of the definition pest control product in subsection 2(1) of the Act, the following are prescribed to be pest control products:

heading: Prescribing
paragraph: (a) a device that is manufactured, represented, distributed or used to directly or indirectly control, destroy, attract or repel a pest or to mitigate or prevent the injurious, noxious or troublesome effects of a pest;

heading: Prescribing
paragraph: (b) a compound or substance that is not an ingredient of a pest control product described in paragraph (a) of that definition but is added to or used with such a product to enhance or modify its physical or chemical characteristics or to modify an effect on host organisms in connection with which the product is intended to be used;

heading: Prescribing
paragraph: (c) an active ingredient that is manufactured, represented, distributed or used to directly or indirectly control, destroy, attract or repel a pest or to mitigate or prevent the injurious, noxious or troublesome effects of a pest;

heading: Prescribing
paragraph: (d) a treated article; and

heading: Prescribing
paragraph: (e) treated seed.

heading: Exemption from application of Act
paragraph: 3 (1) The following pest control products are exempt from the application of the Act:

heading: Exemption from application of Act
paragraph: (a) a pest control product that is a device of a type not described in Schedule 1;

heading: Exemption from application of Act
paragraph: (a.1) despite paragraph (a), an ultraviolet radiation-emitting device or ozone-generating device that is a device as defined in section 2 of the Food and Drugs Act and classified as a Class II, III or IV medical device under the Medical Devices Regulations;

heading: Exemption from application of Act
paragraph: (b) a pest control product that is subject to the Food and Drugs Act and that is used only

heading: Exemption from application of Act
paragraph: (i) to control arthropods on or in humans or animals, if the pest control product is to be administered directly and not by topical application, or

heading: Exemption from application of Act
paragraph: (ii) during the cooking or processing of food for humans to preserve the food;

heading: Exemption from application of Act
paragraph: (c) a pest control product that is used to control viruses, bacteria or other micro-organisms in premises in which food is manufactured, prepared or kept for sale;

heading: Exemption from application of Act
paragraph: (d) a pest control product - other than an ultraviolet radiation-emitting device or ozone-generating device - that is used to destroy or inactivate viruses, bacteria or other micro-organisms in order to treat, mitigate or prevent disease in humans or animals, except in respect of its use in a swimming pool or spa;

heading: Exemption from application of Act
paragraph: (e) except in respect of its uses as a preservative for wood or other material, as a slimicide or in a swimming pool or spa, a pest control product - other than an ultraviolet radiation-emitting device or ozone-generating device - that is used to

heading: Exemption from application of Act
paragraph: (i) destroy or inactivate viruses, bacteria or other micro-organisms in order to treat, mitigate or prevent disease in humans or animals, and

heading: Exemption from application of Act
paragraph: (ii) reduce the population levels of viruses, bacteria or other micro-organisms that cause mould, mildew or odour, or disease in humans or animals;

heading: Exemption from application of Act
paragraph: (f) a pest control product - other than an organism, a device of a type described in Schedule 1 or a treated article - that is imported by a user for their personal use, that is in their possession at the time of the importation and that meets the following conditions:

heading: Exemption from application of Act
paragraph: (i) the total quantity of the product does not exceed 500 g or 500 mL,

heading: Exemption from application of Act
paragraph: (ii) by virtue of its active ingredient and concentration, the product would have the product class designation "DOMESTIC" if it were registered in Canada,

heading: Exemption from application of Act
paragraph: (iii) the product is registered or otherwise authorized in the country of origin as a product equivalent to a pest control product,

heading: Exemption from application of Act
paragraph: (iv) the product is in its original package with the original label intact,

heading: Exemption from application of Act
paragraph: (v) the information on the package and label is in either English or French, is clear and legible, allows for the determination of the active ingredient, concentration and quantity of the product and includes the registration or authorization number assigned by the regulatory body in the country of origin;

heading: Exemption from application of Act
paragraph: (g) a pest control product that is a treated article into which the only pest control product that is incorporated or to which the product is applied is an antimicrobial preservative, if

heading: Exemption from application of Act
paragraph: (i) the product is imported by a user for their personal use,

heading: Exemption from application of Act
paragraph: (ii) the product is in their possession at the time of the importation,

heading: Exemption from application of Act
paragraph: (iii) the product is in its original package with the original label intact, and

heading: Exemption from application of Act
paragraph: (iv) the information on the package and label is in English or French and is clear and legible; and

heading: Exemption from application of Act
paragraph: (h) a pest control product that is

heading: Exemption from application of Act
paragraph: (i) an antimicrobial preservative when it is used in the manufacture of a treated article that is

heading: Exemption from application of Act
paragraph: (A) a feed that is regulated under the Feeds Act,

heading: Exemption from application of Act
paragraph: (B) a fertilizer or supplement that is regulated under the Fertilizers Act,

heading: Exemption from application of Act
paragraph: (C) a drug or cosmetic that is regulated under the Food and Drugs Act, or

heading: Exemption from application of Act
paragraph: (D) a medical device that is a device as defined in section 2 of the Food and Drugs Act and classified as a Class II, III or IV medical device under the Medical Devices Regulations, or

heading: Exemption from application of Act
paragraph: (ii) a treated article that is described in any of clauses (i)(A) to (D) into which the only pest control product that is incorporated or to which the product is applied is an antimicrobial preservative.

heading: Exemption for named uses only
paragraph: (2) A pest control product that is exempt under paragraph (1)(c), (d) or (e) is exempt only in respect of any use described in that paragraph.

heading: Import solely for export
paragraph: 3.1 (1) A person may import a pest control product that is intended solely for the purpose of export.

heading: Activities - section 41.1 of Act
paragraph: (2) A person may possess, handle, store or transport the imported pest control product for the purpose of export.

heading: Products subject to Transportation of Dangerous Goods Act
paragraph: (3) Sections 3.2 to 75 do not apply to a pest control product that is imported under subsection (1) if it is subject to the Transportation of Dangerous Goods Act, 1992.

heading: Products not subject to Transportation of Dangerous Goods Act
paragraph: (4) Sections 4 to 75 do not apply to a pest control product that is imported under subsection (1) if it is not subject to the Transportation of Dangerous Goods Act, 1992.

heading: Safety information
paragraph: 3.2 (1) The information set out in subsection (2) and the safety information set out in subsections (3) to (8) must

heading: Safety information
paragraph: (a) appear in documents that accompany the shipment of the pest control product during transport through Canada and during any short-term storage in Canada;

heading: Safety information
paragraph: (b) be readily available for use in emergency response to any accidents or incidents involving that product;

heading: Safety information
paragraph: (c) appear in a manner that is clearly legible and indelible;

heading: Safety information
paragraph: (d) appear in either English or French; and

heading: Safety information
paragraph: (e) appear in documents that accompany each load of a shipment, if the shipment is broken into loads that are sent to different destinations.

heading: Identification
paragraph: (2) The shipment of the pest control product must be accompanied by documents that contain all of the following information:

heading: Identification
paragraph: (a) the name of the product, which may include a distinctive brand or trademark;

heading: Identification
paragraph: (b) a declaration of net quantity of the product in the package;

heading: Identification
paragraph: (c) the name of the importer and the names of the exporter and owner of the product, if either is different from the importer;

heading: Identification
paragraph: (d) the name, postal address, email address and telephone number of a contact person to whom public inquiries may be directed; and

heading: Identification
paragraph: (e) the physical form of the product.

heading: Hazard identification
paragraph: (3) The shipment of the pest control product must be accompanied by documents that contain information that identifies the nature and degree of hazard inherent in the pest control product by appropriate precautionary symbols and signal words selected from either Schedule 3 or 4. For precautionary symbols and signal words selected from Schedule 4, a hazard statement that indicates the nature of the primary hazard to which the precautionary symbol relates must also be included.

heading: Active ingredient
paragraph: (4) The shipment of the pest control product must be accompanied by documents that contain the following information:

heading: Active ingredient
paragraph: (a) the common chemical name of the active ingredient of the pest control product or, if it has no common chemical name, its chemical or other name; and

heading: Active ingredient
paragraph: (b) the concentration of the active ingredient.

heading: First aid measures
paragraph: (5) The shipment of the pest control product must be accompanied by documents that contain the following information:

heading: First aid measures
paragraph: (a) instructions that set out the practical measures to be taken in the event of poisoning, intoxication or injury caused by the pest control product and that include the statement "Take the documents accompanying the shipment or the container label, if it contains the same information, or the product name with you when seeking medical attention."; and

heading: First aid measures
paragraph: (b) information that is essential to the treatment of persons who are poisoned, intoxicated or injured by the pest control product, including

heading: First aid measures
paragraph: (i) antidotes and remedial measures or, if no specific antidote or remedial measure exists, the statement "Treat symptomatically.",

heading: First aid measures
paragraph: (ii) a description of the injury or the symptoms of poisoning or intoxication, and

heading: First aid measures
paragraph: (iii) a list of the components of the product that may affect the treatment.

heading: Firefighting, handling, transport and storage
paragraph: (6) The shipment of the pest control product must be accompanied by documents that contain information that identifies the appropriate measures to be taken with respect to firefighting, handling, transportation and storage of the pest control product.

heading: Accidental release, decontamination and safe disposal
paragraph: (7) The shipment of the pest control product must be accompanied by documents that contain instructions on the procedure to be followed

heading: Accidental release, decontamination and safe disposal
paragraph: (a) in case of accidental release;

heading: Accidental release, decontamination and safe disposal
paragraph: (b) for decontamination; and

heading: Accidental release, decontamination and safe disposal
paragraph: (c) for the safe disposal of the pest control product and its packages.

heading: Toxicological and ecological risk reduction
paragraph: (8) The shipment of the pest control product must be accompanied by documents that contain information that identifies any significant risk to health and the environment, and instructions on procedures to reduce that risk.

heading: Packaging
paragraph: (9) The packaging of the pest control product must be constructed

heading: Packaging
paragraph: (a) to contain the product safely under normal conditions of storage and transportation; and

heading: Packaging
paragraph: (b) to minimize degradation or change of its contents.

heading: Storage and transport
paragraph: (10) The pest control product must be stored and transported in a separate compartment from any human food or animal feed or in such a way as to avoid any possible contamination of the food or feed if

heading: Storage and transport
paragraph: (a) the product bears the signal word "POISON" superimposed on the precautionary symbol for danger set out in item 2 of Schedule 3; or

heading: Storage and transport
paragraph: (b) the product bears the signal word DANGER and the hazard statements "Fatal if swallowed", "Fatal in contact with skin", "Toxic if swallowed", "Toxic in contact with skin", "Toxic if inhaled" or "Fatal if inhaled" set out in item 4 of Schedule 4.

heading: Information to be provided on request
paragraph: 3.3 (1) The importer, exporter or owner of the pest control product imported solely for the purpose of export must provide the following information to the Minister, in the manner requested, on request:

heading: Information to be provided on request
paragraph: (a) the name of the importer and the names of the exporter and owner of the product, if either is different from the importer;

heading: Information to be provided on request
paragraph: (b) notification of import of the product 30 days in advance of the expected date of import;

heading: Information to be provided on request
paragraph: (c) notification of export of the product;

heading: Information to be provided on request
paragraph: (d) the place of entry or port of unloading;

heading: Information to be provided on request
paragraph: (e) the name of the freight forwarder, if any;

heading: Information to be provided on request
paragraph: (f) the name of the shipper or carrier; and

heading: Information to be provided on request
paragraph: (g) any other information required under subsections 3.2(2) to (8).

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: 4 (1) A person may manufacture, possess, handle, store, transport, import, distribute or use the following unregistered pest control products under the Act:

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (a) an active ingredient that is used only in the manufacture of a registered pest control product that was registered on January 1, 1984, or was registered after January 1, 1984 and the application for its registration was received by the Minister on or before that date, and the active ingredient meets the relevant conditions of registration of the registered pest control product;

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (b) a pest control product

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (i) that is of a type described in Schedule 2 and that meets the applicable conditions set out in that Schedule, and

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (ii) the active ingredient of which is registered under the Act;

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (c) a pest control product that is an ultraviolet radiation-emitting device, other than an ultraviolet lamp or other component that emits ultraviolet radiation, if

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (i) the device is certified by a product certification body as meeting the applicable Canadian electrical safety requirements,

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (ii) the certification mark of the product certification body appears on the label of the device,

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (iii) any claim of efficacy that is made in respect of the device is made only in relation to supplemental sanitization,

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (iv) no express or implied claim in relation to the treatment, mitigation or prevention of disease is made in respect of the device,

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (v) its ultraviolet lamp, or other component that emits ultraviolet radiation, is fully shielded or enclosed in the device, in a manner that prevents exposure to ultraviolet radiation,

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (vi) the device has a mechanism that

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (A) locks the device to prevent access to the ultraviolet lamp, or other component that emits ultraviolet radiation, during operation, or

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (B) automatically shuts off the device if it is opened during operation,

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (vii) a user of the device who follows the instructions referred to in paragraph 30.1(3)(c) for replacing the ultraviolet lamp or any other component that emits ultraviolet radiation is not exposed to the radiation,

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (viii) the device does not produce or generate any other substance, including ozone or hydroxyl, that may be harmful to human health during operation, and

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (ix) the device is used in commercial or industrial premises or in educational institutions, health care facilities or similar institutions or facilities and, as applicable,

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (A) it does not meet the requirement set out in subparagraph (v), is contained within the ventilation system in a manner that prevents exposure to ultraviolet radiation and is installed by an electrician who is the holder of a licence issued by the applicable provincial licensing authority, or

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (B) it does not meet one of the requirements set out in subparagraph (v) or (vi) and is certified by a product certification body either as being part of the Exempt group classification set out in the IEC 62471 standard developed by the International Electrotechnical Commission entitled Photobiological safety of lamps and lamp systems, as amended from time to time, or as meeting the applicable requirements of one of the standards set out in the List of Equivalent Standards for Ultraviolet Photobiological Hazard Assessment, published by the Government of Canada on its website, as amended from time to time;

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (d) an ultraviolet radiation-emitting device that is an ultraviolet lamp, or other component that emits ultraviolet radiation, if the component

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (i) is manufactured, represented or distributed solely for use in a device referred to in paragraph (c), and

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (ii) meets the conditions set out in subparagraphs (c)(iii) and (iv);

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (e) an ultraviolet radiation-emitting device that is an ultraviolet lamp, or other component that emits ultraviolet radiation, that is manufactured, represented or distributed for use as a component in a registered device, if

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (i) the component is evaluated as part of an application to register, amend or renew the registration of the device, and

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (ii) the label of the component contains any information specified by the Minister in the conditions of registration;

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (f) a pest control product that is a treated article into which the only pest control product that is incorporated or to which it is applied is an antimicrobial preservative, if

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (i) the sole purpose of the treatment is to protect or preserve the article,

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (ii) the active ingredient of the preservative is registered or otherwise authorized under paragraph 21(5)(a) of the Act for incorporation into, or application to the article,

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (iii) in the case where the article is treated in Canada, the preservative is registered or otherwise authorized under paragraph (b) or paragraph 21(5)(a) of the Act,

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (iv) in any other case, the treatment

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (A) includes the same active ingredient as that contained in a preservative registered in Canada or otherwise authorized under paragraph (b) or paragraph 21(5)(a) of the Act, and

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (B) meets any conditions of registration or authorization, as the case may be, that relate to the method of application, the uses for which the preservative may be applied to or incorporated into the article and the range of application rates as specified by the Minister under the Act or as set out in Schedule 2; and

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (g) a pest control product that is also a food additive set out in column 1 of the List of Permitted Preservatives, published by the Government of Canada on its website, as amended from time to time, if

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (i) the product is used as an antimicrobial preservative,

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (ii) the sole purpose of the treatment is to protect or preserve the article, and

heading: Permitted activities
paragraph: (iii) the quantity of preservative protects or preserves the article, but does not exceed the quantity necessary to do so.

heading: Used in manufacture only
paragraph: (2) A pest control product referred to in paragraph (1)(a) must not be used for any purpose other than the manufacture of a registered pest control product.

heading: Permitted activities - foreign product
paragraph: (3) A person may possess, handle, store, transport, import or use a foreign product that is imported under a foreign product use certificate.

heading: Permitted activities - for conducting research
paragraph: (4) A person may manufacture, possess, handle, store, transport, import or use a pest control product for the purpose of conducting research in accordance with sections 46 to 70.

heading: Permitted activities - for exportation of certain products
paragraph: 4.1 (1) A person may manufacture, possess, handle, store or transport - or import for use in manufacturing - the following unregistered pest control products under the Act, solely for the purpose of export:

heading: Permitted activities - for exportation of certain products
paragraph: (a) an ultraviolet radiation-emitting device;

heading: Permitted activities - for exportation of certain products
paragraph: (b) an ultraviolet lamp or other component that emits ultraviolet radiation;

heading: Permitted activities - for exportation of certain products
paragraph: (c) an ozone-generating device; and

heading: Permitted activities - for exportation of certain products
paragraph: (d) a pest control product that contains an active ingredient that is registered in Canada.

heading: Export certificate
paragraph: (2) Before a pest control product referred to in any of paragraphs (1)(a) to (c) is shipped, the manufacturer must prepare an export certificate, in the manner specified by the Minister, indicating that the product does not contravene any known requirements of the law of the countries to which it is shipped, consigned or about to be consigned.

heading: New certificate
paragraph: (3) If the pest control product or the country of export changes, the manufacturer must prepare a new certificate.

heading: Period of retention
paragraph: (4) The manufacturer must keep a record of the certificate for five years after the date of the last shipment.

heading: Provision of records
paragraph: (5) The manufacturer must provide the certificate to the Minister on request and within the period specified.

heading: Requirements - information and packaging
paragraph: (6) Subsections 3.2(1) to (3), and (6) to (10) apply to the pest control products referred to in paragraphs (1)(a) to (c).

heading: Requirements of section 3.2
paragraph: (7) A pest control product referred to in paragraph (1)(d) must meet the requirements of section 3.2.

heading: Non-application of section 33
paragraph: (8) Section 33 does not apply to a pest control product referred to in subsection (1).

heading: Designation
paragraph: 5 The following are the classes of pest control products:

heading: Designation
paragraph: (a) "DOMESTIC", if the pest control product is to be distributed primarily to the general public for personal use in or around their homes;

heading: Designation
paragraph: (b) "COMMERCIAL", if the pest control product is to be distributed for use in commercial activities that are specified on the label;

heading: Designation
paragraph: (c) "RESTRICTED", if the pest control product is one for which the Minister, out of concern for its health or environmental risks, has set out additional information to be shown on the label concerning essential conditions respecting the display, distribution or limitations on use of, or qualifications of persons who may use, the product; and

heading: Designation
paragraph: (d) "MANUFACTURING", if the pest control product is to be used only in the manufacture of a pest control product or a product regulated under the Feeds Act or the Fertilizers Act.

heading: Electronic delivery
paragraph: 5.1 (1) For the purpose of subsection 62(1) of the Act, notices or other documents required or authorized to be delivered under the Act may be delivered electronically through the website of the Government of Canada or by another means of electronic communication.

heading: Deemed time of delivery
paragraph: (2) A notice or other document that is delivered electronically is considered to have been delivered

heading: Deemed time of delivery
paragraph: (a) if it was delivered through that website, on the earlier of

heading: Deemed time of delivery
paragraph: (i) the date of its delivery as indicated through that website, and

heading: Deemed time of delivery
paragraph: (ii) the date of its delivery as indicated by a means of automatic electronic communication generated by that website; and

heading: Deemed time of delivery
paragraph: (b) if it was delivered using another means of electronic communication, on the date that is indicated as the day of its delivery by the other means.

heading: Setting aside deemed time of delivery
paragraph: (3) A deemed time of delivery of a notice or other document may be set aside on the basis of any metadata or data from any other tracking system that relates to the notice or other document.

heading: Contents
paragraph: 6 (1) An application to register or amend the registration of a pest control product must include all of the following information:

heading: Contents
paragraph: (a) the applicant's name, address and signature or, if the application is made by a representative of the applicant, both the representative's and applicant's name and address and the representative's signature;

heading: Contents
paragraph: (b) the name and address of

heading: Contents
paragraph: (i) each place of manufacture of the pest control product, if it is or contains a microbial agent, and

heading: Contents
paragraph: (ii) each place of production and formulation of the pest control product, in any other case;

heading: Contents
paragraph: (c) the product name referred to in paragraph 26(1)(a);

heading: Contents
paragraph: (d) the product type referred to in paragraph 26(1)(b);

heading: Contents
paragraph: (e) the product's physical form referred to in paragraph 26(1)(c);

heading: Contents
paragraph: (f) the registration number referred to in paragraph 26(1)(i), if there is one;

heading: Contents
paragraph: (g) in the case of

heading: Contents
paragraph: (i) a chemical pest control product that is an active ingredient, its chemical name, common chemical name and CAS registry number, its percentage of the total weight of the product in which it is contained, the name of each contaminant and other impurity that it contains, and the percentage of total weight of each contaminant and impurity,

heading: Contents
paragraph: (ii) a chemical pest control product other than an active ingredient, the chemical name, common chemical name and CAS registry number of each active ingredient in the product, each active ingredient's percentage of the total weight of the product, and the registration number of each active ingredient or other pest control product used to manufacture the product, and

heading: Contents
paragraph: (iii) any other pest control product, any characteristics that are relevant to its health or environmental risks or value;

heading: Contents
paragraph: (h) in the case of a pest control product that contains one or more formulants, the name of each formulant, its CAS registry number if any, its percentage of the total weight of the product and its purpose in the product;

heading: Contents
paragraph: (i) the size, type and specifications of the package in which the pest control product is to be distributed; and

heading: Contents
paragraph: (j) the statement described in paragraph 26(1)(h).

heading: Electronic copy of label
paragraph: (2) The applicant must include an electronic copy of the proposed label with every application to register a pest control product and with any application to amend the registration of a pest control product that would result in a change to the label.

heading: Certification
paragraph: (3) The applicant must include with every application to register or amend the registration of a pest control product a statement signed by the applicant certifying that the information in the application is accurate and complete.

heading: Records
paragraph: 7 (1) An applicant referred to in subsection 6(1) or a registrant referred to in subsection 16(1) must keep records of

heading: Records
paragraph: (a) in the case of a pest control product other than one that is or contains a microbial agent, the address of each place of manufacture of a pest control product, other than a place of production or formulation; and

heading: Records
paragraph: (b) in the case of a pest control product that contains one or more formulants, the name and address of the supplier of each formulant.

heading: Retention
paragraph: (2) The applicant or the registrant must keep the records for five years after, as the case may be, the date of registration, its amendment or its renewal.

heading: Change of information
paragraph: (3) If the information contained in the records changes, the applicant or registrant must update it but the previous records must be kept for five years after the day on which the update occurs.

heading: Production of records
paragraph: (4) On request by the Minister, an inspector or an analyst, the applicant or registrant must provide any records to the Minister, the inspector or the analyst within the period specified in the request.

heading: Stockholm Convention - evaluations not necessary
paragraph: 7.1 (1) No evaluation under paragraph 7(3)(a) of the Act is necessary when

heading: Stockholm Convention - evaluations not necessary
paragraph: (a) the application is to register or amend the registration of a pest control product that is or contains an active ingredient that is listed as a chemical in Annex A (Elimination) or Annex B (Restriction) of the Stockholm Convention;

heading: Stockholm Convention - evaluations not necessary
paragraph: (b) the application pertains to a production or use of the active ingredient that is prohibited under the Convention;

heading: Stockholm Convention - evaluations not necessary
paragraph: (c) the amendment to the Convention that resulted in the listing has been ratified by Canada by the deposit of its instrument of ratification with the Secretary-General of the United Nations acting as the Depository of the Convention; and

heading: Stockholm Convention - evaluations not necessary
paragraph: (d) the proposed production or use of the active ingredient in the application:

heading: Stockholm Convention - evaluations not necessary
paragraph: (i) is not subject to a specific exemption, or acceptable purpose, notified by Canada under the Convention, as set out in the Register of Specific Exemptions, or a Register of Acceptable Purposes, established under that Convention, or

heading: Stockholm Convention - evaluations not necessary
paragraph: (ii) is not otherwise permitted under the Convention.

heading: Denial of application
paragraph: (2) For the purpose of subsection 8(4) of the Act, the health or environmental risks of a pest control product described in subsection (1) are not acceptable.

heading: Additional information required
paragraph: 8 In addition to the information required by section 6, the applicant must provide the Minister with any other information that the Minister may require to evaluate the health and environmental risks and the value of the pest control product, including, if relevant to the product and its conditions or proposed conditions of registration, the results of scientific investigations respecting any of the following:

heading: Additional information required
paragraph: (a) the efficacy of the pest control product for its intended purpose;

heading: Additional information required
paragraph: (b) the risks posed by the pest control product and its derivatives to humans or animals that may be exposed to it, including when it is manufactured, handled, stored, transported or distributed or during or after its use or disposal, in accordance with its conditions or proposed conditions of registration;

heading: Additional information required
paragraph: (c) the effect of the pest control product and its derivatives on host organisms in connection with which it is intended to be used;

heading: Additional information required
paragraph: (d) the effect of the pest control product and its derivatives on representative species of organisms not targeted by its intended use;

heading: Additional information required
paragraph: (e) the degree of persistence, retention and movement of the pest control product and its derivatives in the environment, including the degree to which the pest control product and its derivatives may leach or dislodge from things treated with the product;

heading: Additional information required
paragraph: (f) methods of analysis for detecting the components and measuring the characteristics of the pest control product;

heading: Additional information required
paragraph: (g) methods of analysis for detecting and determining the amount of the pest control product and its derivatives in human food, animal feed and the environment when the product is used in accordance with its conditions or proposed conditions of registration;

heading: Additional information required
paragraph: (h) appropriate methods for detoxifying or neutralizing the pest control product in water, air or soil, or on any surface;

heading: Additional information required
paragraph: (i) appropriate methods for disposing of the pest control product and its empty packages;

heading: Additional information required
paragraph: (j) the stability of the pest control product under normal conditions of storage and display;

heading: Additional information required
paragraph: (k) the compatibility of the pest control product with other pest control products with which it is recommended to be, or is likely to be, mixed;

heading: Additional information required
paragraph: (l) the effect of mixing the pest control product or using it simultaneously with other pest control products on its value and the health and environmental risks associated with its use;

heading: Additional information required
paragraph: (m) the chemical and physical properties, or the species or strain and biological properties, of the pest control product, its composition, and specifications and processes for its manufacture, including quality control processes;

heading: Additional information required
paragraph: (n) the fate of the pest control product in humans or animals exposed to it, including the identity and quantity of all the major metabolites and other derivatives that result from its use;

heading: Additional information required
paragraph: (o) the residues of the pest control product and its derivatives that may remain in or on human food or animal feed after its use in accordance with its conditions or proposed conditions of registration;

heading: Additional information required
paragraph: (p) the risks posed to humans or animals exposed to the pest control product or its derivatives through their diet or drinking water when the product is used in accordance with its conditions or proposed conditions of registration;

heading: Additional information required
paragraph: (q) the effect of storing and processing, including post-market processing, human food or animal feed in relation to which the pest control product was used on the dissipation or degradation of the pest control product and any of its derivatives;

heading: Additional information required
paragraph: (r) the proposed maximum residue limits for the pest control product and its derivatives in or on human food; and

heading: Additional information required
paragraph: (s) the fate of the pest control product and its derivatives in subsequent crops of human food or animal feed.

heading: Additional information - affidavit and contents
paragraph: 9 (1) When, in the context of an application for registration or to amend a registration, the Minister considers additional information under paragraph 7(6)(b) of the Act that is not publicly available, the applicant must be given access to that information by the Minister for the purpose of making representations under that paragraph with respect to the information, if the applicant submits to the Minister an affidavit made under oath or a statutory declaration under the Canada Evidence Act made before a commissioner for oaths or for taking affidavits that

heading: Additional information - affidavit and contents
paragraph: (a) identifies the information to which access is being requested;

heading: Additional information - affidavit and contents
paragraph: (b) acknowledges that the access is given only for the purpose of enabling the applicant to make representations to the Minister with respect to the information;

heading: Additional information - affidavit and contents
paragraph: (c) states that the applicant will not use the information or make it available to any person for any other purpose; and

heading: Additional information - affidavit and contents
paragraph: (d) states that the information and any copies of it will be returned to the Minister when the stated purpose has been achieved.

heading: Copying or other use
paragraph: (2) The applicant to whom access to additional information is given under subsection (1) must not use the information or provide it to any person for any purpose other than to make representations under paragraph 7(6)(b) of the Act with respect to the information.

heading: Return of information
paragraph: (3) Additional information to which access is given under subsection (1) and any copies of it must be returned to the Minister by the applicant immediately after they have made their representations with respect to the information.

heading: Reference in Register
paragraph: 10 For the purpose of subsection 42(4) of the Act, evaluation reports that are placed in the Register under paragraph 42(2)(f) of the Act must include a reference to information placed in the Register under paragraph 42(2)(e) of the Act.

heading: Samples on request
paragraph: 11 On application to register or amend the registration of a pest control product, the applicant must, if requested by the Minister, provide the Minister with a sample of

heading: Samples on request
paragraph: (a) the pest control product;

heading: Samples on request
paragraph: (b) the technical grade of its active ingredient; and

heading: Samples on request
paragraph: (c) the laboratory standard of its active ingredient.

heading: Registration certificate
paragraph: 12 When a pest control product is registered or a registration is amended under section 8 of the Act, the Minister must issue a registration certificate that bears the registration number of the pest control product and sets out any conditions of registration specified by the Minister.

heading: Maximum validity period
paragraph: 13 The validity period of a registration of a pest control product must end no later than December 31 in the fifth year after the year in which the product is registered.

heading: Five-year periods
paragraph: 16 (1) The registration of a pest control product may be renewed, on application by the registrant to the Minister, for additional periods of not more than five years each.

heading: Renewal applications
paragraph: (2) An application to renew the registration of a pest control product must be accompanied by the following:

heading: Renewal applications
paragraph: (a) the information required by subsection 6(1);

heading: Renewal applications
paragraph: (b) the statement required by subsection 6(3);

heading: Renewal applications
paragraph: (c) the information required by section 8;

heading: Renewal applications
paragraph: (d) if sections 17.05 to 17.11 apply, whichever of the following documents is applicable:

heading: Renewal applications
paragraph: (i) a document that establishes that, as of the date the application is made, a negotiated settlement between the registrant and the data holder has been reached or an arbitral award has been made in respect of the test data and the data holder has not provided a letter of access referred to in section 17.1 to the registrant, or

heading: Renewal applications
paragraph: (ii) a copy of the letter of access referred to in section 17.1; and

heading: Renewal applications
paragraph: (e) if sections 17.12 to 17.17 apply, whichever of the following documents is applicable:

heading: Renewal applications
paragraph: (i) a document that establishes that, as of the date the application is made,

heading: Renewal applications
paragraph: (A) the registrant and data holder are negotiating the compensation payable in respect of the test data,

heading: Renewal applications
paragraph: (B) the determination of the compensation payable in respect of the test data has been submitted to binding arbitration and an arbitral award has not been made, or

heading: Renewal applications
paragraph: (C) a negotiated settlement between the registrant and the data holder has been reached or an arbitral award has been made in respect of the test data and the data holder has not provided a letter of access referred to in section 17.17 to the registrant, or

heading: Renewal applications
paragraph: (ii) a copy of the letter of access referred to in section 17.17.

heading: Interpretation - data holder and test data
paragraph: (2.1) In subsection (2), data holder and test data have the same meanings as in section 17.01.

heading: Request - labels
paragraph: (3) The registrant must, if requested by the Minister, provide the Minister with an electronic copy of the approved label and two hard copies of the marketplace label.

heading: Additional information - affidavit and contents
paragraph: 17 (1) When, in the context of a re-evaluation or special review, the Minister considers additional information under paragraph 19(1)(c) of the Act that is not publicly available, the registrant must be given access to that information by the Minister for the purpose of making representations under that paragraph with respect to the information, if the registrant submits to the Minister an affidavit made under oath or a statutory declaration under the Canada Evidence Act made before a commissioner for oaths or for taking affidavits that

heading: Additional information - affidavit and contents
paragraph: (a) identifies the information to which access is being requested;

heading: Additional information - affidavit and contents
paragraph: (b) acknowledges that the access is given only for the purpose of enabling the registrant to make representations to the Minister with respect to the information;

heading: Additional information - affidavit and contents
paragraph: (c) states that the registrant will not use the information or make it available to any person for any other purpose; and

heading: Additional information - affidavit and contents
paragraph: (d) states that the information and any copies of it will be returned to the Minister when the stated purpose has been achieved.

heading: Copying or other use
paragraph: (2) The registrant to whom access to additional information is given under subsection (1) must not use the information or provide it to any person for any purpose other than to make representations under paragraph 19(1)(c) of the Act with respect to the information.

heading: Return of information
paragraph: (3) Additional information to which access is given under subsection (1) and any copies of it must be returned to the Minister by the registrant immediately after they have made their representations with respect to the information.

heading: Definitions
paragraph: 17.01 The following definitions apply in this section and sections 17.02 to 17.17.

heading: Definitions
paragraph: agreement means an agreement referred to in subsection 66(1) of the Act. (entente)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: compensable data means test data that the Minister considers for the first time in support of a registration, confirmation of the registration or amendment of the registration, but does not include

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) test data that is referred to in the definition exclusive rights;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) test data that is included in a scientific study that has been published; or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (c) test data that is generated by a scientific study that is fully funded by a government or one of its institutions. (donnees assujetties a des droits a payer)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: crop group means a group of crops in which the residues at harvest are similar, based on similarities in appearance, harvestable commodity, edible portions and growth habits. (groupe de cultures)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: data holder means a registrant to whom compensation may be payable in respect of test data. (detenteur de donnees)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: exclusive rights means the exclusive rights to use or rely on any of the following test data that the Minister considers for the first time in support of a registration:

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) test data that the applicant provides in support of an application to register a new active ingredient;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) test data that the applicant provides in support of a concurrent application to register a new pest control product that contains the new active ingredient referred to in paragraph (a); or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (c) test data that the applicant provides in support of an application to register a new compound or substance referred to in paragraph 2(b), if the compound or substance has never been an ingredient in a registered pest control product. (droits exclusifs)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: minor use, in respect of a pest control product, means a use the demand for which originates with a grower or a group of growers and which product is intended to be used on a particular pest in connection with a particular host organism, in all of the following circumstances:

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) the use is for an agricultural purpose;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) the use is supported by a federal or provincial agricultural authority;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (c) the use is supported by crop residue data or dislodgeable foliar residue data. (usage limite)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: representative crop means a crop in a crop group from which extrapolations of residue levels and maximum residue limits may be made to one or more crops in the group. (culture representative)

heading: Definitions
paragraph: test data means test data that is provided to the Minister

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) in support of an application to register a pest control product or to amend a registration made under section 7 of the Act, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) in the context of a re-evaluation or special review, in response to a notice initiating the process under subsection 16(3) or 18(1) of the Act or a notice requiring additional information under paragraph 19(1)(a) of the Act. (donnees d'essai)

heading: Non-application - product copies
paragraph: 17.02 When an applicant wishes to use or rely on the test data of a registrant in order to register a pest control product that is equivalent to the registrant's product by using an active ingredient provided by the registrant, sections 17.03 to 17.11 do not apply if

heading: Non-application - product copies
paragraph: (a) the registrant provides the Minister with a letter, signed by the registrant, that specifies the active ingredient that they agree to provide to the applicant; and

heading: Non-application - product copies
paragraph: (b) the only active ingredient used in the manufacture of the applicant's pest control product is the one provided by the registrant.

heading: Period - general
paragraph: 17.03 (1) A registrant has exclusive rights for 10 years after the date of registration of the new active ingredient, of the new pest control product that contains the new active ingredient or of the new compound or substance.

heading: Extension - minor uses
paragraph: (2) The Minister must extend the period of exclusive rights if all of the following conditions are met:

heading: Extension - minor uses
paragraph: (a) the registrant meets one of the following requirements:

heading: Extension - minor uses
paragraph: (i) they proposed a minor use in the concurrent application to register a new pest control product referred to in paragraph (b) of the definition exclusive rights in section 17.01, or

heading: Extension - minor uses
paragraph: (ii) they made one of the following applications within seven years after the date of registration of the product referred to in subparagraph (i):

heading: Extension - minor uses
paragraph: (A) an application to amend its registration by adding a minor use, or

heading: Extension - minor uses
paragraph: (B) an application to register another new pest control product that contains the same active ingredient as the product and in respect of which a minor use is proposed;

heading: Extension - minor uses
paragraph: (b) the registrant requests an extension of the period of exclusive rights, within eight years after the date of registration of the new active ingredient referred to in paragraph (a) of the definition exclusive rights in section 17.01;

heading: Extension - minor uses
paragraph: (c) the Minister determines that the proposed minor use is a minor use and approves its addition to the registration of the product referred to in subparagraph (a)(i) or the other new pest control product referred to in clause (a)(ii)(B).

heading: Calculation of extension
paragraph: (3) The Minister must apply the following rules when calculating an extension:

heading: Calculation of extension
paragraph: (a) the period of exclusive rights is extended by one year for every three minor uses that are added, whether one or more at a time, to the registration for a total period of exclusive rights of 15 years; and

heading: Calculation of extension
paragraph: (b) the maximum number of minor uses in respect of a crop group is the number of representative crops in the crop group.

heading: When minor use removed
paragraph: (4) The Minister must cancel any extension of one year if

heading: When minor use removed
paragraph: (a) the Minister, on his or her own initiative or in response to a request from the registrant, amends the registration and removes one or more minor uses; and

heading: When minor use removed
paragraph: (b) the remaining number of minor uses is insufficient to uphold the extension.

heading: Consent
paragraph: 17.04 Subject to paragraph 17.05(1)(b), during the period of exclusive rights an applicant may use or rely on a registrant's test data in an application to register a pest control product or amend a registration if the registrant provides the applicant with written consent to use or rely on the test data.

heading: Conditions - use of or reliance on test data
paragraph: 17.05 (1) Subject to subsection 17.1(2), an applicant who makes an application to register a pest control product or to amend a registration may, in accordance with the agreement concluded with the data holder under subsection 17.07(2), use or rely on the following test data if they pay compensation to the data holder in accordance with the negotiated settlement or arbitral award for the period provided for in subsection (2) and if the applicant provides the Minister with a copy of a letter of access:

heading: Conditions - use of or reliance on test data
paragraph: (a) compensable data that the applicant wishes to use or rely on;

heading: Conditions - use of or reliance on test data
paragraph: (b) test data for which the data holder has exclusive rights, if the test data is relevant to the pest control product of the data holder and the test data is relevant to an active ingredient that is not equivalent to the active ingredient contained in the applicant's pest control product; and

heading: Conditions - use of or reliance on test data
paragraph: (c) test data that was considered during an evaluation or review of a pest control product by a foreign regulatory authority and that the data holder has not previously provided to the Minister, if the following conditions are met:

heading: Conditions - use of or reliance on test data
paragraph: (i) the Minister has considered for the first time the decision that results from the evaluation or review of the pest control product by the foreign regulatory authority in support of the re-evaluation or special review decision of the data holder's pest control product,

heading: Conditions - use of or reliance on test data
paragraph: (ii) the Minister requests that the data holder provide the Minister with the following in the form and manner directed by the Minister:

heading: Conditions - use of or reliance on test data
paragraph: (A) documents demonstrating that the test data was provided to the foreign regulatory authority in support of the evaluation or review of the pest control product, or in response to a request from the foreign regulatory authority relating to the evaluation or review,

heading: Conditions - use of or reliance on test data
paragraph: (B) documents demonstrating that the foreign regulatory authority considered the test data in support of its decision of the evaluation or review, and

heading: Conditions - use of or reliance on test data
paragraph: (C) the test data, and

heading: Conditions - use of or reliance on test data
paragraph: (iii) the data holder complies with the request.

heading: Compensable period
paragraph: (2) The period for which compensation is payable by the applicant to the data holder commences on one of the following days and must not exceed 12 years, except in the case of the test data referred to in paragraph (d) for which the period must not exceed the period set out in section 17.03:

heading: Compensable period
paragraph: (a) in the case of compensable data in support of an application to register a pest control product of the data holder, the day on which the Minister receives the application;

heading: Compensable period
