heading: Selection criteria for licence or permit
paragraph:
10
		  (1) Before inviting applications under section 9 for a grazing licence or grazing permit, the minister must decide which of the following are to be used as eligibility or evaluation criteria for selecting a successful applicant:

heading: Selection criteria for licence or permit
paragraph: (a) the submission of a plan that conforms to the requirements under the Forest and Range Practices Act for a range use plan or range stewardship plan;

heading: Selection criteria for licence or permit
paragraph: (b) in the case of a grazing licence, the capability of private land owned or held under lease by an applicant to sustain the applicant's livestock during that part of each year when the livestock will not be on Crown range;

heading: Selection criteria for licence or permit
paragraph: (c) the capability, through facilities on private land owned or held under lease by an applicant, of feeding, medically treating, branding, tagging, loading and unloading the applicant's livestock;

heading: Selection criteria for licence or permit
paragraph: (d) the proximity of the facilities referred to in paragraph (c) to the Crown range that will be described in the licence or permit;

heading: Selection criteria for licence or permit
paragraph: (e) rights over all or part of the Crown range that are the subject of the invitation and that are shared by an applicant with one or more other persons;

heading: Selection criteria for licence or permit
paragraph: (f) private land owned or held under lease that is

heading: Selection criteria for licence or permit
paragraph: (i)  adjacent to the Crown range described in the application, and

heading: Selection criteria for licence or permit
paragraph: (ii)  committed by the applicant for use in conjunction with the Crown range in a manner that benefits the management of the Crown range;

heading: Selection criteria for licence or permit
paragraph: (g) commitment by an applicant to surrender grazing or hay cutting rights over Crown range in order to benefit the management of Crown range;

heading: Selection criteria for licence or permit
paragraph: (g.1) commitment by an applicant to a course of action

heading: Selection criteria for licence or permit
paragraph: (i)  designed to improve or enhance the Crown range described in the application, including but not limited to carrying out a specified range practice as defined in the Forest and Range Practices Act, or a specified range development, and

heading: Selection criteria for licence or permit
paragraph: (ii)  that the applicant undertakes to carry out in conjunction with the licence or permit, as a condition of the licence or permit;

heading: Selection criteria for licence or permit
paragraph: (h) contraventions of this Act, the former Act, the Forest and Range Practices Act, the Forest Practices Code of British Columbia Act, the Livestock Act or the regulations under them by an applicant in the immediately preceding 5 years;

heading: Selection criteria for licence or permit
paragraph: (i) the number of livestock owned or leased by the applicant;

heading: Selection criteria for licence or permit
paragraph: (j) other eligibility or evaluation criteria the minister considers relevant to an invitation for applications under section 9 for grazing licences or grazing permits.

heading: Selection criteria for licence or permit
paragraph: (3) Before inviting applications under section 9 for a hay cutting licence or hay cutting permit, the minister must decide which of the following are to be used as eligibility or evaluation criteria for selecting a successful applicant:

heading: Proposal to all applicants, if more than one
paragraph: 11		  (0.1) In exercising his or her powers or duties under this section and section 15 in respect of applications for a licence or permit made under section 9, the minister must use the eligibility or evaluation criteria in respect of the licence or permit as determined by the minister under section 10 (1) or (3), as applicable.

heading: Proposal to all applicants, if more than one
paragraph: (1) If only one application for a licence or permit is made under section 9, the minister may enter into the licence or permit with the applicant.

heading: Proposal to all applicants, if more than one
paragraph: (2) If more than one application is made under section 9, the minister must deliver in writing to all applicants a proposal respecting the disposition of all applications.

heading: Proposal to all applicants, if more than one
paragraph: (2.1) On receipt of one or more applications for a licence or permit under section 9, the minister may decline to enter into the licence or permit with any or all of the applicants.

paragraph:
13
		  (1) The minister may change a proposal made under section 11 (2) if the minister determines that part of the proposal resulted from an error in

heading: Changes to a proposal
paragraph: (a) numerical calculation, or

heading: Changes to a proposal
paragraph: (b) interpretation of material included in an application submitted in response to an invitation for applications under section 9.

heading: Changes to a proposal
paragraph: (2) A change may be made under subsection (1) of this section before or after receipt of an objection referred to in section 15.

heading: No objection to proposal
paragraph:
14
		  Unless the minister receives notice in writing in accordance with section 15 (1) from one or more of the applicants objecting to a proposal made under section 11, the minister may enter into the licences, permits or both that are identified in the proposal.

heading: Objection to proposal
paragraph:
15
		  (1) An applicant may, within 14 days after a proposal under section 11 (2) is received by the applicant, deliver notice in writing to the minister objecting to the proposal and setting out in the notice the reasons for the objection.

heading: Objection to proposal
paragraph: (2) If, in the opinion of the minister, an objection referred to in subsection (1) does not raise issues relevant to the proposal that warrant its reconsideration, the minister may enter into the licences, permits or both that are identified in the proposal.

heading: Objection to proposal
paragraph: (3) If, in the opinion of the minister, an objection referred to in subsection (1) raises issues relevant to the proposal that warrant its reconsideration, after giving all the applicants an opportunity to be heard, the minister may enter into the licences or permits referred to in the invitation under section 9 with those of the applicants the minister selects.

heading: Objection to proposal
paragraph: (4) Notice of a decision of the minister under subsection (2) or (3) must be delivered to all the applicants.

heading: Direct award - public notice not required
paragraph:
16
		  (1) Despite section 9, the minister, without inviting or accepting applications from other persons, may enter with a person into a grazing or hay cutting licence in any of the following circumstances:

heading: Direct award - public notice not required
paragraph: (a) the number of animal unit months specified in the grazing licence is 100 or less;

heading: Direct award - public notice not required
paragraph: (b) the quantity of hay specified in the hay cutting licence is 10 tonnes or less;

heading: Direct award - public notice not required
paragraph: (c) the grazing or hay cutting licence

heading: Direct award - public notice not required
paragraph: (i)  is entered into with the holder of a permit, lease or licence to occupy Crown land granted under the Land Act,

heading: Direct award - public notice not required
paragraph: (ii)  was publicized in conjunction with the Land Act permit, lease or licence, and

heading: Direct award - public notice not required
paragraph: (iii)  is needed to carry out the operations authorized under or related to the Land Act permit, lease or licence;

heading: Direct award - public notice not required
paragraph: (d) the grazing licence is entered into with a person who, within the 2 weeks before the person applies for the grazing licence under this section, surrendered a grazing lease granted to that person under the Land Act;

heading: Direct award - public notice not required
paragraph: (e) the grazing licence is entered into with a person who holds or held a grazing permit issued under this Act as a replacement permit for a grazing permit issued under the former Act, if the person applies for the grazing licence under this section during the term of the replacement grazing permit or within 2 months after its expiry.

heading: Direct award - public notice not required
paragraph: (1.1) A grazing licence referred to in subsection (1) (d) or (e) must

heading: Direct award - public notice not required
paragraph: (a) describe the same area as the grazing lease or permit referred to in that subsection, and

heading: Direct award - public notice not required
paragraph: (b) specify a number of animal unit months for which the holder is eligible each year, which number must not be more than the number specified in the grazing lease or permit referred to in that subsection, if any.

heading: Direct award - public notice not required
paragraph: (2) Despite section 9 but subject to subsection (3) of this section, the minister, without inviting or accepting applications from other persons, may enter with a person into

heading: Direct award - public notice not required
paragraph: (a) a grazing permit authorizing its holder to use forage, or

heading: Direct award - public notice not required
paragraph: (b) a hay cutting permit authorizing its holder to use hay

heading: Direct award - public notice not required

heading: Direct award - public notice not required

heading: Direct award - public notice required

heading: Direct award - public notice required
paragraph: "compensatory grazing licence or permit" means a grazing licence or permit that specifies a number of animal unit months in full or partial substitution for animal unit months lost to the holder of a grazing licence or permit because of circumstances beyond the holder's control;

paragraph: (3) An offer made under this section may be amended.

heading: Replacement licence content
paragraph: 24		  A licence offered under section 23 must

heading: Replacement licence content
paragraph: (a) have a term beginning on the day after the expiry of the term of the licence being replaced under the offer,

heading: Replacement licence content
paragraph: (b) describe the same area as the licence being replaced under the offer,

heading: Replacement licence content
paragraph: (c) in the case of a grazing licence, specify a number of animal unit months for which the holder is eligible each year that is the same as specified in the licence being replaced under the offer, and

heading: Replacement licence content
paragraph: (d) in the case of a hay cutting licence, grant to the holder the right to harvest a specified quantity of hay that is the same as specified in the licence being replaced under the offer.

heading: Consolidation and subdivision
paragraph:
28
		  (1) With the consent of or on receipt of a written request from the holder of the relevant licences or permits, the minister may do one or more of the following:

heading: Consolidation and subdivision
paragraph: (a) consolidate 2 or more grazing licences held by the same person into a single grazing licence entered into with that person;

heading: Consolidation and subdivision
paragraph: (b) consolidate 2 or more grazing permits held by the same person into a single grazing permit entered into with that person;

heading: Consolidation and subdivision
paragraph: (c) subdivide a grazing licence held by a person into 2 or more grazing licences entered into with the person;

heading: Consolidation and subdivision
paragraph: (d) subdivide a grazing permit held by a person into 2 or more grazing permits entered into with the person;

heading: Consolidation and subdivision
paragraph: (e) delete all or part of the Crown range described in a grazing licence held by a person and include the Crown range or the part of it, as the case may be, in another grazing licence entered into with the person;

heading: Consolidation and subdivision
paragraph: (f) delete all or part of the Crown range described in a grazing permit held by a person and include the Crown range or the part of it, as the case may be, in another grazing permit entered into with the person;

heading: Consolidation and subdivision
paragraph: (g) cancel a licence or permit held by a person if all or part of its Crown range has been included in another licence or permit entered into with the person;

heading: Consolidation and subdivision
paragraph: (h) enter into one or more grazing licences with a person describing the same Crown range as described in one or more licences held by the person that were the subject of consolidation, subdivision or deletion under this section;

heading: Consolidation and subdivision
paragraph: (i) enter into one or more grazing permits with a person describing the same Crown range as described in one or more permits held by the person that were the subject of consolidation, subdivision or deletion under this section.

heading: Consolidation and subdivision
paragraph: (2) Instead of, under section 11 (1), 14, 15 (2) or (3), 16 or 18 (2), entering with an applicant into a licence or permit, the minister, with the applicant's consent, may amend

heading: Consolidation and subdivision
paragraph: (a) a licence held by the applicant by including in it the new subject matter, or

heading: Consolidation and subdivision
paragraph: (b) a permit held by the applicant by including in it the new subject matter.

heading: Retention of associated private land or tenures of holder of licence or permit
paragraph:
29
		  (1) In this section and section 30:

heading: Retention of associated private land or tenures of holder of licence or permit
paragraph: "associated private land", in relation to a licence or permit referred to in subsection (1.1) of this section, means the private land referred to in paragraph (a) of that subsection;

heading: Retention of associated private land or tenures of holder of licence or permit
paragraph: "associated tenure", in relation to a licence or permit referred to in subsection (1.1) of this section, means the permit, lease, licence, certificate, interest, right or privilege referred to in paragraph (b) of that subsection, as applicable.

heading: Retention of associated private land or tenures of holder of licence or permit
paragraph: (1.1) This section and section 30 apply to a licence or permit if the licence or permit contains a requirement or condition to the effect that, during the term of the licence or permit, the holder of the licence or permit is to

heading: Retention of associated private land or tenures of holder of licence or permit
paragraph: (a) retain the ownership of or a leasehold interest in specified private land, or

heading: Retention of associated private land or tenures of holder of licence or permit
paragraph: (b) hold any of the following as specified in the licence or permit:

heading: Retention of associated private land or tenures of holder of licence or permit
paragraph: (i)  a permit, lease or licence under the Land Act to occupy Crown land for a purpose specified by regulation;

heading: Retention of associated private land or tenures of holder of licence or permit
paragraph: (ii)  a guiding territory certificate or transporter licence under the Wildlife Act;

heading: Retention of associated private land or tenures of holder of licence or permit
paragraph: (iii)  an interest, right or privilege in relation to the use of Crown land or resources that is granted under an enactment and specified by regulation.

heading: Retention of associated private land or tenures of holder of licence or permit
paragraph: (2) During the term of a licence or permit the holder of the licence or permit must continue, as applicable,

heading: Retention of associated private land or tenures of holder of licence or permit
paragraph: (a) to own or hold under lease the associated private land for that licence or permit, or

heading: Retention of associated private land or tenures of holder of licence or permit
paragraph: (b) to hold the associated tenure for that licence or permit.

heading: Retention of associated private land or tenures of holder of licence or permit
paragraph: (3) The minister may cancel a licence or permit without first delivering to the holder of the licence or permit a notice of cancellation if the holder contravenes subsection (2).

heading: Retention of associated private land or tenures of holder of licence or permit
paragraph: (4) If the minister determines that there are grounds under subsection (3) to cancel a licence or permit, but decides not to cancel the licence or permit,

heading: Retention of associated private land or tenures of holder of licence or permit
paragraph: (a) the minister must inform the holder of the licence or permit of the decision,

heading: Retention of associated private land or tenures of holder of licence or permit
paragraph: (b) the minister, in making the decision not to cancel, may prepare amendments to the licence or permit to attach conditions to it that the minister considers appropriate in the circumstances, and

heading: Retention of associated private land or tenures of holder of licence or permit
paragraph: (c) the minister must deliver notice to the holder of the licence or permit, setting out the amendments prepared under paragraph (b), if any.

heading: Retention of associated private land or tenures of holder of licence or permit
paragraph: (4.1) On delivery of notice to the holder of a licence or permit in accordance with subsection (4) (c), the licence or permit, as the case may be, is deemed to be amended as set out in the notice.

heading: Retention of associated private land or tenures of holder of licence or permit
paragraph: (5) Sections 55 to 66 do not apply to a cancellation of a licence or permit under subsection (3) of this section.

heading: Substitutions
paragraph: 30		  (1) A holder of a licence or permit may apply to the minister to amend the licence or permit by substituting other land for the holder's associated private land.

heading: Substitutions
paragraph: (2) On receiving an application under subsection (1), the minister may amend the licence or permit by substituting other land for the holder's associated private land.

heading: Other uses of Crown range
paragraph:
34
		  A licence or permit under this Act does not prevent the government from

heading: Other uses of Crown range
paragraph: (a) using the Crown range, or

heading: Other uses of Crown range
paragraph: (b) granting to others the use of the Crown range

heading: Other uses of Crown range
paragraph: described in the licence or permit if the use is for a purpose that the minister considers is compatible with the grazing or hay cutting rights of the holder under the licence or permit.

heading: Change in boundary or area
paragraph:
35
		  In accordance with the regulations and with the consent of the holder of a licence or permit, the minister may vary the boundary or area of the licence or permit.

heading: Licence or permit deletions and reductions, generally
paragraph:
36
		  (1) The minister by order may

heading: Licence or permit deletions and reductions, generally
paragraph: (a) delete land from the Crown range described in a licence or permit,

heading: Licence or permit deletions and reductions, generally
paragraph: (b) reduce as necessary because of the deletion the number of animal unit months or quantity of hay specified in the licence or permit, or

heading: Licence or permit deletions and reductions, generally
paragraph: (c) do both

heading: Licence or permit deletions and reductions, generally
paragraph: if the minister considers that the deletion, reduction or both will lead to more efficient resource use.

heading: Licence or permit deletions and reductions, generally
paragraph: (2) The minister by order may reduce the number of animal unit months or quantity of hay specified in a licence or permit if he or she considers the reduction necessary because the Crown range described in the licence or permit no longer supports the number of animal unit months or quantity of hay.

heading: Licence or permit deletions and reductions because of incompatible land use
paragraph:
37
		  The minister by order may

heading: Licence or permit deletions and reductions because of incompatible land use
paragraph: (a) delete land from the Crown range described in a licence or permit, and

heading: Licence or permit deletions and reductions because of incompatible land use
paragraph: (b) reduce as necessary because of the deletion the number of animal unit months or quantity of hay specified in the licence or permit

heading: Licence or permit deletions and reductions because of incompatible land use
paragraph: if the minister considers that the land deleted is required for a use incompatible with grazing or hay cutting.

heading: Implementing deletions and reductions
paragraph:
38
		  (1) A deletion or reduction or a combination of them, as the case may be, under section 36 or 37 is not effective until the minister has prepared the necessary amendments to the licence or permit and,

heading: Implementing deletions and reductions
paragraph: (a) if there is no reduction in the number of animal unit months or in the quantity of hay, the minister delivers to the holder at least 60 days' notice, setting out the amendments, or

heading: Implementing deletions and reductions
paragraph: (b) if there is a reduction in the number of animal unit months or in the quantity of hay, the minister delivers to the holder at least one year's notice, setting out the amendments.

heading: Implementing deletions and reductions
paragraph: (2) Despite subsection (1), if a holder of a licence or permit consents to waiving the notice period under subsection (1) (a) or (b), the deletion or reduction, or the combination of them, as the case may be, is effective as soon as

heading: Implementing deletions and reductions
paragraph: (a) the minister has prepared the necessary amendments to the licence or permit, and

heading: Implementing deletions and reductions
paragraph: (b) notice of the amendments is delivered to the holder, in accordance with this section.

heading: Implementing deletions and reductions
paragraph: (3) On expiry of a notice delivered to the holder of a licence or permit under subsection (1) or on delivery of a notice under subsection (2), the licence or permit, as the case may be, is deemed to be amended as set out in the notice.

heading: Compensation for reductions
paragraph:
39
		  (1) If during the term of a licence or permit

heading: Compensation for reductions
paragraph: (a) a reduction, or

heading: Compensation for reductions
paragraph: (b) a series of reductions, if more than one,

heading: Compensation for reductions
paragraph: under section 36 (1) or 37 in the number of animal unit months or quantity of hay specified in the licence or permit at the time of the reduction has the effect of reducing by more than 5% the

heading: Compensation for reductions
paragraph: (c) number of animal unit months, or

heading: Compensation for reductions
paragraph: (d) quantity of hay

heading: Compensation for reductions
paragraph: specified in the licence or permit at the beginning of its term, the holder of the licence or permit is entitled to compensation from the government in an amount determined in accordance with subsection (2) of this section.

heading: Compensation for reductions
paragraph: (2) The compensation to which the holder of a licence or permit is entitled under subsection (1) is an amount equal to the value, for the unexpired portion of the term of the licence or permit or for a different period if a different period is prescribed, of the

heading: Compensation for reductions
paragraph: (a) number of animal unit months, or

heading: Compensation for reductions
paragraph: (b) quantity of hay

heading: Compensation for reductions
paragraph: taken by means of the part of the reduction that exceeds 5% of the

heading: Compensation for reductions
paragraph: (c) number of animal unit months, or

heading: Compensation for reductions
paragraph: (d) quantity of hay

heading: Compensation for reductions
paragraph: specified in the licence or permit at the beginning of its term.

heading: Compensation for range developments
paragraph:
40
		  The holder of a licence or permit affected by a deletion of land under section 36 (1) or 37 or in prescribed circumstances by a reduction under section 36 (2) is entitled to compensation from the government in an amount equal to the sum of

heading: Compensation for range developments
paragraph: (a) any labour and material costs reasonably incurred by the holder for range developments,

heading: Compensation for range developments
paragraph: (i)  on the Crown range remaining under the licence or permit after the deletion, and

heading: Compensation for range developments
paragraph: (ii)  made necessary by

heading: Compensation for range developments
paragraph: (A) a deletion of land under section 36 (1) or 37, or

heading: Compensation for range developments
paragraph: (B) a reduction under section 36 (2) if the circumstances in which compensation is payable for such a reduction have been prescribed, and

heading: Compensation for range developments
paragraph: (b) the value of range developments made to the land deleted that

heading: Compensation for range developments
paragraph: (i)  are authorized under an enactment,

heading: Compensation for range developments
paragraph: (iii)  are not or have not been paid for by

heading: Compensation for range developments
paragraph: (A) the government under this Act or another enactment, or

heading: Compensation for range developments
paragraph: (B) a person other than the holder or a former holder of the licence or permit.

heading: Arbitration Act applies to disputes as to amount of compensation
paragraph: 41		  If the government and the holder of a licence or permit do not agree on the amount of compensation payable under section 39 or 40 to the holder the amount must be submitted for determination by arbitration under the Arbitration Act.

heading: Compensation may take form of licence or permit
paragraph: 42		  (1) Compensation payable under section 39 to the holder of a licence or permit may take the form, in whole or in part, of another licence or permit.

heading: Compensation may take form of licence or permit
paragraph: (2) The minister may enter with the holder into the other licence or permit without first giving public notice or inviting applications from other persons.

heading: Set-off for benefits previously received
paragraph:
43
		  The amount of compensation to which the holder of a licence or permit is entitled under sections 39 and 40 must be reduced by any financial or other benefit received by that holder from the government because of or arising out of the deletion or reduction that gives rise to the entitlement.

heading: When compensation not payable
paragraph:
44
		  (1) In this section, "compensation" includes damages.

heading: When compensation not payable
paragraph: (2) No compensation is payable by the government and an action or other proceeding must not be brought or continued against the government for compensation in respect of any of the following:

heading: When compensation not payable
paragraph: (c) subject to section 40, a deletion of land under section 36 (1) or 37 from the Crown range described in a licence or permit if there is no reduction, because of the deletion, in animal unit months or quantity of hay;

heading: When compensation not payable
paragraph: (d) subject to section 40, a reduction under section 36 (2) in the

heading: When compensation not payable
paragraph: (i)  number of animal unit months, or

heading: When compensation not payable
paragraph: (ii)  quantity of hay

heading: When compensation not payable
paragraph: specified in a licence or permit;

heading: When compensation not payable
paragraph: (e) a reduction under section 47 or 48 in the number of animal unit months specified in a licence or permit;

heading: When compensation not payable
paragraph: (f) an order under section 49.

heading: Limit on compensation
paragraph:
45
		  (1) In this section:

heading: Limit on compensation
paragraph: "agreement" means a grazing licence, grazing permit, hay cutting licence or hay cutting permit;

heading: Limit on compensation
paragraph: "compensation" includes damages.

heading: Limit on compensation
paragraph: (2) The compensation payable to the holder of an agreement because of or arising out of

heading: Limit on compensation
paragraph: (a) a deletion of land under section 36 (1) or 37 affecting the agreement,

heading: Limit on compensation
paragraph: (b) a reduction under section 36 (1) or 37 affecting the agreement in the number of animal unit months or quantity of hay, or

heading: Limit on compensation
paragraph: (c) a deletion referred to in paragraph (a) of this subsection in combination with a reduction referred to in paragraph (b) of this subsection

heading: Limit on compensation
paragraph: is limited to the amount of compensation determined in relation to that agreement under sections 39 and 40.

heading: Limit on compensation
paragraph: (3) An action or other proceeding must not be brought or continued against the government for compensation in an amount that exceeds the amount limited under this section.

heading: Limit on compensation
paragraph: (4) The Expropriation Act does not apply in respect of a taking, deletion or reduction, under this Act, of any right or interest held by a person under this Act.

heading: 90% animal unit months use requirement unless otherwise agreed
paragraph: 46		  (1) Unless otherwise agreed by a non-use agreement made in writing between the minister on behalf of the government and the holder of a grazing licence or grazing permit, the holder must ensure that at least 90% of the animal unit months specified in the licence or permit is used in each calendar year.

heading: 90% animal unit months use requirement unless otherwise agreed
paragraph: (2) A non-use agreement referred to in subsection (1)

heading: 90% animal unit months use requirement unless otherwise agreed
paragraph: (a) must conform to prescribed criteria and include prescribed content, and

heading: 90% animal unit months use requirement unless otherwise agreed
paragraph: (b) may include terms and conditions that are consistent with this Act, the Forest and Range Practices Act and the regulations under them.

heading: Reduction for underused animal unit months
paragraph: 47		  (1) If, in the absence of a non-use agreement referred to in section 46, the holder of a grazing licence or grazing permit does not ensure the use in a calendar year of at least 90% of the animal unit months specified in the licence or permit, the minister

heading: Reduction for underused animal unit months
paragraph: (a) may prepare amendments to the licence or permit to reduce the number of animal unit months specified in it by an amount that does not exceed the amount of the unused animal unit months for that calendar year, and

heading: Reduction for underused animal unit months
paragraph: (b) must deliver notice to the holder setting out the amendments prepared under paragraph (a) of this subsection.

heading: Reduction for underused animal unit months
paragraph: (2) On delivery to the holder of a licence or permit of notice in accordance with subsection (1), the licence or permit, as the case may be, is deemed to be amended as set out in the notice.

heading: Reduction for non-compliance with a non-use agreement
paragraph:
48
		  (1) If the holder of a grazing licence or grazing permit, who under section 46 has a non-use agreement, does not ensure the use in a calendar year, of the number of animal unit months specified in the licence or permit after taking into account the non-use agreement, the minister

heading: Reduction for non-compliance with a non-use agreement
paragraph: (a) may prepare amendments to the licence or permit to reduce the number of animal unit months specified in it by an amount that does not exceed the amount of the unused animal unit months for that calendar year, and

heading: Reduction for non-compliance with a non-use agreement
paragraph: (b) must deliver notice to the holder, setting out the amendments prepared under paragraph (a) of this subsection.

heading: Reduction for non-compliance with a non-use agreement
paragraph: (2) On delivery to the holder of a licence or permit of notice in accordance with subsection (1), the licence or permit, as the case may be, is deemed to be amended as set out in the notice.

heading: Directed non-use of Crown range
paragraph:
49
		  (1) The minister may order the holder of a licence or permit, for a period specified by the minister, to refrain to the extent specified in the order from using all or a specified part of the Crown range described in the licence or permit.

heading: Directed non-use of Crown range
paragraph: (2) A holder who is the subject of an order under subsection (1) must comply with the order.

heading: Exemption orders in exceptional circumstances
paragraph:
50
		  (1) If satisfied that the holder of a licence or permit is unable to use or ensure the use of the percentage or number of animal unit months referred to in section 46 (1), 47 (1) or 48 (1) because of

heading: Exemption orders in exceptional circumstances
paragraph: (a) circumstances beyond the holder's control, or

heading: Exemption orders in exceptional circumstances
paragraph: (b) an order under section 49,

heading: Exemption orders in exceptional circumstances
paragraph: the minister by order may exempt the holder from the obligation,

heading: Exemption orders in exceptional circumstances
paragraph: (c) with or without conditions, and

heading: Exemption orders in exceptional circumstances
paragraph: (d) to an extent and for a period specified in the order.

heading: Exemption orders in exceptional circumstances
paragraph: (2) An order under subsection (1) may be made on the minister's own initiative or on application by the holder of a licence or permit.

heading: Exemption orders in exceptional circumstances
paragraph: (3) Before making or refusing to make an order under subsection (1) that is the subject of an application by the holder of a licence or permit, the minister must give the applicant an opportunity to be heard.

heading: Exemption orders in exceptional circumstances
paragraph: (4) The minister must deliver notice to the applicant of a decision refusing to make an order under subsection (1), accompanied by the reasons for the decision.

heading: Exemption orders in exceptional circumstances
paragraph: (5) A holder who is the subject of an order under subsection (1) must comply with the order.

heading: Reporting requirements for grazing
paragraph:
51
		  (1) By December 31 in each year, the holder of a grazing licence or grazing permit must report to the minister the number of animal unit months the holder has used under the licence or permit in that year if the use is less than 90% of the animal unit months.

heading: Reporting requirements for grazing
paragraph: (2) If the minister considers it appropriate in a particular case for the efficient use of Crown range he or she may require the holder of a grazing licence or grazing permit to provide the report described in subsection (1) even if the use of animal unit months is 90% or more.

heading: Reporting requirements for grazing
paragraph: (3) The holder of a grazing licence or grazing permit who is required under subsection (2) to provide a report described in subsection (1) must provide the report.

heading: Temporary increase of animal unit months or quantity of hay
paragraph:
52
		  On application by the holder of a licence or permit and without inviting or accepting applications from other persons, the minister may increase for a specified year

heading: Temporary increase of animal unit months or quantity of hay
paragraph: (a) the number of animal unit months specified in the licence or permit, or

heading: Temporary increase of animal unit months or quantity of hay
paragraph: (b) the specified quantity of hay to be harvested under the licence or permit

heading: Temporary increase of animal unit months or quantity of hay
paragraph: if the minister considers that

heading: Temporary increase of animal unit months or quantity of hay
paragraph: (c) the increase can be used without adversely affecting the management and conservation of the Crown range described in the licence or permit, and

heading: Temporary increase of animal unit months or quantity of hay
paragraph: (d) a competitive process in relation to the increase in the number of animal unit months or in the quantity of hay to be harvested is not practicable in the circumstances.

heading: Earned increase in animal unit months or quantity of hay
paragraph:
53
		  (1) The holder of a licence or permit may submit a plan in writing to the minister for the management by the holder of the Crown range described in the licence or permit in a manner intended to increase the animal unit months or quantity of hay available on that Crown range.

heading: Earned increase in animal unit months or quantity of hay
paragraph: (2) The minister may approve a plan submitted under subsection (1) if the plan conforms to prescribed criteria, if any.

heading: Earned increase in animal unit months or quantity of hay
paragraph: (3) After receiving approval under subsection (2), the holder of the licence or permit to which the plan pertains

heading: Earned increase in animal unit months or quantity of hay
paragraph: (a) may implement the plan, and

heading: Earned increase in animal unit months or quantity of hay
paragraph: (b) if the plan results in an increase in the animal unit months or quantity of hay available on the Crown range described in the licence or permit, request an amendment to the licence or permit to reflect the increase.

heading: Earned increase in animal unit months or quantity of hay
paragraph: (4) If satisfied that an increase requested under subsection (3) is sustainable, the minister

heading: Earned increase in animal unit months or quantity of hay
paragraph: (a) may amend the licence or permit to reflect the increase for the balance of the term of the licence or permit, and

heading: Earned increase in animal unit months or quantity of hay
paragraph: (b) if the amendment is made under paragraph (a) of this subsection, must attach a condition to the licence or permit requiring continued use of the plan.

heading: Cancellation as a result of reductions
paragraph:
53.1
		  (1) If, during the term of a licence or permit,

heading: Cancellation as a result of reductions
paragraph: (a) a reduction, or

heading: Cancellation as a result of reductions
paragraph: (b) a series of reductions, if more than one,

heading: Cancellation as a result of reductions
paragraph: under section 36 (1) or (2), 37, 47 (1) or 48 (1) in the number of animal unit months or quantity of hay specified in the licence or permit has the effect of reducing the number of animal unit months or quantity of hay to zero, the minister, without a hearing, by order may cancel the licence or permit.

heading: Cancellation as a result of reductions
paragraph: (2) The minister must deliver to the holder of the licence or permit notice of a cancellation under subsection (1), specifying the reasons for the cancellation and the day on which the cancellation takes effect.

heading: Cancellation as a result of reductions
paragraph: (3) Sections 64 to 66 do not apply to a cancellation of a licence or permit under subsection (1) of this section.

heading: Application of certain Forest and Range Practices Act provisions
paragraph:
54
		  Divisions 1 and 2 of Part 6 of the Forest and Range Practices Act apply to this Act and the regulations under this Act, unless the context indicates otherwise.

heading: Suspension of rights under licences and permits
paragraph: 55		  Subject to section 60 and in addition to any penalty, charge or order under this Act or the Forest and Range Practices Act, the minister by order may suspend all or part of the rights under a licence or permit, if the holder of the licence or permit

heading: Suspension of rights under licences and permits
paragraph: (a) makes a material misrepresentation, omission or misstatement of fact in

heading: Suspension of rights under licences and permits
paragraph: (i)  the application for the licence or permit or in information furnished with it, or

heading: Suspension of rights under licences and permits
paragraph: (ii)  an operational plan, as defined in the Forest and Range Practices Act,

heading: Suspension of rights under licences and permits
paragraph: (b) does not perform an obligation to be performed by the holder under the licence or permit, other than an obligation under a condition described in section 4 (a.1), 5 (b), 6 (a.1) or 7 (b) of this Act, or

heading: Suspension of rights under licences and permits
paragraph: (c) does not comply with this Act, the Forest and Range Practices Act, the Livestock Act or the regulations under them.

heading: Suspension by minister
paragraph: 56		  In addition to any penalty, charge or order under this Act or the Forest and Range Practices Act, the minister may suspend by order all or part of the rights under a licence or permit if its holder does not comply with a condition described in section 4 (a.1), 5 (b), 6 (a.1) or 7 (b) of this Act.

heading: Notice of suspension
paragraph: 57		  (1) Before rights are suspended by order under section 55, the minister must deliver notice to the holder of the licence or permit

heading: Notice of suspension
paragraph: (a) specifying the material misrepresentation, omission, misstatement, non-performance or non-compliance, and

heading: Notice of suspension
paragraph: (b) allowing the holder at least 5 days after the date of delivery of the notice to remedy the material misrepresentation, omission, misstatement, non-performance or non-compliance.

heading: Notice of suspension
paragraph: (2) Before rights are suspended under section 56, the minister must deliver notice to the holder of the licence or permit

heading: Notice of suspension
paragraph: (a) stating the particulars of the holder's non-compliance with the agreement referred to in section 4 (a.1), 5 (b), 6 (a.1) or 7 (b), and

heading: Notice of suspension
paragraph: (b) allowing the holder at least 5 days after the date of delivery of the notice to remedy the non-compliance.

heading: Opportunity to be heard
paragraph:
58
		  (1) On the request of the holder made during the period allowed under section 57 (1) (b) or (2) (b), the minister must give the holder an opportunity to be heard.

heading: Opportunity to be heard
paragraph: (2) After giving the holder an opportunity to be heard, the minister must rescind the order if he or she is satisfied that there are no grounds for suspending rights under the licence or permit.

heading: When suspension takes effect
paragraph:
59
		  A suspension of rights under section 55 or 56 takes effect on the expiry of the period allowed in the notice.

heading: Suspension by minister or natural resource officer
paragraph:
60
		  (1) By order, the minister or a natural resource officer authorized by the minister may suspend all or some of the rights granted under a licence or permit if he or she believes on reasonable and probable grounds that

heading: Suspension by minister or natural resource officer
paragraph: (a) the holder of the licence or permit has not performed an obligation to be performed by the holder under the licence or permit or has not complied with this Act, the Forest and Range Practices Act, the Livestock Act or the regulations under them and that the non-performance or non-compliance is causing or may imminently cause serious damage to the environment, or

heading: Suspension by minister or natural resource officer
paragraph: (b) because of weather conditions or other natural events, use of the Crown range described in the licence or permit would be detrimental to the forest or forage productivity of the Crown range.

heading: Suspension by minister or natural resource officer
paragraph: (2) The minister or a natural resource officer authorized by the minister may make an order under subsection (1) without advance notice, but must deliver notice of the order to the holder of the licence or permit, accompanied by the reasons for the order.

heading: Suspension by minister or natural resource officer
paragraph: (3) A suspension of rights under this section

heading: Suspension by minister or natural resource officer
paragraph: (a) takes effect on the date notice of the order is delivered to the holder under subsection (2), and

heading: Suspension by minister or natural resource officer
paragraph: (b) continues in effect until the rights

heading: Suspension by minister or natural resource officer
paragraph: (i)  are reinstated by the minister or a natural resource officer authorized by the minister, or

heading: Suspension by minister or natural resource officer
paragraph: (ii)  are cancelled under this Act.

heading: Prohibition against exercising rights under suspension
paragraph: 61		  The holder of a licence or permit must not exercise rights over Crown range granted in the licence or permit if those rights are under suspension.

heading: Reinstatement
paragraph:
62
		  (1) On application by the holder of a licence or permit suspended under section 55 or 56, the minister by order must

heading: Reinstatement
paragraph: (a) reinstate rights under the licence or permit if satisfied that there are no longer any grounds for the suspension, or

heading: Offences
paragraph:
73
		  (1) A person who contravenes section 49 (2), 68 (5) or 76 (2) commits an offence and is liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $100 000 or to imprisonment for not more than one year or to both.

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: 1		  (1) Unless otherwise indicated, words and expressions not defined in this regulation have the meaning given to them in section 1 [definitions] of the Forest Planning and Practices Regulation.

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: (2) In this regulation:

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: "authorization" means an authorization under section 51 [range developments] of the Act;

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: "range agreement holder" means a holder of an agreement under the Range Act;

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: "range readiness criteria" means the plant growth criteria that indicate when a range is ready for grazing;

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: "riparian area" means an area of land that

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: (a) is adjacent to a stream, lake or wetland, and

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: (b) contains vegetation that, due to the presence of water, is distinctly different from the vegetation of adjacent upland areas;

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: "stream" means a watercourse with an alluvial sediment bed, formed when water flows between continuous definable banks, on a perennial or intermittent basis;

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: "stubble height" means the height of plants remaining after harvesting or grazing.

heading: Definitions and application
paragraph: (3) A person is exempt from the requirements of Part 4 to the extent necessary to conform to the requirements of the Workers Compensation Act or a regulation made under that Act.

paragraph: (b) cutting hay;

paragraph: (c) constructing, modifying or maintaining a range development;

heading: Activities and categories of persons prescribed for range practices
paragraph: (d) an activity related to an activity described in paragraph (a), (b) or  (c).

heading: Activities and categories of persons prescribed for range practices
paragraph: (2) Contractors, employees and agents of a holder of an agreement under the Forest Act or the Range Act are a prescribed category of persons for the purposes of paragraph (a) (ii) of the definition of "range practice" in the Act.

heading: Objectives set by government generally
paragraph: 5		  The objectives set by government for the purposes of section 33 (1) (e) [content of range use plan for grazing], 34 (1) (e) [content of range use plan for hay cutting] and 35 (1) (d) [content of range stewardship plan] of the Act are set out in sections 6 to 11.

heading: Objectives set by government for soils
paragraph:
6
		  The objectives set by government for soils are as follows:

heading: Objectives set by government for soils
paragraph: (a) protect soil properties;

heading: Objectives set by government for soils
paragraph: (b) minimize erosion and compaction;

heading: Objectives set by government for soils
paragraph: (c) minimize undesirable disturbance to soils;

heading: Objectives set by government for soils
paragraph: (d) maintain a vigorous and diverse cover of desirable plant species with a variety of root depths sufficient to protect the soil;

heading: Objectives set by government for soils
paragraph: (e) re-establish ecologically suitable vegetation after disturbance occurs;

heading: Objectives set by government for soils
paragraph: (f) maintain ground cover, including sufficient litter and residual dry matter accumulation to protect soil;

heading: Objectives set by government for soils
paragraph: (g) minimize accelerated soil erosion;

heading: Objectives set by government for soils
paragraph: (h) minimize sealing of the soil surface.

heading: Objectives set by government for forage
paragraph:
7
		  The objectives set by government for forage and associated plant communities are as follows:

heading: Objectives set by government for forage
paragraph: (a) maintain or enhance healthy plant communities, including their vigour and cover;

heading: Objectives set by government for forage
paragraph: (b) maintain or enhance forage quality and quantity for livestock and wildlife;

heading: Objectives set by government for forage
paragraph: (c) recruit desirable plants, including through forage seeding;

heading: Objectives set by government for forage
paragraph: (d) maintain a variety of age classes and structural characteristics within plant communities;

heading: Objectives set by government for forage
paragraph: (e) maintain or improve litter;

heading: Objectives set by government for forage
paragraph: (f) enable a range agreement holder, in the exercise of its grazing or hay cutting rights granted by the government, to be vigorous, efficient and world competitive.

heading: Objectives set by government for water
paragraph:
8
		  The objectives set by government for water are as follows:

heading: Objectives set by government for water
paragraph: (a) maintain or improve water resources;

heading: Objectives set by government for water
paragraph: (b) maintain or promote healthy riparian and upland areas;

heading: Objectives set by government for water
paragraph: (c) maintain or promote riparian vegetation that provides sufficient shade to maintain stream temperature within the natural range of variability;

heading: Objectives set by government for water
paragraph: (d) maintain or promote desired riparian plant communities.

heading: Objectives set by government for fish
paragraph:
9
		  The objectives set by government for fish are as follows:

heading: Objectives set by government for fish
paragraph: (a) conserve fish, fish habitat and aquatic ecosystems;

heading: Objectives set by government for fish
paragraph: (b) manage any adverse effect of deleterious material.

heading: Objectives set by government for wildlife
paragraph:
10
		  The objectives set by government for wildlife are as follows:

heading: Objectives set by government for wildlife
paragraph: (a) maintain or promote sustainable, healthy, viable, productive and diverse wildlife populations and their associated habitat;

heading: Objectives set by government for wildlife
paragraph: (b) minimize disturbance during critical periods to wildlife or to wildlife habitats;

heading: Objectives set by government for wildlife
paragraph: (c) manage the risk of interaction between predators and livestock.

heading: Objectives set by government for biodiversity
paragraph:
11
		  The objectives set by government for biodiversity are as follows:

heading: Objectives set by government for biodiversity
paragraph: (a) conserve biodiversity;

heading: Objectives set by government for biodiversity
paragraph: (b) maintain native plant community dynamics;

heading: Objectives set by government for biodiversity
paragraph: (c) encourage the development of late seral plant communities or other desired plant communities;

heading: Objectives set by government for biodiversity
paragraph: (d) maintain plant communities consistent with natural successional stages on areas where forage seeding is carried out within transitory range areas.
