paragraph: (a) in relation to water, includes allow, start, stop, restrict or prohibit the diversion, use, including storage, carriage or distribution of the water, and

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) in relation to works, includes allow, start, stop, restrict, shut or prohibit their construction or operation;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "undertaking" means a project, including all land and other property acquired or to be acquired in connection with the project, and the general scheme for the acquisition, maintenance and operation of the works for the project, for

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) the diversion, carriage, use and sale of water, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) the sale of power produced from water,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: the water use purpose of which water is referred to in an application or authorization;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "unrecorded water" means water in a stream or an aquifer that is not recorded water;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "use approval" means an approval issued under section 10 [use approvals] or written approval, other than a licence, to divert and use water, given under a former Act;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "water district" means a water district prescribed by regulation;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "water manager" means a person designated under section 114 (3) [administration] as a water manager;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "water objective" means an objective established by regulation under section 43 [water objectives];

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "water source well" has the same meaning as in section 1 [definitions] of the Petroleum and Natural Gas Act;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "water sustainability plan" means a water sustainability plan accepted under section 75 (1) or (3) [acceptance of plan];

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "water use purpose" means a purpose defined in section 2 [water use purposes] or a subset of a purpose defined in section 2;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "water users' community" has the same meaning as in section 1 (1) [definitions] of the Water Users' Communities Act;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "well" means an artificial opening in the ground made for the purpose of

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) exploring for or diverting groundwater,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) testing or measuring groundwater,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (c) recharging or dewatering an aquifer,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (d) groundwater remediation,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (e) use as a monitoring well,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (f) use as a closed-loop geoexchange well, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (g) use as a geotechnical well,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: but does not include

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (h) an artificial opening, other than a water source well, to which the Geothermal Resources Act or the Energy Resource Activities Act applies, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (i) an artificial opening of a prescribed class, made for a prescribed purpose or in prescribed circumstances;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "well cap" means a secure cap or lid that prevents vermin, contaminants, debris or other foreign objects or substances from entering the interior of the production casing, and includes a sanitary well seal;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "well cover" means a secure cover, lid or structure that prevents vermin, contaminants, debris or other foreign objects or substances from entering the well;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "well pump" means a pump that

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) is at or in a well, and

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) is used or intended to be used for the purposes of

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (i)  diverting groundwater from a well,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (ii)  adding water to a well to recharge the well or an aquifer, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (iii)  dewatering an aquifer;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "wellhead" means

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) the physical structure, facility, well cover, adapter or device

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (i)  that is at the top of, or at the side and near the top of, a well, and

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (ii)  from or through which groundwater flows or is pumped from the well, and

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) any casing, well cap, valve, grout, liner, seal, vent or drain relating to the well,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: but does not include a well pump or a pump house;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "wetland" means a swamp, marsh, fen or prescribed feature;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "wildlife" means wildlife as defined in paragraph (a) of the definition of "wildlife" in section 1 (1) [definitions and interpretation] of the Wildlife Act;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "works" means

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) anything that can be or is used for

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (i)  diverting, storing, measuring, conserving, conveying, retarding the flow of, confining or using water,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (ii)  producing, measuring, transmitting or using electricity,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (iii)  collecting, conveying or disposing of sewage or garbage, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (iv)  preventing or extinguishing fires,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) booms and piles placed in a stream,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (c) obstructions placed in or removed from streams or the banks or beds of streams,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (d) changes in and about a stream,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (e) access roads to any of the works referred to in paragraphs (a) to (d) or (f) (i), and

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (f) wells and works related to wells, including

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (i)  wellheads,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (ii)  anything that can be or is used for injecting or otherwise adding water or any other substance to a well,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (iii)  anything that can be or is used for constructing, deactivating or decommissioning a well,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (iv)  anything that can be or is used for exploring for, testing, diverting or monitoring groundwater,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (v)  anything that can be or is used for disinfecting a well,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (vi)  an injection system attached to a work that is used for conveying, from a well, groundwater that will be used for applying fertilizers or pesticides, and

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (vii)  anything that can be or is used in relation to a monitoring well or a well made for the purpose of groundwater remediation.

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (2) A reference in this Act to regulations or to anything as prescribed is a reference to regulations of the Lieutenant Governor in Council unless specifically provided otherwise in the applicable provision.

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (3) An authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization issued in substitution for

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) an original authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) an original authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization as modified,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: is conclusively deemed to be the original authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization as modified.

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (4) A reference in this Act

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) to an aquifer includes part of an aquifer, and

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) to a stream includes part of a stream.

heading: Water use purposes
paragraph: 2		  The following defined purposes are the purposes in respect of which water may be diverted from a stream or an aquifer:

heading: Water use purposes
paragraph: "conservation purpose" means the diversion, retention or use of water for the purpose of conserving fish or wildlife and includes the construction of works for that purpose;

heading: Water use purposes
paragraph: "domestic purpose" means the use of water for household purposes by the occupants of, subject to the regulations, one or more private dwellings, other than multi-family apartment buildings, including, without limitation, hotels and strata titled or cooperative buildings, located on a single parcel, including, without limitation, the following uses:

heading: Water use purposes
paragraph: (a) drinking water, food preparation and sanitation;

heading: Water use purposes
paragraph: (b) fire prevention;

heading: Water use purposes
paragraph: (c) providing water to animals or poultry kept

heading: Water use purposes
paragraph: (i)  for household use, or

heading: Water use purposes
paragraph: (ii)  as pets;

heading: Water use purposes
paragraph: (d) irrigation of a garden not exceeding 1 000 m2 that is adjoining and occupied with a dwelling;

heading: Water use purposes
paragraph: "industrial purpose" means a use of water designated by regulation as a use for an industrial purpose, but does not include the use of water for any other water use purpose;

heading: Water use purposes
paragraph: "irrigation purpose" means the use of water on cultivated land or hay meadows to nourish crops or on pasture to nourish forage;

heading: Water use purposes
paragraph: "land improvement purpose" means the diversion or impounding of water to

heading: Water use purposes
paragraph: (a) protect land,

heading: Water use purposes
paragraph: (b) facilitate the development of a recreational facility or of a park or other protected area,

heading: Water use purposes
paragraph: (c) facilitate the reclamation, drainage or other improvement of land, or

heading: Water use purposes
paragraph: (d) carry out a project of a nature similar to a project described in paragraph (b) or (c);

heading: Water use purposes
paragraph: "mineralized water purpose" means

heading: Water use purposes
paragraph: (a) the bottling and commercial distribution of water so impregnated with mineral salts, elements or gases as to potentially give the water therapeutic properties, or

heading: Water use purposes
paragraph: (b) the use in commercial bathing pools of water that is

heading: Water use purposes
paragraph: (i)  impregnated with mineral salts, elements or gases, or

heading: Water use purposes
paragraph: (ii)  naturally at a temperature suitable for that use;

heading: Water use purposes
paragraph: "mining purpose" means

heading: Water use purposes
paragraph: (a) the use of water, including the use of water under pressure, for recovering minerals from the ground or from ore, or

heading: Water use purposes
paragraph: (b) the use of water under pressure to move earth, sand, gravel or rock;

heading: Water use purposes
paragraph: "oil and gas purpose" means the use of water in the development of petroleum or natural gas wells or the production of petroleum or natural gas resources;

heading: Water use purposes
paragraph: "power purpose" means the use of water in the production of electricity or other power;

heading: Water use purposes
paragraph: "storage purpose" means the impounding and retention of water for subsequent use for a water use purpose;

heading: Water use purposes
paragraph: "waterworks purpose" means the carriage or supply of water by one person or entity for the use in British Columbia of another person or entity.

heading: Water Protection Act
paragraph:
3
		  Nothing in this Act authorizes a person to do anything prohibited by the Water Protection Act.

heading: Geothermal resources
paragraph: 4		  This Act does not apply to geothermal resources as defined in section 1 (1) [definitions] of the Geothermal Resources Act.

heading: Vesting water in government
paragraph: 5		  (1) The property in and the right to the use and flow of all the water at any time in a stream in British Columbia are for all purposes vested in the government, except insofar as private rights have been established under authorizations.

heading: Vesting water in government
paragraph: (2) The property in and the right to the use, percolation and flow of groundwater, wherever groundwater is found in British Columbia, are for all purposes vested in the government and are conclusively deemed to have always been vested in the government except insofar as private rights have been

heading: Vesting water in government
paragraph: (a) established under authorizations, or

heading: Vesting water in government
paragraph: (b) deemed under section 22 (8) [precedence of rights].

heading: Vesting water in government
paragraph: (3) No right to divert or use water may be acquired by prescription.

heading: Use of water
paragraph:
6
		  (1) Subject to this section, a person must not divert water from a stream or an aquifer, or use water diverted from a stream or an aquifer by the person, unless

heading: Use of water
paragraph: (a) the person holds an authorization authorizing the diversion or use, or

heading: Use of water
paragraph: (b) the diversion or use is authorized under the regulations.

heading: Use of water
paragraph: (2) A person is not prohibited from

heading: Use of water
paragraph: (a) diverting or storing and beneficially using water from a stream or an aquifer for extinguishing a fire, but if flow is diverted from a stream channel for that use, the flow must promptly be restored to that stream channel when the fire is extinguished, or

heading: Use of water
paragraph: (b) diverting water to test the quality or quantity of water or to conduct a flow test.

heading: Use of water
paragraph: (3) Unless regulations under section 135 (5) [regulations closing or restricting access to water source] provide otherwise, a person is not prohibited from diverting, in accordance with any applicable regulations, and beneficially using unrecorded water

heading: Use of water
paragraph: (a) from a stream for domestic purpose or for prospecting for a mineral, or

heading: Use of water
paragraph: (b) from an aquifer for prospecting for a mineral.

heading: Use of water
paragraph: (4) A person may, in accordance with the regulations, divert, and beneficially use, including store, groundwater from an aquifer for domestic purpose unless

heading: Use of water
paragraph: (a) provided otherwise by regulations under section 135 (6), or

heading: Use of water
paragraph: (b) this subsection does not apply to the applicable aquifer by regulations under section 136 [regulations requiring authorizations for domestic use of groundwater].

heading: Rights acquired under authorizations
paragraph:
7
		  (1) A licence entitles its holder to do the following in a manner provided in the licence:

heading: Rights acquired under authorizations
paragraph: (a) divert and beneficially use the quantity of water specified in the licence;

heading: Rights acquired under authorizations
paragraph: (b) construct, maintain and operate the works authorized by the licence and related works necessarily required for the proper diversion or use of the water or the power produced from the water;

heading: Rights acquired under authorizations
paragraph: (c) make changes in and about a stream necessary for the construction, maintenance or operation of the works referred to in paragraph (b) or to otherwise facilitate the authorized diversion;

heading: Rights acquired under authorizations
paragraph: (d) construct fences, screens and fish or game guards across streams for the purpose of conserving fish or wildlife.

heading: Rights acquired under authorizations
paragraph: (2) A use approval entitles its holder to do anything described in subsection (1) for the period or at the times and in the manner specified in the use approval.

heading: Rights and permissions subject to Act
paragraph:
8
		  (1) The exercise of a right held under an authorization is subject to this Act and the regulations, the terms and conditions of the authorization, the orders of the comptroller, a water manager or an engineer and the rights of all authorization holders whose rights have precedence.

heading: Rights and permissions subject to Act
paragraph: (2) The exercise of permission given under a change approval is subject to this Act and the regulations, the terms and conditions of the change approval, the orders of the comptroller, a water manager or an engineer, the rights of authorization holders and the rights of holders of change approvals issued before the date of the change approval.

heading: Rights and permissions subject to Act
paragraph: (3) The exercise of permission given under a permit is subject to this Act and the regulations, the terms and conditions of the permit and the orders of the comptroller, a water manager or an engineer.

heading: Rights and permissions subject to Act
paragraph: (4) The exercise of permission given under a drilling authorization is subject to this Act and the regulations, the terms and conditions of the drilling authorization and the orders of the comptroller, a water manager or an engineer.

heading: Licences
paragraph:
9
		  On application in accordance with section 12 [application and decision maker initiative procedures], the comptroller or a water manager may issue a licence, authorizing the diversion or use of water for one or more water use purposes, to any of the following:

heading: Licences
paragraph: (a) an owner of land or a mine;

heading: Licences
paragraph: (b) a holder of a certificate of public convenience and necessity issued under the Public Utilities Act, R.S.B.C. 1960, c. 323, the Utilities Commission Act or the Water Utility Act;

heading: Licences
paragraph: (c) a municipality, regional district, improvement district, development district or water users' community;

heading: Licences
paragraph: (d) the government of British Columbia or Canada;

heading: Licences
paragraph: (e) a commission, board or person having charge of the administration of Crown land or a mine or an undertaking on Crown land, administered by British Columbia or Canada or controlled by a ministry, department, branch or other subdivision of the government of British Columbia or Canada;

heading: Licences
paragraph: (f) the Greater Vancouver Water District or any other water district incorporated by an Act;

heading: Licences
paragraph: (g) the British Columbia Hydro and Power Authority.

heading: Use approvals
paragraph: 10		  (1) On application in accordance with section 12 [application and decision maker initiative procedures], the comptroller or a water manager may issue an approval for one or more water use purposes authorizing any of the following to divert or use water from a stream or an aquifer for a term not exceeding 24 months:

heading: Use approvals
paragraph: (a) the government of British Columbia or Canada;

heading: Use approvals
paragraph: (b) another person.

heading: Use approvals
paragraph: (2) A use approval under this section must not authorize

heading: Use approvals
paragraph: (a) the diversion or use of more than the prescribed quantity of water,

heading: Use approvals
paragraph: (b) the diversion or use of water for a prescribed water use purpose, or

heading: Use approvals
paragraph: (c) the construction, maintenance or use of prescribed works.

heading: Use approvals
paragraph: (3) For certainty, a use approval may be issued authorizing a person to divert water from a source of water supply for a water use purpose in relation to an appurtenancy, if any, specified in the use approval, whether or not a use approval was previously issued authorizing the person to divert water from the same water source supply for the same water use purpose in relation to the same appurtenancy.

heading: Changes in and about a stream
paragraph:
11
		  (1) On application in accordance with section 12, the comptroller, a water manager or an engineer may issue an approval authorizing any of the following persons to make changes in and about a stream:

heading: Changes in and about a stream
paragraph: (a) the government of British Columbia or Canada;

heading: Changes in and about a stream
paragraph: (b) another person.

heading: Changes in and about a stream
paragraph: (2) Changes in and about a stream may only be made in accordance with

heading: Changes in and about a stream
paragraph: (a) the terms and conditions of a change approval,

heading: Changes in and about a stream
paragraph: (b) the regulations,

heading: Changes in and about a stream
paragraph: (c) the terms and conditions of an authorization, or

heading: Changes in and about a stream
paragraph: (d) an order.

heading: Application and decision maker initiative procedures
paragraph:
12
		  (1) An applicant may apply to a decision maker by

heading: Application and decision maker initiative procedures
paragraph: (a) complying with any requirements prescribed in respect of the application, and

heading: Application and decision maker initiative procedures
paragraph: (b) within the period, if any, prescribed by regulation,

heading: Application and decision maker initiative procedures
paragraph: (i)  complying with the decision maker's directions under section 13 (1) or (9), if any,

heading: Application and decision maker initiative procedures
paragraph: (ii)  paying the prescribed fees,

heading: Application and decision maker initiative procedures
paragraph: (iii)  providing in the form and manner specified by the decision maker any plans, specifications, reports of assessments and other information the decision maker requests, which information may include, but is not limited to, public personal information that is relevant to the application, respecting

heading: Application and decision maker initiative procedures
paragraph: (A) the applicant,

heading: Application and decision maker initiative procedures
paragraph: (B) existing water users, riparian owners, other applicants and other authorization holders, whose rights are likely to be detrimentally affected if the application is granted, and

heading: Application and decision maker initiative procedures
paragraph: (C) land owners whose land is likely to be physically affected if the application is granted, and

heading: Application and decision maker initiative procedures
paragraph: (iv)  providing in the form and manner specified by the decision maker the consents that are necessary for the decision maker to verify personal information relating to the applicant that is provided under subparagraph (iii).

heading: Application and decision maker initiative procedures
paragraph: (2) For the purposes of subsection (1) (b) (iii), the decision maker may require that a specified assessment be performed, and a report of the assessment be prepared, by a person with the qualifications specified by the decision maker.

heading: Application and decision maker initiative procedures
paragraph: (3) For the purpose of making a decision on an application, the decision maker may

heading: Application and decision maker initiative procedures
paragraph: (a) collect contact information from the applicant, and collect public personal information and government water records, related to a person referred to in subsection (1) (b) (iii), and

heading: Application and decision maker initiative procedures
paragraph: (b) verify information collected under this subsection or provided under subsection (1) or (2), including, in relation to

heading: Application and decision maker initiative procedures
paragraph: (i)  personal information of the applicant, by consent or by reference to public personal information or government water records, and

heading: Application and decision maker initiative procedures
paragraph: (ii)  personal information of a person referred to in subsection (1) (b) (iii) (B) or (C), by direct contact with the person or by reference to public personal information or government water records.

heading: Application and decision maker initiative procedures
paragraph: (4) If works are required to be constructed in order for the applicant to obtain information required for the purposes of subsection (1) (b) (iii), the applicant may construct, in accordance with any applicable regulations, the works for that purpose, subject to any applicable requirement for a drilling authorization in relation to the works.

heading: Application and decision maker initiative procedures
paragraph: (5) The decision maker may

heading: Application and decision maker initiative procedures
paragraph: (a) shorten or extend the period prescribed for the purposes of subsection (1) (b), or

heading: Application and decision maker initiative procedures
paragraph: (b) if no period has been prescribed, set a period for compliance with a direction or request, if any, referred to in subsection (1) (b).

heading: Application and decision maker initiative procedures
paragraph: (6) A decision maker may exercise the powers under this section in relation to an initiative of the decision maker under section 21 [when final licence may be issued], 26 [amendment or substitution of authorization, change approval or permit], 28 [apportionment of rights under licences] or 62 [drilling authorizations].

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph:
13
		  (1) A decision maker must direct that an applicant for a licence, use approval or change approval, or for an amendment to any of them involving a change of works, give notice of the application in accordance with section 117 [delivery and publication of documents and information] or the regulations to

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (a) any of the following whose rights the decision maker considers are likely to be detrimentally affected if the application is granted:

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (i)  an authorization holder;

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (ii)  a change approval holder;

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (iii)  an applicant for an authorization or change approval;

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (iv)  a riparian owner, and

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (b) a land owner whose land is likely to be physically affected if the application is granted.

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (2) A notice under subsection (1) must include the name of the decision maker and the address to which objections to the application may be delivered.

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (3) A person who is given notice under subsection (1) may deliver to the decision maker identified in the notice within the prescribed period any objection the person has to the granting of the application.

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (4) If an objection is delivered in accordance with subsection (3), the decision maker must decide whether or not the objection warrants a hearing.

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (5) If the decision maker decides to hold a hearing, the decision maker must

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (a) give notice to the applicant and to any person who delivered an objection under subsection (3) of

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (i)  the date, time and location of the hearing, or

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (ii)  the date by which written submissions must be received by the decision maker, and

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (b) give the applicant and the objectors the opportunity to be heard in the hearing.

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (6) The decision maker may hold a hearing in writing, electronically or in person or by any combination of written, electronic or in-person hearings and, if the hearing is held orally, either in person or electronically, sections 95 [inquiry powers], 96 [maintenance of order at hearings] and 97 [contempt proceeding for uncooperative person] apply.

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (7) The decision maker must give notice of the decision maker's decision on an application to any person who delivered under subsection (3) an objection in relation to the application.

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (8) For certainty, a decision maker need not give directions under subsection (1) if the decision maker is satisfied that, as a result of the decision maker's decision on an application referred to in that subsection,

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (a) no authorization holder's rights, no change approval holder's rights and no riparian owner's rights will be detrimentally affected,

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (b) no person's land will be physically affected, and

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (c) no person's application for an authorization or a change approval will be detrimentally affected.

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (9) A decision maker may direct that any applicant, and in the case of a transfer under section 27 [transfer of appurtenancy], the transferee, give notice in accordance with section 117 or the regulations,

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (a) in the case of an apportionment under section 28 [apportionment of rights under licences], to the owner of each parcel affected by the apportionment,

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (b) in the case of an abandonment of rights under section 31 [abandonment of rights under an authorization], to anyone who is jointly using works with the applicant and any person whose land is physically affected by the existing works, and

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (c) in any case, to any person whose input into the decision the decision maker considers advisable.

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (10) Subsections (2) to (7) apply if notice is given under subsection (9) (a) or (b).

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (11) Despite subsection (10), if a decision maker gives, or requires to be given, notice under subsection (9), the decision maker may specify how, and the date by which, a person given notice may object to the application.

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (12) A person given notice under subsection (9) (c) is not entitled to be heard in a hearing under this section.

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (13) If a decision maker initiates the issuance of a final licence under section 21 [when final licence may be issued], a 30-year review under section 23, an amendment under section 26 [amendment or substitution of authorization, change approval or permit] or an apportionment under section 28, subsections (9) to (12) of this section apply unless the amendment requires a change of works, in which case subsections (1) to (8) and (14) of this section apply.

heading: Objections to applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (14) Instead of requiring the applicant or a transferee to give a notice required under subsection (1) or (9), the decision maker may give the notice.

heading: Powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph:
14
		  (1) Whether or not notice is given, or objections are delivered, under section 13 in relation to an application, the decision maker may, in accordance with this Act and the regulations,

heading: Powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (a) refuse the application,

heading: Powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (b) amend the application in any respect,

heading: Powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (c) grant all or part of the application,

heading: Powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (d) order the applicant to provide in the form and manner specified by the decision maker plans, specifications, reports of assessments or other information, which information may include, but is not limited to, public personal information that is relevant to the application, respecting

heading: Powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (i)  the applicant,

heading: Powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (ii)  existing water users, riparian owners, other applicants and other authorization holders, whose rights are likely to be detrimentally affected if the application is granted, and

heading: Powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (iii)  land owners whose land is likely to be physically affected if the application is granted,

heading: Powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (e) order the applicant to provide security to the decision maker in the amount the decision maker considers sufficient to ensure the performance of the applicant's obligations under this Act and the authorization, change approval or drilling authorization, as applicable, that is issued to the applicant, or

heading: Powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (f) issue to the applicant, subject to prescribed terms and conditions and on the terms and conditions the decision maker considers advisable,

heading: Powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (i)  one or more conditional licences or final licences, or

heading: Powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (ii)  a use approval, a change approval or a drilling authorization, as applicable.

heading: Powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (2) An applicant must comply with an order made under subsection (1) (d) or (e) within the period specified by the decision maker.

heading: Powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (3) For the purposes of subsection (1) (d), the decision maker may require that a specified assessment be performed, and a report of the assessment be prepared, by a person with the qualifications specified by the decision maker.

heading: Powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (4) If an application is for the purpose of diverting water from an aquifer, the decision maker must take into account the quantity of water persons to whom section 6 (4) [use of water - excluded groundwater users] applies are authorized to divert from the aquifer.

heading: Powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (5) In considering an application for a new licence that relates to the region as defined by the Columbia Basin Trust Act, the decision maker must consider the current long term Columbia Basin Management Plan under section 15 [Columbia Basin Management Plan] of that Act.

heading: Powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (6) Without limiting subsection (1), the decision maker may refuse an application, or reject an application without considering it, if

heading: Powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (a) the applicant fails to comply with

heading: Powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (i)  section 12 (1) [application and decision maker initiative procedures],

heading: Powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (ii)  a direction under section 13 (1) or (9),

heading: Powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (iii)  an order under subsection (1) (d) or (e) of this section, or

heading: Powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (iv)  an order or a direction referred to in this paragraph within the required period,

heading: Powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (b) in the case of an application for a use approval or change approval, the decision maker considers the proposed use of water or the proposed works would be more properly authorized by licence, or

heading: Powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (c) the application is incomplete.

heading: Powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (7) A decision maker must refuse to accept an application or a part of an application that would result in the issuance of an authorization to a person to whom section 6 (4) [use of water - excluded groundwater users] applies.

heading: Powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (8) A decision maker may not issue a licence authorizing the diversion or use of dedicated agricultural water unless the licence is for a qualifying agricultural use on qualifying agricultural land.

heading: Powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (9) Despite subsection (8), a licence may be issued authorizing the diversion or use of unrecorded dedicated agricultural water for domestic purpose or a land improvement purpose.

heading: Powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (10) A decision maker may exercise the powers under this section in relation to an initiative of the decision maker under section 21 [when final licence may be issued], 26 [amendment or substitution of authorization, change approval or permit], 28 [apportionment of rights under licences] or 62 [drilling authorizations].

heading: Powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives
paragraph: (11) For certainty, a use approval may be issued authorizing the diversion or use of unrecorded dedicated agricultural water for any water use purpose on any land.

heading: Environmental flow needs
paragraph: 15		  (1) Except in relation to an application exempted under the regulations, the decision maker must consider the environmental flow needs of a stream in deciding an application in relation to the stream or an aquifer the decision maker considers is reasonably likely to be hydraulically connected to that stream.

heading: Environmental flow needs
paragraph: (2) For an application in respect of which the decision maker must consider, or decides under subsection (4) to consider, the environmental flow needs of a stream,

heading: Environmental flow needs
paragraph: (a) the applicant must provide to the decision maker the information and reports of assessments the decision maker directs for the purposes of paragraph (b) of this subsection, and

heading: Environmental flow needs
paragraph: (b) the decision maker must determine, in accordance with any applicable regulations, the environmental flow needs of the applicable stream.

heading: Environmental flow needs
paragraph: (3) For the purposes of subsection (2) (a), the decision maker may require that a specified assessment be performed, and a report of the assessment be prepared, by a person with the qualifications specified by the decision maker.

heading: Environmental flow needs
paragraph: (4) Despite subsection (1), a decision maker may take into account the environmental flow needs of any stream the decision maker considers may be affected by granting the application.

heading: Mitigation measures
paragraph:
16
		  (1) If the decision maker considers that the diversion and use of water, or changes in and about a stream, proposed by an application for an authorization, or the changes in and about a stream proposed to be made under a change approval, are likely to have a significant adverse impact on the water quality, water quantity or aquatic ecosystem of a stream or aquifer, a stream channel or other uses of water from the stream or aquifer to which the application relates, the decision maker may

heading: Mitigation measures
paragraph: (a) require that the applicant submit a proposal for mitigation measures to address those effects, which mitigation measures must meet prescribed criteria, if any, and

heading: Mitigation measures
paragraph: (b) impose under section 14 (1) (f) [powers respecting applications and decision maker initiatives] terms and conditions requiring implementation of the proposed mitigation measures if those measures meet the prescribed criteria.

heading: Mitigation measures
paragraph: (2) If the decision maker considers that the effects described in subsection (1) cannot be addressed, or cannot be fully addressed, by mitigation measures proposed by the applicant but can be compensated for by other mitigation measures taken on a different part of the stream or aquifer than the part to which the proposal relates, the decision maker may impose under section 14 (1) (f) terms and conditions requiring the applicant to take compensatory mitigation measures that meet the prescribed criteria, in place of or supplemental to any mitigation measures proposed by the applicant, on a different part of the stream or aquifer to which the application relates.

heading: Mitigation measures
paragraph: (3) With the consent of the applicant, the terms and conditions of an authorization or change approval may require that the applicant take compensatory mitigation measures on a different stream or aquifer than the stream or aquifer in respect of which the application is made.

heading: Sensitive streams mitigation
paragraph:
17
		  (1) If an application for an authorization or a change approval, or an amendment to an authorization or change approval, is in relation to a sensitive stream, the decision maker

heading: Sensitive streams mitigation
paragraph: (a) may require that the applicant provide the prescribed plans, specifications, reports of assessments or other information, in addition to the other information required under this Act in relation to the application, and

heading: Sensitive streams mitigation
paragraph: (b) must apply prescribed criteria, if any, in addition to the other criteria to be applied under this Act, in deciding whether to grant the application.

heading: Sensitive streams mitigation
paragraph: (2) An application described in subsection (1) must include mitigation measures that meet the prescribed criteria, if any, and that the applicant proposes to take to mitigate any adverse impact on a protected fish population resulting from granting the application in relation to the sensitive stream.

heading: Sensitive streams mitigation
paragraph: (3) The decision maker may grant an application described in subsection (1) only

heading: Sensitive streams mitigation
paragraph: (a) if satisfied that

heading: Sensitive streams mitigation
paragraph: (i)  any adverse impact, resulting from granting the application, on the sustainability of any protected fish population of the sensitive stream is likely to be insignificant,

heading: Sensitive streams mitigation
paragraph: (ii)  the mitigation measures proposed by the applicant, if carried out, would ensure that granting the application is not likely to cause a significant adverse impact on any protected fish population or the aquatic ecosystem of the sensitive stream, or

heading: Sensitive streams mitigation
paragraph: (iii)  compensatory mitigation measures that meet any prescribed criteria, whether or not proposed by the applicant, if carried out, in place of or supplemental to the proposed mitigation measures, will enhance or enable the enhancement of an aquatic ecosystem elsewhere that will fully compensate for the significant adverse impact on that protected fish population or aquatic ecosystem resulting from granting the application, and

heading: Sensitive streams mitigation
paragraph: (b) if, in the circumstances described in paragraph (a) (ii), the decision maker imposes implementation of the mitigation measures, and in the circumstances described in paragraph (a) (iii), the decision maker imposes implementation of the compensatory mitigation measures, as terms and conditions of the authorization or change approval or amended authorization or change approval, as applicable.

heading: Sensitive streams mitigation
paragraph: (4) If the decision maker considers that there is a reasonable alternative source of water reasonably available to an applicant making an application referred to in subsection (1), the decision maker may refuse to grant the application.

heading: Licences for power purposes
paragraph:
19
		  (1) In this section:

heading: Licences for power purposes
paragraph: "operational term" means the period beginning when

heading: Licences for power purposes
paragraph: (a) the activities described in the definition of "project development term" are completed, or

heading: Licences for power purposes
paragraph: (b) the period authorized for completion of those activities has ended,

heading: Licences for power purposes
paragraph: whichever occurs earlier, during which power is, or is authorized to be, produced under a licence issued for a power purpose and during which a storage purpose authorized by a licence in relation to the power purpose may be exercised;

heading: Licences for power purposes
paragraph: "project development term" means the period, following the issue of a licence for a power purpose but before the beginning of the operational term, during which activities required to prepare for power production under the licence are performed, including, without limitation, project design and engineering, securing construction and other contracts and constructing works.

heading: Licences for power purposes
paragraph: (2) This section applies to

heading: Licences for power purposes
paragraph: (a) a licence issued for a power purpose on or after October 23, 2003, unless the licence is being issued in substitution for a licence that did not specify the term of the licence and was issued for a power purpose before that date,

heading: Licences for power purposes
paragraph: (b) a licence that is being amended, whether or not the licence is replaced, if

heading: Licences for power purposes
paragraph: (i)  the licence was issued for a power purpose before October 23, 2003 and specified the term of licence, and

heading: Licences for power purposes
paragraph: (ii)  the amendment is for the purpose of extending the term of the licence, or

heading: Licences for power purposes
paragraph: (c) a licence that is being amended, whether or not the licence is replaced, if

heading: Licences for power purposes
paragraph: (i)  the licence was issued for a purpose other than a power purpose, and

heading: Licences for power purposes
paragraph: (ii)  the amendment is for the purpose of authorizing the use of water for a power purpose.

heading: Licences for power purposes
paragraph: (3) The decision maker must not issue a licence to which this section applies that has an operational term longer than 40 years.

heading: Licences for power purposes
paragraph: (4) The decision maker may provide in a licence described in subsection (2) (a) or (c) for a project development term of up to 10 years.

heading: Licences for power purposes
paragraph: (5) The holder of a licence issued to authorize the use of water for a power purpose may apply to renew the licence before the expiry of the operational term of that licence.

heading: Licences for power purposes
paragraph: (6) Despite section 26 [amendment or substitution of authorization, change approval or permit], this Act and the regulations apply to the following applications as if the application were for a new licence:

heading: Licences for power purposes
paragraph: (a) an application for an amendment referred to in subsection (2) (b) (ii);

heading: Licences for power purposes
paragraph: (b) an application for an amendment referred to in subsection (2) (c) (ii);

heading: Licences for power purposes
paragraph: (c) an application to extend the term of a licence to which this section applies.

heading: Licences for power purposes
paragraph: (7) The rights exercisable under a licence to which this section applies that is issued in substitution for or as a renewal of another licence have precedence from the same date as the rights under the licence that is replaced.

heading: Licences for power purposes
paragraph: (8) Despite subsection (3), if an application is made under subsection (5), the licence does not expire until the later of

heading: Licences for power purposes
paragraph: (a) the date the decision maker decides on the application, and

heading: Licences for power purposes
paragraph: (b) the expiry date of the operational term of the licence.

heading: Licences for power purposes
paragraph: (9) If a licensee fails to apply to renew a licence to which this section applies before the expiry of the operational term of the licence and the failure, in the opinion of the decision maker, is not the fault of the licensee, the decision maker may extend the expiry date for not more than 6 months from the original expiry date and, if the expiry date is extended, the licence is deemed to be and to have been continuously in force from the date of issue until the new expiry date.

heading: Licences for power purposes
paragraph: (10) Subsection (9) does not apply to a licence for which the expiry date has been extended under that subsection.

heading: Licences for power purposes
paragraph: (11) A decision under subsection (9) of this section to refuse to extend an expiry date is final and may not be appealed to the appeal board.

heading: Purpose, precedence and appurtenancy
paragraph:
20
		  (1) A decision maker must ensure that a licence that the decision maker issues specifies as the appurtenancy of the licence an appurtenancy

heading: Purpose, precedence and appurtenancy
paragraph: (a) that, except in relation to a licence that is required to be registered under the Water Protection Act, is located entirely in British Columbia,

heading: Purpose, precedence and appurtenancy
paragraph: (b) that consists of land, a mine or an undertaking, or any combination of those things, and

heading: Purpose, precedence and appurtenancy
paragraph: (c) that is adequately described in the licence.

heading: Purpose, precedence and appurtenancy
paragraph: (2) A decision maker who issues a use approval, change approval, permit or drilling authorization may specify an appurtenancy that meets the requirements of subsection (1) as the appurtenancy of the use approval, change approval, permit or drilling authorization, as applicable.

heading: Purpose, precedence and appurtenancy
paragraph: (3) The decision maker must ensure that every authorization that the decision maker issues

heading: Purpose, precedence and appurtenancy
paragraph: (a) specifies the date of precedence of the rights under the authorization,

heading: Purpose, precedence and appurtenancy
paragraph: (b) specifies the maximum quantity of water that may be diverted and used for each water use purpose authorized by the authorization, and

heading: Purpose, precedence and appurtenancy
paragraph: (c) is for the diversion of water for one or more water use purposes and those water use purposes are specified in the authorization.

heading: When final licence may be issued
paragraph: 21		  (1) On application under section 12 [application and decision maker initiative procedures], or on the comptroller's or water manager's own initiative, the comptroller or a water manager may issue to the holder of a conditional licence a final licence authorizing the diversion or use of the quantity of water that the decision maker determines to have been beneficially used for the water uses purposes authorized under, and during the term of, the conditional licence, when

heading: When final licence may be issued
paragraph: (a) the licensee completes the works, or

heading: When final licence may be issued
paragraph: (b) the period for completing the works expires and, if any works have not been completed, the decision maker determines that the works that have not been completed are not required.

heading: When final licence may be issued
paragraph: (2) On the issue of a final licence, the conditional licence it replaces has no further effect.

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph:
22
		  (1) The rights exercisable under an authorization that authorizes the diversion of water from a stream have precedence in relation to the rights of other authorization holders who divert water from

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (a) the stream,

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (b) a tributary of the stream, or

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (c) an aquifer the decision maker considers is reasonably likely to be hydraulically connected to that stream

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: according to the dates set out in the authorizations as the dates from which the rights take precedence.

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (2) The rights exercisable under authorizations described in subsection (1) that have precedence from the same date have precedence in accordance with the ranking under subsection (7) of the water use purposes in respect of which the authorizations are issued.

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (3) The rights exercisable under authorizations described in subsection (1) have equal precedence if the rights have precedence from the same date and are for the same water use purpose.

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (4) The rights exercisable under an authorization that authorizes the diversion of water from an aquifer have precedence in relation to the rights of other authorization holders who divert water from the aquifer, or another aquifer the decision maker considers is reasonably likely to be hydraulically connected to that aquifer, according to the date set out in the authorization as the date from which the rights take precedence.

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (5) The rights exercisable under authorizations described in subsection (4) that have precedence from the same date have precedence in accordance with the ranking under subsection (7) of the water use purposes in respect of which the authorizations are issued.

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (6) The rights exercisable under authorizations described in subsection (4) have equal precedence if the rights have precedence from the same date and are for the same water use purpose.

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (7) For the purposes of subsections (2) and (5), water use purposes are ranked, from highest to lowest as follows:

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (a) domestic;

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (b) waterworks;

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (c) irrigation;

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (d) mineralized water;

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (e) mining;

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (f) industrial;

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (g) oil and gas;

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (h) power;

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (i) storage;

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (j) conservation;

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (k) land improvement.

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (8) Despite subsections (1) to (6), a person to whom section 6 (4) [use of water - excluded groundwater users] applies is deemed to have rights that have precedence under those subsections, as if the deemed rights were granted under an authorization that

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (a) sets out as the date of precedence the date of first use of the water, and

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (b) authorizes the use of the greater of

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (i)  2 000 litres of water per day for each private dwelling on a parcel, or

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (ii)  the amount of water the engineer is satisfied the person has been using for domestic purposes.

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (9) Despite subsections (1) to (8), if an order under section 86 (1) or (3) [declarations of significant water shortage] applies to a stream and the comptroller has determined the critical environmental flow threshold for the stream under section 87 (1) [critical environmental flow protection orders], the amount of that critical environmental flow threshold for the stream has precedence over the rights

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (a) under any authorization issued in relation to the stream or a hydraulically connected aquifer referred to in subsection (1) of this section, or

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (b) of a person described in subsection (8) of this section.

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (10) Despite subsections (1) to (9), if an engineer is taking action to enforce the precedence of rights to divert or use water from a stream or aquifer, a person must not be prohibited from diverting water from the stream or aquifer for essential household use.

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (11) For the purposes of this section, "essential household use" means the use by the occupants of one private dwelling of not more than 250 litres of water per day for

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (a) drinking water, food preparation and sanitation, and

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (b) providing water to animals or poultry that are kept

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (i)  for household use, or

heading: Precedence of rights
paragraph: (ii)  as pets.

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph:
23
		  (1) This section applies to a licence that

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (a) was issued on or before the date this section comes into force for an unlimited period or that has, at that date, at least 30 years remaining in its term, or

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (b) is issued after the date this section comes into force for an unlimited period or a term exceeding 30 years,

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph: but does not apply to licences

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (c) issued for a power purpose, or a storage purpose related to a power purpose, on or after October 23, 2003,

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (d) issued under the Industrial Development Act, or

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (e) issued following a review, or reviewed, under the Water Use Plan directives published by the government and dated December 1998.

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (2) On the direction in writing of the comptroller or a water manager, a licensee who holds a licence to which this section applies must submit to a review of the terms and conditions of the licence,

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (a) for a licence issued on or before the date this section comes into force, any time that is at least 30 years after that date, and any time that is at least 30 years after the immediately preceding review under this section, and

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (b) for a licence issued after the date this section comes into force, any time after the licence has been in effect for 30 years after its issue and any time that is at least 30 years after the immediately preceding review under this section.

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (3) A licensee who is given a direction under subsection (2) must, within the period specified in the direction, provide to the decision maker who gave the direction,

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (a) the information, plans, specifications and reports of assessments, including a water conservation audit carried out in accordance with and meeting the requirements of the regulations, specified by the decision maker, and

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (b) in the form and manner specified by the decision maker, the consents that are necessary for the decision maker to verify information provided under paragraph (a).

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (4) The decision maker may require that a specified assessment be performed, and a report of the assessment be prepared, by a person with the qualifications specified by the decision maker.

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (5) Section 12 (1) (b) (iii), (2) and (3) applies for the purpose of a review under this section.

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (6) The decision maker may review the terms and conditions of a licence taking into account

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (a) the best available technology in respect of water use efficiency and water conservation,

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (b) best practices in respect of water use efficiency and water conservation,

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (c) any increase in knowledge respecting actual stream flow or aquifer conditions,

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (d) the effects of climate change,

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (e) the licensee's beneficial use of the water,

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (f) the use, operation or maintenance of works, and

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (g) prescribed factors.

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (7) On a review under this section, the decision maker may amend the terms and conditions of the licence to require the licensee, for the more efficient use or conservation of water, to

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (a) reduce the maximum rate of diversion of water under the licence,

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (b) alter the time of diversion or use, including storage, of water under the licence,

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (c) construct, alter, install, replace, repair, maintain, improve, seal, deactivate, decommission or remove any works, or

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (d) adopt a more efficient practice.

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (8) If the decision maker considers that the changes under this section in terms and conditions of a licence would substantially change the licence, the decision maker may substitute a new licence and the rights under the licence issued in substitution have the same precedence as the rights had under the replaced licence.

heading: Thirty-year review of licence terms and conditions
paragraph: (9) A direction given under subsection (2) is final and may not be appealed to the appeal board.

heading: Permits over Crown land
paragraph: 24		  (1) The comptroller or a water manager in the case of an authorization, or the comptroller, a water manager or an engineer in the case of a change approval or drilling authorization, may, on compliance by the holder of the authorization, change approval or drilling authorization with the regulations, issue to that holder one or more permits authorizing the flooding of Crown land or the construction, maintenance or operation on Crown land of works authorized under the authorization, change approval or drilling authorization.

heading: Permits over Crown land
paragraph: (2) A person must not, for the purposes of exercising rights or performing duties under an authorization, change approval or drilling authorization, construct, maintain or operate works on, or flood, Crown land unless the person

heading: Permits over Crown land
paragraph: (a) holds a permit under this section, or

heading: Permits over Crown land
paragraph: (b) has authority to do so under another enactment.

heading: Transfer of authorization, change approval or permit
paragraph:
25
		  (1) An authorization, change approval or permit that is made appurtenant to any land, mine or undertaking, and the rights granted and duties imposed under the authorization, change approval or permit, pass with a conveyance or other disposition of the land, mine or undertaking.

heading: Transfer of authorization, change approval or permit
paragraph: (2) An owner conveying or otherwise disposing of land, a mine or an undertaking, to which an authorization, change approval or permit is appurtenant, must give written notice of the conveyance or other disposition to the comptroller or a water manager before completing the disposition.

heading: Transfer of authorization, change approval or permit
paragraph: (3) In the case of a transmission or other disposition of land, a mine or an undertaking to which an authorization, change approval or permit is appurtenant to the personal representative or other person representing the owner of the land, mine or undertaking, the personal representative or other person must give to the comptroller or a water manager written notice

heading: Transfer of authorization, change approval or permit
paragraph: (a) as soon as practicable after the transmission or disposition to the personal representative or other person, and

heading: Transfer of authorization, change approval or permit
paragraph: (b) before completing a disposition by the personal representative or other person of the land, mine or undertaking to another person.

heading: Amendment or substitution of authorization, change approval or permit
paragraph:
26
		  (1) On application by the holder in accordance with section 12 [application and decision maker initiative procedures], or on the comptroller's or water manager's own initiative, the comptroller or a water manager may amend an authorization and a permit issued in relation to the authorization, and the comptroller, a water manager or an engineer may amend a change approval and a permit issued in relation to the change approval, to do any of the following:

heading: Amendment or substitution of authorization, change approval or permit
paragraph: (a) extend the time set for beginning construction of works;

heading: Amendment or substitution of authorization, change approval or permit
paragraph: (b) extend the time set for completion of works;

heading: Amendment or substitution of authorization, change approval or permit
paragraph: (c) extend the time set for making beneficial use of water;

heading: Amendment or substitution of authorization, change approval or permit
paragraph: (d) authorize additional or other works than those previously authorized;

heading: Amendment or substitution of authorization, change approval or permit
paragraph: (e) correct an error in the authorization, change approval or related permit;

heading: Amendment or substitution of authorization, change approval or permit
paragraph: (f) remove a provision of the authorization, change approval or related permit that is inconsistent with this Act;

heading: Amendment or substitution of authorization, change approval or permit
paragraph: (g) authorize the use of water for a water use purpose other than a water use purpose specified in the authorization;

heading: Amendment or substitution of authorization, change approval or permit
paragraph: (h) extend the term of the authorization, change approval or related permit;

heading: Amendment or substitution of authorization, change approval or permit
paragraph: (i) increase or reduce the quantity of water authorized to be diverted if it appears to have been erroneously estimated.

heading: Amendment or substitution of authorization, change approval or permit
paragraph: (2) A decision maker who amends an authorization or a change approval, or a permit related to either, may substitute a new authorization, change approval or related permit, as applicable, with the same precedence as the original authorization, change approval or permit, or the original authorization, change approval or permit as modified, as applicable, subject to prescribed terms and conditions and on the terms and conditions that decision maker considers advisable.

heading: Amendment or substitution of authorization, change approval or permit
paragraph: (3) On application, the comptroller or a water manager may amend an authorization and a permit issued in relation to the authorization, and the comptroller, a water manager or an engineer may amend a change approval and a permit issued in relation to the change approval, to make an amendment not referred to in subsection (1), other than an amendment that would increase the quantity of water authorized to be diverted.

heading: Amendment or substitution of authorization, change approval or permit
paragraph: (4) The decision maker under subsection (3), with the written consent of the holder of the authorization, may substitute a new authorization or permit subject to prescribed terms and conditions and on the terms and conditions the decision maker considers advisable.

heading: Amendment or substitution of authorization, change approval or permit
paragraph: (5) Despite subsection (1) (g), a decision maker may not

heading: Amendment or substitution of authorization, change approval or permit
paragraph: (a) authorize a change in water use purpose for dedicated agricultural water except to another qualifying agricultural use, or

heading: Amendment or substitution of authorization, change approval or permit
paragraph: (b) issue a licence to a person to whom section 6 (4) [use of water - excluded groundwater users] applies.

heading: Amendment or substitution of authorization, change approval or permit
paragraph: (6) If an application is made under subsection (1) (h) to extend the term of an authorization, change approval or permit before the date the authorization, change approval or permit expires, the authorization or change approval, as applicable, and any permit issued in relation to either, does not expire until the later of

heading: Amendment or substitution of authorization, change approval or permit
paragraph: (a) the date the decision maker decides on the application, and

heading: Amendment or substitution of authorization, change approval or permit
paragraph: (b) the expiry date of the authorization, change approval or permit, as applicable.

heading: Amendment or substitution of authorization, change approval or permit
paragraph: (7) Despite subsection (1) (h), a decision maker may not amend a use approval to extend the term beyond 24 months from the date the use approval was issued.

heading: Transfer of appurtenancy
paragraph:
27
		  (1) On application by the holder in accordance with section 12 [application and decision maker initiative procedures], the comptroller or a water manager in relation to an authorization and a permit issued in relation to the authorization, and the comptroller, a water manager or an engineer in relation to a change approval and a permit issued in relation to the change approval, subject to prescribed terms and conditions and on the terms and conditions the decision maker considers advisable, may issue one or more new authorizations or change approvals, as applicable, and related permits

heading: Transfer of appurtenancy
paragraph: (a) to a person who is the owner of land, a mine or an undertaking and to whom the holder is transferring some or all of the rights granted and duties imposed under the authorization or change approval and related permit, determining as the appurtenancy for the rights and duties transferred the land, mine or undertaking of the transferee, or

heading: Transfer of appurtenancy
paragraph: (b) to the holder, determining as the appurtenancy for some or all of the rights granted and duties imposed under the authorization or change approval and related permit land, a mine or an undertaking of that holder.

heading: Transfer of appurtenancy
paragraph: (2) An authorization, change approval or permit issued under subsection (1) (a) or (b) has the same precedence as the original authorization, change approval or permit, or the original authorization, change approval or permit, as modified, as applicable.

heading: Transfer of appurtenancy
paragraph: (3) Except in relation to a licence required to be registered under the Water Protection Act, a decision maker must not exercise the decision maker's discretion under subsection (1) of this section to determine an appurtenancy that is not in British Columbia.

heading: Transfer of appurtenancy
paragraph: (4) If the land, mine or undertaking to which an authorization, change approval or permit is appurtenant is mortgaged, and a copy of the mortgage, or particulars of the mortgage, is filed with the comptroller or a water manager, a transfer of the appurtenancy of the authorization, change approval or permit, as applicable, is not effective without the written consent of the mortgagee.

heading: Transfer of appurtenancy
paragraph: (5) Despite subsection (1), the appurtenancy determined under subsection (1) for a licence issued in relation to dedicated agricultural water must be qualifying agricultural land.

heading: Apportionment of rights under licences
paragraph: 28		  (1) If the land to which a licence, or a permit issued in relation to the licence, is appurtenant consists of more than one parcel owned by different persons, on application by an owner of a parcel of that land in accordance with section 12 [application and decision maker initiative procedures], or on the comptroller's or water manager's own initiative, the comptroller or a water manager may apportion among the owners of the parcels the rights granted and duties imposed under the licence or permit.

heading: Apportionment of rights under licences
paragraph: (2) The decision maker may issue to an owner of land described in subsection (1), subject to prescribed terms and conditions and on the terms and conditions the decision maker considers advisable, one or more new licences and related permits in substitution for a licence or permit the rights and duties under which are apportioned under subsection (1).

heading: Apportionment of rights under licences
paragraph: (3) A licence or a permit issued under subsection (2) has the same precedence as the original licence or permit or the original licence or permit, as modified, as applicable.

heading: Rights and responsibilities of applicants and holders
paragraph:
29
		  (1) The following persons must exercise reasonable care to avoid damaging land, works, trees or other property of another person:

heading: Rights and responsibilities of applicants and holders
paragraph: (a) an applicant for an authorization, change approval, drilling authorization or permit;

heading: Rights and responsibilities of applicants and holders
paragraph: (b) the holder of an authorization, change approval, drilling authorization or permit;

heading: Rights and responsibilities of applicants and holders
paragraph: (c) a person who, in accordance with the regulations or an order of the comptroller, a water manager or an engineer, makes changes in and about a stream or diverts or uses, including stores, water.

heading: Rights and responsibilities of applicants and holders
paragraph: (2) A person referred to in subsection (1) (a), (b) or (c) must properly inspect, maintain and repair works constructed, operated or used by the person,

heading: Rights and responsibilities of applicants and holders
paragraph: (a) in accordance with any prescribed requirements,

heading: Rights and responsibilities of applicants and holders
paragraph: (b) in accordance with an order, and

heading: Rights and responsibilities of applicants and holders
paragraph: (c) in a manner that ensures that the works do not cause a significant risk of harm to public safety, the environment, land or other property.

heading: Rights and responsibilities of applicants and holders
paragraph: (3) When an authorization, change approval or permit that authorizes the construction or use of works is abandoned, cancelled or expires, the holder or former holder, as applicable, of the authorization, change approval or permit must ensure that the works are deactivated or decommissioned in accordance with the regulations and orders.

heading: Rights and responsibilities of applicants and holders
paragraph: (4) A person referred to in subsection (1) (a), (b) or (c) is liable to owners of land or premises for damage or loss resulting from the construction, maintenance, use, operation or failure of the person's works.

heading: Rights and responsibilities of applicants and holders
paragraph: (5) Subject to subsections (1) to (4), a holder of a licence for a power purpose, a storage purpose, a waterworks purpose or an irrigation purpose may fell and remove any tree, and remove any rock or other thing, that endangers the holder's works.

heading: Beneficial use
paragraph:
30
		  (1) A person who diverts water must make beneficial use of the water diverted.

heading: Beneficial use
paragraph: (2) A licensee must submit to the comptroller, a water manager or an engineer, as applicable, a signed declaration that complies with subsection (3) at the time directed to do this by the comptroller, water manager or engineer.

heading: Beneficial use
paragraph: (3) A declaration required under subsection (2) must

heading: Beneficial use
paragraph: (a) state whether the licensee has, during the 3 years preceding the date of the declaration,

heading: Beneficial use
paragraph: (i)  made beneficial use of the quantity of water authorized to be diverted under the licence, and

heading: Beneficial use
paragraph: (ii)  complied with all other terms and conditions of the licence,

heading: Beneficial use
paragraph: (b) include any other information, or consents required to verify the other information, required by the decision maker, and

heading: Beneficial use
paragraph: (c) be in the form required by the decision maker.

heading: Beneficial use
paragraph: (4) A direction under subsection (2) may require the licensee to provide with the beneficial use declaration the results of a water conservation audit carried out in accordance with and meeting the requirements of the regulations.

heading: Beneficial use
paragraph: (5) On receipt of a beneficial use declaration and, if required by the decision maker, the results of a water conservation audit, the decision maker may order the licensee to take measures to meet the level of efficiency of water use and conservation of water specified in the order.

heading: Beneficial use
