paragraph: (6) On the direction of the comptroller, a water manager or an engineer, each of the following persons must provide information, or consents required to verify the information, in the time specified, respecting the quantity of water the person has beneficially used in the period specified by the comptroller, water manager or engineer, as applicable:

heading: Beneficial use
paragraph: (a) the holder of a use approval;

heading: Beneficial use
paragraph: (b) a person who diverts, stores or uses water under the regulations;

heading: Beneficial use
paragraph: (c) a person who diverts, stores or uses water as described in section 6 (2) (b) [use of water - flow tests] or (3) [use of water - at sufferance] or as authorized by section 6 (4) [use of water - excluded groundwater users].

heading: Beneficial use
paragraph: (7) For the purpose of inquiring into or confirming beneficial use of water, the decision maker may

heading: Beneficial use
paragraph: (a) collect relevant public personal information or government water records related to a person referred to in subsection (2) or (6) or to the person's use of water, and

heading: Beneficial use
paragraph: (b) verify information collected under this subsection or provided under subsection (3) or (6), including, in relation to personal information, by consent or by reference to public personal information or government water records.

heading: Beneficial use
paragraph: (8) Subject to section 117 (4) [delivery and publication of documents and information], the comptroller may publish a beneficial use declaration or information provided under subsection (6).

heading: Beneficial use
paragraph: (9) A direction given under subsection (2) or (6) is final and may not be appealed to the appeal board.

heading: Abandonment of rights under an authorization
paragraph:
31
		  (1) On application in writing by the holder of an authorization, the comptroller or a water manager may approve the abandonment of all or part of the rights held under the authorization, subject to prescribed terms and conditions and on the terms and conditions the decision maker considers advisable, which terms and conditions may include, but are not limited to,

heading: Abandonment of rights under an authorization
paragraph: (a) requiring the repair, maintenance or removal of works or arrangements respecting responsibility for the repair, maintenance or removal of works with

heading: Abandonment of rights under an authorization
paragraph: (i)  other authorization holders who jointly use or used the works,

heading: Abandonment of rights under an authorization
paragraph: (ii)  previous authorization holders who jointly used the works, or

heading: Abandonment of rights under an authorization
paragraph: (iii)  the owner of land on which the works are located, or

heading: Abandonment of rights under an authorization
paragraph: (b) requiring deactivation or decommissioning of the works or arrangements respecting responsibility for deactivation or decommissioning of the works with one or more persons referred to in paragraph (a).

heading: Abandonment of rights under an authorization
paragraph: (2) If there is more than one registered owner of the land, or more than one owner of a mine or undertaking, to which an authorization is appurtenant, an application under subsection (1) must have attached to it the written consent of all registered owners of the land or all owners of the mine or undertaking, as applicable, to the abandonment of rights.

heading: Abandonment of rights under an authorization
paragraph: (3) If the land, mine or undertaking to which an authorization is appurtenant is mortgaged, and a copy of the mortgage, or particulars of the mortgage, is filed with the comptroller or a water manager, an application under subsection (1) must have attached to it the written consent of the mortgagee to the abandonment of rights.

heading: Abandonment of rights under an authorization
paragraph: (4) If some of the rights held under an authorization are abandoned, the decision maker may issue to the holder a new authorization in substitution with the same precedence as the original authorization, or the original authorization as modified, subject to prescribed terms and conditions and on the terms and conditions the decision maker considers advisable but the authorization holder does not, by the issue of a modified authorization obtain or retain a right that was the subject of the abandonment.

heading: Licensee's right to expropriate land
paragraph:
32
		  (1) A licensee has the right to expropriate any land reasonably required for the construction, maintenance, improvement or operation of works authorized or necessarily required under the licence.

heading: Licensee's right to expropriate land
paragraph: (2) In addition to the right under subsection (1), the holder of a licence that authorizes the diversion of water for domestic purpose or a waterworks purpose has the right to expropriate any land the control of which by the licensee would help prevent pollution of the water authorized to be diverted.

heading: Licensee's right to expropriate land
paragraph: (3) In addition to the rights under subsections (1) and (2), with the consent of the Lieutenant Governor in Council, the holder of a licence that authorizes the construction or use of a dam has the right to expropriate any land that has been flooded by construction of the dam or that would be flooded if the dam were constructed and utilized to the maximum height authorized.

heading: Licensee's right to expropriate land
paragraph: (4) An expropriation under this section must be made in accordance with the regulations and the licensee who expropriates the land must provide compensation to the owner of the land expropriated in the amount determined in accordance with the regulations.

heading: Licensee's right to expropriate land
paragraph: (5) If expropriation proceedings have been commenced by a licensee in relation to land on or in which works authorized under the licence are located, a person, including an owner of the land, must not interfere with the works or prevent the licensee from maintaining, operating, using or improving those works so long as the licensee diligently prosecutes the expropriation proceedings.

heading: Licensee's rights when owner refuses compensation
Licensee's rights when owner refuses compensation
paragraph: (a) an award of compensation is made in relation to land expropriated under section 32,

heading: Licensee's rights when owner refuses compensation
paragraph: (b) the amount of the award is tendered to the owner of the expropriated land, and

heading: Licensee's rights when owner refuses compensation
paragraph: (c) that owner fails to execute and deliver to the licensee the required conveyance or other instrument,

heading: Licensee's rights when owner refuses compensation
paragraph: the licensee is conclusively deemed to be the attorney of that owner for the purpose of executing the conveyance or instrument on that owner's behalf.

heading: Licensee's rights when owner refuses compensation
paragraph: (2) The registrar must register the licensee as owner of the land affected, or as holder of a charge on that land, as indicated in the award, if the licensee

heading: Licensee's rights when owner refuses compensation
paragraph: (a) pays the amount of compensation to the comptroller, or the part of that amount that is payable at the time, that has not been accepted by the owner,

heading: Licensee's rights when owner refuses compensation
paragraph: (b) files with the registrar

heading: Licensee's rights when owner refuses compensation
paragraph: (i)  the executed conveyance or instrument,

heading: Licensee's rights when owner refuses compensation
paragraph: (ii)  a copy of the award, and

heading: Licensee's rights when owner refuses compensation
paragraph: (iii)  a signed statement confirming the payment of the compensation to the comptroller and the failure of the owner to execute the conveyance or instrument, and

heading: Licensee's rights when owner refuses compensation
paragraph: (c) pays to the registrar the applicable fees under the Land Title Act.

heading: Owner to give notice before interfering with works
paragraph: 34		  Despite a right or title acquired or held under a statute or an indefeasible or absolute title held in relation to land, the owner of land or another person who proposes to alter, move, fill in, remove or otherwise interfere with works constructed or used under an authorization must, before doing so, give the holder of the authorization 180 days' written notice of the act or thing proposed to be done.

heading: Entry on land in case of urgency
paragraph:
35
		  (1) If the comptroller or a water manager considers that a delay in beginning the construction of authorized works, or works necessarily required for the proper diversion or use of water under a licence,

heading: Entry on land in case of urgency
paragraph: (a) would not be in the public interest, or

heading: Entry on land in case of urgency
paragraph: (b) would cause a hardship on the licensee,

heading: Entry on land in case of urgency
paragraph: the decision maker may authorize the licensee to enter on, occupy and use any land for constructing the works.

heading: Entry on land in case of urgency
paragraph: (2) The decision maker under subsection (1) may require, as a condition of the authority given, that the licensee provide security to the decision maker in the amount the decision maker considers sufficient to indemnify the owner of the land for any damage that owner might sustain by reason of the construction.

heading: Entry on land in case of urgency
paragraph: (3) On exercising an authority under subsection (1), the licensee must promptly take steps under section 32 [licensee's right to expropriate land] to expropriate the land required.

heading: Entry on land in case of urgency
paragraph: (4) A person, including the owner of the land, must not interfere with the construction of the works so long as the licensee diligently prosecutes the expropriation proceedings.

heading: Joint construction or use of works may be ordered
paragraph:
36
		  If satisfied that the joint use of works by 2 or more authorization holders would conserve water or avoid duplication of works, the comptroller or a water manager may order the joint construction or use by specified authorization holders of specified works and set the terms and conditions for the joint construction or use, including, without limitation, providing for construction, operation, maintenance, removal, replacement, deactivation or decommissioning of the works or compensation as among the users.

heading: Power to authorize extension of rights under licence
paragraph:
37
		  (1) Despite any other provision of this Act, if the comptroller or a water manager considers that no other water supply is reasonably available, the decision maker may authorize a licensee to use or supply some or all of the water authorized under the licence for any water use purposes on land, or for a mine or an undertaking, other than the land, mine or undertaking to which the licence is appurtenant, and may set the terms and conditions on which the water is to be used or supplied.

heading: Power to authorize extension of rights under licence
paragraph: (2) Terms and conditions under subsection (1) may include, but are not limited to, terms and conditions

heading: Power to authorize extension of rights under licence
paragraph: (a) respecting the use of the water or works necessarily required to be used for that use,

heading: Power to authorize extension of rights under licence
paragraph: (b) providing for compensation as between the licensee and a person who is receiving the benefit of the extension, or

heading: Power to authorize extension of rights under licence
paragraph: (c) limiting the term of the extension.

heading: Appointment of water bailiffs
paragraph:
38
		  (1) If the comptroller or a water manager considers that there is no engineer who is able, in person, to take action or measurements in relation to the diversion or use of water from a stream or an aquifer or the works related to the diversion or use, the decision maker may appoint in writing one or more water bailiffs for that purpose, set the terms and conditions of the appointments and give directions in respect of the water bailiffs' responsibilities.

heading: Appointment of water bailiffs
paragraph: (2) If an engineer reports to the comptroller or a water manager that works used by more than one person are not being adequately repaired or maintained, the decision maker may appoint in writing one or more water bailiffs, set the terms and conditions of the appointments and give directions to the water bailiffs, including, without limitation, directions to

heading: Appointment of water bailiffs
paragraph: (a) operate and inspect the operation of specified works, and

heading: Appointment of water bailiffs
paragraph: (b) perform routine repairs on and maintain specified works.

heading: Appointment of water bailiffs
paragraph: (3) A water bailiff, under the direction of an engineer, which direction must be consistent with the directions given under subsection (1) or (2) and may be given by the engineer in person or through an officer, may

heading: Appointment of water bailiffs
paragraph: (a) take action or measurements in respect of the diversion or use of water from the streams and aquifers specified in the water bailiff's appointment,

heading: Appointment of water bailiffs
paragraph: (b) take action in respect of works related to the diversion or use of the water, and

heading: Appointment of water bailiffs
paragraph: (c) inspect, operate, perform routine repairs on and maintain those works.

heading: Appointment of water bailiffs
paragraph: (4) A water bailiff who takes action or measurements under subsection (2) or (3) must keep records of anything the water bailiff does under this section, including, without limitation, actions and measurements taken, work performed, hours of work and expenses incurred, and provide the records to the engineer.

heading: Appointment of water bailiffs
paragraph: (5) Persons, whether or not those persons hold an authorization, who divert or use water from the streams or aquifers in respect of which a water bailiff exercises powers or performs duties under this section are liable to

heading: Appointment of water bailiffs
paragraph: (a) compensate the water bailiff in the amounts and at the times the engineer who directs the water bailiff orders, and

heading: Appointment of water bailiffs
paragraph: (b) reimburse the water bailiff as directed by the engineer for the amounts that the engineer considers were reasonably incurred by the water bailiff in maintaining, operating or repairing the works.

heading: Appointment of water bailiffs
paragraph: (6) A water bailiff may stop the diversion or use of water, and the operation of works, by or on behalf of a person who fails to pay amounts owing to the water bailiff under subsection (5).

heading: Appointment of water bailiffs
paragraph: (7) If a water bailiff assigns to the government all the water bailiff's right, title and interest in and to the indebtedness for amounts payable to the water bailiff under subsection (5), those amounts may be recovered under section 98 [recovery of amounts owing for work performed] as a debt of the persons liable under subsection (5) of this section that is due to the government.

heading: Water reservations
paragraph:
39
		  (1) If the Lieutenant Governor in Council considers it advisable

heading: Water reservations
paragraph: (a) to enable a specified person to investigate the suitability of a stream or an aquifer for a specified water use purpose,

heading: Water reservations
paragraph: (b) to make provision for a water supply from a stream or an aquifer for a proposed waterworks, irrigation or power system or project of a specified person,

heading: Water reservations
paragraph: (c) to ensure water from a stream or an aquifer is available for the benefit of the Crown, or

heading: Water reservations
paragraph: (d) to retain the reserved water in a stream or an aquifer,

heading: Water reservations
paragraph: the Lieutenant Governor in Council may reserve all or part of the water that is in the stream or the aquifer, and that is unrecorded and unreserved and is not dedicated agricultural water, from being diverted or used under this Act except as provided by section 6 (2), (3) or (4) [use of water].

heading: Water reservations
paragraph: (2) The minister must publish a notice in the Gazette giving particulars of a reservation established or amended under subsection (1).

heading: Water reservations
paragraph: (3) A reservation under subsection (1) established

heading: Water reservations
paragraph: (a) in relation to all the unrecorded water in a stream or an aquifer applies to water, other than dedicated agricultural water, that by reason of the expiry, abandonment or cancellation of all or part of the rights under an authorization becomes unrecorded water in the stream or aquifer during the existence of the reservation, and

heading: Water reservations
paragraph: (b) in relation to a specified quantity of water in a stream or an aquifer applies to water that by reason of the expiry, abandonment or cancellation of all or part of the rights under an authorization issued under subsection (4) (c) for water that is subject to the reservation becomes unrecorded water during the existence of the reservation.

heading: Water reservations
paragraph: (4) The Lieutenant Governor in Council, in an order under subsection (1) or in a subsequent order, may provide that water reserved under subsection (1), despite the reservation, may be acquired under a licence,

heading: Water reservations
paragraph: (a) for a reservation under subsection (1) (a) or (b), by the specified person, or a person authorized by the specified person, for the water use purpose, or for the waterworks, irrigation or power system or project, as applicable, for which the water is reserved,

heading: Water reservations
paragraph: (b) for a reservation under subsection (1) (c), by the Crown or a person authorized by the Crown,

heading: Water reservations
paragraph: (c) for a reservation under subsection (1) (a), (b) or (c), by any person for another water use purpose, but the rights under a licence issued under this paragraph must be given a later date of precedence than rights under any licence referred to in paragraph (a) or (b) of this subsection in respect of the water reserved, whether the licence for the other water use purpose is issued before or after the licence referred to in paragraph (a) or (b), and

heading: Water reservations
paragraph: (d) for a reservation under subsection (1) (d), by a specified person for a water use purpose the Lieutenant Governor in Council considers is consistent with the purposes of the reservation.

heading: Water reservations
paragraph: (5) The Lieutenant Governor in Council may cancel a reservation established under subsection (1) effective on a specified date, which date must not be earlier than 30 days after the date of publication of the notice under subsection (6) (a).

heading: Water reservations
paragraph: (6) The minister must publish notice of a cancellation under subsection (5), specifying the date on which the cancellation is effective,

heading: Water reservations
paragraph: (a) in the Gazette, and

heading: Water reservations
paragraph: (b) within 30 days after the publication under paragraph (a), in a newspaper published in the water district in which the stream or the aquifer is located, and if there is no newspaper so published then in a newspaper that circulates in that water district.

heading: Water reservations
paragraph: (7) Applications for the water reserved under a reservation cancelled under subsection (5) may be accepted during the period between the date the notice of cancellation is published in the Gazette and the effective date of the cancellation, but an authorization issued in respect of the application must not be given a date of precedence that is earlier than the effective date of the cancellation.

heading: Water reservations
paragraph: (8) Despite subsection (1), a licence may be issued authorizing for domestic purpose or a land improvement purpose the diversion or use of water to which a reservation established under subsection (1) applies.

heading: Water reservations
paragraph: (9) Despite subsection (1), a use approval may be issued authorizing, for any water use purpose, the diversion and use of water to which a reservation established under subsection (1) applies.

heading: Treaty first nation water reservations
paragraph:
40
		  (1) If the final agreement of a treaty first nation describes a water reservation for water use purposes specified in the agreement, other than a power purpose, that British Columbia is required by the final agreement to establish in favour of the treaty first nation, the Lieutenant Governor in Council may establish that water reservation for those purposes.

heading: Treaty first nation water reservations
paragraph: (2) A water reservation established in favour of a treaty first nation under subsection (1) is deemed to be a water reservation under section 39 subject to the following:

heading: Treaty first nation water reservations
paragraph: (a) the water reserved by the water reservation may only be acquired for the purposes, and in the manner, contemplated by the treaty first nation's final agreement;

heading: Treaty first nation water reservations
paragraph: (b) section 39 (5) to (7) does not apply to that water reservation;

heading: Treaty first nation water reservations
paragraph: (c) section 39 (8) and (9) does not apply to the water reserved by that water reservation.

heading: Treaty first nation water reservations
paragraph: (3) Despite anything to the contrary in this Act, a water reservation established under subsection (1) for purposes authorized by the final agreement

heading: Treaty first nation water reservations
paragraph: (a) is deemed to have been established on the date specified in the final agreement as the reference date for the priority of the water reservation, and

heading: Treaty first nation water reservations
paragraph: (b) has priority for those purposes over water licences issued after that date in relation to the same stream, except water licences given priority by that final agreement.

heading: Nisga'a water reservation
paragraph:
41
		  (1) The Lieutenant Governor in Council may, by order, establish the water reservation, described in paragraph 122 of the Lands Chapter of the Nisga'a Final Agreement, in favour of the Nisga'a Nation.

heading: Nisga'a water reservation
paragraph: (2) The water reservation established under subsection (1) is deemed

heading: Nisga'a water reservation
paragraph: (a) to be a water reservation under section 39 [water reservations] subject to the following:

heading: Nisga'a water reservation
paragraph: (i)  the water reserved by that water reservation may only be acquired for the purposes and in the manner contemplated by paragraphs 122 to 126 of the Lands Chapter of the Nisga'a Final Agreement;

heading: Nisga'a water reservation
paragraph: (ii)  section 39 (5) to (7) does not apply to that water reservation;

heading: Nisga'a water reservation
paragraph: (iii)  section 39 (8) and (9) does not apply to the water reserved by that water reservation, and

heading: Nisga'a water reservation
paragraph: (b) to have been made on March 22, 1996 for the purposes of paragraph 123 of the Lands Chapter of the Nisga'a Final Agreement.

heading: Issue of new licence
paragraph: 42		  If a licence is acquired by

heading: Issue of new licence
paragraph: (a) a regional district under section 289 (2) [expropriation of water licences and related works] of the Local Government Act,

heading: Issue of new licence
paragraph: (b) an improvement district under section 704 [power to expropriate water diversion licences and related works] of that Act, or

heading: Issue of new licence
paragraph: (c) a municipality under section 31 (2) [expropriation of water licences and related works] of the Community Charter,

heading: Issue of new licence
paragraph: the comptroller may issue in place of the acquired licence a new licence having the same precedence but authorizing the diversion or use of water for any water use purpose required by the regional district, improvement district or municipality, as applicable.

heading: Water objectives
paragraph: 43		  (1) For the purposes of sustaining water quantity, water quality and aquatic ecosystems in and for British Columbia, the Lieutenant Governor in Council may make regulations

heading: Water objectives
paragraph: (a) establishing water objectives for a watershed, stream, aquifer or other specified area or environmental feature or matter in order to sustain

heading: Water objectives
paragraph: (i)  water quality required for specified uses of water,

heading: Water objectives
paragraph: (ii)  water quantity required for specified uses of water, and

heading: Water objectives
paragraph: (iii)  water quality and water quantity required to sustain aquatic ecosystems

heading: Water objectives
paragraph: in relation to the watershed, stream, aquifer or other area, feature or matter,

heading: Water objectives
paragraph: (b) specifying factors and criteria to apply for evaluating the impacts of a land use or resource use proposal on objectives established under paragraph (a), and

heading: Water objectives
paragraph: (c) respecting measures to address impacts of such proposals on the objectives.

heading: Water objectives
paragraph: (2) A regulation under this section may

heading: Water objectives
paragraph: (a) require that a water objective be considered by a public officer making a specified decision under a specified enactment, if the decision is in relation to the watershed, stream, aquifer or other area or environmental feature or matter for which the water objective was prescribed, and

heading: Water objectives
paragraph: (b) authorize or require a person referred to in paragraph (a), in order to promote achievement of the water objective, to impose requirements, as terms and conditions, on any instrument the person issues.

heading: Water objectives
paragraph: (3) Terms and conditions authorized or required to be imposed by a regulation under subsection (2) are deemed to be imposed under the specified enactment.

heading: Water objectives
paragraph: (4) Despite any other enactment, a regulation under subsection (2) may provide that a specified water objective applies despite or subject to objectives, standards, requirements or plans established in relation to environmental matters under the specified enactment or another specified enactment.

heading: Water objectives
paragraph: (5) A regulation under this section may require that

heading: Water objectives
paragraph: (a) a regional district consider specified water objectives when developing, amending or adopting a regional growth strategy under Part 13 [Regional Growth Strategies] of the Local Government Act,

heading: Water objectives
paragraph: (b) a municipality consider specified water objectives when developing, amending or adopting an official community plan under Part 14 [Planning and Land Use Management] of the Local Government Act or Part XXVII [Planning and Development] of the Vancouver Charter,

heading: Water objectives
paragraph: (c) a local trust committee consider specified water objectives when developing, amending or adopting an official community plan under section 29 [land use and subdivision regulation] of the Islands Trust Act, and

heading: Water objectives
paragraph: (d) a prescribed person or entity consider specified water objectives when developing, amending or enacting plans or undertaking planning processes under prescribed enactments.

heading: Definitions
paragraph: 44		  For the purposes of this Division:

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "bank-to-bank dam" means

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) a structure that is capable of impounding or storing water and that spans a stream from bank to bank, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) structures that together are capable of impounding or storing water and that span a stream

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (i)  from one bank to a natural or other feature or structure in the stream, and

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (ii)  from the feature or structure to the other bank of the stream or, if applicable, between features or structures and to the other bank of the stream;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "construction of a bank-to-bank dam" includes the alteration of an existing structure so that it becomes a bank-to-bank dam but does not include the alteration of an existing bank-to-bank dam;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "protected river" means a river set out in the Schedule.

heading: No new dams on protected rivers
paragraph:
45
		  (1) A person must not construct a bank-to-bank dam anywhere on a protected river.

heading: No new dams on protected rivers
paragraph: (2) The comptroller or a water manager must not issue or amend an authorization, change approval or permit to authorize the construction of a bank-to-bank dam anywhere on a protected river.

heading: No new dams on protected rivers
paragraph: (3) An authorization, change approval or permit issued or an amendment made contrary to subsection (2) has no effect.

heading: No new dams on protected rivers
paragraph: (4) This section applies despite any other enactment.

heading: No new dams on protected rivers
paragraph: (5) This section does not apply to a dam authorized by a licence, permit or approval issued under the Water Act before March 15, 1997.

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into stream
paragraph: 46		  (1) Unless authorized under this or another enactment or excepted under subsection (2), a person must not

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into stream
paragraph: (a) introduce debris, refuse, carcasses, human or animal waste, pesticides, fertilizers, contaminants or another matter or substance into a stream, a stream channel or an area adjacent to a stream, or

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into stream
paragraph: (b) cause or allow debris, refuse, carcasses, human or animal waste, pesticides, fertilizers, contaminants or another matter or substance to be introduced into a stream, a stream channel or an area adjacent to a stream

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into stream
paragraph: in such a quantity or in such a manner as to cause a significant adverse impact to

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into stream
paragraph: (c) the stream or stream channel,

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into stream
paragraph: (d) the existing uses of the water from the stream,

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into stream
paragraph: (e) the property of riparian owners on the stream,

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into stream
paragraph: (f) an aquifer that is hydraulically connected to the stream or the existing uses of the water from that aquifer, or

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into stream
paragraph: (g) the aquatic ecosystem of the stream.

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into stream
paragraph: (2) Subsection (1) does not apply in relation to

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into stream
paragraph: (a) a forest practice to which section 46 [protection of the environment] of the Forest and Range Practices Act applies, or

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into stream
paragraph: (b) a prescribed activity, practice or substance.

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into stream
paragraph: (3) In a prosecution under section 106 (4) (n) [general offences], it is not necessary to prove that the human or animal waste, pesticide, fertilizer, contaminant or other matter or substance, if diluted or its concentration reduced subsequent to the introduction into the stream, continued to cause or to be likely to cause a significant adverse impact on the quality of water in the stream or in an aquifer that is hydraulically connected to the stream or the uses made of the water from the stream or aquifer that is hydraulically connected to the stream.

heading: Remediation orders in relation to foreign matter in stream
paragraph: 47		  (1) An engineer may order a person who contravenes section 46 (1) [prohibition on introducing foreign matter into stream] to

heading: Remediation orders in relation to foreign matter in stream
paragraph: (a) stop the introduction of debris, refuse, carcasses, human or animal waste, pesticides, fertilizers, contaminants or other matter or substance into the stream, the stream channel or an area adjacent to the stream,

heading: Remediation orders in relation to foreign matter in stream
paragraph: (b) remove the debris, refuse, carcasses, human or animal waste, pesticides, fertilizers, contaminants or other matter or substance from the stream, the stream channel, the area adjacent to the stream or an aquifer that is hydraulically connected to the stream and to which the matter or substance has migrated, and

heading: Remediation orders in relation to foreign matter in stream
paragraph: (c) take measures, in accordance with the direction of the engineer, to remediate or mitigate the effects of the introduction.

heading: Remediation orders in relation to foreign matter in stream
paragraph: (2) If the engineer considers that the effects of an introduction described in subsection (1) (a) cannot be remediated, or cannot be fully remediated, at the location of the introduction, that engineer may order the person referred to in subsection (1) to take compensatory mitigation measures, in place of or supplemental to other remediation measures, on a different part of the stream into which the introduction was made.

heading: Remediation orders in relation to foreign matter in stream
paragraph: (3) The comptroller or a water manager may authorize the government or another person to take the actions necessary to comply with an order under subsection (1), and the person who contravened section 46 (1) is liable to the government or that other person, as applicable, for the costs of complying with the order if any of the following apply:

heading: Remediation orders in relation to foreign matter in stream
paragraph: (a) the person who is subject to an order under subsection (1) fails to comply with the order within the time specified in the order;

heading: Remediation orders in relation to foreign matter in stream
paragraph: (b) the person who contravened section 46 (1) cannot be identified or located after reasonable effort;

heading: Remediation orders in relation to foreign matter in stream
paragraph: (c) the comptroller or the water manager considers that failure to remediate or mitigate the introduction immediately may result in harm or damage to anything referred to in section 46 (1) (c) to (g).

heading: Remediation orders in relation to foreign matter in stream
paragraph: (4) Any expense reasonably incurred by a person in the exercise of authority provided under subsection (3), unless the person is acting on behalf of the government, may be recovered from the person to whom the order was directed as money paid for, and at the request of, that person.

heading: Remediation orders in relation to foreign matter in stream
paragraph: (5) If work is carried out under subsection (3) by or on behalf of the government, the costs to the government are a debt due to the government by the person to whom the order was directed and may be recovered in accordance with section 98 [recovery of amounts owing for work performed].

heading: Remediation orders in relation to foreign matter in stream
paragraph: (6) This section does not limit the authority under section 91 [power of comptroller to authorize actions] or 93 [powers of engineers and officers].

heading: Definitions
paragraph:
48
		  (1) For the purposes of this Division:

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "person responsible", with respect to constructing a well, installing a well pump, conducting a flow test or decommissioning a well, means,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) if the activity is supervised by a professional, that professional,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) if paragraph (a) does not apply and the activity is supervised or performed by a well driller or well pump installer who is qualified to supervise or perform that activity, that well driller or well pump installer,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (c) if neither paragraph (a) nor (b) applies, a person who performs the activity in the ordinary course of that person's business, and

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (d) if none of paragraphs (a), (b) or (c) applies, the person on whose behalf the activity is performed;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "professional" means a registrant as defined in section 5 of Schedule 1 to the Professional Governance Act;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "qualified", in respect of an activity in relation to a well or well pump,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) for a well driller, means a well driller who has the qualifications prescribed as required to perform or supervise the activity in relation to the well or well pump, and

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) for a well pump installer, means a well pump installer who has the qualifications prescribed as required to perform or supervise the activity in relation to the well or well pump;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "well" includes any casing, screen, drive shoe, packer, riser pipe, cap, valve, grout, liner and seal relating to a well;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "well driller" means a person who has the prescribed qualifications;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "well pump installer" means a person who has the prescribed qualifications.

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (2) For the purposes of this Division, a person's actions are directly supervised by another person if that other person is responsible for the control and conduct of the person's actions.

heading: Restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells and related activities
paragraph: 49		  (1) Subject to section 50, this section applies to a person who

heading: Restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells and related activities
paragraph: (a) constructs a well,

heading: Restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells and related activities
paragraph: (b) decommissions a well,

heading: Restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells and related activities
paragraph: (c) deactivates a well, or

heading: Restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells and related activities
paragraph: (d) disinfects a well.

heading: Restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells and related activities
paragraph: (2) A person referred to in subsection (1) must

heading: Restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells and related activities
paragraph: (a) comply with the applicable regulations,

heading: Restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells and related activities
paragraph: (b) in the case of an activity referred to in subsection (1) (a), (b) or (c), either

heading: Restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells and related activities
paragraph: (i)  be a well driller who is qualified in respect of the activity in relation to the well, or

heading: Restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells and related activities
paragraph: (ii)  act under the direct supervision of

heading: Restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells and related activities
paragraph: (A) a person described in subparagraph (i), or

heading: Restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells and related activities
paragraph: (B) a professional who has competency in the field of hydrogeology or geotechnical engineering, and

heading: Restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells and related activities
paragraph: (c) in the case of an activity referred to in subsection (1) (d), be a person described in paragraph (b) or a well pump installer described in section 50 (2) (b) (i), or act under the direct supervision of a person described in section 50 (2) (b) (ii).

heading: Restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells and related activities
paragraph: (3) Unless provided otherwise by a regulation under section 83 [plan regulations - restrictions on groundwater activities] or 137 [minister's regulations restricting groundwater activities], subsection (2) (b) or (c) of this section does not apply in respect of the following:

heading: Restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells and related activities
paragraph: (a) a person

heading: Restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells and related activities
paragraph: (i)  excavating a well to a depth of not more than 15 m, or

heading: Restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells and related activities
paragraph: (ii)  performing an activity referred to in subsection (1) with respect to an excavated well that has a depth of not more than 15 m;

heading: Restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells and related activities
paragraph: (b) a person deactivating or disinfecting a well owned by the person;

heading: Restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells and related activities
paragraph: (c) a person constructing or decommissioning a geotechnical well, if the activity of constructing or decommissioning the well is not likely to penetrate an aquifer;

heading: Restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells and related activities
paragraph: (d) a person installing, replacing or repairing, on a well owned by the person,

heading: Restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells and related activities
paragraph: (i)  a flow meter, or

heading: Restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells and related activities
paragraph: (ii)  a well cap, well cover, valve or vent that is part of the wellhead and accessible at the surface of the ground;

heading: Restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells and related activities
paragraph: (e) a prescribed

heading: Restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells and related activities
paragraph: (i)  person,

heading: Restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells and related activities
paragraph: (ii)  well,

heading: Restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells and related activities
paragraph: (iii)  activity in relation to a prescribed work, or

heading: Restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells and related activities
paragraph: (iv)  activity.

heading: Restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells and related activities
paragraph: (4) A person who, in performing an activity referred to in subsection (3) (c) or prescribed under subsection (3) (e), penetrates an aquifer must stop performing that activity until the person has complied with subsection (2) (b) and must take the steps recommended by the person described in that subsection.

heading: Restrictions respecting well pumps and flow tests
paragraph:
50
		  (1) This section applies to a person who

heading: Restrictions respecting well pumps and flow tests
paragraph: (a) installs, maintains, repairs, removes or tests a well pump or a wellhead,

heading: Restrictions respecting well pumps and flow tests
paragraph: (b) conducts a flow test of a well, or

heading: Restrictions respecting well pumps and flow tests
paragraph: (c) disinfects a well pump.

heading: Restrictions respecting well pumps and flow tests
paragraph: (2) A person referred to in subsection (1) must

heading: Restrictions respecting well pumps and flow tests
paragraph: (a) comply with the applicable regulations, and

heading: Restrictions respecting well pumps and flow tests
paragraph: (b) either

heading: Restrictions respecting well pumps and flow tests
paragraph: (i)  be a well pump installer or well driller who is qualified in respect of the activity in relation to the well, or

heading: Restrictions respecting well pumps and flow tests
paragraph: (ii)  act under the direct supervision of

heading: Restrictions respecting well pumps and flow tests
paragraph: (A) a person described in subparagraph (i), or

heading: Restrictions respecting well pumps and flow tests
paragraph: (B) a professional who has competency in the field of hydrogeology or geotechnical engineering.

heading: Restrictions respecting well pumps and flow tests
paragraph: (3) Despite subsection (2) (b) (i) and (ii) (A), if the regulations require that an activity described in subsection (1) be performed or directly supervised only by a professional who has competency in the field of hydrogeology or geotechnical engineering, that activity must be performed or directly supervised by a professional who is so qualified.

heading: Restrictions respecting well pumps and flow tests
paragraph: (4) Unless provided otherwise by a regulation under section 83 [plan regulations - restrictions on groundwater activities] or 137 [minister's regulations restricting groundwater activities], subsections (2) (b) and (3) do not apply in respect of the following:

heading: Restrictions respecting well pumps and flow tests
paragraph: (a) a person installing a well pump in a monitoring well, a geotechnical well or a closed-loop geoexchange well;

heading: Restrictions respecting well pumps and flow tests
paragraph: (b) a person disinfecting a well pump owned by the person;

heading: Restrictions respecting well pumps and flow tests
paragraph: (c) a prescribed

heading: Restrictions respecting well pumps and flow tests
paragraph: (i)  person,

heading: Restrictions respecting well pumps and flow tests
paragraph: (ii)  well or well pump,

heading: Restrictions respecting well pumps and flow tests
paragraph: (iii)  activity in relation to a prescribed work, or

heading: Restrictions respecting well pumps and flow tests
paragraph: (iv)  activity.

heading: Proof of qualifications and insurance
paragraph:
51
		  (1) On the direction of

heading: Proof of qualifications and insurance
paragraph: (a) the comptroller,

heading: Proof of qualifications and insurance
paragraph: (b) a water manager,

heading: Proof of qualifications and insurance
paragraph: (c) an engineer,

heading: Proof of qualifications and insurance
paragraph: (d) an officer, or

heading: Proof of qualifications and insurance
paragraph: (e) a drinking water officer,

heading: Proof of qualifications and insurance
paragraph: a person who is performing or directly supervising an activity that under this Act must be performed or directly supervised by a professional with specified competencies, or by a well driller or well pump installer who is qualified in respect of the activity in relation to the well, must immediately provide proof that the person is qualified to perform or supervise the activity and, if the person is required under subsection (2) to carry insurance, proof of that insurance.

heading: Proof of qualifications and insurance
paragraph: (2) If the regulations require that a professional or a well driller carry not less than the prescribed amount of liability insurance in the event of liability arising from the performance or supervision of activities under this Act, the professional or well driller, as applicable, must carry that amount.

heading: Proof of qualifications and insurance
paragraph: (3) When asked to do so, a professional, a well driller or a well pump installer must provide to any person who engages the professional, well driller or well pump installer to perform or supervise activities under this Act

heading: Proof of qualifications and insurance
paragraph: (a) proof of insurance, if insurance is required under the regulations, and

heading: Proof of qualifications and insurance
paragraph: (b) proof of qualifications.

heading: Controlling artesian flow during construction
paragraph:
52
		  (1) For the purposes of this section and section 53, artesian flow of a well is under control when

heading: Controlling artesian flow during construction
paragraph: (a) the artesian flow

heading: Controlling artesian flow during construction
paragraph: (i)  is clear of sediment,

heading: Controlling artesian flow during construction
paragraph: (ii)  is entirely conveyed through the well's production casing to the wellhead, if the well has a production casing,

heading: Controlling artesian flow during construction
paragraph: (iii)  may be mechanically stopped for an indefinite period in a manner that prevents leakage onto the surface of the ground or into another aquifer penetrated by the well, and

heading: Controlling artesian flow during construction
paragraph: (iv)  does not pose a threat to property, public safety or the environment, or

heading: Controlling artesian flow during construction
paragraph: (b) if the artesian flow cannot be controlled in accordance with paragraph (a), the well is decommissioned

heading: Controlling artesian flow during construction
paragraph: (i)  in accordance with the regulations,

heading: Controlling artesian flow during construction
paragraph: (ii)  by a person authorized under section 49 [restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells], and

heading: Controlling artesian flow during construction
paragraph: (iii)  in a manner that allows no artesian flow at the surface of the ground or leakage into another aquifer penetrated by the well.

heading: Controlling artesian flow during construction
paragraph: (2) If a well driller or a professional encounters artesian conditions while constructing a well or supervising the construction of a well, the well driller or professional must ensure, as soon as practicable, that

heading: Controlling artesian flow during construction
paragraph: (a) any artesian flow is stopped or brought under control, or

heading: Controlling artesian flow during construction
paragraph: (b) if the artesian well is likely to flow periodically, steps are taken to ensure that that artesian flow will be stopped or controlled during those periods.

heading: Controlling artesian flow during construction
paragraph: (3) A person, other than a well driller or a professional, who, while constructing a well, encounters

heading: Controlling artesian flow during construction
paragraph: (a) flowing artesian conditions, or

heading: Controlling artesian flow during construction
paragraph: (b) artesian conditions that indicate the artesian well is likely to flow periodically,

heading: Controlling artesian flow during construction
paragraph: must notify the well owner of the encounter and the person and the well owner must ensure that a well driller who is qualified in respect of the activity or a professional is engaged, and that well driller or professional must comply with subsection (2) in relation to the artesian flow.

heading: Controlling artesian flow during construction
paragraph: (4) A well driller or professional who encounters or takes steps to stop or control artesian flow must notify the well owner and the land owner of the encounter and the steps taken.

heading: Controlling artesian flow during construction
paragraph: (5) If the well driller or professional described in subsection (2) or engaged under subsection (3) fails to comply with subsection (2), the well owner must ensure that a well driller who is qualified in respect of the activity or a professional complies with subsection (2).

heading: Controlling artesian flow during construction
paragraph: (6) If the comptroller or a water manager is satisfied, based on the report of a professional, that because of exceptional circumstances it is not practicable to bring artesian flow under control in accordance with subsection (1) (a) or (b) but the artesian flow can be managed in another manner without posing a threat to property, public safety or the environment, the artesian flow may be brought under control in accordance with the directions of the decision maker.

heading: Controlling artesian flow during construction
paragraph: (7) A person responsible for stopping or controlling artesian flow under this section must comply with any applicable regulations and any directions of an engineer in relation to stopping or controlling the flow.

heading: Controlling flowing artesian well
paragraph:
53
		  (1) The owner of a flowing artesian well must engage a well driller who is qualified in respect of the activity or a professional and ensure that the well driller or professional, as applicable, stops the flow of that well or brings the flow of that well under control.

heading: Controlling flowing artesian well
paragraph: (2) If the owner of a flowing artesian well fails to comply with subsection (1) and the owner of the land on which the well is located does not know who owns the well, the owner of that land must comply with subsection (1).

heading: Controlling flowing artesian well
paragraph: (3) Section 52 (6) and (7) apply for the purposes of this section.

heading: Well caps or well covers
paragraph:
54
		  (1) The following persons must secure a well cap or well cover on a well in accordance with the regulations:

heading: Well caps or well covers
paragraph: (a) a person who drills a well or alters a well;

heading: Well caps or well covers
paragraph: (b) a person who owns a well that does not have a well cap or well cover secured on the well.

heading: Well caps or well covers
paragraph: (2) If a well owner does not comply with subsection (1) (b) and the owner of the land on which the well is located does not know who owns the well, the owner of that land must comply with subsection (1) (b).

heading: Well caps or well covers
paragraph: (3) A person must not remove the well cap or well cover from a well except for the purpose of

heading: Well caps or well covers
paragraph: (a) inspecting, developing, disinfecting, maintaining, repairing or altering the well or inspecting, maintaining, repairing, replacing or altering works associated with the well,

heading: Well caps or well covers
paragraph: (b) installing, re-installing, removing or testing a well pump,

heading: Well caps or well covers
paragraph: (c) testing the flow of the well,

heading: Well caps or well covers
paragraph: (d) measuring the water level in the well,

heading: Well caps or well covers
paragraph: (e) taking a water sample from the well, or

heading: Well caps or well covers
paragraph: (f) undertaking similar activities that require temporary removal of the well cap or well cover.

heading: Well caps or well covers
paragraph: (4) A person who temporarily removes a well cap or well cover as authorized under subsection (3) must replace the cap or cover in accordance with the regulations as soon as practicable after completing the work for which that cap or cover was removed.

heading: Well caps or well covers
paragraph: (5) A person must not destroy, injure or tamper with a well cap or well cover.

heading: Well identification
paragraph:
55
		  (1) In this section, "owner" and "water supply system" have the same meaning as in section 1 [definitions] of the Drinking Water Protection Act.

heading: Well identification
paragraph: (2) The following persons must attach an identification plate to a well or wellhead in accordance with the regulations:

heading: Well identification
paragraph: (a) a person responsible for drilling a well or altering a well that does not have an identification plate attached;

heading: Well identification
paragraph: (b) unless a plate is attached under paragraph (a), the owner of a water supply system.

heading: Well identification
paragraph: (3) Subsection (2) does not apply in respect of a monitoring well, a geotechnical well, a closed-loop geoexchange well or a well made for the purpose of groundwater remediation.

heading: Well identification
paragraph: (4) A person who is required to attach an identification plate under this section must submit a report in accordance with the regulations to

heading: Well identification
paragraph: (a) the comptroller, and

heading: Well identification
paragraph: (b) a water manager, an engineer or an officer, if directed to do so by that official.

heading: Well identification
paragraph: (5) A person who decommissions a well must remove and destroy the identification plate referred to in subsection (2).

heading: Decommissioning or deactivating well
paragraph: 56		  (1) For the purposes of this section, a well is considered to be in service if

heading: Decommissioning or deactivating well
paragraph: (a) the well is used regularly or on a periodic basis, or

heading: Decommissioning or deactivating well
paragraph: (b) the well is kept active as a backup water supply.

heading: Decommissioning or deactivating well
paragraph: (2) Despite subsection (1), a well is considered to be not in service

heading: Decommissioning or deactivating well
paragraph: (a) if the well is not used for the prescribed period, or

heading: Decommissioning or deactivating well
paragraph: (b) in prescribed circumstances.

heading: Decommissioning or deactivating well
paragraph: (3) If a well is, in accordance with subsection (2), not in service, the well owner must ensure that the well is deactivated or decommissioned as soon as practicable in accordance with the regulations and by a person authorized under section 49 [restrictions on constructing or decommissioning wells and related activities] of this Act.

heading: Decommissioning or deactivating well
paragraph: (4) If a deactivated well is not in service for the prescribed period, the well owner must ensure that the well is decommissioned as soon as practicable in accordance with the regulations and by a person authorized under section 49 of this Act.

heading: Decommissioning or deactivating well
paragraph: (5) Despite the period prescribed for the purposes of subsection (4), if the comptroller or a water manager is satisfied that a well is being properly maintained as a deactivated well for later use, the decision maker may extend that prescribed period.

heading: Decommissioning or deactivating well
paragraph: (6) If the owner of the land on which the well is located does not know who owns the well, the owner of the land must comply with subsections (3) and (4).

heading: Well reports
paragraph:
57
		  (1) Subject to the regulations, a person responsible for

heading: Well reports
paragraph: (a) constructing a well,

heading: Well reports
paragraph: (b) installing a well pump,

heading: Well reports
paragraph: (c) conducting a flow test of a well, or

heading: Well reports
paragraph: (d) decommissioning a well

heading: Well reports
paragraph: must maintain a daily log containing the prescribed information and must complete a report in accordance with the regulations.

heading: Well reports
paragraph: (2) The person referred to in subsection (1) must retain and produce at the direction of an officer, an engineer or a drinking water officer the log and report required under subsection (1).

heading: Well reports
paragraph: (3) A person who is required under subsection (1) to complete a report must submit a copy of the report in accordance with the regulations to

heading: Well reports
paragraph: (a) the well owner,

heading: Well reports
paragraph: (b) in prescribed circumstances, for prescribed wells or if artesian flow is encountered in constructing the well, the comptroller, and

heading: Well reports
paragraph: (c) if directed to do so by the comptroller, a water manager, an engineer, an officer or a drinking water officer, that official.

heading: Well reports
paragraph: (4) Despite section 117 (4) [delivery and publication of documents and information], the comptroller must publish reports received under subsection (3) (b) and may publish reports received under subsection (3) (c), whether or not a report includes personal information.

heading: Well operation
paragraph:
58
		  (1) A person must operate a well in accordance with the regulations and any directions of an engineer in respect of the well.

heading: Well operation
paragraph: (2) A person must not operate a well in a manner that causes or is likely to cause

heading: Well operation
paragraph: (a) the intrusion of saline groundwater, sea water or contaminated water into

heading: Well operation
paragraph: (i)  the aquifer from which that well diverts water,

heading: Well operation
paragraph: (ii)  another aquifer, or

heading: Well operation
paragraph: (iii)  a stream that is hydraulically connected to an aquifer referred to in subparagraph (i) or (ii), and

heading: Well operation
paragraph: (b) a significant adverse impact on

heading: Well operation
paragraph: (i)  the quality of water in

heading: Well operation
paragraph: (A) the aquifer from which a well diverts water,

heading: Well operation
paragraph: (B) another aquifer, or

heading: Well operation
paragraph: (C) a stream that is hydraulically connected to an aquifer referred to in clause (A) or (B), or

heading: Well operation
paragraph: (ii)  the existing uses made of the water diverted from

heading: Well operation
paragraph: (A) a well that diverts water from the aquifer,

heading: Well operation
paragraph: (B) a well that diverts water from another aquifer, or

heading: Well operation
paragraph: (C) a stream that is hydraulically connected to an aquifer referred to in clause (A) or (B).

heading: Well operation
paragraph: (3) Subsection (2) does not apply

heading: Well operation
paragraph: (a) to a well made for the purpose of groundwater remediation, or

heading: Well operation
paragraph: (b) with respect to a prescribed activity in relation to a prescribed class of well.

heading: Well operation
paragraph: (4) In a prosecution under section 106 (5) (i) [general offences], it is not necessary to prove that the saline groundwater, sea water or contaminated water, as applicable, if diluted subsequent to the intrusion, continued to cause or to be likely to cause a significant adverse impact on, as applicable,

heading: Well operation
paragraph: (a) the quality of water in

heading: Well operation
paragraph: (i)  the aquifer from which the well diverts water,

heading: Well operation
paragraph: (ii)  another aquifer, or

heading: Well operation
paragraph: (iii)  a stream that is hydraulically connected to an aquifer referred to in subparagraph (i) or (ii), or

heading: Well operation
paragraph: (b) the existing uses made of the water

heading: Well operation
paragraph: (i)  from any well that diverts water from the aquifer,

heading: Well operation
paragraph: (ii)  from any well that diverts water from another aquifer, or

heading: Well operation
paragraph: (iii)  diverted from a stream that is hydraulically connected to an aquifer referred to in subparagraph (i) or (ii).

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph:
59
		  (1) A person must not introduce, allow to be introduced or cause to be introduced any of the following into a well:

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (a) refuse;

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (b) carcasses;

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (c) human or animal waste;

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (d) pesticides or fertilizers;

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (e) material from construction or demolition;

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (f) a prescribed matter or substance;

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (g) another contaminant, clay, silt, rock or a similar material, or another matter or substance, in such amounts or in such a manner as to cause or to be likely to cause a significant adverse impact on

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (i)  the quality of water in

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (A) the well,

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (B) another well that diverts water from the same aquifer,

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (C) another aquifer, or

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (D) a stream that is hydraulically connected to an aquifer referred to in clause (B) or (C), or

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (ii)  the existing uses made of the water from

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (A) the well,

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (B) another well that diverts water from the same aquifer,

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (C) another aquifer, or

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (D) a stream that is hydraulically connected to an aquifer referred to in clause (B) or (C).

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (2) Subsection (1) does not apply with respect to

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (a) a well owner in the proper operation, disinfection, maintenance, repair, deactivating or decommissioning of a well in accordance with the regulations,

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (b) a well made for the purpose of groundwater remediation,

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (c) activities authorized or required under an enactment,

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (d) a prescribed activity undertaken in accordance with any terms and conditions prescribed by regulation, or

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (e) a prescribed contaminant, matter or substance.

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (3) In a prosecution under section 106 (5) (k) [general offences], it is not necessary to prove that the contaminant, matter or substance, if diluted or its concentration is reduced subsequent to the introduction into the well, continued to cause or to be likely to cause a significant adverse impact on, as applicable,

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (a) the quality of water in

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (i)  the well,

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (ii)  another well that diverts water from the same aquifer,

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (iii)  another aquifer, or

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (iv)  a stream that is hydraulically connected to an aquifer referred to in subparagraph (ii) or (iii), or

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (b) the existing uses made of the water from

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (i)  the well,

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (ii)  another well that diverts water from the same aquifer,

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (iii)  another aquifer, or

heading: Prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well
paragraph: (iv)  a stream that is hydraulically connected to an aquifer referred to in subparagraph (ii) or (iii).

heading: Remediation orders in relation to foreign matter in well
paragraph:
60
		  (1) An engineer may order a person who contravenes section 58 (2) or 59 (1)

heading: Remediation orders in relation to foreign matter in well
paragraph: (a) to stop the introduction of,

heading: Remediation orders in relation to foreign matter in well
paragraph: (b) to remove, or

heading: Remediation orders in relation to foreign matter in well
paragraph: (c) to take measures, as directed by the engineer, to remediate or mitigate the effects of the introduction of

heading: Remediation orders in relation to foreign matter in well
paragraph: any thing, contaminant, matter or substance introduced into a well contrary to section 58 (2) or 59 (1).

heading: Remediation orders in relation to foreign matter in well
paragraph: (2) If the engineer considers that the effects of an introduction described in subsection (1) cannot be remediated, or cannot be fully remediated, at the location of the introduction, that engineer may order the person referred to in subsection (1) to take compensatory mitigation measures, in place of or supplemental to other remediation measures, on a different part of the aquifer into which the introduction was made.

heading: Remediation orders in relation to foreign matter in well
paragraph: (3) If the engineer cannot ascertain who contravened section 58 (2) or 59 (1), as applicable, the engineer may make an order under subsection (1) or (2) against the well owner.

heading: Remediation orders in relation to foreign matter in well
paragraph: (4) If the engineer cannot ascertain who contravened section 58 (2) or 59 (1), as applicable, or who owns the well, the engineer may make an order under subsection (1) or (2) against the owner of the land on which the well is located.

heading: Remediation orders in relation to foreign matter in well
paragraph: (5) The comptroller or a water manager may authorize the government or another person to take the actions necessary to comply with an order under subsection (1), and the person to whom the order was directed is liable for the costs to the government or that other person, as applicable, of complying with the order if

heading: Remediation orders in relation to foreign matter in well
paragraph: (a) a person who is subject to an order under subsection (1), (2), (3) or (4) fails to comply with that order, and

heading: Remediation orders in relation to foreign matter in well
paragraph: (b) the comptroller or the water manager considers that the failure may result in harm or damage to water in the aquifer, in another aquifer or in a stream that is hydraulically connect to either aquifer.

heading: Remediation orders in relation to foreign matter in well
paragraph: (6) Any expense reasonably incurred by the other person, unless that person is acting on behalf of the government, in the exercise of authority provided under subsection (5), may be recovered from the person liable as money paid for, and at the request of, that person.

heading: Remediation orders in relation to foreign matter in well
paragraph: (7) If work is carried out under subsection (5) by or on behalf of the government, the costs to the government are a debt due to the government by the person liable and may be recovered in accordance with section 98 [recovery of amounts owing for work performed].

heading: Remediation orders in relation to foreign matter in well
paragraph: (8) This section does not limit the authority under section 91 [power of comptroller to authorize actions] or 93 [powers of engineers and officers].

heading: Wells on Crown land
paragraph:
61
		  (1) Sections 53 [controlling flowing artesian well], 54 [well caps or well covers], 56 [decommissioning or deactivating well] and 59 [prohibition on introducing foreign matter into well] do not apply to the government as the owner of land on which a well is located unless

heading: Wells on Crown land
paragraph: (a) the well was drilled by or on behalf of the government, or

heading: Wells on Crown land
paragraph: (b) the well was purchased by the government.

heading: Wells on Crown land
paragraph: (2) If, on or after November 1, 2004, a person

heading: Wells on Crown land
paragraph: (a) has a right to use or occupy Crown land on which a well is constructed or located, and

heading: Wells on Crown land
paragraph: (b) fails to comply with section 53, 54, 56 or 59,

heading: Wells on Crown land
paragraph: the government may enforce the applicable provision against the person as if that person were the owner of the land on which the well is located, despite any subsequent termination of the right to use or occupy the land.

heading: Drilling authorizations
paragraph:
62
		  (1) If a regulation under section 83 [plan regulations - restrictions on groundwater activities] or 137 [minister's regulations restricting groundwater activities] of this Act or under section 36 [implementing a plan: restrictions on groundwater activities] of the Drinking Water Protection Act requires that a person hold a drilling authorization in order to

heading: Drilling authorizations
paragraph: (a) drill a well,

heading: Drilling authorizations
paragraph: (b) alter a well,

heading: Drilling authorizations
paragraph: (c) install a well pump, or

heading: Drilling authorizations
paragraph: (d) conduct a flow test,

heading: Drilling authorizations
paragraph: the person must not engage in the restricted activity without holding a drilling authorization issued in accordance with this section.

heading: Drilling authorizations
paragraph: (2) On application in accordance with section 12 [application and decision maker initiative procedures], the comptroller, a water manager or an engineer, subject to prescribed terms and conditions and on the terms and conditions the decision maker considers advisable, may issue a drilling authorization.

heading: Drilling authorizations
paragraph: (3) In considering an application for a drilling authorization, the decision maker must consider, as applicable,

heading: Drilling authorizations
paragraph: (a) the water sustainability plan in respect of which the regulation is made under section 83,

heading: Drilling authorizations
paragraph: (b) the purpose identified in the minister's regulation under section 137, or

heading: Drilling authorizations
paragraph: (c) the drinking water protection plan the regulations implement.

heading: Drilling authorizations
paragraph: (4) The decision maker must not issue a drilling authorization unless

heading: Drilling authorizations
paragraph: (a) the applicant is the owner of the land on which the well and any works related to the well are or will be located,

heading: Drilling authorizations
paragraph: (b) the land on which the well and any works related to the well are or will be located is Crown land, or

heading: Drilling authorizations
paragraph: (c) if neither paragraph (a) nor (b) applies, the applicant submits the prescribed evidence of the consent of the owner of the applicable land.

heading: Drilling authorizations
paragraph: (5) A person to whom a drilling authorization is issued must comply with the terms and conditions of the drilling authorization and any applicable requirements of

heading: Drilling authorizations
paragraph: (a) this Act and the regulations,

heading: Drilling authorizations
paragraph: (b) orders of the comptroller, a water manager or an engineer, or

heading: Drilling authorizations
paragraph: (c) any other enactment.

heading: Drilling authorizations
paragraph: (6) If a regulation under section 83 of this Act or under section 36 of the Drinking Water Protection Act prohibits an activity referred to in subsection (1) of this section, an application for a drilling authorization authorizing the activity in the area to which the prohibition applies may not be considered.

heading: Drilling authorizations
paragraph: (7) On application under section 12 or on the comptroller's, water manager's or engineer's own initiative, the comptroller, a water manager or an engineer, subject to prescribed terms and conditions and on the terms and conditions the decision maker considers advisable, may amend a drilling authorization.

heading: Drilling authorizations
paragraph: (8) If an amendment to a drilling authorization would substantially change the drilling authorization, the decision maker may issue in substitution another drilling authorization, subject to prescribed terms and conditions and on the terms and conditions that decision maker considers advisable.

heading: Water analyses for new or altered wells
paragraph: 63		  (1) If a well is drilled or prescribed alterations are made to a well, the person responsible for a prescribed activity in relation to the well, or another person in prescribed circumstances, must, in accordance with the regulations,

heading: Water analyses for new or altered wells
paragraph: (a) take or cause to be taken a sample of the groundwater in the well, and

heading: Water analyses for new or altered wells
paragraph: (b) cause the sample to be analyzed.

heading: Water analyses for new or altered wells
paragraph: (2) If the groundwater in a well is to be used for domestic purposes as defined in section 1 [definitions] of the Drinking Water Protection Act, the sampling and the analyses of the groundwater required by regulations referred to in subsection (1) of this section must also comply with the requirements under that Act.

heading: Water analyses for new or altered wells
paragraph: (3) A person who is required by regulations under subsection (1) to have groundwater samples analyzed must submit a copy of the results of the analyses, in the prescribed time and manner, to

heading: Water analyses for new or altered wells
paragraph: (a) the comptroller,

heading: Water analyses for new or altered wells
paragraph: (b) the well owner, and

heading: Water analyses for new or altered wells
paragraph: (c) if directed to do so by a water manager, an engineer, an officer or a drinking water officer, that official.

heading: Water analyses for new or altered wells
paragraph: (4) Subject to section 117 (4) [delivery and publication of documents and information], the comptroller must publish results received by the comptroller under subsection (3).

heading: Definitions
paragraph: 64		  For the purposes of this Division:

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "local authority" means

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) the council of a municipality,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) the board of a regional district,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (c) a local trust committee,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (d) an improvement district or greater board, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (e) a body prescribed by regulation as a local authority for the purposes of a particular water sustainability plan;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "plan regulation" means a regulation under

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) section 76 [plan regulations - effect on statutory decisions],

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) section 77 [plan regulations - effect on approval by approving officer],

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (c) section 78 [plan regulations - restriction or prohibition on use of land or resources],

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (d) section 79 [plan regulations - reduction of water rights],

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (e) section 80 [plan regulations - directions regarding works or operations],

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (f) section 81 [plan regulations - relationship with other planning processes],

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (g) section 82 [plan regulations - dedicated agricultural water], and

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (h) section 83 [plan regulations - restrictions on groundwater activities];

heading: Definitions
