paragraph: "responsible person", in respect of a proposed water sustainability plan, means the person designated by the minister under section 66 (2) (a) [order establishing plan development process] as the person responsible for preparing the proposed plan;

heading: Definitions
paragraph: "significant change" means a change in relation to a licence or a drilling authorization, whether the change is voluntary or involuntary, that is recommended by a proposed water sustainability plan and that, if implemented, would,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (a) in the case of a licence,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (i)  significantly reduce the quantity of water that the licensee is authorized to divert under the licence,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (ii)  result in significantly different works than the works authorized under the licence,

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (iii)  restrict the water use purposes for which water may be used under the licence, or

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (iv)  cancel the licence, and

heading: Definitions
paragraph: (b) in the case of a drilling authorization, cancel the drilling authorization.

heading: Order designating area for planning process
paragraph:
65
		  (1) The minister, on request or on the minister's own initiative, by order, may designate an area for the purpose of the development of a water sustainability plan

heading: Order designating area for planning process
paragraph: (a) if the minister considers that a plan for the area will assist in

heading: Order designating area for planning process
paragraph: (i)  preventing or addressing

heading: Order designating area for planning process
paragraph: (A) conflicts between water users,

heading: Order designating area for planning process
paragraph: (B) conflicts between the needs of water users and environmental flow needs,

heading: Order designating area for planning process
paragraph: (C) risks to water quality, or

heading: Order designating area for planning process
paragraph: (D) risks to aquatic ecosystem health, or

heading: Order designating area for planning process
paragraph: (ii)  identifying restoration measures in relation to a damaged aquatic ecosystem, or

heading: Order designating area for planning process
paragraph: (b) in other prescribed circumstances.

heading: Order designating area for planning process
paragraph: (2) A request to the minister referred to in subsection (1) must

heading: Order designating area for planning process
paragraph: (a) be made in the prescribed manner, if any, and

heading: Order designating area for planning process
paragraph: (b) include the prescribed information, if any.

heading: Order designating area for planning process
paragraph: (3) An order under subsection (1) must include the reasons for which the order is made.

heading: Order designating area for planning process
paragraph: (4) Section 124 (4) (d) [general regulation-making powers] applies to an area designation under subsection (1) of this section.

heading: Order establishing plan development process
paragraph:
66
		  (1) The minister, by order, may establish the process by which a proposed water sustainability plan for a plan area is to be developed.

heading: Order establishing plan development process
paragraph: (2) Without limiting subsection (1), an order under that subsection may do one or more of the following:

heading: Order establishing plan development process
paragraph: (a) designate the government or another person as the person responsible for preparing the proposed plan;

heading: Order establishing plan development process
paragraph: (b) if the government is the responsible person,

heading: Order establishing plan development process
paragraph: (i)  establish the terms of reference for the plan, and

heading: Order establishing plan development process
paragraph: (ii)  establish one or more technical advisory committees in relation to development of the plan;

heading: Order establishing plan development process
paragraph: (c) if a person other than the government is the responsible person,

heading: Order establishing plan development process
paragraph: (i)  authorize the responsible person to prepare the terms of reference for the plan, subject to approval by the minister, and

heading: Order establishing plan development process
paragraph: (ii)  require the responsible person to establish one or more technical advisory committees in relation to development of the plan;

heading: Order establishing plan development process
paragraph: (d) subject to subsection (3), do one or more of the following:

heading: Order establishing plan development process
paragraph: (i)  provide whether remuneration will be paid to members or classes of members of the technical advisory committee and set the remuneration to be paid to a member or a class of member of a technical advisory committee;

heading: Order establishing plan development process
paragraph: (ii)  require the responsible person or another person specified in the order to pay the remuneration referred to in subparagraph (i);

heading: Order establishing plan development process
paragraph: (iii)  require the responsible person or another person specified in the order to reimburse a member of a technical advisory committee for reasonable travelling and out-of-pocket expenses necessarily incurred by the member in relation to the person's participation in the technical advisory committee.

heading: Order establishing plan development process
paragraph: (3) If an order under subsection (2) (d) requires the government to pay remuneration to or reimburse the expenses of a member of a technical advisory committee,

heading: Order establishing plan development process
paragraph: (a) no payment, other than as reimbursement under subsection (2) (d) (iii), may be made to a public service employee, and

heading: Order establishing plan development process
paragraph: (b) any payment or reimbursement under the order must be in accordance with the directives of Treasury Board.

heading: Order limiting planning process or recommendations
paragraph:
67
		  (1) The minister, by order, may limit

heading: Order limiting planning process or recommendations
paragraph: (a) the issues to be considered in a water sustainability plan development process, or

heading: Order limiting planning process or recommendations
paragraph: (b) the recommendations that may be made in the plan for measures to address the issues considered.

heading: Order limiting planning process or recommendations
paragraph: (2) Without limiting subsection (1), an order under that subsection may provide that a proposed water sustainability plan may not contain a recommendation that

heading: Order limiting planning process or recommendations
paragraph: (a) a specified regulation or order under this or another specified Act be made, or

heading: Order limiting planning process or recommendations
paragraph: (b) any regulations or orders under this or another Act be made.

heading: Content of plan terms of reference
paragraph:
68
		  (1) The terms of reference for a proposed water sustainability plan must include the following:

heading: Content of plan terms of reference
paragraph: (a) the purpose of the proposed plan;

heading: Content of plan terms of reference
paragraph: (b) the scope of the proposed plan;

heading: Content of plan terms of reference
paragraph: (c) the issues to be addressed in the proposed plan;

heading: Content of plan terms of reference
paragraph: (d) a description of the organizational structure supporting the development of the proposed plan, which structure must meet any prescribed minimum requirements;

heading: Content of plan terms of reference
paragraph: (e) an estimate of the financial, human and other resources required for the plan development process and a description of the funding commitments and committed sources of other resources identified in the estimate;

heading: Content of plan terms of reference
paragraph: (f) a process for public and stakeholder communications and consultations, which process must meet any prescribed minimum requirements;

heading: Content of plan terms of reference
paragraph: (g) if the responsible person is a person other than the government, a process for consultations with the government throughout the plan development process;

heading: Content of plan terms of reference
paragraph: (h) a time limit for completing the proposed plan;

heading: Content of plan terms of reference
paragraph: (i) any other prescribed information.

heading: Content of plan terms of reference
paragraph: (2) Without limiting the terms of reference that may be established for a proposed plan, the terms of reference may include

heading: Content of plan terms of reference
paragraph: (a) considerations relating to water in a stream, groundwater and surface water runoff not in a stream, and

heading: Content of plan terms of reference
paragraph: (b) uses of land or resources that affect the water referred to in paragraph (a).

heading: Content of plan terms of reference
paragraph: (3) Subject to subsection (4), the terms of reference established for a proposed plan may be amended during the plan development process,

heading: Content of plan terms of reference
paragraph: (a) if the terms of reference were established by the minister under section 66 (2) (b) (i) [order establishing plan development process], by the minister, or

heading: Content of plan terms of reference
paragraph: (b) in any other case, by the person who prepared the terms of reference under section 66 (2) (c) (i), subject to the approval of the minister,

heading: Content of plan terms of reference
paragraph: and subsections (1) and (2) of this section apply in relation to a proposed amendment.

heading: Content of plan terms of reference
paragraph: (4) The minister, by order, may extend the time set out in the terms of reference for completing a proposed plan, whether or not the time previously set has expired.

heading: Other planning processes
paragraph:
69
		  (1) In this section:

heading: Other planning processes
paragraph: "band" has the same meaning as in the Indian Act (Canada);

heading: Other planning processes
paragraph: "first nation government" means

heading: Other planning processes
paragraph: (a) a Nisga'a Government,

heading: Other planning processes
paragraph: (b) the governing body of a treaty first nation, and

heading: Other planning processes
paragraph: (c) the governing body of a band.

heading: Other planning processes
paragraph: (2) In preparing a proposed water sustainability plan, consideration may be given to the results of other Provincial government, local authority and first nation government strategic, operational and land or water use planning processes in relation to land or water within or adjacent to the plan area.

heading: Other planning processes
paragraph: (3) A proposed plan may be prepared in conjunction with the preparation of

heading: Other planning processes
paragraph: (a) a proposed drinking water protection plan under the Drinking Water Protection Act, or

heading: Other planning processes
paragraph: (b) a land use or water use plan prepared under a prescribed enactment.

heading: Information to be considered
paragraph: 70		  In preparing a proposed water sustainability plan, the responsible person must ensure that consideration is given to any prescribed information or prescribed records.

heading: Notice to affected persons
paragraph:
71
		  (1) This section applies if the responsible person for a water sustainability plan becomes aware that the plan may contain recommendations that, if implemented, would likely

heading: Notice to affected persons
paragraph: (a) detrimentally affect the rights of any of the following:

heading: Notice to affected persons
paragraph: (i)  an authorization holder;

heading: Notice to affected persons
paragraph: (ii)  a change approval holder;

heading: Notice to affected persons
paragraph: (iii)  a drilling authorization holder;

heading: Notice to affected persons
paragraph: (iv)  an applicant for an authorization, change approval or drilling authorization;

heading: Notice to affected persons
paragraph: (v)  a riparian owner;

heading: Notice to affected persons
paragraph: (vi)  a person holding a right in relation to the use of land or resources, or

heading: Notice to affected persons
paragraph: (b) physically affect the land of a land owner.

heading: Notice to affected persons
paragraph: (2) In the circumstances referred to in subsection (1), the responsible person must, as soon as reasonably possible after the circumstances arise, give notice, in accordance with section 117 [delivery and publication of documents and information] or the regulations, to the person whose rights or land would likely be affected that a water sustainability plan is proposed to be prepared, or is being prepared, as applicable, and that the person's rights may be detrimentally affected, or the person's land may be physically affected, as the case may be.

heading: Notice to affected persons
paragraph: (3) A person who is given notice under subsection (2) may deliver to the responsible person within the period specified in the notice any concerns the person has with the proposed recommendations.

heading: Powers for development of plan
paragraph:
72
		  (1) For the purposes of developing a proposed water sustainability plan, the minister, by order, may

heading: Powers for development of plan
paragraph: (a) require a person who diverts or uses water from a stream or aquifer in the plan area, or who engages in a land or resource activity that may affect the sustainability of the quality or quantity of water in a stream or aquifer or an aquatic ecosystem in the plan area, to provide to the responsible person, or a specified representative of the responsible person, the information related to that diversion or use or land or resource activity that the responsible person or representative, as the case may be, considers advisable, and any consents required to verify that information, which information may include but is not limited to

heading: Powers for development of plan
paragraph: (i)  the person's contact information,

heading: Powers for development of plan
paragraph: (ii)  information respecting the person's diversion and use of water in the plan area, and

heading: Powers for development of plan
paragraph: (iii)  information respecting the person's activities that affect the quality or quantity of water in a stream or aquifer or an aquatic ecosystem in the plan area,

heading: Powers for development of plan
paragraph: (b) authorize the responsible person or representative, as the case may be,

heading: Powers for development of plan
paragraph: (i)  to undertake investigations, tests and surveys that that responsible person or representative considers advisable, including, without limitation, authorizing the person to collect relevant public personal information, and

heading: Powers for development of plan
paragraph: (ii)  to authorize other persons to undertake investigations, tests and surveys, or collect the information, referred to in subparagraph (i),

heading: Powers for development of plan
paragraph: (c) direct that, for the purposes of this section, section 89 [right of access to land and premises by authorized persons] applies to the responsible person or representative, as the case may be, and persons working under the direction of that responsible person or representative,

heading: Powers for development of plan
paragraph: (d) establish limits or conditions on the authority, under the order, of the responsible person or representative, as the case may be, or a person working under the direction of that responsible person or representative, and

heading: Powers for development of plan
paragraph: (e) authorize the government to collect from the responsible person or representative personal information collected by the responsible person or representative for the purposes of the water sustainability plan.

heading: Powers for development of plan
paragraph: (2) The minister may provide a responsible person with relevant government water records.

heading: Powers for development of plan
paragraph: (3) If the comptroller, a water manager or an engineer is specified as a representative of a responsible person in an order under subsection (1), an order of the comptroller, water manager or engineer, as the case may be, in exercising a discretion under the order under subsection (1) is final and may not be appealed to the appeal board.

heading: Plan content
paragraph:
73
		  (1) A proposed water sustainability plan must include the following:

heading: Plan content
paragraph: (a) a description of the plan area;

heading: Plan content
paragraph: (b) a description of the issues considered in the planning process;

heading: Plan content
paragraph: (c) a description of the public and stakeholder communications and consultations undertaken in the planning process;

heading: Plan content
paragraph: (d) a description of any notifications provided to potentially affected persons as required by section 71 [notice to affected persons] and a summary of any concerns received under that section;

heading: Plan content
paragraph: (e) the recommendations for measures to address the issues considered in the planning process and the rationale for the recommendations;

heading: Plan content
paragraph: (f) a description of the implications of, and who is responsible for, implementing the plan recommendations;

heading: Plan content
paragraph: (g) an estimate of the financial, human and other resources required for implementation of the plan and possible sources of the resources identified in the estimate, including funding commitments, if any;

heading: Plan content
paragraph: (h) prescribed information.

heading: Plan content
paragraph: (2) Without limiting subsection (1) (e), a proposed plan may recommend a process for the resolution of disputes between water users.

heading: Plan content
paragraph: (3) A proposed plan may include, but is not limited to,

heading: Plan content
paragraph: (a) a description of the relationship of the plan to other provincial plans,

heading: Plan content
paragraph: (b) prescribed information, and

heading: Plan content
paragraph: (c) a recommended timeline for review of the plan.

heading: Submission of proposed plan to minister
paragraph:
74
		  (1) After a proposed water sustainability plan has been prepared, the responsible person may submit the proposed plan to the minister.

heading: Submission of proposed plan to minister
paragraph: (2) If a proposed plan submitted to the minister under subsection (1) recommends a significant change in respect of a licence or a drilling authorization and the holder of the licence or drilling authorization has consented to the change, the proposed plan must be accompanied by

heading: Submission of proposed plan to minister
paragraph: (a) a copy of the written consent of the holder of the licence or drilling authorization, and

heading: Submission of proposed plan to minister
paragraph: (b) a detailed proposal assigning to each person or other entity who would benefit from implementation of the recommendation some or all of the responsibility for compensating the licensee or drilling authorization holder, consented to in writing by each such person.

heading: Submission of proposed plan to minister
paragraph: (3) If a proposed plan submitted to the minister under subsection (1) recommends a significant change in respect of a licence or a drilling authorization and the holder of the licence or drilling authorization has not consented to the change, the proposed plan must be accompanied by

heading: Submission of proposed plan to minister
paragraph: (a) a list of the affected licences and drilling authorizations,

heading: Submission of proposed plan to minister
paragraph: (b) a statement of the public benefit from the significant change, and

heading: Submission of proposed plan to minister
paragraph: (c) a statement of any available source of funding to pay compensation or for compensatory measures for the involuntary significant changes.

heading: Submission of proposed plan to minister
paragraph: (4) If the minister considers that a proposed plan submitted under subsection (1)

heading: Submission of proposed plan to minister
paragraph: (a) is incomplete,

heading: Submission of proposed plan to minister
paragraph: (b) does not comply with this Act or the regulations, or

heading: Submission of proposed plan to minister
paragraph: (c) is inconsistent with the terms of reference for the plan,

heading: Submission of proposed plan to minister
paragraph: the minister may require that the deficiencies in the plan be addressed and the plan be resubmitted under subsection (1) before the minister considers the plan.

heading: Acceptance of plan
paragraph:
75
		  (1) If a proposed water sustainability plan submitted to the minister under section 74 (1) does not contain a recommendation that a regulation or order under this or another Act be made in relation to the plan, the minister may accept all or part of the proposed plan as a water sustainability plan.

heading: Acceptance of plan
paragraph: (2) If a proposed water sustainability plan submitted to the minister under section 74 (1) contains a recommendation that a regulation or order under this or another Act be made in relation to the plan, the minister may place the following before the Lieutenant Governor in Council:

heading: Acceptance of plan
paragraph: (a) the proposed plan;

heading: Acceptance of plan
paragraph: (b) if the proposed plan recommends a significant change in respect of a licence or a drilling authorization, the details of any information provided to the minister in respect of the licence or drilling authorization under section 74 (2) or (3), as applicable;

heading: Acceptance of plan
paragraph: (c) any comments of the minister in respect of the proposed plan.

heading: Acceptance of plan
paragraph: (3) The Lieutenant Governor in Council, by regulation, may accept as a water sustainability plan all or part of a proposed plan placed before the Lieutenant Governor in Council under subsection (2).

heading: Acceptance of plan
paragraph: (4) Subject to section 117 (4) [delivery and publication of documents and information], the minister must arrange for a water sustainability plan accepted under this section to be published.

heading: Plan regulations - effect on statutory decisions
paragraph:
76
		  (1) In this section:

heading: Plan regulations - effect on statutory decisions
paragraph: "issue" includes replace, amend, extend and renew;

heading: Plan regulations - effect on statutory decisions
paragraph: "land or resource instrument" means an instrument that, under an enactment, authorizes the use of or disposes of Crown land or Crown natural resources.

heading: Plan regulations - effect on statutory decisions
paragraph: (2) For the purposes of a water sustainability plan, the Lieutenant Governor in Council, by regulation applicable in relation to all or part of the plan area, may do one or more of the following:

heading: Plan regulations - effect on statutory decisions
paragraph: (a) require that the plan be considered by a public officer making a specified decision under a specified enactment;

heading: Plan regulations - effect on statutory decisions
paragraph: (b) require or restrict the issuance of specified land or resource instruments by a public officer under a specified enactment;

heading: Plan regulations - effect on statutory decisions
paragraph: (c) prohibit the issuance of specified land or resource instruments by a public officer under a specified enactment, unless the specified enactment requires that the land or resource instruments be issued;

heading: Plan regulations - effect on statutory decisions
paragraph: (d) require or restrict the exercise by a public officer of a power under a specified enactment;

heading: Plan regulations - effect on statutory decisions
paragraph: (e) prohibit the exercise by a public officer of a power under a specified enactment, unless the specified enactment requires that the power be exercised.

heading: Plan regulations - effect on statutory decisions
paragraph: (3) A regulation under subsection (2) (b) may establish requirements that must be imposed by the public officer as terms and conditions on a land or resource instrument under the specified enactment.

heading: Plan regulations - effect on statutory decisions
paragraph: (4) A regulation under subsection (2) (d) may establish requirements that must be imposed on a person by the public officer in exercising a power under the specified enactment.

heading: Plan regulations - effect on statutory decisions
paragraph: (5) Requirements imposed under subsection (3) or (4) are deemed to be imposed under the enactment under which the land or resource instrument is issued or the power is exercised, as the case may be.

heading: Plan regulations - effect on statutory decisions
paragraph: (6) The issuance of a land or resource instrument contrary to a regulation under subsection (2) (b) or (c), or the exercise of a power contrary to a regulation under subsection (2) (d) or (e), has no effect.

heading: Plan regulations - effect on approval by approving officer
paragraph:
77
		  (1) In this section, "approving officer" has the same meaning as in section 1 of the Land Title Act.

heading: Plan regulations - effect on approval by approving officer
paragraph: (2) For the purposes of a water sustainability plan, the Lieutenant Governor in Council, by regulation applicable in relation to all or part of the plan area, may

heading: Plan regulations - effect on approval by approving officer
paragraph: (a) restrict the issuance of an approval of a plan requiring the approval of an approving officer under a specified enactment, or

heading: Plan regulations - effect on approval by approving officer
paragraph: (b) require an approving officer to reject a plan referred to in paragraph (a).

heading: Plan regulations - effect on approval by approving officer
paragraph: (3) A regulation under subsection (2) (a) may establish requirements that must be imposed as terms and conditions of an approval of a plan referred to in that subsection.

heading: Plan regulations - restriction or prohibition on use of land or resources
paragraph: 78		  (1) For the purposes of a water sustainability plan, the Lieutenant Governor in Council, by regulation applicable in relation to all or part of the plan area, may restrict or prohibit

heading: Plan regulations - restriction or prohibition on use of land or resources
paragraph: (a) a specified use of land or natural resources,

heading: Plan regulations - restriction or prohibition on use of land or resources
paragraph: (b) a specified activity in relation to land or natural resources, or

heading: Plan regulations - restriction or prohibition on use of land or resources
paragraph: (c) use of specified works.

heading: Plan regulations - restriction or prohibition on use of land or resources
paragraph: (2) A regulation under subsection (1) may be made applicable to any land or natural resources in British Columbia.

heading: Plan regulations - restriction or prohibition on use of land or resources
paragraph: (3) A regulation under subsection (1) applies whether or not the specified use or activity, or the use of the specified works, is authorized under an enactment, unless otherwise provided in the regulation.

heading: Plan regulations - reduction of water rights
paragraph:
79
		  (1) For the purposes of a water sustainability plan, the Lieutenant Governor in Council, by regulation applicable in relation to all or part of the plan area, may direct the comptroller or a water manager to

heading: Plan regulations - reduction of water rights
paragraph: (a) amend the terms and conditions of licences identified in the regulation, regardless of the precedence of the rights under those licences, to reduce, in accordance with the regulation, the maximum quantity of water that may be diverted under the licences from a specified stream or aquifer, or

heading: Plan regulations - reduction of water rights
paragraph: (b) cancel licences identified in the regulation.

heading: Plan regulations - reduction of water rights
paragraph: (2) Without limiting subsection (1), a regulation under that subsection must

heading: Plan regulations - reduction of water rights
paragraph: (a) identify the licences, specifically or by class, that are to be subject to the regulation, and

heading: Plan regulations - reduction of water rights
paragraph: (b) set out the method for calculating the reduction in water quantity applicable to each of those licences.

heading: Plan regulations - reduction of water rights
paragraph: (3) The precedence of the rights of the holder of a licence to the quantity of water the holder is authorized to divert after a reduction under subsection (1) is unaffected by the reduction in the quantity of water.

heading: Plan regulations - directions regarding works or operations
paragraph:
80
		  (1) For the purposes of a water sustainability plan, the Lieutenant Governor in Council, by regulation applicable in relation to all or part of the plan area, may direct the comptroller or a water manager to amend the terms and conditions of a licence to require the licensee to, in accordance with the regulations,

heading: Plan regulations - directions regarding works or operations
paragraph: (a) reduce the maximum rate of diversion of water that may be diverted under the licence,

heading: Plan regulations - directions regarding works or operations
paragraph: (b) alter the timing of diversion, use, including storage, of water under the licence,

heading: Plan regulations - directions regarding works or operations
paragraph: (c) construct, alter, install, replace, repair, maintain, improve, seal, deactivate, decommission or remove works, including for the more efficient use or conservation of water, under the licence,

heading: Plan regulations - directions regarding works or operations
paragraph: (d) adopt a more efficient practice, or

heading: Plan regulations - directions regarding works or operations
paragraph: (e) make other changes to works or operations of the licensee in relation to the licence, as set out in the regulation.

heading: Plan regulations - directions regarding works or operations
paragraph: (2) The rights of the holder of a licence amended by the comptroller or a water manager to comply with a regulation under subsection (1), other than rights in relation to the terms and conditions amended as required by the regulation, are unaffected by the amendment.

heading: Plan regulations - relationship with other planning processes
paragraph:
81
		  For the purposes of a water sustainability plan, the Lieutenant Governor in Council, by regulation, may do one or more of the following:

heading: Plan regulations - relationship with other planning processes
paragraph: (a) require that in other specified Provincial government or local authority strategic or operational planning processes, consideration be given to a specified part or all of the plan;

heading: Plan regulations - relationship with other planning processes
paragraph: (b) require that the results of specified Provincial government strategic or operational planning processes be consistent with a specified part or all of the plan;

heading: Plan regulations - relationship with other planning processes
paragraph: (c) provide that specified Provincial government strategic or operational plans do not have legal effect to the extent of any inconsistency with a specified part or all of the plan.

heading: Plan regulations - dedicated agricultural water
paragraph:
82
		  (1) For the purposes of a water sustainability plan, the Lieutenant Governor in Council, by regulation applicable to all or part of the plan area, may dedicate, for qualifying agricultural use on qualifying agricultural land in the plan area or part, a specified quantity of water, in a stream or aquifer, that is

heading: Plan regulations - dedicated agricultural water
paragraph: (a) both unrecorded and unreserved, or

heading: Plan regulations - dedicated agricultural water
paragraph: (b) held under a licence issued for a qualifying agricultural use on qualifying agricultural land in the plan area.

heading: Plan regulations - dedicated agricultural water
paragraph: (2) A dedication under this section applies to water that becomes unrecorded water by reason of the abandonment, cancellation or expiry of all or part of the rights under a licence

heading: Plan regulations - dedicated agricultural water
paragraph: (a) issued in respect of dedicated agricultural water described in subsection (1) (a), or

heading: Plan regulations - dedicated agricultural water
paragraph: (b) described in subsection (1) (b).

heading: Plan regulations - restrictions on groundwater activities
paragraph:
83
		  (1) For the purpose of a water sustainability plan, the Lieutenant Governor in Council, by regulation applicable in relation to all or part of the plan area, may restrict or prohibit one or more of the following or may impose requirements on a person doing one or more of the following:

heading: Plan regulations - restrictions on groundwater activities
paragraph: (a) constructing a well;

heading: Plan regulations - restrictions on groundwater activities
paragraph: (b) installing well pumps;

heading: Plan regulations - restrictions on groundwater activities
paragraph: (c) conducting flow tests;

heading: Plan regulations - restrictions on groundwater activities
paragraph: (d) performing another activity in relation to a well or groundwater.

heading: Plan regulations - restrictions on groundwater activities
paragraph: (2) Without limiting subsection (1), a restriction in a regulation under that subsection may include a requirement that a person hold a drilling authorization in order to carry out one or more of the activities referred to in section 62 (1) [drilling authorizations].

heading: Plan regulations - restrictions on groundwater activities
paragraph: (3) Without limiting subsection (1), a regulation under that subsection may require that the comptroller or a water manager amend or cancel a drilling authorization.

heading: General provisions in relation to plan regulations
paragraph:
84
		  (1) Subject to subsections (2) to (4), a plan regulation applies despite any other enactment.

heading: General provisions in relation to plan regulations
paragraph: (2) Subsection (1) does not apply in respect of a conflict between a plan regulation and any of the following enactments or regulations made under any of the following enactments:

heading: General provisions in relation to plan regulations
paragraph: (a) the Creston Valley Wildlife Act;

heading: General provisions in relation to plan regulations
paragraph: (b) the Drinking Water Protection Act;

heading: General provisions in relation to plan regulations
paragraph: (c) the Ecological Reserve Act;

heading: General provisions in relation to plan regulations
paragraph: (d) the Environment and Land Use Act;

heading: General provisions in relation to plan regulations
paragraph: (e) section 9 of the Greater Vancouver Water District Act;

heading: General provisions in relation to plan regulations
paragraph: (f) the Industrial Development Act;

heading: General provisions in relation to plan regulations
paragraph: (g) the Muskwa-Kechika Management Area Act;

heading: General provisions in relation to plan regulations
paragraph: (h) the Park Act;

heading: General provisions in relation to plan regulations
paragraph: (i) the Significant Projects Streamlining Act;

heading: General provisions in relation to plan regulations
paragraph: (j) the Water Protection Act;

heading: General provisions in relation to plan regulations
paragraph: (k) section 4 of the Wildlife Act;

heading: General provisions in relation to plan regulations
paragraph: (l) a prescribed enactment.

heading: General provisions in relation to plan regulations
paragraph: (3) A plan regulation does not apply to licences applied against a water reservation referred to in section 40 [treaty first nation water reservations] or 41 [Nisga'a water reservation].

heading: General provisions in relation to plan regulations
paragraph: (4) A plan regulation applies whether or not a right that is acquired, accrued or accruing, at any time before or after the regulation is made, is affected by the regulation.

heading: General provisions in relation to plan regulations
paragraph: (5) If the decision maker considers that the amendments made to a licence in accordance with regulations under section 79 [plan regulations - reduction of water rights] or 80 [plan regulations - directions regarding works or operations] would substantially change the licence, the decision maker may substitute a new licence.

heading: Review and amendment of plans
paragraph: 85		  (1) The minister, by order, may direct that a water sustainability plan be reviewed to determine whether the plan should be amended or cancelled.

heading: Review and amendment of plans
paragraph: (2) Except as provided by order of the minister, this Division applies to

heading: Review and amendment of plans
paragraph: (a) a review under subsection (1), and

heading: Review and amendment of plans
paragraph: (b) any amendment to a plan proposed by a review.

heading: Declarations of significant water shortage
paragraph:
86
		  (1) If the minister considers that one or more streams in an area have fallen or are at risk of falling below their critical environmental flow thresholds, the minister may make a temporary order declaring a significant water shortage in the area designated in the order.

heading: Declarations of significant water shortage
paragraph: (2) An order under subsection (1) must specify the term of the order, which term may not exceed 90 days.

heading: Declarations of significant water shortage
paragraph: (3) Whether or not a temporary order under subsection (1) has been made or expired, if the Lieutenant Governor in Council considers that one or more streams in an area have fallen or are at risk of falling below their critical environmental flow thresholds, the Lieutenant Governor in Council may make an order declaring a significant water shortage in the area designated in the order.

heading: Declarations of significant water shortage
paragraph: (4) When an order of the Lieutenant Governor in Council under subsection (3) comes into force, an order under subsection (1) in relation to the same designated area expires.

heading: Declarations of significant water shortage
paragraph: (5) Section 124 (4) (d) [general regulation-making powers] applies to an area designated in an order under subsection (1) or (3).

heading: Critical environmental flow protection orders
paragraph:
87
		  (1) If an order under section 86 (1) or (3) is in force, the comptroller must, for the purposes of section 22 (9) [precedence of rights], by order, determine in accordance with any applicable regulations, the critical environmental flow threshold for each stream that meets all of the following criteria:

heading: Critical environmental flow protection orders
paragraph: (a) the stream is in the area designated in the order and has a regionally significant aquatic ecosystem;

heading: Critical environmental flow protection orders
paragraph: (b) water is being diverted from the stream under this Act or the stream is hydraulically connected to an aquifer from which water is being diverted under this Act;

heading: Critical environmental flow protection orders
paragraph: (c) the comptroller considers that enforcing the precedence of the stream's critical environmental flow threshold under section 22 (9) will assist in preventing significant or irreversible harm to the aquatic ecosystem of the stream.

heading: Critical environmental flow protection orders
paragraph: (2) If the comptroller considers that more than one stream in an area to which an order under section 86 (1) or (3) applies is described in subsection (1), the comptroller may determine the critical environmental flow thresholds for the streams based on the degree of benefit the comptroller considers the aquatic ecosystems of the streams would derive from enforcement of the precedence of their critical environmental flow thresholds, in descending order, beginning with the stream that would derive greatest benefit and stopping

heading: Critical environmental flow protection orders
paragraph: (a) when the critical environmental flow threshold has been determined for all of the streams described in subsection (1), or

heading: Critical environmental flow protection orders
paragraph: (b) if the order under section 86 (1) or (3) expires before paragraph (a) applies, upon that expiry.

heading: Critical environmental flow protection orders
paragraph: (3) An order under subsection (1) is final and may not be appealed to the appeal board.

heading: Critical environmental flow protection orders
paragraph: (4) An order under subsection (1) and the implementation, under this Act, of the precedence provided for in section 22 (9) apply

heading: Critical environmental flow protection orders
paragraph: (a) despite the rights of any person who, under this Act, is diverting or using water from the stream or the aquifer hydraulically connected to the stream, as the case may be, and

heading: Critical environmental flow protection orders
paragraph: (b) whether or not a right that is acquired, accrued or accruing under this Act at any time before or after the coming into force of this section is affected by the order.

heading: Fish population protection orders
paragraph:
88
		  (1) If the minister considers that the flow of water in a specified stream is or is likely to become so low that the survival of a population of fish in the stream may be or may become threatened, the minister may make an order respecting the diversion, rate of diversion, time of diversion, or use, including storage and time of storage, of water from the specified stream, or a specified aquifer hydraulically connected to the stream, regardless of the precedence set out in section 22 [precedence of rights].

heading: Fish population protection orders
paragraph: (2) The minister may make an order under subsection (1) only after giving due consideration to the needs of agricultural users.

heading: Fish population protection orders
paragraph: (3) An order under subsection (1) must specify the term of the order.

heading: Fish population protection orders
paragraph: (4) An order under subsection (1) applies

heading: Fish population protection orders
paragraph: (a) despite the rights of any person who, under this Act, is diverting or using water from the specified stream or the specified aquifer, as the case may be, and

heading: Fish population protection orders
paragraph: (b) whether or not a right that is acquired, accrued or accruing under this Act at any time before or after the coming into force of this section is affected by the order.

heading: Right of access to land and premises by authorized persons
paragraph:
89
		  (1) The following persons may enter onto any land or premises for the purpose of exercising powers or performing duties under this Act or another enactment:

heading: Right of access to land and premises by authorized persons
paragraph: (a) the comptroller, a water manager or an engineer, or a person working under the direction of the comptroller, a water manager or an engineer;

heading: Right of access to land and premises by authorized persons
paragraph: (b) an officer, a drinking water officer or a water bailiff;

heading: Right of access to land and premises by authorized persons
paragraph: (c) an employee or officer of a municipality, regional district, improvement district, development district or water users' community;

heading: Right of access to land and premises by authorized persons
paragraph: (d) a holder of a licence that authorizes the carriage or supply of water or electricity to the public.

heading: Right of access to land and premises by authorized persons
paragraph: (2) The authority under this section must not be used to enter into a private dwelling except with the consent of the occupant or as authorized by a warrant issued under this or another Act.

heading: Right of access to land and premises by authorized persons
paragraph: (3) A person authorized under this section or section 90 to enter onto land or premises may call on the assistance of a peace officer.

heading: Right of access to land and premises by authorized persons
paragraph: (4) If requested to do so, a peace officer may accompany a person referred to in subsection (3) and do anything necessary to assist the person in the exercise of the powers or performance of the duties in respect of which the entry is made.

heading: Entry warrant
paragraph:
90
		  If satisfied by evidence on oath or affirmation that entry onto land or premises, including premises occupied as a private dwelling, is necessary for the purposes of this Act, a justice may issue a warrant authorizing any of the following persons to enter onto that land or those premises for the purpose of exercising powers or performing duties under this Act:

heading: Entry warrant
paragraph: (a) the comptroller, a water manager, an engineer, a drinking water officer or an officer;

heading: Entry warrant
paragraph: (b) a person authorized by the comptroller or a water manager to carry out an order made under this Act;

heading: Entry warrant
paragraph: (c) a person responsible for preparing a proposed water sustainability plan if the minister has given direction under section 72 (1) (c) [powers for development of plan] applying section 89 to the person.

heading: Power of comptroller to authorize actions
paragraph:
91
		  (1) If a person to whom an order of the comptroller, a water manager or an engineer is directed fails to do the things ordered, the comptroller may authorize the government or another person to do those things and the person to whom the order was directed is liable for the costs of the government or that other person, as applicable, of complying with the order.

heading: Power of comptroller to authorize actions
paragraph: (2) Any expense reasonably incurred by the other person in the exercise of authority provided under subsection (1), unless the person is acting on behalf of the government, may be recovered from the person liable as money paid for, and at the request of, the person liable.

heading: Power of comptroller to authorize actions
paragraph: (3) If work is carried out under subsection (1) by or on behalf of the government, the costs to the government are a debt due to the government by the person liable and may be recovered in accordance with section 98 [recovery of amounts owing for work performed].

heading: Power of comptroller to authorize actions
paragraph: (4) If the comptroller considers that it is in the public interest that things should be done to mitigate an imminent and significant risk or hazard to public safety, the environment, land or other property, the comptroller may authorize that things be done to reduce or eliminate the risk or hazard, including, without limitation, any of the following actions:

heading: Power of comptroller to authorize actions
paragraph: (a) construct, alter, install, replace, repair, maintain, improve, seal, deactivate, decommission or remove works;

heading: Power of comptroller to authorize actions
paragraph: (b) make changes in and about a stream;

heading: Power of comptroller to authorize actions
paragraph: (c) divert water whether or not for a water use purpose;

heading: Power of comptroller to authorize actions
paragraph: (d) engage the services of, or require a report of, a person authorized under the regulations in relation to the services or report;

heading: Power of comptroller to authorize actions
paragraph: (e) any action reasonably required for that purpose.

heading: Power of comptroller to authorize actions
paragraph: (5) If things done under subsection (4) were necessary because a person failed to carry out an order, the costs to the government are a debt due to the government of the person to whom the order was directed and may be recovered in accordance with section 98.

heading: Power of comptroller to authorize actions
paragraph: (6) A person authorized by the comptroller under this section may enter onto land or premises at any reasonable time and may take along any other persons or equipment as may be necessary for the purpose of doing the things that person is authorized to do.

heading: Power of comptroller to authorize actions
paragraph: (7) The authority under subsection (6) must not be used to enter into a private dwelling except with the consent of the occupant or as authorized by a warrant issued under this or another Act.

heading: Power to amend or revoke order
paragraph:
92
		  (1) The comptroller, at any time on notice to any person whose rights the comptroller considers are likely to be detrimentally affected, or whose land the comptroller considers is likely to be physically affected, may amend or revoke an order of the comptroller, a water manager, an engineer, an officer, the Water Board or the Board of Investigation.

heading: Power to amend or revoke order
paragraph: (2) A water manager, at any time on notice to any person whose rights the water manager considers are likely to be detrimentally affected, or whose land the water manager considers is likely to be physically affected, may amend or revoke any order of a water manager, an engineer, an officer, the Water Board or the Board of Investigation.

heading: Power to amend or revoke order
paragraph: (3) An engineer, at any time on notice to any person whose rights the engineer considers are likely to be detrimentally affected, or whose land the engineer considers is likely to be physically affected may amend or revoke any order of an engineer or an officer.

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph:
93
		  (1) An order under this section may be directed to any person who has a right, permission or obligation under this Act, including, without limitation,

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (a) in the case of works in respect of which an authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization is required, to a person who holds the authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization, as applicable, authorizing the construction or use of the works,

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (b) in the case of works for which no authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization is required, to a person who constructs or installs the works, owns the works or is the owner of the land on which the works are located,

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (c) in the case of the diversion or use of water under an authorization or change approval, to a person who holds the authorization or change approval,

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (d) in the case of the diversion or use of water other than under an authorization or change approval, to the person who is diverting or using the water without an authorization or change approval, whether or not an authorization or change approval is required,

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (e) in the case of works for which an authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization is required but has not been obtained, to the person who has constructed or is using the works,

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (f) in relation to changes in and about a stream, to the person who made the changes in and about a stream or a person who derives a benefit from those changes in and about a stream, and

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (g) in relation to a matter respecting groundwater or a well, to a person responsible within the meaning of section 48 [definitions for Division 3 of Part 3].

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (2) In addition to the other powers given under this Act, for the purpose of enforcing the provisions of this Act, the regulations or the terms and conditions of an authorization, change approval, permit, drilling authorization or compliance agreement, or administering precedence of rights in relation to the diversion or use of water, an engineer may do one or more of the following:

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (a) inspect, take action, close or lock works;

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (b) inspect or take action in relation to the construction of works;

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (c) determine whether water is being beneficially used;

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (d) order the construction, alteration, installation, replacement, repair, maintenance, improvement, sealing, deactivation, decommissioning or removal of any works;

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (e) order

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (i)  a person who makes changes in and about a stream or any person who derives a benefit from the changes in and about a stream to restore or remediate those changes, or

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (ii)  if the engineer considers that the impacts of changes in and about a stream made by that person cannot be remediated, or cannot be fully remediated, at the location of the changes in and about the stream, compensatory mitigation measures, in place of or supplemental to other remediation measures, on a different part of the stream in respect of which changes were made, or with the consent of the person, on another stream;

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (f) order the construction, installation and maintenance of a measuring or testing device in addition to any construction, installation or maintenance of measuring or testing devices required under the regulations;

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (g) order the operation of, and provision of data from, a measuring or testing device in addition to any operation or provision of data required under the regulations;

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (h) order a person who is not subject to the regulations in relation to the measuring, testing or reporting under section 131 [regulations respecting measuring, testing and reporting] to comply with specified regulations or to otherwise measure, test and report in relation to water usage or works;

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (i) in person or through an officer or a water bailiff, make orders and take action with respect to the diversion, rate of diversion, time of diversion, carriage, distribution and use, including storage and time of storage, of water;

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (j) in accordance with directions of the comptroller or a water manager, give directions, in person or through an officer, to a water bailiff to

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (i)  take action respecting the diversion, rate of diversion, time of diversion, carriage, distribution or use, including storage and time of storage, of water from the streams and aquifers specified in the water bailiff's appointment,

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (ii)  take action respecting works related to the activities referred to in subparagraph (i), and

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (iii)  take measures to carry out the operation, routine repair or maintenance of works;

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (k) order the release of stored or impounded water that the engineer considers to be a danger to public safety or property;

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (l) order the owner of a flowing artesian well, or if the owner of the well is not known, the owner of the land on which the well is situated, to engage a well driller who is qualified in respect of the activity or a professional, as defined in section 48 [definitions for Division 3 of Part 3], to ensure that the artesian flow of that well is stopped or brought under control in accordance with section 53 [controlling flowing artesian well];

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (m) order a change in the operation of a well that is being operated contrary to section 58 [well operation] and give directions respecting the operation of the well;

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (n) order a person to remediate or mitigate any impact on an aquifer, groundwater or the existing uses of groundwater that results because a well was sited, constructed, floodproofed or operated other than in accordance with the requirements of this Act or the regulations;

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (o) install measuring or testing devices;

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (p) take measurements of or test

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (i)  water in a stream or aquifer,

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (ii)  the flow of water in a stream or aquifer, or

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (iii)  works;

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (q) determine the allowances of water to offset evaporation, seepage and other losses.

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (3) An order under subsection (2) may be made subject to any terms and conditions the engineer considers advisable.

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (4) In accordance with directions of an engineer, an officer may do one or more of the following:

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (a) take action, close or lock works;

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (b) take action in relation to the construction of works;

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (c) install measuring or testing devices;

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (d) take measurements of or test

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (i)  water in a stream or aquifer,

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (ii)  the flow of water in a stream or aquifer, or

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (iii)  works;

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (e) in person or through a water bailiff, take action with respect to the diversion, rate of diversion, time of diversion, carriage, distribution and use, including storage and time of storage, of water;

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (f) take action respecting works related to the activities referred to in paragraph (e), or direct a water bailiff to do so;

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (g) direct a water bailiff to take measures to carry out the operation, routine repair or maintenance of those works.

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (5) An officer may inspect

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (a) works,

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (b) the construction, deactivation or decommissioning of works,

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (c) an existing or proposed water use,

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (d) an activity or changes in and about a stream, and

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (e) records related to a matter referred to in paragraphs (a) to (d).

heading: Powers of engineers and officers
paragraph: (6) For the purposes of section 94 (8), an engineer or officer may examine the works authorized under an authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization or the place of use referred to in an authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization and make a finding referred to in that section.

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph:
94
		  (1) Some or all of the rights of the holder under an authorization, or the permission granted to the holder under a change approval, permit or drilling authorization, may be suspended for any period, and an authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization and the rights or permissions under it may be cancelled in whole or in part, by the comptroller or a water manager, in any of the following circumstances:

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (a) the holder of the authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization fails to construct the works authorized, within the time specified, by the authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization;

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (b) the holder of the authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization fails to comply with this Act or the regulations;

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (c) the holder of the authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization fails to comply with a term or condition of the authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization;

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (d) the holder of the authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization fails to comply with an order of the comptroller, a water manager or an engineer, whether given directly or through an officer or water bailiff;

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (e) the holder of the authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization makes a material misstatement or misrepresentation in the application or in information provided to the comptroller, a water manager or an engineer with respect to the authorization, change approval, permit, drilling authorization or application;

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (f) the title of the holder of the authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization to the land, mine or undertaking to which the authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization is appurtenant, is cancelled or otherwise terminated, if the cancellation or termination results from the operation of a statute or the exercise of a statutory authority;

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (g) in the case of a licence, the licensee fails to make beneficial use of the water for 3 successive years;

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (h) in the case of a licence, the licensee makes a material misstatement or misrepresentation in a beneficial use declaration;

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (i) in the case of a use approval, the holder makes a material misstatement or misrepresentation in information required to be provided under section 30 (6) [beneficial use];

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (j) in the case of an authorization, the holder fails for 2 years after the due date to pay any amount due to the government in respect of the authorization;

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (k) in the case of an authorization, the holder fails for 180 days after the due date to pay a water bailiff's fees or expenses payable by that authorization holder.

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (2) If a decision maker proposes to suspend rights under an authorization or permissions under a change approval, permit or drilling authorization, the decision maker must deliver to the person exercising the rights, or to the person occupying the land to which the authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization is appurtenant, 3 days' written notice of the proposal and, if the decision maker considers the matter urgent, the rights or permissions may be suspended immediately on verbal notice and without a hearing.

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (3) If the decision maker proposes to cancel an authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization that is appurtenant to land, the decision maker must give written notice of the proposal to every person who has notified the comptroller or a water manager that the person has an interest in the land.

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (3.1) If land referred to in subsection (3) comprises more than 6 parcels, the decision maker may, for the purposes of satisfying the requirement to give written notice under that subsection, give notice of the proposal by publication of at least one insertion each week for 3 consecutive weeks in a newspaper that circulates in the area in which the land is located.

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (4) If the decision maker proposes to cancel an authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization that is not appurtenant to land, the decision maker must deliver to the holder of the authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization, and to every person who has notified the comptroller or a water manager that the person has an interest in the authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization, notice of the proposal to cancel the authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization, as applicable.

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (5) If, within 30 days after delivering a notice under subsection (2), (3) or (4), or the last publication of a notice under subsection (3.1), as applicable, an objection to the proposed suspension or cancellation is filed with the decision maker by a person claiming a legal or beneficial interest in the authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization, the decision maker must decide whether the objection warrants a hearing and if the decision maker decides to hold a hearing orally, either in person or electronically, sections 95 to 97 apply.

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (6) The decision maker may hold a hearing in writing, electronically or in person or by any combination of written, electronic or in-person hearings.

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (7) Whether or not the decision maker decides under subsection (5) to hold a hearing, the decision maker must

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (a) determine whether the alleged grounds for suspension or cancellation are substantiated, and

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (b) make the order the decision maker considers advisable.

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (8) If a proposal to cancel or suspend an authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization is based on an engineer's or officer's report to the decision maker

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (a) that the engineer or officer examined the works authorized under an authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization and found them unfit or unsuitable for use, or

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (b) in the case of an authorization, that the engineer or officer examined the place of use referred to in the authorization and found no indication of recent beneficial use of water in accordance with the authorization,

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: the holder of the authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization, as applicable, must prove to the satisfaction of the decision maker that the holder of the authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization has complied with this Act, the regulations and the authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization.

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (9) The rights, permissions and duties of the different holders under an authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization are separable, and fulfillment by one holder of the holder's duties under the authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization does not prevent or delay the suspension or cancellation of the rights or permissions of another holder of that authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization.

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (10) If an authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization has been cancelled in part, the decision maker may issue in substitution to the holder of the authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization, subject to prescribed terms and conditions and on the terms and conditions the decision maker considers advisable but with the same precedence as the authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization under which the cancelled rights were granted,

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (a) in the case of a licence, as applicable,

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (i)  a conditional licence or a modified conditional licence, or

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (ii)  a final licence or modified final licence, and

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (b) in the case of a use approval, change approval or drilling authorization, a modified use approval, change approval or drilling authorization, as applicable,

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: but the holder of the authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization does not, by the issue of the new or modified authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization, obtain or retain any right that has been cancelled.

heading: Suspension and cancellation of rights and permissions
paragraph: (11) An order of the decision maker to cancel in whole or in part an authorization and all rights under it under subsection (1) (j) or (k), is final and may not be appealed to the appeal board.

heading: Inquiry powers
paragraph:
95
		  (1) If it appears to the comptroller, a water manager or an engineer that the proper determination of a matter within the comptroller's, water manager's or engineer's jurisdiction requires a public or other inquiry or hearing, the comptroller, water manager or engineer, as applicable, may hold that inquiry or hearing.

heading: Inquiry powers
paragraph: (2) A decision maker holding an inquiry or hearing under this section may make an order requiring a person to do either or both of the following:

heading: Inquiry powers
paragraph: (a) attend, in person or by electronic means, before the decision maker to answer questions on oath or affirmation, or in another manner;

heading: Inquiry powers
paragraph: (b) produce for the decision maker a record or thing in the person's possession or control.

heading: Inquiry powers
paragraph: (3) A decision maker holding an inquiry under this section may apply to the Supreme Court for an order

heading: Inquiry powers
paragraph: (a) directing a person to comply with an order made under subsection (2), or

heading: Inquiry powers
paragraph: (b) directing any directors and officers of a person to cause the person to comply with an order made under subsection (2).

heading: Maintenance of order at hearings
paragraph:
96
		  (1) A decision maker holding an inquiry or hearing under section 95 may make orders or give directions that the decision maker considers necessary for the maintenance of order at the inquiry or hearing, and, if a person disobeys or fails to comply with an order or direction, the decision maker may call on the assistance of a peace officer to enforce the order or direction.

heading: Maintenance of order at hearings
paragraph: (2) A peace officer called on under subsection (1) may do anything that is necessary to enforce the order or direction and may use such force as is reasonably required for that purpose.

heading: Maintenance of order at hearings
paragraph: (3) Without limiting subsection (1), a decision maker holding an inquiry or hearing under this Act, by order, may

heading: Maintenance of order at hearings
paragraph: (a) impose restrictions on a person's continued participation in or attendance at the inquiry or hearing, and

heading: Maintenance of order at hearings
paragraph: (b) exclude a person from further participation in or attendance at the inquiry or hearing until that decision maker orders otherwise.

heading: Contempt proceeding for uncooperative person
paragraph:
97
		  (1)  The failure or refusal of a person who is subject to an order under section 95 to do any of the following makes the person, on application to the Supreme Court by the decision maker who made the order, liable to be committed for contempt as if the person were in breach of an order or judgment of the Supreme Court:

heading: Contempt proceeding for uncooperative person
paragraph: (a) attend before the decision maker;

heading: Contempt proceeding for uncooperative person
paragraph: (b) take an oath or make an affirmation;

heading: Contempt proceeding for uncooperative person
paragraph: (c) answer questions;

heading: Contempt proceeding for uncooperative person
paragraph: (d) produce records or things in the person's possession or control.

heading: Contempt proceeding for uncooperative person
paragraph: (2) The failure or refusal of a person who is subject to an order or direction under section 96 to comply with the order or direction makes the person, on application to the Supreme Court by the decision maker who made the order or gave the direction, liable to be committed for contempt as if the person were in breach of an order or judgment of the Supreme Court.

heading: Contempt proceeding for uncooperative person
paragraph: (3) Subsections (1) and (2) do not limit the conduct for which a finding of contempt may be made by the Supreme Court.

heading: Recovery of amounts owing for work performed
paragraph:
98
		  (1) If, under a provision of this Act, costs to the government in carrying out an order that was directed to a person who failed to comply with the order may be recovered in accordance with this section or amounts owed to a water bailiff are assigned to the government, the comptroller may recover the costs or amounts owing by

heading: Recovery of amounts owing for work performed
paragraph: (a) issuing a certificate that

heading: Recovery of amounts owing for work performed
paragraph: (i)  in the case of work performed by the government,

heading: Recovery of amounts owing for work performed
paragraph: (A) sets out the reasonable costs the government incurred in complying with the order, and

heading: Recovery of amounts owing for work performed
paragraph: (B) identifies the person to whom the order was directed,

heading: Recovery of amounts owing for work performed
paragraph: (ii)  in the case of amounts assigned by a water bailiff,

heading: Recovery of amounts owing for work performed
paragraph: (A) sets out the reasonable costs of the work performed or expenses incurred by the water bailiff, and

heading: Recovery of amounts owing for work performed
paragraph: (B) identifies the person as liable for those costs and expenses, and

heading: Recovery of amounts owing for work performed
paragraph: (iii)  specifies all or some of the amounts set out under subparagraph (i) (A) or (ii) (A) as payable by the person identified in the certificate,

heading: Recovery of amounts owing for work performed
paragraph: (b) delivering notice of the certificate to the person identified in the certificate, and

heading: Recovery of amounts owing for work performed
paragraph: (c) filing the certificate with a court that has jurisdiction.

heading: Recovery of amounts owing for work performed
paragraph: (2) If an order referred to in subsection (1) was directed at more than one person, or more than one person is liable for the costs and expenses of the water bailiff, the certificate under that subsection

heading: Recovery of amounts owing for work performed
paragraph: (a) may apportion the costs to be paid among the persons to whom the order was directed and specify the amount payable by each person, and

heading: Recovery of amounts owing for work performed
paragraph: (b) may specify that 2 or more of the persons identified in the certificate are jointly and separately liable to pay all or a portion of the costs.

heading: Recovery of amounts owing for work performed
paragraph: (3) A certificate that is filed in a court under this section has the same effect, and all proceedings may be taken on the certificate, as if it were a judgment of the court with which it is filed for the recovery of a debt of the person identified, in the amount stated, in the certificate.

heading: Administrative monetary penalties
paragraph:
99
		  (1) The comptroller may take the actions authorized under this Division in accordance with the regulations, if the comptroller is satisfied on a balance of probabilities that a person has

heading: Administrative monetary penalties
paragraph: (a) contravened a prescribed provision of this Act or the regulations,

heading: Administrative monetary penalties
paragraph: (b) failed to comply with an order under this Act, or

heading: Administrative monetary penalties
paragraph: (c) failed to comply with a term or condition of an authorization, change approval, permit or drilling authorization.

heading: Administrative monetary penalties
paragraph: (2) In the circumstances referred to in subsection (1), the comptroller may deliver to the person an administrative monetary penalty notice

heading: Administrative monetary penalties
paragraph: (a) identifying the person's contravention or failure as determined by the comptroller,

heading: Administrative monetary penalties
paragraph: (b) imposing an administrative monetary penalty in an amount not greater than the prescribed amount, and

heading: Administrative monetary penalties
paragraph: (c) requiring the person to pay the administrative monetary penalty specified in the notice.

heading: Administrative monetary penalties
paragraph: (3) In determining the amount of an administrative monetary penalty, the comptroller must consider the following:

heading: Administrative monetary penalties
paragraph: (a) previous contraventions or failures by, administrative penalties imposed on or orders issued to

heading: Administrative monetary penalties
paragraph: (i)  the person,

heading: Administrative monetary penalties
paragraph: (ii)  if the person is an individual, a corporation for which the individual is or was an officer, director or agent, and

heading: Administrative monetary penalties
paragraph: (iii)  if the person is a corporation, an individual who is or was an officer, director or agent of the corporation;

heading: Administrative monetary penalties
